Pumpkin helps nourish the stomach, promote fluid production, and stimulate intestinal peristalsis.

tips_en: Soak the black rice before making porridge so it fully absorbs water. Cook the rice in the soaking water to preserve the nutrients.

description_en: Corn can not only stimulate gastrointestinal motility and prevent constipation, but also promote cholesterol metabolism and accelerate the excretion of intestinal toxins. Sweet potatoes can replenish the blood, replenish qi, promote fluid production, and widen the intestines and stomach. This porridge can promote digestion and maintain intestinal detoxification.

tips_en: Corn becomes moldy and deteriorates due to moisture, producing aflatoxin, which is carcinogenic and should not be eaten.

description_zh: 木瓜薏米银耳羹是以木瓜为主要食材的一道菜品，具有调理肠胃、滋阴补阴、清肺润肺、清热去火、抗衰老、丰胸、润肤美肤等功效。
description_en: Papaya barley and white fungus soup is a dish with papaya as the main ingredient. It has the functions of regulating the stomach and intestines, nourishing yin, clearing and moisturizing the lungs, clearing heat and removing internal heat, anti-aging, breast enhancement, moisturizing and beautifying the skin.
tips_zh: 木瓜中的番木瓜碱，对人体有小毒，每次食量不宜过多，过敏体质者应慎食。怀孕时不能吃木瓜只是怕引起宫收缩腹痛，但不会影响胎儿。
tips_en: Papain in papaya is slightly toxic, so don't eat too much at a time; those with allergies should eat with caution. Pregnant women avoid papaya because of the risk of uterine contractions and abdominal pain, not because it harms the fetus.

steps.content_zh: 木瓜去皮去籽切块，烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入木瓜与冰糖，搅拌。

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间结束后即可享用。
steps.content_en: Serve after cooking time is complete.

name_en: Oatmeal and purple sweet potato porridge
description_zh: 燕麦紫薯粥是一款养生又美味的食品，取材简单，在家里就可以制作，而且制作方法很简单。还可以根据不同口味的人来添加白糖等调味品。此粥有滋润降燥，通便，降血压和胆固醇等功效。不论大人、小孩还是老人，都非常适合食用。
description_en: Purple sweet potato oat congee is a healthy, delicious dish that is easy to make at home with simple ingredients. Add sugar or other seasonings to taste. It moisturizes, relieves dryness, aids bowel movements, and helps lower blood pressure and cholesterol. It suits adults, children, and the elderly alike.
tips_zh: 食用燕麦一次不宜太多，否则会造成胃痉挛或是胀气。
tips_en: Don't eat too much oats at once, or it may cause stomach cramps or bloating.

steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

description_zh: 南瓜的营养成分较全，营养价值也较高。嫩南瓜中维生素C及葡萄糖含量比老南瓜丰富。老南瓜钙、铁、胡萝卜素含量较高。这些对防治哮喘病均较有利。而南瓜小米粥即可护理肠胃，又可清火滋阴。
description_en: Pumpkin is highly nutritious. Young pumpkin has more vitamin C and glucose, while mature pumpkin has more calcium, iron and carotene—all helpful in preventing asthma. Pumpkin and millet porridge soothes the stomach, clears internal heat and nourishes yin.
tips_zh: 中医学认为：南瓜味甘，性温，具有补中益气、消痰止咳的功能，可治气虚乏力、肋间神经痛、疟疾、痢疾等症，但体胃热炽盛者应少食。
tips_en: Traditional Chinese medicine believes that pumpkin is sweet in taste and warm in nature. It has the functions of replenishing qi, eliminating phlegm and relieving cough. It can treat qi deficiency, intercostal neuralgia, malaria, dysentery and other diseases. However, those with excessive body and stomach heat should eat less.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味。
steps.content_en: After completion, you can add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 花生可使儿童智力提高，促进细胞发育，有增强大脑的记忆功能，并且有效地防止人体过早衰老，具有抗老化作用。
description_en: Peanuts can boost children's intelligence, promote cell growth, enhance memory, and effectively prevent premature aging.
tips_zh: 生食花生米易患病，花生在地里生长时，其外壳多被病菌或寄生虫卵污染，生食时很容易受其感染而患各种疾病。
tips_en: Eating raw peanuts can make you sick: while growing underground, their shells are often contaminated with bacteria or parasite eggs, so eating them raw can easily cause various infections and diseases.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味。

description_en: It has the effects of strengthening the spleen and stomach, eliminating stagnation and losing weight, replenishing qi and calming the nerves. Regular consumption of eight-treasure porridge can be used to prevent the occurrence of obesity. It is also a daily health and fitness food.
tips_zh: 八宝粥的原料不一定要限制以上的几种，可以根据个人的爱好放入其他原料。
tips_en: The raw materials of eight-treasure porridge do not have to be limited to the above, and other raw materials can be added according to personal preferences.

name_en: Purple sweet potato and millet congee
description_zh:
紫薯中的硒和铁是人体抗疲劳、抗衰老、补血的必要元素，特别是硒被称为“抗癌大王”，易被人体吸收，可留在血清中，修补心肌，增强机体免疫力。
小米有清热、清渴，滋阴，补脾肾肠胃，利小便、治水泻等功效。
description_en:
The selenium and iron in purple sweet potatoes are essential for fighting fatigue, aging and replenishing blood. Selenium, dubbed the "anti-cancer king," is easily absorbed, stays in the bloodstream, repairs heart muscle and boosts immunity.
Millet clears heat and quenches thirst, nourishes yin, tonifies the spleen, kidneys and stomach, promotes urination and helps relieve diarrhea.
tips_zh: 紫薯保存时须保持干燥，不宜放在塑料袋中。
tips_en: Keep purple sweet potatoes dry when storing; do not keep them in plastic bags.

steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 完成后根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味即可
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 南瓜粥比较清热对胃好 ；燕麦粥跟粗粮类似，利于排毒；黑米可以补血养颜，滋阴补肾，加强胃肠蠕动，帮助食物消化。
description_en: Pumpkin porridge clears away heat and is good for the stomach; oatmeal is similar to whole grains and is good for detoxification; black rice can nourish blood and nourish the skin, nourish yin and kidneys, strengthen gastrointestinal motility, and help digest food.
tips_zh: 挑选南瓜时，金黄色的南瓜，颜色越深黄，条纹越清楚、越粗重，就越成熟；绿色的南瓜，绿得发黑的是成熟南瓜。
tips_en: When selecting pumpkins, golden pumpkins, the darker the color, the clearer and thicker the stripes, the more mature they are; green pumpkins, the ones that are green and black are mature pumpkins.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 黑米洗净提前浸泡半天
steps.content_en: Wash the black rice and soak it for half a day in advance

steps.content_zh: 南瓜切块备用，燕麦洗净后与泡好的黑米同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：粥--稠--1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Cut the pumpkin into cubes and set aside. Wash the oats and put them into the pot at the same time as the soaked black rice. Add water to the water level line: porridge-thickness-1 position and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余90分钟时放入南瓜。。完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味
steps.content_en: With 90 minutes left, add the pumpkin. Once done, add sugar to taste

description_zh: 《黄帝内经》中有“五谷为养”之说，五谷为养人养生之根本。杂粮中含有多种谷物，其营养全面、结构平衡，富含多种微量元素。多食杂粮饭有助于降低血压、调节血糖、减肥瘦身。
description_en: The Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic says 'the five grains are nourishment'—the foundation of a healthy diet. Mixed grains offer complete, balanced nutrition and are rich in trace elements. Eating more mixed-grain rice helps lower blood pressure, regulate blood sugar, and support weight loss.
tips_zh: 有肠道疾病的人群不宜食用过多粗粮，粗粮膳食纤维含量较高不宜消化，容易加重病情。
tips_en: People with intestinal disorders should not eat too much whole grain; its high dietary fiber is hard to digest and may worsen the condition.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 黑米、燕麦、大麦米提前浸泡半天。
steps.content_en: Soak the black rice, oats, and pearl barley for half a day in advance.

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净后与所有原料放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2.5的位置。
steps.content_en: After washing the rice, put it into the pot with all the raw materials, and add water to the water level: 2.5 meters northeast.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成即可食用。
steps.content_en: Serve once cooking is complete.

description_zh: 二米饭能提高蛋白质吸收率。大米约含75%淀粉，是人体热量主要来源，而小米能养胃，还有减轻皱纹、色斑等功效，其蛋白质营养价值却低于大米，二米饭最大作用能够功能互补。一般来说，食物中的蛋白质必须经过肠胃道消化，分解成氨基酸才能被人体吸收利用，但不是所有食物所提供的蛋白质都能被人体吸收。二米饭中的蛋白质混合使用，取长补短，提高蛋白质利用率。
description_en: Mixed white rice and millet improves protein absorption. White rice is about 75% starch and a main source of energy, while millet nourishes the stomach and may reduce wrinkles and age spots, though its protein value is lower. Together they complement each other. Generally, dietary protein must be digested into amino acids before the body can use it—and not all protein is fully absorbed. Combining the two grains' proteins balances their strengths and raises protein utilization.
tips_zh: 淘洗小米时不宜用力搓洗，否则会造成营养流失。
tips_en: It is not advisable to scrub vigorously when washing millet, otherwise it will cause nutrient loss.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 大米和小米洗净后同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米3左右的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and millet and put them into the pot at the same time. Add water to the water level line: about 3 meters northeast, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 糙米有8种氨基酸、16种矿物质、21种维生素，它给人类的营养是完整的、全面的、天然的。核桃含有丰富的不饱和脂肪酸，经常食用核桃，不但不会升高血糖，还能减少肠道对胆固醇的吸收。
description_en: Brown rice has 8 amino acids, 16 minerals and 21 vitamins — complete, well-rounded, natural nutrition. Walnuts are rich in unsaturated fatty acids; eating them regularly not only avoids raising blood sugar but also reduces cholesterol absorption.
tips_zh: 糙米口感较粗，质地紧密，煮起来也比较费时，煮前可以将它淘洗后用冷水浸泡过夜。
tips_en: Brown rice has a coarser texture and is dense, so it takes longer to cook. You can wash it and soak in cold water overnight first.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将糙米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米刻度3的位置，撒上核桃仁和北杏仁，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the brown rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice mark 3. Sprinkle walnut kernels and northern almonds and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 一个番茄饭还挺好玩的，材料选择方面相当的自由，按下煮饭键后，就开开心心做运动去了，开锅就能吃，简直是单身男女的福音！而且番茄饭还有健胃消食，生津止渴，润肠通便，清热解毒，降脂降压的功效。
description_en: One-pot tomato rice is fun and very flexible—pick whatever ingredients you like. Press start, go exercise, and when you open the lid dinner is ready: a real blessing for singles! It's also said to aid digestion, quench thirst, ease bowel movements, clear heat, and help lower blood fat and pressure.
tips_zh: 现在番茄很多都是催熟的，所以买番茄的时候也一定要注意，那种看着外面很红亮但是里面的籽还是绿色的就肯定是催熟的。自然成熟的番茄籽是土黄色、肉质比较酥，有沙质感。
tips_en: Many tomatoes today are artificially ripened, so be careful when buying them: if one looks bright red outside but its seeds are still green, it's definitely been forced. Naturally ripened tomatoes have yellowish-brown seeds and tender, slightly grainy flesh.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后，水加到水位线：东北米2的位置，将番茄放在中间，周围撒上其他原料，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: After washing the Northeast rice, add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 2. Place the tomatoes in the middle, sprinkle other ingredients around it, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 煮熟后的样子。
steps.content_en: Appearance after cooking.

steps.content_zh: 将番茄搅碎，所有原料混合均匀，撒上黑胡椒和少许盐就可享用啦。
steps.content_en: Crush the tomatoes, mix all ingredients evenly, sprinkle with black pepper and a little salt and enjoy.

description_zh: 燕麦的营养价值很高，在禾谷类作物中蛋白质含量很高，且含有人体必需的8种氨基酸，其组成也平衡。大米是提供B族维生素的主要来源，是预防脚气病、消除口腔炎症的重要食资源。把大米和燕麦片结合使用，不仅使其营养价值更趋于合理，并且使其口感更加香郁。
description_en: Oats are highly nutritious, with a high protein content among cereals and all eight essential amino acids in a balanced profile. Rice is a major source of B vitamins, important for preventing beriberi and oral inflammation. Combining rice and oats improves both nutritional balance and flavor.
tips_zh: 燕麦一般人都可食用，特别适合于中老年人。吃燕麦一次不宜太多，否则会造成胃痉挛或是胀气。
tips_en: Oats are suitable for everyone, especially the middle-aged and elderly. Do not eat too much at once, or it may cause stomach cramps or bloating.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将燕麦与大米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：3稍低一点的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the oats and rice and put them into the pot. Add water to a position slightly lower than the water level: 3 and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅即可。
steps.content_en: When done, take it out of the pan.

description_zh: 锅巴饭清香扑鼻，勾人食欲。搭配菜肴淡淡的香味，将锅巴和米饭的香味融合得恰到好处，真的是香酥可口，回味无穷。
description_en: The rice crispy rice is fragrant and whet your appetite. Paired with the light aroma of the dishes, the aroma of the crispy rice and crispy rice is perfectly blended. It is really crispy and delicious, with endless aftertaste.
tips_zh: 随着米量的增加，锅巴的效果可能会有所减弱。
tips_en: As the amount of rice increases, the effect of the rice crispy rice may weaken.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 黄油软化后放入锅胆中，加入洗好的米，放入盐。水加到水位线：丝苗米1的位置。开始烹饪
steps.content_en: After softening the butter, put it in the inner pot, add the washed rice and salt. Add water up to the level line: the 'Simiao rice 1' mark. Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后出锅可根据个人的口味撒上胡椒粉、辣椒粉等增加风味。
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, you can sprinkle pepper, chili powder, etc. according to your personal taste to increase the flavor.

description_zh: 大米粥是中国经常食用的家常饭，特别是早餐。大米性味甘平，有和胃气、补脾虚、壮筋骨、和五脏的功效。大米粥，补中益气，健脾和胃，除烦止渴。
description_en: Rice porridge is a common Chinese home meal, especially at breakfast. Rice is sweet and neutral, harmonizing the stomach, tonifying the spleen, strengthening the sinews and bones and balancing the organs. It replenishes qi, strengthens the spleen and stomach, relieves irritability and quenches thirst.
tips_zh: 粳米炒香后煮粥，可增加其温燥之性，尤宜于脾胃虚寒者。
tips_en: Frying the japonica rice before making congee increases its warming, drying nature — especially good for those with a cold spleen and stomach.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 淘洗干净后放入锅中，根据个人喜好放入适量的水，开始烹饪。完成后即可享用。
steps.content_en: Rinse thoroughly, place in the pot, add water to taste, and start cooking. Enjoy when done.

description_zh: 红豆粥亦称小豆粥，即以红豆为主要材料熬制而成的粥，具有健脾止泻、利水消肿、益气补血等功效。
description_en: Adzuki bean porridge, also called small-bean porridge, is made mainly from adzuki beans. It strengthens the spleen and relieves diarrhea, promotes urination and reduces swelling, and replenishes qi and blood.
tips_zh: 选择红豆时，以紧小赤者为佳。
tips_en: Choose small, firm red beans.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 红豆需要提前洗净浸泡半天。
steps.content_en: Red beans need to be washed and soaked for half a day in advance.

steps.content_zh: 粳米洗净后与红豆同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置。开始烹饪，完成后根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: Wash the japonica rice and put it into the pot at the same time as the red beans. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1. Start cooking, and when finished, add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 小米粥健脾和胃、补益虚损，和中益肾，可单独煮熬，亦可添加大枣、红豆、红薯、莲子、百合等，熬成风味各异的营养粥。不过，需要注意的是，产妇，还是老弱人群，是不能完全以小米为主食，应注意搭配，以免缺乏其他营养。
description_en: Millet porridge strengthens the spleen and stomach, replenishes deficiencies, and harmonizes the kidneys. It can be boiled alone, or jujubes, red beans, sweet potatoes, lotus seeds, lilies, etc. can be added to make nutritious porridge with different flavors. However, it should be noted that pregnant women, or the elderly and weak, cannot completely rely on millet as their staple food, and should pay attention to the combination to avoid lack of other nutrients.
tips_zh: 小米粥不宜太稀薄；淘米时不要用手搓，忌长时间浸泡或用热水淘米。
tips_en: Millet porridge should not be too thin; do not rub it with your hands when washing the rice, and avoid soaking it for a long time or washing it in hot water.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 小米淘洗干净后放入锅中，加入水到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，
steps.content_en: Wash the millet and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level: thick porridge 1.

steps.content_zh: 开始烹饪。完成后即可享用。
steps.content_en: Start cooking. Enjoy when done.

description_zh: 绿豆粥，即指用绿豆和稻米为主要材料混合熬制而成的粥。绿豆为一种常见的杂粮，性寒味甘，有清热解毒，降火消暑的功效，十分适合在夏天食用。绿豆还含有丰富的蛋白质，维生素和微量元素，具有十分高的营养价值，是一种十分健康的天然食品。
description_en: Mung bean porridge refers to porridge made from a mixture of mung beans and rice as the main ingredients. Mung bean is a common cereal. It is cold in nature and sweet in taste. It has the effects of clearing away heat and detoxifying, reducing fire and relieving heat. It is very suitable for consumption in summer. Mung beans are also rich in protein, vitamins and trace elements. They have very high nutritional value and are a very healthy natural food.
tips_zh: 有脾胃虚寒者不宜食用。
tips_en: People with spleen and stomach deficiency should not eat it.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 绿豆提前洗净浸泡半天。
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans in advance and soak for half a day.

steps.content_zh: 将绿豆与粳米同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。完成后放入冰糖调味即可享用。
steps.content_en: Put mung beans and japonica rice into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, and start cooking. When finished, add rock sugar to taste and enjoy.

description_zh: 把芝士加到米饭里，当做早餐的话，简直满满的幸福感！强烈推荐芝士饭团~紫米配合芝士，益气补血、暖胃健脾。
description_en: Add cheese to rice and have it for breakfast, it will be full of happiness! Highly recommend cheese rice balls~Purple rice combined with cheese can replenish qi and blood, warm the stomach and strengthen the spleen.
tips_zh: 紫米的米粒外部有一坚韧的种皮包裹，不易煮烂，故紫米应浸泡一夜再煮。
tips_en: Purple rice grains have a tough seed coat that is hard to break down, so soak them overnight before cooking.

steps.content_zh: 紫米洗净浸泡后与粳米同煮。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the purple rice, then cook it with the japonica rice.

steps.content_zh: 米饭煮好后趁热拌入寿司醋。芝士片撕成小片。
steps.content_en: When the rice is cooked, stir in the sushi vinegar while it's still hot. Tear cheese slices into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 米饭冷却后，将米饭平铺在保鲜膜上，放上肉松、芝士片与蛋黄酱，包成饭团即可。
steps.content_en: After the rice has cooled, spread the rice flat on the plastic wrap, add the meat floss, cheese slices and mayonnaise, and wrap it into a rice ball.

steps.content_zh: 开吃咯
steps.content_en: Let's eat

description_zh: 巧克力是女人永远的甜品，喜欢黑巧克力含有的微苦，白巧克力含有的绵甜。巧克力蛋糕绝对是下午茶的好搭档，营养丰富，易消化。
description_en: Chocolate is a woman's eternal dessert—the slight bitterness of dark chocolate, the mellow sweetness of white. Chocolate cake is a perfect afternoon tea companion: nourishing and easy to digest.
tips_zh: 原料比例可参考预调粉说明，制作完成后放在冰箱里冷却后会更美味。
tips_en: For the ratio of raw materials, please refer to the pre-mixed powder instructions. After the preparation is completed, it will be more delicious after cooling in the refrigerator.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将黑巧克力和黄油隔水融化。
steps.content_en: Melt dark chocolate and butter over water.

steps.content_zh: 蛋清蛋白分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。
steps.content_en: Separate the whites from the yolks; no yolk should remain in the whites.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中加入牛奶、融化的巧克力液、20g糖，筛入面粉。
steps.content_en: Add milk, melted chocolate and 20 g sugar to the yolk, then sift in flour.

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀，到无颗粒的状态。
steps.content_en: Stir evenly until there are no particles.

steps.content_zh: 蛋白中加入几滴柠檬汁，打蛋器低速挡姜蛋白搅拌到鱼眼泡状态。
steps.content_en: Add a few drops of lemon juice to the egg whites and beat on low speed until frothy with large bubbles.

steps.content_zh: 加入剩余糖的1/3，继续搅拌约30秒，搅拌到肥皂泡状态。
steps.content_en: Add 1/3 of the remaining sugar and continue stirring for about 30 seconds until soapy.

steps.content_zh: 再加入1/3糖，继续搅拌约60秒，搅拌到有纹路出现。
steps.content_en: Add another 1/3 of the sugar and continue stirring for about 60 seconds until texture appears.

steps.content_zh: 再加剩余糖。继续搅拌约3分钟，搅拌到干性发泡，拉起直角不弯曲。
steps.content_en: Add the remaining sugar and continue beating for about 3 minutes until stiff peaks form—the peaks should stand straight without bending.

steps.content_zh: 将打好的蛋清分三次拌入蛋黄糊中，不要转圈，要无规则翻拌。
steps.content_en: Fold the beaten egg whites into the egg yolk paste in three batches, do not turn in circles, but mix irregularly.

steps.content_zh: 翻拌好的面糊倒入锅胆，在台面上磕几下，除去表面气泡，将锅胆放入饭煲中，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour the mixed batter into the inner pot, tap it on the counter a few times to remove surface bubbles, then place the pot in the rice cooker and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后倒扣脱模即可。
steps.content_en: After completion, flip it upside down and release it from the mold.

description_zh: 椰蓉是用优质、新鲜、肉厚的椰子做原料经过特殊工序烘干而成，香味浓郁，是烘焙的常用材料。椰蓉中含有糖类、脂肪、蛋白质、维生素B族、维生素C及微量元素钾、镁等营养成分。椰蓉蛋糕，有浓浓的椰香味，非常好吃。
description_en: Desiccated coconut is made from high-quality, fresh, thick-fleshed coconuts dried through a special process. It has a rich aroma and is a common baking ingredient. It contains sugars, fats, protein, B vitamins, vitamin C, and trace minerals such as potassium and magnesium. Coconut cake has a strong coconut aroma and is delicious.
tips_zh: 打发蛋白时放几滴柠檬汁或者白醋会更容易些。
tips_en: It will be easier to add a few drops of lemon juice or white vinegar when beating egg whites.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 先将蛋白与蛋黄分离，分离出来的蛋黄打散后筛入面粉和椰浆，加入玉米油搅拌均匀。（蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。）
steps.content_en: First separate the egg whites and egg yolks, beat the separated egg yolks, sift in the flour and coconut milk, add the corn oil and stir evenly. (Egg yolk is separated from egg white, and there must be no yolk in the egg white.)

steps.content_zh: 全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加20克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Wash and dry all tools, especially those for beating egg whites. Beat the whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating. When large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and continue. When the foam becomes fine and dense, add 20 g more sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.

steps.content_zh: 打好的蛋白分三次加入蛋黄面糊中加入椰蓉，上下翻拌，倒入锅中后轻轻磕几下去除表面气泡，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add the beaten egg whites into the egg yolk batter in three batches and add the grated coconut, stir it up and down, pour it into the pot and tap it gently a few times to remove bubbles on the surface, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后取出，自然冷却后用模具刻成小熊的样子。
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, take it out, cool it naturally and then use a mold to carve it into the shape of a bear.

steps.content_zh: 冷藏的淡奶油加入细砂糖打成6成发。
steps.content_en: Add refrigerated whipping cream to caster sugar and beat until 60% fluffy.

steps.content_zh: 将奶油抹在蛋糕上，撒上椰蓉装饰即可。
steps.content_en: Spread the cream on the cake and sprinkle with coconut to decorate.

steps.content_zh: 完成开始吃咯。
steps.content_en: Finished and started eating.

description_zh: 乳酪蛋糕没有戚风蛋糕那么轻盈，也没有重油蛋糕那么实在。轻乳酪蛋糕口感还是很松软的，爽滑软绵，味道刚刚好。
description_en: Cheesecake is not as light as chiffon cake, nor is it as solid as heavy oil cake. The light cheesecake is still very soft, smooth and soft, and has just the right taste.
tips_zh: 蛋糕做好后自然冷却，在冰箱里冷藏半天芝士会更香醇。
tips_en: Let the cake cool naturally; chilling it in the fridge for half a day makes the cheese richer.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 奶油芝士，黄油，隔水溶化，加20克牛奶搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Dissolve cream cheese and butter in water, add 20 grams of milk and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 打蛋，分离蛋黄蛋白，单独打散蛋黄加面粉，40克牛奶，50克糖，搅拌均匀后将第一步的芝士倒入。
steps.content_en: Beat the eggs, separate the egg yolk and protein, beat the egg yolk separately and add flour, 40 grams of milk, 50 grams of sugar, mix well and pour in the cheese from the first step.

steps.content_zh: 全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加40克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Wash and dry all tools, especially those for beating egg whites. Separate yolks from whites—no yolk in the whites. Beat the whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating. When large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and continue. When the foam becomes fine and dense, add 40 g more sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.

steps.content_zh: 舀一半蛋白到第三步的成品中，由下往上翻盛，拌匀以后倒入剩下的一半蛋白中，翻盛均匀.倒入面糊，App 选择开始烹饪，烹饪模式下烹饪50分钟.
steps.content_en: Scoop half of the egg whites into the finished product in step 3, stir it from bottom to top, mix well, then pour in the remaining half of the egg whites, and stir evenly. Pour in the batter, select Start Cooking on the App, and cook in cooking mode for 50 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 完成后自然冷却，在冰箱里冷藏半天芝士会更香醇。
steps.content_en: Cool naturally after completion, and the cheese will be more mellow if refrigerated for half a day.

name_en: Ginger, red dates and brown sugar porridge
description_zh: 生姜是驱寒暖胃的一种很家常食材，用它和红枣，红糖在一起可以是很好的一道食疗佳品，有补中益气、健脾胃、暖胃，驱寒散瘀的功效，非常适合女性朋友和老年人食用。
description_en: Ginger is a common ingredient that dispels cold and warms the stomach. With red dates and brown sugar it makes a therapeutic dish that replenishes qi, strengthens the spleen and stomach, warms the stomach, and dispels cold and blood stasis—especially good for women and the elderly.
tips_zh: 优质红糖呈晶粒状或粉末状，干燥而松散，不结块，不成团，无杂质，其水溶液清晰，无沉淀，无悬浮物。
tips_en: High-quality brown sugar is in the form of grains or powder, dry and loose, no caking, no agglomeration, no impurities, and its aqueous solution is clear, no precipitation, no suspended matter.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 粳米、红枣、生姜洗净切片；三者同时放入锅中，水加到水位线稠粥1，
steps.content_en: Wash and slice the japonica rice, red dates, and ginger; put the three into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level to thicken the porridge 1,

steps.content_zh: 开始烹饪。完成后放入适量的红糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: Start cooking. When done, add brown sugar to taste.

name_en: Red date, Job's tears and barley porridge
description_zh: 红枣性温枣能提高人体免疫力补气血。薏米大米粥，易消化，益气健脾、利水解暑。
description_en: Red dates are warming and can boost immunity and replenish qi and blood. Barley and rice porridge is easy to digest and helps replenish qi, strengthen the spleen and relieve summer heat.
tips_zh: 大麦一次性不宜食用过多，过多则会伤害元气。
tips_en: It is not advisable to eat too much barley at one time, as too much will damage your vitality.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 大麦、薏米和红枣提前洗净，浸泡。
steps.content_en: Wash the barley, barley and red dates in advance and soak them.

steps.content_zh: 米洗净过后与前三者同时放入锅中，水加到水位线稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and add it to the pot with the first three ingredients; fill to the thick-congee 1 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可放入适量的糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste.

name_en: Rock sugar, white fungus and snow pear soup
description_zh: 银耳性平味甘淡，能滋阴润肺、养气和血、补脑提神，对阴虚火旺、不能吃人参鹿茸的人是一种良好的补品，特别适合女性食用。雪梨具有美容润肺，滋补身体的功效。
description_en: Snow fungus is neutral in nature and mild in flavor; it nourishes yin, moistens the lungs, replenishes qi and blood, and boosts brain power and energy. It is a good tonic for people with yin deficiency and internal heat who cannot take ginseng or deer antler velvet, and is especially suitable for women. Snow pears beautify the skin, moisten the lungs and nourish the body.
tips_zh: 银耳要提前浸泡好，才能煮的入口即化。
tips_en: Soak the snow fungus well in advance so it cooks to a melt-in-the-mouth texture.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 银耳洗净浸泡，去蒂撕成小朵。雪梨去皮切块后与银耳放入锅中，加入适量的水，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the snow fungus, remove the stems and tear into small florets. Peel and chop the snow pear, put it into the pot with the snow fungus, add an appropriate amount of water, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余20分钟时放入枸杞和适量的冰糖调味，完成过后即可享用。
steps.content_en: With 20 minutes left, add goji berries and rock sugar to taste. Enjoy when done.

description_zh: 冰糖山楂粥属于高血脂食疗药膳食谱之一，对改善症状十分有益。山楂具有消食化积、活血散瘀的功效。
description_en: Rock sugar hawthorn porridge is one of the dietary formulas for treating hyperlipidemia and is very beneficial to improving symptoms. Hawthorn has the effects of digestion and accumulation, activating blood circulation and dispersing blood stasis.
tips_zh: 此粥合适酒后食用，可解酒醒酒。
tips_en: This porridge is good after drinking, helping to relieve drunkenness and sober you up.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 粳米与山楂洗净后，同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。完成后放入适量的冰糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: Wash the japonica rice and hawthorn berries, add both to the pot, fill to the thick-congee 1 mark and start cooking. When done, add rock sugar to taste.

description_zh: 大爱用酸奶做的蛋糕，原料简简单单，热量也很低。但就是好看好吃，细密轻盈的组织，香甜松软的口感，百做不烦，百吃不腻，家里老人孩子都特别爱。
description_en: I love yogurt cake: simple ingredients, low calories, yet beautiful and delicious. Fine, light crumb, sweet and fluffy—never tiresome to make or eat, and loved by young and old at home.
tips_zh: 打蛋白霜的时候可滴入几滴白醋或者柠檬汁，有利于打发。
tips_en: When beating the meringue, you can add a few drops of white vinegar or lemon juice to help beat it.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄糊搅拌均匀后，全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。
steps.content_en: After mixing the yolk batter, wash and dry all utensils, especially those for whipping the whites. Separate yolks from whites; no yolk should remain in the whites.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄液中放入玉米油、10克白砂糖、酸奶搅拌后筛入低筋粉。
steps.content_en: Add corn oil, 10 g white sugar and yogurt to the egg yolks, stir, then sift in cake flour.

steps.content_zh: 用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加20克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating; when large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and keep beating; once the foam is fine and dense, add 20 g more sugar and beat to stiff peaks.

steps.content_zh: 将蛋白霜和蛋黄糊分两次搅拌均。（不规则搅拌，不可朝一个方向，不然会消泡）。
steps.content_en: Fold the meringue and yolk batter together in two additions. (Stir irregularly, not in one direction, or it will deflate.)

steps.content_zh: 将混合好的面糊分出一半筛入抹茶粉，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Divide half of the mixed batter and sift in the matcha powder and stir evenly.

steps.content_zh: 电饭煲中先放入1/2的面糊再放入抹茶糊，再放入面糊后用牙签在表面画出花纹，后开始烘焙。
steps.content_en: Put half the batter in the rice cooker, then the matcha batter, then the remaining batter; draw a pattern on the surface with a toothpick and start baking.

steps.content_zh: 出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan.

steps.content_zh: 享用咯。
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

description_zh: 布朗尼的由来有个很有趣的故事，据说有个胖胖的黑人嬷嬷系着围裙，在厨房烘培着松软可口的巧克力蛋糕，结果居然忘了将奶油先打发，而意外做出的失败作品，这块原本要丢掉的蛋糕，老妈妈一尝，居然十分美味，于是布朗尼蛋糕这个“可爱的错误”就这么成为美国家庭中最代表性的蛋糕了。
description_en: There is a very interesting story about the origin of brownies. It is said that there was a fat black grandma wearing an apron and baking a soft and delicious chocolate cake in the kitchen. However, she forgot to beat the cream first, and accidentally made a failed work. This cake that was originally going to be thrown away, when the old mother tasted it, it turned out to be very delicious. Therefore, this "cute mistake" of brownies has become the most representative cake in American families.
tips_zh: 如果觉得甜，可适量减少糖的用量。
tips_en: If you find it sweet, you can reduce the amount of sugar appropriately.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 巧克力隔水融化。
steps.content_en: Melt the chocolate over water.

steps.content_zh: 黄油软化后放入砂糖，打入鸡蛋，搅拌均匀后筛入面粉、泡打粉。再拌入稍微冷却的巧克力酱。
steps.content_en: After softening the butter, add granulated sugar and an egg, mix well, then sift in the flour and baking powder. Fold in the slightly cooled chocolate sauce.

steps.content_zh: 放入掰碎的核桃仁后搅拌均匀。同时电饭煲蛋糕模式下预热5分钟，将面糊倒入锅中，开始烘焙。
steps.content_en: Add the broken walnuts and mix well. Meanwhile preheat the cooker in Cake mode for 5 minutes, pour in the batter and start baking.

steps.content_zh: 出锅后自然冷却，放在冰箱冷藏半天后风味更佳。撒上糖霜装饰。
steps.content_en: Let cool naturally after cooking; chilling in the fridge for half a day improves the flavor. Dust with powdered sugar to serve.

description_zh: 桂圆含丰富的葡萄糖、蔗糖和蛋白质等，含铁量也比较高，可在提高热能、补充营养的同时促进血红蛋白再生，从而达到补血的效果。甜荞，味甘，性凉。能健脾除湿，消极降气。
description_en: Longan is rich in glucose, sucrose, protein, etc., and has a relatively high iron content. It can increase heat energy, supplement nutrients, and promote hemoglobin regeneration, thereby achieving the effect of replenishing blood. Sweet buckwheat is sweet in taste and cool in nature. It can invigorate the spleen, remove dampness, and reduce negative energy.
tips_zh: 有脾胃虚寒者不宜食用过量荞麦。
tips_en: People with spleen and stomach deficiency should not eat too much buckwheat.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 桂圆去壳、粳米和荞麦洗净后同时放入锅中，水加到：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Peel the longan, wash the japonica rice and buckwheat and put them into the pot at the same time. Add water to the position of thick porridge 1 and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后可放入适量的糖调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, add sugar to taste.

name_en: Longan, red dates, egg and sugar water
description_zh: 桂圆红枣鸡蛋糖水是一道美味可口的汉族名点，属于粤菜系甜品，需要的主要材料有桂圆，鸡蛋。桂圆红枣鸡蛋糖水既补血又美味，而且男女都适宜食用，不仅补益心脾，而且养血安神。
description_en: Longan, red date, and egg sweet soup is a delicious classic Han Chinese dessert from Cantonese cuisine; its main ingredients are longans and eggs. It nourishes the blood and tastes great, suitable for men and women alike—tonifying the heart and spleen and calming the mind.
tips_zh: 有湿盛中满及痰火者不宜食用。
tips_en: People with excessive dampness and phlegm fire should not eat it.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 桂圆去壳，切姜片；
steps.content_en: Shell the longans and slice the ginger;

steps.content_zh: 姜桂圆、红枣和姜放入锅胆，加入至水位线：稠粥1/2的刻度。盖上盖子启动电饭煲；
steps.content_en: Put the ginger, longan, red dates and ginger into the pot and add to the water level: 1/2 of the thick porridge. Close the lid and start the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 剩余5分钟时加入鸡蛋，不要搅动继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: When 5 minutes are left, add eggs and continue to simmer without stirring;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束和可加入适量红糖调料；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add brown sugar to taste;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 糙米的最大特色是含有胚芽，是一颗完整、有生命活力的种子。将糙米在一定温度、湿度下进行培养，待糙米发芽到一定程度时将其干燥，所得到的由幼芽和带糠层的胚乳组成的制品即称为发芽糙米。
description_en: Brown rice's key feature is its germ — a complete, living seed. Cultivated at a set temperature and humidity, then dried after sprouting, the result of young sprouts and bran-coated endosperm is called germinated brown rice.
tips_zh: 购买糙米时要选择有机糙米，挑选色彩深、胚芽部分很鲜明的糙米。
tips_en: When buying brown rice, choose organic brown rice and choose brown rice with dark color and distinct germ part.

steps.content_zh: 准备好有机糙米，洗净后放入锅胆中；
steps.content_en: Prepare organic brown rice, wash it and put it into the pot;

steps.content_zh: 根据东北米的水位线，加入水到水位线：3的位置后启动烹饪模式；
steps.content_en: Following the water-level marks for Northeast rice, add water up to the '3' line, then start the cooking mode;

steps.content_zh: 完成后即可享用。
steps.content_en: Serve when finished.

description_zh: 杂粮饭就是利用各种杂粮，经过合理的营养的搭配，然后烹煮成的饭食。粗粮有降低血压、调节血糖、减肥瘦身等功效。
description_en: Multigrain rice is made by cooking a variety of grains with well-balanced nutrition. Whole grains can help lower blood pressure, regulate blood sugar, and aid weight loss.
tips_zh: 有肠道疾病的人群不宜食用过多粗粮，粗粮膳食纤维含量较高不宜消化。建议煮饭前将杂粮浸泡2小时。
tips_en: People with intestinal disorders should not eat too much whole grain; the high fiber content is hard to digest. It's best to soak the grains for 2 hours before cooking.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将所有食材洗净，放入锅中。水加到水位线：东北米4的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash all ingredients and put them into the pot. Add water to the water level line: 4 meters northeast and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后享用。
steps.content_en: Enjoy when done.

description_zh: 多食黑米具有开胃益中，健脾暖肝，明目活血，滑涩补精之功，对于少年白发、妇女产后虚弱，病后体虚以及贫血、肾虚均有很好的补养作用。
description_en: Eating more black rice has the effects of appetizing and benefiting the heart, strengthening the spleen and warming the liver, improving eyesight and activating blood circulation, smoothing and replenishing essence. It has a very good nourishing effect on young people with gray hair, women with postpartum weakness, physical weakness after illness, anemia, and kidney deficiency.
tips_zh:
1、泡黑米的水要与米同煮，以保存营养成分。
2、黑米冷却时一定要包上保鲜膜，不然表面的黑米会变得非常硬。
tips_en:
1. Cook the black rice in its soaking water to keep the nutrients.
2. Wrap the black rice in plastic wrap as it cools, or the top layer will become very hard.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 黑米洗净后放入锅胆中，水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，浸泡四小时后开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the black rice and put it in the inner pot, add water up to the level line: the 'Northeast rice 2' mark, soak for four hours, then start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 芒果取果肉切丁；
steps.content_en: Cut the mango flesh into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，将黑米盛出包上保鲜膜放凉后做成饭团放入容器中，椰浆中放入白砂糖搅拌均匀后倒入碗中，最后放上芒果就行啦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, scoop out the black rice, wrap in plastic wrap, cool, shape into rice balls, and place in a container. Stir sugar into coconut milk, pour into a bowl, and top with mango.

description_zh: 橙子味甘、酸，性凉。具有防治便秘的功效、生津止渴、开胃下气帮助消化。橙子营养极为丰富而全面，能够补充维C，增加抵抗力，老幼皆宜。
description_en: Oranges are sweet and sour and cooling in nature. They help prevent constipation, promote saliva and relieve thirst, stimulate the appetite, and aid digestion. Oranges are highly nutritious, providing vitamin C and boosting immunity—suitable for young and old alike.
tips_zh: 黄油要自然软化，不可软化成液态，用手能按下去的程度最好。
tips_en: The butter should be softened naturally and should not be softened into a liquid state. It is best if it can be pressed down with your hands.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 一个橙子，将橙子皮磨成屑。记得不要擦到白色的部分，橙色部分都磨下来就好。剩下的部分去皮加半个柠檬榨汁。
steps.content_en: Take one orange and zest the peel—avoid the white pith, just grate off the orange part. Peel the remaining orange and juice it with half a lemon.

steps.content_zh: 另一个橙子切成0.5厘米厚的片，加上糖、橙汁（留30克放入蛋糕中）一点点盐，熬成橙子酱。
steps.content_en: Cut another orange into 0.5 cm thick slices, add sugar, orange juice (leave 30 grams into the cake) and a little salt, and boil it into orange jam.

steps.content_zh: 黄油软化后加上糖粉用电动打蛋器打到膨胀且变白的程度。
steps.content_en: After softening the butter, add powdered sugar and beat with an electric mixer until fluffy and pale.

steps.content_zh: 分次加入鸡蛋液，充分搅拌。
steps.content_en: Add the egg liquid in portions and mix thoroughly.

steps.content_zh: 加入橙汁和橙皮屑搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Add orange juice and orange zest and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 筛入蛋糕粉和泡打粉搅拌顺滑无颗粒的状态。
steps.content_en: Sift in the cake flour and baking powder and stir until smooth and lump-free.

steps.content_zh: 面糊放入锅胆中，抹平表面，规则的放上煮好的橙子片，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the batter in the inner pot, smooth the surface, arrange the cooked orange slices neatly on top, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成。
steps.content_en: Cooking is complete.

steps.content_zh: 刷上橙子酱。
steps.content_en: Brush with ponzu sauce.

description_zh: 慕斯蛋糕最早出现在美食之都法国巴黎，最初大师们在奶油中加入起稳定作用和改善结构，口感和风味的各种辅料，使之外型，色泽，结构，口味变化丰富，更加自然纯正，冷冻后食用其味无穷，成为蛋糕中的极品。
description_en: Mousse cake first appeared in the gourmet capital of Paris, France. Initially, masters added various auxiliary materials to the cream to stabilize and improve the structure, texture and flavor, making the appearance, color, structure and taste richer and more natural and pure. After freezing, it tastes endless and becomes the best cake.
tips_zh: 巧克力奶煮沸后要立即倒入蛋黄，并持续不断的搅打。
tips_en: After the chocolate milk is boiled, immediately pour in the egg yolks and continue to beat.

steps.content_zh: 准备好巧克力蛋糕胚材料
steps.content_en: Prepare chocolate cake base ingredients

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋、清水、玉米油放入干净容器中，搅拌均匀后筛入预拌粉。
steps.content_en: Put the eggs, water and corn oil into a clean container, stir evenly and sift in the pre-mixed powder.

steps.content_zh: 预拌粉搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Stir the premixed powder until well combined.

steps.content_zh: 面糊放入锅胆中，App选择蛋糕模式，60分钟。完成后倒出冷却。
steps.content_en: Put the batter in the inner pot, select Cake mode in the app for 60 minutes. Once done, turn out and let cool.

steps.content_zh: 完全冷却后，在冰箱中冷冻一会后用模具压成爱心形状。
steps.content_en: After it is completely cooled, freeze it in the refrigerator for a while and then mold it into a heart shape.

steps.content_zh: 切成两片。
steps.content_en: Cut into two slices.

steps.content_zh: 制作慕斯液，准备好原料。
steps.content_en: Make mousse liquid and prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 吉利丁粉加少许的水，使其充分吸水。
steps.content_en: Add a little water to gelatine powder to make it fully absorb water.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄隔温水打蓬松、变色。
steps.content_en: Beat egg yolks in warm water until fluffy and discolored.

steps.content_zh: 牛奶加黑巧克力加热煮沸。
steps.content_en: Heat milk and dark chocolate and bring to a boil.

steps.content_zh: 将巧克力牛奶液成线状缓缓倒入蛋黄糊中，同时不停的搅拌。
steps.content_en: Slowly pour the chocolate milk liquid into the egg yolk paste in a linear shape while stirring constantly.

steps.content_zh: 趁热放入泡好的吉利丁粉。
steps.content_en: While hot, add soaked gelatine powder.

steps.content_zh: 加入两瓶盖百利甜酒。
steps.content_en: Add two capfuls of Baileys.

steps.content_zh: 将混合好的巧克力酱放到冰箱中冷藏，待完全冷却还没有凝固的时候取出。鲜奶油加入糖打发到五成发。
steps.content_en: Place the mixed chocolate sauce in the refrigerator and take it out when it has cooled completely and has not solidified. Add sugar to the fresh cream and beat until 50% fluffy.

steps.content_zh: 将奶油和巧克力酱混合，做成慕斯酱。
steps.content_en: Mix the cream and chocolate sauce to make a mousse sauce.

steps.content_zh: 将第一层蛋糕胚放入模具上。倒入慕斯液。
steps.content_en: Place the first cake layer in the mold. Pour in the mousse mixture.

steps.content_zh: 重复上一步操作，完成后将蛋糕整体放入冰箱中冷藏3小时凝固后取出，用电吹风暖风缓缓解热模具侧面脱模。
steps.content_en: Repeat the previous step, then chill the whole cake for 3 hours to set. Use a hair dryer on warm to loosen the sides of the mold and unmold.

steps.content_zh: 用可可粉装饰。
steps.content_en: Garnish with cocoa powder.

name_en: Mung bean and dried tangerine peel sweet soup
description_zh: 薏米绿豆陈皮糖水具有清热解暑，理气健脾利水的功效，可用于夏季脾胃虚弱胃口不佳，大便粘腻不爽，浮肿、虚胖的人群。此膳采用的均是药食两用的材料，大多数人都可食用。
description_en: Job's tears, mung bean and tangerine peel dessert soup clears heat, relieves summer heat, regulates qi and strengthens the spleen. It suits people with weak digestion, poor appetite, sticky stools or swelling in summer. All ingredients are food-safe medicinal herbs, suitable for most people.
tips_zh: 食谱中没有放糖，喜欢甜食的可以根据个人口味酌情放入。
tips_en: No sugar is added; add to taste if you have a sweet tooth.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 绿豆和薏米提前洗净浸泡3小时。
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and Job's tears in advance and soak for 3 hours.

steps.content_zh: 将所有食材放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put all the ingredients into the pot, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 香蕉味香，肉质软糯，香甜可口，非常可口而且富含营养价值。芝士的浓厚配上香蕉的香醇，只可意会不可言传。
description_en: Bananas are fragrant, soft and glutinous, sweet and delicious, very delicious and rich in nutritional value. The richness of the cheese combined with the mellow flavor of the banana can only be imagined but cannot be expressed in words.
tips_zh: 香蕉要选择已经熟透的香蕉，味道会更香。
tips_en: Choose fully ripe bananas for a richer flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将黄油、奶油芝士和30克牛奶一起放入容器中，隔水加热融化后放入一个香蕉压成泥状。
steps.content_en: Put the butter, cream cheese and 30 grams of milk together in a container, heat over water to melt, then add a banana and press it into a puree.

steps.content_zh: 取两个鸡蛋、蛋清和蛋黄分离。装蛋白的容器必须是无油无水无蛋黄。同时打蛋器擦干，不可以有水。
steps.content_en: Take two eggs and separate the yolks from the whites. The bowl for the whites must be free of oil, water and yolk. Dry the beaters too—no water allowed.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄液中放入剩下的牛奶、筛入面粉搅拌均匀，无颗粒状。用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加20克糖，继续打到干性泡发（筷子可以插进去不倒的状态）。
steps.content_en: Add the remaining milk to the egg yolk liquid, sift in the flour and stir evenly without any lumps. Use an electric whisk to beat the egg whites. Add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 grams of sugar to the egg whites and start beating. After making a large foam, add 20 grams of sugar and continue beating. When the foam is soft and thick, add 20 grams of sugar. Continue beating until the foam is dry (chopsticks can be inserted into it without falling over).

steps.content_zh: 将蛋黄、蛋清、芝士牛奶液混合。
steps.content_en: Mix egg yolks, egg whites, and cheese milk liquid.

steps.content_zh: 将混合液，放入锅胆中，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the mixture into the pot and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

steps.content_zh: 出锅后冷却，放入冰箱中冷藏后食用。
steps.content_en: Cool after serving and refrigerate before serving.

description_zh: 百合具有润肺止咳、养阴消热、清心安神之效。这一款双白水，非常适合夏天饮用，薏米抵御紫外线，排水肿：百合利水祛湿，解渴安神。
description_en: Lily has the effects of moistening the lungs and relieving coughs, nourishing yin and eliminating heat, clearing the heart and calming the nerves. This double white water is very suitable for drinking in summer. Barley resists ultraviolet rays and drains swelling; lily promotes water removal, quenches thirst and calms the nerves.
tips_zh: 干百合的储存方法：放入密封的罐子里，放入冰箱或阴凉干燥处即可。
tips_en: How to store dried lilies: Place in a sealed jar in the refrigerator or a cool, dry place.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 薏米与百合分开浸泡，3小时左右；
steps.content_en: Soak barley and lily separately for about 3 hours;

steps.content_zh: 将薏米倒入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the barley into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入百合与冰糖，继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add lily bulbs and rock sugar, and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 完成后可马上饮用，或冷却后入冰箱冷藏。
steps.content_en: It can be consumed immediately after completion, or cooled and refrigerated.

description_zh: 桂花酸梅汤是一道美味可口的汉族小吃。酸甜可口既有酸梅汤的酸甜又有桂花的甜香，消食合中，生津止渴，是夏日必备的饮料。
description_en: Osmanthus and sour plum soup is a delicious Han snack. Sweet and sour, it has the sweet and sour taste of sour plum soup and the sweet fragrance of osmanthus. It is a perfect combination of digestion, production of body fluids and thirst quenching. It is a must-have drink in summer.
tips_zh: 第一次煮好酸梅汤剩下的材料，可加入上次煮汤用水的一半进行第二次煮。味道并不比第一次差哦。
tips_en: The leftover ingredients from the first batch of sour plum drink can be boiled a second time with half as much water. It tastes no worse than the first;

steps.content_zh: 准备好所有原料。
steps.content_en: Have all ingredients ready.

steps.content_zh: 将原料洗净后放入锅中。（冰糖不要放入），水加到最大水位线，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the ingredients and place in the pot (do not add the rock sugar yet). Add water to the maximum water line and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后根据个人口味放入适量的冰糖调味。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of rock sugar to taste according to personal taste.

name_en: Mung bean and sago sweet soup
description_zh: 西米有健脾，补肺，化痰的功效，有治脾胃虚弱和消化不良的作用；不仅能使皮肤恢复天然润泽，还能生津解暑。爽滑可口，深受人们的喜爱。
description_en: Sago has the effects of strengthening the spleen, nourishing the lungs, and resolving phlegm, and can treat weak spleen and stomach and indigestion; it can not only restore the natural moisture of the skin, but also produce fluid and relieve heat. Smooth and delicious, it is deeply loved by people.
tips_zh: 西米不可用水浸泡，一定要开水下锅。
tips_en: Do not soak tapioca pearls; always add them to boiling water.

steps.content_zh: 绿豆洗净后浸泡3小时后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and soak them for 3 hours, then put them into the pot. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 准备好西米。
steps.content_en: Get the sago ready.

steps.content_zh: 锅中放入足量的水，沸腾后放入西米。大火煮15分钟，关火后焖5分钟。
steps.content_en: Put enough water in the pot and add sago after boiling. Cook over high heat for 15 minutes, then turn off the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 捞出西米后用冷水冲2到3遍，表面不粘稠。
steps.content_en: Drain the tapioca pearls and rinse with cold water 2–3 times until no longer sticky.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后将西米与绿豆混合，根据个人口味放入适量的糖即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, mix the tapioca pearls with the mung beans and add sugar to taste.

description_zh: 不喜欢蛋糕外面的奶油，做个白蛋糕又觉得太普通了，喜欢吃红枣，不如就做个枣泥蛋糕。枣泥蛋糕枣香醇厚，松软可口。
description_en: If you don't like cake frosting and a plain white cake seems too ordinary, but you love red dates, make a date paste cake instead. It has a rich date aroma and is soft and delicious.
tips_zh: 大枣一定要充分泡发，这样打出来的枣泥才能顺滑。
tips_en: The jujube must be fully soaked so that the jujube paste will be smooth.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 红枣洗净充分泡发。
steps.content_en: Wash the red dates and soak them thoroughly.

steps.content_zh: 红枣去核加入一半（或以上）的玉米油和蜂蜜打成枣泥。
steps.content_en: Remove the pits from the red dates and add half (or more) of the corn oil and honey to make a date puree.

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋加入红糖、油。容器中不可有水。
steps.content_en: Add brown sugar and oil to the eggs. The container must be dry.

steps.content_zh: 用电动打蛋器打发膨胀到原来的3倍，颜色变白。可流动的状态。
steps.content_en: Beat with an electric mixer until tripled in volume, pale in color, and still flowing.

steps.content_zh: 筛入面粉泡打粉。
steps.content_en: Sift in the flour and baking powder.

steps.content_zh: 放入枣泥后搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Add the jujube paste and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 面糊倒入锅中，撒上腰果，开始烘焙。
steps.content_en: Pour the batter into the pot, sprinkle with cashews, and start baking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan when finished.

name_en: Lotus leaf, mung bean and lily sweet soup
description_zh: 荷叶、百合经过炮制以后，具有清暑利湿、升阳发散、祛瘀止血等作用，对多种病症均有一定疗效。
description_en: Prepared lotus leaf and lily bulb help clear summer heat, promote diuresis, raise yang, dispel stasis, and stop bleeding, offering some benefit for various ailments.
tips_zh: 冰镇后味道更佳。
tips_en: It tastes better chilled.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料，绿豆与百合洗净浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients, wash the mung beans and lilies and soak them for 2 hours.

steps.content_zh: 干荷叶洗净后与百合、绿豆同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the dried lotus leaves and put them into the pot together with lilies and mung beans. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 玫瑰花不仅可以减肥，还具有一定的美容功效，对女性的好处是尤其明显的。多饮玫瑰减脂茶，去油解腻，去火明目。
description_en: Roses can not only lose weight, but also have certain beauty effects, especially for women. Drink more rose fat-reducing tea to remove oil and greasiness, remove fire and improve eyesight.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 原料洗净后一起放入锅中（冰糖除外），水加到水位线：稠粥3/4的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the raw materials and put them into the pot together (except rock sugar). Add water to the water level: 3/4 of the thick porridge and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味。
steps.content_en: After completion, you can add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 口感带有微微的韧性，清新爽口，非常适合夏天吃，这一款蛋糕的热量也是比普通蛋糕低。
description_en: The taste is slightly tough, fresh and refreshing, and is very suitable for summer. This cake also has lower calories than ordinary cakes.
tips_zh: 嫩豆腐也可以用60克无糖豆浆加30克底筋面粉和20克玉米淀粉代替。
tips_en: Silk tofu can also be replaced with 60 grams of sugar-free soy milk, 30 grams of base flour and 20 grams of corn starch.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 嫩豆腐用打蛋器打成顺滑状。
steps.content_en: Beat the soft tofu with a whisk until smooth.

steps.content_zh: 筛入面粉、玉米油搅拌均匀。蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。装蛋清的容器要无水、无油、无蛋黄。全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。
steps.content_en: Sift in flour and corn oil and stir evenly. The egg yolk is separated from the egg white, and there must be no yolk in the egg white. The container containing egg whites should be free of water, oil and egg yolk. Clean all tools and wipe them dry, especially those used to beat egg whites.

steps.content_zh: 用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加40克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating; when large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and keep beating; once the foam is fine and dense, add 40 g more sugar and beat to stiff peaks.

steps.content_zh: 蛋白霜与面糊混合，切拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Fold the meringue into the batter until evenly combined.

steps.content_zh: 撒上杏仁碎。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with crushed almonds.

steps.content_zh: 搅拌后放入锅胆中。选择蛋糕模式，烹饪55分钟。
steps.content_en: Stir and pour into the inner pot. Select Cake mode and cook 55 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 完成后切块，用整个的杏仁装饰。
steps.content_en: When done, cut into cubes and garnish with whole almonds.

description_zh: 还记得那个小品吗，这就是当年叱咤春晚的“玛勒姬丝”。鸡肉含有维生素C、E等，蛋白质的含量比例也比较高，而且消化率高，很容易被人体吸收利用。鸡丝软嫩，椒丝脆爽，麻辣爽口，风味独特。
description_en: Remember that skit? This is the famous 'Malajisi' dish from the Spring Festival Gala. Chicken is rich in vitamins C and E and high-quality protein that's easy to digest. The tender chicken and crisp peppers make it spicy, numbing and unique.
tips_zh: 冷藏下风味更佳哦。
tips_en: The flavor is better when refrigerated.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鸡胸在中间片开，成两大片放上生姜，蒸煮模式15分钟。
steps.content_en: Slice the chicken breast in half horizontally into two large pieces, add ginger, and steam-cook for 15 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 黄瓜切条，大葱切丝。
steps.content_en: Cut the cucumber into strips and the scallion into thin shreds.

steps.content_zh: 大蒜压成蒜蓉。
steps.content_en: Press the garlic into minced garlic.

steps.content_zh: 芝麻油、生抽、花椒油、芝麻酱、辣椒油、蒜蓉，混合搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Mix sesame oil, light soy sauce, Sichuan pepper oil, sesame paste, chili oil, and minced garlic until well combined.

steps.content_zh: 鸡胸煮熟后放入冷水中放凉。
steps.content_en: After the chicken breasts are cooked, place them in cold water and let cool.

steps.content_zh: 撕成鸡丝。
steps.content_en: Shred the chicken.

steps.content_zh: 将鸡丝与黄瓜放入调好的酱料中，放入花生米，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Add shredded chicken and cucumber into the prepared sauce, add peanuts, and stir evenly.

steps.content_zh: 装盘，撒上香菜、葱丝，白芝麻。
steps.content_en: Plate and garnish with cilantro, shredded scallion and white sesame seeds.

description_zh: 浓郁的麦香加上香甜的牛奶和清香的蓝莓，让你充满活力一早上。
description_en: Rich wheat aroma, sweet milk, and fresh blueberries will energize your whole morning.
tips_zh: 本食谱和部分图片由DayDayCook日日煮提供。
tips_en: This recipe and some photos are provided by DayDayCook.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 生燕麦片洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥的1/2的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the raw oatmeal and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level: 1/2 of the thick porridge and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪剩余10分钟时倒入牛奶，继续煮。完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味。撒上蓝莓就可享用啦。
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, pour in the milk and keep cooking. Add sugar to taste when done, then top with blueberries and enjoy.

description_zh: 红薯糖水的做法超级简单，搭配生姜和牛奶营养丰富，此款糖水非常适合姑娘们。
description_en: This sweet potato dessert soup is super easy to make, and with ginger and milk it is very nutritious — perfect for girls.
tips_zh: 本食谱和部分图片由DayDayCook日日煮提供。
tips_en: This recipe and some photos are provided by DayDayCook.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 红薯去皮切块。
steps.content_en: Peel and cut sweet potatoes into cubes.

steps.content_zh: 生姜拍松。
steps.content_en: Lightly crush the ginger.

steps.content_zh: 红薯、生姜和冰糖放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1/2的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the sweet potato, ginger and rock sugar in the pot, add water up to the 1/2 mark of the thick porridge level, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时放入牛奶，时间结束后即可享用。
steps.content_en: With 5 minutes left, add the milk; enjoy when the timer ends.

description_zh: 中医上讲鲜百合具有养心安神，润肺止咳的功效，对病后虚弱的人非常有益。荔枝不仅具有良好的营养滋补之功，而且还对气候干燥而引起的多种季节性疾病有一定的防治作用。
description_en: In traditional Chinese medicine, fresh lily bulb nourishes the heart, calms the mind, moistens the lungs and relieves cough—especially beneficial for those recovering from illness. Lychee is not only nourishing but also helps prevent various seasonal illnesses caused by dry weather.
tips_zh: 本食谱和部分图片由DayDayCook日日煮提供。
tips_en: This recipe and some photos are provided by DayDayCook.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 薏米洗净浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the job's tears for 2 hours.

steps.content_zh: 干百合洗净浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Wash the dried lilies and soak them for 2 hours.

steps.content_zh: 将浸泡好的百合、冰糖与薏米同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥3/4的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the soaked lily, rock sugar and barley into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level: 3/4 of the thick porridge, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后放入荔枝和蜂蜜，就完成啦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, add lychees and honey and it's done.

description_zh: 香叶对消化系统有显着的助益，可以帮助你打开胃口、祛退胀气、安抚胃痛，而且养肝补肾，促进尿液流动。柠檬有淡淡的清香，这种方式吃粗粮，健康又美味。
description_en: Bay leaves greatly benefit digestion—they stimulate appetite, relieve bloating, soothe stomach pain, and support liver and kidney health while promoting urine flow. Lemon adds a light, fresh aroma, making this way of eating whole grains both healthy and delicious.
tips_zh: 本食谱和部分图片由DayDayCook日日煮提供。肠胃不适者尽量减少食用柠檬和糙米。
tips_en: This recipe and some pictures are provided by DayDayCook. People with gastrointestinal discomfort should try to avoid eating lemon and brown rice.

steps.content_zh: 准备好要食材原料。
steps.content_en: Get ingredients ready.

steps.content_zh: 糙米洗净后放入锅中，放上香叶。水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the brown rice, put it in the pot with bay leaves, fill to the Northeast-rice 2 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 柠檬取柠檬汁和柠檬皮。
steps.content_en: Extract the lemon juice and zest.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后盛出米饭。放入少许盐、挤上柠檬汁搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Serve rice when cooking is complete. Add a little salt, squeeze in lemon juice and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 撒上柠檬屑即可享用。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with lemon zest and serve.

description_zh: 藜麦是唯一含优质完全蛋白质的植物性食物（也就是含肉类蛋质的植物性食物）。低升糖、低脂、低热量，富含多种矿物质，口感独特，是减肥佳品。
description_en: Quinoa is the only plant-based food containing high-quality complete protein (that is, a plant-based food containing meat and eggs). Low in sugar, low in fat, low in calories, rich in a variety of minerals and with a unique taste, it is a good product for weight loss.
tips_zh: 肠胃功能不佳者可将糙米与燕麦用白米代替。
tips_en: Those with poor digestion can replace the brown rice and oats with white rice.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 所有原料洗净后放入锅胆中，水加到水位线：东北米3的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: After washing all the raw materials, put them into the pot, add water to the water level line: 3 meters northeast, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 思慕雪，或叫果昔，英文名Smoothie，在欧美特别盛行，特别是夏季。思慕雪是将新鲜的水果与酸奶混合在一起，浓稠香甜，如丝一般顺滑。
description_en: Smoothie, or smoothie, also known as Smoothie in English, is particularly popular in Europe and the United States, especially in summer. Smoothie is a blend of fresh fruit and yogurt that is thick, sweet, and silky smooth.
tips_zh: 牛奶一定要选择高品质的全脂牛奶，不然做出来的酸奶不够浓稠。
tips_en: The milk must be high-quality whole milk, otherwise the yogurt will not be thick enough.

steps.content_zh: 先用锅烧一锅水，高温杀菌，水倒掉后擦干水分，倒入一半的牛奶，放上乳酸菌搅拌均匀后再加入另一半的牛奶。
steps.content_en: First, boil a pot of water and sterilize it at high temperature. Pour out the water and wipe it dry. Pour in half of the milk, add lactic acid bacteria and stir evenly before adding the other half of the milk.

steps.content_zh: 酸奶模式发酵12小时，完成后将酸奶放入冰箱中冷藏（纯化静置）4小时。
steps.content_en: Ferment in yogurt mode for 12 hours, then refrigerate for 4 hours to set.

steps.content_zh: 准备好其他原料。
steps.content_en: Have other ingredients ready.

steps.content_zh: 将所有原料和酸奶放入料理机中搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Place all ingredients and yogurt in a food processor and blend until smooth.

steps.content_zh: 倒出就可享用啦。
steps.content_en: Pour out and enjoy.

name_en: Glutinous rice, osmanthus and lotus root
description_zh: 桂花糯米藕，又名蜜汁糯米藕，是江南地区特色传统名点之一，糯米灌在莲藕中，配以桂花酱、大红枣一起精心制作，是江南地区传统菜式中一道独具特色的中式甜品，以其香甜、清脆、桂花香气浓郁而享有口碑。
description_en: Osmanthus glutinous rice lotus root, also known as honey-glazed glutinous rice lotus root, is one of the famous traditional snacks in the Jiangnan region. Glutinous rice is filled with lotus roots, carefully prepared with osmanthus sauce and red dates. It is a unique Chinese dessert among the traditional dishes in the Jiangnan region. It enjoys a reputation for its sweetness, crispness, and rich osmanthus aroma.
tips_zh: 选择藕节短、藕身粗的为好，从藕尖数起第二节藕最好。
tips_en: It is better to choose lotus roots with short segments and thick body. The second segment from the tip of the lotus root is the best.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前一晚浸泡好，滤干水分拌入白糖和少许干桂花。
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice overnight, drain, and mix with sugar and a little dried osmanthus.

steps.content_zh: 莲藕去皮，顶部切开当盖子。
steps.content_en: Peel the lotus root and cut the top to serve as a lid.

steps.content_zh: 把糯米塞入莲藕中放入，用牙签封口后放入锅胆中，加入足量的水没过莲藕，放入冰糖、白糖、红糖和桂花，慢煮4四小时即可。（糯米不能塞得太紧实）
steps.content_en: Stuff glutinous rice into the lotus root, seal with toothpicks and place in the inner pot. Add enough water to cover, plus rock sugar, white sugar, brown sugar and osmanthus, and simmer 4 hours. (Do not pack the rice too tightly.)

steps.content_zh: 完成后稍微冷却，出锅切片。
steps.content_en: When done, cool slightly and slice into slices.

description_zh: 这款的伯爵茶香是超超超浓郁款，唇齿留香，口感清新甘甜，有香浓的伯爵茶味。
description_en: This version has an intensely rich Earl Grey aroma that lingers, with a fresh, sweet taste.
tips_zh: 打发蛋清的时候可以将蛋清放入冰箱冷冻室中，稍微冰冻一会，有利于打发。
tips_en: When whipping egg whites, you can put the egg whites in the freezer of the refrigerator and freeze them for a while to facilitate whipping.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 牛奶、清水和一勺红茶在奶锅中煮沸后小火慢煮2分钟。过滤茶叶，取90克奶茶。
steps.content_en: Bring milk, water, and a spoonful of black tea to a boil in a saucepan, then simmer 2 minutes. Strain the tea leaves and measure out 90 g of milk tea.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中放入30克白砂糖。
steps.content_en: Add 30 g white sugar to the egg yolks.

steps.content_zh: 加入玉米油、奶茶搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Add corn oil and milk tea and stir evenly.

steps.content_zh: 将剩下的红茶研磨到蛋黄中。
steps.content_en: Grind the remaining black tea into the egg yolks.

steps.content_zh: 筛入面粉，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Sift in the flour and stir well.

steps.content_zh: 全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加40克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Wash and dry all tools, especially those for beating egg whites. Separate yolks from whites—no yolk in the whites. Beat the whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating. When large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and continue. When the foam becomes fine and dense, add 40 g more sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄糊和蛋白糊混合，切拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Mix egg yolk paste and egg white paste, cut and mix evenly.

steps.content_zh: 将混合好的面糊倒入锅胆中，轻轻磕几下去除表面气泡。选择蛋糕模式 60分钟。
steps.content_en: Pour the mixed batter into the inner pot, tap a few times to remove surface bubbles, then select Cake mode for 60 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 完成后及时倒扣出锅。
steps.content_en: When finished, turn it upside down and take it out of the pot.

description_zh: 一道传统的泰式甜点，做法简单，味道甘甜，热量也不高，非常适合胖怕的姑娘们吃。
description_en: A traditional Thai dessert, it is simple to make, has a sweet taste and is not high in calories. It is very suitable for girls who are afraid of being fat.
tips_zh: 如果觉得椰浆有些腻，可以用椰汁代替，但是会不正宗。
tips_en: If you feel that coconut milk is a bit greasy, you can use coconut milk instead, but it will not be authentic.

steps.content_zh: 准备好做斑斓叶椰汁饭的原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients for coconut milk rice.

steps.content_zh: 泰国糯米洗净后提前浸泡一夜后，放入锅胆中加入100毫升的椰浆后加水到水位线：东北米2的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Thai glutinous rice and soak overnight. Put it in the inner pot, add 100 ml coconut milk, then add water to the 'Northeast rice 2' line and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 米饭煮好。
steps.content_en: The rice is cooked.

steps.content_zh: 准备好芒果、椰蓉。
steps.content_en: Prepare mango and coconut.

steps.content_zh: 盛出米饭盘，芒果切片。
steps.content_en: Serve the rice on a plate and slice the mango.

steps.content_zh: 用小奶锅加热椰浆浓缩。
steps.content_en: Heat the coconut milk in a small saucepan to thicken it.

steps.content_zh: 将浓缩好的椰浆盖在糯米饭上，撒上椰蓉即可。
steps.content_en: Cover the glutinous rice with the concentrated coconut milk and sprinkle with grated coconut.

description_zh: 蛋白又软又滑，蛋黄最外边一层已经凝固，里面却还有汁水。
description_en: The white is soft and smooth; the outer layer of the yolk has set while the inside is still runny.
tips_zh: 鸡蛋大小有所不同，可能煮出来的结果有所不同，可多做几次根据自己经验判断。
tips_en: Egg sizes vary, so results may differ; try a few times and judge based on your own experience.

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋洗净后放入锅胆中，水加到水位线：米2.5的位置。
steps.content_en: Wash the eggs, place in the inner pot, and add water to the rice 2.5 mark on the water level line.

steps.content_zh: 煮了9分钟的鸡蛋。
steps.content_en: Egg boiled for 9 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 煮了10分钟的鸡蛋。
steps.content_en: Egg boiled for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 煮了12分钟的鸡蛋。
steps.content_en: Egg boiled for 12 minutes.

description_zh: 温泉蛋的魅力就在于它如豆花般细嫩的蛋清和鲜黄剔透的半融蛋黄。品尝时嘴唇触碰到蛋清的柔软，一口咬下去蛋黄又温柔地化在口中，任何言语都不足表达此时心中的被治愈感。
description_en: The charm of an onsen egg lies in its silky, tofu-like white and its rich, translucent, half-set yolk. As your lips meet the tender white and the yolk melts gently in your mouth, words can hardly express the comfort.
tips_zh: 煮完鸡蛋后冲凉，直接敲开蛋壳倒出鸡蛋食用。鸡蛋中的沙门氏菌在60℃25分钟可被杀死。温泉蛋的加工时间一般为20分钟以上 温度65度以上。
tips_en: After boiling, cool the egg, crack the shell, and eat it out of the shell. Salmonella in eggs can be killed at 60 C for 25 minutes. Onsen eggs are generally cooked for over 20 minutes at above 65 C.

steps.content_zh: 常温的鸡蛋洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，点击手机烹饪图标，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the eggs at room temperature and put them into the pot. Add water to the water level: Northeast meter 2. Click the cooking icon on your phone to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 煮了25分钟的温泉蛋，半融蛋黄，豆花般的蛋清。
steps.content_en: Hot spring eggs cooked for 25 minutes, half-melted egg yolk, and egg white like tofu pudding.

steps.content_zh: 煮了30分钟的温泉蛋，蛋黄已经全凝固，但是依然松软、蛋清还是豆花的状态。
steps.content_en: Onsen egg cooked for 30 minutes: the yolk is fully set but still soft, while the white remains silky like tofu pudding.

steps.content_zh: 也可以搭配各种蔬菜沙拉食用，是一个完美的早餐组合。
steps.content_en: It can also be eaten with various vegetable salads, making it a perfect breakfast combination.

description_zh: 百合润肺止咳、养阴消热、清心安神之功效；莲子补脾止泻，益肾涩精，解暑祛火，健脾安神。
description_en: Lily bulbs moisten the lungs, relieve cough, nourish yin, clear heat, and calm the mind; lotus seeds strengthen the spleen, stop diarrhea, benefit the kidneys, relieve summer heat, and calm the spirit.
tips_zh: 夏日多食粥，清淡饮食为宜。此粥稠稀适中，可根据个人喜好调节稠稀度。
tips_en: Eat more porridge in summer and a light diet is appropriate. This porridge is moderately thick and thin, and the thickness can be adjusted according to personal preference.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 干百合提前洗净浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Wash the dried lilies and soak them for 2 hours in advance.

steps.content_zh: 莲子提前浸泡2小时（可去心）。
steps.content_en: Soak the lotus seeds for 2 hours ahead (cores may be removed).

steps.content_zh: 绿豆洗净浸泡2小时。大米洗净后与三者同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the mung beans for 2 hours. Wash the rice, then put it in the pot with the other three ingredients, add water to the thick porridge level 1 mark, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan when finished.

name_en: Tangerine peel and red bean soup
description_zh: 红豆具有清热解毒、健脾益胃、利尿消肿、通气除烦等多重功效；而陈皮有化痰止咳、助消化的作用。这款甜品不仅能清心养神、清肺和胃， 而且能让女性排毒瘦身， 养颜美肤。
description_en: Adzuki beans clear heat and detoxify, strengthen the spleen and stomach, promote urination, reduce swelling and relieve bloating and irritability; dried tangerine peel helps resolve phlegm, relieve cough and aid digestion. This dessert not only calms the mind and clears the lungs and stomach, but also helps women detoxify, slim down and beautify the skin.
tips_zh: 如果想做成红豆沙，可继续煮1小时。
tips_en: If you want to make red bean paste, you can continue cooking for 1 hour.

steps.content_zh: 红豆洗净后提前浸泡4小时左右。
steps.content_en: Wash the red beans and soak them for about 4 hours in advance.

steps.content_zh: 准备好陈皮，洗净。
steps.content_en: Prepare the tangerine peel and wash it.

steps.content_zh: 将红豆、陈皮放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the red beans and tangerine peel into the pot, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖享用。
steps.content_en: When finished, you can add an appropriate amount of sugar according to your personal taste and enjoy.

name_en: Sorghum, Glutinous Rice and Sausage Rice
description_zh: 香软的糯米配上高粱米不仅口感粗中有细，而且各种营养物质相互搭配更全面。
description_en: Soft, fragrant glutinous rice paired with sorghum not only has a texture that's both coarse and fine, but also offers a more complete mix of nutrients.
tips_zh: 糯米一定要充分的浸泡，不然会煮不熟。
tips_en: Glutinous rice must be soaked thoroughly, or it will not cook through.

steps.content_zh: 高粱米和糯米洗净后提前浸泡半天。
steps.content_en: Wash the sorghum and glutinous rice and soak for half a day in advance.

steps.content_zh: 广东腊肠切稍微厚一点的片。
steps.content_en: Cut the Cantonese sausage into slightly thicker slices.

steps.content_zh: 将泡好的高粱米和糯米放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的位置，铺上腊肠，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the soaked sorghum rice and glutinous rice into the pot, add water to the water level line: northeast rice 2, put the sausage on it, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成。
steps.content_en: Cooking is complete.

steps.content_zh: 享用吧。
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

description_zh: 风靡网络的蜂窝煤蛋糕，来一次“黑暗料理”吧。
description_en: Let’s have a “dark cuisine” with the briquette cake that is popular on the Internet.
tips_zh: 蛋糕做好，自然冷却后要放到冰箱中冷冻一会，这样模具刻出来的蛋糕不会破碎。
tips_en: After the cake is made and cooled, chill it in the fridge briefly so it won't break when cut with a mold.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄和蛋清分离，蛋黄中加入玉米油、20克糖、牛奶、竹炭粉，筛入面粉后搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Separate yolks from whites. Add corn oil, 20 g sugar, milk and bamboo charcoal powder to the yolks, sift in flour and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 剩余的60克糖，分三次加入到蛋清中，将蛋清打成干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Add the remaining 60 grams of sugar to the egg whites in three batches, and beat the egg whites into dry foam.

steps.content_zh: 将面糊和蛋白霜混合后，倒入锅胆中，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: After mixing the batter and meringue, pour it into the pot and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后倒扣出来，自然冷却放入冰箱冷冻中稍微把蛋糕冷冻结实一些。
steps.content_en: When finished, turn it upside down, let it cool naturally and put it in the refrigerator to freeze the cake a little firmer.

steps.content_zh: 用自制的模具将蛋糕刻出蜂窝煤的样子。
steps.content_en: Use a homemade mold to carve the cake into a honeycomb shape.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 绿豆沙是一种非常好的解暑食品，能清热消暑、解毒消痛、利尿除湿。夏日饮用绿豆沙，可以清凉解暑，安神养心。
description_en: Mung bean paste is an excellent summer cooler, clearing heat, relieving summer heat, detoxifying, easing pain, promoting urination and removing dampness. Drinking it in summer cools you down and calms the mind.
tips_zh: 如果想做成绿豆汤可减少一半绿豆的量。
tips_en: If you want to make mung bean soup, reduce the amount of mung beans by half.

steps.content_zh: 绿豆洗净后，提前浸泡两小时。
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and soak them for two hours in advance.

steps.content_zh: 将绿豆放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the mung beans into the pot, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味。想吃凉的可等到冷却后放入冰箱中冷藏。
steps.content_en: After completion, you can add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste. If you want to eat it cold, wait until it cools down and put it in the refrigerator.

description_zh: 再没有比遇见玉米更令人愉快的事了，就透过留在蛋糕中的颗粒感来表现这份感动吧！
description_en: There is nothing more pleasant than meeting corn, let’s express this feeling through the grainy texture left in the cake!
tips_zh: 低筋粉中可掺入一半的玉米面代替。
tips_en: Half of the cornmeal can be mixed into the cake flour instead.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 甜玉米粒用料理机打成玉米浓浆。鸡蛋，蛋黄、蛋清分离，蛋黄中加入玉米油、20克白糖、玉米浓浆搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Blend the sweet corn kernels into a thick corn puree. Separate the egg yolk and white; add corn oil, 20 g sugar, and the corn puree to the yolk and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 筛入面粉，搅拌成没有颗粒的面糊。
steps.content_en: Sift in the flour and stir until there are no lumps.

steps.content_zh: 剩余的细砂糖分三次加入蛋白中，蛋清打成干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Add the remaining caster sugar to the egg whites in three batches, and beat the egg whites into dry foam.

steps.content_zh: 面糊与蛋白霜混合均匀后倒入锅胆中，稍微磕几下锅胆，去除表面气泡，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Once the batter and meringue are well combined, pour into the inner pot, tap it a few times to remove surface bubbles, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后扣出自然冷却。
steps.content_en: When finished, take it out to cool naturally.

description_zh: 具有补血补气、消除疲劳、健胃、生津除烦、利小便的功效。糙米具有健脾养胃、补中益气、调和五脏、治疗贫血、促进消化吸收、润肠通便的功效。嚼劲十足，回味悠长。
description_en: It has the effects of nourishing blood and qi, eliminating fatigue, strengthening the stomach, promoting fluid production and relieving troubles, and promoting urination. Brown rice has the effects of strengthening the spleen and stomach, replenishing qi, harmonizing the five internal organs, treating anemia, promoting digestion and absorption, and moisturizing the intestines and laxative. It's chewy and has a long aftertaste.
tips_zh: 肠胃功能不佳者，可在糙米中放入一些东北米。
tips_en: Those with poor digestion can add some northeastern rice to the brown rice.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 糙米洗净后，放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，撒上杏仁和葡萄干，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the brown rice, put it in the pot, fill to the Northeast-rice 2 mark, sprinkle on almonds and raisins, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后稍微搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: When done, stir slightly to combine.

description_zh: 藜麦做为植物却含有动物界才具有的完全蛋白，是非常少见的，它具有均衡补充营养、增强机体功能、修复体质、调节免疫和内分泌、提高机体应激能力的功效。
description_en: As a plant, quinoa contains a complete protein that is only found in the animal kingdom, which is very rare. It has the effects of balancing nutrition, enhancing body functions, repairing the body, regulating immunity and endocrine, and improving the body's stress ability.
tips_zh: 藜麦易熟口感好，可以和各种食材搭配。
tips_en: Quinoa is easy to cook and tastes good, and can be paired with a variety of ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 藜麦和东北米洗净后同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米3的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the quinoa and Northeast rice and add to the pot together; add water to the Northeast Rice-3 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成即可享用。
steps.content_en: Complete and enjoy.

description_zh: 食用黑米能补肾，改善心、肝、脾、胃之功能，固本扶正，大补气血阴阳，对消化系统功能弱的人是很好的营养补品。同时，还可滋养肌肤，防止白发早生，具有延缓衰老之功效。保护血管，补虚养身。
description_en: Eating black rice can nourish the kidneys, improve the functions of the heart, liver, spleen, and stomach, strengthen the body, and replenish qi, blood, yin and yang. It is a good nutritional supplement for people with weak digestive system functions. At the same time, it can also nourish the skin, prevent premature gray hair, and have the effect of delaying aging. Protect blood vessels, replenish deficiency and nourish the body.
tips_zh: 优质的黑米有光泽，米粒大小均匀，不含杂质，很少有碎米。
tips_en: High-quality black rice is shiny, has uniform grain size, contains no impurities, and rarely has broken rice.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料，红枣泡发，黑米和东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients, soak the red dates, wash the black rice and Northeast rice and put them into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 2, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后拌入适量的白糖调味，还可搭配果酱食用。
steps.content_en: After cooking, mix in sugar to taste; also good with jam.

description_zh: 荞麦能够辅助降血脂、辅助降血压、改善血液循环，米饭中富含碳水化合物、富含锰。荞麦饭，健脾益气，消食宽肠。
description_en: Buckwheat helps lower blood lipids and blood pressure and improve blood circulation, while rice is rich in carbohydrates and manganese. Buckwheat rice strengthens the spleen and qi, aids digestion, and relieves bloating.
tips_zh: 荞麦多含维生素、氨基酸营养丰富，老人小孩尤宜食用。
tips_en: Buckwheat is rich in vitamins and amino acids and is especially good for the elderly and children.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 荞麦和东北米洗净后同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米3的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the buckwheat and northeastern rice and put both in the pot; add water to the northeastern rice 3 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 银耳是一种胶质食用菌和药用菌，其粗纤维有助于肠胃蠕动，减少脂肪吸收，有推动减少脂肪的作用，兼具去除脸部黄褐斑、雀斑的功效，与其花钱乱吃不可靠的减肥品，不如来点银耳，美容静心，安神助眠。
description_en: Snow fungus is a gelatinous edible and medicinal fungus. Its crude fiber aids gastrointestinal motility, reduces fat absorption and helps promote fat reduction, and it also helps remove facial melasma and freckles. Rather than spending money on unreliable diet products, have some snow fungus - it beautifies the skin, calms the mind and improves sleep.
tips_zh: 莲子心虽然苦，但是具有清热、固精、安神的功效。
tips_en: Lotus seed cores are bitter, but they clear heat, retain essence, and calm the mind.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 莲子、百合、银耳浸泡三小时（银耳要充分的浸泡，不然煮出的糖水不浓稠）。
steps.content_en: Soak the lotus seeds, lily bulbs, and white fungus for 3 hours (soak the white fungus thoroughly, or the sweet soup won't be thick).

steps.content_zh: 将莲子、银耳、百合同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the lotus seeds, white fungus, and lily into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后根据个人口味放入适量的冰糖调味。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of rock sugar to taste according to personal taste.

description_zh: 思慕雪的主要成分是新鲜的水果或者冰冻的水果，再加上碎冰、果汁、雪泥、乳制品等，混合成半固体的饮料，具有保护肠胃，促消化的功效。
description_en: The main ingredients of smoothies are fresh fruits or frozen fruits, plus crushed ice, juice, slush, dairy products, etc., mixed into a semi-solid drink, which has the effect of protecting the gastrointestinal tract and promoting digestion.
tips_zh: 1、不同菌种做酸奶使用的牛奶比例可能不同，详情参考菌种说明书。2、根据季节的温度不同、制作酸奶数量多少可适当增加或者减少发酵时间。
tips_en:
1. Different starters use different milk ratios—check the instructions on your starter.
2. Adjust the fermentation time based on the temperature and the amount you're making.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 先将锅胆开水烫煮杀菌，擦干水分。倒入一半的牛奶，放入乳酸菌混合均匀后再倒入另一半的牛奶，开始发酵。
steps.content_en: First, boil the pot bladder in boiling water to sterilize it, then wipe dry the water. Pour in half of the milk, add lactic acid bacteria and mix evenly, then pour in the other half of the milk and start fermentation.

steps.content_zh: 发酵完成后放入冰箱冷藏（钝化）至少四小时。
steps.content_en: After fermentation is complete, refrigerate (passivate) for at least four hours.

steps.content_zh: 可根据个人口味放入各种水果、果酱一起享用。
steps.content_en: You can add various fruits and jams according to your personal taste and enjoy together.
