description_zh: 银耳滋阴润肺抗衰老，是女性必备之滋补品。南瓜能够补中益气，富含维生素A，E，有美白肌肤的功效。
description_en: Snow fungus nourishes yin, moistens the lungs and fights aging - a must-have tonic for women. Pumpkin replenishes the middle and boosts qi, and is rich in vitamins A and E, which help whiten the skin.
tips_zh: 银耳要充分泡发后才能煮的软烂入口即化。
tips_en: Only after the snow fungus is fully rehydrated will it cook down soft and melt in the mouth.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 南瓜去皮切丁，银耳充分泡发。
steps.content_en: Peel and dice the pumpkin, and soak the white fungus thoroughly.

steps.content_zh: 将银耳、南瓜同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the white fungus and pumpkin into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 根据个人口味放入适量的冰糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: Add rock sugar to taste and it's done.

name_en: Coconut Milk and Mung Bean Sweet Soup
description_zh: 椰汁绿豆爽是以鲜椰浆、绿豆肉等食材制成的一道美食。具有清理去火的功效，是极佳夏日消暑美食。
description_en: Coconut milk and mung bean sweet soup is made with fresh coconut cream, shelled mung beans, and other ingredients. It clears internal heat and is an excellent summer refresher.
tips_zh: 椰汁不适合煮长时间煮，所以最好在绿豆煮好放凉后倒入。
tips_en: Coconut milk doesn't stand up to long cooking, so it's best added after the mung beans are cooked and cooled.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 绿豆浸1小时后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥½的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Soak the mung beans for 1 hour, then put them in the pot, add water to the thick porridge 1/2 mark, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后，将绿豆捞出自然冷却后，倒入冷藏的椰汁和白糖即可享用。
steps.content_en: When finished, take out the mung beans and let them cool naturally, then pour in the refrigerated coconut milk and sugar and enjoy.

description_zh: 一款很健康的低脂肪蛋糕，加上了小麦胚芽更能提供各种矿物质和微量元素。
description_en: A very healthy low-fat cake, added with wheat germ to provide various minerals and trace elements.
tips_zh: 小麦胚芽要购买即食的，如果是生的要先炒熟。
tips_en: Wheat germ should be purchased ready-to-eat. If it is raw, it should be fried first.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 蛋清和蛋黄分离，蛋黄中放入玉米油、酸奶和小麦胚芽混合后筛入低筋粉，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Separate the egg whites and yolks; mix corn oil, yogurt and wheat germ into the yolks, then sift in low-gluten flour and stir well.

steps.content_zh: 蛋清中挤入几滴柠檬汁，分三次加入细砂糖用电动打蛋器将蛋清打发至拉起有直立不弯曲的角 的状态。
steps.content_en: Add a few drops of lemon juice to the egg whites, then add caster sugar in three batches and beat with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form that stand upright without bending.

steps.content_zh: 面糊和蛋白霜搅拌均匀后倒入锅胆中，震动几下去除表面气泡，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Stir the batter and meringue evenly, then pour it into the pot, shake it a few times to remove surface bubbles, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后倒出冷却。
steps.content_en: When done, pour out to cool.

description_zh: 莲子煮不烂不是莲子的问题！莲子怎么煮才能酥烂呢？不要提前浸泡，直接开煮就能酥软！！！！隔夜浸泡五谷或者煮银耳时不软烂，即使蒸也没用，方法就在此呀！！！
description_en: If lotus seeds won't soften, it's not the seeds' fault! How do you cook them until tender? Don't soak them in advance—just start cooking and they'll turn soft!!!! If grains soaked overnight or white fungus won't soften, steaming won't help either—here's the trick!!!
tips_zh: 南瓜要选择皮厚一点，纹路稍深的，会比较香甜。
tips_en: Choose pumpkins with thicker skin and deeper veins, which will make them more fragrant and sweet.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 莲子洗净后浸泡3小时（不喜欢吃苦味的可以去掉莲子心），南瓜切小块。三者同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the lotus seeds for 3 hours (remove the cores if you dislike bitterness), and cut the pumpkin into small pieces. Put all three into the pot, add water to the porridge 1 mark, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: When finished, you can add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

name_en: Stewed Pear with Lily Bulbs and Lotus Root
description_zh: 夏秋交替，昼夜温差大。气候日渐干燥，特别容易出现咽干嗓子疼等症状。养阴润肺在这个时节正是时候。特别推荐这款养阴润肺的保健饮品——百合莲藕炖梨，就再合适不过了。
description_en: As summer turns to autumn, day-night temperature gaps widen and the air grows dry, often causing dry throat and soreness. Now is the time to nourish yin and moisten the lungs. I highly recommend this nourishing drink—pear stewed with lily bulb and lotus root.
tips_zh: 梨与螃蟹同食伤肠胃；忌与鹅肉同食。
tips_en: Eating pears with crabs harms the stomach and intestines; avoid eating with goose meat.

steps.content_zh: 准备原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 干百合洗净泡发。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the dried lily.

steps.content_zh:
莲藕去皮洗净切片，梨洗净带皮去籽切块。
将莲藕、百合、梨放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥3/4的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en:
Peel, wash and slice the lotus root; wash the pear, keep the skin on, core and cut into pieces.
Put the lotus root, lily bulbs and pear in the pot, add water to the 3/4 mark for thick porridge, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 剩余10分钟时可根据个人口味放入适量的冰糖调味。
steps.content_en: In the remaining 10 minutes, you can add an appropriate amount of rock sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 绿豆和茶的组合，不仅可以延续绿豆的清热解暑，而且会有独特的茶的香味。绿豆清热之功在皮，解毒之功在肉，是家庭常备清暑饮料，清暑开胃，老少皆宜。
description_en: The combination of mung beans and tea can not only continue the heat-clearing and relieving effects of mung beans, but also have a unique tea aroma. The heat-clearing effect of mung bean lies in the skin and the detoxifying effect lies in the meat. It is a common summer drink in the family. It can clear away heat and appetize, and is suitable for all ages.
tips_zh: 体寒、正在服用药物者不宜食用。
tips_en: People who are cold and taking medication should not consume it.

steps.content_zh: 准备原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 绿豆和大麦洗净浸泡半小时后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置。
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and barley, soak them for half an hour and put them into the pot. Add water to the water level: thick porridge 1.

steps.content_zh: 完成后根据个人口味放入适量的冰糖调味。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of rock sugar to taste according to personal taste.

description_zh: 提拉米苏好吃、精致、浪漫，人人喜爱，在节日聚会的时候做上一些，会讨得孩子们一片欢呼声。其实看似神秘的西点，制作不难，喜欢吃的朋友不如跟我一起做吧。
description_en: Tiramisu is delicious, elegant and romantic, loved by all—make some for a holiday gathering and the kids will cheer. This mysterious-looking Western dessert is actually easy; if you like it, make it with me.
tips_zh: 芝士液一定要在冰箱中冷藏到半凝固状态，不然上面一层的蛋糕会浮起来。
tips_en: The cheese mixture must be chilled in the refrigerator until semi-set, otherwise the top cake layer will float.

steps.content_zh: 准备好摩卡戚风蛋糕原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients for the mocha chiffon cake.

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋蛋黄和蛋白分离，蛋黄中放入玉米油、浓缩咖啡搅拌后筛入面粉和可可粉搅拌到无颗粒状态。
steps.content_en: Separate the yolk and white; add corn oil and espresso to the yolk, then sift in flour and cocoa powder and stir until smooth.

steps.content_zh: 蛋清打成干性泡发后与面糊混合，倒入锅中开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks, fold into the batter, pour into the pot and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 准备好奶油芝士的原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare the cream cheese ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 吉利丁粉用少许凉水浸泡。
steps.content_en: Soak the gelatine powder in a little cold water.

steps.content_zh: 咖啡酒和浸好的吉利丁粉隔水加热融化。
steps.content_en: Heat the coffee wine and soaked gelatine powder over water and melt.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄加入糖打发到发白的状态后缓缓倒入热咖啡酒。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg yolks with sugar until pale, then slowly pour in the hot coffee liqueur.

steps.content_zh: 芝士打成顺滑状态、奶油加糖打发到有纹路状态后两者混合，加入冷却的咖啡酒搅拌均匀，放到冰箱冷藏。
steps.content_en: Beat the cheese until smooth, beat the cream and sugar until they are textured, then mix the two, add the cooled coffee wine, stir evenly, and put it in the refrigerator.

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕做好后完全冷却，切成两片用慕斯圈压成圆形后将一张稍微切小一圈。
steps.content_en: Once the cake is done and completely cool, cut it into two layers, cut rounds with a mousse ring and trim one slightly smaller.

steps.content_zh: 待奶油芝士液冷却到半凝固状态时取出，倒入第一片蛋糕上。
steps.content_en: When the cream cheese liquid has cooled to a semi-solidified state, take it out and pour it onto the first piece of cake.

steps.content_zh: 重复上一个步骤，完成后放入冰箱冷藏一夜。
steps.content_en: Repeat the previous step and place in the refrigerator overnight.

steps.content_zh: 取出脱模用可可粉装饰。
steps.content_en: Remove from mold and decorate with cocoa powder.

name_en: Fermented black bean and rib braised rice
description_zh: 【焖饭】是我家里经常做的一种快速料理，别以为【快速】这两个字听起来感觉这道饭有点马虎；其实口感相当的好吃而且省事。在煮米饭的时候电饭煲底部不断的在加热，而热度不断的上升；米饭表面放的肋排，而肋排肉汁不断的给米饭吸收了，所有的精华都在米饭里。 米饭中透着排骨和豆豉的香味，软软的土豆更是让人流连忘返。
description_en: Stewed rice is a quick dish I often make at home. Don't let 'quick' fool you—it's delicious and easy. As the rice cooker heats from the bottom, the ribs on top release their juices into the rice, so all the flavor ends up in the grains. The rice is fragrant with pork and fermented black beans, and the soft potatoes are simply irresistible.
tips_zh: 豆豉可以用老干妈辣椒酱代替。
tips_en: You can substitute chili sauce for the fermented black beans.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 排骨飞水后洗净。
steps.content_en: Blanch the ribs and wash.

steps.content_zh: 处理好的排骨用豆豉、耗油、生抽、生姜、干辣椒、料酒腌制2小时。胡萝卜切丁。
steps.content_en: Marinate the prepared ribs with fermented black beans, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, ginger, dried chili and cooking wine for 2 hours. Dice the carrot.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度。上面撒上胡萝卜，倒入腌制好的排骨和腌料，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice and add water to the water line: Northeast Rice level 2. Sprinkle carrot on top, add the marinated ribs and marinade, then start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成。
steps.content_en: Cooking is complete.

steps.content_zh: 出锅撒上葱花即可享用。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan and sprinkle with chopped green onion and enjoy.

description_zh: 冬天里我最喜欢吃的就是咸肉菜饭了，真正的百吃不厌啊~~ 这天气是一日冷过一日了，冷风吹在身上就很想念菜饭的味道啊！有股浓浓的老上海的味道，真的是喜欢到不行呀！
description_en: My favorite in winter is cured pork with greens and rice—I never tire of it. As the days get colder and the wind bites, I crave that old Shanghai flavor more than ever. Absolutely love it!
tips_zh: 若有结冻的猪油，取少许拌在饭里更香！
tips_en: If you have frozen lard, stir a little into the rice for extra fragrance!

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 咸肉在水中浸泡一会，去除些盐分，切长条。青菜切碎。
steps.content_en: Soak the cured pork briefly to remove some salt, then cut into strips. Chop the greens.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热后放入少许油，先将咸肉炒出油，变得透明后，再放入青菜炒断生。
steps.content_en: After the wok is hot, add a little oil. First fry the bacon until the oil becomes transparent, then add the vegetables and fry until raw.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，倒入炒好的肉和菜。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 2 mark. Pour in the fried meat and vegetables. Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Stir well after cooking.

steps.content_zh: 出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan.

description_zh: 对妈妈拿手的五香牛肉焖饭我记忆尤深：牛肉在调味料的作用下慢慢炖着，这道从妈妈手里传承来的菜，现在已成为我家必备的菜肴，在我心中也成为家的味道之代表。
description_en: I particularly remember my mother’s specialty five-spice beef stewed rice: the beef is slowly stewed with seasonings. This dish passed down from my mother has now become a must-have dish in my family, and it has also become a representative of the taste of home in my heart.
tips_zh: 要选取优质的牛腩，瘦肉中带有肥肉，这样才香。
tips_en: Choose good beef brisket with some fat marbled in the lean meat for the best flavor.

ingredients.name_en: Star anise, dried chili pepper, bay leaves

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 各种蔬菜切丁、牛腩切小块。
steps.content_en: Dice various vegetables and cut beef brisket into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅中加入油，将牛腩炒香后放入香料、蔬菜翻炒。用料酒、生抽、老抽、冰糖调味后加入水没过原料。
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a pan and stir-fry the beef brisket until fragrant, then add the spices and vegetables. Season with cooking wine, light and dark soy sauce, and rock sugar, then add water to cover.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后滤干水分，倒入锅中，倒入上一步骤的牛肉和汤汁（牛肉汤汁较多，不需额外加水）。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeastern rice, drain the water, pour it into the pot, and pour in the beef and soup from the previous step (the beef has more soup, so no additional water is needed). Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成。
steps.content_en: Cooking is complete.

steps.content_zh: 出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan.

ingredients.name_en: Star anise, dried chili pepper, bay leaves

description_zh: 香菇滑稽...哦不，滑鸡饭是也。香菇是世界第二大食用菌，也是我国特产之一，在民间素有“山珍”之称。干香菇、鸡肉混合鲜嫩可口，食材丰富，营养全面。
description_en: The mushrooms are funny...oh no, the chicken rice is too. Shiitake mushrooms are the second largest edible fungi in the world and one of my country's specialties. They are known as "mountain delicacies" among the people. The mixture of dried mushrooms and chicken is tender and delicious, rich in ingredients and comprehensive in nutrition.
tips_zh: 鸡肉也可用鸡胸肉，但是没有鸡腿肉口感Q 弹。
tips_en: You can use chicken breast instead, but it won't be as springy as chicken thigh meat.

steps.content_zh: 准备好原料。
steps.content_en: Get the ingredients ready.

steps.content_zh: 香菇洗净泡发，鸡肉切片。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the mushrooms and slice the chicken.

steps.content_zh: 香菇和鸡肉混合后用耗油、生姜、料酒、小葱腌制1小时。
steps.content_en: Mix the mushrooms and chicken and marinate them with oil, ginger, cooking wine, and green onions for 1 hour.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，倒入腌制好的鸡肉和菌菇，开始烹饪。菌菇类腌制和烹饪过程中会析出水分）。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice, add water to the water line: Northeast Rice level 2, add the marinated chicken and mushrooms, then start cooking. (Mushrooms release water during marinating and cooking.)

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后尝一下咸淡，如果淡的话撒上盐调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, taste and add salt if it needs more seasoning;

steps.content_zh: 出锅，撒上葱花。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan and sprinkle with chopped green onion.

description_zh: 天天上班，尤其是中午，饭做得复杂了，休息的时间就没有了，太简单又撑不过一下午。咋办？简单---那就来一份有菜又有肉的米饭吧。土豆排骨糯米饭，米饭入味、排骨酥烂、土豆香软。
description_en: Working every day, especially at lunch: an elaborate meal leaves no time to rest, but something too simple won't fill you up for the afternoon. What to do? Easy—have a rice meal with both veggies and meat. Sticky rice with potatoes and ribs: flavorful rice, tender ribs and soft, fragrant potatoes.
tips_zh: 排骨要选取优质的仔排，味道会更好。
tips_en: Choose good-quality young ribs for better flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 圆糯米洗净浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the round glutinous rice for 2 hours.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅中放油，将香料炒香、煎排骨、加入料酒、生抽、老抽、冰糖后放入水和土豆。（水与原料齐平即可）烧开即可。
steps.content_en: Put oil in a wok, stir-fry the spices until fragrant, fry the ribs, add cooking wine, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, rock sugar, then add water and potatoes. (The water is level with the raw materials.) Bring to a boil.

steps.content_zh:
圆糯米滤干水分，东北米洗净后倒入锅中，再加入上一步骤的排骨，（注意汤汁不要太多，与食材齐平即可）
开始烹饪。
steps.content_en:
Drain the round glutinous rice. Wash the Northeast rice and pour into the pot, then add the ribs from the previous step. (Don't add too much sauce—just enough to cover the ingredients.)
Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成。
steps.content_en: Cooking is complete.

steps.content_zh: 出锅享用。
steps.content_en: Serve out of the pan and enjoy.

description_zh: 咖喱一词来源于坦米尔语，是“许多的香料加在一起煮”的意思，据说咖喱的故乡在印度，是因为他们为终年闷热潮湿的天气所致。但好多国家都有咖喱，且种类不同、颜色不同、味道也不同，学问大啦！这道咖喱鸡肉炊饭算是咖喱控和懒癌患者的福音，一锅搞定。
description_en: The word curry comes from Tamil, which means "many spices added together to cook". It is said that the hometown of curry is in India because they suffer from the hot and humid weather all year round. But many countries have curry, and there are different types, colors, and tastes. It’s a great place to learn! This curry chicken rice is good news for curry addicts and lazy cancer patients, it can be cooked in one pot.
tips_zh: 除了鸡肉还可以做成自己喜爱的其他食材。
tips_en: Besides chicken, you can use other ingredients you like.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿肉和各种蔬菜切丁。
steps.content_en: Dice chicken thighs and various vegetables.

steps.content_zh: 先在炒锅中将放入油将洋葱炒香，后放入鸡腿油煎上色，再放入土豆和胡萝卜，加入水和咖哩块，熬成稍微浓稠的咖喱酱。
steps.content_en: First add oil in a wok and sauté the onions until fragrant, then add the chicken legs and fry until browned, then add the potatoes and carrots, add water and curry cubes, and simmer into a slightly thick curry sauce.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后，水加到水位线：东北米1的刻度。（给咖喱酱留出空间，不然米饭会变稀）
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice and add water to the water line: Northeast Rice level 1. (Leave room for the curry sauce, or the rice will turn too soft.)

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan when finished.

description_zh: 香肠扩张血管、促进生长、发育、增强免疫力；腊肉保护神经系统、补血、护齿；鸡蛋润燥、增强免疫力、护眼明目，健康营养， 让美味更简单。
description_en: Sausage dilates blood vessels, promotes growth and development, and enhances immunity; bacon protects the nervous system, nourishes blood, and protects teeth; eggs moisturize, enhance immunity, protect eyesight, and are healthy and nutritious, making delicious food easier.
tips_zh: 喜欢的话还可以在饭上浇上酱汁，生抽+耗油+麻油，比例是大约3:1:1。
tips_en: If you like, you can also top the rice with sauce, light soy sauce + oil + sesame oil, the ratio is about 3:1:1.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 香菇泡发。
steps.content_en: Rehydrate the shiitake mushrooms.

steps.content_zh: 腊鸡腿切厚片、香菇切丁、香肠切片。
steps.content_en: Cut the cured chicken legs into thick slices, dice the mushrooms, and slice the sausages.

steps.content_zh: 大米洗好后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，放入上一步的原料。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice, place in the pot, add water to the water line: Northeast Rice level 2, add the ingredients from the previous step and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时放入洗好的上海青焖熟，烹饪完成后即可出锅。搭配一个太阳蛋就能美美的享用了。
steps.content_en: With 5 minutes left, add the washed bok choy and steam until cooked. Serve when done — delicious with a sunny-side-up egg.

name_en: Winter Melon and Mung Bean Soup
description_zh: 冬瓜具有消暑止渴、清热化痰、利尿消肿、减肥解毒等功效。味淡爽口，独具清香，是夏季的理想蔬菜。绿豆不仅营养丰富，而且还是夏日解暑佳品。
description_en: Winter melon relieves summer heat and thirst, clears heat and phlegm, promotes urination, reduces swelling, aids weight loss and detoxifies. Mild and refreshing with a delicate aroma, it's an ideal summer vegetable. Mung beans are not only nutritious but also a classic summer cooler.
tips_zh: 薏米虽好但是孕妇及津枯便秘者忌用。
tips_en: Although barley is good, it should not be used by pregnant women and those with constipation.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 薏米与绿豆提前浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Soak barley and mung beans for 2 hours in advance.

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜去皮切丁（可不用去皮）。
steps.content_en: Peel and dice the winter melon (no need to peel).

steps.content_zh: 将冬瓜、薏米和绿豆同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。完成后根据个人口味放入适量的冰糖调味。
steps.content_en: Place the winter melon, job's tears and mung beans in the pot, add water to the water line: Thick Porridge level 1, and start cooking. When done, add rock sugar to taste.

description_zh: 金银花清热解毒，莲子养心安神、止泻、补脾，大米富含碳水化合物、富含锰，三者结合可以更好地清热明目，解毒降火。
description_en: Honeysuckle clears away heat and detoxifies, lotus seeds nourish the heart and calm the mind, stop diarrhea, and tonify the spleen. Rice is rich in carbohydrates and manganese. The combination of the three can better clear away heat and improve eyesight, detoxify and reduce fire.
tips_zh: 体虚及脾胃功能弱者不宜食用莲子。
tips_en: People with physical weakness and weak spleen and stomach functions should not eat lotus seeds.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 莲子洗净后泡发。（不喜欢莲子心可去心）
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the lotus seeds. (Remove the cores if you dislike the bitter taste)

steps.content_zh: 粳米洗净后与金银花、莲子同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味。
steps.content_en: Wash the japonica rice and put it into the pot together with the honeysuckle and lotus seeds. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 and start cooking. After completion, you can add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

name_en: Buckwheat and Purple Sweet Potato Rice
description_zh: 荞麦等五谷可以减少若干慢病的发病风险，和米饭、紫薯的搭配易于消化吸收，补充微量元素，增强免疫力，非常适合老人食用。
description_en: Grains such as buckwheat can lower the risk of several chronic diseases; paired with rice and purple sweet potatoes, they are easy to digest and absorb, supply trace elements, and strengthen immunity—ideal for older people.
tips_zh: 脾胃虚寒，消化功能不佳者不宜食用过量荞麦。
tips_en: Those with a weak, cold stomach or poor digestion should not eat too much buckwheat.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 紫薯洗净去皮切丁。
steps.content_en: Wash, peel and dice the purple sweet potato.

steps.content_zh: 东北米和荞麦洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米3的刻度，撒上处理好的紫薯丁。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice and buckwheat and put them into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 3 mark, and sprinkle with the processed purple potato cubes. Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan when finished.

description_zh: 没有胃口的时候，看见荤菜都没有食欲了。如果能吃上一口清甜美味，加上养生中药做的甜品。即养生又凉血解毒是件多么让人惬意的事情。看到这你是不是有点迫不及待，别急慢慢往下看 ~
description_en: When I have no appetite, I lose my appetite even when I see meat dishes. If you can have a bite of sweet and delicious desserts made with health-preserving Chinese medicine. It is such a satisfying thing to maintain health and cool the blood and detoxify. Are you a little impatient after seeing this? Don’t be impatient and read on slowly ~
tips_zh: 食用后不宜饮浓茶。
tips_en: Avoid drinking strong tea after eating.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 南瓜去皮去籽切块。
steps.content_en: Peel, remove seeds and cut pumpkin into cubes.

steps.content_zh: 龟苓膏切块待用。
steps.content_en: Cut the turtle paste into pieces and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 南瓜放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥¾的刻度，开始烹饪。完成后盛出，放入龟苓膏和蜂蜜即可享用。
steps.content_en: Put the pumpkin into the pot, add water to the water level: ¾ of the thick porridge mark, and start cooking. When finished, take it out, add turtle paste and honey and enjoy.

description_zh: 胡萝卜中的维生素含量比较高，但是呢有的孩子却不爱吃它。这款蛋糕孩子肯定喜欢的，根本吃不出来里面加了胡萝卜。而且把蔬菜加进蛋糕里，还可以充分补充维生素呢！
description_en: Carrots have a relatively high vitamin content, but some children don’t like to eat them. Children will definitely like this cake, and they won’t be able to tell that carrots are added to it. And adding vegetables to the cake can also fully supplement vitamins!
tips_zh: 胡萝卜会出水，所以面糊可以稠一点。
tips_en: The carrots will release water, so the batter can be thicker.

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜洗净后搓成胡萝卜屑。
steps.content_en: Wash the carrots and grind into carrot crumbs.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄和蛋清分离，蛋黄、玉米油、牛奶倒入胡萝卜屑中，搅拌均匀后筛入面粉搅拌到顺滑无颗粒。
steps.content_en: Separate the egg yolk and egg white, pour the egg yolk, corn oil, and milk into the carrot crumbs, stir evenly, then sift in the flour and stir until smooth and without particles.

steps.content_zh: 蛋清加入细砂糖打成干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Beat egg whites with caster sugar until dry.

steps.content_zh: 蛋白霜和面糊混合后倒入锅胆中，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: After the meringue and batter are mixed, pour it into the pot and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后倒扣。
steps.content_en: Back off when finished.

description_zh: 最近胃又开始折磨人，比较懒，正常的饭量胃也会又胀又泛酸。想着还是琢磨着吃点清淡的吧。朋友推荐了这款易消化的粥，即使是有胃病，也可以凉血解毒，润肌美容.
description_en: My stomach has been acting up again lately, and I've been feeling sluggish—even a normal portion leaves me bloated and acid reflux-y. I figured I should eat something light. A friend recommended this easy-to-digest porridge; even with stomach trouble, it can cool the blood, detoxify, and nourish the skin.
tips_zh: 若要加强解毒凉血的效果，可连同冬瓜皮一起煮食。
tips_en: To enhance the effect of detoxifying and cooling blood, you can cook the winter melon peel together.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 肉糜用姜末，盐腌制一会。
steps.content_en: Marinate the minced meat with minced ginger and salt for a while.

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜切片。将东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。烹饪时间剩余30分钟时，放入冬瓜和肉糜，搅拌。
steps.content_en: Slice the winter melon. Wash the Northeast rice, place in the pot, add water to the water line: Thick Porridge level 1, and start cooking. When 30 minutes remain, add the winter melon and minced pork and stir.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后用盐、胡椒粉调味，撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with chopped scallion.

name_en: Preserved egg and lean meat porridge
description_zh: 【皮蛋瘦肉粥】是广东经典的粥品，无人不知无人不晓的老火靓粥。皮蛋瘦肉粥能清热去虚火。皮蛋瘦肉粥不仅香浓软滑，饱腹暖心，皮蛋Q弹瘦肉嫩滑，一口能感受它的米粥芬香。
description_en: Congee with century egg and lean pork is a classic Cantonese slow-cooked porridge known to everyone. It's believed to clear heat and ease internal fire. Creamy, soft, and warming, with bouncy century egg and tender pork—every spoonful is fragrant.
tips_zh: 不宜食用过多皮蛋。
tips_en: It is not advisable to eat too many preserved eggs.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 肉糜用盐、料酒、生姜腌制一会，生姜切丝、皮蛋切块、小葱切葱花。
steps.content_en: Marinate the minced meat with salt, cooking wine and ginger for a while; shred the ginger, cut the century egg into pieces and chop the scallion.

steps.content_zh: 粳米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入皮蛋和肉糜，搅拌均匀后继续焖煮。完成后用盐、胡椒粉调味后撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: Wash the japonica rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 and start cooking. When 30 minutes are left in the cooking time, add preserved eggs and minced meat, mix well and continue to simmer. When finished, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with chopped green onion.

description_zh: 很多朋友都喜欢吃排骨，排骨比一般的瘦肉，都会味道好一些。而很多朋友会买一些排骨来煮粥。当然光是排骨粥会很单调，所以一些朋友会选择煮山药排骨粥。煮的好吃的话，这样当然是让人很喜欢吃的。那么，山药排骨粥的做法是什么?不如就一起来看一下，希望下面的内容对大家有所启发。
description_en: Many people love ribs—more flavorful than ordinary lean meat—and some use them for porridge. On its own rib porridge can be bland, so yam rib porridge is a popular choice and, well made, is truly delightful. So how do you make it? Let us take a look—hope this helps.
tips_zh: 糖尿病患者不可多食。
tips_en: Diabetics should not eat too much.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片，铁棍山药洗净去皮切块。
steps.content_en: Slice the ginger, wash, peel and cut the iron stick yam into cubes.

steps.content_zh: 排骨出水后洗净。
steps.content_en: Blanch the ribs and wash.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，放入排骨和山药，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeastern rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1. Add the ribs and yams and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入盐和胡椒粉调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt and pepper.

steps.content_zh: 出锅后撒上葱花。
steps.content_en: After serving, sprinkle with green onion.

description_zh: 生滚牛肉粥是一道美味可口的汉族名点，属于粤菜系。作为广州传统粥品，是将预先煮好的粥底加入新鲜肉料滚后片刻离火而成。生滚粥的做法既保存了食材原来的鲜美度，又不会破坏其营养物质，非常的鲜香好吃。
description_en: Quick-boiled beef congee is a classic Cantonese dish. A traditional Guangzhou congee, it's made by adding fresh ingredients to a pre-cooked rice base and boiling briefly before taking it off the heat. This method preserves the ingredients' natural flavor and nutrients, making it deliciously fresh and aromatic.
tips_zh: 牛肉末也可以用薄牛肉片代替。
tips_en: Ground beef can be replaced with thinly sliced beef.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切丝、青菜切碎、牛肉碎用料酒、生姜和生抽腌制一会。
steps.content_en: Shred the ginger, chop the greens, and marinate the minced beef with cooking wine, ginger, and light soy sauce for a while.

steps.content_zh: 粳米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the japonica rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入青菜和牛肉碎，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add the greens and minced beef, and stir well.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后用生抽、芝麻油调味即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, season with light soy sauce and sesame oil.

description_zh: 鸡肉对营养不良、畏寒怕冷、乏力疲劳、月经不调、贫血、虚弱等有很好的食疗作用。香菇营养丰富，多吃能强身健体、增加对疾病的抵抗能力、促进胎儿的发育。此粥富含多种营养元素，且极易被人吸收。
description_en: Chicken has therapeutic benefits for malnutrition, chills, fatigue, irregular menstruation, anemia, and weakness. Shiitake mushrooms are nutritious and, when eaten often, can strengthen the body, boost immunity, and promote fetal development. This congee is rich in various nutrients and is easily absorbed.
tips_zh: 鸡腿肉也可用鸡胸肉代替，但是没有鸡腿肉Q弹。
tips_en: Chicken thighs can also be replaced with chicken breasts, but there are no chicken thighs.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 干香菇泡发后切丁，鸡肉切片后用盐、生姜胡椒粉腌制，小葱切成葱花。
steps.content_en: Soak the dried shiitake mushrooms and dice them, slice the chicken and marinate it with salt, ginger and pepper, and cut the shallots into chopped green onions.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后与香菇同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪，烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入腌制好的鸡肉。搅拌后继续焖煮，完成后用盐、胡椒粉调味，撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeastern rice and put it into the pot with the mushrooms at the same time. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 and start cooking. When the cooking time is 30 minutes left, add the marinated chicken. Stir and continue to simmer. When finished, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with chopped green onion.

description_zh: 入秋了，不过天气依然会有点炎热，这时候来碗热乎乎的清淡粥，放入鲜虾芹菜不油腻又鲜味十足，这个季节再合适不过了。芹菜鲜虾粥清香鲜美，还能低脂降压。
description_en: Autumn has arrived but the weather is still warm. A warm, light porridge with fresh shrimp and celery is not greasy yet full of flavor—just right for this season. Celery and shrimp porridge is fragrant, refreshing, low-fat and helps lower blood pressure.
tips_zh: 购买鲜虾时要注意，新鲜的虾头尾与身体紧密相连，虾身有一定的弯曲度。
tips_en: When buying fresh shrimp, you should pay attention to the fact that the head and tail of fresh shrimp are closely connected to the body, and the body of the shrimp has a certain degree of curvature.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切丝、小葱切葱花、芹菜切丁。
steps.content_en: Shred the ginger, chop the scallions, and dice the celery.

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾去虾线。
steps.content_en: Devein the fresh shrimp.

steps.content_zh: 粳米洗净后与姜丝放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的位置，开始烹饪。烹饪时间剩余 30分钟时，放入芹菜和鲜虾，继续焖煮。
steps.content_en: Wash the japonica rice and add with shredded ginger to the pot; fill to the thick-congee 1 mark and start cooking. When 30 minutes remain, add celery and fresh shrimp and keep simmering.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后用盐和胡椒粉调味，撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with chopped scallion.

description_zh: 今天做一款简单的养生粥：丝瓜虾米粥。此粥软烂易消化、颜色清新、消暑开胃，还能护肤美容，真的是老少皆宜哦！
description_en: Today's simple nourishing porridge: loofah and dried shrimp porridge. Soft, easy to digest, light and refreshing, it cools summer heat, whets the appetite and is good for the skin—perfect for all ages.
tips_zh: 挑选丝瓜时以选表皮呈鲜嫩的绿色、没有刮伤或变色的为佳。
tips_en: When choosing loofah, it is better to choose one with fresh green skin and no scratches or discoloration.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 丝瓜切片，生姜切丝，虾米洗净后稍微浸泡去除杂质。粳米和虾米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Slice the loofah, shred the ginger, wash the dried shrimps and soak them briefly to remove impurities. Wash the japonica rice and dried shrimps and put them into the pot. Add water to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入处理好的姜丝和丝瓜，烹饪完成后调味、撒上葱花和虾米即可。
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add the prepared shredded ginger and loofah. After cooking, season and sprinkle with chopped scallion and dried shrimp.

description_zh: 遇上没胃口的时候，喝粥是上选。选择这款田园虾仁粥，因为虾仁中富含多种矿物质，所以它是极好的养生粥品哦。
description_en: When you have no appetite, porridge is the best choice. This garden shrimp porridge is packed with minerals from the shrimp, making it a great nourishing meal.
tips_zh: 优质虾仁的表面略带青灰色或有桃仁网纹，前端粗圆，后端尖细，呈弯钩状，色泽鲜艳；而水泡虾仁体发白或微黄，轻度红变，体半透明，露出的肠线较鲜虾粗大或已散开。
tips_en: Good-quality peeled shrimp are slightly bluish-gray or have a walnut-like pattern, thick and round at the front, tapering to a hooked tail, with bright color. Water-soaked shrimp look white or yellowish, slightly reddened and translucent, with a thicker or loosened vein.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切丝、小葱切葱花、干香菇洗净泡发、虾仁用胡椒、盐和生姜腌制一会。青豆、胡萝卜、玉米粒和香菇同时放入锅中，加入洗好的粳米，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Shred the ginger, chop the scallions, rinse and soak the dried shiitake mushrooms, and marinate the shrimp with pepper, salt, and ginger for a while. Add green peas, diced carrot, corn kernels, and mushrooms to the pot with the rinsed japonica rice. Add water to the 'thick porridge 1' level and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时，倒入腌制好的虾仁，继续焖煮都结束。
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add the marinated shrimp and simmer until done.

steps.content_zh: 放入适量的盐和白胡椒粉调味，出锅后撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: Season with salt and white pepper, then sprinkle with scallion before serving.

description_zh: 一抹红色的诱惑——红丝绒蛋糕。松软的蛋糕胚抹上了诱人的奶油芝士霜，最后点缀上可爱的车厘子和鲜红的草莓，别特多好看了。
description_en: A touch of red temptation—red velvet cake. Soft sponge layered with tempting cream cheese frosting, topped with cute cherries and bright red strawberries. Simply beautiful.
tips_zh:
1、一定要等蛋糕冷却了再切片，不然会碎。
2、没有红曲米粉用可可粉代替。
tips_en:
1. Let the cake cool completely before slicing, or it will crumble.
2. No red yeast rice powder? Use cocoa powder instead.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋的蛋白和蛋清分离；
steps.content_en: Separation of egg whites and whites;

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中加入玉米油、牛奶，搅拌均匀后筛入红曲粉和低筋粉；
steps.content_en: Add corn oil and milk to the egg yolks, mix well, then sift in red yeast rice powder and cake flour;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌到无颗粒状态；
steps.content_en: Stir until there are no particles;

steps.content_zh: 蛋清中滴入几滴柠檬汁后，打发过程中分三次放入细砂糖；
steps.content_en: After adding a few drops of lemon juice to the egg whites, add fine sugar in three batches during the whipping process;

steps.content_zh: 打发到拉起有不弯曲直角的状态；
steps.content_en: Beat until pulled up and not bent at right angles;

steps.content_zh: 取1/3的蛋白霜倒入面糊中，不规则翻拌；
steps.content_en: Pour 1/3 of the meringue into the batter and mix irregularly;

steps.content_zh: 剩余的面糊和蛋白霜继续按照上一步骤操作，倒入饭煲中，APP选择蛋糕模式60分钟；
steps.content_en: Continue to follow the previous step with the remaining batter and meringue, pour it into the rice cooker, and select cake mode on the APP for 60 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 完成后取出，冷却；
steps.content_en: When done, take it out and cool;

steps.content_zh: 分成三片；
steps.content_en: Divide into three pieces;

steps.content_zh: 黄油和奶油芝士，在室温下软化；
steps.content_en: Soften the butter and cream cheese at room temperature;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀后倒入糖霜和奶油；
steps.content_en: Stir evenly and pour in the icing sugar and cream;

steps.content_zh: 打发；
steps.content_en: send away;

steps.content_zh: 三层都抹上芝士奶油霜；
steps.content_en: Spread cheese buttercream on all three layers;

steps.content_zh: 放上樱桃和草莓就完成啦
steps.content_en: Top with cherries and strawberries—done!

steps.content_zh: 可以撒上一些糖粉装饰，赶紧拍照吧！
steps.content_en: You can sprinkle some powdered sugar for decoration and take photos quickly!

description_zh:
秋冬是吃芋头最好的季节，这个时候的芋头香甜粉绵，无论是入菜，做点心，都非常好吃。而且芋头的营养价值丰富，作为碱性食物，能中和体内积存的酸性物质，调整人体的酸碱平衡，产生美容养颜、乌黑头发的作用。
而中医认为芋头有开胃生津、消炎镇痛、补气益肾等功效，是秋补的理想食材，今天用芋头和西米做了一道广东很常见也很有名的甜点：香芋西米露。在寒冷的天气里喝上这么一碗香甜绵滑的甜点，也是一件非常温暖惬意的事。
description_en:
Autumn and winter are the best seasons to eat taro. The sweet and sticky taro at this time is very delicious whether in dishes or as snacks. Moreover, taro is rich in nutritional value. As an alkaline food, it can neutralize the acidic substances accumulated in the body, adjust the body's acid-base balance, and produce beautification and black hair.
Traditional Chinese medicine believes that taro has the functions of appetizing, promoting body fluids, reducing inflammation and analgesia, replenishing qi and kidneys, etc., and is an ideal ingredient for autumn nourishment. Today, I used taro and sago to make a very common and famous dessert in Guangdong: taro and sago dew. It is also a very warm and comfortable thing to drink such a bowl of sweet and smooth dessert in the cold weather.
tips_zh: 西米不可提前浸泡，煮熟后要冲凉水。
tips_en: Do not soak tapioca pearls in advance; rinse with cold water after cooking.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 红豆洗净浸泡3小时左右。
steps.content_en: Wash the red beans and soak them for about 3 hours.

steps.content_zh: 芋头去皮切块洗净后与红豆同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥¾的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Peel, cut, and wash the taro and put it in the pot with the red beans; add water to the porridge ¾ mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 同时，烧一锅水，水开后倒入西米，搅拌。
steps.content_en: At the same time, boil a pot of water. When the water boils, pour in the sago and stir.

steps.content_zh: 西米中没有白色颗粒时，捞出冲凉水去除表面粘液，放入纯净水中待用。
steps.content_en: When there are no white particles in the sago, take out the cold water to remove the surface mucus and put it into purified water for later use.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后将红豆、芋头与牛奶、椰浆混合后放入西米，根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味，可冷藏。
steps.content_en: After cooking, mix the red beans and taro with milk and coconut milk, add the tapioca pearls, and sweeten to taste. Can be chilled.

description_zh: 山药+百合的组合，看上去非常的小清新，两者搭配在一起煮粥，不仅可以宁心安神，补脾胃，益肺肾。
description_en: The combination of yam + lily looks very refreshing. Combining the two together to cook porridge can not only calm the mind and calm the mind, nourish the spleen and stomach, and benefit the lungs and kidneys.
tips_zh: 百合虽能补气，亦伤肺气，不宜多服。
tips_en: Although lily can replenish qi, it can also damage lung qi and should not be taken too much.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 百合洗净。
steps.content_en: Rinse the lily bulbs.

steps.content_zh: 铁棍山药洗净去皮，切段。
steps.content_en: Wash and peel the iron rod yam and cut into sections.

steps.content_zh: 同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥½的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: At the same time, put it into the pot, add water to the water level: ½ thick porridge mark, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: When there are 10 minutes left in the cooking time, add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 菠萝的营养价值很好，它含有丰富的维生素和微量元素，对人体很有好处。糯米和我们平时吃的大米也不一样，糯米的粘性比较大，所以吃糯米饭是非常压饿的。菠萝糯米饭的产生应该也有糯米饭压饿的原因吧。
description_en: Pineapple is very nutritious, rich in vitamins and trace elements, and great for your health. Glutinous rice differs from regular rice in that it is stickier, so glutinous rice dishes are very filling. That is probably why pineapple glutinous rice was created.
tips_zh: 在食肉类或油腻食物后，吃些菠萝对身体大有好处，“菠萝咕咾肉”、“菠萝牛肉”都是可以放心吃的菜肴。
tips_en: After eating meat or greasy food, eating some pineapple is very good for the body. "Pineapple Sour Pork" and "Pineapple Beef" are dishes that can be eaten with confidence.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 泰国糯米洗净后浸泡5小时。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak Thai sticky rice for 5 hours.

steps.content_zh: 菠萝肉切成丁，在盐水中浸泡1小时。
steps.content_en: Cut the pineapple flesh into cubes and soak in salt water for 1 hour.

steps.content_zh: 糯米倒入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米1.5的刻度，撒上菠萝、葡萄干、蔓越莓干，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the glutinous rice in the pot, fill to the Northeast-rice 1.5 mark, sprinkle on pineapple, raisins and dried cranberries, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后可撒上适量的糖调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, sprinkle with sugar to taste.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 山药味甘、性平，入肺、脾、肾经、不燥不腻，具有健脾补肺、益胃补肾、固肾益精、聪耳明目、助五脏、强筋骨、长志安神、延年益寿的功效。山药和南瓜组合，清淡、味道香甜清热滋润、美味养颜。
description_en: Yam is sweet and neutral, entering the lung, spleen and kidney meridians; neither drying nor greasy, it strengthens the spleen and lungs, benefits the stomach and kidneys, secures essence, sharpens hearing and vision, supports the five organs, strengthens bones and muscles, calms the mind and promotes longevity. Combined with pumpkin, it is light, sweet, nourishing and beautifying.
tips_zh: 山药在剥皮之后，表面的粘液使其变的很滑，难以抓牢或稳稳的放在砧板上，切成想要的形状，这时候，可以在双手上涂些盐和醋，再拿山药的时候就不会手滑了，也不会影响山药的正常味道。
tips_en: After the yam is peeled, the mucus on the surface makes it very slippery, making it difficult to grasp or place it firmly on the cutting board and cut it into the desired shape. At this time, you can apply some salt and vinegar on your hands so that your hands will not slip when you pick up the yam, and it will not affect the normal taste of the yam.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 南瓜去皮切丁。
steps.content_en: Peel and dice pumpkin.

steps.content_zh: 山药去皮切厚片。
steps.content_en: Peel the yam and cut into thick slices.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米3的刻度，撒上南瓜和山药，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 3 mark. Sprinkle pumpkin and yam and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，出锅即可。
steps.content_en: Serve once cooking is complete.

description_zh: 糙米富含多种矿物质、维生素能改善身体机能。同时还带和虾米还能补充钙质。
description_en: Brown rice is rich in minerals and vitamins that improve body function; combined with kelp and dried shrimp, it also helps supplement calcium.
tips_zh: 可以添加少许糯米增加稠度。
tips_en: You can add a little glutinous rice to thicken it.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切丝、香葱切成葱花、海带丝切段。糙米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Shred the ginger, chop the scallions, and cut the kelp into sections. Rinse the brown rice and put it in the pot; add water to the 'thick porridge 1' level and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时，放入洗好的海带丝、生姜丝。烹饪完成后用盐、胡椒粉调味，撒上葱花和虾皮即可。
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add the washed shredded kelp and ginger. After cooking, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle with chopped scallion and dried shrimp.

description_zh:
胡萝卜含有丰富的维生素a，维生素a素有“护眼之必需”之称，是预防眼干、视力衰退、夜盲症的良方，所以，电脑一族应该多吃些胡萝卜，有保护视力的作用。除此之外，胡萝卜还有利膈宽肠、增强免疫功能、降糖降脂等功效。
羊肉性温，冬季常吃羊肉，不仅可以增加人体热量，抵御寒冷，而且还能增加消化酶，保护胃壁，修复胃粘膜，帮助脾胃消化，起到抗衰老的作用。
description_en: Carrots are rich in vitamin A, known as 'essential for eye health,' which helps prevent dry eyes, vision loss, and night blindness, so computer users should eat more carrots to protect their vision. Carrots also aid digestion, boost immunity, and help lower blood sugar and lipids. Lamb is warming; eating it often in winter not only increases body heat and wards off the cold, but also boosts digestive enzymes, protects and repairs the stomach lining, helps the stomach and spleen digest, and has anti-aging effects.
tips_zh: 羊肉最好选择羊羔肉，肉质嫩滑且膻味不重。
tips_en: The best choice for mutton is lamb. The meat is tender and not too smelly.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜、生姜、羊肉切块，小葱切成葱花。粳米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，放入处理好的胡萝卜、生姜和羊肉，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Cut the carrot, ginger, and lamb into pieces and chop the scallion. Wash the rice and put it in the pot, add water to the porridge level 1 mark, add the prepared carrot, ginger, and lamb, then start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后用盐、胡椒粉调味，撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: When finished, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle with chopped green onion.

description_zh: 将补铁补脑佳品菠菜焖入了饭中，简单易做又健康美味，不爱吃青菜的孩纸都大口地吃。一锅素菜饭里面加一根腊肠就行，那点荤油那点香味儿就足以让菜饭美翻天，盐都不用加。碗中颜色红有红的浓香，绿有绿的清鲜，饭借菜鲜菜借饭香，两种味道互相兼容的美味，跟单纯的白饭配菜是色香味的与众不同。特别适合挑食不吃蔬菜的孩子，腊肠的香味融入到饭中，加上菠菜更营养。
description_en: Stew spinach, a good food for iron and brain supplements, into rice. It is simple, easy to make, healthy and delicious, and even children who don’t like vegetables will eat it. Just add a piece of sausage to a pot of vegetarian rice. The little meat oil and the aroma are enough to make the vegetable rice delicious. No need to add salt. The color in the bowl is red and the aroma is strong, the green is fresh and green, the rice borrows the vegetable and the fresh vegetable borrows the fragrance of the rice. The two flavors are compatible with each other, and the color, aroma and taste are different from the simple white rice side dishes. It is especially suitable for children who are picky eaters and do not eat vegetables. The aroma of the sausage is integrated into the rice, and the spinach is more nutritious.
tips_zh: 烫好菠菜后要及时冲凉水，才能保证菠菜的翠绿。
tips_en: Rinse the blanched spinach under cold water right away to keep it bright green.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 腊肠洗净切丁。
steps.content_en: Wash and dice the Chinese sausage.

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米3的刻度，上面撒上腊肠，开始烹饪。同时菠菜洗净后用开水烫10秒钟后立即冲凉水，挤干水分切碎。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and place in the pot, add water to the water line: Northeast Rice level 3, sprinkle cured sausage on top and start cooking. Meanwhile, blanch the washed spinach in boiling water for 10 seconds, rinse in cold water, squeeze dry and chop.

steps.content_zh: 剩余5分钟时，开盖拌入菠菜。
steps.content_en: When 5 minutes remain, uncover and stir in spinach.

steps.content_zh: 出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan.

description_zh: 远离家门的日子恋家的孩子总会想起妈妈的味道，于是就会凭着自己的记忆和感觉去尝试去寻找。印象中妈妈喜欢吃软糯的糯米饭。第一次做，想尝试更加丰富的口感，于是加了熏肉，没想到口味还很独特。
description_en: Away from home, you crave Mom's cooking and try to recreate it from memory. I remember she loved soft, sticky glutinous rice. On my first try I added smoked meat for a richer texture—and the result was wonderfully unique.
tips_zh: 也可以提前将腊肉和香菇一起煸炒下增加香味，不用再放入盐，腊肉和虾皮都是含盐量较大的食物。
tips_en: You can also stir-fry the bacon and mushrooms in advance to increase the flavor. No need to add salt. Both bacon and dried shrimps are foods with high salt content.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 香菇和糯米提前洗净浸泡。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the shiitake mushrooms and glutinous rice in advance.

steps.content_zh: 腊肠洗净后切片、香菇切丝。东北米洗净后倒入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，再放入泡好的糯米，放上腊肉、香菇和虾皮，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash and slice the sausage and shred the mushrooms. Wash the Northeast rice and pour it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 2 mark, then add the soaked glutinous rice, top with bacon, mushrooms and shrimp skin, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅即可
steps.content_en: When finished, take it out of the pot

description_zh: 加入了新鲜的牛肉，借鉴了生滚牛肉粥的做法，尝试还是很成功滴！肉质比普通瘦猪肉还要鲜嫩顺滑！
description_en: I added fresh beef, inspired by quick-cooked beef congee, and the experiment worked great—the meat is even more tender and silky than ordinary lean pork!
tips_zh: 牛肉也可放点水淀粉腌制，增加嫩度。
tips_en: The beef can also be marinated with some water starch to increase tenderness.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 皮蛋剥壳、生姜切丝。
steps.content_en: Shell the century egg and shred the ginger.

steps.content_zh: 将皮蛋切丁，牛肉切丝后用调料腌制。粳米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Dice the preserved egg, shred the beef and marinate it. Wash the rice, put it in the pot, add water to the thick porridge 1 level and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时，倒入处理好的牛肉和皮蛋，完成后用盐和胡椒粉调味即可。
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add the prepared beef and century egg; season with salt and pepper when done.

description_zh: 受羊肉饭的启发，我尝试着做了五花肉豆角焖饭，没想到大受欢迎啊！从那以后，每当下班回家比较晚，时间比较紧的情况下，我就做这个当晚饭，每次都能让家人吃的很满意。一锅就能搞定的美食，方便简单，关键好吃。
description_en: Inspired by the mutton rice, I tried to make braised rice with pork belly and beans. Unexpectedly, it was so popular! Since then, whenever I get home late from get off work and time is tight, I will make this for dinner, and my family will be very satisfied every time. One-pot delicacies are convenient, simple, and most importantly, delicious.
tips_zh: 可以放入糯米代替普通米，要提前浸泡。
tips_en: Glutinous rice can be added instead of ordinary rice, but it must be soaked in advance.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 四季豆去丝、五花肉切片、土豆切块。
steps.content_en: Shred the green beans, slice the pork belly, and cut the potatoes into cubes.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅中放入少许油烧热，倒入五花肉片煸炒出油。
steps.content_en: Heat a little oil in a pan, add the pork belly slices, and stir-fry until the fat renders.

steps.content_zh: 倒入生姜、土豆、生姜和四季豆，用生抽、老抽、白糖调味，大火收汁（口味要稍微咸一些）。
steps.content_en: Pour in the ginger, potatoes, ginger and green beans, season with light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and sugar, and reduce the juice over high heat (the taste should be slightly salty).

steps.content_zh: 米饭洗净后倒入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米3的刻度。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice, put it in the pot and fill to the Northeast-rice 3 mark.

steps.content_zh: 倒入上一步处理好的原料，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour in the ingredients processed in the previous step and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan when finished.

description_zh: 吃香喝辣的日子多了，偶尔也想来一点清淡点的饭菜。嘿，香芋排骨饭对无辣不欢的我来说，是算清淡的便饭了。普通常见的食材，简单的饭菜一锅搞定，重要的是很讨孩子们喜欢。隔段日子不吃，还真是会让人想念它的香味呢。或许，多年以后，这就是孩子们心中最无法替代的妈妈的味道。
description_en: There are so many days of eating spicy food, and occasionally I want to have some lighter meals. Hey, taro pork ribs rice is a light meal for me who doesn’t like spicy food. Commonly used ingredients, simple meals can be prepared in one pot, and the most important thing is that they are very popular with children. If you don't eat it for a few days, you will really miss its fragrance. Perhaps, many years later, this is the taste of the most irreplaceable mother in the hearts of children.
tips_zh: 还可以加入一些自己喜欢的食材比如：胡萝卜、土豆等。
tips_en: You can also add your favorite ingredients, such as carrots or potatoes.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 香芋去皮洗净切块。
steps.content_en: Peel, wash, and cut the taro into chunks.

steps.content_zh: 洋葱切碎。
steps.content_en: Chop the onion.

steps.content_zh: 排骨出水后洗净。
steps.content_en: Blanch the ribs and wash.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热，放入少许油将排骨炒香后倒入洋葱煸炒，放入香芋，加入水，用盐、糖、老抽调味，烧开即可。
steps.content_en: Heat a wok with a little oil, stir-fry the ribs until fragrant, add the onion and stir-fry, then add the taro and water. Season with salt, sugar, and dark soy sauce, and bring to a boil.

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净倒入锅中，倒入上一步的排骨和汤汁，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and pour it into the pot, pour in the ribs and soup from the previous step and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成。
steps.content_en: Cooking is complete.

steps.content_zh: 出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan.

description_zh: 给你加个抗寒属性+50%的buff。主要的原料是用新鲜羊肉，胡萝卜、洋葱、清油、羊油和大米。香浓的羊肉，劲道的米饭，软糯的胡萝卜，还有那浓郁的孜然味道，味香可口。
description_en: This gives you a +50% cold-resistance buff. The main ingredients are fresh lamb, carrot, onion, vegetable oil, lamb fat and rice. Rich lamb, chewy rice, tender carrots and a strong cumin flavor make it wonderfully fragrant and delicious.
tips_zh: 羊肉最好是挑稍微带点肥肉的羊排，这样煮好的肉口感比较丰满。
tips_en: Choose lamb ribs with a little fat, so the cooked meat has a richer texture.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜、洋葱、羊肉切小块。
steps.content_en: Cut the carrot, onion, and lamb into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅中烧热油，放入羊肉炒香后，倒入各种蔬菜，用咖喱粉、孜然粉、黑胡椒粉、辣椒粉和盐调味。
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a pan, stir-fry the lamb until fragrant, add the vegetables, and season with curry powder, cumin, black pepper, chili powder, and salt.

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净后放入锅中，加入水到水位线：东北米3的刻度，倒入上一步炒好的原料，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: After washing the rice, put it into the pot, add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 3 mark, pour in the ingredients fried in the previous step, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan when finished.

description_zh: 银耳非常适合在秋天等天气干燥的时候吃，这道银耳菠萝糖水就选取了菠萝来一起搭配，制成后菠萝的果香融合着银耳的新鲜，一次性多做一点放冰箱冷藏，完全可以替代日常喝水，滋润身体，美容解毒，非常值得一试。
description_en: Snow fungus is perfect for dry weather such as autumn. This snow fungus and pineapple sweet soup pairs it with pineapple; once made, the fruity aroma of pineapple blends with the freshness of the snow fungus. Make a larger batch and refrigerate it - it can fully replace daily water, moisturizing the body, beautifying the skin and detoxifying. Definitely worth a try.
tips_zh: 一般来说，胖型的菠萝比起瘦长的，肉更多，更结实，也更甜。
tips_en: Generally speaking, fat pineapples have more meat, are firmer, and sweeter than skinny ones.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 银耳提前洗净浸泡5小时，去蒂撕成小片。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the snow fungus 5 hours in advance, then remove the stems and tear into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 菠萝切片后与洗好的银耳、红枣同时放入锅中，加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Slice the pineapple and put it into the pot together with the washed white fungus and red dates. Add to the water level: thick porridge 1 and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后放入适量的冰糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of rock sugar to taste.

description_zh: 这款粥所用的红枣、山药、糯米三种上好食材，营养价值很高，有着补肾、补血等多种功效，特别是在寒冷的冬天，吃上一碗香甜可口的米饭，不但满足了味蕾，也滋补了身体。
description_en: The three fine ingredients used in this porridge, red dates, yam, and glutinous rice, have high nutritional value and have many functions such as nourishing the kidneys and blood. Especially in the cold winter, eating a bowl of sweet and delicious rice not only satisfies the taste buds, but also nourishes the body.
tips_zh: 买的时候可以掰开一点外皮，或者看山药切断面，肉质呈白色，汁液黏稠的就是新鲜山药;被冻过的山药切开后，里面肉色发红如铁锈，而且有硬心，汁液像水。
tips_en: When buying, you can break off a little of the skin, or look at the cut surface of the yam. The flesh is white and the juice is sticky. It is a fresh yam. After being cut into a frozen yam, the flesh inside is red like rust, has a hard core, and the juice is like water.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 糯米洗净后浸泡5小时左右。
steps.content_en: Wash the glutinous rice and soak it for about 5 hours.

steps.content_zh: 山药洗净去皮切块。
steps.content_en: Wash, peel and cut the yam into pieces.

steps.content_zh: 将泡好的糯米倒入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2.5的刻度。放入处理好的山药和红枣。
steps.content_en: Pour the soaked glutinous rice into the pot and add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 2.5 mark. Add the processed yam and red dates.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅即可。
steps.content_en: When done, take it out of the pan.

description_zh: 绿豆酿莲藕又叫白切莲藕，一口咬下去，莲藕和绿豆交结一起，粉中带香，甭提有多美味。熟藕温补，绿豆寒凉，两者配合在一起，滋润降火，饮食中和，可口美味。
description_en: Mung bean stuffed lotus root is also called white-cut lotus root. When you bite into it, the lotus root and mung bean are mixed together. The powder is fragrant, not to mention how delicious it is. Ripe lotus root is warm and tonic, and mung bean is cold. The two work together to moisturize and reduce internal heat, make the diet neutral, and delicious.
tips_zh: 如果不怕麻烦可以将充分浸泡的绿豆用手搓去皮。
tips_en: If you are not afraid of trouble, you can peel the fully soaked mung beans by hand.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 绿豆提前洗净浸泡5小时左右，莲藕去皮洗净。将莲藕的靠近顶端的地方用刀切断。将浸泡好的绿豆灌入莲藕的孔中，一边灌一边用筷子压实。
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and soak them for about 5 hours in advance. Peel and wash the lotus roots. Cut off the lotus root near the top with a knife. Pour the soaked mung beans into the holes of the lotus roots and compact them with chopsticks while filling.

steps.content_zh: 将切下来的莲藕盖子扣回原来位置上，四周用牙签固定。
steps.content_en: Buckle the cut lotus root lid back to its original position and secure it with toothpicks around it.

steps.content_zh: 将莲藕和桂花放入锅中，加入水超过莲藕3厘米即可。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the lotus root and sweet-scented osmanthus into the pot, add water to cover the lotus root by 3 cm. Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 取一个小奶锅放入冰糖、桂花和少量的水熬成桂花糖浆。
steps.content_en: Take a small milk pot, add rock sugar, osmanthus and a small amount of water to boil the osmanthus syrup.

steps.content_zh: 莲藕烹饪完成后，切片倒上桂花糖浆即可。
steps.content_en: Once the lotus root is cooked, slice it and drizzle with osmanthus syrup.

description_zh: 成熟的水蜜桃果肉清甜柔软多汁，比起全是水的西瓜，它含有的蛋白质比苹果、葡萄高一倍，比梨子多七倍；铁的含量比苹果多三倍，比梨多五倍。水蜜桃慕斯蛋糕，颜色亮丽，口味香甜可口。
description_en: Ripe peach pulp is sweet, soft and juicy. Compared with watermelon, which is all water, it contains twice as much protein as apples and grapes, and seven times more than pears. It also contains three times more iron than apples and five times more than pears. Peach mousse cake, bright in color, sweet and delicious.
tips_zh: 原料是两份慕斯蛋糕的分量。
tips_en: The ingredients are two servings of mousse cake.

steps.content_zh: 蜜桃味戚风蛋糕原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients for peach chiffon cake.

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋蛋清和蛋黄分离（蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。），蛋黄中加入水蜜桃汁、玉米油后筛入低筋粉搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Separate the egg white and yolk (no yolk should remain in the white); add peach juice and corn oil to the yolk, then sift in cake flour and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加40克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Wash and dry all tools, especially those for beating egg whites. Beat the whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating. When large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and continue. When the foam becomes fine and dense, add 40 g more sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.

steps.content_zh:
面糊和蛋白霜不规则搅拌均匀后倒入锅胆中，轻轻磕几下去除表面气泡。
选择蛋糕模式，60分钟。
steps.content_en:
Stir the batter and meringue evenly, then pour it into the pot, and gently tap it a few times to remove surface bubbles.
Select cake mode, 60 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 完成后倒出，自然冷却。
steps.content_en: When finished, pour it out and let it cool naturally.

steps.content_zh: 准备慕斯极淋面原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients for mousse glaze.

steps.content_zh: 吉利丁粉中加入少许纯净水，搅拌均匀后充分吸水。
steps.content_en: Add a little pure water to the gelatine powder, mix well and fully absorb the water.

steps.content_zh: 水蜜桃去皮切块后加400克水和50克糖，小火慢煮10分钟。
steps.content_en: Peel and cut the peach into pieces, add 400 grams of water and 50 grams of sugar, and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 捞出煮透的水蜜桃用打碎机打成蓉，水蜜桃汁留用。
steps.content_en: Take out the cooked peaches, blend into a puree and reserve the peach juice.

steps.content_zh: 淡奶油加入80克糖打成有纹路，克流动的状态。水蜜桃蓉加入一半的吉利丁，隔水加热充分融化，后放入冰箱中冷藏。
steps.content_en: Whip the cream with 80 g sugar until traces remain and it still flows slightly. Add half the gelatin to the peach puree, melt over a water bath, then refrigerate.

steps.content_zh: 水蜜桃蓉完全冷却后倒入处理好的奶油搅拌均匀。放入冰箱中冷藏到半凝固状态。
steps.content_en: Once the peach puree is completely cool, fold it into the prepared cream and mix well. Refrigerate until semi-set.

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕从中间片开，用面具压成型。
steps.content_en: Slice the cake in half horizontally and cut into shape with a mold.

steps.content_zh: 在上面倒上慕斯液，涂均匀后放入冰箱中冷藏至少4小时或者冷冻2小时。
steps.content_en: Pour the mousse liquid on top, spread evenly and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or freeze for 2 hours.

steps.content_zh: 取300克水蜜桃汁，加入剩余的吉利丁小火煮到吉利丁融化。
steps.content_en: Take 300 grams of peach juice, add the remaining gelatine and cook over low heat until the gelatine melts.

steps.content_zh: 水蜜桃汁完全冷却后机上柠檬汁，倒入蛋糕最上层后继续放入冰箱中冷藏，完全定型后即可取出。
steps.content_en: Once the peach juice is completely cool, add the lemon juice, pour over the top layer of the cake, and refrigerate until fully set before removing.

steps.content_zh: 可用热毛巾在慕斯圈捂一会或者用吹风机脱模。
steps.content_en: You can use a hot towel to cover the mousse circle for a while or use a hair dryer to remove the mold.

description_zh: 梨子营养丰富，能润燥化痰、润肠通便，而红酒中含有的原花青素能保护心血管，白藜芦醇能抗癌。梨子性寒，但煮熟以后寒性会有所减弱。在煮梨汤时，加适量紫红的葡萄酒，既补充了梨和红酒中的营养物质，给人视觉上的享受，还能温暖肠胃，使其润肺止咳的功效发挥得更好。
description_en: Pears are rich in nutrients and can moisten dryness, reduce phlegm, and relieve constipation. The proanthocyanidins contained in red wine can protect cardiovascular systems, and resveratrol can fight cancer. Pears are cold in nature, but the coldness will be weakened after being cooked. When making pear soup, add an appropriate amount of purple wine, which not only supplements the nutrients in pears and red wine, giving people visual enjoyment, but also warms the stomach and intestines, so that the effect of moistening the lungs and relieving coughs can be better exerted.
tips_zh: 炖梨其间不时给梨浇汁和翻身，让梨充分浸泡在酒汁中。
tips_en: While stewing the pear, occasionally baste and turn it so it soaks fully in the wine sauce.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 梨去皮，柠檬切角。
steps.content_en: Peel the pear and cut the lemon into wedges.

steps.content_zh: 将梨、柠檬片、冰糖和肉桂同时放入锅中。加入300毫升红酒，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Place the pear, lemon slices, rock sugar and cinnamon in the pot. Add 300 ml red wine and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入容器中自然冷却后放入冰箱中冷藏一夜。
steps.content_en: After cooking is complete, place in a container to cool naturally and then refrigerate overnight.

steps.content_zh: 装盘。
steps.content_en: Plate.

description_zh: 经常吃一些花生米可增强记忆力、健脑和抗衰老，花生米富含高油脂，有润肠功效，在一定程度上能预防便秘。糯米是家常经常食用的粮食之一，因其香糯黏滑，常被用以制成风味小吃，深受大家喜爱。
description_en: Eating some peanuts regularly can enhance memory, strengthen the brain and resist aging. Peanuts are rich in fat and have the effect of moisturizing the intestines and can prevent constipation to a certain extent. Glutinous rice is one of the most commonly eaten foods at home. Because of its fragrant, glutinous and sticky texture, it is often used to make snacks and is loved by everyone.
tips_zh: 糯米烹饪前要充分浸泡。
tips_en: Glutinous rice should be soaked thoroughly before cooking.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 三种原料都要提前洗净浸泡3小时左右。
steps.content_en: All three raw materials must be washed and soaked in advance for about 3 hours.

steps.content_zh: 将三者同时倒入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米3的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour the three into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level line: 3 meters northeast, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

name_en: Snow fungus and purple sweet potato sweet soup
description_zh: 紫薯富含纤维素，可促进肠胃蠕动。银耳可以补血美容，抗衰老。
description_en: Purple sweet potatoes are rich in fiber, which promotes digestion. Tremella helps nourish the blood, beautify the skin and fight aging.
tips_zh: 选购紫薯时表面看起来要光滑，外皮有黑斑的不要。
tips_en: Choose purple sweet potatoes with smooth skin; avoid those with black spots.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 银耳提前洗净浸泡，去蒂撕成小朵。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the snow fungus in advance, then remove the stems and tear into small florets.

steps.content_zh: 紫薯去皮切丁后与浸泡好的银耳同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Peel and dice the purple sweet potato, add it with the soaked tremella to the pot, fill to the thick-congee 1 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking is complete, you can add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 每当季节交替的时候，温度时热时凉的，很多人比较容易感冒咳嗽，煲个清润雪梨汤喝喝那也是极好的~滋润身体，润肺养颜。
description_en: When seasons change and temperatures swing, many people catch colds or coughs—a nourishing pear soup is just the thing to soothe the body, moisten the lungs, and improve the complexion.
tips_zh: 炖好了之后可酌情加糖。我买的无花果和梨都很甜。
tips_en: Add sugar to taste after stewing. The figs and pears I bought were very sweet.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鲜百合洗净。
steps.content_en: Wash fresh lilies.

steps.content_zh: 雪梨去皮切块。
steps.content_en: Peel and cut the pears into cubes.

steps.content_zh: 无花果切块。
steps.content_en: Cut the figs into pieces.

steps.content_zh: 将雪梨、无花果和百合同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥¾的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put pears, figs and lilies into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level: ¾ of the thick porridge mark, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后根据个人口味调味。
steps.content_en: Season to taste when done.

description_zh: 菠萝含有多种维生素，不仅能淡化面部色斑，使皮肤滋润、光泽，还能有效去除角质，促进肌肤新陈代谢，使皮肤呈现健康状态，有很好的美白养肤作用。菠萝桔子杏仁糖水，香味浓郁，甜酸可口。
description_en: Pineapple contains a variety of vitamins, which can not only lighten facial spots, make the skin moist and shiny, but also effectively exfoliate, promote skin metabolism, make the skin appear healthy, and have a good whitening and nourishing effect. Pineapple orange marzipan water, rich in fragrance, sweet and sour.
tips_zh: 此汤不要煲得太久了，否则会很酸。
tips_en: Don't simmer this soup for too long, otherwise it will be very sour.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 桔子去皮取桔瓣。
steps.content_en: Peel the tangerines and separate the segments.

steps.content_zh: 菠萝切片。
steps.content_en: Pineapple slices.

steps.content_zh: 将桔子、菠萝、杏仁同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥¾的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the oranges, pineapples, and almonds into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level: ¾ of the thick porridge, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后根据个人口味放入适量的冰糖调味。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of rock sugar to taste according to personal taste.

description_zh: 黄豆芽是一种营养丰富，味道鲜美的蔬菜，是较多蛋白质和维生素的来源。黄豆芽还具有清热明目、补气养血、防止牙龈出血、心血管硬化等功效。牛肉补脾胃，滋补健身，营养价值高。两者搭配，省时省力，美味营养！
description_en: Soybean sprouts are a nutritious and delicious vegetable, a good source of protein and vitamins. They also help clear heat, improve eyesight, replenish qi and blood, prevent bleeding gums and cardiovascular hardening. Beef nourishes the spleen and stomach, strengthens the body, and is highly nutritious. Together they save time and effort and are delicious and nutritious!
tips_zh: 牛肉要选用瘦中带肥的牛腩肉，这样会比较香。
tips_en: Choose beef brisket with a little fat for a richer flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 牛肉切片，豆芽去尾。
steps.content_en: Slice the beef and remove the tails from the bean sprouts.

steps.content_zh: 牛肉用煎锅煎出油后与豆芽同炒，放入盐、蒜泥、黑胡椒调味。大米洗净后倒入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的位置，倒入炒好的牛肉，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Render fat from the beef in a pan, stir-fry with bean sprouts, and season with salt, garlic paste, and black pepper. Wash the rice, add it to the pot, fill water to the Northeast rice level 2 line, add the cooked beef, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，如果觉得味道不够，可再次放入适量的调味料调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, add more seasoning if the flavor is lacking.

description_zh: 酸辣开胃、清爽可口、特别方便。在加班的深夜、肚饥的中午，做一碗韩式泡菜饭，肚子饱饱，生活就快乐起来了！
description_en: Hot, sour, appetizing and easy. Late at work or hungry at noon, a bowl of Korean kimchi rice fills you up and makes life better!
tips_zh: 泡菜属于高纤维、低热量的食物，有助于消化，减少脂肪累积
tips_en: Kimchi is a high-fiber, low-calorie food that helps digestion and reduces fat accumulation.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 泡菜、五花肉切片、彩椒切块。
steps.content_en: Slice kimchi, pork belly, and dice bell peppers.

steps.content_zh: 煎锅中放入少许油，烧热后将五花肉煎至两面金黄。
steps.content_en: Put a little oil in the frying pan, heat it up and fry the pork belly until golden brown on both sides.

steps.content_zh: 放入蒜泥、泡菜、韩式辣椒酱炒香，待用，彩椒炒断生。
steps.content_en: Add minced garlic, kimchi, and Korean chili paste and stir-fry until fragrant. Set aside. Stir-fry the colored pepper until raw.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的位置。开始烹饪，烹饪时间剩余30分钟时倒入炒好泡菜。出锅后倒入彩椒即可。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 2. Start cooking and add the fried kimchi when 30 minutes of cooking time remain. After taking it out of the pot, add the bell peppers.

description_zh: 蛤蜊饭不必放盐及其他调料就可以很鲜。姜切丝可以去姜的燥火，再吃姜就能够暖胃不上火了。
description_en: Clam rice is delicious without salt or seasoning; shredding the ginger tempers its heat, so it warms the stomach without causing internal heat.
tips_zh: 买回来的蛤蜊，放在清水中，放一点盐，不可以用淡水养。如果需要保存，可以将蛤蜊放入冰箱冷藏室。但是蛤蜊最好现吃现买，吃多少买多少，不要一次买太多。
tips_en: Keep live clams in clean salted water—never in fresh water. To store them, refrigerate. But clams are best bought and eaten fresh; buy only what you need, don't overbuy.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 蛤蜊放在淡盐水中吐沙。
steps.content_en: Soak clams in lightly salted water to purge sand.

steps.content_zh: 焯水取蛤蜊净肉。
steps.content_en: Blanch the clams and remove the meat.

steps.content_zh: 洋葱切丁、生姜切丝。东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的位置，开始烹饪。烹饪时间剩余10分钟时，倒入姜丝、洋葱、蛤蜊肉，用盐、胡椒粉调味。
steps.content_en: Dice the onion and shred the ginger. Wash the Northeast rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 2 and start cooking. When there are 10 minutes left in the cooking time, add shredded ginger, onions, and clam meat, and season with salt and pepper.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅即可。
steps.content_en: When done, take it out of the pan.

description_zh: 这道菜鸡肉丝鲜嫩，夹杂着香菜和葱丝，口感丰富。麻酱香味浓郁，香辣适口，是一道非常美味的家常凉菜。
description_en: Tender shredded chicken with cilantro and scallion gives a rich texture. The sesame sauce is aromatic and mildly spicy—a delicious home-style cold dish.
tips_zh: 麻酱是夏天常吃的一种酱料，可以用芝麻酱，也可以花生酱，芝麻酱各半。
tips_en: Sesame sauce is a sauce often eaten in summer. You can use sesame sauce or peanut butter, half and half sesame sauce.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将童子鸡切洗净斩成大块，与生姜一起放入饭煲中，加入水超过鸡肉即可，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash and chop the chicken into large pieces, put it into the rice cooker together with the ginger, add water to cover the chicken, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 将骨头取出，鸡肉撕成丝。
steps.content_en: Remove the bones and shred the chicken into shreds.

steps.content_zh: 芝麻酱用纯净水稀释，放入生抽、辣椒油、芝麻油、香醋调成适合自己口味的酱汁。
steps.content_en: Dilute the sesame sauce with purified water, add light soy sauce, chili oil, sesame oil, and balsamic vinegar to make a sauce that suits your taste.

steps.content_zh: 将酱汁倒入鸡丝中，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Pour the sauce into the shredded chicken and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 装盘。
steps.content_en: Plate.

description_zh: 蓝莓山药泥是一道美味的菜肴，不仅颜值超级高，富含多种矿物质、营养素，能美容养颜。
description_en: Blueberry yam puree is a delicious dish — beautiful to look at, rich in minerals and nutrients, and good for beauty.
tips_zh: 山药要带皮煮，不然会煮烂，打不成泥状，或者隔水蒸也可以。
tips_en: Yams should be cooked with the skin on, otherwise they will become rotten and cannot be pureed. Alternatively, they can be steamed in water.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 山药切段，洗净后放入锅中，加水超过山药即可。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Cut the yam into sections, wash, put in the pot and add water to cover. Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后放入凉水中冷却。用筷子能插进山药中就代表熟透了。
steps.content_en: When done, place in cold water to cool. If chopsticks slide into the Chinese yam, it's cooked through.

steps.content_zh: 去皮，打成山药泥。如果太干，可以放一些牛奶或者奶油。
steps.content_en: Peel and puree the yam. If it's too dry, add some milk or cream.

steps.content_zh: 蓝莓酱用纯净水稀释，放入蜂蜜和糖调味。
steps.content_en: Dilute the blueberry jam with purified water, then sweeten with honey and sugar.

steps.content_zh: 用裱花袋挤出山药泥，淋上蓝莓酱，放上蓝莓即可。
steps.content_en: Use a piping bag to pipe out the yam puree, top with blueberry jam, and top with blueberries.

name_en: Sichuan scallops and peach gum stewed pears
description_zh: 这道药膳中所用的川贝母是一种名贵的中药材，其主要功效为清热润肺，化痰止咳。用于肺热燥咳，干咳少痰，阴虚劳嗽，咯痰带血。治虚劳咳嗽、吐痰咯血等。
description_en: The medicinal herb used here, Chuanbei fritillary bulb, clears heat, moistens the lungs and relieves cough and phlegm. It's used for dry coughs, yin deficiency and coughing up blood.
tips_zh: 川贝建议选用野生贝母，与人工养殖的川贝相比，功效要更好更快，几粒就有人工川贝近一两的效果，像喉咙痛这种疾病，纯野生品种的吃几粒，一两天就好了，人工品种要炖梨子吃3-5天才有效果。
tips_en: It is recommended to use wild Fritillaria scallops. Compared with artificially cultured Sichuan Fritillaria, the effect is better and faster. A few grains can have nearly one or two effects of artificial Sichuan Fritillaria. For diseases such as sore throat, a few grains of pure wild varieties will be cured in a day or two. The artificial varieties require stewed pears for 3-5 days before they are effective.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 桃胶和川贝洗净提前泡发，雪梨去皮、去籽切丁。
steps.content_en: Wash the peach gum and Sichuan clams and soak them in advance. Peel, remove seeds and dice the pear.

steps.content_zh: 将川贝、雪梨、桃胶同时放入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥½刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put Sichuan clams, snow pear and peach gum into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level: ½ mark of thick porridge, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时放入适量的黄冰糖即可。
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add some yellow rock sugar.

description_zh: 小时候和妈妈上街都会嚷嚷着买一个草莓味的蛋糕，现在自己来做一个吧。
description_en: When I was a kid, my mother and I would always clamor to buy a strawberry-flavored cake when we went out on the street. Now let’s make one ourselves.
tips_zh: 奶油不要打的太硬，这样涂抹的时候会不容易涂抹。
tips_en: Don't whip the cream too hard, as this will make it harder to spread when applying.

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕胚原料。
steps.content_en: Cake base ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄和蛋清分离。全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。
steps.content_en: Separate the yolks from the whites. Wash and dry all utensils, especially those for whipping the whites. No yolk should remain in the whites.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中放入牛奶、20克糖、玉米油和牛奶搅拌后，筛入低筋粉，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Add milk, 20 g sugar, corn oil and milk to the egg yolks, stir, then sift in cake flour and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加40克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating; when large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and keep beating; once the foam is fine and dense, add 40 g more sugar and beat to stiff peaks.

steps.content_zh: 蛋白霜和蛋黄糊不规则搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Gently fold the meringue and yolk batter together until just combined.

steps.content_zh: 将蛋糕糊倒入锅胆中，轻轻磕几下去除表面气泡。放入到饭煲中，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour the cake batter into the pan and gently tap it a few times to remove any bubbles on the surface. Put it into the rice cooker and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后扣出冷却。同时准备装饰原料。
steps.content_en: When done, unmold and let cool. Prepare the garnishes meanwhile.

steps.content_zh: 奶油中加入糖粉打到8成泡发。
steps.content_en: Add powdered sugar to the cream and beat until 80% foamy.

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕切片，抹上奶油，放上草莓。
steps.content_en: Slice the cake, spread with cream and top with strawberries.

steps.content_zh: 用奶油均匀涂抹蛋糕，同时放上水果装饰。
steps.content_en: Spread the cream evenly over the cake and decorate with fruit.

description_zh: 螃蟹是公认的食中珍味，有“一盘蟹，顶桌菜”的民谚。它不但味奇美，而且养分丰厚，是一种高蛋白的补品，对滋补身体很有益处，而且味道鲜美，营养价值非常高。
description_en: Crab is recognized as a delicacy in food, and there is a folk saying that "a plate of crabs is the top dish on the table". Not only does it taste delicious, but it is also rich in nutrients. It is a high-protein supplement that is very beneficial to nourishing the body. It is also delicious and has very high nutritional value.
tips_zh: 蟹肉也不宜多吃：体质过敏的人不宜吃蟹。蟹肉寒凉有活血祛淤之功，故对孕妇不利尤其是蟹爪，有堕胎的作用。
tips_en: It is also not advisable to eat too much crab meat: people with allergies should not eat crab. Crab meat is cold and has the effect of promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis, so it is not good for pregnant women, especially crab claws, which have the effect of abortion.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切小片。
steps.content_en: Cut ginger into small slices.

steps.content_zh: 洋葱切丁。
steps.content_en: Dice the onion.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后与生姜、洋葱同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeastern rice and put it into the pot together with ginger and onions. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 同时梭子蟹在另一个锅中煮熟，取蟹肉。将蟹腿和蟹壳放入粥中同煮。
steps.content_en: Meanwhile, boil the swimming crab in another pot and extract the meat. Add the crab legs and shells to the porridge as it cooks.

steps.content_zh: 完成后调味，撒上蟹肉即可出锅。
steps.content_en: When done, season, sprinkle with crab meat and serve.

description_zh: 老鸭是夏秋季节的清补佳品，它不仅营养丰富，而且因其常年在水中生活，性偏凉，有滋五脏之阳、清虚劳之热、补血行水、养胃生津的功效。
description_en: Old duck is a gentle tonic for summer and autumn: it is not only nutritious, but because it lives in water year-round it is cooling in nature. It nourishes the yang of the five organs, clears deficiency heat, nourishes the blood, promotes fluid metabolism, and nourishes the stomach and promotes saliva.
tips_zh: 鸭子性偏凉，对于素体虚寒，受凉引起的不思饮食、胃部冷痛、腹泻清稀的人都应少食。
tips_en: Ducks are cooler in nature, so people who are physically weak, have no desire to eat, suffer from cold stomach pain, or have loose diarrhea due to cold should eat less.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鸭子切块后焯水，洗净。
steps.content_en: Cut the duck into chunks, blanch, and wash clean.

steps.content_zh: 火腿切小片。
steps.content_en: Slice the ham into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切小块。
steps.content_en: Cut the ginger into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 笋切滚刀块。
steps.content_en: Cut the bamboo shoots into pieces with a hob.

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜去皮切片。将老鸭、生姜、笋、火腿同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Peel and slice the winter melon. Put the duck, ginger, bamboo shoots, and ham into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入冬瓜。焖煮到完成即可。
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add the winter melon and simmer until done.

description_zh: 热量低，最适合作减肥食品，由于纤维丰富，有助于排除便秘问题，还能减低血液中胆固醇值，防止动脉硬化。
description_en: Low in calories and ideal for weight loss. Rich in fiber, it helps relieve constipation, lower blood cholesterol, and prevent arteriosclerosis.
tips_zh: 选购干贝时，应注意：形状尽量完整，呈短圆柱形，坚实饱满，肉质干硬。
tips_en: When buying dried scallops, look for whole, short cylinders that are firm, plump and dry.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 火腿切小片。
steps.content_en: Slice the ham into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 干贝洗净，浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Wash the scallops and soak them for 2 hours.

steps.content_zh: 将干贝、火腿和各种菌类同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1刻度。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Place the dried scallops, ham and assorted mushrooms in the pot, add water to the water line: Thick Porridge level 1, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后调味，即可出锅。
steps.content_en: When finished, season and serve.

description_zh: 腊味煲仔饭吃起来既能有肉料，米饭有焦黄的锅巴，而且饭中还带了肉香，那种由煲仔带出的特有饭味，令人食欲大增。
description_en: Cured meat claypot rice gives you both meat and a golden, crispy rice crust, with the rice infused with savory meat aroma. That unique claypot flavor is truly appetite-boosting.
tips_zh: 煲仔饭，用米十分讲究，一般选用丝苗米，如果没丝苗米可用泰国香米代替。
tips_en: For claypot rice, the rice matters: use Si Miao rice, or substitute Thai jasmine rice if unavailable.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 丝苗米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：丝苗米刻度2，开始烹饪。酱肉切片。
steps.content_en: Wash the jasmine rice and place in the pot, add water to the water line: Jasmine Rice level 2, then start cooking. Slice the cured pork.

steps.content_zh: 腊肠切片。
steps.content_en: Slice sausage.

steps.content_zh: 洋葱切末。
steps.content_en: Finely chop the onion.

steps.content_zh: 大蒜切片。
steps.content_en: Slice garlic.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片。
steps.content_en: Slice the ginger.

steps.content_zh: 香菜切末。
steps.content_en: Chop the cilantro.

steps.content_zh: 煮饭的同时熬制酱汁，将大蒜等香辛料炒香后倒入适量的水，用耗油、生抽、汤调味，完成后撒上香菜即可。
steps.content_en: While the rice cooks, make the sauce: stir-fry garlic and other aromatics until fragrant, add water, and season with oyster sauce, light soy sauce, and broth. Sprinkle with cilantro when done.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余15分钟时，放入切好的腊肠和酱肉。继续烹饪到完成即可。淋上酱汁搅拌后就能享用啦。
