steps.content_en: When there are 15 minutes left in the cooking time, add the sliced ​​sausage and sauced meat. Continue cooking until done. Pour on the sauce, stir and enjoy.

description_zh: 花生炖牛腩不仅汤汁鲜香、牛肉酥烂更有有补虚养身的功效。
description_en: Peanut-braised beef brisket has a rich, savory broth and tender beef, and it also helps replenish and strengthen the body.
tips_zh: 新鲜的牛腩富有光泽，色泽红润，少许的脂肪为洁白或淡黄色，外表微干或有风干膜，用手触摸不黏手并且弹性好，有鲜牛肉特有的味道。如果牛腩肉外表黏手或极度干燥，用手压后凹陷不能复原，则表明牛腩肉已经不新鲜了。
tips_en: Fresh beef brisket is glossy and reddish, with a little white or pale yellow fat, a slightly dry surface or thin dry film, not sticky to the touch, springy, and smelling of fresh beef. If it feels sticky or very dry and the dent does not rebound when pressed, it is no longer fresh.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 牛腩切块后出水洗净。
steps.content_en: Cut the beef brisket into pieces and wash in running water.

steps.content_zh: 洋葱切小块。
steps.content_en: Cut the onion into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 芹菜切段。
steps.content_en: Cut celery into sections.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切小块。
steps.content_en: Cut the ginger into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 洗净所有原料放入饭煲中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度。开始烹饪，完成后调味即可。
steps.content_en: Wash all the ingredients and put them into the rice cooker. Add water to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark. Start cooking and season when finished.

description_zh: 味增是日本的一种调味品，以营养丰富味道独特而风靡。用它作为调料来腌渍鱼，蒸出来的鱼很咸香，与用潮汕的豆瓣酱类似，口感不错。
description_en: Miso is a Japanese condiment that is popular for its rich nutrition and unique taste. Use it as a seasoning to pickle fish. The steamed fish is very salty and has a good taste, similar to the Chaoshan bean paste.
tips_zh: 腌渍鱼肉时不要放太多的味增，小心会咸。
tips_en: Don't add too much miso when marinating fish, as it may make it salty.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鱼柳切块。
steps.content_en: Cut fish fillet into pieces.

steps.content_zh: 用味增、和味淋腌渍鱼柳1小时。
steps.content_en: Marinate the fish fillet with miso and mirin for 1 hour.

steps.content_zh: 将鱼柳装入盘中，包上保鲜膜，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Place the fish fillets on a plate, wrap in plastic wrap and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可搭配柠檬奶油汁，橄榄油食用。
steps.content_en: When finished, it can be served with lemon cream sauce and olive oil.

description_zh: 大米粥最能养人，中医认为大米能味甘性平，补脾养胃，除烦止渴。因此要经常食用米粥。
description_en: Rice porridge is the most nourishing. TCM considers rice sweet and neutral, tonifying the spleen and stomach, relieving irritability and quenching thirst—so eat it often.
tips_zh: 稀饭是一种比粥清稀的稍粘稠状物体，通俗点就是比粥要稀。稀饭的做法很简单，他不像粥花的时间那么长材料也没那么丰富，不过早餐多吃些稀饭可以清理肠胃，对身体还是很有益处的。
tips_en: Thin congee is lighter than regular porridge — a thin, slightly thickened liquid. It is quick and easy to make, with less time and fewer ingredients. Having it at breakfast helps cleanse the stomach and is very good for you.

steps.content_zh: 东北米。
steps.content_en: Northeast meters.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稀粥½杯刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeastern rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level: ½ cup of gruel and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可搭配主食，小菜食用。
steps.content_en: After completion, it can be eaten with staple food and side dishes.

description_zh: 沙加蛋糕起源于1832年，由厨师Sacher研制出的一种巧克力蛋糕，非常受奥地利人欢迎。如今，沙加蛋糕已经风靡全世界，其独特的朱古力馅心与果酱的美味令人回味无穷，是代表奥地利的国宝级点心。
description_en: Sachertorte originated in 1832, created by chef Sacher as a chocolate cake beloved by Austrians. Today it is famous worldwide; its distinctive chocolate filling and jam are unforgettable, making it Austria's national treasure dessert.
tips_zh: 巧克力不能直接放在火上融化，要隔热水加热融化。
tips_en: The chocolate cannot be melted directly on the fire. It must be heated and melted by insulating water.

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕胚原料。
steps.content_en: Cake base ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 室温下软化黄油、加入20克的细砂糖搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Soften the butter at room temperature, add 20 grams of caster sugar and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。上一部，加入蛋黄，打到稍微蓬松。
steps.content_en: Clean all tools and wipe them dry, especially those used to beat egg whites. The egg yolk is separated from the egg white, and there must be no yolk in the egg white. In the previous part, add egg yolk and beat until slightly fluffy.

steps.content_zh: 巧克力隔水加热融化后倒入上一步的原料中。
steps.content_en: Heat the chocolate over water and melt it, then pour it into the ingredients from the previous step.

steps.content_zh: 筛入低筋粉，搅拌到无颗粒的状态。
steps.content_en: Sift in the low-gluten flour and stir until no lumps remain.

steps.content_zh: 用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加20克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating; when large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and keep beating; once the foam is fine and dense, add 20 g more sugar and beat to stiff peaks.

steps.content_zh: 面糊和蛋白霜搅拌均匀后，倒入锅中抹平表面，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: After mixing the batter and meringue evenly, pour into the pot, smooth the surface, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后倒扣出冷却。
steps.content_en: After cooking is complete, invert to cool.

steps.content_zh: 完全冷却后切两片，抹上果酱。
steps.content_en: Once completely cooled, cut into two slices and spread with jam.

steps.content_zh: 奶油加热到沸腾后关火，放入巧克力完全融化到无颗粒状态。
steps.content_en: Heat the cream until it boils, then turn off the heat and add the chocolate, which is completely melted until there are no grains.

steps.content_zh: 趁热淋到蛋糕表面。
steps.content_en: Pour over the cake while hot.

steps.content_zh: 撒上杏仁片或者其他干果装饰，放入冰箱中冷藏。
steps.content_en: Garnish with slivered almonds or other dried fruits and refrigerate.

description_zh: 中国人吃螃蟹的习俗由来已久，螃蟹的营养丰富，滋味鲜美。尤其是蛋白质含量比猪肉、鱼肉都要高出几倍。
description_en: The Chinese have eaten crab for centuries. Crabs are nutritious and delicious, with several times more protein than pork or fish.
tips_zh: 蟹要吃鲜活的，死蟹不宜吃
tips_en: Eat only live crab; avoid dead crab.

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：稠粥二分之一刻度，放上一个小蒸架，大闸蟹放入盘子中，将盘子放在蒸架上，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the thick porridge ½ mark, place a small steaming rack inside, put the hairy crab on a plate, set the plate on the rack, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪过程中，将生姜切末，放入醋中调成姜醋汁，烹饪完成后，大闸蟹搭配姜醋汁食用。
steps.content_en: During the cooking process, mince the ginger and add it to vinegar to make ginger vinegar sauce. After the cooking is completed, eat the hairy crabs with the ginger vinegar sauce.

description_zh: 桃胶奶不但超好吃而且做起来也容易，爱美的你怎可以错过。
description_en: Peach gum milk is not only super delicious but also easy to make. If you love beauty, how can you miss it?
tips_zh: 虽然桃胶的功效与作用对身体有很多的帮助，但是有一些人群是不可以食用桃胶的，就比如孕妇。孕妇怀孕期间不可以食用桃胶，因为桃胶在体内所产生的作用会不利于胎儿在母体内发育。
tips_en: Although the effects and functions of peach gum are very helpful to the body, there are some groups of people who cannot eat peach gum, such as pregnant women. Pregnant women should not eat peach gum during pregnancy because the effects of peach gum in the body will be detrimental to the development of the fetus in the mother.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 桃胶洗净浸泡12小时到桃胶完全软化的状态，去除里面的杂质。
steps.content_en: Wash the peach gum and soak for 12 hours until completely soft, then remove any impurities.

steps.content_zh: 红枣洗净去核，桂圆去壳。
steps.content_en: Wash and pit the red dates; shell the longans.

steps.content_zh: 将桃胶、红枣、桂圆和黄冰糖同时放入碗中，同时锅中放一个小架子加入水超过架子3厘米。放上碗隔水蒸煮。
steps.content_en: Put the peach gum, red dates, longans and yellow rock sugar in a bowl. Place a small rack in a pot with water 3 cm above it, set the bowl on the rack and steam over water.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后倒入常温的牛奶即可享用咯。
steps.content_en: After cooking is complete, pour in milk at room temperature and enjoy.

description_zh: 山药性质甘淡利湿，具有健脾利湿的功效，百合性甘，具有润肺止咳的功效，这2种都是药食两用的食物，具有补脾利湿的作用。
description_en: Yam is sweet in nature and light in diluting dampness, and has the effect of strengthening the spleen and diluting dampness. Lily is sweet in nature, and has the effect of moistening the lungs and relieving cough. These two are both medicinal and edible foods, which have the effect of tonifying the spleen and diluting dampness.
tips_zh: 一般人群均可食用山药。适宜糖尿病患者、腹胀、病后虚弱者食用。
tips_en: The general population can eat yam. It is suitable for people with diabetes, abdominal distension, and those who are weak after illness.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鲜百合掰开洗净。
steps.content_en: Break open the fresh lilies and wash them.

steps.content_zh: 山药去皮切厚片。
steps.content_en: Peel the yam and cut into thick slices.

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，放上处理好的百合与山药，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice and put it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 2 mark. Put the processed lilies and yams and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 茶叶蛋物美价廉。可以做餐点，闲暇时又可当零食，实用和情趣都兼而有之。
description_en: Tea eggs are inexpensive and tasty—enjoy them as a meal or a snack in your spare time; they're both practical and fun.
tips_zh: 如果觉得不够入味，可以增加煮的时间，茶叶蛋越久越好吃。
tips_en: If you feel it is not tasty enough, you can increase the cooking time. The longer the tea eggs are, the more delicious they will be.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 先用蒸煮模式8分钟将鸡蛋煮熟后打碎。
steps.content_en: First use the steam cooking mode for 8 minutes to cook the eggs and then break them into pieces.

steps.content_zh: 将煮好的鸡蛋放入锅中，加入水超过鸡蛋，放入各种香料、生抽和老抽。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the boiled eggs in the pot, add water to cover, then add the spices, light soy sauce and dark soy sauce. Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 白蟹是梭子蟹的俗称，白蟹肉质细嫩、洁白，富含蛋白质、脂肪及多种矿物质。
description_en: White crab is another name for the swimming crab; its meat is tender and white, and it's rich in protein, fat, and various minerals.
tips_zh: 蟹肉营养虽好，但食用时一定要注意，梭子蟹性寒，对蟹有过敏史，或有荨麻疹、过敏性哮喘、过敏性皮炎的人，尤其是有过敏体质的儿童、老人、孕妇最好不要吃蟹。
tips_en: Although crab meat is nutritious, you must pay attention when eating it. Swimming crabs are cold in nature. People with a history of allergies to crabs, or people with urticaria, allergic asthma, or allergic dermatitis, especially children, the elderly, and pregnant women with allergies, should not eat crabs.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 白蟹洗净后去鳃，切块，放入盘子中，上面放上姜片、葱段，浇上料酒。锅中加水到水位线：稠粥二分之一，将白蟹入蒸屉中，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Rinse the crab, remove the gills, cut into pieces, and place on a plate; top with ginger slices and scallion sections and drizzle with cooking wine. Add water to the pot to the 'thick porridge ½' level, put the crab in the steamer, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 同时将小米椒切成圈、剩余的小葱切葱花。
steps.content_en: At the same time, cut the millet peppers into rings and chop the remaining green onions.

steps.content_zh: 蒸熟后取出。
steps.content_en: Remove after steaming.

steps.content_zh: 淋上酱油。撒上葱花、辣椒圈，淋上热油即可。
steps.content_en: Drizzle with soy sauce, sprinkle with chopped scallions and chili rings, and pour hot oil over the top.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 山药筒骨汤能够生津润燥，具有滋养肌肤、毛发的功能，所以说山药排骨汤有美容功效。因此在秋冬两季我们更加应该多吃山药排骨汤，不仅发挥了山药排骨汤的功效，同时还能够润泽肌肤，满足你的食欲。
description_en: Yam and bone soup promotes fluids and moistens dryness, nourishing the skin and hair, so yam rib soup has beauty benefits. Eat it more in autumn and winter: it delivers those benefits, moisturizes the skin and satisfies your appetite.
tips_zh: 熬排骨汤可加2～3滴白醋，以促使骨中的钙质释出，并溶入汤汁中，使汤味鲜美。
tips_en: Add 2-3 drops of white vinegar when making rib soup to help release calcium from the bones into the broth and improve the flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 筒骨出水后洗净。
steps.content_en: Blanch the tube bones and rinse clean.

steps.content_zh: 山药洗净去皮切块、红枣洗净后与筒骨同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，放入葱姜，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash, peel and cut the yams, wash the red dates and put them into the pot together with the tube bones. Add water to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark, add onion and ginger, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的盐、胡椒粉调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking is complete, you can add an appropriate amount of salt and pepper to season according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 既美味又健康的炖排骨，口味可以根据自己的爱好更换，超级简单。
description_en: Delicious and healthy braised spare ribs, with flavors you can adjust to your taste—super simple.
tips_zh: 排骨会出油，所以这道菜肴不用放油，既健康又美味。
tips_en: The ribs release their own fat, so no oil is needed—healthy and tasty.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 排骨洗净滤干水分，大蒜、生姜都切成末。放入排骨中。
steps.content_en: Wash and drain the ribs; mince the garlic and ginger and add them.

steps.content_zh: 放入鸡汁、料酒、烧烤酱、生抽、老抽和蜂蜜一起腌渍一小时。
steps.content_en: Marinate with chicken stock, cooking wine, barbecue sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and honey for 1 hour.

steps.content_zh: 将排骨和酱汁一起倒入锅中，开始烹饪。完成后出锅撒上芝麻即可，如果觉得汤汁不够浓稠可以用蒸煮模式大火收汁5分钟。
steps.content_en: Add the ribs to the pan with the sauce and begin cooking. When finished, take it out of the pot and sprinkle with sesame seeds. If you feel that the soup is not thick enough, you can use the steaming mode to reduce the sauce over high heat for 5 minutes.

description_zh: 牛肉富含蛋白质，氨基酸组成比猪肉更接近人体需要，能提高机体抗病能力，对生长发育及术后，病后调养的人在补充失血、修复组织等方面特别适宜，寒冬食牛肉可暖胃，是该季节的补益佳品。
description_en: Beef is rich in protein, with an amino acid profile closer to human needs than pork. It boosts immunity and is especially good for growth, recovery after surgery or illness, replenishing blood, and repairing tissue. Eating beef in cold winters warms the stomach and makes a nourishing seasonal dish.
tips_zh: 牛肉的纤维组织较粗，结缔组织又较多，应横切，将长纤维切断，不能顺着纤维组织切，否则不仅没法入味，还嚼不烂。
tips_en: Beef has thicker fibrous tissue and more connective tissue. It should be cut crosswise to cut off the long fibers. It should not be cut along the fibrous tissue. Otherwise, it will not be tasty and chewy.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 牛腱出水后洗净，放入锅中加入水没过牛肉即可，放入各种香料和调料，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Blanch the beef shank, rinse it, place in the pot with water to cover, add the spices and seasonings, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后拿出冷却后切片，用卤肉汁、芝麻油、葱、蒜、辣椒调成酱汁淋在牛肉上即可享用。
steps.content_en: When finished, take it out and cool it, then slice it into slices. Use braised gravy, sesame oil, onions, garlic, and chili to make a sauce and pour it over the beef to enjoy.

description_zh: 营养又简单
description_en: Nutritious and simple
tips_zh: 可以在碗口封一个保鲜膜，以免盖子上的水蒸气滴下来，破坏蛋羹的表面。
tips_en: You can seal the mouth of the bowl with a plastic wrap to prevent water vapor from dripping from the lid and damaging the surface of the custard.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋打散后加入150克左右的温水，搅拌均匀。静放5分钟去除表面气泡。
steps.content_en: After beating the eggs, add about 150 grams of warm water and stir evenly. Let it sit for 5 minutes to remove surface bubbles.

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加入水超过水位线：稠粥½刻度，将盘子放在蒸架中，蛋液倒入盘子，盖好盖子开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add water to the inner pot above the water level line: the thick porridge ½ mark, set the plate on the steaming rack, pour the beaten egg into the plate, cover and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时放入虾仁，继续烹饪。完成后淋上芝麻油和生抽，撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: With 5 minutes left, add the shrimp and continue cooking. Drizzle with sesame oil and light soy sauce, and sprinkle with chopped scallion.

name_en: Black bean sauce rib braised rice
description_zh: 电磁加热技术和压力可以让米饭更筋道香甜，同样也可以让排骨更加鲜嫩，肉香能更好地渗透进米粒中，做一大锅快手的豉汁排骨焖饭，简单又美味，一家人一起分享满满一锅的幸福。
description_en: The electromagnetic heating technology and pressure can make the rice more chewy and sweet, and can also make the pork ribs more tender and the meat aroma can better penetrate into the rice grains. Make a quick and easy pot of braised pork ribs with black bean sauce. It is simple and delicious, and the whole family can share a pot full of happiness.
tips_zh: 感谢下厨房达人：Flora牛一提供本食谱。
tips_en: Thanks to the kitchen expert: Flora Niuyi for providing this recipe.

steps.content_zh: 准备好所需要使用的食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 洋葱切丝，姜切片，蒜切末，大葱切片备用。
steps.content_en: Shred the onion, slice the ginger, mince the garlic, and slice the green onion and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 取一个炒锅，锅中放油，比平时炒菜可以略多一些，因为后面要跟米饭一起焖，会更好吃，油热后放入蒜末、姜片、大葱和洋葱爆香。
steps.content_en: Take a wok, put a little more oil in the pot than usual, because it will be simmered with rice later, which will make it more delicious. After the oil is hot, add minced garlic, ginger slices, green onions and onions and saute until fragrant.

steps.content_zh: 爆香以后，加入豆豉继续翻炒至豆豉香味溢出。
steps.content_en: Once fragrant, add the fermented black beans and stir-fry until their aroma is released.

steps.content_zh: 豉香气出来以后放入清洗好的排骨中火翻炒，期间加入生抽，然后加入小半碗水略微炖煮一下，让豆豉的咸香味溢出，然后加盐和糖调味，比平时炒菜略咸即可，汤汁收到较少，不需要留很多汤汁。
steps.content_en: Once the beans are fragrant, add the rinsed ribs and stir-fry over medium heat, adding soy sauce. Pour in a little water and simmer briefly to release the salty aroma, then season with salt and sugar—slightly saltier than usual. Reduce the sauce until little remains.

steps.content_zh: 排骨盛出来备用，电饭煲内胆放入淘洗好的米，加入没过米1厘米左右的水。
steps.content_en: Take the ribs out and set aside. Put the washed rice into the rice cooker and add water to cover the rice by about 1 cm.

steps.content_zh: 把排骨倒在电饭煲中，略微铺平，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour the ribs into the rice cooker, flatten them slightly, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余3分钟时，开盖加入切好的青椒丝、红椒丝，然后继续焖饭3三分钟左右。
steps.content_en: With 3 minutes left, open the lid, add the shredded green and red peppers, and continue steaming the rice for about 3 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 最后开盖，趁热撒上葱花，然后翻拌均匀就可以享用啦。
steps.content_en: Finally, open the lid, sprinkle with chopped scallions while hot, toss well, and enjoy.

name_en: Tender chicken and shimeji mushroom rice
description_zh: 用电饭锅就可以一次满足有菜有肉的想法，饭熟的同时就可以开吃了。
description_en: A rice cooker lets you have both vegetables and meat in one go—dinner is ready as soon as the rice is done.
tips_zh:
1.真姬菇可以换成喜欢的菌类（白玉菇、口蘑亦可）
2.煮饭前米需要加盐
3.炒好的鸡粒和真姬菇会出水，加入米时候只需要将材料加入，水不要。
感谢下厨房达人：惠妈妈hui提供本食谱。
tips_en:
1. Swap the shimeji mushrooms for any mushrooms you like (white beech or button mushrooms work too).
2. Salt the rice before cooking.
3. The chicken and mushrooms release water, so add only the solids to the rice, not the liquid.
Thanks to Hui Mama (hui), a top cook on Xiachufang, for this recipe.

steps.content_zh: 准备好材料。
steps.content_en: Have materials ready.

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿洗干净，去骨、去皮，切粒。真姬菇洗干净，葱切成葱花备用。
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken thigh, debone and remove the skin, then dice. Wash the shimeji mushrooms and chop the scallions; set aside.

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿粒加入蒜蓉、盐、胡椒粉、麻油、酱油调味，腌制30分钟。
steps.content_en: Season the diced chicken thigh with minced garlic, salt, pepper, sesame oil, and soy sauce, then marinate for 30 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 米两杯，洗干净。水量只比米高一点就可以了（菇会出水，米饭的水量不宜多）。同时下一点盐搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Wash 2 cups of rice. Use only slightly more water than rice (mushrooms release moisture, so do not add too much). Add a pinch of salt and stir well.

steps.content_zh: 不粘锅内放油，下鸡腿粒翻炒。
steps.content_en: Put oil in a non-stick pan, add chicken drumsticks and stir-fry.

steps.content_zh: 下真姬菇。
steps.content_en: The real shimeji mushroom.

steps.content_zh: 略炒一下，加入一大匙酱油，翻炒一下后关火。
steps.content_en: Stir-fry briefly, add a tablespoon of soy sauce, stir-fry briefly and then turn off the heat.

steps.content_zh: 将鸡腿粒和真姬菇加入饭上面（多余的水不放），开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add the chicken drumsticks and shimeji mushrooms on top of the rice (do not add excess water) and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 煮好后撒入葱花。
steps.content_en: After cooking, add chopped green onions.

steps.content_zh: 用饭勺将米饭和材料搅拌均匀即可。
steps.content_en: Mix the rice and ingredients well with a rice paddle.

description_zh: 秋冬适合的汤水，海底椰润肺止咳，清心安神。苹果止渴生津，健脾止泻。加入无花果和蜜枣会令汤更加清甜滋润，秋冬喝一碗~舒服。
description_en: A suitable soup for autumn and winter, sea coconut moistens the lungs and relieves coughs, clearing the heart and calming the mind. Apple quenches thirst and promotes body fluids, strengthens the spleen and stops diarrhea. Adding figs and candied dates will make the soup sweeter and more moist, making it a comforting bowl to drink in autumn and winter.
tips_zh:
1.肉类飞水有利于去处肉腥味，汤更清澈
2.苹果也可以去皮使用
感谢下厨房达人：惠妈妈hui提供本食谱。
tips_en:
1. Draining the meat into water will help remove the fishy smell of the meat and make the soup clearer.
2. Apples can also be peeled and used
Thanks to the kitchen expert: Hui Mamahui for providing this recipe.

steps.content_zh: 材料准备好
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients

steps.content_zh: 所需要的汤料：海底椰、无花果、蜜枣，南、北杏，洗干净备用
steps.content_en: Required soup ingredients: sea coconut, figs, candied dates, southern and northern apricots, washed and set aside

steps.content_zh: 瘦肉洗干净，切成大粒
steps.content_en: Rinse the lean pork and cut into large pieces

steps.content_zh: 下入沸水中煮一下，捞出用凉水冲洗干净备用
steps.content_en: Boil in boiling water, remove and rinse with cold water and set aside

steps.content_zh: 苹果用盐彻底搓干净表皮，一个苹果切成6块，去除果核
steps.content_en: Rub the apple skin thoroughly with salt, cut one apple into 6 pieces, and remove the core

steps.content_zh: 下去足量清水至水位线顶部，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour enough water to the top of the water line and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后放入适量的盐调味。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of salt to taste.

steps.content_zh: 享用吧。
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

description_zh: 贴秋膘，清爽的骨头汤走起~加了胡萝卜和山药，红白相间好喝又没有骨头汤的油腻感。
description_en: Time to bulk up for autumn with a light bone soup~ Carrots and yam make it colorful, tasty and not greasy.
tips_zh: 煲汤的时候过早放盐往往会使肉块缩小，肉质变硬，吃起来味道也差。所以我一般都是炖好汤再放盐；若一次性喝不完可以在汤碗里加盐，没有加盐的骨头汤更容易存放。感谢下厨房达人：鸡蛋花蒋蒋鸡蛋花提供本食谱。
tips_en: Adding salt too early when making soup tends to shrink the meat, make it tough, and spoil the flavor. I usually add salt after the soup is done; if you can't finish it all, add salt in the bowl instead - unsalted bone broth keeps better. Thanks to Xiachufang user Jidan Hua Jiang Jiang Ji Dan Hua for this recipe.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材，我炖汤喜欢用猪尾骨，亦可选用筒骨或仔排。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients. I like to use pig tail bones when making soup, but you can also use tube bones or short ribs.

steps.content_zh:
带上手套或者裹一个塑料袋给山药去皮，直接皮肤接触后会手痒；
山药和胡萝卜去皮，生姜切片；玉米切粗段后对半切开，每一半再切成三瓣，啃的时候会很方便。
steps.content_en:
Wear gloves or wrap your hand in a plastic bag to peel the yam, or direct contact will make it itch;
Peel the yam and carrot, slice the ginger; cut the corn into thick sections, halve them, then split each half into three—much easier to eat.

steps.content_zh: 猪骨入冷水，加姜片，一盖子料酒，煮出脏兮兮的沫沫关火，将猪骨头冲洗干净。
steps.content_en: Put the pork bones in cold water with ginger slices and a capful of cooking wine. Once the dirty foam forms, turn off the heat and rinse the bones clean.

steps.content_zh: 所有的材料放入电饭煲，滴几滴白醋，可以帮助骨头里面的钙质游离出来。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put all the ingredients into a rice cooker and add a few drops of white vinegar to help free the calcium from the bones. Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 等电饭煲发出烹饪完成的提示音就ok啦！
steps.content_en: Wait until the rice cooker beeps when cooking is complete!

steps.content_zh: 撒盐，撒葱花开喝！
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with salt, sprinkle with green onions and drink!

description_zh: 干贝鲜嫩，虾肉鲜甜，配上鸡肉的嫩滑，不需要任何味精，在家也能做清淡不失鲜美的海鲜粥哦~
description_en: The scallops are fresh and tender, the shrimps are fresh and sweet, and the chicken is tender and smooth. You don’t need any MSG. You can make a light yet delicious seafood porridge at home~
tips_zh: 感谢下厨房达人：Flora牛一提供本食谱。
tips_en: Thanks to the kitchen expert: Flora Niuyi for providing this recipe.

ingredients.quantity_zh: 一块鸡大胸或3块鸡小胸
ingredients.quantity_en: 1 large chicken breast or 3 small chicken breasts

steps.content_zh: 准备好所有需要的食材，其中小葱切末，干贝提前冷水泡开，姜切丝。
steps.content_en: Prepare all the required ingredients, including mincing the shallots, soaking the scallops in cold water in advance, and shredding the ginger.

steps.content_zh: 电饭煲内胆中加入掏洗好的米。
steps.content_en: Add washed rice to the rice cooker pot.

steps.content_zh: 加入6杯水（或鸡高汤），我比较喜欢1:6的粥的稠度，喜欢更稀一点的可以水的比例更大些。
steps.content_en: Add 6 cups of water (or chicken stock), I prefer a porridge consistency of 1:6, if you like a thinner consistency you can use a larger proportion of water.

steps.content_zh: 加入泡好的干贝和切好的姜丝，点击手机图标开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add the soaked scallops and sliced ​​ginger, and click the phone icon to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 开始煮粥后，可以处理鸡肉，鸡胸水煮至断生，然后撕成鸡丝。
steps.content_en: After starting to cook the porridge, you can process the chicken. Boil the chicken breasts until they are tender and then tear them into shreds.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余60分钟时放入准备好的鸡丝。
steps.content_en: With 60 minutes left, add the prepared shredded chicken.

steps.content_zh: 在离程序结束还有15分钟的时候放入腌制好的虾仁和鲜虾，程序结束后撒葱花出锅就可以咯。
steps.content_en: When there are 15 minutes left before the end of the program, add the marinated shrimps and fresh shrimps. After the program ends, sprinkle with chopped green onions and serve.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，放入盐、白胡椒撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, add salt and white pepper and sprinkle with chopped scallion.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

ingredients.quantity_zh: 一块鸡大胸或3块鸡小胸
ingredients.quantity_en: 1 large chicken breast or 3 small chicken breasts

description_zh: 鸡肉已经软烂，很轻松就能脱骨拆出鸡肉，再浇上香浓的鸡汤汤底做的椒麻调味汁，味道不能更赞啦。
description_en: The chicken is already tender and can be easily removed from the bones. The chicken is then topped with a spicy pepper and sesame sauce made from a fragrant chicken soup base. The taste couldn't be better.
tips_zh: 感谢下厨房达人：Flora牛一提供本食谱。
tips_en: Thanks to the kitchen expert: Flora Niuyi for providing this recipe.

steps.content_zh: 准备好所有需要的食材，1.在鸡的表面抹一层盐。不要太多，控制好咸淡，可以淡一些，后面调味汁也会有咸味的。
steps.content_en: Prepare all ingredients. 1. Rub a thin layer of salt over the chicken—not too much; keep it light, since the sauce later will be salty too.

steps.content_zh: 在电饭煲的内胆底部铺上一层葱丝和姜片。
steps.content_en: Place a layer of shredded green onion and ginger slices on the bottom of the rice cooker's inner pot.

steps.content_zh: 然后把清洗好的鸡整只塞进内胆，然后撒上几粒花椒。
steps.content_en: Then put the whole cleaned chicken into the inner pot and sprinkle with a few peppercorns.

steps.content_zh: 然后在鸡背上再放一些葱丝和姜片，然后再加入两碗水和少许料酒。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Then put some shredded green onions and ginger slices on the back of the chicken, then add two bowls of water and a little cooking wine. Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 饭煲焖煮完成。
steps.content_en: The rice cooker is finished cooking.

steps.content_zh: 把焖好的鸡捞出来，拆成小块，鸡架不需要了，鸡汤过滤下保留备用。
steps.content_en: Take out the stewed chicken and break it into small pieces. The chicken rack is no longer needed. Strain the chicken soup and reserve it for later use.

steps.content_zh: 在炖鸡的时候我们可以做椒麻鸡最出彩的调味汁啦，青椒红椒洋葱切丝，大葱切5厘米的段备用。
steps.content_en: While the chicken is stewing, we can make the most outstanding sauce for the peppercorn chicken. Cut green peppers, red peppers, and onions into shreds, and cut green onions into 5 cm sections for later use.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅热锅冷油，先加入干辣椒后，加入一大把花椒爆香，你没看错，真的是一大把，这样椒麻的口味才能出来。
steps.content_en: Heat the wok with cold oil, first add the dried chili peppers, then add a large handful of Sichuan peppercorns and sauté until fragrant. You read that right, it’s really a large handful, so that the peppery and numbing flavor can come out.

steps.content_zh: 继续加入葱段和洋葱丝，爆香后加入鸡汤。
steps.content_en: Continue to add green onions and shredded onions, sauté then add chicken stock.

steps.content_zh: 趁热把调味汁浇在拆好的鸡肉上，浸泡20分钟左右再吃会更美味哦~
steps.content_en: Pour the sauce over the disassembled chicken while it's hot, and soak it for about 20 minutes before eating. It will be more delicious~

name_en: Job's Tears, Lotus Seeds & Snow Fungus
description_zh: 夏秋交替之际清心润肺少不了它，炖的稠稠的糯糯的当水喝，加一味清心莲子与祛湿薏米走起！
description_en: At the turn of summer and autumn, it is indispensable for clearing the heart and moisturizing the lungs. Drink the thick and glutinous stew with water, add lotus seeds for clearing the heart and dehumidifying barley and go!
tips_zh:
1、银耳撕成小朵后容易出胶质；
2、可以在前一天晚上预约好第二天完成。
tips_en:
1. Tearing the snow fungus into small florets helps it release its gel.
2. You can use the timer the night before to have it ready the next day.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材，请根据人数适当增减食材哟~ 一朵银耳大概够3-5人食用，两个人的话小半朵银耳搞定！
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients. Please increase or decrease the ingredients according to the number of people~ One white fungus is enough for 3-5 people. For two people, half a white fungus will make it!

steps.content_zh: 薏米、莲子、银耳稍微冲洗后倒入冷水泡发一晚上。
steps.content_en: Rinse barley, lotus seeds and white fungus slightly, then pour them into cold water and soak them overnight.

steps.content_zh: 泡发好的银耳冲洗后去蒂，撕成小块，撕小块更容易较快炖出胶质。
steps.content_en: Rinse the rehydrated snow fungus, remove the stem, and tear into small pieces—smaller pieces release their gel faster when cooked.

steps.content_zh: 将所有的食材放入电饭煲（除了枸杞和冰糖）  ，水加到煮粥的最高水位线。开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put all ingredients in the rice cooker (except goji berries and rock sugar), add water to the maximum porridge water line and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 倒数半小时的时候开盖加入枸杞和冰糖。
steps.content_en: When counting down to half an hour, open the lid and add the wolfberry and rock sugar.

steps.content_zh: 完成后，薏米也炖开花了，银耳汤糯糯的~
steps.content_en: After it was finished, the barley blossomed and the white fungus soup was glutinous~

steps.content_zh: 开吃。
steps.content_en: Start eating.

description_zh: 桃胶、皂角和银耳，三种佳品搭配起来，实在不能不说是一种梦幻组合，绝对是女人梦寐以求的美容养颜之圣品！
description_en: Peach gum, soapnut, and white fungus are three fine ingredients that make a truly dreamy combination—the beauty elixir women have long dreamed of!
tips_zh: 桃胶，又称桃树胶，是由桃树上自然分泌出来的桃树油经化学反应而制得的浅黄色粘稠液体，经进一步干燥，粉碎为固体颗粒状，是一种浅黄色透明的固体天然树脂，除补充胶元蛋白之外，桃胶本身的药用功效更佳，内服可养肠胃，同时对面部粉刺、痤疮、色斑均有疗效。
tips_en: Peach gum, also called peach tree resin, is a light yellow viscous liquid obtained by processing the sap naturally secreted by peach trees; after further drying and crushing into granules, it becomes a light yellow transparent natural resin. Besides supplying collagen, peach gum has even greater medicinal value: taken internally, it nourishes the stomach and intestines and helps with facial acne, pimples, and dark spots.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 桃胶、皂角米提前洗净浸泡一夜后去除杂质。
steps.content_en: Wash the peach gum and soapnut rice in advance, soak overnight, then remove impurities.

steps.content_zh: 银耳洗净充分浸泡至少2小时，撕成小朵。
steps.content_en: Wash the snow fungus and soak thoroughly for at least 2 hours, then tear into small florets.

steps.content_zh: 将处理好的桃胶、皂角米、银耳、红枣同时放入锅中，水加到最高水位线，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Place the prepared peach gum, soapbean seeds, silver ear fungus and red dates in the pot, add water to the highest water line and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时根据个人口味放入适量的冰糖调味。完成后就可以享用啦。
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add rock sugar to taste. Enjoy when done.

description_zh: 黑森林蛋糕是德国著名甜点，融合了樱桃的酸、奶油的甜、樱桃的醇香。
description_en: Black Forest Cake is a famous German dessert that combines the sourness of cherries, the sweetness of cream, and the mellow aroma of cherries.
tips_zh: 奶油一定要冷藏后打发。
tips_en: The cream must be refrigerated before whipping.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 全部使用工具清洗干净，擦干水，尤其是打发蛋清的器具。蛋黄与蛋清分离，蛋清中不得有蛋黄。用电动打蛋器打发蛋白，在蛋白里加几滴柠檬汁和20克糖开始打，打出大的泡沫以后放20克糖，继续打，打到泡沫细软稠密时再加40克糖，继续打到干性泡发。
steps.content_en: Wash and dry all tools, especially those for beating egg whites. Separate yolks from whites—no yolk in the whites. Beat the whites with an electric mixer: add a few drops of lemon juice and 20 g sugar and start beating. When large bubbles form, add another 20 g sugar and continue. When the foam becomes fine and dense, add 40 g more sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中加入玉米油、牛奶搅拌均匀后筛入面粉和可可粉，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Add corn oil and milk to the yolk and mix well, then sift in flour and cocoa powder and stir until combined.

steps.content_zh: 面糊与蛋白霜分三次不规则搅拌在一起。
steps.content_en: Fold the batter and meringue together in three additions using gentle, irregular stirring motions.

steps.content_zh: 将混合好的蛋糕糊倒入锅胆中，轻轻磕几下，去除表面气泡，开始烘焙。
steps.content_en: Pour the mixed cake batter into the pan, tap it gently a few times to remove surface bubbles, and start baking.

steps.content_zh: 烘焙蛋糕的时间，刮出巧克力屑。
steps.content_en: While the cake is baking, scrape out the chocolate shavings.

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕烘焙完成后，完全冷却后均匀切成三片。
steps.content_en: Once baked and completely cool, cut the cake evenly into three layers.

steps.content_zh: 冷藏的奶油加入糖打发，抹在蛋糕配上，放上黑樱桃，然后重复操作这一步骤。
steps.content_en: Beat the chilled cream with sugar, spread it over the cake, top with black cherries, and repeat this step.

steps.content_zh: 用奶油将蛋糕体抹平。
steps.content_en: Smooth the cream over the cake.

steps.content_zh: 装饰。
steps.content_en: Garnish.

description_zh: 秋季天气干燥，适宜养肺润燥、生津止渴的食物，这几天天气闷热，多喝清润滋补汤水打败秋老虎。
description_en: The weather in autumn is dry, which is suitable for nourishing the lungs, moistening dryness, and quenching thirst. The weather is sultry these days, so drink more clear and nourishing soups to defeat the autumn tiger.
tips_zh: 盐一定要最后放，这样煲出来的排骨才会酥烂，不柴。
tips_en: The salt must be added last, so that the cooked pork ribs will be crispy and chewy.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 银耳提前洗净浸泡至完全泡发后撕成小朵。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the white fungus in advance until it is completely soaked, then tear it into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 排骨飞水后洗净，放入锅中，加入足量的清水或者高汤至最高水位线。
steps.content_en: Blanch and wash the ribs, put in the pot and add water or broth up to the max level.

steps.content_zh: 放入洗好的北杏仁、海底椰、蜜枣、银耳和生姜。
steps.content_en: Add the washed apricot kernels, sea coconut, red dates, snow fungus and ginger.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入适量的盐调味即可。
steps.content_en: Season with salt to taste after cooking.

name_en: Steamed Razor Clams with Garlic & Glass Noodles
description_zh: 非常简单一道海鲜料理，普通的食材组合到一起能产生出奇妙的变化 ~
description_en: A very simple seafood dish, ordinary ingredients can produce wonderful changes when combined together ~
tips_zh: 蛏子食用前要在淡盐水中充分吐去沙子。
tips_en: Before eating, razor clams should be fully spit out in light salt water to remove sand.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 粉丝在冷水中浸泡 10分钟。
steps.content_en: Soak the vermicelli in cold water for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh:
蛏子充分吐沙后用刀割开背部连接部分，将泡好的粉丝垫在盘子底部，上面码放好蛏子
放上葱段、生姜丝浇上少许料酒，放在蒸架中.
steps.content_en:
After the razor clams are fully sanded, use a knife to cut the connecting part on the back, place the soaked vermicelli on the bottom of the plate, and stack the razor clams on top.
Add scallions and shredded ginger, pour a little cooking wine, and place in the steaming rack.

steps.content_zh: 锅中水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，放入蒸架开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice 2 mark, put in the steaming rack and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后，撒上葱花、蒜泥、辣椒圈，淋上蒸鱼豉油，烧一锅热油淋上即可食用啦。
steps.content_en: When finished, sprinkle with chopped green onion, minced garlic, chili rings, pour steamed fish with soy sauce, heat a pot of hot oil and pour it over to serve.

name_en: Northern and Southern Apricot Stewed Sydney
description_zh: 海底椰是南方常见的汤料之一，有滋阴润肺、除燥清热、润肺止咳等作用。
description_en: Sea coconut is one of the common soup ingredients in the south. It has the functions of nourishing yin and moistening the lungs, removing dryness and clearing away heat, moistening the lungs and relieving cough.
tips_zh: 梨皮有很多的功效。能清心润肺，止咳化痰，能止泻，所以做糖水时建议保留梨皮。
tips_en: Pear peel has many benefits. It can clear the heart and moisten the lungs, relieve coughs and reduce phlegm, and stop diarrhea. Therefore, it is recommended to retain the pear skin when making sugar water.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 雪梨去核切块（保留梨皮）无花果切块
steps.content_en: Core and chop the snow pear (keep the skin); chop the figs.

steps.content_zh: 南北杏仁洗净后，与雪梨、无花果同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥¾的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: After washing the northern and southern almonds, put them into the pot together with the pears and figs. Add water to the water level: ¾ of the thick porridge and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时，放入适量的冰糖调味，完成后即可享用啦。
steps.content_en: When there are 10 minutes left in the cooking time, add an appropriate amount of rock sugar to taste and enjoy after completion.

description_zh: 没有什么事情是用一笼屉蒸饺解决的，如果有配碟醋 ，再多点也能吃下 ~
description_en: Nothing can be solved with a basket of steamed dumplings. If it comes with a dish of vinegar, you can eat even more~
tips_zh: 暂时还没有学会如何包这种饺子的方法，学习中 ······
tips_en: I haven’t learned how to make this kind of dumplings yet, I’m still learning...

steps.content_zh: 冷冻的柳叶饺，不需要解冻哦。
steps.content_en: Frozen willow leaf dumplings do not need to be defrosted.

steps.content_zh: 蒸笼上放上干净的纱布，码放上饺子。
steps.content_en: Place clean gauze on the steamer and stack the dumplings.

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米2的刻度，开始烹饪，三分钟后水烧开，放入蒸屉继续蒸。
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice 2 mark, start cooking; after 3 minutes the water boils, then put in the steaming rack and continue steaming.

steps.content_zh: 完成后搭配醋就能享用啦。
steps.content_en: When finished, serve with vinegar and enjoy.

description_zh: 秋天无花果正上市，用来装饰蛋糕非常简单颜值又高，同时无花果健胃清肠，消肿解毒具有很好的药用价值。
description_en: Fresh figs are in season in autumn — simple and elegant for decorating cakes. They also aid digestion, reduce swelling and detoxify, offering great medicinal value.
tips_zh: 无花果性寒，对于寒性胃病患者而言不仅无忧帮助疾病的恢复，同时还有可能造成疾病的加重，因此胃病患者应该避免食用。
tips_en: Figs are cold in nature. For patients with cold stomach problems, they not only help the recovery of the disease, but may also aggravate the disease. Therefore, patients with stomach problems should avoid eating them.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh:
2枚鸡蛋打碎后，用电动打蛋器快速搅打，过程中分三次加入60克绵白糖。
打至到原来蛋液的三倍左右，并有纹路出现。
steps.content_en:
Crack 2 eggs and beat them quickly with an electric egg beater. Add 60 grams of sugar in three batches during the process.
Beat until it is about three times the original egg liquid and texture appears.

steps.content_zh: 筛入低筋粉、泡打粉。
steps.content_en: Sift in the low-gluten flour and baking powder.

steps.content_zh: 倒入蜂蜜、玉米油、浓缩咖啡搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Pour in honey, corn oil, and espresso and stir evenly.

steps.content_zh: 将面糊倒入锅胆中，轻轻磕去气泡，选择蛋糕模式60分钟。
steps.content_en: Pour the batter into the pan, gently knock out any air bubbles, and select cake mode for 60 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 烘焙完成后放置到完全冷却。
steps.content_en: After baking, let it cool completely.

steps.content_zh: 装饰原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients for garnish.

steps.content_zh: 将奶油芝士和淡奶油混合在一起放入绵白糖，搅拌至打发。
steps.content_en: Mix the cream cheese and light cream together, add the sugar, and stir until whipped.

steps.content_zh: 将奶油芝士霜均匀抹在蛋糕表面，无花果切块后裹上蜂蜜放在奶油上，最后撒上一些坚果碎即可。
steps.content_en: Spread the cream cheese frosting evenly on the surface of the cake, cut the figs into cubes, wrap them in honey and put them on top of the cream, and finally sprinkle some chopped nuts.

description_zh: 板栗，味道甘甜芳香，属于健胃补肾、延年益寿的上等果品，和酥软的东北米融在一起，板栗的香。再加上腊肉，沁出的滴滴肉味和腊味，一道色香味俱全的主食便诞生了。
description_en: Sweet and fragrant, chestnuts are a top-quality food that strengthens the stomach, tonifies the kidneys, and promotes longevity. Blended with soft Northeast rice, their aroma—plus the rich, smoky drippings of cured bacon—creates a main dish that's a feast for the eyes, nose, and palate.
tips_zh: 腊肉的油一定要炒出来这样饭才香。
tips_en: The oil from the bacon must be fried so that the rice will be fragrant.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 板栗肉切小块、腊肠切片、腊肉切丁。
steps.content_en: Cut the chestnut meat into small pieces, slice the sausage, and dice the cured bacon.

steps.content_zh: 将腊肠、腊味和板栗在锅中煸炒出油。
steps.content_en: Stir-fry the sausage, cured meats and chestnuts in a pot to release the oil.

steps.content_zh:
东北米淘洗干净后，水加到水位线：东北米3的刻度，倒入煸炒好的原料。
开始烹饪。
steps.content_en:
Wash the Northeast rice thoroughly, add water to the water line: Northeast Rice level 3, then pour in the stir-fried ingredients.
Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后即可享用。
steps.content_en: Serve when finished.

description_zh: 牛腩软儒不柴，养颜美容，肉汤鲜香。有补中益气，滋养脾胃，强健筋骨之功效。
description_en: The beef brisket is soft and nutty, nourishing the skin and beautifying the body, and the broth is delicious. It has the effect of replenishing vital energy, nourishing the spleen and stomach, and strengthening muscles and bones.
tips_zh: 上好牛腩肉质鲜红，周围有筋膜，没有大块的油脂。
tips_en: Good quality beef brisket is bright red in texture, surrounded by fascia and without large chunks of fat.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh:
生姜洗净切片，白萝卜去皮切滚到块，大葱切段。
香料洗净后放入不锈钢炉料包中。
steps.content_en:
Rinse and slice the ginger, peel and cut the daikon into chunks, and cut the scallions into sections.
Rinse the spices and put them in a stainless-steel spice bag.

steps.content_zh:
牛腩出水后冲洗干净，与生姜、香料、大葱和同时放入锅中。
水加到最大水位线淋上料酒。
点击开始烹饪。
steps.content_en:
Rinse the beef brisket and put it into the pot with ginger, spices, green onions and scallions.
Add water to the maximum water level and pour cooking wine on top.
Click to start cooking.

steps.content_zh:
烹饪时间剩余90分钟时放入切好的白萝卜。
烹饪完成后放入适量的盐调味即可。
steps.content_en:
With 90 minutes left, add the sliced white radish.
After cooking, season with salt to taste.

description_zh: 药膳乌鸡是一款温补的药膳，滋阴润燥、补中益气，很适合秋冬季节吃。
description_en: Medicinal black-bone chicken is a warm and tonic medicinal diet that nourishes yin, moisturizes dryness, and replenishes qi. It is very suitable for eating in autumn and winter.
tips_zh: 当归煮汤后汤会有点苦味，不喜欢的可以不放。
tips_en: The soup will be a little bitter after the angelica is boiled. If you don't like it, you can leave it out.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh:
乌鸡切块，出水后冲洗干净，生姜切片、黄芪、党参、当归洗净。
将所有原料放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度。
点击开始烹饪。
steps.content_en:
Cut the black chicken into pieces, blanch and rinse clean. Slice the ginger; wash the astragalus, codonopsis and angelica.
Put all ingredients in the pot, add water to the water line: Thick Porridge level 1.
Tap Start Cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后放入适量的盐调味即可。
steps.content_en: When finished, add an appropriate amount of salt to taste.

name_en: Old Duck with Solomon's Seal and Glehnia
description_zh: 沙参玉竹老鸭汤是经典的广东老火汤，玉竹可润燥，止渴；沙参可治肺热咳嗽。两者搭配老鸭煲汤，不失为秋季润燥靓汤。
description_en: Glehnia and Solomon's seal duck soup is a classic Cantonese slow-cooked soup. Solomon's seal moistens dryness and quenches thirst; glehnia relieves lung-heat cough. Simmered with duck, it's an excellent autumn soup for moistening dryness.
tips_zh: 对于素体虚寒，受凉引起的不思饮食，胃部冷痛者不适宜食用。
tips_en: It is not suitable for those who are weak and cold, do not want to eat due to cold, and suffer from cold stomach pain.

steps.content_zh: 准备好原料。
steps.content_en: Get the ingredients ready.

steps.content_zh:
老鸭切块，洗净去除内脏。生姜洗净切片，玉竹片和沙参洗净。
老鸭出水后洗净，与玉竹、沙参和生姜同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度。
点击开始烹饪。
steps.content_en:
Cut the old duck into pieces, wash and remove the innards. Wash and slice the ginger, and wash the Solomon's seal and glehnia root slices.
Blanch the duck, rinse it, then put it in the pot with the Solomon's seal, glehnia root and ginger; add water to the thick porridge level 1 mark.
Tap Start Cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后可放入适量的盐调味即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking is complete, add an appropriate amount of salt to taste.

description_zh: 猕猴桃、香蕉、椰蓉、椰汁与黑米，共同搭配出一碗诱人的水果粥，每天晚上预约好煮粥，早上起来花5分钟就能享用一碗充满“正能量”的早餐。
description_en: Kiwi, banana, coconut, coconut milk and black rice are combined to create an attractive bowl of fruit porridge. Make an appointment to cook the porridge every night, and you can enjoy a bowl of breakfast full of "positive energy" in 5 minutes in the morning.
tips_zh: 可根据个人的喜好搭配不同的水果或者果汁一起食用。
tips_en: It can be eaten with different fruits or juices according to personal preference.

steps.content_zh: 黑米洗净后提前浸泡5小时后与东北米同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the black rice and soak it for 5 hours in advance, then put it into the pot with the northeastern rice at the same time. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 煮粥的同时将猕猴桃去皮切片。
steps.content_en: While the porridge is cooking, peel and slice the kiwi fruit.

steps.content_zh: 香蕉切片。
steps.content_en: Slice the banana.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入适量的白糖调味。盛出粥，淋上椰汁，摆上切好的水果撒上椰蓉就完成了。
steps.content_en: After cooking, sweeten with sugar to taste. Spoon the porridge into bowls, drizzle with coconut milk, top with cut fruit, and sprinkle with shredded coconut.

description_zh: 你看见一盘酥烂挂酱的红烧肉，喷香扑鼻，你就想来碗白米饭，吃了它。
description_en: When you see a plate of braised pork with crispy sauce and a fragrant aroma, you want to have a bowl of white rice and eat it.
tips_zh: 选择五花肉时，要选择肥瘦适当五花肉就是层层肥瘦相间，比例接近吃起来才会不油不涩，口感恰到好处。
tips_en: When choosing pork belly, choose pork belly that is appropriately fat and lean, that is, the layers of fat and lean pork belly are alternating with each other. The proportions are close to each other so that it will taste neither oily nor astringent, and the taste will be just right.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 五花肉切块后出水（焯水）洗净。
steps.content_en: Cut the pork belly into pieces, drain (blanch) and wash.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切小块。
steps.content_en: Cut the ginger into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 将处理好的五花肉、生姜、料酒、生抽、冰糖、香料同时放入锅中，加水与肉齐平即可，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the processed pork belly, ginger, cooking wine, light soy sauce, rock sugar, and spices into the pot at the same time, add water to be level with the meat, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 后期20分钟会自动大火收汁。
steps.content_en: In the next 20 minutes, the juice will be automatically reduced by high heat.

steps.content_zh: 出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan.

name_en: Snow pea, spinach and Chinese sausage rice
description_zh: 虽然工作忙碌, 吃饭还是得讲究, 不能委屈自己,还是得有荤有素, 营养可口, 接下来说的这道荷兰豆菠菜腊肠饭。中意它的原因呢, 主要是简单、好吃。吃饭讲究的是色、香、味、形。广东腊肠混合着米饭和时蔬的香, 口水已经下来了吧; 至于味道呢, 搭配的荷兰豆、紫甘蓝、菠菜和胡萝卜, 甜咸交织, 一看就知道富含各种维生素、矿物质, 营养全面。
description_en: Even with a busy job, meals deserve care — don't shortchange yourself; include both meat and vegetables for a nutritious, tasty diet. Take this snow pea, spinach and sausage rice, for example. I like it because it's simple and delicious. A good meal is about color, aroma, flavor and presentation. The aroma of Cantonese sausage mixed with rice and fresh vegetables will make your mouth water; as for flavor, the snow peas, purple cabbage, spinach and carrot bring a sweet-savory balance, packed with vitamins and minerals for complete nutrition.
tips_zh: 生的菠菜有股青涩的味道，所以在放入锅中前要用开水烫一下，可消除涩味。
tips_en: Raw spinach has an astringent taste, so blanch it in boiling water before adding it to the pot to remove the bitterness.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜和腊肠洗净后切丁, 东北米淘洗干净后倒入锅中, 水加到水位线: 东北米3的刻度, 撒上腊肠、胡萝卜丁, 点击开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the carrots and sausages and dice them. Wash the Northeast rice and pour it into the pot. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 3 mark. Sprinkle the sausage and diced carrots and click to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 紫甘蓝洗干净后切丝; 将洗干净的荷兰豆、菠菜放入开水中烫30秒后捞出, 菠菜切碎。
steps.content_en: Wash the purple cabbage and cut into shreds; blanch the washed snow peas and spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, remove and chop the spinach.

steps.content_zh: 收到手机提示音之后, 打开锅盖, 将这些食材倒入锅中焖煮。
steps.content_en: After the phone beeps, open the lid, add these ingredients and simmer.

steps.content_zh: 完成后开盖搅拌, 淋上少许橄榄油就能享用啦。
steps.content_en: When done, open the lid, stir, drizzle with a little olive oil and enjoy.

description_zh: 熬粥是南方人偏爱的味口，而味道鲜美的海鲜粥更是老少皆宜的美食。鲜香无比，口感绵滑。
description_en: Congee is a favorite in southern China, and delicious seafood congee is loved by all ages. It is wonderfully savory and silky smooth.
tips_zh: 蛏子和蛤蜊要在淡盐水中吐沙半天。
tips_en: The razor clams and clams need to spit out sand in light salt water for half a day.

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 先将粥米洗净后放入饭煲中，水加到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度；点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；蛏子和蛤蜊浸泡后吐沙，焯水至贝壳张开；
steps.content_en: First wash the porridge rice and put it into the rice cooker. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge -1 mark; click on the phone to start cooking icon to start cooking; soak razor clams and clams, spit out the sand, and blanch them until the shells open;

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾去虾线；
steps.content_en: Devein the fresh shrimp;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时，放入生姜丝、虾、蛤蜊、蛏子和芹菜丁；
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add shredded ginger, shrimp, clams, razor clams, and diced celery;

steps.content_zh: 完成后用盐、胡椒粉调味，撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: When finished, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle with chopped green onion.

description_zh: 此汤有健脾开胃，护肤养颜的作用。萝卜可以减少高血压和冠心病的发生，能消除积垢，清除多余脂肪，润泽皮肤，颜面清秀。
description_en: This soup strengthens the spleen, stimulates the appetite, and nourishes the skin. Radish can reduce the risk of hypertension and coronary heart disease, help remove buildup and excess fat, and keep the skin moist and the complexion clear.
tips_zh: 牛腩汤虽好，但是高胆固醇、高脂肪、消化力弱的人不宜多吃。
tips_en: Brisket soup is delicious, but those with high cholesterol, high fat levels, or weak digestion should not eat too much.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 牛腩出水后洗净，生姜切片，将香料放到不锈钢卤料包中，锅中加入水到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，点击开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the beef brisket after it is out of water, slice the ginger, put the spices into a stainless steel brine bag, add water to the pot to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark, click to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 白萝卜洗净后切滚刀块，油豆腐切开，烹饪时间剩余90分钟时放入白萝卜和油豆腐，继续烹饪。
steps.content_en: Rinse and cut the daikon into chunks and halve the fried tofu; when 90 minutes of cooking time remain, add them and continue cooking.

steps.content_zh: 粉丝洗净后提前浸泡。
steps.content_en: Wash the vermicelli and soak it in advance.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时放入粉丝。烹饪结束后放入适量的盐调味，出锅后撒上香菜、辣椒圈即可。
steps.content_en: With 5 minutes left, add the glass noodles. After cooking, season with salt, then top with cilantro and chili rings.

name_en: Steamed Egg & Meat Patty with Rice
description_zh: 一菜一饭同时出锅，方便、简单、美味，新鲜的鸡蛋配上肥瘦相间的肉末，不仅美观，营养上也搭配合理。适合工作忙碌的你~
description_en: Dish and rice cooked together—convenient, simple and delicious. Fresh eggs with fatty-and-lean minced pork look beautiful and make a balanced meal. Perfect for your busy workdays.
tips_zh: 刚刚完成后盘子很烫，小心烫伤。
tips_en: The plate will be very hot right after finishing, so be careful of burns.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh:
生姜切末、小葱切葱花倒入肉末中，同时放入生抽和料酒。
鸡蛋去壳，打入碗中。
steps.content_en:
Chop the ginger and green onions into minced pieces and pour them into the minced meat. Add the light soy sauce and cooking wine at the same time.
Peel the eggs and break them into a bowl.

steps.content_zh: 肉末调味后搅拌均匀，可放入少许淀粉搅拌上劲。将肉末扑倒盘子上，用勺子压下三个坑，放入鸡蛋用。
steps.content_en: Season the minced meat and mix well; add a little starch and mix until sticky. Spread the meat on a plate, press three wells with a spoon, and place the eggs in them.

steps.content_zh: 将鸡蛋倒入肉末上，同时准备淘洗好一杯米饭，加入水。
steps.content_en: Pour the eggs over the minced meat, prepare a cup of rice and add water.

steps.content_zh: 将处理好的鸡蛋和肉放到蒸架上，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Place the cooked eggs and meat on the steam rack and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后取出，撒上葱花，盛一碗米饭出来就搞定了一餐，是不是很方便呢？（如果喜欢吃嫩一点的，可以在剩余10分钟时取出，小心烫手哦！）
steps.content_en: When finished, take it out, sprinkle with chopped green onions, put a bowl of rice out and you have a complete meal. Isn’t it very convenient? (If you like to eat it tenderer, you can take it out with 10 minutes left, be careful as it will burn your hands!)

name_en: Steamed Shrimp with Garlic and Rice
description_zh: 浓浓的蒜香味 , 新鲜的大虾, 咸、甜、Q嫩 , 配上一碗米饭不失为一顿饕餮大餐啦。
description_en: Rich garlic aroma, fresh prawns, salty-sweet and springy—paired with a bowl of rice, it's a veritable feast.
tips_zh: 完成后锅内温度高 , 小心烫手哦。
tips_en: When finished, the temperature inside the pot will be high, so be careful not to burn your hands.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾洗净去虾线 , 开背。
steps.content_en: Wash the fresh shrimps, devein them and cut the backs.

steps.content_zh: 大蒜去皮切成蒜末 , 同时与蒸鱼豉油、葱花、辣椒圈、辣椒油、芝麻油混合调成蒜蓉酱。
steps.content_en: Peel and mince the garlic, and mix it with steamed fish soy sauce, chopped green onion, chili rings, chili oil, and sesame oil to make a garlic sauce.

steps.content_zh: 将处理好的鲜虾与蒜蓉酱混合 , 腌渍5分钟。
steps.content_en: Mix the prepared shrimps with garlic sauce and marinate for 5 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 将腌制好的虾放入盘子中 , 倒入腌制的蒜蓉酱 , 同时淘洗好大米。
steps.content_en: Place the marinated shrimps on a plate, pour in the marinated garlic sauce, and rinse the rice at the same time.

steps.content_zh: 将虾放到蒸架上 , 蒸架放入煲中 , 开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Place the shrimps on the steamer rack, place the steamer rack into the pot, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后就可享用 , 用蒸虾的汤汁来泡饭也非常好吃呢。
steps.content_en: You can enjoy it after it is finished. It is also very delicious to soak rice with the steamed shrimp soup.

name_zh: 金银蛋娃娃菜配黑椒鸡肉板栗饭
name_en: Gold and silver eggs with baby napa cabbage, black pepper chicken and chestnut rice
description_zh: 即使是一个人吃饭也不能马虎，一天辛苦的工作后身心疲倦，已经懒得下厨去做饭。不如来试一下这道鸡肉饭加上蒸娃娃菜吧，清淡营养，方便快捷。
description_en: Even eating alone deserves a good meal. After a long, tiring day, you may be too worn out to cook. Try this chicken rice with steamed baby napa cabbage—light, nutritious, quick and easy.

steps.content_zh: 准备好金银蛋娃娃菜食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients for gold and silver egg baby cabbage.

steps.content_zh: 娃娃菜洗净后切成长条。
steps.content_en: Wash the baby cabbage and cut into long strips.

steps.content_zh: 瑶柱洗净泡发，皮蛋、咸鸭蛋切丁、大蒜去皮切片，洒在娃娃菜上，淋上高汤。
steps.content_en: Rinse and soak the dried scallops until soft; dice the century egg and salted duck egg, peel and slice the garlic, scatter over the baby napa cabbage, and drizzle with broth.

steps.content_zh: 黑椒板栗饭原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients for black pepper and chestnut rice.

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿肉切片用盐与黑胡椒腌渍。
steps.content_en: Slice the chicken thigh meat and marinate with salt and black pepper.

steps.content_zh: 在平底锅中将鸡肉煎上色。
steps.content_en: Brown the chicken in a pan.

steps.content_zh: 鸭田米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米1的刻度，倒入煎好的鸡肉和板栗肉。
steps.content_en: Wash the duck-field rice, put it in the pot, add water to the Northeast rice 1 mark on the water level line, then pour in the pan-fried chicken and chestnut meat.

steps.content_zh: 放入准备好的娃娃菜，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add the prepared baby cabbage and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后开盖。
steps.content_en: Open the lid when finished.

steps.content_zh: 开吃。
steps.content_en: Start eating.

description_zh: 鲜甜、香滑、美味的瑶柱饭，全家疯抢。
description_en: The whole family goes crazy for the sweet, smooth and delicious Scallop Rice.

steps.content_zh: 瑶柱用冷水冲洗一下，放碗内用小量热开水浸泡半小时
steps.content_en: Rinse the dried scallops with cold water, place in a bowl, and soak in a little hot water for half an hour

steps.content_zh: 用手把瑶柱撕碎，水要保留用来煮饭
steps.content_en: Tear the dried scallops apart by hand and save the soaking water for cooking the rice

steps.content_zh: 米洗好后，把瑶柱和水放进饭煲，再加适量的水 (就跟平时煮饭一样)，之后再加少许花生油
steps.content_en: After washing the rice, put the dried scallops and their water into the cooker, add water as you normally would for rice, then a little peanut oil.

steps.content_zh: 选择精煮程序，开始烹调
steps.content_en: Select the 'precise cook' program and start cooking

steps.content_zh: 待米饭煮好后，打开发现香喷扑鼻
steps.content_en: After the rice is cooked, open it and you will find that it is fragrant.

steps.content_zh: 把两只鸡蛋加少许盐打烂，再放进饭里
steps.content_en: Crack two eggs with a little salt and add them to the rice

steps.content_zh: 再加入适量生抽拌匀
steps.content_en: Add appropriate amount of light soy sauce and mix well

steps.content_zh: 就这样简单，就做好美味的瑶柱饭了
steps.content_en: It’s so simple, you can make delicious Yao Zhu Rice

description_zh: 稻谷收获后，经砻谷机脱去谷壳，保存皮层、糊粉层和胚芽即为糙米。相比于白米，糙米的营养价值更高，含有更多的维生素、矿物质及膳食纤维。可调节人体新陈代谢、增强机体免疫力等作用。糙米虽好，但是其质地坚硬紧密，可能造成肠胃的不适，因此在糙米中加入适量的白米煮成二米饭，同时具有口感和营养，不失为最佳组合。
description_en: After rice is harvested, a huller removes the husk while keeping the bran, aleurone layer and germ — this is brown rice. Compared with white rice, brown rice is more nutritious, with more vitamins, minerals and fiber; it helps regulate metabolism and boost immunity. Though good for you, its hard, dense texture can upset the stomach, so mixing brown and white rice gives the best combination of taste and nutrition.
tips_zh: 除了煮饭以外，可以先将糙米炒至微微发黑后，用开水冲泡，做成糙米茶，可防治高血压、高血糖和脑中风等。
tips_en: Besides cooking rice, you can stir-fry brown rice until slightly darkened and steep it in boiling water to make brown rice tea, which helps prevent and control high blood pressure, high blood sugar and stroke.

steps.content_zh: 原料。
steps.content_en: raw material.

steps.content_zh: 将糙米和鸭田米洗净后，水加到水位线：丝苗米2的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: After washing the brown rice and duck field rice, add water to the water level line: silk seedling rice 2 mark, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 黑米又被称为“贡米”，能够维持血管正常的渗透压，防治血管破裂。同时黑米有助于改善白发、体虚和肾虚等。黑米加上有米鸭田米能补虚养身、滑涩补精。
description_en: Black rice, also known as "Gong rice", can maintain normal osmotic pressure of blood vessels and prevent and treat blood vessel rupture. At the same time, black rice can help improve gray hair, physical weakness and kidney deficiency. Black rice plus Youmi Ya Tian rice can nourish the body, smooth astringent and replenish essence.
tips_zh: 黑米不像白米那样精加工，而是多半在脱壳之后以糙米的形式直接食用，这种口感较粗的黑米适合用来煮粥。煮粥前先浸泡，充分吸收水分。泡米用的水要与米同煮，以保存其中的营养成分。
tips_en: Black rice is not as refined as white rice. Instead, it is mostly eaten directly in the form of brown rice after shelling. This kind of black rice with a thicker texture is suitable for cooking porridge. Soak it before cooking porridge to fully absorb the water. The water used to soak the rice should be boiled with the rice to preserve the nutrients.

steps.content_zh: 原料。
steps.content_en: raw material.

steps.content_zh: 黑米提前浸泡1夜后与鸭田米同时倒入锅中，再倒入浸泡黑米的水到水位线：东北米1.5的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Soak the black rice overnight in advance and then pour it into the pot with the duck field rice at the same time. Then pour the water used to soak the black rice to the water level: the 1.5 mark for Northeast rice and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 荞麦起源于中国，已知最早的荞麦实物距今已有2000多年的历史，荞麦突出的营特点是含有芦丁，芦丁含有降血脂、降胆固醇、软化血管、预防高血脂和心脑血管疾病。由于荞麦没有延展性和弹性口感欠佳，所以搭配了鸭田米增加其口感和营养。同时又加入了少量的高粱米可使不同氨基酸和营养素互补。
description_en: Buckwheat originated in China, and the earliest known specimens date back more than 2,000 years. Its standout nutritional feature is rutin, which helps lower blood lipids and cholesterol, soften blood vessels, and prevent high blood lipids and cardiovascular disease. Because buckwheat lacks extensibility and elasticity and has a poor texture, it is paired with duck-field rice to improve both taste and nutrition, with a little sorghum added so different amino acids and nutrients complement each other.
tips_zh: 高粱米一定要煮烂才容易消化，所以采用了时间较长的香甜煮。
tips_en: Sorghum rice must be boiled until it is easy to digest, so it is cooked sweetly for a longer time.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 荞麦、高粱米和鸭田米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：丝苗米2.5的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the buckwheat, sorghum, and duck-field rice and put them in the pot; add water to the Simiao rice 2.5 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 五谷杂粮在饮食中的主导地位。 营养学认为，最好的饮食其实是平衡膳食。平衡膳食的第一原则就要求食物要尽量多样化。粗杂粮的某些微量元素，例如铁、镁、锌、硒的含量要比细粮多一些。这几种微量元素对人体健康的价值是相当大的。粗杂粮中的钾、钙、维生素e、叶酸、生物类黄酮的含量也比细粮丰富。粗杂粮有利于糖尿病用粗杂粮代替部分细粮有助于糖尿病患者控制血糖，经常食用能有效的降低三高。
description_en: Whole grains should take a leading role in the diet. Nutritionists agree the best diet is a balanced one, whose first principle is variety. Whole grains contain more trace elements such as iron, magnesium, zinc and selenium than refined grains, along with more potassium, calcium, vitamin E, folate and bioflavonoids—all valuable to health. For diabetics, replacing some refined grains with whole grains helps control blood sugar, and regular consumption can effectively lower blood pressure, blood sugar and blood lipids.
tips_zh: 消化能力有问题的人(例如，胃溃疡、十二指肠溃疡)不适合吃五谷杂粮中的难消化的谷物，因为这些食材较粗糙，跟胃肠道物理摩擦，会造成伤口疼痛。
tips_en: People with digestive problems (e.g., stomach or duodenal ulcers) should avoid the harder-to-digest grains among whole grains, since these coarse foods can physically irritate the gut and cause pain.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 所有原料洗净后提前浸泡一夜。
steps.content_en: Wash all raw materials and soak them overnight.

steps.content_zh: 将所有原料放入锅中，用浸泡杂粮的水倒入锅中水位线：丝苗米2的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put all the raw materials into the pot, pour the water used to soak the grains into the pot, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 习惯于精细饮食的人，要及时调整自己的饮食结构，帮助身体获取更充足的纤维素。主食方面，应适当掺加一些粗粮，时常与精粮搭配或交替进食，可以很好地帮助我们清理肠道，保持肠道的通畅。燕麦糙米饭含有比白米更低的糖类成分，但是蛋白质、粗纤维和矿物质远远高于精粮。能有效的减少肠道中的油脂，而且燕麦糙米饭嚼劲十足，果腹感极强，非常适合在减肥瘦身中的人群。
description_en: Those used to refined foods should adjust their diet to get more fiber. Add some whole grains to staple meals, mixing or alternating with refined grains to help cleanse and keep the intestines regular. Oat brown rice has less sugar than white rice but far more protein, fiber and minerals. It helps reduce intestinal fat, is pleasantly chewy and very filling—ideal for anyone trying to lose weight.
tips_zh: 消化功能不好的人群减少食用。
tips_en: People with poor digestive function should eat less.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 糙米和燕麦米洗净后浸泡3小时候倒入锅中，用泡米的水加到水位线：东北米2的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the brown rice and oat rice for 3 hours, then put in the pot; use the soaking water to fill to the Northeast-rice 2 mark and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 玉米的营养价值在谷类食物中是出类拔萃的。每百克玉米的脂肪含量是1.2克，为精米白面的3 6倍，其脂肪特点是：一半以上为亚油酸，并具有谷固醇、卵磷脂、维生素 E等有益于防治血管硬化和促进脑细胞功能的物质。玉米的蛋白质含量略高于精米白面，纤维素含量则是后者的4 10倍，因此，玉米有刺激肠蠕动、防治便秘的作用。玉米的胡萝卜素含量比大豆高5倍。每百克玉米的含钙量高达22毫克，在谷物中是少见的。玉米的口感较精米白面差，所以，提倡将玉米磨成渣同鸭田米一起混做混吃，不仅能改善口感，还能提高营养价值。
description_en: Corn's nutritional value is outstanding among grains. Per 100 g, corn contains 1.2 g of fat, 3-6 times that of polished rice and white flour. More than half of its fat is linoleic acid, and it also contains sitosterol, lecithin, and vitamin E, which help prevent hardening of the arteries and promote brain cell function. Corn's protein content is slightly higher than that of refined rice and flour, while its fiber content is 4-10 times higher, so corn stimulates intestinal movement and helps prevent constipation. Corn has 5 times more carotene than soybeans. Each 100 g contains up to 22 mg of calcium, rare among grains. Corn does not taste as good as refined rice or flour, so it is recommended to grind it into grits and mix it with duck-field rice - this improves both taste and nutrition.
tips_zh: 相对于白米，玉米拥有丰富的纤维素，但钾含量高，需要控制钾离子的人，如慢性肾脏病患者应该注意食用量。
tips_en: Compared with white rice, corn is rich in fiber, but has high potassium content. People who need to control potassium ions, such as patients with chronic kidney disease, should pay attention to their consumption.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鸭田米和玉米渣洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米2.5的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the duck-field rice and corn grits, put them in the pot, add water to the Northeast rice 2.5 mark on the water level line, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 萝卜煲羊肉是一道补肾壮阳、补虚温中，养力最强的冬季养生汤。其营养丰富，味道鲜美。常吃可以温暖肠胃，储存热量。冬季寒气逼人，给人们带来了很多不便，尤其是老年人，稍不注意便会受到寒气的侵袭，常会引起旧病复发或诱发新病。所以冬季要注意保暖，养生要从“避寒”开始。 冬天吃羊肉非常合适，因为羊肉性温，能给人体带来热量。中医说它是助元阳、补精血、疗肺虚、益劳损之妙品，是一种良好的滋补强壮食物。
description_en: Radish and lamb soup is a nourishing winter soup that warms and tonifies the body. It is rich in nutrients and delicious. Regular consumption warms the stomach and helps store heat. Winter cold brings many inconveniences, especially for the elderly, who may suffer a relapse of old ailments or new illnesses. So keep warm in winter — health starts with avoiding the cold. Lamb is ideal in winter because it is warming and provides energy. Traditional Chinese medicine regards it as a food that boosts yang, replenishes essence and blood, and relieves fatigue — a nourishing, strengthening food.
tips_zh: 有外感热病及热性体质者不宜食用。
tips_en: Not suitable for people with externally contracted febrile diseases or a hot constitution.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 羊肉出水洗净后倒入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，放入生姜、陈皮和草果，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the mutton and pour it into the pot. Add the water to the water level line: thick porridge 1. Add ginger, tangerine peel and grass fruit and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 白萝卜去皮切滚刀块待用，枸杞用水泡发。
steps.content_en: Peel the white radish and cut into cubes for later use. Soak the wolfberry in water.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余90分钟时，放入切好的白萝卜，继续焖煮。
steps.content_en: When 90 minutes are left in the cooking time, add the sliced ​​radish and continue simmering.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时，倒入泡好的枸杞子。
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add the soaked goji berries.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间结束后放入适量的盐、胡椒粉调味。喜欢吃蒜苗、香菜和葱花的同学可以适量的放入。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt and pepper. Add garlic chives, cilantro, and chopped scallion if you like.

description_zh:
羊肉肉质细嫩，味道鲜美，含有丰富的营养。味甘而不腻，性温而不燥，秋冬食羊肉，既能抵御风寒，又可滋补身体，实乃寒凉季节进补佳品。 
肉苁蓉具有补肾阳、益精血、润肠通便的功效，被誉为“沙漠人参”，其含有微量生物碱、多糖、矿物质等，具有降低血压、抗动脉粥样硬化作用，有一定抗衰老作用。肉苁蓉可用来平补，适合进补食用。
description_en:
Lamb is tender, delicious and rich in nutrients. Sweet but not greasy, warming but not dry, it wards off wind-cold and nourishes the body in autumn and winter — an ideal tonic for the cold season.
Cistanche tonifies kidney yang, replenishes essence and blood, and moistens the intestines to relieve constipation. Known as 'desert ginseng', it contains trace alkaloids, polysaccharides and minerals, and helps lower blood pressure, resist atherosclerosis and slow aging. It is a gentle tonic suitable for nourishing the body.
tips_zh: 羊肉性温热，常吃容易上火。因此，吃羊肉时要搭配凉性和甘平性的蔬菜，能起到清凉、解毒、去火的作用。
tips_en: Lamb is warming, so eating it often can cause internal heat. Pair it with cool or neutral vegetables to help cool the body, detoxify and reduce internal heat.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 肉苁蓉浸泡12小时后切片，生姜去皮切片。
steps.content_en: Soak the cistanche for 12 hours and then slice it; peel and slice the ginger.

steps.content_zh: 羊肉出水洗净后放入锅中，放入生姜片、当归、黄芪，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the mutton and put it into the pot, add ginger slices, angelica root, and astragalus root. Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 mark, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 山药去皮切块，浸在水中待用。
steps.content_en: Peel and cut the yam into pieces, soak in water and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余60分钟时，放入山药继续焖煮。
steps.content_en: With 60 minutes left, add the Chinese yam and continue simmering.

steps.content_zh: 完成后放入盐、胡椒粉调味即可。
steps.content_en: When finished, add salt and pepper to taste.

description_zh: 说起玉米碴子粥，南方的朋友比较少见，这是一道北方比较传统和典型的主食，当然一般我们认为它是属于中青年人来食用比较合适，老年人由于牙齿问题可能会影响对营养物质的吸收，不过由于它低热量营养价值丰富，还是很受欢迎。
description_en: Corn grits porridge is uncommon in the south but a traditional northern staple. It's best for young and middle-aged people; seniors with dental issues may not absorb nutrients well, yet its low calories and rich nutrition keep it popular.
tips_zh: 在进食玉米渣的时候，要多加咀嚼，这样有助于消化吸收，特别对于容易便秘的人能起到改善的作用。
tips_en: When eating corn residue, chew more, which will help digestion and absorption, especially for people who are prone to constipation.

steps.content_zh: 小碴子即玉米渣1.5杯，洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash 1.5 cups of small corn residue, put it into the pot, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪过程中可适当的搅拌。出锅前10分钟可淋上少许色拉油，你会发现不光成品粥色泽鲜亮，而且入口别样鲜滑。
steps.content_en: Stir properly during cooking. You can drizzle a little salad oil on it 10 minutes before serving. You will find that not only the finished porridge is bright in color, but also very smooth in the mouth.

description_zh: 味噌汤是日本的一道传统家庭料理，几乎每天都会出现在日本家庭的餐桌上。冷冷的冬天来一晚鲜美可口的蛤蜊汤，温暖一整天。
description_en: Miso soup is a traditional Japanese home dish, served almost daily. On a cold winter day, a bowl of delicious clam miso soup warms you all day long.
tips_zh: 可根据个人口味放入豆腐、海带丝、白萝卜等增添风味。味增一定要过筛。
tips_en: Add tofu, shredded kelp or white radish to taste for extra flavor. Be sure to strain the miso.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 蛤蜊提前在淡盐水中吐沙。
steps.content_en: Soak clams in lightly salted water beforehand to purge sand.

steps.content_zh: 瑶柱洗净泡发。
steps.content_en: Rinse and soak the dried scallops until soft.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切丝后与泡好的瑶柱同时放入锅中，水加大水位线：稠粥¾的刻度，点击手机烹饪图标，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add the shredded ginger and soaked dried scallops to the pot, fill water to the 'thick porridge ¾' level, tap the cooking icon on your phone, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 水烧开后放入菌菇和蛤蜊。
steps.content_en: After the water boils, add the mushrooms and clams.

steps.content_zh: 舀1大勺味噌入漏勺，用筷子搅拌融化后继续煮。
steps.content_en: Scoop 1 tablespoon of miso into a strainer, dissolve it with chopsticks, and continue cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成后尝一下味道，放入白胡椒粉调味。出锅后撒上葱花。
steps.content_en: When done, taste and season with white pepper. Sprinkle with chopped scallions before serving.

description_zh: 在西方人的Party上很常会看到一道很受欢迎的小吃﹐名为“魔鬼蛋（Deviled Eggs）”。其实魔鬼蛋是传统西餐中很有名的开胃菜﹐而这里的“魔鬼”，指的是调味料的辣味。这道菜简单易做、好看好吃，而且，鸡蛋营养丰富
description_en: At Western parties you'll often find a popular snack called deviled eggs. A famous appetizer in classic Western cuisine, the 'devil' refers to the spicy seasoning. Easy to make, attractive and tasty—and eggs are highly nutritious.
tips_zh: 剥开的鸡蛋要放入清水中，不然会有氧化。可根据个人口味放入调味料调味。
tips_en: Place peeled eggs in clean water to prevent oxidation. Season to taste.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋洗净后放入锅中，加水没过鸡蛋2厘米，点击手机烹饪图标，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the eggs, place in the pot, add water to 2 cm above them, then tap the cooking icon on your phone to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋煮好后，过凉水剥壳，切开。
steps.content_en: Once the eggs are cooked, cool in cold water, peel, and cut open.

steps.content_zh: 取出鸡蛋黄，倒入蛋黄酱、辣椒仔、黄芥末、黑胡椒搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Take out the egg yolk, add mayonnaise, chili pepper, yellow mustard, and black pepper and stir evenly.

steps.content_zh: 用裱花袋挤入蛋白中。
steps.content_en: Use a piping bag to pipe in egg whites.

steps.content_zh: 撒上辣椒粉。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with chili powder.

steps.content_zh: 可放上坚果碎装饰。
steps.content_en: Can be garnished with chopped nuts.

description_zh: 去茶餐厅，鲜虾烧麦几乎是必点的点心之一。口感Q弹，鲜嫩多汁，其实在家做起来比包饺子还要简单。
description_en: At a Hong Kong-style café, shrimp shaomai is almost a must-order dim sum. Springy, juicy and tender—and easier to make at home than dumplings.
tips_zh:
可在肉馅拌入香菇、红萝卜、黑木耳、竹笋或荸荠等，使肉馅的味道更丰富
如果买不到广东烧卖皮用普通的馄饨皮也是可以的。
tips_en:
Mix shiitake mushrooms, carrot, black fungus, bamboo shoots or water chestnuts into the pork filling for richer flavor.
If you can't find Cantonese shaomai wrappers, ordinary wonton wrappers work too.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 一半的虾仁切成丁，放入肉末中。用盐、白胡椒粉、芝麻油、生抽、糖调味。
steps.content_en: Dice half the shrimp and mix into the minced pork. Season with salt, white pepper, sesame oil, light soy sauce, and sugar.

steps.content_zh: 倒入淀粉，朝着一个方向搅拌约4分钟使得肉末上劲。
steps.content_en: Pour in the starch and stir in one direction for about 4 minutes to thicken the minced meat.

steps.content_zh: 剩余的虾仁用胡椒粉、生抽腌渍备用。
steps.content_en: Marinate the remaining shrimps with pepper and light soy sauce and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 取一张烧卖皮，放入馅料。
steps.content_en: Take a piece of siomai skin and add the fillings.

steps.content_zh: 用虎口捏紧，在顶部再塞入一些馅。
steps.content_en: Pinch it tightly with the tiger's mouth and stuff some more stuffing on top.

steps.content_zh: 顶部放上腌渍好的虾仁。
steps.content_en: Top with the marinated shrimp.

steps.content_zh: 包好一些烧卖，同时锅中加水到水位线：东北米2的刻度，点击手机图标开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wrap some siomai and add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast meter 2. Click the phone icon to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 将包好烧卖放入蒸笼中，蒸笼上放上纱布，大约5分钟后水沸腾放入蒸笼，蒸煮烧卖。
steps.content_en: Put the wrapped siomai into a steamer, put gauze on the steamer, wait for about 5 minutes after the water boils, put it in the steamer, and cook the siomai.

steps.content_zh: 约10分钟后就蒸熟了。
steps.content_en: It will be steamed through in about 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 享用吧。
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

description_zh: 广式水晶虾饺在广州饮食界的地位，可以用“至高无上”来形容。皮白如雪，薄如纸，半透明，内馅隐约可见，吃起来爽滑清鲜，美味诱人。
description_en: Cantonese crystal shrimp dumplings are hailed as supreme in Guangzhou cuisine. White as snow, thin as paper and translucent, with the filling faintly visible—smooth, fresh and irresistible.
tips_zh: 做虾饺的难度在于制皮，如果一次不成功就多试几次。静置醒发面团很重要会让面团更有延展性。馅包的不可过多，包的多了，有的饺子会长开口了。
tips_en: The difficulty of making shrimp dumplings lies in making the skin. If you don't succeed once, try a few more times. It is important to let the dough rest to rise. This will make the dough more malleable. Don't pack too much stuffing. If you pack too much, some dumplings will become open.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 用牙签取虾线，在虾尾部的第二个关节处容易取出。
steps.content_en: Use a toothpick to remove the shrimp vein; it comes out easily at the second joint from the tail.

steps.content_zh: 取出的虾仁一般用刀背剁成虾茸。一般用盐、胡椒粉腌渍。
steps.content_en: Finely mince the peeled shrimp with the back of a knife, then marinate with salt and pepper.

steps.content_zh: 肉末中放入生姜末、虾茸，用盐、胡椒粉、糖、生抽、芝麻油调味。
steps.content_en: Add minced ginger and minced shrimp to the minced meat, and season with salt, pepper, sugar, light soy sauce, and sesame oil.

steps.content_zh: 撒上一大勺淀粉，顺着一个方向搅拌上劲。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle a tablespoon of starch and stir in one direction.

steps.content_zh: 澄面和土豆淀粉混合，准备好刚刚沸腾的开水，一边倒入面粉中一边搅拌。
steps.content_en: Mix the flour and potato starch, prepare just boiling water, and pour it into the flour while stirring.

steps.content_zh: 用手揉到无明显的面粉状态。盖上纱布静置10分钟。
steps.content_en: Knead with hands until there is no obvious flour. Cover with gauze and let sit for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 10分钟后取出面团，抹上一层食用油（无明显味道的油，如玉米油）
steps.content_en: After 10 minutes, take out the dough and apply a layer of cooking oil (oil with no obvious flavor, such as corn oil)

steps.content_zh: 揉成光滑的面团，静置10分钟。
steps.content_en: Knead into a smooth dough and let it rest for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 取一小块，搓成长条，切小段，擀成薄片。放上一些肉馅和一个虾仁。
steps.content_en: Take a small piece, roll into a long strip, cut into small pieces and flatten into thin wrappers. Add some minced pork filling and one shrimp.

steps.content_zh: 如图所示包虾饺。
steps.content_en: Make shrimp dumplings as shown in the picture.

steps.content_zh: 如图所示包虾饺。
steps.content_en: Make shrimp dumplings as shown in the picture.

steps.content_zh: 如图所示包虾饺。
steps.content_en: Make shrimp dumplings as shown in the picture.

steps.content_zh: 包饺子的同时在锅胆中加水，到水位线：东北米2的刻度，点击手机图标开始烹饪。大约5分钟后水烧开。
steps.content_en: While wrapping the dumplings, add water to the inner pot up to the water line: Northeast Rice level 2, then tap the icon on your phone to start cooking. The water boils in about 5 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜切片垫在饺子下面，放入蒸笼中。水沸腾后放入蒸笼，大约蒸10分钟。
steps.content_en: Slice the carrot and place it under the dumplings, then put them in the steamer. Once the water boils, add the steamer and steam for about 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 蒸好的样子。
steps.content_en: How it looks when steamed.

steps.content_zh: 享用吧。
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

description_zh: 即使是空巢青年，即使要赶着上班，早晨出门前也能喝碗热腾腾的稀饭。
description_en: Even empty nesters, even if they have to rush to work, can still drink a bowl of hot porridge before going out in the morning.
tips_zh:
当然最后一步也可以不加牛奶直接加水，没有牛奶味的稀饭是谷物原香也很滋润的。
锅胆座入电饭煲合盖，利用预约功能设置好第二天一早的开饭时间，就可以放心地睡觉，然后起床上班前就能享用热气腾腾的非常滋润的小米稀饭了。
我自己喝前喜欢加一点糖，当然有人就喜欢原香。
tips_en:
Of course, you can also add water directly in the last step without adding milk. The porridge without milk flavor has the original flavor of grain and is very moist.
Put the pot into the rice cooker and close the lid. Use the reservation function to set the meal time for the next morning. Then you can sleep peacefully and enjoy the steaming and very moist millet porridge before getting up to go to work.
I like to add a little sugar before drinking it, but of course some people like the original flavor.

steps.content_zh: 用量杯盛1/2杯小米，根据个人口味和家里储备可以添加少许绿豆、大米，或者其他豆子、麦仁等等。
steps.content_en: Use a measuring cup to hold 1/2 cup of millet. You can add a little mung beans, rice, or other beans, wheat kernels, etc. according to your personal taste and household reserves.

steps.content_zh: 准备1包牛奶。其实加上牛奶有牛奶口味，感觉蛮不错；不加牛奶也就是一碗普通的稀饭，也很不错。
steps.content_en: Prepare 1 packet of milk. In fact, with the addition of milk, it tastes like milk, which feels pretty good; without the addition of milk, it is just a bowl of ordinary porridge, which is also very good.

steps.content_zh: 小米和添加的一些辅料在碗中淘洗干净，我一般淘两次，都沥掉水。
steps.content_en: Wash the millet and some added accessories in a bowl. I usually wash it twice and drain off the water.

steps.content_zh: 小米倒进锅胆里，有水是我用来冲掉碗边的米粒的。
steps.content_en: Pour the millet into the pot, and use the water to wash away the rice grains on the edge of the bowl.

steps.content_zh: 倒进1袋牛奶，然后加水至合适水位线。因为是煮稀饭，我个人偏好稀稠适中的，所以1/2杯的米加水至稠的这边½水位线处。后续可以根据需求量和个人口感微调。
steps.content_en: Pour in one bag of milk, then add water to the appropriate water line. Since this is thin porridge and I prefer a medium consistency, I use 1/2 cup of rice with water up to the thick-porridge ½ line. Adjust later to taste and quantity.

steps.content_zh: 完成后即可享用哦。
steps.content_en: Enjoy when finished.

description_zh: 说起冬阴功大家一定很熟悉，但是今天的这款冬阴功汤你一定没喝过。首先这款汤是清汤并不是常见的红红的冬阴功汤，它的精髓在于煲汤底，用虾头和各种泰式香料慢煮出味，然后放入虾仁和蘑菇，用柠檬、鱼露、汤调味。酸、辣、鲜、香、甜，回口甘醇，而且并不油腻。
description_en: Everyone knows tom yum, but you haven't tasted this version. It's a clear broth, not the usual red one. The secret is the base: simmer shrimp heads with Thai spices, then add shrimp and mushrooms, and season with lemon, fish sauce and sugar. Sour, spicy, savory, aromatic and sweet, with a mellow finish—and not greasy.
tips_zh: 提示：除了虾之外当然也可以加入其它的海鲜类和蔬菜。
tips_en: Tip: Besides shrimp, other seafood and vegetables work too.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾洗净后去头、小干葱切块、香茅草拍软后切段、朝天椒切圈、香菜梗切段、南姜去皮切片、柠檬叶在手中揉搓出味。
steps.content_en: Wash the fresh shrimp and remove the heads; cut the shallots into pieces, crush the lemongrass and cut into sections, cut the bird's eye chilies into rings, cut the cilantro stems into sections, peel and slice the galangal, and rub the kaffir lime leaves between your hands to release their aroma.

steps.content_zh: 将上一步准备好的原料放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，开始煲汤底。
