steps.content_en: Put the ingredients prepared in the previous step into the pot, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1 mark, and start cooking the soup base.

steps.content_zh: 煲汤的同时蘑菇切块，虾尾去壳开背。
steps.content_en: While the soup is simmering, cut the mushrooms into cubes and remove the shells from the shrimp tails.

steps.content_zh: 约煮了40分钟，放入处理好的虾仁和蘑菇，继续煮20分钟。
steps.content_en: After cooking for about 40 minutes, add the processed shrimps and mushrooms and continue cooking for 20 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 最后放入豆芽焖熟即可。放入鱼露、糖、青柠檬调味，出锅后撒上香菜。
steps.content_en: Finally, add the bean sprouts and simmer until cooked. Season with fish sauce, sugar, and lime, then sprinkle with cilantro before serving.

description_zh: 椰汁鸡汤（Tom Kha Gai）为曼谷的一道名菜，与冬阴功齐名。在泰文中，Tom用在菜名中，表示汤；Kha指的是南姜；Gai就是鸡了，跟粤语“鸡”的发音很相似。由椰奶为汤底，加入鸡肉由浓郁的黄姜、香茅及柠檬叶香气提味，有点微酸，但是口感清爽顺口，十分美味。
description_en: Tom Kha Gai (coconut milk chicken soup) is a famous Bangkok dish, on par with tom yum. In Thai, 'Tom' in a dish name means soup, 'Kha' refers to galangal, and 'Gai' is chicken—similar to the Cantonese word for chicken. With a coconut milk base, chicken is flavored by the rich aromas of turmeric, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves; slightly sour but light and smooth, it's truly delicious.
tips_zh: 南姜、青柠叶和香茅算是金三角组合了，泰国菜中（尤其是汤类）很多时候都要同时用到三者，例如冬阴功。这些材料相当重要，基本上是带来了这道汤的灵魂，所以不能用其他材料代替。
tips_en: Galangal, kaffir lime leaves and lemongrass form a golden trio in Thai cooking—especially in soups like tom yum. They're essential, giving the soup its very soul, so no substitutions.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将鸡肉切片用鱼露提前腌渍备用。
steps.content_en: Marinate the chicken slices in fish sauce in advance and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 青柠叶用手揉搓出味，香茅去头，去下部分拍松切段，南姜去皮切片。
steps.content_en: Rub the lime leaves with your hands to extract the flavor, remove the heads of the lemongrass, pat the lower part to loosen and cut into sections, peel and slice the galangal.

steps.content_zh: 锅中放入300毫升的浓缩椰汁后加水到水位线：稠粥¾的刻度，点击手机开始图标，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour 300 ml of coconut milk into the pot, add water up to the water level line: the thick porridge ¾ mark, then tap Start on the phone to begin cooking.

steps.content_zh: 处理菌菇。
steps.content_en: Handle mushrooms.

steps.content_zh: 40分钟后汤底煲好，放入腌渍好的鸡肉和菌菇，继续煮。
steps.content_en: After 40 minutes, the soup base is ready. Add the marinated chicken and mushrooms and continue cooking.

steps.content_zh: 出锅前用鱼露、糖调味，放入切开的樱桃番茄，挤入柠檬汁就能享用啦。
steps.content_en: Season with fish sauce and sugar before serving, add sliced ​​cherry tomatoes, squeeze in lemon juice and enjoy.

description_zh: 念念不忘张艾嘉主演的《海南鸡饭》，普通的食材仿佛被赋予了生命，奈何白切鸡和鸡油饭做起来要耗费很长的时间。所以这道香茅鸡肉饭就诞生了，把鸡肉和米饭一起煮，混合着南姜、香茅的香味，小干葱的香甜，鸡肉Q弹不柴，泰国香米固有的茉莉香，令人食指大动！
description_en: I cannot forget Hainan Chicken Rice starring Sylvia Chang—ordinary ingredients seem to come alive, but poached chicken and chicken fat rice take forever. So this lemongrass chicken rice was born: chicken and rice cooked together with galangal, lemongrass and shallot, springy tender chicken, the jasmine fragrance of Thai rice—irresistible.
tips_zh: 香茅是这道焖饭的灵魂，不可缺少！泰国香米不用洗，直接炒香，不然后影响香味和口感！
tips_en: Lemongrass is the soul of this braised rice—indispensable! Don't wash the Thai jasmine rice; stir-fry it directly to bring out its aroma, otherwise the flavor and texture will suffer!

steps.content_zh: 食材
steps.content_en: Ingredients

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿洗净，切块后用盐腌渍待用；香茅拍松后打结，小干葱切丝，南姜去皮切片。
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken thigh, cut into chunks, and marinate with salt; crush the lemongrass and tie in a knot, shred the shallots, and peel and slice the galangal.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅中放油烧热，将香料炒香，香茅炒软。
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a pan, stir-fry the spices until fragrant and the lemongrass until soft.

steps.content_zh: 放入鸡腿，煎上色后取出。
steps.content_en: Add chicken legs, fry until browned and take out.

steps.content_zh: 倒入泰国香米小火翻炒。
steps.content_en: Pour in the Thai fragrant rice and stir-fry over low heat.

steps.content_zh: 大米炒到发白后倒入杂蔬菜，稍微炒一会即可。
steps.content_en: Stir-fry the rice until it turns white, then add the mixed vegetables and stir-fry for a while.

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的泰国香米倒入锅中，水加到水位线：丝苗米2的刻度，放入煎好的鸡块，用盐、鸡汁调味后点击开始烹饪图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour the fried Thai fragrant rice into the pot, add water to the water level line: Silk Rice 2 mark, add the fried chicken pieces, season with salt and chicken juice, and click the start cooking icon to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

steps.content_zh: 取出香茅和南姜，享用吧！
steps.content_en: Remove the lemongrass and galangal and enjoy!

description_zh: 若是你眼里有彩虹，怎么会被灰暗淹没？若是你心中有欢笑，怎么会被泪水冲决？若是，你饿了，心情糟糕了，我就煮一碗五彩饭给你吃！
description_en: If there's a rainbow in your eyes, how could gloom overwhelm you? If there's laughter in your heart, how could tears wash it away? And if you're hungry and feeling down, I'll cook you a bowl of colorful rice!
tips_zh:
1 粗粮类包括豆类和薯类，其和大米是辅主的关系，所以每种都不要太多

2 这道五彩饭不用蒸好米饭后再与其他食材混合，而是直接一锅蒸制，省时省力

3 因为玉米、豌豆、紫薯、山药、胡萝卜均有出水，所以加水量一定要控制好

4 淘洗大米时不要反复搓洗，正确的方法是在水里搅动大米，使用专门的淘米器效果更佳

5 蒸好的米饭不要马上开盖，而是焖15分钟后再食用，这是为了让锅底的米粒充分吸收饭里面的水分，而不会产生沾锅底的问题

6 花树使用的大米是东北米，如果使用丝苗米，请按照丝苗米的水位线酌情改变加水量

7 除了花树加的这些粗粮，还可以加入芋头、红薯、南瓜等食材，创意不拘一格，又好吃又有营养就是硬道理。
tips_en:
1. Whole grains include beans and tubers; they complement rice rather than replace it, so don't add too much of each.

2. This colorful rice is steamed in one pot—no need to cook the rice first and mix it later; it saves time and effort.

3. Corn, peas, purple sweet potato, Chinese yam, and carrots all release water, so control the amount of water you add.

4. Don't scrub the rice when rinsing; just swirl it in water—a rice washer works even better.

5. Don't open the lid right away; let the rice rest for 15 minutes before serving so the bottom grains absorb the moisture and don't stick to the pot.

6. Huashu used Northeast rice; if using Si Miao rice, adjust the water according to its water-level line.

7. Besides these grains, you can add taro, sweet potato, or pumpkin—get creative; tasty and nutritious is all that matters.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将紫薯、山药、胡萝卜分别去皮洗净切小丁备用。
steps.content_en: Peel the purple sweet potato, yam, and carrot respectively, wash and cut into small cubes and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 大米淘洗干净后再浸泡20-30分钟备用，水果玉米和豌豆分别洗净控干水分备用
steps.content_en: Rinse the rice and soak it for 20-30 minutes before use. Wash the fruits, corn and peas separately and dry them before use.

steps.content_zh: 饭煲内先加入浸泡好的大米，然后加水，因为所搭配的粗粮类均会出水，所以，要加少于两杯米所需的水量，如图所示。
steps.content_en: First add the soaked rice to the cooker, then add water. Since the mixed grains release water, use less water than needed for two cups of rice, as shown.

steps.content_zh: 然后把所有粗粮类铺到大米上方。选择精煮开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Then spread all the whole grains on top of the rice. Select Concentrate to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 将蒸好的五彩饭搅拌均匀即可盛出食用。
steps.content_en: Stir the steamed colorful rice evenly and serve.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 一直都大爱卤鸡腿，满满的都是肉，闻着香，吃着也够味。用来做便当的话加点蔬菜就可以啦~完胜街边拍档的卤鸡腿，不仅集合了各种香料的风味，味道层次非常丰富，做法却非常简单。超适合懒宝宝们哦。
description_en: I love braised chicken legs—so much meat, fragrant aroma and rich flavor. Add vegetables for a bento and it beats any street-stall version. A blend of spices gives wonderfully layered flavor, yet the method is very simple. Perfect for lazy cooks.
tips_zh: 卤水可以放凉后放入冰箱中冷藏，下次可继续使用。
tips_en: The brine can be cooled down and then placed in the refrigerator to be refrigerated and can be used again next time.

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿洗净焯水、焯好用冷水冲洗一下。
steps.content_en: Wash and blanch the chicken legs, then rinse them with cold water.

steps.content_zh: 准备好所有的香料。
steps.content_en: Get all the spices ready.

steps.content_zh: 将鸡腿放入电饭煲中，放入香料，倒入水刚好没过鸡腿的样子。
steps.content_en: Put the chicken legs into the rice cooker, add the spices, and pour in water just enough to cover the chicken legs.

steps.content_zh: 加入料酒，冰糖，生抽，老抽，盐等调料。
steps.content_en: Add cooking wine, rock sugar, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, salt and other seasonings.

steps.content_zh: 煮60分钟即可，煮好可放电饭煲里过夜，这样会更入味。
steps.content_en: Cook for 60 minutes. After cooking, you can put it in the rice cooker overnight to make it more delicious.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 小米是易消化的食品，对胃不好的人尤其好，用来做蛋糕不仅口感软绵、香味诱人，而且营养丰富，宝宝们肯定会超级爱吃！
description_en: Millet is an easy-to-digest food, especially good for people with weak stomachs. When used to make cakes, it not only tastes soft and has an attractive aroma, but is also rich in nutrients. Babies will definitely love it!
tips_zh: 食材中没有加任何面粉（小麦粉），所以小麦过敏的宝宝也可以食用。
tips_en: No flour (wheat) is added, so babies with wheat allergies can eat it too.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 小米洗净后浸泡一夜充分吸收水分。
steps.content_en: Wash the millet and soak it overnight to fully absorb moisture.

steps.content_zh: 泡好的小米滤干水分。
steps.content_en: Drain the soaked millet and drain the water.

steps.content_zh: 将小米放入料理机中，加入4个蛋黄、玉米油，打成小米浆。
steps.content_en: Put the millet into a food processor, add 4 egg yolks, corn oil, and beat into millet slurry.

steps.content_zh: 蛋清用电动打蛋器打发，过程中分三次放入细砂糖。直到出现直立的小角。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer, adding caster sugar in three batches until upright peaks form.

steps.content_zh: 将小米浆缓缓倒入蛋白霜中，不规则翻拌到均匀。
steps.content_en: Slowly pour the millet slurry into the meringue and mix irregularly until even.

steps.content_zh: 将米糊倒入锅胆中，轻轻磕几下去除表面气泡，点击开始烹饪图标进行烘焙。
steps.content_en: Pour the rice paste into the pot, tap it gently a few times to remove surface bubbles, and click the start cooking icon to start baking.

steps.content_zh: 烘焙完成后取出，自然冷却。
steps.content_en: After baking is completed, take it out and let it cool naturally.

steps.content_zh: 酸奶与蜂蜜混合，涂抹在蛋糕上，用水果装饰即可。
steps.content_en: Mix yogurt with honey, spread over the cake and decorate with fruit.

description_zh: 核桃饭的想法是来自《小森林》夏秋篇，将核桃捣碎，和调味料一起加入大米中，烹煮时满屋子都是核桃的香气。煮好的米饭带着核桃风味，吃起来也会有一种吃坚果的满足感。而且这个饭不仅热食好吃，也适合冷食，捏成饭团当便当或带出门野餐。《小森林》里的市子就是捏成成饭团做了便当。
description_en: The idea for walnut rice comes from 'Little Forest' (Summer/Autumn). Crush the walnuts and add them with seasonings to the rice; as it cooks, the whole house fills with walnut aroma. The cooked rice carries a walnut flavor and gives the satisfaction of eating nuts. It's delicious hot and also good cold—shaped into rice balls for a bento or taken on a picnic. In 'Little Forest,' Ichiko made rice balls for her bento.

steps.content_zh: 准备好所需要使用的食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 核桃用研钵捣碎，只要捣至比米粒大一些的颗粒，不需要捣成末。
steps.content_en: Crush the walnuts in a mortar and pestle until the particles are larger than rice grains. There is no need to pound the walnuts into powder.

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净，水的份量比平时煮饭稍微少放一点。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and add a little less water than usual when cooking rice.

steps.content_zh: 将捣碎的核桃以及生抽、橄榄油、白胡椒加入大米中，稍稍搅拌均匀。点击开始烹饪图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add the mashed walnuts, light soy sauce, olive oil, and white pepper to the rice and stir evenly. Click on the start cooking icon to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成啦。
steps.content_en: Done.

steps.content_zh: 趁热配个小菜就很好吃啦。
steps.content_en: It's delicious when served hot with a side dish.

steps.content_zh: 或者捏成饭团做便当，冷食味道依然不错。
steps.content_en: Or shape it into rice balls and make a bento. It still tastes good when eaten cold.

description_zh: 咖啡味的蛋糕胚，加上奶油和巧克力。简直是节日里的颜值担当！
description_en: Coffee-flavored sponge with cream and chocolate—the star of any holiday table!
tips_zh: 天生不会抹奶油，O(∩_∩)O哈哈~
tips_en: I’m born not to put on cream, O(∩_∩)O haha~

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕胚的原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients for the cake base.

steps.content_zh: 蛋白与蛋黄分离、蛋黄中加入60克玉米油、20克细砂糖和浓缩咖啡，搅拌均匀后筛入面粉与可可粉，搅拌成无颗粒的面糊。装蛋清的容器要无水、无油的干净状态。
steps.content_en: Separate the egg whites from the egg yolks, add 60 grams of corn oil, 20 grams of fine sugar and espresso to the egg yolks, stir evenly, sift in the flour and cocoa powder, and stir into a particle-free batter. The container containing egg whites should be clean and free of water and oil.

steps.content_zh: 蛋清用电动打蛋器打发，打发过程中分三次放入60克糖，打成干性发泡的状态。（有直立不弯曲的角）。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric egg beater. During the beating process, add 60 grams of sugar in three batches and beat into dry peaks. (Has upright, unbent corners).

steps.content_zh: 将面糊与蛋白霜混合，切拌均匀后倒入饭煲中。
steps.content_en: Mix the batter and meringue, mix well and pour into the rice cooker.

steps.content_zh: 锅胆轻轻磕几下，去除表面的气泡。然后就选择蛋糕模式60分钟，开始烘焙吧。
steps.content_en: Tap the pan gently a few times to remove air bubbles on the surface. Then select cake mode for 60 minutes and start baking.

steps.content_zh: 淡奶油中一次性加入绵白糖、倒入香草精油、咖啡酒，打发到7成左右有纹路可稍微流动的状态。
steps.content_en: Add caster sugar, vanilla extract, and coffee liqueur to the cream all at once, and whip to about soft peaks with visible traces that still flow slightly.

steps.content_zh: 将蛋糕横切3片，每两片中挤入奶油最上层用巧克力装饰。
steps.content_en: Cut the cake into 3 slices, pipe cream on top of each slice and decorate with chocolate.

steps.content_zh: 美美哒。
steps.content_en: Beautiful.

description_zh: 一块腊肉、一个土豆，一份米饭，晚餐就OK啦！
description_en: A piece of bacon, a potato, and a portion of rice, dinner is ready!
tips_zh: “三高”人士请自觉少油少盐！
tips_en: People with "three highs" please consciously consume less oil and less salt!

steps.content_zh: 将腊肉切成2cm大块状
steps.content_en: Cut bacon into 2cm chunks

steps.content_zh: 土豆切成条状
steps.content_en: Potatoes cut into strips

steps.content_zh: 香菇切条
steps.content_en: Cut shiitake mushrooms into strips

steps.content_zh: 葱花
steps.content_en: Chopped scallion

steps.content_zh: 加少许花生油，将上述材料翻炒，添些生抽（生抽略平时炒菜要多放点）
steps.content_en: Add a little peanut oil, stir-fry the above ingredients, and add some light soy sauce (you should add more light soy sauce when cooking)

steps.content_zh: 将菜放进已淘洗好的米锅内
steps.content_en: Put the vegetables into the washed rice pot

steps.content_zh: 选择精煮键，60分钟后就出锅了，味道超级好哦😍
steps.content_en: Press the 'precise cook' button; it's ready in 60 minutes and tastes amazing 😍

description_zh:
坚持做美食，我所有朴素的愿望都是：“尽心去做，不负人生。”
我做的食物真的都很平凡，它们就像我自己的写照。但，每一份平凡食物的背后也都装进了我的真心——比如，这朴素而又健康的藜麦饭。
description_en:
I keep cooking because of my simple wish: 'Put your heart into it and live up to life.'
The food I make is truly ordinary—much like me. But behind every ordinary dish goes my sincere heart—like this humble, wholesome quinoa rice.
tips_zh: 藜麦和大米的组合所有的人群都可食用哦。
tips_en: The combination of quinoa and rice is suitable for everyone.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将大米和藜麦清洗干净后泡半小时。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and quinoa and soak them for half an hour.

steps.content_zh: 紫薯去皮洗净切丁备用。
steps.content_en: Peel, wash and dice the purple sweet potato; set aside.

steps.content_zh: 电饭煲内先加入大米、藜麦，再按照两杯大米的水位线加入适量清水，选择精煮键煮饭，同时将紫薯放在蒸架上一起蒸。（压力IH饭煲可在其他的锅具中蒸熟）
steps.content_en: Add the rice and quinoa to the cooker, then add water to the 2-cup rice level and select the regular cook setting; steam the purple sweet potatoes on the rack at the same time. (With a pressure IH model, steam them in a separate pot.)

steps.content_zh: 蒸熟的藜麦饭就是这样滴。
steps.content_en: This is how steamed quinoa rice drips.

steps.content_zh: 取一份藜麦饭和蒸熟的紫薯混合均匀，先摆出八卦的一部分，再用纯藜麦饭摆出另一部分，最后取两种不同饭捏成圆形“点睛”，这极其朴素的太极饭就完成了。
steps.content_en: Take a portion of quinoa rice and steamed purple sweet potatoes and mix them evenly. First place one part of the Bagua, and then use pure quinoa rice to place the other part. Finally, take two different kinds of rice and shape them into a round shape for "the finishing touch". This extremely simple Tai Chi rice is completed.

name_en: Goji Berry and Sweet Potato Brown Rice
description_zh: 糙米，由于内保护皮层没有受到破坏，含有粗纤维、糠蜡等，与普通精致白米相比，糙米的瘦身效果显著。糙米中含有的维他命、矿物质等含量比精致白米要丰富，越来越受到人们的欢迎，是一种绿色的健康食品。
description_en: Brown rice, because the inner protective cortex has not been damaged, contains crude fiber, bran wax, etc. Compared with ordinary refined white rice, brown rice has a significant slimming effect. Brown rice contains more vitamins, minerals and other contents than refined white rice, and is becoming more and more popular among people. It is a green and healthy food.
tips_zh:
1、糙米提前浸泡半小时，口感好。
2、这个食材搭配，有助于消化和减肥。
tips_en:
1. Soak brown rice for half an hour in advance to make it taste better.
2. This combination of ingredients helps digestion and weight loss.

steps.content_zh: 备原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare raw materials.

steps.content_zh: 把糙米、枸杞、鸭田米洗净。
steps.content_en: Wash the brown rice, wolfberry, and duck rice.

steps.content_zh: 红薯去皮切丁。
steps.content_en: Peel and dice the sweet potatoes.

steps.content_zh: 把淘洗好的鸭田米、糙米放入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米1的位置，放入红薯和枸杞后点击手机开始烹饪图标，进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the washed duck field rice and brown rice into the pot, add water to the water level line: Northeast rice 1, add sweet potatoes and wolfberries, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 洋葱、蒜头、蔬菜、香料去炖煮，过程中加入少量的水，料理完成的红酒炖牛肉，不仅风味非常浓郁可口、层次丰富；而且入口即化、不油不腻，搭配美味的马铃薯泥，再来一杯法国勃根地红酒，哇！什么是人间美味，这不就是了吗？
description_en: Stew onions, garlic, vegetables and spices, adding a small amount of water during the process. The finished red wine braised beef is not only very rich, delicious and rich in flavor, but also melts in the mouth, not greasy and not greasy. Pair it with delicious mashed potatoes and a glass of French Burgundy red wine, wow! What is the delicacy of the world? Isn’t this it?
tips_zh:
吃完牛肉剩余下的汤汁用来烩意大利面也是个不错的选择哦。
如果没有迷迭香可在超市中购买混合香草。
tips_en:
The leftover beef broth also makes a great pasta sauce.
If you don't have rosemary, buy a mixed herb blend at the supermarket.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 西芹、洋葱、胡萝卜洗净后切块，大蒜去皮。
steps.content_en: Wash and cut celery, onions, and carrots into cubes, and peel garlic.

steps.content_zh: 牛肉洗净后用盐、黑胡椒码味在煎锅中煎上色后取出待用。
steps.content_en: Rinse the beef, season with salt and black pepper, sear in a pan until browned, then remove and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 各种蔬菜在煎锅中炒香，倒入番茄酱和迷迭香，翻炒均匀。
steps.content_en: Saute various vegetables in a frying pan until fragrant, add tomato paste and rosemary, and stir-fry evenly.

steps.content_zh: 将煎好的牛肉和蔬菜同时放入锅中，倒入红酒和清水，点击手机图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the fried beef and vegetables into the pot at the same time, pour in red wine and water, and click the phone icon to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪过程中适当开盖1-2次搅拌，剩余20分钟时，饭煲会自动调节成大火收汁。
steps.content_en: During cooking, open the lid 1-2 times to stir. With 20 minutes left, the cooker automatically switches to high heat to reduce the sauce.

steps.content_zh: 完成后用盐、黑胡椒和糖调味。
steps.content_en: Season with salt, black pepper and sugar when done.

description_zh: 咋眼一看，你绝对想不到这些不起眼的木头居然是美味的蛋糕~所以说，人们的智慧总是无限的！圣诞节将近，如果你也想要做出一个与众不同的圣诞甜品？不如试试这款另辟蹊径的树桩蛋糕吧！
description_en: At first glance, you would never guess that these inconspicuous pieces of wood are actually delicious cakes ~ So, people’s wisdom is always infinite! Christmas is approaching, if you want to make a unique Christmas dessert? Why not try this unique tree stump cake!
tips_zh: 黄油不能直接用火融化，要软化不融的状态。
tips_en: Butter cannot be melted directly with fire, it must be softened but not melted.

steps.content_zh: 可可蛋糕胚原料。
steps.content_en: Cocoa cake embryo raw material.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄与蛋清分离，装蛋清的容器一定要无水、无油、无蛋黄，这样才能打发。
steps.content_en: Separate the yolks from the whites; the bowl for the whites must be dry, oil-free and free of yolk so they whip properly.

steps.content_zh: 用电动打蛋器将蛋清打至鱼眼泡状，放入20克糖，继续高速搅拌。
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until fish-eye bubbles form, add 20 g sugar, and continue beating on high speed.

steps.content_zh: 打至海绵泡泡时，继续放入20克糖高速搅拌。
steps.content_en: When the sponge is foamy, continue to add 20 grams of sugar and mix at high speed.

steps.content_zh: 打至有纹路出现时放入20克糖，继续搅拌至拉起时出现直立、不弯曲的小角即可。
steps.content_en: Beat until texture appears, add 20 grams of sugar, and continue stirring until straight, unbent corners appear when pulled up.

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中加入玉米油、10克糖、50克牛奶加班均匀后筛入低筋粉和可可粉，（面粉类一定要过筛不然有颗粒）
steps.content_en: Add corn oil, 10 g sugar and 50 g milk to the yolk, mix well, then sift in low-gluten flour and cocoa powder (always sift flours to avoid lumps).

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀后与蛋清分三次混合，不规则搅拌均匀。完成后倒入锅胆中，轻轻磕几下去除表面气泡，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烘焙。
steps.content_en: Mix well, fold into the egg whites in three additions, stirring irregularly. Pour into the inner pot, tap a few times to remove bubbles, then tap Start Cooking on the phone to bake.

steps.content_zh: 烘焙蛋糕的时候，准备榛子巧克力糖霜。黄油自然软化后与其它的原料用电动打蛋器打至顺滑的状态。
steps.content_en: While the cake bakes, prepare the hazelnut chocolate frosting. Let the butter soften, then beat it with the other ingredients using an electric mixer until smooth.

steps.content_zh: 戚风蛋糕烘焙完成后，倒扣取出，完全冷却后切成两片。在一面上抹上榛子巧克力糖霜，将另一片盖上，继续涂抹，并在周围涂抹均匀。
steps.content_en: After the chiffon cake is baked, turn it upside down and take it out, cool completely and cut into two pieces. Spread hazelnut chocolate frosting on one side, cover with the other piece, and continue spreading, spreading evenly around.

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕周围用巧克力酱抹上后用叉子划出树皮纹路、顶部划出年轮。最后用糖人和水果装饰，再撒上糖粉就完成啦。
steps.content_en: Spread chocolate sauce around the cake and use a fork to mark bark lines and growth rings on the top. Finally, decorate with candies and fruits, then sprinkle with powdered sugar and it's done.

description_zh: 北方的孩子出门总是念念不忘家乡的味道，这时候就该来一碗热腾腾的面，豆角、土豆和面条包裹着浓郁的汤汁，然后被锅“焖”在怀里。
description_en: Children in the north always miss the taste of their hometown when they go out. At this time, it is time to have a bowl of hot noodles. Beans, potatoes and noodles are wrapped in rich soup, and then "simmered" in the arms of the pot.
tips_zh: 动手能力强的同学可以自己擀面，焖面软硬还取决于汤汁量可以自己多做几次掌握。
tips_en: Students with strong hands-on skills can roll the noodles by themselves. The softness and hardness of the braised noodles depends on the amount of soup. You can master it by yourself by doing it several times.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 现将手擀面用食用油拌匀，这样焖面的时候不会黏在一起。
steps.content_en: First toss the hand-rolled noodles with cooking oil so they won't stick together while braising.

steps.content_zh: 土豆去皮切块、豆角切段、五花肉切成片，生姜切末。
steps.content_en: Peel and cut the potatoes into cubes, cut the beans into sections, cut the pork belly into slices, and mince the ginger.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热后放油，烧热后将土豆和豆角煸炒出香味后取出待用。
steps.content_en: Heat the wok, add oil, stir-fry the potatoes and beans until fragrant, then take them out and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 锅中留油，将切好的五花肉、八角和生姜放入锅中煸炒香。
steps.content_en: Keep a little oil in the pot and stir-fry the sliced pork belly, star anise and ginger until fragrant.

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的土豆和豆角倒回锅中，加入生抽、老抽和适量的盐调味，加入水稍稍没过食材煮开即可。
steps.content_en: Return the fried potatoes and beans to the pot, add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and an appropriate amount of salt to taste, add water to slightly cover the ingredients and bring to a boil.

steps.content_zh: 将上一步的食物倒入锅中，留一些汤汁。面条放入锅中，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour the food from the previous step into the pot, leaving some soup. Put the noodles into the pot and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时倒入留出的汤汁，用筷子搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: When 5 minutes of cooking time remain, pour in the reserved soup and stir evenly with chopsticks.

steps.content_zh: 完成后可放入蒜泥、香醋搭配食用哦。
steps.content_en: When finished, you can add minced garlic and balsamic vinegar and eat together.

description_zh: 德国黑薯，也是紫薯的一种，是紫红薯类食物中营养含量最佳之一，除了具有普通红薯的营养成分外，还富含硒元素和花青素，肉质细腻，香甜可口。和有机鸭田粥米一起炖煮，粥品细腻爽滑，粘稠绵密。
description_en: German black sweet potato is a purple variety, among the most nutritious of its kind. Besides the usual sweet potato nutrients, it is rich in selenium and anthocyanins, with a fine, sweet taste. Stewed with organic duck-field rice, the porridge turns smooth, thick and creamy.
tips_zh:
1、粥米是细碎的米，炖煮时间短，更加节省时间。
2、如果黑薯切小粒，也可以在粥米开锅后再放入。
3、常吃此粥，可保护视力、预防眼疾、缓解疲劳。
tips_en:
1. Porridge rice is finely crushed rice, and the stewing time is short, which saves time.
2. If the black potato is cut into small pieces, you can also add it after the porridge and rice are boiled.
3. Eating this porridge regularly can protect eyesight, prevent eye diseases and relieve fatigue.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将有机鸭田粥米淘洗干净。
steps.content_en: Wash the organic duck field porridge rice thoroughly.

steps.content_zh: 黑薯去皮切滚刀块。
steps.content_en: Peel the black sweet potato and cut into roll-cut chunks.

steps.content_zh: 将粥米和黑薯块放入米家电饭煲中，加适量纯净水，启动煮粥程序。
steps.content_en: Put the porridge rice and black potato pieces into the Mijia rice cooker, add an appropriate amount of purified water, and start the porridge cooking process.

steps.content_zh: 煮好的黑薯粥细腻爽滑，粘稠绵密。
steps.content_en: The finished purple sweet potato porridge is smooth, silky, thick, and creamy.

description_zh:
鸡翅香而不腻，青椒鲜而脆嫩。
晚饭并不太适合吃排骨这样较肥腻的食物，因此选择了鸡翅这种清淡些的食材。并且加入青椒，使口感倍加清爽。
当然了，晚上还是以八分饱为宜，虽然我也吃撑了！
description_en:
Chicken wings are fragrant but not greasy, and green peppers are fresh and crisp.
Spare ribs are too rich for dinner, so I chose lighter chicken wings instead. Adding green peppers makes it even more refreshing.
Of course, it's best to eat only until 80% full at night—though I ended up stuffing myself too!
tips_zh:
调料可以根据个人口味自行调整，建议清淡口味为宜。
也可加入孜然，即为孜然青丝鸡翅饭。
tips_en:
The seasoning can be adjusted according to personal taste, and a lighter taste is recommended.
Cumin can also be added to make cumin green shredded chicken wing rice.

steps.content_zh: 准备4-6个鸡翅中，清洗干净。
steps.content_en: Prepare 4-6 chicken wings and clean them.

steps.content_zh: 将土豆切块，娃娃菜切丝，备用。
steps.content_en: Cut the potatoes into cubes and shred the baby cabbage and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 将青椒切成丝，备用。准备适量葱花，备用。
steps.content_en: Cut the green pepper into shreds and set aside. Prepare appropriate amount of chopped green onions and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 将淘好的米放入厚釜中，加入适量的水，泡好。
steps.content_en: Put the washed rice into a thick cauldron, add an appropriate amount of water, and soak well.

steps.content_zh: 在炒锅中放入适量的食用油，加热后放入鸡翅，土豆块，生抽和料酒，进行翻炒，并加入调料。翻炒均匀后出锅。注意不可炒干。
steps.content_en: Heat some oil in a wok, add the chicken wings, potato chunks, light soy sauce and cooking wine, stir-fry and add the seasonings. Stir-fry evenly and remove from heat—don't let it dry out.

steps.content_zh:
.娃娃菜可以根据个人口味添加。本人制作时加入娃娃菜主要是为了增加女儿青菜的摄入量。
加入后轻轻翻炒，即可出锅。
steps.content_en: Baby napa cabbage can be added to taste. I added it mainly to get my daughter to eat more greens. Add and stir-fry gently, then serve.

steps.content_zh: 将出锅的食材加入至泡好米的锅中，尽量让汤没过全部食材。
steps.content_en: Add the cooked ingredients into the pot where the rice has been soaked, and try to make sure the soup covers all the ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 启动精煮模式，去欣赏节目吧，记得用小米盒子哦！如果做一下体感运动，还能多吃些饭呢！
steps.content_en: Start the Fine Cook mode and go enjoy a show—don't forget your Mi Box! A little motion gaming and you'll work up an appetite for more rice!

steps.content_zh: 米饭煮好后开盖加入青椒和葱花，拌匀，保温3分钟。
steps.content_en: When the rice is done, open the lid, add green pepper and chopped scallions, mix well and keep warm for 3 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 9.好看又美味的青丝鸡翅饭完美出锅！
steps.content_en: 9. The beautiful and delicious green silk chicken wings rice is cooked perfectly!

steps.content_zh: 成品展示。
steps.content_en: Finished product display.

description_zh:
南瓜是日常生活中非常常见的食材之一，似乎一年四季都有。它色泽金黄，味道香甜，而且营养还特别丰富。南瓜富含维生素B、维生素C和钙、淀粉、蛋白质、胡萝卜素、磷等成分，常吃南瓜，可使大便通畅，肌肤丰美，尤其对女性，有美容作用。
在这道极为普通的南瓜饭里加点培根，味道顿时提升不少，偶尔咀嚼到一块，腊香溢满口，忍不住要多吃几碗哈
description_en:
Pumpkin is one of the most common ingredients in daily life and seems to be available all year round. It is golden in color, sweet in taste, and extremely nutritious. Pumpkin is rich in vitamin B, vitamin C, calcium, starch, protein, carotene, phosphorus and other ingredients. Regular consumption of pumpkin can make the stool smooth and the skin plump, especially for women, it has a beauty effect.
Add some bacon to this very ordinary pumpkin rice, and the taste immediately improves a lot. Occasionally, I chew a piece, and the bacon aroma fills my mouth. I can't help but eat a few more bowls.
tips_zh:
1、如果没有培根，可以换成香肠、腊肉也不错
2、饭的软硬可按照自己喜欢来添加水量
3、葱花要最后加入，这样香味更浓些
tips_en:
1. No bacon? Sausage or cured pork works too.
2. Adjust the water for softer or firmer rice to taste.
3. Add the chopped scallions last for a stronger aroma.

steps.content_zh: 备好所需食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 南瓜去皮切小块，培根一样切小块。
steps.content_en: Peel the pumpkin and cut into small pieces, and cut the bacon into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 锅中倒适量油，将培根煸炒2分钟，倒入生抽继续煸炒片刻。
steps.content_en: Pour an appropriate amount of oil into the pot, stir-fry the bacon for 2 minutes, add the light soy sauce and continue to stir-fry for a while.

steps.content_zh: 放入南瓜，同时调入盐和白胡椒粉翻炒均匀。
steps.content_en: Add the pumpkin, add salt and white pepper and stir-fry evenly.

steps.content_zh: 倒入洗净的大米，翻炒2分钟关火。
steps.content_en: Pour in the washed rice, stir-fry for 2 minutes and turn off the heat.

steps.content_zh: 将锅中处理好的食材和水倒入电饭锅内胆中，开启快煮功能进行烹饪，结束程序后再保温15分钟即可。
steps.content_en: Pour the processed ingredients and water into the rice cooker, turn on the quick cooking function to cook, and then keep warm for 15 minutes after finishing the program.

steps.content_zh: 食用之前撒入葱花拌匀。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with chopped scallions and mix well before serving.

description_zh: 一直喜欢吃番茄意面，但是意面太难煮。于是自己DIY了一次，用手擀面代替了意面。面条被海鲜的鲜香、番茄的酸甜“拥抱”，手擀面Q弹的嚼劲也不亚于意面，喜欢面食的同学赶紧试试吧。
description_en: I have always loved tomato pasta, but pasta is too difficult to cook. So I DIYed it once and rolled the noodles by hand instead of pasta. The noodles are "embraced" by the freshness of seafood and the sweetness and sourness of tomatoes. The hand-rolled noodles are as chewy as pasta. Those who like pasta should give it a try.
tips_zh: 所用的面条是超市购买的手擀面，动手能力强的同学可以自己擀面条哦。
tips_en: The noodles used are hand-rolled noodles purchased from supermarkets. Students with strong hands-on skills can roll the noodles by themselves.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 洋葱、番茄切丁，蒜瓣切片。
steps.content_en: Dice the onion and tomato; slice the garlic cloves.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热后放入少许色拉油将洋葱、大蒜炒上色。
steps.content_en: After the wok is hot, add a little salad oil and fry the onions and garlic until they turn colour.

steps.content_zh: 入番茄丁，继续炒。
steps.content_en: Add diced tomatoes and continue frying.

steps.content_zh: 番茄丁炒融化变软后放入鱿鱼、蛤蜊肉和虾，用白胡椒和盐调味。
steps.content_en: Once the diced tomatoes have cooked down and softened, add the squid, clam meat, and shrimp, and season with white pepper and salt.

steps.content_zh: 加入水稍稍没过食材即可，烧开关火后尝一下味道，因为后面要焖面，所以汤汁要比平时做菜咸一点。
steps.content_en: Add water to cover the ingredients slightly, then turn off the heat and taste the taste. Because the noodles will be simmered later, the soup will be a little saltier than usual.

steps.content_zh: 将煮好海鲜倒入锅中，放上手擀面，点击手机图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour the cooked seafood into the pot, put your hands on the dough, and click the phone icon to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 剩余5分钟时开盖搅拌后，继续焖煮。
steps.content_en: When 5 minutes are left, open the lid and stir, then continue simmering.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后再尝下味道，可自己根据喜好调节。
steps.content_en: Taste the taste after cooking is complete and adjust according to your preference.

description_zh: 平常我们吃米饭都是纯大米，或加点玉米渣，但是有一种米非常的营养、滋补，还特有香气，它就是黑米，黑米素有“贡米”、“药米”、“长寿米”的美誉 ，有特殊的营养价值，黑米滋阴补肾，健脾暖肝、明目活血。在焖米饭的时候只要加里一些，口感马上口感得到提升，味道得到升华，最主要的营养一级棒！
description_en: Usually we eat pure rice, or add some corn residue, but there is a kind of rice that is very nutritious, nourishing, and has a unique aroma. It is black rice. Black rice is known as "tribute rice", "medicine rice" and "longevity rice". It has special nutritional value. Black rice nourishes yin and kidneys, strengthens the spleen and liver, improves eyesight and activates blood circulation. When simmering rice, just add a little bit, and the texture will immediately improve, the taste will be sublimated, and the most important thing is great nutrition!
tips_zh: 米颜色越深滋补效果越好
tips_en: The darker the rice, the better its nourishing effect.

steps.content_zh: 备好食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 食材洗净后都放入电饭煲内胆。
steps.content_en: Wash the ingredients and put them all into the rice cooker's inner pot.

steps.content_zh: 加入清水，水量在东北米横杠处3.5-4中间处。点击手机开始图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add water to a level between 3.5 and 4 on the Northeast Rice line. Tap the Start icon on your phone to cook.

steps.content_zh: 煮好的米饭，颜色漂亮，粒粒分明，口感筋道，带有黑米特有的香气，非常好吃。
steps.content_en: The cooked rice has a beautiful color, distinct grains, chewy texture, and the unique aroma of black rice. It is very delicious.

name_en: Yellow millet and shredded Xiang pork rice
description_zh: 小时候，每到腊月初八，老爸老妈都要做上一锅带豆的大黄米饭。饭桌上黄橙橙粘粘的黄米饭，或拌糖或把瘦肉丝加酱油盐炒了来拌着吃，一甜一咸，谁喜欢吃什么味的，自己去调。那时候小，如今吃这个的时候少，每天腊八饭，老爸还要加上些夏天预留的豆角豆，经过晒干，加到米里一起焖了，米香豆子面，记忆里的美味。我这次买完大黄米到家后，想起应该还有豆子，但是怎么也不能还原家里种的那种豆子了，可以加芸豆。这些年，老爸依旧会每年焖上大黄米饭叫我们回去吃。
description_en: Growing up, on the eighth day of the twelfth lunar month my parents always made a pot of yellow millet with beans. The golden, sticky rice on the table, mixed with sugar or with stir-fried shredded pork in soy sauce and salt—sweet or savory, everyone chose what they liked. We were young then, and nowadays I rarely eat it. At each Laba Festival Dad still adds dried beans saved from summer to the rice: the grains are fragrant, the beans soft, a taste from memory. This time, after buying yellow millet, I wished I still had those home-grown beans, but could not recreate them; kidney beans work instead. All these years Dad still makes yellow millet rice every year and calls us home to eat.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 肉切细丝，葱切碎备用。
steps.content_en: Cut the meat into thin strips, chop the green onions and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 大黄米洗净，加水到刻度线：东北米3.5，开始精煮。
steps.content_en: Wash the rhubarb rice, add water to the mark: Northeast rice 3.5, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 焖饭的同时炒猪肉丝，锅中油加热，放入肉丝翻炒。
steps.content_en: While the rice simmers, stir-fry the shredded pork: heat oil in a pan and stir-fry until cooked.

steps.content_zh: 加入生抽、葱花，盐、花椒粉炒匀。
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, chopped green onion, salt and pepper powder and stir well.

steps.content_zh: 出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan.

steps.content_zh: 盛出米饭，拌上肉丝，浇上一点油更香。
steps.content_en: Serve the rice, mix in the shredded pork and drizzle with a little oil for extra flavor.

description_zh: 这道粥，非常的好喝，清爽不油腻，特别能激起食欲，并且做法简单。食材里用到的大米我选的是碎米，爱烂还非常香，再配以鸡肉和香菇，营养又味美。香菇提高免疫力、防癌抗癌、延缓衰老；鸡肉强身健体、促进智力发育。
description_en: This porridge is very delicious, refreshing and not greasy, it can especially stimulate appetite, and it is simple to make. The rice used in the ingredients is broken rice, which is very fragrant and nutritious. It is also paired with chicken and mushrooms, which is nutritious and delicious. Mushrooms improve immunity, prevent and fight cancer, and delay aging; chicken strengthens the body and promotes intellectual development.
tips_zh: 香菇和鸡肉是绝搭，这两种食材放一起非常的鲜，并且不油腻。
tips_en: Shiitake mushrooms and chicken are a perfect match—together they're very savory yet not greasy.

steps.content_zh: 备好食材，香菇洗净。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients and wash the mushrooms.

steps.content_zh: 碎米洗净入电饭锅内胆，加入3小碗清水，选择煮粥模式，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the broken rice and put it into the rice cooker, add 3 small bowls of water, select the porridge cooking mode, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 剩余30分钟的时候放入切好的香菇丁和鸡肉丁，加入葱花，搅匀，合上盖子继续熬制。
steps.content_en: When the remaining 30 minutes are left, add the diced mushrooms and chicken, add the chopped green onions, stir well, close the lid and continue cooking.

steps.content_zh: 电饭锅提示音响起，粥就熬好了，加入盐、香油搅匀即可。
steps.content_en: When the rice cooker beeps, the congee is ready; add salt and sesame oil, stir well, and serve.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 羊肉比较细嫩,味道鲜美,含有丰富的营养,所以是冬季进补佳品.冬吃萝卜，夏吃姜，到老不要开药方。萝卜含有能诱导人体产生干扰素的多种微量元素，可增强机体免疫力，也是冬天很适宜吃的一款食材，今天，先炒入味，再用米家IH电饭煲，炖焖了一锅的羊肉萝卜，不仅味道鲜美，而且营养丰富。
description_en: Mutton is relatively tender, delicious and rich in nutrients, so it is a good tonic in winter. Eat radish in winter and ginger in summer. Do not prescribe medicine when you are old. Radish contains a variety of trace elements that can induce the human body to produce interferon, which can enhance the body's immunity. It is also a very suitable ingredient to eat in winter. Today, I first stir-fry the flavor, and then use the Mijia IH rice cooker to stew a pot of mutton radish. It is not only delicious, but also rich in nutrients.
tips_zh: 羊肉，在进行焯水的时候，要放入一勺的醋，这样羊肉的那种骚味就会去除，减轻。
tips_en: When blanching mutton, add a spoonful of vinegar to remove and reduce the odor of the mutton.

ingredients.name_en: June Fresh Special Grade Soy Sauce

steps.content_zh: 羊肉，放入清水中，放入一小勺的白醋，烧开，捞出，清水冲洗去浮油和杂质，沥干水分。
steps.content_en: Put the mutton into clean water, add a small spoonful of white vinegar, bring to a boil, remove, rinse with clean water to remove floating oil and impurities, and drain the water.

steps.content_zh: 煮过的羊肉很好切，切成方块，备用。
steps.content_en: The boiled lamb is easy to cut; cut into cubes and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 白萝卜一个，削皮，切成滚刀块，备用。
steps.content_en: One white radish, peeled and cut into hob cubes, set aside.

steps.content_zh: 准备好各种调料，生姜大蒜，香叶，山楂，桂皮，辣椒，六月鲜红烧酱油。
steps.content_en: Prepare various seasonings, including ginger, garlic, bay leaves, hawthorn, cinnamon, chili, and June fresh braised soy sauce.

steps.content_zh: 热锅，入油，8分热，放入生姜蒜，煸香。
steps.content_en: Heat the pan, add oil, heat for 8 minutes, add ginger and garlic, stir until fragrant.

steps.content_zh: 再放入事先切好的羊肉，煎下，然后翻炒。
steps.content_en: Add the pre-cut mutton, fry, and then stir-fry.

steps.content_zh: 调入一勺的盐，翻炒均匀。
steps.content_en: Add a spoonful of salt and stir-fry evenly.

steps.content_zh: 再放入其他的调料，翻炒。
steps.content_en: Add other seasonings and stir-fry.

steps.content_zh: 淋入六月鲜的红烧酱油。这个红烧酱油要多放点，以便色会好看些。
steps.content_en: Pour in Liu Yue Xian braising soy sauce. Use a bit more of this sauce for better color.

steps.content_zh: 再放入六月鲜的特级酱油。
steps.content_en: Then add June Fresh’s special soy sauce.

steps.content_zh: 再淋入料酒。
steps.content_en: Then pour in the cooking wine.

steps.content_zh: 翻炒均匀，这时候可以准备好饭煲内胆。
steps.content_en: Stir-fry evenly. At this time, you can prepare the rice cooker inner pot.

steps.content_zh: 把羊肉全部连汤汁一起都放入到电饭煲中。
steps.content_en: Put all the mutton and soup into the rice cooker.

steps.content_zh: 把切好的萝卜块，也一并放入电饭煲中。再加入凉水，大概是露出半块萝卜块这样的水量。点击手机图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add the chopped radish to the rice cooker too, then pour in cold water to about half-cover the radish. Tap the phone icon to cook.

steps.content_zh: 程序结束，打开一锅香味扑鼻的红焖羊肉萝卜就已经好了。如果觉得汤汁补浓稠可以调成蒸煮模式10分钟左右大火收汁。
steps.content_en: When the program ends, open the lid — the fragrant braised lamb with radish is ready. If the sauce is too thin, switch to Steam/Simmer mode for about 10 minutes on high heat to reduce it.

steps.content_zh: 成品，再放点香菜就可以开吃了。
steps.content_en: Finished product, add some coriander and it's ready to eat.

ingredients.name_en: June Fresh Special Grade Soy Sauce

description_zh: 杂粮与大米煮成五彩米饭，盛米饭的时候，一勺下去，五彩斑斓，代表着来年五谷丰登，风调雨顺。
description_en: Whole grains and white rice cooked together make colorful rice; each scoop is a riot of colors, symbolizing a bountiful harvest and favorable weather in the coming year.
tips_zh: 各种蔬菜杂粮可自己搭配。
tips_en: You can mix various vegetables and grains by yourself.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将所有的米分开浸泡一夜；
steps.content_en: Soak all rice separately overnight;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米3的刻度。将蒸笼放上，点击烹饪图标进行烹饪。烹饪完成后继续焖5分钟；
steps.content_en: Add water to the inner pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice 3 mark. Place the steamer on top and tap the Cooking icon to cook. After cooking, keep it covered for another 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 叶儿粑又叫艾馍，是四川地区特色传统小吃。节日食俗，在川西农家清明节、川南春节的传统食品。珠圆玉润，所以又叫做猪儿粑，肉末芽菜油而不腻，咸香可口，味道巴适得很！
description_en: Ye'er ba, also called ai mo, is a traditional Sichuan snack. It's a festival food—eaten at Qingming in western Sichuan and Spring Festival in the south. Round and glossy, it's also called zhu'er ba. The minced pork and preserved mustard greens filling is rich but not greasy, salty and fragrant—absolutely delicious!
tips_zh: 叶儿粑粉我是通过某宝购买四川当地的，如果不方便都买也可用糯米粉代替。良姜叶子也可用荷叶、粽叶、桔子叶等代替。
tips_en: I bought the ye'er ba flour from Sichuan via an online shop; if that's inconvenient, glutinous rice flour works too. Galangal leaves can be replaced with lotus leaves, zong leaves or orange leaves.

steps.content_zh: 原料。
steps.content_en: raw material.

steps.content_zh: 良姜叶洗净，切成5厘米宽的长方形。
steps.content_en: Wash the galangal leaves and cut into 5 cm wide rectangles.

steps.content_zh: 生姜洗净后剁成末，锅烧热后放油，将肉末煸炒香放入姜末和芽菜。
steps.content_en: Rinse and finely chop the ginger. Heat oil in the pot, stir-fry the minced meat until fragrant, then add the ginger and preserved mustard greens.

steps.content_zh: 炒香后盛出，撒上葱花搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Saute until fragrant, then sprinkle with chopped green onion and stir evenly.

steps.content_zh: 开始和面，取一半的粉分次倒入清水，揉均匀后再放入叶儿粑粉，继续加水揉。
steps.content_en: Start kneading the dough, take half of the flour and pour it into the water in batches. After kneading evenly, add the Yeerba flour and continue to add water and knead.

steps.content_zh: 揉到表面光滑，无明显的粉状即可。注意水不要一次性放太多，面团整体要偏硬。
steps.content_en: Knead until smooth with no visible flour. Do not add all the water at once—the dough should be on the firm side.

steps.content_zh: 一块面团，揉搓成球形。
steps.content_en: A piece of dough, rolled into a ball.

steps.content_zh: 按压出一个坑。
steps.content_en: Press to create a pit.

steps.content_zh: 放入炒好的馅料。
steps.content_en: Add the prepared filling.

steps.content_zh: 将馅料包裹起来，如果包不住可取些面团补上。剪裁好的良姜叶表面涂抹上油，将包好的叶儿粑放在上面。这样就是包叶儿粑的步骤啦。
steps.content_en: Wrap the filling. If it cannot be wrapped, use some dough to make up. Apply oil on the surface of the cut galangal leaves and place the wrapped leaf cake on top. These are the steps for wrapping leaf cakes.

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸笼中，锅中加水到水位线：东北米2的刻度。将蒸笼放入锅中，选择蒸煮模式20分钟。
steps.content_en: Put in the steamer, add water to the Northeast Rice 2 level, place the steamer in the pot and select Steam mode for 20 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 蒸好咯，白白胖胖的像不像猪猪呢？
steps.content_en: Done — white and plump, doesn't it look like a little pig?

steps.content_zh: 咬一口表皮软糯，馅心儿咸香可口。
steps.content_en: When you take a bite, the skin is soft and waxy, and the filling is salty and delicious.

name_en: Steamed pork with purple sweet potato powder
description_zh: 粉蒸肉又名面面肉，是广泛流行于中国南方地区的的汉族传统名菜之一。以主料带皮五花肉加米粉和其他调味料制作而成。粉蒸肉糯而清香，酥而爽口，有肥有瘦，红白相间，嫩而不糜，米粉油润，五香味浓郁。
description_en: Steamed pork, also known as noodle meat, is one of the traditional Han dishes that is widely popular in southern China. It is made with the main ingredient skin-on pork belly, rice noodles and other seasonings. The steamed meat is glutinous and fragrant, crisp and refreshing, fat and thin, red and white, tender but not greasy, and the rice noodles are oily and rich in five flavors.
tips_zh:
1、用紫薯垫底是为了吸收蒸肉时流出的油脂，可用土豆、南瓜、红薯代替。
2、蒸肉粉是有味道的，所以不用再次腌渍猪肉，可用少许老抽上色。
3、蒸肉粉超市中有售，可以挑选自己喜欢的口味。
tips_en:
1. The purple sweet potato base absorbs the fat from the steamed pork; potato, pumpkin, or sweet potato work too.
2. The steamed pork flour mix is already seasoned, so don't re-marinate the pork—just add a little dark soy sauce for color.
3. Steamed pork flour mix is sold in supermarkets; pick your favorite flavor.

steps.content_zh: 原料。
steps.content_en: raw material.

steps.content_zh: 五花肉切1厘米厚的片，用老抽搅拌均匀上色。
steps.content_en: Cut the pork belly into 1cm thick slices, stir with dark soy sauce and brown evenly.

steps.content_zh: 紫薯去皮切1厘米厚的片，将紫薯垫在盘子上。
steps.content_en: Peel the purple sweet potato and cut into 1 cm thick slices; line the plate with them.

steps.content_zh: 肉片裹上蒸肉粉均匀的铺在紫薯上。
steps.content_en: Coat the meat slices in steamed meat powder and spread them evenly over the purple sweet potatoes.

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸笼中，锅中水加到水位线：东北米3的刻度。点击手机开始图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put in the steamer, add water to the Northeast Rice 3 level and tap Start on the phone.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后取出，小心烫哦。
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, take it out and be careful not to burn it.

steps.content_zh: 撒上葱花，享用吧。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with chopped green onion and enjoy.

description_zh: 好吃又好玩，糯米和腊肠的搭配，丰富了人们对于美味的各种想象。糯米的口感甜糯，在烹煮的过程中，吸饱肉汁以后会充满咸香的味道。
description_en: Delicious and fun, the combination of glutinous rice and cured sausage sparks all kinds of tasty ideas. The rice is sweet and sticky, but as it cooks it soaks up the meat juices and becomes richly savory.
tips_zh:
1、如果可以买到生的咸鸭蛋，优选食用咸鸭蛋，咸鸭蛋的蛋黄中的油脂流入糯米中，味道更香。
2、 剩余的蛋清可以炒菜、蒸蛋白都可以。
tips_en:
1. If you can buy raw salted duck eggs, it is better to eat salted duck eggs. The fat in the yolk of the salted duck eggs flows into the glutinous rice, making it more fragrant.
2. The remaining egg whites can be used for stir-frying or steaming egg whites.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 糯米洗净提前浸泡一夜，滤干水分，腊肠、香菇切小丁与玉米同时放入滤干水分的糯米中，撒上已茶匙的盐混合均匀。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the glutinous rice overnight, then drain. Dice the sausage and shiitake and add with the corn to the rice; sprinkle with a teaspoon of salt and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 鸭蛋顶部敲一个小洞，倒出蛋清，蛋黄留在蛋壳中。
steps.content_en: Punch a small hole in the top of the duck egg and pour out the egg white, leaving the yolk in the shell.

steps.content_zh: 将准备好的糯米塞入蛋壳中。
steps.content_en: Stuff the prepared glutinous rice into the eggshell.

steps.content_zh: 用锡箔纸包裹住鸭蛋。
steps.content_en: Wrap the duck egg in foil.

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加入水到水位线：东北米3的刻度，将鸭蛋放入蒸笼中，选择蒸煮模式40分钟。
steps.content_en: Add water to the inner pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice 3 mark, put the duck eggs in the steamer, and select Steam mode for 40 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 完成后去壳食用，是不是很有趣呢。
steps.content_en: Isn’t it fun to peel and eat it after it’s finished?

description_zh: 火腿除了肉的身份以外，还是一个很好的调味品，火腿丁烹煮后各种味道释放在糯米饭中，和糯米的糯，豌豆的嫩组成一个超棒的搭配，在我的好吃的饭排行榜前几名哦，而且做起来超级简单。
description_en: Besides being a meat, ham is a great seasoning. Diced ham releases its flavors into the glutinous rice, pairing the sticky rice and tender peas into an amazing combo—one of my top rice dishes, and it's super easy to make.
tips_zh: 除了豌豆还可以加入一些自己喜欢的食材哦。
tips_en: In addition to peas, you can also add some other ingredients you like.

steps.content_zh: 准备好所需要使用的食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 火腿切成小丁，糯米洗净后浸泡4小时。
steps.content_en: Dice the ham; wash the glutinous rice and soak for 4 hours.

steps.content_zh: 将洗净的糯米放入电饭锅中，水的份量比平时煮饭稍微少放一点，再倒入火腿和豌豆。
steps.content_en: Put the washed glutinous rice into the rice cooker, add a little less water than usual for cooking rice, and then add the ham and peas.

steps.content_zh: 橄榄油、盐也倒入，稍稍搅拌均匀后点击手机烹饪图标进行焖煮。
steps.content_en: Pour in the olive oil and salt, stir evenly, and then click the cooking icon on your phone to simmer.

steps.content_zh: 煮好趁热翻拌一下，让豌豆、火腿丁和糯米饭混合的更均匀。
steps.content_en: While hot, toss the cooked rice to mix the peas, diced ham, and glutinous rice more evenly.

steps.content_zh: 开吃，配个小菜就很完美啦。
steps.content_en: It's perfect when served with a side dish.

description_zh: 用海参煮的小米粥，最大限度的保留了海参的营养，是道很滋补的粥品，具有补肾益精，养血润燥的功效，大家不妨一试。
description_en: Millet porridge cooked with sea cucumber retains the nutrition of sea cucumber to the maximum extent. It is a very nourishing porridge. It has the effects of nourishing the kidneys, replenishing essence, nourishing blood and moisturizing dryness. You may wish to try it.
tips_zh: 如果嫌一整个不方便食用，可以先切小再一起煮。
tips_en: If you find it inconvenient to eat the whole one, you can cut it into small pieces first and then cook them together.

steps.content_zh: 原料。
steps.content_en: raw material.

steps.content_zh: 小米洗净，放入电饭煲中，加水至粥刻度线1，点击开始烹饪图标。
steps.content_en: Wash the millet, put it into the rice cooker, add water to the porridge mark 1, and click the start cooking icon.

steps.content_zh: 还差15分钟的时候，放入处理好的海参和姜丝、枸杞、盐调味。
steps.content_en: With 15 minutes left, add the prepared sea cucumber, shredded ginger, goji berries and salt to taste.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 红薯已被营养学家当作一种药食兼用，营养均衡的食品，它的热量只有同等重量大米所产生热量的三分之一，而且几乎不含脂肪和胆固醇。常吃红薯有益于人体健康，并有一定减肥功效。
description_en: Nutritionists regard sweet potato as a food with both medicinal and nutritional value and balanced nutrition. It has only one-third the calories of the same weight of rice and contains almost no fat or cholesterol. Eating it regularly is good for health and has some weight-loss effect.
tips_zh: 红薯别一次吃得太多，以免出现烧心、返酸或腹胀等腹部不适症状。
tips_en: Do not eat too much sweet potato at once, to avoid heartburn, acid reflux or bloating.

steps.content_zh: 红薯削皮，切成块状，备用。
steps.content_en: Peel the sweet potato, cut into chunks and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 有机粥米，粥米是打碎了的五常大米，煮出的粥更粘稠。
steps.content_en: Organic porridge rice, porridge rice is broken Wuchang rice, and the cooked porridge is thicker.

steps.content_zh: 粥米洗净后倒入锅胆中，水加到水位线：稠粥-½的刻度，放入切好的红薯，点击烹饪图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the porridge rice and pour it into the pot. Add water to the water level: thick porridge - ½ mark. Add cut sweet potatoes and click the cooking icon to cook.

steps.content_zh: 听到程序结束的提示音，就说明粥已经煮好了。
steps.content_en: When you hear the beep when the program ends, it means the porridge is ready.

description_zh: 红枣的特点是维生素含量特别高，素有“天然维生素丸”的美誉，具有滋阴补阳、补血的功效。黑米，素有“黑珍珠”和“世界米中之王”的美誉，和大枣一样，都是补血佳品，红枣黑米同煮，营养非常的丰富。
description_en: Red dates are characterized by their particularly high vitamin content and are known as "natural vitamin pills". They have the effect of nourishing yin, yang, and blood. Black rice, known as the "black pearl" and "the king of rice in the world", is a good product for nourishing blood, just like jujube. When cooked with red jujube and black rice, it is very nutritious.
tips_zh: 黑米至少浸泡2小时以上，泡到用手可以掐断的程度，如果时间可以，最好提前一晚浸泡。
tips_en: Soak the black rice for at least 2 hours, until it can be broken apart by hand. If time allows, it is best to soak it overnight.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 黑米、红枣分别用清水浸泡。
steps.content_en: Soak black rice and red dates in water respectively.

steps.content_zh: 泡好的黑米和大米一起淘洗干净。
steps.content_en: Rinse the soaked black rice together with the white rice.

steps.content_zh: 连同红枣，放入米家电饭煲，水加到水位线：东北米-1.5的刻度，点击图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add the red dates to the Mijia rice cooker, fill water to the 'Northeast rice - 1.5' line, then tap the icon to cook.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

name_en: Sichuan clam and snow pear glutinous rice porridge
description_zh: 川贝，是一味名贵中药材，主要适用于外感风热咳嗽，效果显著。进入冬季，加之雾霾频发，感冒咳嗽的老人孩子有很多，用川贝、雪梨、糯米熬成粥，享受美味的同时还能治病防病。
description_en: Sichuan Fritillary scallop is a precious Chinese medicinal material. It is mainly suitable for cough caused by exogenous wind-heat, and the effect is remarkable. In the winter, with the frequent smog, there are many old people and children suffering from colds and coughs. Make porridge with Sichuan clams, snow pears and glutinous rice. You can enjoy the delicious food and treat and prevent diseases at the same time.
tips_zh:
1、糯米和川贝要提前浸泡，不仅节省煮制的时间，成品口感也好吃
2、雪梨的皮要消掉，否则会拉嗓子
tips_en:
1. Soak the glutinous rice and fritillaria in advance—it saves cooking time and improves the texture.
2. Peel the Asian pear, or it will irritate your throat.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 将糯米和川贝清水提前浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice and Sichuan clams in water for 2 hours in advance.

steps.content_zh: 把淘洗好的糯米、川贝放入米家电饭煲中，水加到水位线：稠粥-½的刻度，点击开始烹饪图标。
steps.content_en: Put the washed glutinous rice and Sichuan clams into the Mijia rice cooker, add water to the water level: thick porridge - ½ mark, and click the start cooking icon.

steps.content_zh: 雪梨去皮、切块。
steps.content_en: Peel and chop the snow pear.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时开锅，放入雪梨再继续焖煮。
steps.content_en: When there are 30 minutes remaining in the cooking time, open the pot, add the pears and continue to simmer.

steps.content_zh: 临出锅放入冰糖，搅至融化即可。
steps.content_en: Before taking out the pan, add rock sugar and stir until melted.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 感谢冬天让我遇见了腌笃鲜。冬天腌制风干的腊肉，加上市场上新鲜爽脆的冬笋，咕噜咕噜一阵乱炖，腊肉的醇香，冬笋的清香，简单的一道菜，简直鲜掉了眉毛，这个季节一定要多喝几次。
description_en: Thanks to winter for letting me meet Jian Du Xian. The cured and air-dried bacon in winter, combined with the fresh and crisp winter bamboo shoots on the market, stews for a while. The mellow flavor of the bacon and the fragrance of the winter bamboo shoots are a simple dish that is simply amazing. You must drink it several times this season.
tips_zh:
1.可以在开始炖的时候滴两滴白醋，有利于猪蹄中的营养物质析出。
2.因为火腿比较咸，所以调味的时候少许放点盐即可。
tips_en:
1. Add a couple drops of white vinegar when you start stewing to help release nutrients from the pork trotters.
2. The ham is salty, so add only a little salt when seasoning.

steps.content_zh: 原料。
steps.content_en: raw material.

steps.content_zh: 冬笋去壳，洗净后切滚刀块、小葱打成葱节、生姜拍松。
steps.content_en: Peel the winter bamboo shoots, wash them and cut them into hob pieces, beat the shallots into scallion joints, and pat the ginger into loose pieces.

steps.content_zh: 锅中烧一锅开水，放入少许盐巴，沸腾后放入笋和百叶结去除青涩味。
steps.content_en: Bring a pot of water to a boil with a little salt; add the bamboo shoots and tofu skin knots to remove their raw, astringent taste.

steps.content_zh: 捞出笋和百叶结后放入猪蹄焯水，洗净。
steps.content_en: Remove the bamboo shoots and tofu knots; blanch the pig's trotters and wash.

steps.content_zh: 金华火腿提前浸泡2小时。
steps.content_en: Soak Jinhua ham for 2 hours in advance.

steps.content_zh: 将火腿、猪蹄、生姜、葱结和料酒放入锅中，加入水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击烹饪图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the ham, pig's trotters, ginger, scallion knots and cooking wine into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark, click the cooking icon to cook.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余60分钟时放入冬笋和百叶结。
steps.content_en: With 60 minutes left, add the bamboo shoots and tofu skin knots.

steps.content_zh: 出锅后捞出葱结，放入少量的盐和白胡椒调味。撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: After taking it out of the pot, remove the onion knots and season with a small amount of salt and white pepper. Sprinkle with chopped green onion and serve.

steps.content_zh: 享用吧。
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

description_zh: 小米珍珠丸子｜新鲜肉糜裹上色泽金黄、晶莹明亮的小米，制成的肉丸不仅形似珍珠，吃起来也是又香又滑口，营养跟口感皆有加成！
description_en: Millet and Pearl Meatballs｜Fresh minced meat is wrapped in golden, crystal-clear millet. The meatballs made not only look like pearls, but also taste delicious and smooth, with added nutrition and taste!
tips_zh: 小米有黄色的外膜，口感不滑润，加一些香油拌匀，会又香又爽口。
tips_en: Millet has a yellow outer film and the taste is not smooth. Add some sesame oil and mix well, it will be fragrant and refreshing.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料。
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 小米提前浸泡4小时。
steps.content_en: Soak millet for 4 hours in advance.

steps.content_zh: 生姜切末放入猪肉中，同时放入胡椒粉、芝麻油、生抽、葱花和淀粉，搅打上劲。
steps.content_en: Add minced ginger to the pork along with pepper, sesame oil, light soy sauce, chopped scallions, and starch; stir vigorously until well combined.

steps.content_zh: 搅打好的肉末搓成肉丸子状。
steps.content_en: Shape the beaten minced meat into meatballs.

steps.content_zh: 浸泡好的小米滤干水分后，放入少许盐和芝麻油搅拌均匀
steps.content_en: Drain the soaked millet, then mix with a little salt and sesame oil

steps.content_zh: 肉圆裹表面均匀的裹上小米，后放入蒸笼中，锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-½的刻度，点击开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wrap the surface of the meatballs evenly with millet, then put them into a steamer. Add water to the pot until the water level is - ½ Northeast rice. Click to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 蒸煮完成后取出享用，小心烫手哦。
steps.content_en: When cooking is done, remove and enjoy — careful, it's hot.

description_zh: 蒸虾咸甜鲜香，粉丝吸收虾的鲜味和酱汁，味道更鲜美顺滑，关键是超简单。
description_en: The steamed shrimp is salty-sweet and savory, and the glass noodles soak up the shrimp essence and sauce for a richer, smoother taste — and it's super easy.
tips_zh: 最正宗的做法是要把一半的蒜蓉炸成金黄色，再与一半的生蒜蓉混合在一起用蒸鱼豉油调味，不怕麻烦的小伙伴可以一试哦（注意：炸蒜蓉一定要小火）
tips_en: The most authentic way is to fry half of the minced garlic until golden brown, then mix it with half of the raw garlic and season with steamed fish soy sauce. Friends who are not afraid of trouble can try it (note: the fried garlic must be on low heat)

steps.content_zh: 食材。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾洗净后开背，去虾线。
steps.content_en: Wash the fresh shrimps, open the back and remove the shrimp lines.

steps.content_zh: 粉丝提前浸泡软。
steps.content_en: Soften the glass noodles ahead of time.

steps.content_zh: 大蒜去皮剁成蒜蓉。
steps.content_en: Peel the garlic and chop into minced garlic.

steps.content_zh: 小葱切葱花、朝天椒切圈与蒜蓉一起倒入粉丝中，淋上2茶匙蒸鱼豉油，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Chop the green onions, cut the chilies into rings and mince the garlic and pour them into the vermicelli. Drizzle with 2 teaspoons of steamed fish soy sauce and stir evenly.

steps.content_zh: 取一个盘子（6吋左右）将粉丝垫底，方面码放好开背的虾，淋上酱汁。将盘子放入蒸笼中，锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击图标进行蒸煮。
steps.content_en: Take a plate (about 6 inches), line it with cellophane noodles, arrange the butterflied shrimp on top and drizzle with sauce. Place the plate in the steamer, add water to the inner pot up to the water line: Northeast Rice - level 2, then tap the icon to steam.

steps.content_zh: 蒸好以后，端出摆一个漂亮的造型，烧一锅滚热的油淋在蒜蓉上，瞬间香味扑鼻。
steps.content_en: Once steamed, plate it attractively, heat a pot of oil until piping hot and pour it over the garlic — the aroma rises at once.

steps.content_zh: 享用吧.
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

description_zh: 西红柿牛腩汤是一道非常经典的汤品，开胃爽口，冷冷的冬天来一碗是不是很暖和！
description_en: Tomato and beef brisket soup is a classic, appetizing dish—a bowl warms you right up on a cold winter day!
tips_zh:
1.所有的食材都可以根据个人口味自由增减的。
2.西红柿的皮也可以提前去掉，用刀在西红柿顶部划十字后用开水烫一下，就可去皮啦。
tips_en:
1. Adjust all ingredients to taste.
2. You can peel the tomatoes first: score a cross on top and blanch in boiling water.

steps.content_zh: 牛腩切块，土豆去皮切块，西红柿洗干净切块，准备好葱姜蒜和桂皮。
steps.content_en: Cut the brisket into chunks, peel and cube the potatoes, wash and chop the tomatoes, and prepare scallion, ginger, garlic, and cinnamon bark.

steps.content_zh: 把所有食材放入电饭煲内胆中。
steps.content_en: Put all ingredients into the rice cooker pot.

steps.content_zh: 加入水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，加入料酒，盐，糖，生抽调味，点击图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Add water to the water level line: thick porridge -1 mark, add cooking wine, salt, sugar, light soy sauce to taste, click the icon to cook.

steps.content_zh: 完成后享用吧。（尝下味道，如果觉得不够可以再放入少许调味料调味）
steps.content_en: Enjoy when done. (Taste, and add a little more seasoning if needed.)

description_zh:
每天早晨一个鸡蛋，不仅可以补充蛋白质，还能护眼，有助于记忆。但有些人仍然心存疑虑，担心胆固醇摄入过多，怕每天食用引发高血脂。岂不知，每天早餐进食一个鸡蛋，是有诸多好处的。
鸡蛋中的蛋白质富含构造人类生物细胞所需的氨基酸，是每天必需摄入的营养来源。
description_en:
An egg every morning not only supplies protein but also protects your eyes and helps memory. Yet some people still worry about excess cholesterol, fearing that eating an egg daily will cause high blood lipids. Little do they know there are many benefits to an egg each morning.
The protein in eggs is rich in the amino acids needed to build human cells, making it an essential daily nutrient.
tips_zh:
1：如果家里有老人吃可以不放白糖。
2:盐根据个人口味随意增减，老抽多少可以根据颜色来定，喜欢深一点颜色就多加点，少加颜色就会淡一点。
3:做一次也可以多做一些，做的多要多放一点盐，这样不容易坏。
4：鸡蛋在汤料里浸泡时间越久越入味。
tips_en:
1. Skip the sugar if seniors will be eating it.
2. Adjust the salt to taste; use dark soy sauce for color—more for a deeper shade, less for a lighter one.
3. You can make a larger batch—just add a bit more salt so it keeps better.
4. The longer the eggs soak in the broth, the more flavorful they become.

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋提前煮熟剥皮，准备好老抽，生抽，白糖，葱姜蒜，桂皮。
steps.content_en: Boil and peel the eggs in advance, and prepare dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, sugar, onion, ginger, garlic, and cinnamon.

steps.content_zh: 所有材料都放入电饭煲内胆中，加入适量的水没过鸡蛋，加入适量的盐。
steps.content_en: Put all the ingredients into the rice cooker pot, add an appropriate amount of water to cover the eggs, and add an appropriate amount of salt.

steps.content_zh: 点击开始烹饪图标，就可以等着吃啦。建议做好后在汤汁里继续保温1小时，这样可以更入味。
steps.content_en: Click the start cooking icon and wait to eat. It is recommended to keep it warm in the soup for 1 hour after making it to make it more delicious.

description_zh: 这款汤味道鲜美回味甘甜，非常好喝，鸡爪和花生还真是绝搭，鸡爪软烂脱骨、汤鲜美、花生香，非常有食欲！花生延缓衰老、补气血； 鸡爪能增强皮肤张力，有消除皱纹的功效，养颜护肤！绝对是一道女人汤，女人要常喝。
description_en: Deliciously savory with a sweet finish: chicken feet and peanuts are a perfect match—tender feet, flavorful broth and fragrant peanuts. Peanuts fight aging and replenish energy; chicken feet improve skin elasticity and reduce wrinkles. A beauty soup women should enjoy often.

steps.content_zh: 备好食材
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 鸡爪洗净泡去血水，花生泡3小时
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken feet and soak them in water to remove the blood. Soak the peanuts for 3 hours.

steps.content_zh: 鸡爪剪掉爪尖
steps.content_en: Trim the tips off the chicken feet

steps.content_zh: 冷水入锅，加入1汤匙料酒焯水去腥，开锅后撇去浮沫
steps.content_en: Pour cold water into the pot, add 1 tablespoon of cooking wine, blanch the water to remove the fishy smell, and skim off the foam after boiling

steps.content_zh: 鸡爪颜色变白即可捞入电饭锅内胆，捞入泡好的花生
steps.content_en: Once the chicken feet turn white, transfer them to the rice cooker's inner pot along with the soaked peanuts

steps.content_zh: 加入开水，加入葱、姜、大料、半汤匙料酒。（水量依据个人喜好，爱喝汤的就稍微多加点）
steps.content_en: Add boiling water, scallions, ginger, star anise and half a tablespoon of cooking wine. (Adjust the water to your liking—add more if you love soup.)

steps.content_zh: 点击图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Click on the icon to cook.

steps.content_zh: 完成后调味，撒上香菜就能享用啦。
steps.content_en: When done, season, sprinkle with coriander and enjoy.

name_en: Fresh Shrimp and Glutinous Rice Balls
description_zh: 糯米丸子，就是肉丸子外面裹上一层糯米蒸熟，蒸好后外观洁白如颗颗珍珠，又名“珍珠丸子”。加了鲜虾，营养更加丰富，好吃而不腻。
description_en: Glutinous rice balls are meatballs wrapped with a layer of glutinous rice and steamed. After steaming, they look as white as pearls, also known as "pearl meatballs". With the addition of fresh shrimp, it is more nutritious and delicious but not greasy.
tips_zh: 肉末中还可以加入马蹄末、胡萝卜末、香菇丁等自己喜欢的食材。
tips_en: You can also add chopped water chestnut, carrot or shiitake mushroom to the minced meat.

steps.content_zh: 原料。
steps.content_en: raw material.

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾去虾头，取出虾仁去虾线，尾留用，虾仁切丁。
steps.content_en: Remove the heads from the fresh shrimps, remove the shrimp devein, keep the tails, and dice the shrimps.

steps.content_zh: 糯米要提前进浸泡一夜后滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice overnight in advance, then drain;

steps.content_zh: 小葱切葱花、生姜切末；
steps.content_en: Chop green onions and mince ginger;

steps.content_zh: 将葱姜和虾仁丁一起放入肉末中，放入料酒去腥，用胡椒粉、生抽、芝麻油调味，放入淀粉后搅打上劲；
steps.content_en: Add onion, ginger and diced shrimp into the minced meat, add cooking wine to remove the fishy smell, season with pepper, light soy sauce and sesame oil, add starch and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 将搅打好的肉末揉成团，外面裹上滤干水分的糯米，在最上面插上虾尾。（为了好看哈哈）；锅胆中放入水到水位线：东北米2的刻度，点击图标开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Knead the beaten minced meat into a ball, wrap the outside with drained glutinous rice, and insert shrimp tails on top. (For the sake of good looks haha); put water in the pot to the water level line: northeast meter 2, click the icon to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 成品，是不是很好看呢，赶紧回家露一手吧。
steps.content_en: The finished product looks great, don’t you? Go home and show it off.

description_zh: 来自高原之上等天然青稞米，煮成了香喷喷的青稞饭 配上热辣辣的青稞酒让心儿醉了。来杯酥油茶，吃点牦牛肉生活岂不美哉。长期食用可降血糖、血脂、血压；除宿便、排於毒、消雀斑。
description_en: Superior natural highland barley from the plateau makes a fragrant barley meal; paired with warming barley wine, it's intoxicating. Add a cup of butter tea and some yak beef—what a wonderful life. Regular consumption can help lower blood sugar, blood lipids, and blood pressure, relieve constipation, expel toxins, and reduce freckles.
tips_zh: 消化能力有问题的人。消化能力有问题的人（例如，胃溃疡、十二指肠溃疡）不适合吃五谷杂粮，因为这些食材较粗糙，跟胃肠道物理摩擦，会造成伤口疼痛。容易胀气的人，吃多了也不舒服。
tips_en: People with digestive problems. Those with digestive issues (e.g., stomach or duodenal ulcers) shouldn't eat whole grains, because these coarse foods can rub against the gastrointestinal tract and cause pain. People prone to bloating may also feel uncomfortable after eating a lot.

steps.content_zh: 青稞米。
steps.content_en: Highland barley rice.

steps.content_zh: 青稞米洗净后倒入饭煲中，水加到水位线：丝苗米-2的刻度，点击图标开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Wash the highland barley and pour it into the rice cooker, add water up to the water level line: the Simiao rice - 2 mark, then tap the icon to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 焖煮完成。
steps.content_en: Simmering complete.

steps.content_zh: 来杯酥油茶配点牦牛肉如何。
steps.content_en: How about a cup of butter tea with some yak beef?

description_zh: 山药是清肺佳品，在雾霾猛烈来袭的晚上预约一锅花生山药粥。早上起来就可以享受软糯的早餐，宣肺化痰，每一天元气都是元气满满。
description_en: Yams are great for clearing the lungs. Make a reservation for a pot of peanut and yam porridge at night when the haze comes. You can enjoy a soft and glutinous breakfast when you wake up in the morning, which can relieve lung inflammation and resolve phlegm, and make you full of vitality every day.
tips_zh:
1. 如果选择预约，大米和花生可以无需提前浸泡；
2 .山药是清肺佳品，除了可以煮粥食用外，像和黑木耳一起炒制，也同样适合雾霾天多多食用。
tips_en:
1. If you choose to make a reservation, rice and peanuts do not need to be soaked in advance;
2. Yam is a good product for clearing the lungs. In addition to being eaten as porridge, it is also suitable for consumption in hazy days when fried with black fungus.

ingredients.name_en: One section of iron stick yam

steps.content_zh: 食材。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 大米淘洗干净后浸泡30分钟，花生同样浸泡，山药去皮洗净切小丁。
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and soak it for 30 minutes. Soak the peanuts in the same way. Peel, wash and cut the yam into small cubes.

steps.content_zh: 将浸泡好的大米、花生、山药丁加入电饭煲中，按照水位线加入适量清水
steps.content_en: Add the soaked rice, peanuts, and diced yam to the rice cooker, and add an appropriate amount of water according to the water level.

steps.content_zh: 点击开始烹饪，完成后就可盛出享用啦。
steps.content_en: Tap Start Cooking; when done, serve and enjoy.

ingredients.name_en: One section of iron stick yam

description_zh: 来自《舌尖上的中国》的一道菜，自家腌制的咸肉和山上的雷笋再加点香葱点缀味道实在赞。任何调料都没有放，却鲜美异常。
description_en: A dish from 'A Bite of China': home-cured bacon and mountain spring bamboo shoots with a little scallion on top—truly delicious. No seasoning added at all, yet incredibly savory.
tips_zh: 咸肉和火腿都比较咸，所以一定要提前浸泡除去一些咸味。咸肉切好片厚用热水再稍微烫一会。
tips_en: Bacon and ham are relatively salty, so be sure to soak them in advance to remove some of the saltiness. Cut the bacon into thick slices and blanch them in hot water for a while.

steps.content_zh: 火腿和咸肉提前洗净，浸泡2小时。（建议咸肉切片后再次浸泡一会，可以去除部分咸味）
steps.content_en: Wash the ham and cured pork in advance and soak for 2 hours. (Slice the cured pork and soak again briefly to remove some saltiness.)

steps.content_zh: 千张切丝。
steps.content_en: Thousands of slices shredded.

steps.content_zh: 雷笋切滚刀块。
steps.content_en: Cut the bamboo shoots into hob pieces.

steps.content_zh: 雷笋和千张垫在盘子底部，咸肉切片，火腿切丁。将咸肉片均匀的铺在雷笋上，火腿丁洒在中间。可以在煮米饭的同时将这道菜放在蒸笼上蒸熟。
steps.content_en: Place the bamboo shoots and qianzhang on the bottom of the plate, slice the bacon, and dice the ham. Spread the bacon slices evenly on the bamboo shoots, and sprinkle the diced ham in the middle. This dish can be steamed on a steamer basket while the rice is cooking.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

steps.content_zh: 一碗米饭配上千张、雷笋和咸肉，简约而不简单。
steps.content_en: A bowl of rice with qianzhang, bamboo shoots and bacon is simple but not simple.

description_zh: 红糖自古都是女人的最爱，也是产后和经期的佳品。红糖可以暖宫、暖胃、去胃寒，配以生姜、红枣，经期喝可以暖宫、缓解痛经，经后养血美颜。
description_en: Brown sugar has long been a favorite of women and is a wonderful tonic after childbirth and during menstruation. It warms the womb and stomach and dispels stomach chill; with ginger and red dates, drinking it during menstruation warms the womb and eases cramps, while afterwards it nourishes the blood and beautifies the skin.
tips_zh: 没有古方红糖的普通红糖也可以。
tips_en: Regular brown sugar is fine if you don't have traditional brown sugar.

steps.content_zh: 原料。
steps.content_en: raw material.

steps.content_zh: 红枣洗净，用剪刀剪成条去核后放入电饭煲。
steps.content_en: Wash the red dates, cut them into strips with scissors, remove the core and put them into the rice cooker.

steps.content_zh: 把红糖和姜片也一起放入。
steps.content_en: Add the brown sugar and ginger slices as well.

steps.content_zh: 加入两碗清水。
steps.content_en: Add two bowls of water.

steps.content_zh: 选择蒸煮模式30分钟，程序结束，即可盛出饮用，红枣也一起食用。
steps.content_en: Select steam mode for 30 minutes; when done, serve and drink, eating the red dates too.

name_en: Horseshoe, Tremella and Red Date Soup
description_zh: 马蹄银耳红枣汤
description_en: Horseshoe, Tremella and Red Date Soup
tips_zh: 冰糖的量可根据自己口味来放。
tips_en: The amount of rock sugar can be adjusted according to your own taste.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料。
steps.content_en: Ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 银耳泡发后（泡约半小时），去掉黄色根部，撕成小朵。
steps.content_en: After soaking the white fungus (soak for about half an hour), remove the yellow roots and tear them into small florets.

steps.content_zh: 马蹄去皮切小块。
steps.content_en: Peel the water chestnuts and cut into small pieces.

steps.content_zh: 食材处理好后都放入电饭煲内胆中，加入水，到水位线的3/4的位置，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Once prepared, put all the ingredients into the rice cooker's inner pot, add water to the 3/4 mark of the water level line, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 程序时间剩余20分钟时放入冰糖，继续焖煮结束后即可享用。
steps.content_en: When 20 minutes remain, add rock sugar, keep simmering and enjoy when done.

description_zh:
红豆是很好的养生佳品，在日常饮食中，吃一些红豆对身体健康很有好处。红豆具有健脾胃，祛湿排毒，养心补血，消除水肿等功效。
红豆种子可供食用与药用，常用于煮粥、制豆沙。今天用来做成蜜豆也很不错，又香又甜，就这样空口吃也停不下来，不过，用来制作面包、蛋糕及其它甜点更美味哟。
description_en:
Adzuki beans are an excellent health food, and eating some in your daily diet is very good for you. They strengthen the spleen and stomach, remove dampness and toxins, nourish the heart and blood, and reduce edema.
The seeds are edible and medicinal, often used in porridge and sweet red bean paste. Made into candied red beans today, they are wonderfully fragrant and sweet — you cannot stop eating them plain, though they are even better in bread, cakes and other desserts.
tips_zh:
1．红豆泡过之后会熟的更快
2．冰糖粉可换成白糖
3．在烹饪期间，可以时常观察里面的情况，如果水少了，可酌情添加开水
4．红豆煮熟后，如果水比较多，可将多余的红豆水倒到碗里（可以饮用的），再拌糖粉进去
5．如果一个程序没煮熟，可再重复一次
tips_en:
1. Soaked red beans cook faster.
2. Powdered rock sugar can be replaced with white sugar.
3. Check on it during cooking; add boiling water if the level gets low.
4. Once the beans are cooked, pour off any extra liquid (it's drinkable), then stir in the sugar.
5. If one cooking cycle isn't enough, run it again.

steps.content_zh: 红豆洗净后提前浸泡一晚。
steps.content_en: Wash the adzuki beans and soak them overnight in advance.

steps.content_zh: 老冰糖用料理机打成细粉（也可以换成白糖）。
steps.content_en: Use a food processor to beat old rock sugar into fine powder (you can also replace it with white sugar).

steps.content_zh: 将泡好的红豆倒入电饭煲内胆中，加入适量水，开始烹饪。
steps.content_en: Pour the soaked red beans into the rice cooker pot, add an appropriate amount of water, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 程序结束后看豆子的成熟情况，如果用手一碾就烂，那就可以了，如果还有点硬，那还得重复煮一次。
steps.content_en: After the program is over, check the maturity of the beans. If they become mushy when crushed with your hands, then it’s OK. If they are still a little hard, you have to cook them again.

steps.content_zh: 红豆煮好后，倒出多余的水分，放入冰糖粉拌匀即可。
steps.content_en: Once the adzuki beans are cooked, drain the excess water and mix in powdered rock sugar.

steps.content_zh: 做好的蜜豆放入冰箱冷藏保存，随用随取，不过最好尽快吃完。
steps.content_en: Store the prepared honey beans in the refrigerator and use them as needed, but it is best to eat them as soon as possible.

name_en: Purple rice and black goji congee
description_zh: 黑枸杞总体来说功效很多，抵抗衰老、改善睡眠、美容养颜、改善皮肤、护肝明目、增进视力、改善循环、增强体质、补肾益精等，枸杞是个好东西!与红枸杞最大的区别是原花青素含量很高，甚至是蓝莓的10倍以上，具有很好的抗衰老、美容美肤的作用。
description_en: Black goji berries have many benefits: anti-aging, improving sleep, beauty and skin care, protecting the liver and improving eyesight, enhancing vision, improving circulation, strengthening the body, and tonifying the kidneys and replenishing essence—goji is a good thing! The biggest difference from red goji is its very high anthocyanin content, even over 10 times that of blueberries, giving it excellent anti-aging and beauty benefits.
tips_zh: 如果选择预约功能，糯米可以不用浸泡。建议枸杞还是要在剩30分钟以后再放，这样会减少营养流失。
tips_en: If using the timer function, the glutinous rice doesn't need soaking. Add the goji berries only when 30 minutes remain to reduce nutrient loss.

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前用水浸泡两个小时以上。
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice in water for at least two hours in advance.

steps.content_zh: 先把泡好的糯米放入锅中，加入适量的清水，电饭煲插上电源，选择煮粥键90分钟。
steps.content_en: First put the soaked glutinous rice into the pot, add an appropriate amount of water, plug in the rice cooker, and select the porridge button for 90 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 剩余30分钟时放入黑枸杞。
steps.content_en: When 30 minutes are left, add black wolfberry.

steps.content_zh: 完成后出锅即可，软软糯糯的很好喝。
steps.content_en: When done, take it out of the pan and it will be soft and glutinous and delicious.

name_en: Red date and peanut two-grain porridge
description_zh:
一碗好粥，总能带给人温暖的感觉，居家生活久了，做的饭菜多了，粥，却始终是心头爱。对于粥里的食材，总是随着自己的心意和想要得到的营养功效而添加。
妈妈寄来了她自己种的花生，剥好的一粒一粒的放在布袋里，颗颗饱满。花生中钙含量比较高，对孩子来说可以促进儿童骨骼发育，还能改善血液循环，增强记忆，花生中的锌元素还能够促进儿童大脑发育，延缓人体衰老，另外花生还有一个重要的作用，它能滋血通乳，对于还在哺乳期的我来说，很是合适。
既然是粥，就不能缺米，大米和小米都是家里常备的食材，再配上些红枣，有一些枣的香甜味，这样味道更好一些，不仅大人喜欢喝，孩子也更会喜欢。
description_en: A good bowl of porridge always warms the heart. After years of home cooking, porridge remains my favorite. I add ingredients according to my mood and the nutrition I want. Mom sent peanuts she grew herself, shelled one by one in a cloth bag, each one plump. Peanuts are high in calcium, promoting children's bone development, improving blood circulation and boosting memory; the zinc in them also supports brain development and delays aging. Peanuts also nourish the blood and promote lactation, which suits me as a nursing mother. Since it's porridge, rice is a must. White rice and millet are always in our pantry, plus some red dates for sweetness—better tasting, and loved by adults and children alike.
tips_zh: 小时候煮粥，都是在炉火上用锅慢熬，有一个人必须守着，大火烧开，小火慢煮，边煮还要边搅拌，以免糊了锅底。现在方便多了，因为有电饭煲，把所有的食材放进去，通电，启动程序，就可以做别的事情去了，时间到自有一锅好粥等着自己。
tips_en: As a child, porridge was simmered slowly on the stove with someone watching it: bring to a boil, then cook over low heat, stirring to avoid scorching. Now it is easy with a rice cooker—add the ingredients, power on, start the program and get on with your day; when the time is up, a good pot of porridge awaits.

steps.content_zh: 准备好大米、小米、红枣、花生；
steps.content_en: Prepare rice, millet, red dates, and peanuts;

steps.content_zh: 花生洗净后，用刀切碎；红枣洗净后去核掰碎；
steps.content_en: Wash and chop the peanuts; wash, pit, and break the red dates;

steps.content_zh: 大米小米洗净，连同处理好的花生和红枣一起放进电饭煲内；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and millet and put them into the rice cooker together with the processed peanuts and red dates;

steps.content_zh: 加入适量的清水；
steps.content_en: Add appropriate amount of water;

steps.content_zh: 启动“煮粥”程序，时间可以自定，我一般选90分钟；
steps.content_en: Start the "cooking porridge" program, the time can be customized, I usually choose 90 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 90分钟后，待提示音响起，一锅飘着枣香的热粥就可以准备食用了；
steps.content_en: After 90 minutes, when the beep sounds, a pot of hot porridge with the fragrance of dates will be ready to eat;

steps.content_zh: 米和花生都已经软烂，枣味已经融入枣里，香甜可口，孩子们也都爱喝。
steps.content_en: The rice and peanuts are already soft and rotten, and the jujube flavor has been integrated into the jujube. It is sweet and delicious, and the children also love to drink it.

steps.content_zh: 这款粥补气养血，营养丰富，可以说是老少皆宜。
steps.content_en: This nourishing porridge boosts energy and blood, suitable for all ages.

description_zh: 小米IH电饭煲是IH电磁加热技术，这样的好处就是能让煮出来的饭熟的更均匀，今天我就拿它成功做了一道五彩八宝饭。用它蒸出来的糯米口感更筋道韧性，颗粒剔透分明。
description_en: The Xiaomi IH rice cooker uses induction heating, so rice cooks more evenly. Today I used it to make a colorful eight-treasure rice; the steamed glutinous rice is chewy and springy, with clear, distinct grains.
tips_zh:
1、凉的糯米饭不易消化，所以冷藏后的八宝饭要再次加热后才可食用。不宜在冰箱中存放太久。
2、糯米一定要提前充分浸泡。
tips_en:
1. Cold glutinous rice is hard to digest, so reheat the eight-treasure rice before eating if chilled. Don't store it too long in the fridge.
2. Soak the glutinous rice thoroughly in advance.

steps.content_zh: 糯米冷水浸泡4个小时以上用配套的蒸笼垫一个蒸笼布，把糯米倒在蒸笼布上，电饭锅内胆放入三分之一的清水。
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice in cold water for more than 4 hours. Use the matching steamer to place a steamer cloth, pour the glutinous rice on the steamer cloth, and fill the rice cooker with one-third of the water.

steps.content_zh: 选择电饭锅的蒸煮功能，自定义时间45分钟开始蒸饭，程序结束后开盖取出糯米饭倒入盘中备用，可见糯米颗粒饱满油光剔透。
steps.content_en: Select the steaming function of the rice cooker and set the time of 45 minutes to start steaming rice. After the program is completed, open the lid, take out the glutinous rice and pour it into a plate for later use. You can see that the glutinous rice grains are full and shiny.

steps.content_zh: 秤量准备好所有食材：五彩豆、猪油、白糖、蒸熟的糯米。
steps.content_en: Weigh and prepare all the ingredients: colorful beans, lard, sugar, and steamed glutinous rice.

steps.content_zh: 乘热倒入白糖和猪油。
steps.content_en: Stir in sugar and lard while still hot.

steps.content_zh: 将油、糖和糯米饭拌匀。
steps.content_en: Mix oil, sugar and glutinous rice.

steps.content_zh: 取一个抹了油的玻璃碗，把五彩豆按自已意愿排列在碗底，其它五彩豆与糯米饭混合均匀。
steps.content_en: Take an oiled glass bowl, arrange the colorful beans on the bottom of the bowl as you wish, and mix the other colorful beans with the glutinous rice evenly.

steps.content_zh: 把糯米饭放到碗里用手圧实。
steps.content_en: Put the glutinous rice into a bowl and squeeze it tightly with your hands.

steps.content_zh: 压平糯米饭表面。
steps.content_en: Flatten the surface of the glutinous rice.

steps.content_zh: 五彩八宝饭就做好了。如果马上吃可直接倒扣盘中装饰后开吃，当日不吃可以倒扣后用保鲜膜包好于冰箱冷冻，吃时解冻再蒸十分钟即可。
steps.content_en: The colorful eight-treasure rice is ready. To serve now, invert onto a plate, garnish and enjoy. If not eating today, invert, wrap in plastic and freeze; when ready, thaw and steam for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 成品。
steps.content_en: Finished product.

description_zh: 最近收到了小米家的新品【米家IH电饭煲】，开箱瞬间一片雪白映入眼帘--简约、清新、通体雪白，绝对的高颜值。盖子上隐印着多功能智能烹饪方式，按下中间的开关取出内胆，我终于见到了传说中的3mm烈焰厚釜内胆（合金内胆），这质感这厚重真不是吹的，一看就是高端大气上档次的好东西。正好适逢春节我决定把这款小美丽带到东北的婆婆家显摆下，今天用它做了一道地道的东北菜小鸡炖蘑菇收获好评一片。
description_en: I recently got Xiaomi's new Mijia IH Rice Cooker. Unboxing it, I was greeted by a sea of white—simple, fresh, and all-white, absolutely gorgeous. The lid is subtly printed with the multi-function smart cooking modes. Pressing the button in the middle and taking out the inner pot, I finally saw the legendary 3 mm 'flame thick pot' inner pot (alloy inner pot)—the texture and heft are no exaggeration; it looks like a high-end, elegant piece. With Spring Festival coming up, I decided to bring this beauty to my mother-in-law's in the Northeast to show off. Today I used it to make an authentic Northeastern dish, chicken stewed with mushrooms, and got nothing but praise.

steps.content_zh: 准备好所需食材,榛蘑切记要温水浸泡数小时。
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients. Remember to soak the hazelnut mushrooms in warm water for several hours.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅内放少许油，加入大葱和姜片小火翻炒出香味。
