steps.content_en: Heat a little oil in a pan and stir-fry the scallion and ginger slices over low heat until fragrant.

steps.content_zh: 加入大料、桂皮、花椒粉爆香。
steps.content_en: Add aniseed, cinnamon, and peppercorns and saute until fragrant.

steps.content_zh: 爆香以后，加入鸡块大火翻炒。
steps.content_en: Once fragrant, add the chicken pieces and stir-fry over high heat.

steps.content_zh: 炒至鸡肉变色，水份收干。
steps.content_en: Stir-fry until the chicken changes color and the liquid evaporates.

steps.content_zh: 加入生抽、老抽、糖、料酒翻炒均匀。
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar and cooking wine and stir-fry evenly.

steps.content_zh: 加入适量开水烧开，水量与鸡肉持平。
steps.content_en: Add an appropriate amount of boiling water and bring to a boil, the amount of water is equal to that of the chicken.

steps.content_zh: 将鸡肉全部倒入电饭锅内。
steps.content_en: Pour all the chicken into the rice cooker.

steps.content_zh: 待烹饪结束前半小时，开盖加入榛蘑继续炖20分钟。
steps.content_en: Half an hour before the end of cooking, add the hazelnut mushrooms and continue simmering for 20 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束前10分钟时加入适量的盐，炖至烹饪结束，盛出即可美享。
steps.content_en: Add salt 10 minutes before cooking ends, simmer until done, then serve and enjoy.

description_zh: 银耳营养丰富，胶质不输燕窝，口感也相去不远，价格却要便宜许多，堪称是高贵不贵的「平民燕窝」。搭配山楂果，不仅酸甜可口非常好喝，润燥养颜的效果也很不错的。今天，我用米家IH电饭煲，做了这款酸酸甜甜的小甜点，IH米家电饭煲，无论是外观还是质感都那么的讨人喜欢，一身的洁白；功能也很强大，只要把所有的食材放入内胆中，你就可以随心所欲的去做其他的事情，根本不用顾及这个汤会做不好，你就等着喝汤了；如果，程序结束，你还没有来，米家的电饭煲会自动的进入到保温功能。
description_en: Tremella is rich in nutrients, its gelatin is not inferior to that of bird's nest, and its taste is not far different, but the price is much cheaper. It can be called a noble but not expensive "bird's nest". Paired with hawthorn fruit, it not only tastes sour and sweet, but also has a good effect of moisturizing and nourishing the skin. Today, I used the Mijia IH rice cooker to make this sweet and sour dessert. The IH Mijia rice cooker is so pleasing in appearance and texture. It is all white. It is also very powerful. Just put in all the ingredients. In the inner pot, you can do other things as you like, without having to worry about whether the soup will be cooked well, you just wait to drink the soup; if the program ends and you haven't come yet, the Mijia rice cooker will automatically enter the keep warm function.
tips_zh: 银耳，我喜欢吃着有点脆的口感，所以用冷水泡发；如果，喜欢，软烂，绵柔的口感，可以用温水泡发。
tips_en: I like my snow fungus slightly crunchy, so I rehydrate it in cold water; if you prefer it soft, tender and fluffy, use warm water.

steps.content_zh: 银耳提前一晚，用冷水泡发，备用；
steps.content_en: Soak white fungus in cold water one night in advance and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 准备IH电饭煲内胆，把银耳清晰干净，放入内胆中，加入水没过银耳为宜；
steps.content_en: Prepare the inner pot of the IH rice cooker, clean the white fungus, put it into the inner pot, and add water to cover the white fungus;

steps.content_zh: 加入冰糖，冰糖的量可以根据个人喜好和水量来定；
steps.content_en: Add rock sugar. The amount of rock sugar can be determined according to personal preference and the amount of water;

steps.content_zh: 再把山楂，洗净，切成对半分开，加入到电饭煲的内胆中；
steps.content_en: Then wash the hawthorn, cut it in half, and add it to the inner pot of the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 准备工作做好，然后就是启动，IH 米家电饭煲的煮粥功能，1个半小时，程序结束，酸甜可口的银耳汤就可以喝了，如果你不在，米家电饭煲还有保温功能，会在你回家的时候，喝到温暖的汤；
steps.content_en: After the preparations are done, start the porridge cooking function of the IH Mijia rice cooker. After 1 and a half hours, the program ends, and the sweet and sour white fungus soup is ready to drink. If you are away, the Mijia rice cooker also has a heat preservation function, so you will have warm soup when you get home;

steps.content_zh: 完成咯
steps.content_en: Done

name_en: Longan and Red Date Laba Porridge
description_zh: “小孩小孩你别馋， 过了腊八就是年。 腊八粥喝几天， 哩哩啦啦二十三。 二十三糖瓜粘。 二十四扫房子。 二十五做豆腐。 二十六煮煮肉， 二十七杀年鸡， 二十八把面发， 二十九蒸馒头， 三十晚上玩一宿， 大年初一扭一扭” 腊八节，我用米家IH电饭煲预约了一锅的桂圆红枣腊八粥，食材都放入电饭煲中，选择预约功能，第二天，一早起床就可以喝上热乎乎的腊八粥了，是不是再也不用担心早上起不来了。
description_en: 'Child, child, don't be greedy—once Laba arrives, the New Year is near. Eat Laba porridge for a few days, and soon it's the 23rd. On the 23rd, sticky sugar candy; on the 24th, sweep the house; on the 25th, make tofu; on the 26th, cook meat; on the 27th, kill the New Year chicken; on the 28th, let the dough rise; on the 29th, steam buns; on New Year's Eve, play all night; on New Year's Day, dance a jig.' For the Laba Festival, I used the Mi Home IH Rice Cooker's timer to make longan and red date Laba porridge. I put all the ingredients in the cooker, set the timer, and the next morning woke up to hot porridge—no more worrying about getting up early!
tips_zh: 这个放什么种类和多少都根据个人喜好而已，非常简单的。
tips_en: Add whatever you like and however much you like—it's very simple.

steps.content_zh: 准备好各种食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare various ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 浸泡一晚，清洗去浮尘；把所有的食材都放入电饭煲的内胆中；加入适量的水，水位可以根据煮粥的刻度；
steps.content_en: Soak for one night and wash away the floating dust; put all the ingredients into the inner pot of the rice cooker; add an appropriate amount of water, the water level can be according to the porridge cooking scale;

steps.content_zh: 加入冰糖；冰糖的量还是根据个人的喜好；
steps.content_en: Add rock sugar; the amount of rock sugar is still based on personal preference;

steps.content_zh: 启动电饭煲，选择煮粥模式，再选择预约功能，根据你的预约时间，就会自动开始煮粥，煮好后，会进入保温模式，第二天早上就可以喝上暖暖的粥了
steps.content_en: Start the rice cooker, select the porridge cooking mode, and then select the reservation function. According to your reservation time, the porridge will automatically start cooking. After cooking, it will enter the keep warm mode, and you can have warm porridge the next morning.

steps.content_zh: 第二天，起床就只管喝粥；
steps.content_en: The next day, just drink porridge when you wake up;

steps.content_zh: 成品，喝粥咯。
steps.content_en: Finished product, drink porridge.

name_en: Green bean, sausage and tomato rice
description_zh: 一个人带两个孩子，有时候忙起来没有时间做饭，我也是想尽一切办法，做简单省事的饭菜，焖饭在家就是一种比较讨好的食物，我试过各种的搭配，每一次都能让家人心满意足的吃上两大碗。有荤有素有主食，而且只要一个电饭煲就可以完成，省时省力又好吃。白天天气好的时候，要带两个孩子出去户外活动，晒晒太阳，就提前把所有的食材准备好放进锅里，在外面玩的差不多了，手机APP上简单操作一下，等到午饭点一进家门就可以闻到喷香的饭菜味，这种感觉好极了！
description_en: Raising two kids on my own, I often don't have time to cook, so I look for simple, fuss-free meals. Stewed rice is a real crowd-pleaser at home—I've tried all kinds of combinations, and every time my family happily eats two big bowls. It's got meat, veggies, and a staple, all in one rice cooker: easy and delicious. On nice days, when I take the kids out to play in the sun, I prep everything and put it in the pot in advance. When we're done playing, a quick tap on the app means we walk in to a wonderful aroma at lunchtime—it feels great!
tips_zh: 煮饭时放的水一定要少一点，番茄和豆角煮熟后都会出水。
tips_en: Use less water when cooking the rice, since tomatoes and green beans release water as they cook.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材，西红柿、四季豆、腊肠。腊肠是我自己灌的，第一次做，五香的，味道还是不错的。四季豆我们也叫豆角，也可以换成别的豆角。
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients: tomatoes, green beans and cured sausage. I made the sausage myself for the first time, five-spice flavored, and it turned out quite good. Green beans are also called snap beans here; you can swap in other beans.

steps.content_zh: 四季豆和腊肠都分别切成小丁；
steps.content_en: Cut the green beans and sausage into small cubes;

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净，放进锅里，我家喜欢吃东北大米，煮出来的米饭颗粒感比较好；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and put it into the pot. My family likes to eat Northeastern rice, and the cooked rice has a better grainy texture;

steps.content_zh: 切好的豆角和腊肠，加入生抽、盐、黑胡椒粉拌一下，这里要注意，腊肠在制作的过程中本身就是高盐的食品，生抽也含有盐份，所以这里再放盐要适量，如果喜欢清淡点的可以不用再单独放盐；
steps.content_en: Chop the beans and sausage, add light soy sauce, salt, and black pepper and mix. Note here that the sausage itself is a high-salt food during the production process. The light soy sauce also contains salt, so add an appropriate amount of salt here. If you like it lighter, you don’t need to add salt separately;

steps.content_zh: 锅里注入适量的清水，再把拌好的豆角和腊肠倒进去，铺平；清水量就是平时正常做米饭的量就可以；
steps.content_en: Pour an appropriate amount of water into the pot, then add the mixed green beans and lap cheong sausage and spread evenly; use the same amount of water as you normally would for rice;

steps.content_zh: 西红柿洗净后把底部挖掉；
steps.content_en: Wash the tomato and scoop out the bottom;

steps.content_zh: 把挖好的西红柿放在锅里；合上锅盖，接通电源；点击手机开始烹饪图标精选烹饪。
steps.content_en: Put the dug tomatoes in the pot; close the pot lid, turn on the power; click on the phone to start cooking with selected cooking icons.

steps.content_zh: 等我回到家，一开门就闻到来自厨房的香味儿，那感觉真好；电饭煲正在保温呢；
steps.content_en: When I got home, I smelled the aroma from the kitchen as soon as I opened the door. It felt so good; the rice cooker was keeping warm;

steps.content_zh: 打开锅盖，做好的饭菜已经等着我了；
steps.content_en: When I opened the lid of the pot, the cooked meal was already waiting for me;

steps.content_zh: 用筷子挑去西红柿上的皮，再用锅铲翻拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Lift off the tomato skins with chopsticks, then stir well with a spatula;

steps.content_zh: 装碗，开吃。
steps.content_en: Put the bowl in and start eating.

description_zh:
这碗红豆芋头汤，是我从一位微博好友那学来的，喜欢红豆，喜欢芋头，却从来没想过把它们组合在一起，配以红糖，煮出甜蜜的味道。
总有人在朋友圈里发一些鸡汤文，说女人，一定要好好爱自己，好好照顾自己。有时候真的很想问，你会做饭吗？你会煮汤吗？如果你连饭都不会为自己做，连汤都不会为自己煮，真的就能好好爱自己了么？！
这碗甜蜜滋润的汤水，煮给自己，不需要多高强的厨艺，只要一个电饭煲而已！
description_en: I learned this red bean and taro soup from a friend online. I love both, but never thought to combine them until adding brown sugar for a sweet finish. People always post inspirational quotes telling women to love themselves—but can you cook? Can you make soup? If not, how can you truly care for yourself? This sweet, nourishing soup needs no fancy skills, just a rice cooker!
tips_zh: 红糖的量可以根据个人口味自行调节。
tips_en: Adjust the amount of brown sugar to taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好红小豆、红糖、小芋头；红小豆提前一晚泡上水；
steps.content_en: Prepare red adzuki beans, brown sugar, and taro; soak the red adzuki beans in water one night in advance;

steps.content_zh: 芋头洗净去皮切成滚刀块；
steps.content_en: Wash, peel and cut the taro into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 把切好的芋头、泡好的红小豆、红糖一起放进电饭煲里；注入适量的清水，我是放到煮粥档的水位线最高处；
steps.content_en: Put the chopped taro, soaked red adzuki beans, and brown sugar into the rice cooker; pour in an appropriate amount of water, I put it at the highest water level of the porridge setting;

steps.content_zh: 用手机APP操控一下，设置煮粥程序1小时30分；
steps.content_en: Set the porridge program to 1 hour 30 minutes in the app;

steps.content_zh: 一碗可以消肿去湿的营养汤水就可以出锅了；怎么样，够简单吧！
steps.content_en: A bowl of nutritious soup that can reduce swelling and remove dampness is ready; how about it, it’s simple enough!

steps.content_zh: 7.这三种食材，红豆消肿去湿热量低，多食不胖，红糖补气养血，芋头化痰散结益脾胃，轻轻松松煮一锅汤水，滋润一下自己吧！
steps.content_en: 7. Of these three ingredients, red beans reduce swelling and dampness and are low in calories. Eat more and you will not gain weight. Brown sugar nourishes qi and blood. Taro dissolves phlegm and stagnation and benefits the spleen and stomach. You can easily boil a pot of soup to moisturize yourself!

description_zh:
每年过年的时候都会包很多的饺子，买肉剁馅，自然就会剩下不少的猪肉皮。我特别喜欢把这些剩下的猪肉皮收集在一起，清洗干净，刮去油脂，小火慢炖，放凉结冻，做上好多份肉皮冻，拌上蒜汁，就是一道爽口营养的小凉菜
    据说，经常食用肉皮，可使皮肤丰润饱满，富有弹性，平整光滑，防瘪减皱，靓你肌肤，美你毛发。 像我们生活在干燥的北方，冬天又是人的皮肤容易缺水的季节，这时皱纹会悄悄地爬上眼角，然后向整个面部延伸。人体皮肤之所以出现皱纹，是由于皮肤细胞贮水功能发生障碍，细胞结合水的能力下降，可塑性衰减，弹性降低，黏膜干燥所致。要延缓或减少皱纹的出现，就必须摄入一些能提高结合力的胶原蛋白和弹性蛋白。肉皮正是富含胶原蛋白的食物，对减皱美容有特效。
    做肉皮冻没有什么技术含量，但是却是一个很耗时间的事情，以往做肉皮冻都是放在汤锅里小火煮三个小时左右，让肉皮里的胶质全部释放到汤水里，使汤水变的黏稠，因为要煮的时间很久，开着灶火，中途有点什么事，也不能随意出门，否则就得关火，等回来再继续煮，这次换了电饭煲来做肉皮冻，就没有这个顾虑了。
description_en:
Every year during the Chinese New Year, I make a lot of dumplings and buy meat to chop the fillings, so naturally there will be a lot of pork skin left over. I especially like to collect the remaining pork skins together, clean them, scrape off the grease, simmer them over low heat, let them cool and freeze, make multiple portions of pork skin jelly, mix them with garlic sauce, and it will be a refreshing and nutritious cold dish.
    It is said that regular consumption of meat skin can make the skin plump, elastic, smooth, anti-wrinkle, beautiful skin, and beautiful hair. As we live in the dry north, winter is the season when human skin is easily dehydrated. At this time, wrinkles will quietly creep up to the corners of the eyes and then extend to the entire face. Wrinkles appear on human skin because the water storage function of skin cells is impaired, the ability of cells to bind water is reduced, plasticity is attenuated, elasticity is reduced, and mucous membranes are dry. To delay or reduce the appearance of wrinkles, you must consume some collagen and elastin that can improve bonding. Meat skin is a food rich in collagen, which has special effects on wrinkle reduction and beauty.
    There is no technical content in making pork skin jelly, but it is a very time-consuming task. In the past, pork skin jelly was cooked on low heat in a soup pot for about three hours, so that all the colloid in the meat skin is released into the soup, making the soup thick. Because it takes a long time to cook, if something happens in the middle of the cooking time, you can't go out at will, otherwise you have to turn off the heat and continue cooking when you come back. This time I used a rice cooker to make pork skin jelly, so I don't have to worry about it.
tips_zh: 如果猪皮上有猪毛的话可以用火稍微烤一下可去除。
tips_en: If there are pig hairs on the pig skin, it can be removed by roasting it with fire.

steps.content_zh: 准备好猪肉皮，肉皮凉水下锅，煮开去浮沫，再煮两分钟后捞出来；用刀刮去猪皮上残留的白色的肥肉，刮的越干净越好；然后用温水清洗一下；
steps.content_en: Prepare the pork skin, put the skin in a pot of cold water, boil to remove the foam, cook for another two minutes and take it out; use a knife to scrape off the remaining white fat on the pig skin, the cleaner the scraping, the better; then wash it with warm water;

steps.content_zh: 姜切片，处理好的猪皮切成小细条；
steps.content_en: Slice the ginger and cut the processed pork skin into small strips;

steps.content_zh: 把猪皮和姜片一起放进电饭煲里；
steps.content_en: Put the pork rinds and ginger slices into the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 注入清水，没入肉皮，稍稍多一点就可以；点击手机开始烹饪图标进行小火慢炖。
steps.content_en: Add water to cover the pork skin, with just a little extra; tap 'Start Cooking' on your phone to slow-cook on low heat.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，打开锅盖散去热气，放凉后可以倒入保鲜盒再放冰箱冷藏，我图省事，直接把锅胆盖了保鲜膜放冰箱里了，就成了肉皮冻，直接倒扣就出来了。切成小块蘸上调味汁就可以吃了；
steps.content_en: After cooking, open the lid to let the steam escape. Once cooled, transfer to a sealed container and refrigerate. For convenience, I just covered the inner pot with plastic wrap and chilled it — it set into aspic and turned right out when inverted. Cut into pieces and serve with dipping sauce;

steps.content_zh: 准备调味汁，我用的是蒜泥、香醋、生抽、盐、香油调拌的；
steps.content_en: Prepare the sauce, I use minced garlic, balsamic vinegar, light soy sauce, salt, and sesame oil;

steps.content_zh: 把切好的肉皮冻摆好，浇上调料汁，再切点青椒碎放在上面装饰一下。这样就可以开吃了。
steps.content_en: Arrange the cut meat jelly, pour the sauce on it, and cut some green peppers on top to decorate. Then you can start eating.

description_zh: 小米IH电饭煲确实功能强悍，没曾想用它做的菠菜戚风蛋糕完全可以媲美烤箱版的戚风，入口绵软，云朵般的口感！儿子说还不如以后就用它来做蛋糕了。
description_en: The Xiaomi IH rice cooker is truly powerful—to my surprise, its spinach chiffon cake rivals an oven-baked one, soft as a cloud! My son says we should just use it for cakes from now on.
tips_zh:
1、打发蛋白的容器和工具一定要无油、无水、无蛋黄。
2、细砂糖要在打发蛋清过程中分三次倒入。
3、烘焙完成后要及时倒扣取出，不然会缩小影响口感和外观。
tips_en:
1. The containers and tools used to whip egg whites must be free of oil, water and egg yolk.
2. Pour the fine sugar in three times during the process of beating the egg whites.
3. After baking, take it out in time, otherwise it will shrink and affect the taste and appearance.

steps.content_zh: 菠菜洗净控水，用原汁机分离出菠菜汁；
steps.content_en: Wash and drain the spinach, then extract the juice with a juicer;

steps.content_zh: 准备蛋糕所需的食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients needed for the cake;

steps.content_zh: 分离蛋白蛋黄，将蛋黄内加入10克白糖、油、波菜汁打匀，加入低粉拌匀备用；
steps.content_en: Separate the egg whites from the egg yolks, add 10 grams of sugar, oil and spinach juice to the egg yolks and beat well, then add the flour and mix well and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 蛋白用电动打蛋器打发至有鸟嘴状；（干性发泡）
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until they form bird's-beak peaks (stiff peaks);

steps.content_zh: 这是打发好的蛋黄糊和蛋白，取三分之一的蛋黄糊到蛋白糊中切拌均匀，再将其全部倒入剩余的蛋白中切拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Here are the whipped yolk batter and whites. Fold one third of the yolk batter into the whites, then fold everything back into the remaining whites;

steps.content_zh: 将蛋糊全部倒入电饭煲的内胆中；
steps.content_en: Pour all the egg batter into the inner pot of the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 上下振动几下内胆，排出蛋糊内的大气泡，放入电饭煲；点击开始烹饪图标进行烘焙。
steps.content_en: Vibrate the inner pot up and down a few times to expel large bubbles in the egg batter, then put it into the rice cooker; click the start cooking icon to start baking.

steps.content_zh: 开盖有惊喜，漂亮的菠菜蛋糕涨得好高呀；
steps.content_en: There is a surprise when you open the lid, the beautiful spinach cake has risen so high;

steps.content_zh: 切开看也是完美的内部组织；
steps.content_en: Even when cut open, the internal structure is perfect;

steps.content_zh: 用它来做了一道鸡年美美的下午茶小点心。
steps.content_en: I used it to make a lovely afternoon tea treat for the Year of the Rooster.

description_zh: 小米IH电饭煲是IH电磁加热技术，这样的好处就是能让煮出来的食物受热更均匀，今天我就拿它成功做了红烧牛肉。用它的煲炖汤功能做出了满意的口感，共炖了90分钟。时间是比电压力锅长了点，但它慢火细炖出来的牛肉软烂但又不失牙劲，入味很深，烧出来的牛肉鲜美多汁，非常好吃!
description_en: Xiaomi IH rice cooker uses IH electromagnetic heating technology. The advantage of this is that the cooked food can be heated more evenly. Today I successfully made braised beef with it. I used its soup stewing function to create a satisfying taste and simmered it for a total of 90 minutes. The time is a little longer than that of an electric pressure cooker, but the beef cooked slowly and carefully will be tender but not chewy, with a deep flavor. The beef will be juicy and delicious!
tips_zh: 牛肉最好选择比较嫩的牛腩肉，肥瘦均匀。入口嫩滑不柴，也可以在剩余30分钟时放入土豆一起焖煮。
tips_en: It is best to choose tender beef brisket, which is evenly fat and lean. It is tender and smooth in the mouth. You can also add potatoes and simmer it together for the remaining 30 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 炒锅内放少许油；
steps.content_en: Put a little oil in the wok;

steps.content_zh: 放入香料等小火焙香；
steps.content_en: Add spices and other ingredients and roast over low heat until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 把香料挪开，放入豆瓣酱小火煎出红油；
steps.content_en: Remove the spices, add bean paste and fry over low heat until red oil is produced;

steps.content_zh: 放入干辣椒粉小火炒出红油；
steps.content_en: Add dried chili powder and fry over low heat to produce red oil;

steps.content_zh: 放入冰糖小火炒融化；
steps.content_en: Add rock sugar and melt over low heat.

steps.content_zh: 放入葱姜爆香；
steps.content_en: Add onions and ginger and sauté until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 加入浸泡一夜去了血水的牛肉块；
steps.content_en: Add the beef cubes soaked overnight to remove the blood;

steps.content_zh: 加入生抽、老抽、料酒；
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and cooking wine;

steps.content_zh: 炒匀；将牛肉倒入电饭煲内锅中，加入开水，撒入盐。
steps.content_en: Stir well; transfer the beef to the rice cooker's inner pot, add boiling water, and sprinkle in salt.

steps.content_zh: 准备好了，点击开始烹饪进行焖煮；
steps.content_en: When ready, click Start Cooking to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 好吃看得见。
steps.content_en: Delicious to see.

description_zh: 竹笋、香菇和少许宣威火腿。小火慢炖出来的汤原汁原味，放少许的盐调味，没有放味精和鸡精也很鲜美。
description_en: Bamboo shoots, shiitake mushrooms and a little Xuanwei ham. Slow-simmered over low heat, the soup keeps its natural flavor; with just a pinch of salt it is delicious even without MSG or chicken bouillon.
tips_zh: 火腿是咸的煮汤后汤中含有盐分，所以放盐的时候要尝一下是否会过咸。
tips_en: Ham is salty and the soup will contain salt after cooking, so when adding salt, you should taste it to see if it is too salty.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 香菇用洗净后用温水泡发，火腿用温水洗净；
steps.content_en: Wash the shiitake mushrooms and soak in warm water to rehydrate; rinse the ham with warm water;

steps.content_zh: 毛笋和雷笋却皮，切去咬不动的部分（用指甲掐进去掐不动），切滚刀块；
steps.content_en: Peel the bamboo shoots, cut off the tough parts (those you can't pierce with a fingernail), and cut into chunks;

steps.content_zh: 香菇片后与火腿同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击开始烹饪图标进行煲汤。
steps.content_en: Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and ham to the pot together, add water to the porridge -1 mark on the water level line, then tap the Start Cooking icon to cook the soup.

steps.content_zh: 竹笋在放了盐的沸水中焯水，去除青涩味，捞出后放入饭煲。
steps.content_en: Blanch the bamboo shoots in salted boiling water to remove the raw, astringent taste, drain, then put them in the rice cooker.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入少许的盐调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with a little salt.

description_zh: 最近几年黄焖鸡风靡全国，因其鸡肉鲜嫩，汤汁鲜美而出名。其实做法很简单，再配上一碗米饭，简直是绝世美味！
description_en: Braised chicken has become popular all over the country in recent years and is famous for its tender chicken and delicious soup. In fact, the preparation is very simple, and when paired with a bowl of rice, it is simply delicious!
tips_zh:
1、鸡肉要选择童子鸡或者鸡腿，因为肉质比较嫩。如果用土鸡的话要增加烹饪时间和水量。
2、喜欢吃辣的同学可以多放些辣椒
3、习惯用汤汁泡饭的可以泡香菇时多放些水，然后将泡香菇的水与鸡肉一起炖。
tips_en:
1. Use a young chicken or chicken thighs for tender meat. If using free-range chicken, increase the cooking time and water.
2. Add more chilies if you like it spicy.
3. If you enjoy rice with broth, use extra water to soak the shiitake, then braise the chicken with that soaking liquid.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料有这些；
steps.content_en: The ingredients are as follows;

steps.content_zh: 童子鸡洗净后用耗油、生抽、小葱、生姜和料酒腌制半小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the young chicken and marinate with oyster sauce, light soy sauce, scallions, ginger and cooking wine for half an hour;

steps.content_zh: 香菇洗净后用温水泡发。泡好后切片，泡香菇的水留用；
steps.content_en: Wash the shiitake mushrooms and soak in warm water to rehydrate. Once soft, slice them and reserve the soaking liquid;

steps.content_zh: 将腌制好的鸡肉和腌料倒入锅中，同时将放入香菇和泡香菇的水。将锅胆放入饭煲中，点击开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the marinated chicken and marinade into the pot, and add the mushrooms and the water used to soak them. Put the pot into the rice cooker and click the start cooking icon to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪 的同时将彩椒切片；
steps.content_en: Slice bell peppers while cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时放入彩椒，继续焖煮到结束为止；
steps.content_en: With 5 minutes left, add the bell peppers and simmer until done;

steps.content_zh: 完成后盛出；
steps.content_en: Serve when finished;

steps.content_zh: 开吃吧。
steps.content_en: Let's eat.

description_zh:
在老上海一般大众只有煤球炉的年代，泡饭一般单纯是用热水泡的，很少人家会用煤油炉加热。现在当然通常会用煤气灶烧一下或者微波炉转一下，约略可以等同于稀饭。
  上海人吃泡饭的缘起或许与生活环境的阈限和经济条件的逼仄有关，以往一般上海人家里的煤球炉或者煤饼炉主要用途是买菜回家后做饭使用，早晨一般无法赶早迅速烧出开水来洗脸、烧粥，另外煤炉需要长时间有人值守，也是很不方便的，一般他们会花点小钱从老虎灶打水，这无论在时间上还是经济上都俭省。老虎灶开水和剩饭的组合就是泡饭，这和上海人追求实惠的精神也息息相关。
  但是当泡饭成为这座城市的饮食文化基因之后，却也超越了阶层限制，无论是在赫德路的爱林登公寓，霞飞路的新康花园，抑或是蕃瓜弄、十六铺，早晨一碗泡饭，也无论是搭配栗子蛋糕、奶油小方、蝴蝶酥、羊角面包、水煮蛋和烤吐司条，还是就只有油条蘸酱油、咸菜，泡饭在阿拉的早餐中几乎不可或缺。
description_en: In old Shanghai, when most people only had coal stoves, paofan was simply rice soaked in hot water; few heated it on a kerosene stove. Today it's usually warmed on a gas stove or in a microwave—much like thin congee. The custom may have come from cramped living conditions and tight budgets: coal stoves were for cooking after market trips, and mornings were too rushed to boil water for washing and porridge, while tending the stove took constant attention. People saved time and money by buying hot water from the tiger-stove shop. Hot water plus leftover rice is paofan—a reflection of Shanghai's practical spirit. Yet once paofan became part of the city's culinary DNA, it transcended class: whether in the Ealing apartments on Hertford Road, the Xin Kang Gardens on Avenue Joffre, or in Fangua Lane and Shiliupu, a morning bowl of paofan—paired with chestnut cake, cream squares, palmiers, croissants, boiled eggs and toast sticks, or simply youtiao dipped in soy sauce and pickles—is almost indispensable to our breakfast.
tips_zh:
1.喜欢吃硬一点的泡饭，可以将烹饪时间调整为20分钟左右。
2.如果青菜比较大或者比较老，需要将青菜切成段后放入。
tips_en:
1. If you like to eat harder rice, you can adjust the cooking time to about 20 minutes.
2. If the vegetables are large or old, you need to cut the vegetables into sections and put them in.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将剩米饭倒入锅中，加入水超过米饭2厘米即可；
steps.content_en: Pour the remaining rice into the pot and add water to cover the rice by 2 cm;

steps.content_zh: 香肠切片倒入；
steps.content_en: Slice the sausage and add it in;

steps.content_zh: 香菇泡发后切片倒入锅中；
steps.content_en: Soak the mushrooms and then slice them into pieces and add them to the pot;

steps.content_zh: 直接点击开始烹饪图标进行烹饪。
steps.content_en: Simply tap the Start Cooking icon to begin.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时放入洗好的上海青后继续焖煮。
steps.content_en: When there are 5 minutes left in the cooking time, add the washed Shanghai greens and continue to simmer.

steps.content_zh: 完成后放入少许盐和胡椒粉调味即可。
steps.content_en: When done, season with a little salt and pepper.

name_en: Spring Bamboo Shoot and Free-Range Chicken Soup
description_zh:
一声春雷，唤醒了春笋。它们冲破泥土，掀翻石块，一个一个从地里冒出来。
春笋裹着浅褐色的外衣，像嫩生生的娃娃。它们迎着春风，在阳光中笑，在春雨里长。一节，一节，又一节。向上，向上，再向上。
原汁原味的鸡汤里放上清香鲜嫩的春笋，炖好后满屋子都是鸡汤的香味，鲜味简直无法用语言表达。
description_en: A spring thunderclap wakes the bamboo shoots. They break through the soil, push aside stones, and pop out of the ground one by one. Wrapped in light brown husks like tender babies, they greet the spring breeze, smile in the sunshine, and grow in the spring rain—joint by joint, upward, upward, ever upward. Add these fragrant, tender shoots to a plain chicken soup, and once it's done the whole house smells of broth—the umami is beyond words.
tips_zh:
1、鸡肉要选择土鸡，这样煲出来的汤才够香。
2、笋入锅前要焯水，去除涩味。
3、葱、姜和料酒不能少。
tips_en:
1. Use a free-range chicken for a fragrant soup.
2. Blanch the bamboo shoots first to remove their astringency.
3. Don't skip the scallions, ginger, and cooking wine.

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 生姜拍松、毛笋去壳切成滚刀块、小葱打成葱结；
steps.content_en: Floss the ginger, peel the bamboo shoots and cut them into hob pieces, and tie the green onions into knots;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的笋在沸水中焯水；
steps.content_en: Blanch the cut bamboo shoots in boiling water;

steps.content_zh: 土鸡焯水后冲洗干净；
steps.content_en: Blanch the chicken and rinse thoroughly;

steps.content_zh:
饭煲中放入土鸡、竹笋、葱姜，倒入料酒，加水到最大水位线。
点击开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Put the free-range chicken, bamboo shoots, scallions and ginger in the rice cooker, pour in cooking wine, and add water to the max water level line.
Tap the Start Cooking icon to cook;

steps.content_zh: 小火慢炖2小时后，放入盐调味；
steps.content_en: After simmering for 2 hours, add salt to taste;

steps.content_zh: 只放了盐，没有放其他的调味品。鸡汤呈金黄色、鸡肉不柴，汤更是鲜美无比。
steps.content_en: Only salt was added—no other seasonings. The broth is golden, the chicken isn't dry, and the soup is exceptionally delicious.

description_zh:
节假日吃多了油腻难消化的食物。这个时节正是吃菠菜的好时候，菠菜所含的营养不仅种类众多，且大部分营养的含量要比其他蔬菜多好几倍，因而被称为“营养的宝库”。
而且这道菜清淡爽口，含有大量的膳食纤维，能改善肠道功能。，同时用的是生的红衣花生，生吃花生好处多多，能调节身体机能，改善肠胃。放了脆脆的腰果，口感更佳。
description_en: During holidays we eat too much rich, hard-to-digest food. This is the perfect season for spinach: it contains a wide variety of nutrients, most in amounts several times higher than other vegetables, earning it the name 'treasure trove of nutrition.' This dish is light and refreshing, with plenty of dietary fiber to improve bowel function. It also uses raw red-skin peanuts, which have many benefits, helping regulate body functions and improve the stomach and intestines. Adding crunchy cashews makes it even better.
tips_zh:
1、菠菜不要煮的太久，不仅影响口感，营养物质也会流失。
2、生吃花生一定要把花生米洗净，也可以油炸后在拌入。
3、酱汁可以根据个人口味自己调制。
tips_en:
1. Don't boil the spinach too long—it ruins the texture and loses nutrients.
2. If eating the peanuts raw, wash them well; you can also fry them first and then toss.
3. Adjust the dressing to taste.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加入水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，放入少许盐，点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level line: northeast rice -2 mark, add a little salt, click to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 大约6分钟后水烧开，放入洗净的菠菜，煮1分钟左右；
steps.content_en: After about 6 minutes, the water will boil, add the washed spinach and cook for about 1 minute;

steps.content_zh: 煮好后立即捞出，过凉水。冷却后挤干水分切段；
steps.content_en: Remove immediately after cooking and rinse under cold water. Once cool, squeeze out excess water and cut into sections;

steps.content_zh: 大蒜剁成蒜末，加入陈醋、芝麻油、辣椒油和盐调成酱汁；
steps.content_en: Chop the garlic into minced garlic, add vinegar, sesame oil, chili oil and salt to make a sauce;

steps.content_zh: 将菠菜段和花生米混合，用调好的酱汁搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Mix the spinach segments and peanuts, and stir evenly with the prepared sauce;

steps.content_zh: 取一个碗，底部放上腰果，用搅拌好的菠菜填满，压实后倒扣出。
steps.content_en: Take a bowl, put cashews on the bottom, fill it with the stirred spinach, compact it and pour it out.

description_zh:
这道菜最大的优点就是：简单！简单！简单！
蒜蓉蒸金针菇，不一样的口感，脆脆的，再配上自己做的蒜蓉，味道简直了，光盘！比吃肉还过瘾！
description_en: Its best quality is: simple! Simple! Simple! Steamed enoki mushrooms with garlic are crisp and different; with homemade garlic sauce, they're so good the plate is licked clean—better than meat!
tips_zh:
1、炒蒜蓉酱的时候要小火，蒜蓉容易炒糊锅。
2、不要一次性放太多蒸鱼豉油或者生抽，如果蒸好后觉得不入味，可以再次放入少许。
3、蒜蓉酱中还可以放入少许剁椒增加风味，注意剁椒特别咸。
tips_en:
1. Fry the garlic sauce over low heat—garlic scorches easily.
2. Don't add too much steamed fish soy sauce or light soy sauce at once; you can add a little more after steaming if needed.
3. A bit of chopped chili can liven up the garlic sauce, but it's very salty.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击开始烹饪图标；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 2 mark, then tap the Start Cooking icon;

steps.content_zh: 烧水的同时剁蒜蓉、切辣椒；
steps.content_en: While boiling water, mince garlic and slice chili peppers;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅大火烧热后，放入色拉油和芝麻油转小火，放入蒜蓉和辣椒圈；
steps.content_en: After the wok is heated over high heat, add salad oil and sesame oil, turn to low heat, add minced garlic and chili rings;

steps.content_zh: 炒到变色的时候关火，用余温加热；
steps.content_en: When it changes color, turn off the heat and let the residual heat finish cooking;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸鱼豉油调味；
steps.content_en: Season with steamed fish soy sauce.

steps.content_zh: 将做好的蒜蓉酱倒在金针菇上。同时锅中烧的水差不多沸腾了，将蒸笼放入饭煲中，蒸约8分钟；
steps.content_en: Pour the prepared garlic sauce over the enoki mushrooms. Meanwhile, the water in the pot is nearly boiling—place the steamer in the rice cooker and steam for about 8 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 蒸好后，金针菇的汁水已经蒸出来了，鲜甜爽口；
steps.content_en: When done, the enoki mushrooms have released their juices — sweet, fresh and refreshing;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 鹌鹑蛋，过年的时候必须的一款小食，提前卤好，一直浸泡着，等客人来了，那就直接可以盛起来，上桌，在开饭前，可以先吃鹌鹑蛋，卤鹌鹑蛋，香味十足，很美味哦～～
description_en: Quail eggs are a must-have snack during the Chinese New Year. They are marinated in advance and kept soaked. When the guests arrive, they can be scooped up and served directly. Before the meal, you can eat quail eggs first. Braised quail eggs are full of flavor and delicious~~
tips_zh: 可以根据自己的口味调整盐的量，但太少不易入味。
tips_en: You can adjust the amount of salt according to your own taste, but too little will make it taste bad.

steps.content_zh: 鹌鹑蛋，清洗干净备用；
steps.content_en: Quail eggs, cleaned and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 准备好调料，放入一小碗中，备用；
steps.content_en: Prepare the seasoning, put it into a small bowl and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 米家电饭煲内胆中，加入 卤味包，和上面的调料，加入适量的水，淹没鹌鹑蛋为宜 ；
steps.content_en: In the Mijia cooker's inner pot, add the braising spice bag and the above seasonings, then add enough water to cover the quail eggs;

steps.content_zh: 放入鹌鹑蛋，水要淹没鹌鹑蛋哦 ；
steps.content_en: Put in the quail eggs, the water should cover the quail eggs;

steps.content_zh: 点击手机开始烹饪图标，进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Tap the Start Cooking icon on your phone to cook;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪大概是15 分钟的样子，打开锅盖，用勺子，把鹌鹑蛋一个个都慢慢的敲破，为了更加入味 ；
steps.content_en: After about 15 minutes, open the lid and use a spoon to gently crack each quail egg so it absorbs more flavor;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成就可以了，为了更加的入味，可以继续浸泡在锅中过夜 ；
steps.content_en: Cooking is done; for deeper flavor, leave it soaking in the pot overnight;

steps.content_zh: 成品。
steps.content_en: Finished product.

description_zh: 山楂好吃，但是新鲜山楂存放的不好，容易烂，我就想着做成山楂酱之类的，酸酸甜甜的，可以淋在面包上或者各类甜点上。自制的山楂酱，没有添加防腐剂。只用山楂和砂糖、冰糖熬制而成的，绿色食品，营养又美味，酸甜适中；爱吃番茄酱的俩宝，都喜欢吃，特别是小宝，不过，小盆友也不能一次吃太多哦。山楂酱功效在于消食，其富含维生素C及多种有机酸，能增加胃中消化酶的分泌增加其活性，从而起到促进消化的效果。
description_en: Hawthorn is delicious, but fresh hawthorn stores poorly and rots easily, so I thought of making hawthorn sauce—sweet and tart, drizzled over bread or desserts. Homemade, with no preservatives: just hawthorn, granulated sugar and rock sugar. Green and nutritious, with a balanced sweet-sour taste. My two kids, who love ketchup, both enjoy it, especially the younger one—but little ones should not eat too much at once. Hawthorn sauce aids digestion: rich in vitamin C and organic acids, it boosts digestive enzyme secretion and activity.
tips_zh: 每100克山楂果肉中的维生素C含量高达73毫克，是苹果是15倍，含钙量也达到52毫克，在水果中也是首屈一指的。
tips_en: The vitamin C content in every 100 grams of hawthorn pulp is as high as 73 mg, which is 15 times that of apples. The calcium content also reaches 52 mg, which is second to none among fruits.

steps.content_zh: 山楂，准备好，用专用工具，去除山楂里面的籽，没有专门工具可以用钢笔套；
steps.content_en: Prepare the hawthorn. Use a special tool to remove the seeds from the hawthorn. If you don’t have a special tool, you can use a pen cover;

steps.content_zh: 山楂，去除好籽后，清洗干净，上面撒少许的盐，均匀的搅拌下，腌制15分钟；
steps.content_en: Remove the seeds from the hawthorn, clean it, sprinkle a little salt on it, stir evenly, and marinate for 15 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 腌制好后，用水冲去表面的盐分，清洗下，放入电饭煲内胆中，加入适量的水；
steps.content_en: After marinating, rinse off the surface salt, wash it, place in the rice cooker's inner pot, and add an appropriate amount of water;

steps.content_zh: 点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪，这样就可以忙其他的事情了；
steps.content_en: Tap the Start Cooking icon on your phone to cook, so you can attend to other things;

steps.content_zh: 在功能结束前20分钟的时候，加入冰糖，搅拌下，继续盖好，等程序结束；
steps.content_en: 20 minutes before the end of the function, add rock sugar, stir, continue to cover, and wait for the program to end;

steps.content_zh: 程序结束后，搅拌下就已经很碎了，也比较的浓稠了；
steps.content_en: After the program ends, just stir and it will break down and become nicely thick;

steps.content_zh: 用料理机，把煮好的山楂加入进去，搅拌成山楂糊糊，放入平底不粘锅；
steps.content_en: Blend the cooked hawthorn berries in a food processor into a paste, then transfer to a nonstick skillet;

steps.content_zh: 加入，几滴的柠檬汁；
steps.content_en: Add a few drops of lemon juice;

steps.content_zh: 放入冰糖和白砂糖都可以，小火慢熬 ；
steps.content_en: Add rock sugar or granulated sugar and simmer gently.

steps.content_zh: 一定要小火慢慢的熬煮，不断的用勺子搅拌，以防止糊底，看着山楂的颜色慢慢的变得鲜花深起来，也就差不多了 ；
steps.content_en: Be sure to simmer slowly over low heat, stirring constantly with a spoon to prevent the bottom from being burnt. Watch as the color of the hawthorn slowly becomes darker than a flower, and that’s it;

steps.content_zh: 也可以用手指在勺子上划一下，看着不粘合，浓稠了，就可以准备，干净的玻璃瓶，用沸水清洗干净，无水无油，装好，倒扣，待凉，盖好盖子，放入冰箱中，存放起来；
steps.content_en: You can also use your fingers to mark it on a spoon. If it doesn't stick and is thick, you can prepare a clean glass bottle, wash it with boiling water, no water and no oil, put it in place, turn it upside down, let it cool, cover it, put it in the refrigerator, and store it;

steps.content_zh: 成品。
steps.content_en: Finished product.

description_zh: 上次做了蜜豆没有吃完，便用它来做了包子。吃起来虽然没有豆沙包那样细腻、滑口，但也十分香甜，并且还有点嚼头，真的很不错。
description_en: Leftover honey beans from last time became steamed buns. Not as smooth as red bean paste buns, but still sweet with a pleasant chew—really quite good.
tips_zh:
1、做包子的面团最好软一点，面粉的吸水量不一样，倒水和面的时候不要一次全部倒入，最好分几次倒入
2、包子包好后一定要醒发，冬天时间会长些，夏天会短些
3、包子蒸好后不要立马开盖，否则包子会回缩
tips_en:
1. The dough for making steamed buns should be softer. The amount of water absorbed by flour is different. When pouring water into the dough, do not pour it all at once. It is best to pour it in several times.
2. The buns must be left to rise after being wrapped. The time will be longer in winter and shorter in summer.
3. Do not open the lid immediately after steaming the buns, otherwise the buns will shrink.

steps.content_zh: 备好所需食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 面粉里放入糖和酵母混合均匀，再倒入温水和面，直到把面团揉至光滑，覆盖保鲜膜放置15-20分钟；
steps.content_en: Add sugar and yeast to the flour and mix well, then pour in warm water and knead until the dough is smooth; cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 15-20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 面团醒好后搓成长条，平均分成小份；
steps.content_en: After the dough has risen, roll it into a long strip and divide it into small portions;

steps.content_zh: 将小面团擀成圆形的面皮，再将蜜豆放在面皮中间；
steps.content_en: Roll the small dough into a round shape and place the honey beans in the middle of the dough;

steps.content_zh: 一个褶一个褶的捏压起来，最后封好口就包好了；
steps.content_en: Pinch and press pleat by pleat, and finally seal it and wrap it up;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加水，到水位线：东北米-2的刻度；在蒸笼内铺上不粘垫（或刷油），把包好的包子坯放入其中，盖上盖子醒发约30分钟，待包子发起来后开始烹饪，上气后蒸12分钟
steps.content_en: Add water to the inner pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 2 mark; line the steamer with a non-stick mat (or brush with oil), place the wrapped raw buns inside, cover and let rise for about 30 minutes. Once the buns have risen, start cooking; steam for 12 minutes after the steam comes out.

steps.content_zh: 蒸好后再焖5分钟左右即可取出。
steps.content_en: After steaming, let it stand for about 5 minutes before removing.

description_zh: 这道饭菜合一的"香肠煲饭"，做法特别简单，只需将处理好的食材放进电饭煲里烹饪，煮好之后拌入调料就可以享用。虽然简单，但不失美味，并且有荤有素的搭配，营养也非常全面。
description_en: This all-in-one 'sausage claypot rice' is very easy: just put the prepared ingredients in the rice cooker, then stir in the seasoning when done. Simple yet delicious, with both meat and vegetables for balanced nutrition.
tips_zh:
1、香肠可以是麻辣的，也可以是广式甜味的，自己喜欢就行
2、在大米里放点盐可以有点底味
3、煮饭的水量不宜过多，否则煮好的米饭太软，黏黏糊糊的影响口感，最好是粒粒分明会有点嚼劲
4、喜欢吃锅巴的话可以选择锅巴饭模式
tips_en:
1. Use spicy or sweet Cantonese sausage—whatever you like.
2. A little salt in the rice gives it a base flavor.
3. Don't add too much water, or the rice will be mushy; aim for separate grains with a little chew.
4. If you like crispy rice crust, choose the crispy rice mode.

steps.content_zh: 好所需食材；
steps.content_en: Good ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 香肠切片，胡萝卜去皮切丁；
steps.content_en: Slice the sausage, peel and dice the carrot;

steps.content_zh: 大米倒入电饭锅内胆中，淘洗干净后放入少许盐，并倒入清水稍稍搅拌一下；
steps.content_en: Pour the rice into the rice cooker, wash it thoroughly, add a little salt, pour in water and stir briefly;

steps.content_zh: 将玉米粒、胡萝卜粒和香肠平铺在上面，开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Spread corn kernels, carrot kernels and sausage on top and start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 煮饭期间来配调味料，将蚝油和味极鲜放在一起搅拌均匀备用；
steps.content_en: While the rice is cooking, add the seasonings, stir together the oyster sauce and fenjixian, and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 待程序结束后倒入调味料，再继续保温10分钟；
steps.content_en: After the program is finished, pour in the seasonings and keep warm for another 10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 最后将煮熟的米饭和食材混合均匀就可以盛出开吃啦。
steps.content_en: Finally, mix the cooked rice and ingredients evenly, then serve and enjoy.

description_zh: 用一句话来描述这道菜，那就是非常简单、非常好吃！厨房小白也能轻松完成哦！
description_en: In a word, this dish is simple and delicious! Even a kitchen beginner can make it easily!
tips_zh:
1、排骨要选择仔排，不要买大骨头肉太少。
2、如果单独蒸排骨的话大约需要40分钟。
tips_en:
1. Choose young ribs—big bones have too little meat.
2. If steaming the ribs on their own, allow about 40 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 仔排洗净后滤干水分，最好能用厨房纸巾吸干水分，用蒸肉粉搅拌均匀，让每个排骨都能裹上蒸肉粉；
steps.content_en: Wash the pork ribs and drain the water. It is best to use kitchen towels to absorb the water. Use steamed pork powder and stir evenly so that each rib can be coated with steamed pork powder;

steps.content_zh: 取一个小盘子，能放进蒸笼中的，将排骨码放在盘子中，
steps.content_en: Take a small plate that can fit into the steamer, and place the ribs on the plate.

steps.content_zh: 我是在煮饭的同时蒸的排骨，非常方便简单；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标就可以进行烹饪了；
steps.content_en: I steamed the ribs while cooking rice, which is very convenient and simple; just click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 完成图，一个饭，一道菜，在饭块煮好的时候炒一个蔬菜，简简单单的一餐就完成啦~~荤素搭配。
steps.content_en: To complete the picture, one rice, one dish, stir-fry a vegetable while the rice is cooked, and a simple meal is completed~~ A combination of meat and vegetables.

description_zh: 经典的川菜，简简单单的五花肉用水文火煮熟后，肉质鲜嫩，味道鲜美，黄瓜与肉片搭配，起来肥而不腻。鲜艳的红油中点缀着少许白芝麻，搭配着蒜味、陈醋的香味口感浓厚而又不失温柔。
description_en: A classic Sichuan dish: simple pork belly is gently simmered in water until the meat is tender and delicious. Paired with cucumber slices, it is rich but not greasy. The bright red oil is dotted with white sesame seeds, while garlic and aged vinegar give a bold yet gentle flavor.
tips_zh:
1、选择五花肉时要选择肥瘦相间的，不会太柴也不会太腻。
2、煮猪肉不宜过长，不然会失去口感。
3、切肉片是当然是越薄越好。
4、吃完记得刷牙哦。
tips_en:
1. Choose pork belly with alternating fat and lean—neither dry nor greasy.
2. Don't boil the pork too long, or it loses its texture.
3. Slice the meat as thinly as you can.
4. Remember to brush your teeth afterwards!

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉洗净后切成条状，与生姜、香葱、八角、香叶同时放入锅中，倒入料酒加入水稍稍没过猪肉即可，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the pork belly and cut it into strips. Put it into the pot together with ginger, chives, star anise and bay leaves. Pour in cooking wine and add water to cover the pork slightly. Click on the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 煮肉的同时。大蒜头去皮用蒜臼子捣成蒜泥；
steps.content_en: While the meat cooks, peel the garlic and crush it in a mortar into a paste;

steps.content_zh: 捣好的蒜泥中加入生抽、陈醋、辣椒油、芝麻油、葱花、白糖调成蒜蓉酱汁；
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, aged vinegar, chili oil, sesame oil, chopped green onion, and sugar to the mashed garlic to make a garlic sauce;

steps.content_zh: 黄瓜洗净后用削皮刀削成薄片；
steps.content_en: Wash the cucumber and shave into thin slices with a peeler;

steps.content_zh: 猪肉煮好后（用筷子能插透）用凉水洗净，冷却；
steps.content_en: After the pork is cooked (it can be penetrated with chopsticks), wash it with cold water and cool it;

steps.content_zh: 将猪肉切成薄片（ 考验刀工时候啦），在盘子上一层黄瓜一层肉片的摆好；
steps.content_en: Cut the pork into thin slices (it’s time to test your knife skills), and place a layer of cucumbers and a layer of meat slices on the plate;

steps.content_zh: 淋上调好的酱汁，配一杯小酒岂不快哉？
steps.content_en: Drizzle with the prepared sauce and enjoy with a glass of wine.

description_zh: 春季万物生长人体肝脏生发的时节，要注重养肝多吃绿色食物。菠菜正值上市的时节，与猪肝和枸杞一起煮成粥，易消化还能养肝护肝，排除毒素。
description_en: Spring is when everything grows and the liver flourishes, so eat more green foods to nourish it. Spinach is in season; simmered with pork liver and goji berries into porridge, it's easy to digest and helps nourish the liver and flush out toxins.
tips_zh:
1、猪肝要选择新鲜、颜色鲜艳有水分的猪肝。
2、此粥如果是给很小的宝宝吃，可以把猪肝和菠菜切的更小些甚至切成末也可。 
3、猪肝不能煮的太久，以免变硬影响口感，但也要注意，不要一味求嫩，否则，既不能有效去毒，又不能杀死病菌、寄生虫卵。因此烹调时间不能太短，至少应该使肝完全变成灰褐色，看不到血丝才好。
tips_en:
1. For pork liver, choose fresh, brightly colored and moist pork liver.
2. If this porridge is for very young babies, you can cut the pork liver and spinach into smaller pieces or even mince them. 
3. Pork liver cannot be cooked for too long, so as not to harden and affect the taste, but you must also be careful not to blindly seek tenderness, otherwise, it will not be able to effectively remove toxins, and will not be able to kill bacteria and parasite eggs. Therefore, the cooking time cannot be too short, at least the liver should be completely turned into gray-brown, and no blood streaks can be seen.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后倒入锅胆中，水加到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行煲粥；
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeastern rice and pour it into the pot. Add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark. Click the start cooking icon on your phone to cook porridge;

steps.content_zh: 煲粥的同时，将菠菜洗净后切成段，生姜切末，枸杞泡发；
steps.content_en: While cooking the porridge, wash and cut the spinach into sections, mince the ginger, and soak the goji berries;

steps.content_zh: 将猪肝切成片；在水中泡30分钟左右，去血水洗净。
steps.content_en: Cut the pork liver into slices; soak in water for about 30 minutes, then wash with water to remove blood.

steps.content_zh: 放入少许料酒、盐、姜末和淀粉上浆；
steps.content_en: Add a little cooking wine, salt, minced ginger and starch for sizing;

steps.content_zh: 煲粥的时间剩余30分钟时放入猪肝，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: When 30 minutes are left for the porridge cooking time, add the pork liver and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 同时放入枸杞后继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: At the same time, add the wolfberry and continue to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 剩余5分钟时放入洗好的菠菜；
steps.content_en: When 5 minutes are left, add washed spinach;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入盐和胡椒粉调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt and pepper.

name_en: Century Egg and Fish Slice Soup
description_zh:
皮蛋、豆腐和鱼片都是鲜嫩爽滑的食材，三者在一起共同煮成汤羹。出锅后撒上芝麻油、香菜或者小葱。搅拌均匀后香气四溢。
从营养价值上来讲，鱼片和豆腐都是优质蛋白质来源，非常适合老年人和儿童。
description_en:
Century egg, tofu, and fish slices are all tender and silky; together they make a lovely soup. Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with cilantro or scallions before serving—stir and it's beautifully fragrant.
Nutritionally, fish and tofu are excellent sources of quality protein, ideal for the elderly and children.
tips_zh:
1、一般的鱼肉都可以，最好选择鱼刺少的鱼。 
2、鱼肉切片尽量切薄些，易熟且口感好。
tips_en:
1. Any white fish works, but choose one with few bones.
2. Slice the fish as thinly as possible so it cooks quickly and tastes better.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鱼柳洗净后切薄片；
steps.content_en: Wash the fish fillet and cut into thin slices;

steps.content_zh: 用盐、胡椒粉、5毫升料酒和少许淀粉腌制（鱼片外部要薄薄得一层浆即可）；
steps.content_en: Marinate with salt, pepper, 5 ml cooking wine, and a little starch (the fish slices just need a thin coating);

steps.content_zh: 内酯豆腐切小块；
steps.content_en: Cut lactone tofu into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 皮蛋去壳切块；
steps.content_en: Shell and dice the century egg;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片后和豆腐、5毫升料酒同时倒入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the sliced ginger, tofu, and 5 ml cooking wine in the pot, add water to the 'thick porridge - 1' level, and tap Start Cooking on your phone;

steps.content_zh: 水沸腾后倒入腌制好的鱼片和皮蛋，轻轻搅拌均匀，继续煮；
steps.content_en: When the water boils, add the marinated fish slices and century egg, stir gently, and continue cooking;

steps.content_zh: 直到再次沸腾；
steps.content_en: Until it comes to a boil again;

steps.content_zh: 将剩余的淀粉加水调成淀粉水，倒入锅中勾芡，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Add the remaining starch to water to make starch water, pour it into the pot to thicken it, and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 再次煮沸即可，用盐、胡椒粉调味，最后淋上芝麻油，撒上葱花或者香菜即可出锅。
steps.content_en: Bring to a boil again, season with salt and pepper, then drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with chopped scallions or cilantro before serving.

description_zh: 记得小时候很不喜欢吃菠菜，涩涩的口感很差。后来有一天妈妈做了一道芝麻酱拌菠菜，酱汁充满了芝麻酱的香味，还有一些酸甜味，最后点缀了一些坚果，然后我一个人就能干掉一大盘。现在，这就是我最常用的吃菠菜方法。做起来无敌简单，卖相也哈好，而且只过水这样的办法也有效减少了菠菜营养的流失。
description_en: I once disliked spinach for its astringency, until Mom made it with sesame sauce, a sweet-and-sour dressing and nuts—I ate a whole plate. It's now my favorite way: easy, pretty, and blanching preserves nutrients.
tips_zh:
1、可以撒上喜欢的坚果搭配。
2、如果有多余的酱汁用来拌蔬菜沙拉也是不错的选择。
3、菠菜在沸水中煮1分钟即可，然后马上过凉水，这样不会影响色泽。
tips_en:
1. Sprinkle with your favorite nuts to finish.
2. Any leftover sauce is great tossed with a green salad.
3. Boil the spinach for just 1 minute, then plunge it into cold water to keep its color.

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，倒入1勺子的盐，给菠菜一些底味。点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level: -2 mark on Northeastern rice. Pour in 1 tablespoon of salt to give the spinach some flavor. Click on the phone to start cooking icon;

steps.content_zh: 烧水的同时制作芝麻酱，准备好温水，大蒜剁成蒜蓉；
steps.content_en: While the water heats, make the sesame sauce: prepare warm water and finely chop the garlic;

steps.content_zh: 挖一大勺芝麻酱到碗中，用辣椒油、糖、蒜蓉、盐、陈醋调味，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Scoop a large spoonful of sesame paste into a bowl, season with chili oil, sugar, minced garlic, salt and aged vinegar, and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 水烧开后倒入菠菜；
steps.content_en: After the water boils, add the spinach;

steps.content_zh: 断生后立即去除，过凉水；
steps.content_en: Remove immediately after cutting off the growth and rinse with cold water;

steps.content_zh: 拧干水分后切成段，塞入碗中，倒扣成型；
steps.content_en: Wring out the water, cut into sections, stuff into a bowl, and turn upside down to shape;

steps.content_zh: 最后淋上调制好的酱汁即可。
steps.content_en: Finally, drizzle with the prepared sauce.

name_en: Pork trotters stewed in rock sugar
description_zh: 米家电饭煲有前期小火慢炖后期大火收汁的烹饪曲线，最适合做这种富含超级多胶原蛋白的肉，软糯入味的猪蹄入口即化，只需简单几步就能做出的一锅美食。
description_en: The Mijia rice cooker has a cooking curve of slow simmering at first and then high heat to reduce the juice. It is most suitable for cooking this kind of super collagen-rich meat. The soft, glutinous and delicious pig's trotters melt in your mouth. It only takes a few simple steps to make a one-pot delicacy.
tips_zh:
1、这道菜的烹饪曲线是定制的，所以只能在App端操作哦。
2、生抽中是含盐的，前期不要放太多，完成后可根据个人口味调节。
3、辣度根据自己口味调节。
4、放凉后吃猪蹄冻也是很好的选择哦。
tips_en:
1. This dish uses a custom cooking program, so you can only start it from the app.
2. Light soy sauce is salty, so don't add too much at first—adjust at the end.
3. Adjust the spiciness to taste.
4. The pork trotter jelly is also great chilled.

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 猪蹄焯水后洗净；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pig's trotters and wash them;

steps.content_zh: 将冰糖、干辣椒、生抽、香叶、八角、老抽、桂皮和料酒放入锅中；
steps.content_en: Put rock sugar, dried chili peppers, light soy sauce, bay leaves, star anise, dark soy sauce, cinnamon and cooking wine into the pot;

steps.content_zh: 放入焯水后的猪蹄，加水与猪蹄齐平即可；点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put in the blanched pig's trotters and add water to make them flush; click on the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 2.5小时后锅中的猪蹄；可以尝一下味道，如果觉得淡了再稍微放一些盐调味；
steps.content_en: After 2.5 hours, put the pig's trotters in the pot; you can taste it and if it feels bland, add some salt to taste;

steps.content_zh: 出锅。
steps.content_en: Remove from the pan.

description_zh: 有些同志，总是有一颗爱吃美食的心无奈却长了一双笨拙的手，但是！今天给大家带来的这道美食！是由电饭煲做的可乐鸡翅，最大的优点就是简单和美味！
description_en: Some comrades always have a love for delicious food but have a pair of clumsy hands, but! This delicious dish is brought to you today! Coke chicken wings are made in a rice cooker. The biggest advantage is that they are simple and delicious!
tips_zh:
1、如果觉得颜色不够深可以放两滴老抽上色。
2、鸡翅的表皮含有脂肪所以不用另外放油。
tips_en:
1. If the color is too light, add two drops of dark soy sauce.
2. Chicken wings have enough fat in the skin, so no extra oil is needed.

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 鸡翅中洗净后，在表面划开，以方便入味；
steps.content_en: After washing the chicken wings, score them on the surface to facilitate the flavoring;

steps.content_zh: 用料酒和生抽腌渍10分钟；
steps.content_en: Marinate in cooking wine and light soy sauce for 10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中放入姜片、小葱、香叶和八角；
steps.content_en: Add ginger slices, shallots, bay leaves and star anise to the pot;

steps.content_zh: 倒入腌渍好的鸡翅和可乐；点击手机App开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour in the marinated chicken wings and cola; click on the mobile app to start cooking icon;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后就可以享受美食啦！就是这么简单！
steps.content_en: Once cooking is done, enjoy your meal! It's that simple!

name_en: Lotus, Jujube & Job's Tears Beauty Porridge
description_zh: 一部三生三世十里桃花，满足了人们对美好的所有期许，我们虽不能三世轮回，却可以根据四季轮回，通过饮食，让青春容颜多留些日子。粥，具有材料丰富，制作简便，易于消化吸收的特点，以粥进行食补，更适合保健养生。而这一道莲枣薏仁护肤粥，最适合在春寒料峭的季节食用。
description_en: "Three Lives, Three Worlds, Ten Miles of Peach Blossom" satisfies all people's expectations for beauty. Although we cannot reincarnate in three lives, we can keep our youthful appearance for a few more days according to the four seasons and through diet. Porridge is rich in ingredients, easy to prepare, and easy to digest and absorb. Using porridge as a dietary supplement is more suitable for health care. This lotus-date and coix seed skin care porridge is most suitable to be eaten in the cold spring season.
tips_zh:
1、薏仁不易熟，至少要提前浸泡3小时。
2、红枣要选皮色紫红，颗粒大而均匀的。
tips_en:
1. Barley is not easy to ripen and must be soaked for at least 3 hours in advance.
2. Choose jujubes with purple-red skin and large and uniform particles.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将洗净的莲子、红枣、薏仁清水浸泡，薏仁要泡3小时；
steps.content_en: Soak the washed lotus seeds, red dates and coix seeds in water. Soak the coix seeds for 3 hours;

steps.content_zh: 米家电饭煲内放入约800毫升的清水，放入食材；点击手机开始烹饪图标进行煲粥；
steps.content_en: Pour about 800 ml of water and the ingredients into the Mijia rice cooker; tap Start Cooking on your phone to make congee;

steps.content_zh: 完成后可根据个人口味放入适量的糖调味。
steps.content_en: After completion, you can add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste.

name_en: Beauty wood ear and red date porridge
description_zh: 木耳红枣粥，是一道春季养生食谱，春季养生、养颜美容、产后恢复、气血双补、还可调节高血压。黑木耳中铁的含量极为丰富，因此黑木耳养血驻颜，常吃可令人肌肤红润，容光焕发，益气养血。
description_en: Wood ear and red date porridge is a spring wellness recipe—good for spring health, beauty, postpartum recovery, and replenishing both qi and blood, as well as helping regulate high blood pressure. Black wood ear is extremely rich in iron, so it nourishes the blood and keeps you looking young; regular consumption gives rosy, radiant skin and boosts qi and blood.
tips_zh:
1、一定要食用干木耳，干木耳是经过暴晒处理的成品，暴晒过程中会分解大量的光感物质，所以更安全
2、冰糖的用量根据自己的口味添加，不喜欢的也可以省略
3、红枣养颜，粥品中选用无核小枣更适合，如有核的，可先除去枣核
tips_en:
1. Use dried wood ear mushrooms—sun-drying breaks down light-sensitive compounds, making them safer.
2. Add rock sugar to taste, or omit it.
3. Red dates are good for the skin; use small pitted dates in the porridge, or pit them first.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 红枣洗净、浸泡；
steps.content_en: Wash and soak red dates;

steps.content_zh: 黑木耳用冷水泡发，去蒂去杂质，撕成小瓣；
steps.content_en: Soak the black fungus in cold water until softened, remove the stems and impurities, and tear into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 加入约1000毫升的水，倒入大米、黑木耳、小枣，点击手机开始烹饪图标一同熬煮；
steps.content_en: Add about 1000 ml of water, pour in rice, black fungus, and jujube, and click on the phone to start cooking icon to cook together;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时，黑木耳、红枣、大米熟烂成粥，加入冰糖调味；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, the black fungus, red dates, and rice should be cooked into porridge; add rock sugar to taste;

steps.content_zh: 继续焖煮到烹饪完成，即可盛出食用。
steps.content_en: Continue simmering until cooking is complete, then serve.

description_zh:
这是一道非常营养的菜，虽是素菜却又非常好吃，再配以粥或米糊确实不错，深受老人和孩子的喜爱。蔬菜用蒸的做法，营养不流失，颜色也很漂亮。
土豆含有丰富的维生素及钙、钾等微量元素，且易于消化吸收，营养丰富；胡萝卜增强免疫功能，还能促进利于儿童成长发育，益肝明目，降糖降脂。
description_en: A nutritious vegetarian dish that's also delicious, perfect with porridge and loved by kids and seniors. Steaming keeps the nutrients and colors intact. Potatoes are rich in vitamins and minerals and easy to digest; carrots boost immunity, aid child development, benefit the liver and eyes, and help regulate blood sugar and lipids.
tips_zh:
1 蔬菜丝要粗些，这样蒸的时候不会太烂不成型
2 浇在蔬菜上的油要足够热，这样才能激出葱蒜的香味
tips_en:
1 The vegetable shreds should be thicker so that they won’t be too rotten and shapeless when steamed.
2. The oil poured on the vegetables should be hot enough to bring out the aroma of onions and garlic.

steps.content_zh: 备好食材。胡萝卜洗净，土豆去皮洗净；
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients. Wash the carrot; peel and wash the potato.

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜和土豆都用擦丝板擦成粗丝；
steps.content_en: Shred the carrot and potato into coarse strips using a grater;

steps.content_zh: 一点点撒入面粉；
steps.content_en: Sprinkle in flour little by little;

steps.content_zh: 一边撒一边用筷子拌匀，使每根蔬菜上都均匀沾上面粉；
steps.content_en: Use chopsticks to mix evenly while sprinkling, so that each vegetable is evenly coated with flour;

steps.content_zh: 电饭锅里加入开水，屉上铺湿屉布，拌好的蔬菜丝上蒸笼，点击手机开始烹饪图标，精选蒸煮；
steps.content_en: Add boiling water to the rice cooker, lay a damp steamer cloth on the rack, put the mixed shredded vegetables in the steamer, tap Start Cooking on your phone, and select Steam;

steps.content_zh: 蒜拍扁切末，葱切丝；
steps.content_en: Crush and mince the garlic, shred the scallion;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好的蔬菜丝扣入大盘子里，上面放蒜末、葱丝、盐；
steps.content_en: Turn the steamed shredded vegetables onto a large plate, then top with minced garlic, shredded scallion and salt;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加入炒菜量的植物油，烧至冒烟，快速浇在葱丝、蒜末上，拌匀即可食用。
steps.content_en: Add the usual amount of vegetable oil for stir-frying to the pot, heat until smoking, then quickly pour it over the shredded scallions and minced garlic, mix well and serve.

name_en: Cold Mixed Vegetables and Egg Slices
description_zh:
鸡蛋大家每天都吃，它的营养仅次于母乳，它还含有人体必须的营养物质，如脂肪、蛋白质、卵磷脂、维生素、钙、铁、钾等，被称为“理想的营养库”。
今天来一道鸡蛋的另一种做法，宝妈今天就把它凉拌，平常吃一个鸡蛋的，用了这种办法两个都不够，没有过多的调味料，却也清爽可口。
description_en:
Everyone eats eggs every day; their nutrition is second only to breast milk. They contain essential nutrients such as fats, protein, lecithin, vitamins, calcium, iron, and potassium, and are known as an 'ideal nutrient storehouse.'
Today, here's another way to prepare eggs. Moms can try them cold-tossed—even if you normally eat just one egg, this way two won't be enough. With no heavy seasoning, it's still light and delicious.
tips_zh:
1 香菜起点缀作用，实际和鸡蛋不是很搭，可以省略
2 鸡蛋切片的办法有二，其一：锯齿刀蘸水切；其二：手和牙扯一根线，绕道鸡蛋上一片片往下勒，这个办法最好，鸡蛋片完整不爱碎。
tips_en:
1 Coriander is used as a garnish. It doesn’t actually go well with eggs and can be omitted.
2. There are two ways to slice eggs. One is to dip a serrated knife in water and cut; the other is to pull a thread with your hands and teeth, and go around the top of the egg to slice it down. This method is the best, and the egg slices will not break at all.

steps.content_zh: 备好食材。黄瓜、香菜、海鲜菇洗净；
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients. Wash the cucumber, cilantro and seafood mushrooms.

steps.content_zh: 冷水入锅煮鸡蛋，将鸡蛋和水同时加入到锅内，点击手机开始烹饪图标；
steps.content_en: Pour cold water into the pot to cook the eggs. Add the eggs and water to the pot at the same time. Click the start cooking icon on your phone;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余3分钟时。放入海鲜菇焯水；
steps.content_en: With 3 minutes left, blanch the seafood mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 海鲜菇和鸡蛋一起入冷水里冷却一下；
steps.content_en: Cool the seafood mushrooms and egg together in cold water;

steps.content_zh: 黄瓜拍微扁后斜刀切块，香菜切段（香菜一两根点缀就可以，也可以不放，我的放多了）；
steps.content_en: Lightly crush the cucumber, then cut diagonally into chunks; cut the cilantro into sections (one or two sprigs are enough for garnish, or omit it—I added too much);

steps.content_zh: 用生抽、米醋和芝麻油调成酱汁；
steps.content_en: Mix light soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil into a sauce;

steps.content_zh: 刀蘸水切鸡蛋成厚片状；
steps.content_en: Dip a knife in water and cut the eggs into thick slices;

steps.content_zh: 黄瓜、香菜入盘，海鲜菇捞出入盘，鸡蛋码在上面，淋入味汁即可上桌。轻拌匀即可食用；
steps.content_en: Put the cucumber and coriander on the plate, remove the seafood mushrooms and put them on the plate, put the eggs on top, pour the sauce and serve. Mix lightly and serve;

steps.content_zh: 完成咯。
steps.content_en: Done.

description_zh: 雪梨和枇杷都能能够润肺止咳、祛痰，治疗咳嗽，与银耳同炖，不仅仅能改善口感，还可以补充胶原蛋白，滋润身体，清补美容。
description_en: Both snow pears and loquats moisten the lungs, relieve cough and expel phlegm. Stewed with snow fungus, they not only improve the taste but also replenish collagen, nourish the body, and provide gentle nourishment and beauty benefits.
tips_zh:
1、如果喜欢吃入口即化的银耳，需要提前浸泡一晚上然后撕成小朵。
2、冰糖的量可以根据个人口味调整。
tips_en:
1. If you like to eat white fungus that melts in your mouth, you need to soak it overnight and then tear it into small florets.
2. The amount of rock sugar can be adjusted according to personal taste.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银耳洗净后充分泡发，撕成小朵；
steps.content_en: After washing, fully rehydrate the snow fungus and tear into small florets;

steps.content_zh: 雪梨和枇杷去皮、去核、切块；
steps.content_en: Peel, pit and chop the snow pear and loquats;

steps.content_zh: 将银耳、雪梨、枇杷和冰糖同时放入锅中，加水稍稍没过银耳即可；
steps.content_en: Put the white fungus, snow pear, loquat and rock sugar into the pot at the same time, add water to slightly cover the white fungus;

steps.content_zh: 完成后即可享用一碗沁人心脾、润肺止咳的枇杷雪梨羹啦。
steps.content_en: After finishing, you can enjoy a bowl of loquat and snow pear soup that is refreshing, moistening the lungs and relieving coughs.

description_zh:
青稞可能年纪比较小的人对它了解的不是很多，在粮食匮乏的那个年代，青稞作为一种主要粮食，支撑着很多人走过了那段艰难的岁月。青稞在我国是一种历史比较悠久的经济作物，尤其是在青藏、青海、西藏等自然环境恶劣的地区，青稞由于生长周期短、耐寒性强，而成为了备受当地人青睐的作物。
青稞生长在西藏海拔3800-4500米高度，富含葡聚糖、蛋白质、矿物质、维生素E等高营养成分。
作为水果的枇杷入粥，不仅增加观感，还会让粥的口感更好。
description_en: Younger people may not know much about highland barley. In times of food scarcity, it was a staple that helped many people through those hard years. In China it is a crop with a long history, especially in harsh environments such as the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, Qinghai and Tibet, where its short growing cycle and cold resistance made it a favorite among locals. Highland barley grows in Tibet at altitudes of 3,800-4,500 meters and is rich in beta-glucan, protein, minerals, vitamin E and other nutrients. Adding loquats as fruit to the porridge not only improves its look but also its taste.
tips_zh: 对于一般人群来说，青稞都是可以食用的，尤其是对于糖尿病患者来说，更是稳定血糖的一种佳品。不过大家需要记住的是，青稞不要吃太多，每次食用在40克左右就可以了。另外，青稞作为一种粗粮，那些脾胃虚弱的人，千万不能多吃。
tips_en: Highland barley is suitable for most people, especially diabetics, as it helps stabilize blood sugar. Remember not to eat too much—about 40 g per serving is enough. As a whole grain, it should also be avoided in large amounts by those with weak digestion.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 青稞米和粥米洗净后同时放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行煲粥；
steps.content_en: Wash the highland barley and porridge rice, put both in the pot, add water up to the water level line: the thick porridge - 1 mark, then tap Start Cooking on the phone to make porridge;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟的时候放入冰糖和去皮去核的枇杷，继续焖煮到烹饪完成；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add rock sugar and the peeled, pitted loquats, and keep simmering until done;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

name_en: Loquat and White Fungus Sweet Soup
description_zh: 春天天气变化快，忽冷忽热，容易感冒、咳嗽。多喝一些百合枇杷羹，具有滋阴润肺、清热止咳的功效。
description_en: The weather changes rapidly in spring, with hot and cold weather, making it easy to catch colds and coughs. Drink more lily and loquat soup, which has the effects of nourishing yin and moisturizing the lungs, clearing away heat and relieving cough.
tips_zh:
1、冰糖的量根据个人口味调整。
2、如要需要银耳入口即化，一定要充分的浸泡，最好浸泡一晚上，然后撕成小朵。
3、百合容易氧化，所以洗净后要放在水中。
tips_en:
1. Adjust the rock sugar to taste.
2. For melt-in-the-mouth snow fungus, soak it thoroughly—ideally overnight—then tear into small florets.
3. Lily bulbs oxidize easily, so keep them in water after washing.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银耳洗净后泡发2小时，撕成小朵；
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the snow fungus for 2 hours, then tear into small florets;

steps.content_zh: 鲜百合掰开后冲洗干净，浸泡在水中；
steps.content_en: Separate the fresh lily bulbs, rinse clean, and soak in water;

steps.content_zh: 枇杷去皮去核；
steps.content_en: Peel and core the loquat;

steps.content_zh: 将银耳和枇杷同时放入锅中，加水稍稍没过银耳即可；点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the white fungus and loquat into the pot at the same time, add water to slightly cover the white fungus; click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余20分钟时，放入冰糖和百合；
steps.content_en: With 20 minutes left, add rock sugar and lily bulbs;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后就能盛出享用啦。
steps.content_en: Serve and enjoy once cooking is complete.

description_zh: 又到了一年吃枇杷的季节，云南蒙自的枇杷已经成熟上市了。成熟的枇杷味道甜美，营养颇丰。春末时节，早晚温差较大容易感冒咳嗽，中医认为枇杷果实有润肺、止咳、止渴的功效。吃枇杷时要剥皮。除了鲜吃外，亦有以枇杷肉制成糖水罐头，或者做成果酱。
description_en: It's loquat season again, and Mengzi's loquats in Yunnan are ripe and on the market. Ripe loquats are sweet and highly nutritious. In late spring, big day-night temperature swings cause colds and coughs; TCM holds that loquat moistens the lungs, relieves cough and quenches thirst. Peel before eating. Besides fresh, loquats can be canned in syrup or made into jam.
tips_zh:
1.白糖可以换成冰糖，口味可以根据个人口味调整糖的多少。
2.如果要做成膏，可以先用料理机将枇杷打成果泥。
3.可以不加川贝母，仅作为甜品食用。
tips_en:
1. Swap white sugar for rock sugar and adjust the sweetness to taste.
2. For a paste, puree the loquats in a food processor first.
3. You can omit the fritillaria and enjoy it simply as a dessert.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 枇杷洗净后去皮去核，撒上白糖腌渍；
steps.content_en: Wash the loquats, peel and pit them, then sprinkle with sugar and marinate;

steps.content_zh: 静置到白糖融化即可；
steps.content_en: Let it sit until the sugar dissolves;

steps.content_zh: 川贝捣成粉末；
steps.content_en: Pound Sichuan clam into powder;

steps.content_zh: 将腌渍好的枇杷和川贝粉同时放入锅胆中，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the pickled loquat and Sichuan scallop powder into the pot at the same time, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 熬到果酱的颜色变红就行啦，烹饪过程中用软铲子搅拌几次；
steps.content_en: Just cook until the color of the jam turns red. Use a soft spatula to stir several times during the cooking process;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 单身汪无害，美食自己吃！大口吃鸡腿才叫爽！鲜美的卤汁，滑嫩的鸡肉！满满一嘴，一下子，就葛优躺了！哈哈😜😝，电饭煲党们，动起来，把材料买齐，让美食犒劳自己吧！
description_en: Being single has its perks—enjoy the food yourself! Big bites of chicken leg are the best! Rich braising sauce, tender chicken—one mouthful and you'll want to flop on the sofa! Haha 😜😝 Rice cooker fans, get moving, gather the ingredients and treat yourself to something delicious!
tips_zh:
1.纯电饭煲，不需要锅啥的！
2.水最好用净水器的水！自来水会稍微影响口感。
3.料酒我是用的五香的，会更浓香点！其他料酒也都可以！
4.在外漂泊者，单身汪们对自己好点，一个电饭煲就搞定啦！
5.卤水等冷了放冰箱下次再用把！也可以做早餐米粉的卤水！
tips_en:
1. Just use the rice cooker—no other pots needed!
2. Use filtered water; tap water slightly affects the taste.
3. I used five-spice cooking wine for a richer aroma, but any cooking wine works.
4. Fellow singles and folks away from home: treat yourself—one rice cooker is all you need!
5. Cool the braising liquid and refrigerate it for next time; it also works as a sauce for breakfast rice noodles.

steps.content_zh: 首先准备好材料！单身贵族必备各种材料，随时给自己来顿美食！😜😝👏👏
steps.content_en: First, prepare the ingredients! A great set for singles—treat yourself to a delicious meal anytime! 😜😝👏👏

steps.content_zh: 把鸡腿洗干净了，放电饭煲里水没过鸡腿，自选煮10分钟（就是大家讲的焯水）
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken legs, put water in the rice cooker to cover the chicken legs, and cook for 10 minutes of your choice (this is what everyone calls blanching)

steps.content_zh: 煮好后捞出，用冷水冲洗下！电饭煲也清洗下，把鸡腿放进去！
steps.content_en: After cooking, take it out and rinse it with cold water! Also clean the rice cooker and put the chicken legs in!

steps.content_zh: 配料都按上面清单准备好！（以后可以按自己口味调整）
steps.content_en: Prepare all ingredients per the list above (adjust to taste next time)!

steps.content_zh: 把香料放入电饭煲里面！加水没过鸡腿！然后倒入生抽，老抽，五香料酒，盐，冰糖等调料！
steps.content_en: Put the spices into the rice cooker! Add water to cover the chicken legs! Then pour in light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, five-spice wine, salt, rock sugar and other seasonings!

steps.content_zh: 自选蒸煮60分钟就可以了！打开卤香扑鼻！
steps.content_en: Just select the steam-and-cook setting for 60 minutes! Open it up and the braised aroma hits you!

steps.content_zh: 装盘，可以带点卤水！也可以直接夹鸡腿就开吃！卤香四溢，鲜滑可口！一会就没了！😊😜
steps.content_en: Plate and serve with a bit of braising liquid! Or just pick up a drumstick and dig in! Fragrant, tender and juicy—it'll be gone in no time! 😊😜

description_zh: 这是一道非常有特色的菜肴，荷叶作为一种天然的烹饪食材，无论是煮饭还是做菜都是别有一番风味。这道荷香排骨饭，经过层层的包裹，长时间的蒸制，在打开荷叶包的瞬间，香气扑鼻，诱人食欲，吃在嘴里各种香味全在唇齿之中，非常有满足感。
description_en: A truly special dish: lotus leaf adds unique flavor to both rice and cooking. Wrapped in layers and steamed slowly, this lotus-wrapped rib rice releases an irresistible aroma when opened, and every bite is deeply satisfying.
tips_zh:
1、荷叶可在网上买到
2、由于大米在蒸制过程中会膨胀，所以荷叶包的高度一定不能太高，否则容易把电饭煲的盖子顶开
3、如果想要吃软烂点的，可延长蒸制时间
tips_en:
1. Lotus leaves can be bought online.
2. Rice expands while steaming, so don't make the lotus-leaf parcel too tall or it will push the rice cooker lid open.
3. For softer rice, extend the steaming time.

steps.content_zh: 备好所需食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大米淘洗干净后浸泡1小时，再沥干水分；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice, soak it for 1 hour, and then drain it;

steps.content_zh: 干的荷叶放入淡盐水中浸泡1小时（荷叶泡水里会浮上来，在上面压个重物就解决了）；
steps.content_en: Soak the dried lotus leaves in light salt water for 1 hour (the lotus leaves will float when soaked in water, so put a heavy object on them to solve the problem);

steps.content_zh: 排骨洗净后调入盐、生抽、老抽、蚝油、料酒、白胡椒粉、糖、姜片和葱段，搅拌均匀腌制1小时；
steps.content_en: After washing the ribs, add salt, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, cooking wine, white pepper, sugar, ginger slices and green onions, stir well and marinate for 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 荷叶泡好后，铺垫到电饭煲蒸笼上；
steps.content_en: Soak the lotus leaf and line the rice cooker's steamer basket with it;

steps.content_zh: 将腌制好的排骨裹上大米；
steps.content_en: Coat marinated pork ribs with rice;

steps.content_zh: 放进蒸笼里，让每块排骨都裹上大米，全部弄好后再将剩余的米粒铺放在上面；
steps.content_en: Put in the steamer and coat each rib piece with rice; when done, spread the remaining rice on top.

steps.content_zh: 将排骨包裹起来，中间可用牙签固定服帖（注意：荷叶包的高度最好在蒸笼的2/3处），锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度，开始烹饪，蒸制1小时即可；
steps.content_en: Wrap the ribs, and use toothpicks to fix them in the middle (note: the height of the lotus leaf package is best at 2/3 of the steamer). Add water to the pot to the water level: -3 Northeast meters. Start cooking and steam for 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好取出后，打开荷叶撒点葱花就可以开吃啦
steps.content_en: When done, unwrap the lotus leaf, sprinkle with chopped scallion and enjoy

name_en: Shepherd's purse and winter bamboo shoot rice
description_zh: 荠菜是一种即美味又营养的野菜，在春季特别多见。许多人通常都喜欢用它来制作面食和汤羹，最为常见的有馄饨、饺子、包子等，味道都特别鲜美。不过，今天我用荠菜做的是一道菜饭，特意买了些荠菜，再配上鲜嫩的冬笋和培根，使其米饭吃起来更加有滋有味。
description_en: Shepherd's purse is a delicious, nutritious wild vegetable especially common in spring. Many people like using it in wontons, dumplings, steamed buns, and soups, all of which taste wonderful. Today I'm making a vegetable rice with it: I bought some fresh shepherd's purse and paired it with tender winter bamboo shoots and bacon to make the rice even more flavorful.

steps.content_zh: 备好所需食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 培根切小块，冬笋去壳后，取嫩的部分切小丁焯水备用；
steps.content_en: Cut the bacon into small pieces, peel the winter bamboo shoots, cut the tender parts into small cubes and blanch them in water for later use;

steps.content_zh: 荠菜洗净后焯水，过冷水，挤干水分后切小段备用；
steps.content_en: Wash and blanch the shepherd's purse, rinse it in cold water, squeeze out the water, and cut into short pieces;

steps.content_zh: 锅中倒少许油，油热后倒入培根和冬笋定翻炒，放入生抽继续炒制片刻盛出备用；
steps.content_en: Pour a little oil into the pot, when the oil is hot, add bacon and winter bamboo shoots and stir-fry, add light soy sauce and continue to fry for a while, set aside;

steps.content_zh: 大米倒入电饭锅内胆中，淘洗干净后放入盐；
steps.content_en: Pour the rice into the rice cooker, wash it thoroughly and add salt;

steps.content_zh: 倒入适量清水；
steps.content_en: Pour in appropriate amount of water;

steps.content_zh: 将炒制过的培根和冬笋丁倒进锅中，并稍稍搅拌一下，开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the fried bacon and diced winter bamboo shoots into the pot, stir briefly and start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 待烹饪结束后，放入荠菜保温10分钟即可
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, add the shepherd's purse and keep warm for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 完成后将饭菜混合均与就可以享用了；
steps.content_en: When finished, mix the meal and enjoy;

steps.content_zh: 也可以用模具做个自己喜欢的造型哈。
steps.content_en: You can also use molds to make the shape you like.

description_zh: 绿豆能和五脏、滋脾胃、利尿消肿；百合可清热润肺，常喝这款粥，可缓解因天气变化带来的不适。
description_en: Mung beans harmonize the five organs, nourish the spleen and stomach, promote urination and reduce swelling; lily bulbs clear heat and moisten the lungs. Drinking this porridge regularly relieves discomfort caused by changes in weather.
tips_zh:
1、绿豆、糯米适合提前浸泡，最好能达3小时左右
2、在煮开锅后再下入百合
3、冰糖在最后添加即可
4、煮粥用开水，可避免米粒粘锅
tips_en:
1. Mung beans and glutinous rice are suitable for soaking in advance, preferably for about 3 hours.
2. Add lily after boiling the pot
3. Add rock sugar at the end
4. Use boiling water when cooking porridge to prevent rice grains from sticking to the pot.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将绿豆、糯米、百合都洗净，用清水浸泡，其中糯米、绿豆浸泡3小时以上；
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans, glutinous rice, and lilies, and soak them in water. Soak the glutinous rice and mung beans for more than 3 hours;

steps.content_zh: 米家电饭煲内放约1000克开水，放入浸泡好的绿豆、糯米；
steps.content_en: Put about 1000 grams of boiling water in the Mijia rice cooker, add soaked mung beans and glutinous rice;

steps.content_zh: 点击手机开始烹饪图标进行煲粥；
steps.content_en: Click on the phone to start cooking icon to make porridge;

steps.content_zh: 剩余10分钟时放入百合，最后加入冰糖化开即可。
steps.content_en: When 10 minutes are left, add lily, and finally add rock sugar to dissolve.

description_zh: 芝麻中含有大量的不饱和脂肪酸，适合高脂血症、高血压等疾病患者食用，此粥有利于宽肠通便。
description_en: Sesame seeds contain plenty of unsaturated fatty acids and suit people with high blood lipids, high blood pressure, and similar conditions; this congee also helps relieve constipation.
tips_zh:
1、蜂蜜要在温热的时候放入，不会破坏蜂蜜的营养
2、因为黑芝麻是熟的，所以等开锅后放入
3、大米提前浸泡一下，粥品口感更好
tips_en:
1. Add the honey when the porridge is warm, not hot, to preserve its nutrients.
2. The black sesame seeds are already toasted, so add them after the pot comes to a boil.
3. Soak the rice first for a better porridge texture.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大米淘洗干净，浸泡30分钟；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and soak it for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 3、米家电饭煲中加入开水，放入已经浸泡过的大米，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行煲粥；
steps.content_en: 3. Add boiling water to the Mijia rice cooker, add soaked rice, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to cook porridge;

steps.content_zh: 开锅后加入黑芝麻再煮20分钟，大米熟烂即可关火；
steps.content_en: After boiling the pot, add black sesame seeds and cook for another 20 minutes. Turn off the heat when the rice is cooked;

steps.content_zh: 晾凉至温热时，调入适量蜂蜜即可食用。
steps.content_en: When it is cooled until warm, add an appropriate amount of honey and serve.

description_zh: 冬瓜薏米排骨汤是一种典型的营养价值很高的养生保健汤，这款汤不仅可用于清热解毒、消暑，而且还可以作为一款滋补汤，用于身体虚弱的人补身体，味道清香淡雅，任何季节都适合食用。
description_en: Winter melon, barley and pork ribs soup is a typical health-preserving soup with high nutritional value. This soup can not only be used to clear away heat, detoxify and relieve summer heat, but can also be used as a nourishing soup for weak people to replenish the body. The taste is refreshing and elegant, and is suitable for consumption in any season.
tips_zh:
1、薏米的性质微寒偏凉，因此，严重的脾胃虚寒患者、虚冷症、孕妇、体质虚弱，身体水分不足，常出现嘴唇干裂、口渴的人，都不适宜长期服食薏仁粥或单纯的薏仁食品。
2、除了盐不用放鸡精、味精类调味料，汤中原本的鲜味会被影响。
tips_en:
1. The nature of barley is slightly cold and cool. Therefore, patients with severe spleen and stomach deficiency, asthenia-cold syndrome, pregnant women, people with weak constitution, insufficient body water, often chapped lips and thirsty are not suitable to take barley porridge or simple barley food for a long time.
2. In addition to salt, there is no need to add chicken essence or MSG seasonings, as the original umami flavor in the soup will be affected.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜去皮去籽，切厘2米厚的片；
steps.content_en: Peel and seed the winter melon, and cut into 2-meter-thick slices;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片；
steps.content_en: Slice the ginger;

steps.content_zh: 排骨焯水后与冬瓜、薏米、料酒和生姜同时放入锅中，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行煲汤；
steps.content_en: After blanching, put the ribs in the pot with winter melon, barley, cooking wine and ginger; tap Start Cooking on the phone to make the soup.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，放入适量的盐调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking is complete, add an appropriate amount of salt to taste;

steps.content_zh: 享用吧。
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

name_en: Steamed winter melon with minced pork
description_zh: 冬瓜利湿解毒，肉末健脾补益，常见的食材，简简单单的制作方法，但美味与营养兼备， 好吃而且不贵哟。
description_en: Winter melon can relieve dampness and detoxify, and minced meat can strengthen the spleen and nourish the spleen. They are common ingredients and simple preparation methods, but they are both delicious and nutritious. They are delicious and not expensive.
tips_zh:
1、如果觉得冬瓜味道淡，可以在铺肉末之前在冬瓜上稍微撒一点盐。
2、冬瓜不要切得太后，不然不容易入味。
tips_en:
1. If you think the winter melon tastes bland, you can sprinkle a little salt on the winter melon before spreading the minced meat.
2. Don’t cut the winter melon too late, otherwise it won’t be tasty.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜去皮去籽，切薄片，码在盘子上；
steps.content_en: Peel and seed the winter melon, cut into thin slices, and place on a plate;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切成姜末、小葱切成葱花、大蒜切成蒜片后与肉末混合后搅拌均匀，用盐、胡椒粉、芝麻油、料酒腌渍；
steps.content_en: Mince the ginger, chop the scallions, and slice the garlic, then mix with the minced meat and stir well; marinate with salt, pepper, sesame oil, and cooking wine;

steps.content_zh: 将肉末均匀的铺在冬瓜上；将盘子放在蒸笼中；
steps.content_en: Spread the minced meat evenly on the winter melon; place the plate in the steamer;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 2 mark, then tap Start Cooking on the phone to cook;

steps.content_zh: 完成后的样子；
steps.content_en: What it will look like when finished;

steps.content_zh: 慢慢的取出后撒上葱花，享用吧。
steps.content_en: Take it out slowly, sprinkle with chopped green onion, and enjoy.

description_zh: 你家是不是有一些充满回忆的面食，小时候每当胃口不好的时候，妈妈就会煮一锅面疙瘩。青菜、番茄加上Q弹爽口的面疙瘩，一碗下去暖意融融。
description_en: Does your family have a nostalgic noodle dish? When I had no appetite as a child, Mom would cook a pot of dough-drop noodles. Greens, tomatoes and chewy little dough pieces—one bowl warms you right up.
tips_zh: 除了以上的食材还可以放入香菇、虾仁等等符合个人口味的食材。
tips_en: In addition to the above ingredients, you can also add mushrooms, shrimps and other ingredients that suit your personal taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 青菜切碎、番茄切丁；
steps.content_en: Chop the bok choy and dice the tomato;

steps.content_zh: 我喜欢吃软软的青菜，所以一开始就放入水将青菜和番茄煮上了（水 加到水位线稠粥：-1的刻度）；
steps.content_en: I like to eat soft vegetables, so I put in water to cook the vegetables and tomatoes at the beginning (water is added to the water level line for thick porridge: -1 scale);

steps.content_zh: 点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Tap the Start Cooking icon on your phone to begin cooking;

steps.content_zh: 面粉中缓缓的加入水，将面粉搅拌成絮状；
steps.content_en: Gradually add water to the flour, stirring until it forms flocculent crumbs;

steps.content_zh: 水开后倒入面粉，搅拌均匀后继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: Once the water boils, stir in the flour, mix well, and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋打成蛋液；
steps.content_en: Beat eggs into egg liquid;

steps.content_zh: 当面疙瘩飘起后倒入蛋液搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: When the gnocchi floats, pour in the egg liquid and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 出锅前用盐、胡椒粉调味，淋上芝麻油撒上葱花。
steps.content_en: Season with salt and pepper before serving, drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with chopped green onions.

description_zh:
花蛤，又叫蛤蜊，其肉质鲜美无比，被称为“天下第一鲜”、“百味之冠”，是不少人爱吃的一种海鲜。花蛤含钙、镁、铁、锌等多种人体必需的微量元素，可作为人类的营养、绿色食品，深受消费者的青睐。
花蛤蒸蛋这道菜味道鲜美，吃到嘴里十分的滑嫩，营养也是很丰富的，制作起来也是很方便的，今天,我用米家的电饭煲也照样能简单方便的做这道美味的菜.
description_en:
Clams, also called clams, have extremely delicious meat and are known as "the most delicious in the world" and "the crown of all flavors". They are a seafood that many people love to eat.
