Clam contains calcium, magnesium, iron, zinc and other trace elements necessary for the human body. It can be used as human nutrition and green food, and is favored by consumers.
The steamed clam egg dish is delicious, very smooth and tender in the mouth, rich in nutrients, and very convenient to make. Today, I can still make this delicious dish simply and conveniently using Mijia rice cooker.
tips_zh: 蒸水蛋，最重要的就是要把蛋打好，一定要化开来；还有上面用保鲜膜盖上，就是为了让鸡蛋，不被蒸过头了
tips_en: The key to steamed eggs is to beat them well until fully blended; cover with plastic wrap to prevent overcooking.

steps.content_zh: 花蛤，提前浸泡，为了能吐出里面的脏东西，备用（没有全部用的哦，蒸蛋就用几个就可以了，其他的就可以炒着吃）；
steps.content_en: Soak the clams in advance so they expel any grit, and set aside (you won't use them all—just a few for the steamed egg; the rest can be stir-fried);

steps.content_zh: 准备两个鸡蛋，打入大碗中，碗要面大点，但是不要太深的碗，深盘最适合；
steps.content_en: Prepare two eggs and break them into a large bowl. The bowl should be larger but not too deep. A deep plate is most suitable;

steps.content_zh: 水烧开，放入花蛤，烫下，就可以让花蛤，张开大嘴，这样就可以捞出来了，备用；
steps.content_en: Boil the water, put in the clams, and scald them so that the clams can open their big mouths so that they can be fished out and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋，打散，加入一小勺的盐，搅拌均匀，加入适量的水，继续搅拌均匀；如果为了蒸蛋更加的细腻的话，可以滤下，我做的时候没有过滤；
steps.content_en: Beat the eggs, add a small spoonful of salt and mix well, then add some water and stir again; strain for a smoother steamed egg—I didn't strain mine;

steps.content_zh: 然后再把花蛤，一个一个均匀的放入蛋糊中，依次摆放好；
steps.content_en: Then place the clams one by one evenly into the egg batter, arranging them neatly;

steps.content_zh: 上面用保鲜膜包好，在保鲜膜上用牙签扎几个小孔；放入米家电饭煲的蒸屉中，锅胆内水加到水位线：东北米——2的刻度，点击手机开始烹饪图标。（注意用的碗或者深盘子不要完全盖住出气孔，否则会造成锅内高压的情况顶开盖子）
steps.content_en: Cover the top with plastic wrap and poke a few holes in it with a toothpick. Place in the rice cooker's steamer basket, add water to the inner pot up to the water line: Northeast Rice — level 2, then tap Start Cooking on your phone. (Note: don't let the bowl or deep plate completely cover the steam vent, or pressure will build up and force the lid open.)

steps.content_zh: 完成后，上面放点味极鲜和葱，就可以开吃了；
steps.content_en: When it's done, add some fresh scallions and green onions on top, and you're ready to eat;

steps.content_zh: 成品。
steps.content_en: Finished product.

description_zh:
牛肉是中国人的第二大肉类食品，仅次于猪肉，牛肉蛋白质含量高，而脂肪含量低，所以味道鲜美，受人喜爱，享有“肉中骄子”的美称。
性平，味甘，归脾、胃经，补脾胃、益气血、强筋骨、消水肿等功效，治虚损羸瘦，消渴，脾弱不运，痞积，水肿，腰膝酸软。用米家的电饭煲一一个程序就可以吃香醇的牛肉了，太棒了。
description_en:
Beef is China's second most popular meat after pork. It is high in protein and low in fat, so it is delicious and beloved, known as "the pick of meats."
Neutral in nature and sweet in taste, it benefits the spleen and stomach, replenishes qi and blood, strengthens tendons and bones, and reduces edema. It is used for weakness, wasting, diabetes, poor digestion, abdominal masses, edema, and sore waist and knees. With a Mijia rice cooker, one program gives you rich, tender beef - wonderful!
tips_zh: 牛肉，选择牛腱子，这样的肉更加的有嚼劲；还有切牛肉的要按着纹理。
tips_en: For beef, choose beef tendon, which makes the meat chewier; and when cutting beef, follow the grain.

steps.content_zh: 买回来的牛腱子，提前在大点的盆里，浸泡出血水，中途要多换换水；
steps.content_en: Soak the beef tendons you bought in bleeding water in a larger basin in advance, and change the water more often;

steps.content_zh: 准备好生生姜和大蒜，还有其他的生抽、老抽还有料酒等；
steps.content_en: Prepare ginger and garlic, as well as other light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, cooking wine, etc.;

steps.content_zh: 把牛肉放入米家电饭煲中，放入生姜和大蒜；
steps.content_en: Put beef into Mijia rice cooker, add ginger and garlic;

steps.content_zh: 然后在电饭煲中，加入适量的水，水要没过牛肉，再加入生抽、老抽和料酒，盐等各种调料；
steps.content_en: Then add water to the rice cooker to cover the beef, followed by light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, cooking wine, salt, and other seasonings;

steps.content_zh: 点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标，烹饪完成后牛肉就已经喷香扑鼻了；我一般都是头一晚上炖上，第二天早上，捞出来，中午就可以开吃了；
steps.content_en: Tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen; when done, the beef will be wonderfully fragrant. I usually stew it the night before, take it out the next morning, and it's ready to eat by noon;

steps.content_zh: 取出后切片，一盘香味醇香的牛肉就可以开吃了；可以蘸着酱油醋吃，也可以就这样吃。
steps.content_en: After taking it out and slicing it, a plate of fragrant beef is ready to eat; you can eat it with soy sauce and vinegar, or you can just eat it as it is.

description_zh: 光看着颜色就让人垂涎欲滴，莴笋、胡萝卜、玉米粒和西蓝花绽放在软绵绵的粥中。味道清新，减肥降脂。制作简单，而且粥类更容易消化，也比较容易入口。各种蔬菜，还可以适当补充维生素和矿物质。
description_en: Just looking at the colors makes your mouth water, with lettuce, carrots, corn kernels and broccoli blooming in the soft porridge. Fresh taste, weight loss and fat reduction. It is simple to make, and porridge is easier to digest and easier to eat. Various vegetables can also supplement vitamins and minerals appropriately.
tips_zh:
1、蔬菜可根据个人喜好放入。
2、不建议放鸡精和味精类调味品，会影响蔬菜粥的口味。
tips_en:
1. Add any vegetables you like.
2. Avoid chicken bouillon or MSG—they'll spoil the fresh taste of the vegetable porridge.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 粥米洗净后放入电饭煲中，水加到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行煲粥；
steps.content_en: Wash the congee rice, put it in the cooker, fill to the thick-congee -1 mark, and tap Start Cooking on your phone to make congee;

steps.content_zh: 西蓝花洗净切小朵；
steps.content_en: Wash the broccoli and cut into small florets;

steps.content_zh: 莴笋去皮切丁；
steps.content_en: Peel and dice the celtuce;

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜去皮切丁；
steps.content_en: Peel and dice carrots;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时，放入切好的蔬菜，加入适量的盐，搅拌均匀，继续焖煮到烹饪结束；
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add the chopped vegetables and some salt, stir well, and simmer until done;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 很多人都知道莴笋好吃，无论凉拌还是炒着吃，却不知道莴笋叶也是个宝，具有清热解毒功效,莴笋中钾的含量是钠的27倍，其含有的维生素还有利于促进排尿，保持体内的水电解质平衡，对高血压、心脏病和水肿均有一定的食疗作用。
description_en: Many people know that lettuce is delicious, whether eaten cold or stir-fried, but they do not know that lettuce leaves are also a treasure, with the effect of clearing away heat and detoxifying. The potassium content in lettuce is 27 times that of sodium. The vitamins contained in lettuce are also helpful to promote urination, maintain the water and electrolyte balance in the body, and have certain therapeutic effects on high blood pressure, heart disease and edema.
tips_zh:
1、腊肠也可以换成咸肉、腊肉类的食材。
2、莴笋叶煮的时候会出水，所以减少了水量。
tips_en:
1. You can swap the sausage for salted or cured pork.
2. Celtuce leaves release water while cooking, so I reduced the water.

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 莴笋叶浸泡，浸泡去除表面杂物；
steps.content_en: Soak the celtuce leaves to remove surface dirt;

steps.content_zh: 切丝；
steps.content_en: shred;

steps.content_zh: 腊肠切丁；
steps.content_en: Dice the Chinese sausage;

steps.content_zh: 将莴笋叶和腊肠在炒锅中煸炒香；
steps.content_en: Saute lettuce leaves and sausage in a wok until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后倒入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米-2.5的刻度，撒上少许盐；点击手机开始烹图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeast rice and pour it into the pot, add water to the water level line: Northeast rice -2.5 mark, sprinkle with a little salt; click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 完成后拌匀盛出。
steps.content_en: When finished, mix well and serve.

description_zh: 莴笋味道清香味苦，含有的大量纤维素，能够促进人体的肠壁蠕动。用来与肉丸一起煮汤，味道鲜美，清热解毒。莴笋中含有多种维生素和无机盐，其中以铁的含量较丰富，且它在有机酸和酶的作用下，易为人体吸收，所以食用新鲜莴笋，对各种贫血非常有效。
description_en: Lettuce has a refreshing and bitter taste, and contains a large amount of fiber, which can promote the peristalsis of the human intestinal wall. Used to cook soup with meatballs, it is delicious, heat-clearing and detoxifying. Lettuce contains a variety of vitamins and inorganic salts, among which iron is relatively abundant, and it is easily absorbed by the human body under the action of organic acids and enzymes. Therefore, eating fresh lettuce is very effective in treating various anemias.
tips_zh:
1、莴笋和肉丸都不宜煮的太久，不仅营养流失而且会失去口感。
2、汤中除了盐不宜再放入其他调味料，影响汤的清新口感。
tips_en:
1. Neither lettuce nor meatballs should be cooked for too long. Not only will the nutrients be lost, but the taste will also be lost.
2. It is not advisable to add other seasonings to the soup except salt, which will affect the fresh taste of the soup.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 莴笋去皮切滚刀块；
steps.content_en: Peel the lettuce and cut into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 小葱洗净后切葱花；
steps.content_en: Wash the green onions and chop them into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 生姜剁成姜蓉；
steps.content_en: Finely chop the ginger into a paste;

steps.content_zh: 肉糜中加入盐、胡椒粉、芝麻油、小葱、姜末、淀粉和料酒，搅打上劲；
steps.content_en: Add salt, pepper, sesame oil, scallion, minced ginger, starch and cooking wine to the minced meat and beat until sticky;

steps.content_zh: 揉成一个个的小肉丸待用；
steps.content_en: Roll into small meatballs and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机开始烹饪；水沸腾后放入莴笋；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the thick porridge - 1 mark and tap Start Cooking on the phone; add the celtuce once the water boils;

steps.content_zh: 再次沸腾后放入肉丸子，待肉丸漂浮后就完成啦，放入少许的盐调味，撒上葱花就能出锅啦；
steps.content_en: When it boils again, add the meatballs. When the meatballs float, add a little salt to taste, sprinkle with chopped green onion and it's ready to serve;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh:
山药能补脾养胃，生津益肺，补肾涩精。
黑米所含锰、锌、铜等无机盐大都比大米高1~3倍；更含有大米所缺乏的维生素C、叶绿素、花青素、胡萝卜素及强心甙等特殊成分，因而黑米比普通大米更具营养。多食黑米具有开胃益中，健脾暖肝，明目活血，滑涩补精之功，对于少年白发、妇女产后虚弱，病后体虚以及贫血、肾虚均有很好的补养作用。
description_en:
Yam strengthens the spleen and stomach, promotes fluids, benefits the lungs and tonifies the kidneys.
Black rice contains manganese, zinc, copper and other mineral salts mostly 1–3 times higher than white rice, plus vitamin C, chlorophyll, anthocyanins, carotene and cardiac glycosides that white rice lacks. It is more nutritious: eating it often stimulates the appetite, warms the liver, improves vision and blood circulation and nourishes essence—helpful for premature graying, postpartum weakness, post-illness deficiency, anemia and kidney deficiency.
tips_zh:
黑米不像白米那样精加工，而是多半在脱壳之后以糙米的形式直接食用，这种口感较粗的黑米适合用来煮粥。煮粥前先浸泡，充分吸收水分。泡米用的水要与米同煮，以保存其中的营养成分。米粒外部有一坚韧的种皮包裹，不易煮烂，故黑米应先浸泡一夜再煮。
病后消化能力弱的人不宜急于吃黑米，可吃些紫米来调养
tips_en:
Black rice is not as refined as white rice. Instead, it is mostly eaten directly in the form of brown rice after shelling. This kind of black rice with a thicker texture is suitable for cooking porridge. Soak it before cooking porridge to fully absorb the water. The water used to soak the rice should be boiled with the rice to preserve the nutrients. There is a tough seed coat on the outside of the rice grain, which is not easy to cook, so black rice should be soaked overnight before cooking.
People with weak digestion after illness should not rush to eat black rice. They can eat some purple rice to recover.

steps.content_zh: 山药洗净后去皮切块；
steps.content_en: Wash the yam, peel and cut into pieces;

steps.content_zh: 提前一晚浸泡好的黑米，连同泡米的水一起倒入锅胆中，再放入洗好的粥米和山药，开始煲粥。
steps.content_en: Pour the black rice soaked overnight, with its soaking water, into the inner pot; add the washed porridge rice and yam and start cooking the porridge.

steps.content_zh: 完成后放入糖调味即可。
steps.content_en: When done, add sugar to taste.

description_zh: 一年前开始给孩子做营养早餐，也号召身边的妈妈们加入进来，做一份快手、营养、健康的早饭陪伴孩子开始一天的快乐学习。这款糯米藕中放了玫瑰，糯软可口，好看又好吃。
description_en: A year ago I started making nutritious breakfasts for my kids and got other moms involved too—quick, healthy meals to start their day of happy learning. This glutinous rice stuffed lotus root has rose in it: soft, sticky, pretty, and delicious.
tips_zh:
1、糯米一定要提前浸泡，不然很难煮。
2、这个配方含糖量比较低，不甜，所以可根据个人口味放糖。
tips_en:
1. Glutinous rice must be soaked in advance, otherwise it will be difficult to cook.
2. This recipe has a relatively low sugar content and is not sweet, so you can add sugar according to your personal taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材，糯米要浸泡过夜噢；
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients, the glutinous rice needs to be soaked overnight;

steps.content_zh: 为了防止仍有淤泥嵌在藕节中，我将两头都切掉，为了防止糯米漏出来，可以切五毫米的薄片，旋转180度，用牙签固定，孔与孔之间错开，糯米就不会漏了；
steps.content_en: In order to prevent there is still mud embedded in the lotus root joints, I cut off both ends. In order to prevent the glutinous rice from leaking out, you can cut a 5 mm slice, rotate it 180 degrees, and fix it with a toothpick. The holes should be staggered so that the glutinous rice will not leak out;

steps.content_zh: 用筷子辅助将糯米塞满每个空隙，小孔用玫瑰花堵上，大孔塞实就不用管了，事实证明确实没怎么漏；
steps.content_en: Use chopsticks to pack glutinous rice into every gap, plugging small holes with rose petals; large holes just need to be packed tight—it turned out there was hardly any leakage;

steps.content_zh: 红糖、玫瑰花、藕段放入电饭煲内，清水没过一半藕段即可；装进美美的小米电饭煲，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the brown sugar, rose petals and lotus root pieces in the rice cooker, adding water to cover half of the lotus root; transfer to the Mi rice cooker and tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen.

steps.content_zh: 翻面，继续煮粥模式两小时；
steps.content_en: Turn it over and continue in porridge mode for two hours;

steps.content_zh: 煮好后不要取出，放在电饭煲内继续焖至上色；切片上桌，淋上煮藕段的汁水，洒少许玫瑰花瓣；
steps.content_en: Do not take it out after cooking, place it in the rice cooker and continue to simmer until it changes color; slice into pieces and serve, pour the juice from the boiled lotus root segments and sprinkle with a few rose petals;

name_en: Broccoli, cheese and quinoa rice balls
description_zh: 粗粮加上蔬菜和芝士的搭配，简直是完美的早餐选择。维生素、膳食纤维和矿物质俱全，简单又美味，给孩子的营养早餐添助力。
description_en: Whole grains with vegetables and cheese make a perfect breakfast. Full of vitamins, fiber and minerals — simple, delicious, and a great boost to your child's nutrition.

steps.content_zh: 选取优质藜麦和小米，藜麦不用浸泡噢；
steps.content_en: Choose high-quality quinoa and millet. There is no need to soak the quinoa;

steps.content_zh: 正常水量，精煮模式很好地保存了藜麦和小米中的水份，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: With the normal water level, the fine-cook mode preserves the moisture in the quinoa and millet. Tap the 'Start Cooking' icon on the phone screen to begin;

steps.content_zh: 看，煮好的米饭黏糯香甜，连藜麦都已经开花了；
steps.content_en: Look, the cooked rice is sticky and sweet, and even the quinoa has bloomed;

steps.content_zh: 将西兰花焯水，拌入米饭中，加少许盐调味；
steps.content_en: Blanch the broccoli, stir into the rice, and season with a pinch of salt;

steps.content_zh: 芝士片切丁；
steps.content_en: Dice cheese slices;

steps.content_zh: 取一把米饭，乘热裹入芝士片，搓成球状；
steps.content_en: Take a handful of rice, wrap it in cheese slices while it's hot, and roll into a ball;

steps.content_zh: 看，芝士片在饭团中慢慢融化，营养丰富，有助于孩子长高的西兰花芝士藜麦饭团就做好了；
steps.content_en: Look, the cheese slices are slowly melting in the rice balls. The broccoli cheese quinoa rice balls are rich in nutrients and help children grow taller.

steps.content_zh: 成品图。
steps.content_en: Finished product picture.

description_zh: 春天正当竹笋和莴笋上市的时节，味道鲜美清香、清热去火。还富含很多种矿物质、膳食纤维和维生素。一年之计在于春，春天要更好的健脾、清肠道，保养身体。所以在这个时节很适合吃这道菜。简单美味低热量。
description_en: Spring is the season for bamboo shoots and celtuce—fresh, fragrant, and cooling. They're packed with minerals, fiber, and vitamins. Spring is the time to strengthen the spleen, cleanse the intestines, and care for your body. This dish is perfect for the season: simple, tasty, and low in calories.
tips_zh: 竹笋和莴笋焯水的时候在水中放入盐是为了给一个基本底味，最后放入生抽是为了让味道更鲜美。
tips_en: Adding salt to the water when blanching bamboo shoots and celtuce gives a basic seasoning; adding light soy sauce at the end makes it more savory.

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 竹笋切丝；
steps.content_en: Shred bamboo shoots;

steps.content_zh: 莴笋去皮切丝；
steps.content_en: Peel and shred lettuce;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中水加到水位线：稠粥-½的刻度，加入2茶匙盐，点击手机开始烹饪图标；
steps.content_en: Add water to the inner pot up to the water level line: the thick porridge - ½ mark, add 2 teaspoons of salt, and tap Start Cooking on the phone;

steps.content_zh: 烧水的同时将干辣椒切碎，大蒜切末；
steps.content_en: While the water heats, chop the dried chilies and mince the garlic;

steps.content_zh: 大概8分钟后水烧开，放入竹笋丝和莴笋丝，煮两分钟后捞出过凉水，保持清脆的口感；
steps.content_en: After about 8 minutes, bring the water to a boil, add shredded bamboo shoots and lettuce, cook for two minutes and then drain into cold water to maintain a crisp texture;

steps.content_zh: 将冷却后的双丝放到盘子中，放上干辣椒和蒜末；
steps.content_en: Place the cooled shreds on a plate, top with dried chili peppers and minced garlic;

steps.content_zh: 将色拉油和芝麻油烧热后淋在蒜末和干辣椒上；
steps.content_en: Heat the salad oil and sesame oil and pour over the minced garlic and dried chili pepper;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 很多上班族喜欢上班带饭，但是工作繁忙，没有时间准备。这道便当，方便快捷又美味，煮饭的同时就将食才做好了，搭配上新鲜的莴笋更健康。
description_en: Many office workers bring lunch but lack time to prepare. This bento is quick, easy and tasty—the side dishes cook while the rice does, and fresh celtuce makes it healthier.
tips_zh:
1、可以多做一些，一半当天吃，一半带着上班。
2、还可以根据个人爱好放入其他的蔬菜，但是要焯水哦。
tips_en:
1. You can make more, half to eat on the day and half to take to work.
2. You can also add other vegetables according to personal preference, but they need to be blanched.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸭田米洗净后倒入锅中，水加到水位线：东北米-1的刻度，腊鸡腿洗净后切块，铺在大米上，最后放上姜片，点击手机开始烹饪图标，进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the duck-field rice and pour into the pot; add water to the Northeast rice -1 mark on the water level line. Wash and cut the cured chicken thigh into chunks, spread over the rice, and top with ginger slices. Tap the Start Cooking icon on your phone to cook;

steps.content_zh: 莴笋切丝，泡在水中防止氧化；
steps.content_en: Shred the celtuce and soak in water to prevent browning;

steps.content_zh: 饭煲烹饪完成后，铺上莴笋丝；
steps.content_en: After the rice cooker is finished cooking, add shredded lettuce;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀后继续焖5分钟；
steps.content_en: Stir evenly and continue to simmer for 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 冷却后就能盛出放到便当盒里了，第二天上班的时候加热下。
steps.content_en: After cooling, you can put it in a lunch box and heat it up when you go to work the next day.

name_en: Salted egg yolk pork floss green dumpling
description_zh: 转眼清明又近，青团又要做起来啦。这款火遍大江南北、排队都买不到的网红咸蛋黄肉松青团今年一定学会自己做，青色的外皮软糯Q弹，内馅油亮温润，咬一口满口溢香，味道完全比得过市售青团。
description_en: Qingming is near, so it's time for green glutinous rice balls again. This viral salted-egg-yolk and pork-floss version sells out everywhere—learn to make it this year. The green skin is soft and chewy, the filling rich and glossy, and every bite bursts with aroma, better than store-bought.
tips_zh:
1、黏米粉就是普通的大米粉。
2、如果没有艾草粉，可以用新鲜的艾草或者菠菜煮熟后打成汁。
3、完成后刷油是为了增加光泽，以防表皮发硬。
tips_en:
1. Glutinous rice flour is just regular sweet rice flour.
2. No mugwort powder? Cook fresh mugwort or spinach and blend it into juice.
3. Brush with oil at the end for shine and to keep the surface from hardening.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 先将咸蛋黄蒸制15分钟；
steps.content_en: First steam the salted egg yolk for 15 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 糯米粉、粘米粉和艾草粉混合后，缓缓加入水揉成面团；
steps.content_en: Mix glutinous rice flour, rice flour and mugwort powder, then gradually add water and knead into a dough;

steps.content_zh: 蒸熟后的咸蛋黄用刀背碾碎；
steps.content_en: Crush the steamed salted egg yolks with the back of a knife;

steps.content_zh: 将肉松和蛋黄混合后揉成团状；
steps.content_en: Mix the meat floss and egg yolk and knead into a dough;

steps.content_zh: 取一些面团用手拍成面皮，放上蛋黄肉松馅；
steps.content_en: Take some dough and pat it into a dough with your hands, then put the egg yolk and meat floss filling;

steps.content_zh: 做好的生青团，放入蒸笼中，点击手机开始烹饪图标，进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the prepared green dumplings into the steamer and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 准备好一些橄榄油,蒸熟后在青团的表面刷上一层；
steps.content_en: Prepare some olive oil, steam it and brush a layer on the surface of the green dough;

steps.content_zh: 取出享用吧。
steps.content_en: Take out and enjoy.

name_en: Lettuce, fungus and cured duck soup
description_zh: 腊鸭调出来的咸汤简直要鲜掉眉毛了，吃完这锅就可以抵御春寒啦。
description_en: The salty soup made from waxed duck is so delicious that you can ward off the spring cold after eating this pot.
tips_zh:
1、有的腊鸭特别咸，所以煮汤之前要浸泡一会。
2、调味前尝一下汤是否够味，不够再放入少量的盐调味。
tips_en:
1. Some cured ducks are very salty, so soak the duck for a while before making the soup.
2. Taste the soup before seasoning; add a little salt only if needed.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 腊鸭切块后浸泡1小时，去除一些咸味，不然煮出来太咸；
steps.content_en: Cut the cured duck into pieces and soak for 1 hour to remove some of the saltiness, otherwise it will be too salty;

steps.content_zh: 木耳发泡洗净；
steps.content_en: Rehydrate and wash the wood ear mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 泡好的腊鸭块焯水；
steps.content_en: Blanch the soaked cured duck pieces;

steps.content_zh: 生姜拍松；
steps.content_en: Lightly crush the ginger;

steps.content_zh: 将腊鸭、木耳和生姜同时放入锅中，水加到最高水位线，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the cured duck, fungus and ginger into the pot at the same time, add water to the highest water level, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪过过程中，撇去浮油；
steps.content_en: During cooking, skim off any floating oil;

steps.content_zh: 莴笋去皮切块，剩余30分钟时倒入锅中；
steps.content_en: Peel and cut the celtuce into chunks, add to the pot with 30 minutes remaining;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入胡椒粉调味即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking is complete, add pepper to taste.

name_en: Steamed ribs with fermented black beans
description_zh: 豆豉蒸排骨是一道广泛流传于大江南北的菜肴，色香味形俱全，排骨滑嫩脱骨，肉质弹而不烂，而且吸足了蒜香和椒香，每一口都鲜美味浓。
description_en: Steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce is a dish widely spread across the country. It is full of color, flavor and shape. The pork ribs are smooth and tender, falling off the bones, and the meat is elastic but not rotten. It also absorbs the aroma of garlic and pepper, making every bite delicious and delicious.
tips_zh:
1、可以在煮米饭的时候一起将排骨蒸上，方便快捷。
2、放一些芝麻油在里面，会更香，但是会比较油腻。
tips_en:
1. You can steam the ribs while cooking the rice, which is convenient and quick.
2. Put some sesame oil in it, it will be more fragrant, but it will be greasy.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 仔排用清水浸泡30分钟，去除血水捞出后控干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the pork chops in clean water for 30 minutes, remove the blood, take them out and drain them;

steps.content_zh: 豆豉和大蒜用蒜捣子捣烂，这样做会更入味；
steps.content_en: Crush the fermented black beans and garlic with a mortar for deeper flavor;

steps.content_zh: 倒入料酒、蚝油、盐、辣椒圈、老抽搅拌均匀调成酱料；
steps.content_en: Pour in the cooking wine, oyster sauce, salt, chili rings, and dark soy sauce and mix evenly to form a sauce;

steps.content_zh: 倒入排骨中，倒入淀粉后搅拌均匀，腌渍30分钟；
steps.content_en: Pour into the pork ribs, stir in the starch and marinate for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 摆在盘子中；
steps.content_en: Arrange on a plate;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度，将排骨放蒸笼中，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the inner pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 3 mark, put the spare ribs in the steamer, and tap Start Cooking on the phone to cook;

steps.content_zh: 完成；
steps.content_en: Finish;

steps.content_zh: 撒上一些辣椒装饰。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with a little chili for garnish.

description_zh: 传说：“人间有了青稞粮，日子过得真甜美；一日三餐不愁吃，顿顿还有青稞酒。人人感谢云雀鸟，万众珍爱青稞粒。”青稞具有含有蛋白质、脂肪、淀粉、维生素B具有补脾养胃、益气止泻、壮筋益力等功效，磨成粉做成蛋糕后使蛋糕的纤维量增加，有助于消化，老少皆宜。
description_en: Legend: "With highland barley grain in the world, life is really sweet; you can eat three meals a day without worrying about it, and there is highland barley wine for every meal. Everyone is grateful to the skylark bird, and everyone cherishes highland barley grains." Highland barley contains protein, fat, starch, and vitamin B. It has the effects of nourishing the spleen and stomach, replenishing qi and diarrhea, strengthening muscles and strength, etc. When ground into powder and made into cakes, the fiber content of the cake increases, which is helpful for digestion and is suitable for all ages.
tips_zh:
1、可以留5克的油刷在锅胆中，这样取出蛋糕的时候会容易些。
2、装蛋清的容器要无水、无油、无蛋黄。
tips_en:
1. Reserve 5 g of oil to brush the inner pot so the cake comes out easily.
2. The bowl for the egg whites must be free of water, oil, and yolk.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将蛋清和蛋白分离；
steps.content_en: Separate egg whites and egg whites;

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中搅均匀后倒入牛奶、玉米油搅拌后筛入青稞面搅拌到无颗粒状态；
steps.content_en: Stir the egg yolks evenly, then pour in the milk and corn oil, stir, then sift in the highland barley noodles and stir until there are no particles;

steps.content_zh: 蛋清用电动打蛋器打发，过程中分三次倒入砂糖，打到干性发泡的状态（拉起有直立不弯曲的角）；
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric egg beater. Pour in the sugar in three batches during the process and beat until dry peaks form (the corners should be upright and not bent);

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄和蛋白混合后不规则切拌均匀，倒入锅胆中；点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烘焙；
steps.content_en: Mix yolks and whites with irregular folding motions, pour into the inner pot; tap the start cooking icon on the app to bake;

steps.content_zh: 完成后取出；
steps.content_en: Remove when finished;

steps.content_zh: 切开，享用吧。
steps.content_en: Cut and enjoy.

description_zh: 春天是老家田地里野菜疯长的季节，各种的田地里都会有很多的野生荠菜冒出头，小时候我们就会拎着篮子在田边地头挖上嫩嫩的野生荠菜，回去摘洗干净，配上鸡蛋或猪肉做成馅，包饺子或者包子，美美的吃上一顿！这是一份属于春天特别的味道，也是属于我们儿时的记忆。
description_en: Spring is the season when wild vegetables grow wildly in the fields in my hometown. There will be a lot of wild shepherd's purse sprouting in various fields. When we were young, we would carry baskets on the edges of the fields to dig out tender wild shepherd's purses, go back and pick them clean, make stuffing with eggs or pork, make dumplings or steamed buns, and have a delicious meal! This is a special taste of spring and a memory of our childhood.

steps.content_zh: 准备一个小盆，把温水和酵母粉放进去；
steps.content_en: Prepare a small basin and put warm water and yeast powder into it;

steps.content_zh: 再倒进面粉；
steps.content_en: Pour in the flour again;

steps.content_zh: 用筷子搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Stir well with chopsticks;

steps.content_zh: 揉成一个光滑的面团；盖上盖子或保鲜膜，放置温暖处发酵至两倍大；
steps.content_en: Knead into a smooth dough; cover with a lid or plastic wrap and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled in size;

steps.content_zh: 准备荠菜，摘洗干净，我这种是野生荠菜，是婆婆专门从老家带来的；
steps.content_en: Prepare shepherd's purse, pick and wash it. Mine is wild shepherd's purse, which my mother-in-law brought specially from her hometown;

steps.content_zh: 锅里烧开水，把荠菜放进去烫30秒捞出，这样可以去除荠菜中的草酸含量；
steps.content_en: Boil water in a pot, put the shepherd's purse in and blanch it for 30 seconds and take it out. This can remove the oxalic acid content in the shepherd's purse;

steps.content_zh: 把烫过的荠菜挤去多余的水份，切碎；
steps.content_en: Squeeze excess water from the blanched shepherd's purse and chop into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 猪肉切小块，放进料理碗里；
steps.content_en: Cut the pork into small pieces and put into a cooking bowl;

steps.content_zh: 猪肉切小块，放进料理碗里；
steps.content_en: Cut the pork into small pieces and put into a cooking bowl;

steps.content_zh: 把肉馅和荠菜放在一个小盆里；
steps.content_en: Place minced meat and shepherd's purse in a small basin;

steps.content_zh: 放进生抽、盐和香油，再加点复合调味料，一起用筷子顺时针搅拌成馅；
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, salt and sesame oil plus a little mixed seasoning, and stir clockwise with chopsticks into a filling.

steps.content_zh: 面发好了，里面有蜂窝状；
steps.content_en: The dough has risen and has a honeycomb texture inside;

steps.content_zh: 分成若干个小面团；
steps.content_en: Divide into several small dough pieces;

steps.content_zh: 取其中一个面团，擀成中间厚四周薄的面皮；包上猪肉荠菜馅；
steps.content_en: Take one of the doughs and roll it out into a dough that is thick in the middle and thin around the edges; wrap it with pork and shepherd’s purse filling;

steps.content_zh: 包子就包好了；
steps.content_en: The buns are wrapped;

steps.content_zh: 依次包好八个包子生坯，底部放置油纸，这样可以防止粘笼屉，静置醒发10分钟左右；这个醒发的时间要看包子生胚的大小和室内温度的高底进行调节；
steps.content_en: Wrap eight raw buns in sequence, place oiled paper on the bottom to prevent them from sticking to the basket, and let them rest for about 10 minutes; the time to rise depends on the size of the buns and the indoor temperature.

steps.content_zh: 凉水上锅，选择蒸,，总用时30分钟左右（包含把水烧开的时间）；手机APP操控，很是方便！
steps.content_en: Add cold water to the pot, choose steaming, it will take about 30 minutes in total (including the time to boil the water); it is very convenient to control it through the mobile APP!

steps.content_zh: 看，美味的大包子可以上桌了。这个馅真的很好吃；
steps.content_en: Look, the delicious big buns are ready to serve. This filling is really tasty;

description_zh:
妈妈的生日之际，远在千里之外的我为了表达深深的祝福，特意做了3个寿桃请妈妈视吃了，并遥祝她老人家万寿无疆，身体安康！
用的是米家IH电饭煲蒸出来的，便捷且寿桃成品口感也非常之好，完全可以替代传统火蒸，容量也很适合，赞！
description_en:
For Mom's birthday, a thousand miles away, I made three longevity peaches to send her my deep blessings, wishing her a long and healthy life!
Steamed in the Mi IH rice cooker—convenient, and the peaches turned out wonderfully. It fully replaces traditional steaming over a flame, and the capacity is just right. Thumbs up!

steps.content_zh: 面粉中除了红曲粉之外的全部加入搅拌缸中搅拌光滑，常温发酵至面团二倍大；
steps.content_en: Add all the flour except the red yeast rice powder to the mixing bowl and knead until smooth, then ferment at room temperature until doubled in size;

steps.content_zh: 发酵好的面团揉匀；
steps.content_en: Knead the fermented dough evenly;

steps.content_zh: 分割成三个面团；
steps.content_en: Divide dough into three;

steps.content_zh: 把它们捏成桃子形状；
steps.content_en: Shape them into peach shapes;

steps.content_zh: 用牙刷沾红曲粉把面团表面刷上色；
steps.content_en: Dip a toothbrush in red yeast rice powder and brush the dough surface to color it;

steps.content_zh: 依次做好，锅内放水，把寿桃生胚摆放在电饭煲的蒸架上，静置15分钟；
steps.content_en: Do it in sequence, put water in the pot, place the raw peach embryos on the steam rack of the rice cooker, and let it sit for 15 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Tap the Start Cooking icon on your phone to begin cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后让其在锅内焖2分钟取出。
steps.content_en: After cooking, let it steam in the pot for 2 minutes, then remove.

description_zh:
破酥包子是云南的特色美食，我家大小两个男人都爱吃它，所以家里只要有冬笋我就会做一次给他们解解馋。
这次仍是用的米家IH电饭煲蒸制，自从有了这款漂亮大气的米家IH电饭煲做什么美食我都会最先想到能不能爱它来完成呢，真是爱之切呀！
description_en:
Posu buns are a specialty delicacy in Yunnan. Both men in my family love to eat it, so as long as there are winter bamboo shoots in the house, I will make them to satisfy their cravings.
This time I still use the Mijia IH rice cooker for steaming. Ever since I got this beautiful and elegant Mijia IH rice cooker, when I make any delicious food, I will first think about whether I can love it to finish it. I really love it!

steps.content_zh: 面粉、老面、发酵粉、水混合揉成团常温进行发酵；
steps.content_en: Mix flour, starter dough, baking powder and water, knead into a dough, and let it ferment at room temperature;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉、冬笋、香菇切成米粒丁状；
steps.content_en: Cut the pork belly, winter bamboo shoots, and shiitake mushrooms into diced rice;

steps.content_zh: 油六成热后加入肉丁炒散，加入香菇丁、笋丁炒匀；
steps.content_en: When the oil is 60% hot, add the diced pork and stir-fry until loose. Add the diced mushrooms and bamboo shoots and stir-fry evenly;

steps.content_zh: 加入生抽，老抽，盐，料酒炒匀关火，加入金钩和胡椒粉拌匀备用；
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, salt and cooking wine, stir well, turn off the heat, add golden hook and pepper, mix well and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 这是发酵好的面团，内部有细密的蜂孔；
steps.content_en: This is fermented dough with fine honeycomb holes inside;

steps.content_zh: 把面团倒入厨师机中，加入小苏打搅打均匀。然后制作油酥：猪油烧热加入面粉拌匀放凉即可；
steps.content_en: Put the dough in a stand mixer, add baking soda and mix well. For the oil paste: heat lard, stir in flour and let cool.

steps.content_zh: 取200克面团擀成大薄片；
steps.content_en: Take 200 grams of dough and roll it into large thin sheets;

steps.content_zh: 均匀抹上油酥；
steps.content_en: Spread the pastry evenly;

steps.content_zh: 卷起；
steps.content_en: roll up;

steps.content_zh: 用手扯出四个剂子；
steps.content_en: Pull out four doses with your hands;

steps.content_zh: 把两头捏紧收拢，按扁成中间厚两边薄的圆面片，同老婆饼的手法包入肉馅，捏紧；
steps.content_en: Pinch the two ends together, flatten into a round dough piece with a thick middle and thin sides, wrap the meat filling in the same way as the wife cake, and pinch tightly;

steps.content_zh: 收口朝下放置在蒸垫中，锅内放水；点击手机开始烹饪图标，启动蒸煮程序；
steps.content_en: Place seam-side down on the steaming mat, add water to the pot and tap Start Cooking on the phone to begin steaming.

steps.content_zh: 蒸20分钟完成后，在锅内焖2分钟取出，热食口感最好。
steps.content_en: After steaming for 20 minutes, simmer in the pot for 2 minutes and take it out. It tastes best when eaten hot.

description_zh:
每年3-5月正是吃草莓的好季节，应季的草莓个个鲜红欲滴、果实饱满，而且价格很便宜。如果这段时间不抓紧吃草莓，错过又要等明年了。以往草莓的吃法无非就是洗干净了直接放进嘴里，多一道工序就是沾点白糖再塞进嘴里，稍微麻烦点的还可以榨草莓汁。今天小编手把手教大家一个草莓的新吃法，它也是一款经典的日本小吃——草莓大福。
大福的外皮和麻糬类似，用糯米制成，外面会沾上一层白粉避免粘手，里头包着饱满的带皮红小豆馅，馅料的量常跟饼皮的量一样甚至更多，使得大福的外型圆浑有致。据说大福就因为这样的外型而被称为“大腹饼”，后人取其吉祥的谐音改称“大福”。
description_en:
March to May is the perfect season for strawberries—fresh, plump, beautifully red, and great value. Don't miss them, or you'll wait another year. Usually strawberries are simply washed and eaten, maybe dipped in sugar, or blended into juice. Today we'll show you a new way to enjoy them: the classic Japanese snack, strawberry daifuku.
Daifuku's outer layer is like mochi, made from glutinous rice and dusted with white powder to prevent sticking. It wraps a generous filling of whole red bean paste, often as much as or more than the wrapper, giving it a round, plump shape. It's said this shape earned it the name 'big belly cake,' later renamed 'daifuku' for its auspicious sound.
tips_zh:
1、手粉很重要，一定要准备不然非常粘手，手粉就是熟的淀粉，可以放在微波炉里面转2分钟；
2、用来蒸的饭盒要抹油，方便后来取出；
3、加热后的糯米糊取出，看是否还有白色粉状没有熟透的糯米粉，如果有的话再放入锅中  蒸5分钟；
tips_en:
1. Dusting flour is essential—otherwise the dough sticks badly to your hands. It's just cooked starch; microwave it for 2 minutes.
2. Oil the steaming container so the cake is easy to remove.
3. After heating, check the rice paste for any white, uncooked powder; if you see some, steam for another 5 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将糯米粉和玉米淀粉以及糖混合在一起；
steps.content_en: Mix glutinous rice flour with cornstarch and sugar;

steps.content_zh: 加入清水搅拌均匀后倒入玉米油；
steps.content_en: Add water, mix well and then pour in corn oil;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌后倒入饭盒中（饭盒中刷上一层油）；
steps.content_en: Stir and pour into a lunch box brushed with oil;

steps.content_zh: 锅中放一个小蒸架，加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，放上面糊，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Place a small steaming rack in the pot, add water to the water level line: northeast rice -2 mark, put the batter on it, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 草莓洗净去蒂，用豆沙包裹住；
steps.content_en: Wash and hull the strawberries, then wrap them in red bean paste;

steps.content_zh: 锅中蒸好后，取出倒入盆中，使劲搅拌到光滑的状态；
steps.content_en: After steaming in the pot, take it out into a bowl and stir vigorously until smooth;

steps.content_zh: 手上抹手粉，取一团面揉成皮，包上草莓豆沙就行啦；
steps.content_en: Apply hand powder on your hands, take a ball of dough and knead it into a skin, then wrap it with strawberry bean paste;

steps.content_zh: 切开的样子。
steps.content_en: The way it looks cut.

name_en: Black sesame and soy milk braised rice
description_zh: 早餐的时候喜欢打各种五谷豆浆来喝，有时候做的多了，就会剩下一杯，为了不浪费我都用来揉面蒸馒头了，这样也能全面吸收豆浆里的营养，还不会浪费食材。这一天早餐又剩下了一杯黑芝麻豆浆，突然想到，普通黄豆浆可以用来蒸米饭，那这黑芝麻豆浆用来蒸米饭如何呢？想到就要去实验一下，于是中午做了一款焖饭，用到了这碗被剩下来的黑芝麻豆浆，为了省事，还放了一些菜进去，做一款豆浆焖饭，没成想，这款临时起意的焖饭却得到了婆婆的夸奖，不仅有焖饭的香，土豆的糯，香肠的嚼劲，还有黑芝麻豆浆的香浓，没有加水哦，剩下的那碗豆浆的量刚刚好！
description_en: I like to make all kinds of grain and soy milk for breakfast. Sometimes if I make too much, there will be a cup left. In order not to waste it, I use it to knead the dough and steam the steamed buns. This way I can fully absorb the nutrients in the soy milk and not waste the ingredients. I had another cup of black sesame soy milk left for breakfast that day. I suddenly thought that ordinary soy milk can be used to steam rice. How about using this black sesame soy milk to steam rice? I thought of experimenting, so I made a stewed rice at noon, using the leftover bowl of black sesame soy milk. In order to save trouble, I also put some vegetables in to make a soy milk stewed rice. Unexpectedly, this impromptu stewed rice was praised by my mother-in-law. It not only has the aroma of stewed rice, glutinous potatoes, chewy sausage, but also the rich aroma of black sesame soy milk. No water is added, and the amount of the remaining bowl of soy milk is just right!

steps.content_zh: 先把大米洗净放进电饭煲里；
steps.content_en: First wash the rice and put it into the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 把黑芝麻豆浆也倒进锅里；
steps.content_en: Pour the black sesame soy milk into the pot as well;

steps.content_zh: 再准备好焖饭所用的其它食材；我这里放了香肠、土豆、豆角、杏鲍菇；
steps.content_en: Then prepare other ingredients for stewed rice; here I put sausages, potatoes, beans, and king oyster mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 把食材洗净切成小块；
steps.content_en: Wash the ingredients and cut them into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 把各种食材放进一个容器里，加入生抽酱油、盐、黑胡椒粉、蚝油一起调拌均匀。注意食材中的香肠是咸甜口味的，而酱油和蚝油也都是咸味的，盐的量要少放，如果喜欢清淡的可以不用再加盐了。黑胡椒粉是用来提味的，没有也可以不用放；
steps.content_en: Put all the ingredients into a container, add light soy sauce, salt, black pepper, and oyster sauce and mix well. Note that the sausages in the ingredients are salty and sweet, while soy sauce and oyster sauce are also salty, so you should add less salt. If you like it lighter, you don’t need to add more salt. Black pepper is used to enhance the flavor, you don’t need to add it if you don’t have it;

steps.content_zh: 把拌好的食材倒进电饭煲里，平摊开；点击手机开始烹饪图标，进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the mixed ingredients into the rice cooker and spread them flat; click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 小时过后，电饭煲会发出提示音，打开饭煲，黑芝麻豆浆焖饭已经做好了；
steps.content_en: After the hour has passed, the rice cooker will beep, turn on the rice cooker, and the black sesame and soy milk stewed rice is ready;

steps.content_zh: 用饭勺拌一下，让米饭和菜混合均匀，因为用的黑芝麻豆浆，所以大米的颜色都被染的有些发黑，但味道却是很香的；
steps.content_en: Stir with a rice paddle to mix the rice and vegetables evenly; the black sesame soy milk tinted the rice slightly dark, but it tasted wonderful;

steps.content_zh: 有米有肉有菜有菌有豆制品，还有可以补钙乌发的黑芝麻，这样一份营养丰富的焖饭，是不是很值得尝试一下呢！如果你家早餐也有喝不完的豆浆，不如试试焖个米饭吧！
steps.content_en: With rice, meat, vegetables, mushrooms, and soy products—plus black sesame for calcium and black hair—this nourishing braised rice is worth a try! If you have leftover soy milk at breakfast, why not cook a pot of rice with it?

description_zh: 菠菜大量上市之际，做了款菠菜汁戚风蛋糕，颜色亮丽，松软可口，和烤箱烤出来的口感一样好。
description_en: When spinach was in season, I made a spinach juice chiffon cake — bright in color, soft and delicious, just as good as one baked in an oven.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材，菠菜汁榨好；
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients and squeeze the spinach juice;

steps.content_zh: 蛋清蛋黄分离，分别放到无水无油的两个容器中；
steps.content_en: Separate the whites and yolks into two clean, dry, oil-free bowls;

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄加入30克细砂糖，用手动打蛋器搅拌均匀，加入玉米油搅拌均匀，再加入50克菠菜泥拌匀；
steps.content_en: Add 30 g caster sugar to the egg yolks and mix with a hand whisk, add corn oil and mix well, then add 50 g spinach puree and stir;

steps.content_zh: 再加入低筋面粉，再次搅拌均匀，搅拌至无颗粒；
steps.content_en: Add low-gluten flour again, stir evenly again, and stir until there are no lumps;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋白中滴入几滴白醋，先用慢速打至成粗泡，分3次加入30克细砂糖；
steps.content_en: Add a few drops of white vinegar to the egg whites, beat at slow speed until they form a rough foam, then add 30 grams of fine sugar in three batches;

steps.content_zh: 快速打至出纹路状；
steps.content_en: Punch quickly until texture appears;

steps.content_zh: 最后出现小直尖的状态；
steps.content_en: Finally, a small straight point appears;

steps.content_zh: 取三分之一的蛋白加入到蛋黄糊中，用刮刀搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Add one-third of the egg whites to the egg yolk paste and mix evenly with a spatula;

steps.content_zh: 然后再加入剩余的鸡蛋白，轻轻从底部刮起搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Then add the remaining egg whites, gently scraping from the bottom, and mix well;

steps.content_zh: 10.将面糊倒入电饭煲中，颠几下震出大气泡，点手机开始烹饪图标进行烘焙；
steps.content_en: 10. Pour the batter into the rice cooker, stir it a few times to release large bubbles, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start baking;

steps.content_zh: 烤好后打开电饭煲，已经顶到了盖子；
steps.content_en: When done, open the rice cooker — the cake has risen right up to the lid;

steps.content_zh: 拿出切开，柔软可口。
steps.content_en: Take it out and cut it, soft and delicious.

description_zh: 樱花做出来的水晶皮冻，晶莹剔透，粉粉的樱花做出来真的很惊艳。
description_en: Crystal aspic made with cherry blossoms is clear and sparkling; the pink blossoms make it truly stunning.

steps.content_zh: 肉皮先浸泡2小时，然后切去猪皮上的肥肉，刮去猪毛，凉水下锅，水开后煮5分钟；
steps.content_en: Soak the pork skin for 2 hours, then trim off the fat, scrape off the hairs, put it in cold water to boil, and cook for 5 minutes once the water boils;

steps.content_zh: 取出，再次把肥肉和猪毛刮去，加一点碱面搓猪皮，搓到很干净，不沾一点肥肉，然后冲洗净，再稍加醋，再次冲洗干净。
steps.content_en: Take it out, scrape off the fat and pig hair again, add a little alkaline flour and rub the pig skin until it is very clean without any fat on it, then rinse it, add a little vinegar, and rinse it again.

steps.content_zh: 凉水下锅再煮2分钟，把最后的一点杂质煮掉，再把肉皮里外刮一遍。
steps.content_en: Put the pot under cold water and cook for another 2 minutes to boil out the last bit of impurities, and then scrape the inside and outside of the meat skin.

steps.content_zh: 电饭煲中放入水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度，将处理好的肉皮放入碗中，加入清水，放到蒸笼中，隔水蒸90分钟。
steps.content_en: Pour water into the rice cooker to the water level line: -3 Northeast Rice. Put the processed pork skin into a bowl, add water, put it in a steamer, and steam for 90 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 取出放在浅盘里放凉；
steps.content_en: Remove and place in a shallow dish to cool;

steps.content_zh: 处理盐渍樱花：把樱花用清水冲洗几遍，去掉咸味；
steps.content_en: Processing of salted cherry blossoms: Rinse the cherry blossoms several times with water to remove the salty smell;

steps.content_zh: 将处理好的樱花放在放凉的皮冻汤里，放冰箱冷藏一宿；
steps.content_en: Place the processed cherry blossoms in the cooled jelly soup and refrigerate overnight;

steps.content_zh: 切时候用刀沾水，好切，吃时候蘸上调料。
steps.content_en: Dip a knife in water when cutting to make it easier to cut, and dip it in seasoning when eating.

name_en: Green rice balls with cured pork and bamboo shoots
description_zh:
青团是江南地区一带的传统特色小吃，青色的，通常是采用浆麦草汁，有的采用青艾汁，甚至其他的一些绿色蔬菜汁和糯米粉捣制再以豆沙为馅而成，不甜不腻，带有清淡却悠长的青草香气。人们用它祭祖，但更多的是应令尝新。
青团的馅可甜可咸，看个人喜欢。这段时间的冬笋比较便宜，也非常鲜嫩，所以就用它和肉配在一起，加点酱料炒香，这样做出的青团酱香味浓，脆嫩可口特别好吃。
description_en: Qingtuan (green rice balls) are a traditional specialty snack of the Jiangnan region. Green in color, they are usually made from wheatgrass juice - sometimes mugwort juice or other green vegetable juice - mixed with glutinous rice flour and filled with red bean paste. Not sweet or greasy, they carry a light, lingering grassy aroma. People use them for ancestor worship, but more often to enjoy the season's fresh treat. The filling can be sweet or savory, as you like. Winter bamboo shoots are cheap and very tender right now, so I paired them with meat and a bit of sauce stir-fried until fragrant; the resulting qingtuan are rich in savory sauce flavor, crisp, tender and especially delicious.
tips_zh:
1、可以选用带点肥的猪肉，这样吃起来更润口
2、馅料里也可以放点香菇，增加香味
3、麦苗粉网上可以买到，有条件的可以用艾草来制作
4、青团蒸的时间不宜过长，否则会软榻不成形
5、青团放凉后会变得有点干硬，食用前入微波炉高火加热几十秒即可
tips_en:
1. You can choose pork with a little fat, so it tastes more moist.
2. You can also put some mushrooms in the filling to increase the flavor.
3. Wheatgrass powder can be purchased online, and if possible, it can be made with mugwort.
4. The green dumplings should not be steamed for too long, otherwise they will become soft and lose their shape.
5. The green dumplings will become a little dry and hard after cooling. Just heat them in the microwave on high heat for a few dozen seconds before eating.

steps.content_zh: 备好所需食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 冬笋去壳后，取嫩的部分切对半切开，放开水里煮5到8分钟捞出；
steps.content_en: After peeling the winter bamboo shoots, cut the tender parts in half, boil them in boiling water for 5 to 8 minutes and remove;

steps.content_zh: 猪肉切小丁，焯过水的冬笋切丁；
steps.content_en: Cut the pork into small cubes, and cut the blanched winter bamboo shoots into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 锅中油热后，下入肉丁煸炒；
steps.content_en: After the oil in the pot is hot, add the diced pork and stir-fry;

steps.content_zh: 肉丁炒至变白后倒入料酒、姜末、生抽、甜面酱、糖、黄豆酱炒出香味；
steps.content_en: Once the diced meat turns white, add cooking wine, minced ginger, light soy sauce, sweet bean sauce, sugar and soybean paste and stir until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 放入笋丁翻炒1分钟；
steps.content_en: Add the diced bamboo shoots and stir-fry for 1 minute;

steps.content_zh: 关火后倒入芝麻油炒匀盛出放凉备用；
steps.content_en: Turn off the heat, add sesame oil, stir-fry well, set aside to cool;

steps.content_zh: 将糯米粉、粘米粉和麦苗粉放一起混合均匀；
steps.content_en: Mix glutinous rice flour, sticky rice flour and wheatgrass flour together;

steps.content_zh: 取一小块面团捏成小碗状，放入前面炒好的肉馅；
steps.content_en: Take a small piece of dough and shape it into a small bowl, and add the meat filling that was fried earlier;

steps.content_zh: 把口封好后搓成圆球；
steps.content_en: Seal the mouth and roll into a round ball;

steps.content_zh: 蒸笼垫上防粘垫，把包好的青团坯子依次放入，待电饭煲中的水沸腾后放入蒸笼，蒸8至10分钟；
steps.content_en: Line the steamer with a non-stick mat, arrange the green rice dumplings, then place the steamer in the cooker once the water boils and steam for 8–10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 青团蒸好趁热刷一层食用油，可防止表皮干硬；
steps.content_en: Brush the steamed qingtuan with a layer of cooking oil while still hot to keep the skins from drying out and hardening;

steps.content_zh: Q弹软糯，咸鲜适口，很好吃哦。
steps.content_en: Q is elastic, soft and glutinous, salty and delicious, very delicious.

description_zh: 猪肉炖粉条，是东北一道非常有名的菜，炖好的后香气扑鼻，肉香而不腻，粉条吸足了汤汁，滑溜溜带点小筋道，非常好吃。
description_en: Pork stewed with glass noodles is a famous Northeastern Chinese dish. When done, it is wonderfully fragrant - the pork is savory but not greasy, and the noodles soak up the broth, becoming silky and slightly chewy. Delicious!
tips_zh:
1 这里的粉条选择很重要，选用东北的优质土豆粉条为佳，它能和肉一起下锅，并且不粘汤，粉条透明、还有点小筋道
2 这里需要特别注意的是如果是红薯粉条，千万别和肉一起下锅炖，可以先把粉条煮软，等肉快出锅的时候再下锅炖一下即可，要不会粘汤、粉条变碎
tips_en:
1 The choice of vermicelli here is very important. It is better to choose high-quality potato vermicelli from Northeast China. It can be cooked with meat and does not stick to the soup. The vermicelli is transparent and has a little chewy texture.
2 What needs special attention here is that if it is sweet potato vermicelli, do not stew it with the meat. You can boil the vermicelli until it is soft, and then stew it in the pot when the meat is about to come out of the pot. Otherwise, the soup will not stick to the vermicelli and the vermicelli will break into pieces.

steps.content_zh: 备好食材，五花肉洗净；
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients and wash the pork belly;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉切1指宽的条；
steps.content_en: Cut the pork belly into 1-finger-wide strips;

steps.content_zh: 葱姜切好；
steps.content_en: Chop onion and ginger;

steps.content_zh: 热锅入植物油，放入八角小火煸出香味，放入五花肉炒到颜色微黄、煸出少量油，放入葱姜爆香，烹入料酒去腥；
steps.content_en: Heat vegetable oil in a wok, stir-fry star anise over low heat until fragrant, add the pork belly and stir-fry until lightly golden with some fat rendered, add scallion and ginger until fragrant, then splash in cooking wine to remove any gamey smell;

steps.content_zh: 放入酱油提色；
steps.content_en: Add soy sauce for color;

steps.content_zh: 加入清水，大火烧开，放入折断并洗净的粉条,再大火烧开至粉条变软（不干的粉条可直接手抓住插入开着的锅里，粉条很快变软，用厨房剪把变软的部分剪断，剩下的一段直接下锅就可以）
steps.content_en: Add water, bring to a boil over high heat, add broken and washed vermicelli, and boil over high heat until the vermicelli becomes soft (the vermicelli that is not dry can be directly grasped by hand and inserted into the open pot. The vermicelli will become soft quickly. Use kitchen shears to cut off the soft part, and the remaining section can be directly put into the pot)

steps.content_zh: 所有食材连汤倒入电饭锅，加入盐调味，炖30分钟，炖好的菜香气扑鼻，肉香而不腻，粉条吸足了汤汁，滑溜溜带点小筋道，非常好吃；
steps.content_en: Pour all the ingredients and broth into the rice cooker, season with salt and stew 30 minutes. The finished dish is fragrant, the meat savory but not greasy, and the glass noodles have soaked up the sauce—slippery with a slight chew. Delicious.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

name_en: Lamb stewed with radish in clear soup
description_zh: 内蒙的羊肉非常好吃，最近几年更是羔羊肉甚多，肉嫩细腻又紧致，几乎没有什么膻味，在老家通常都会宰一只羊来吃，羊腿用来烤制或切小块烤肉串，那么带点肥的部份怎么吃呢，当然是用来清炖了，这是当地老百姓家家都用的做法，再放入萝卜块，既吸收了油腻又增加了营养，并且羊肉还非常鲜美，令人欲罢不能。
description_en: Inner Mongolian lamb is delicious, and in recent years there's plenty of young lamb—tender, fine-textured and lean, with barely any gamey smell. Back home they often slaughter a whole sheep: the legs are roasted or cut into skewers, while the fattier cuts are stewed, a method every local household uses. Add radish chunks to absorb the richness and add nutrition; the lamb stays wonderfully delicious and utterly irresistible.
tips_zh:
1 羊肉清炖稍微肥些更好吃
2 萝卜的块不要太大，小点缩短炖制时间
3 不需要加酱油，这样会保留羊肉的鲜味
tips_en:
1 The mutton stew is slightly fatter and more delicious.
2. Don’t make the radish pieces too big. Make them smaller to shorten the stewing time.
3 No need to add soy sauce, this will retain the freshness of the mutton

steps.content_zh: 羊肉洗净，稍微肥些的炖出来才好吃；
steps.content_en: Wash the lamb; slightly fatty meat stews up better;

steps.content_zh: 羊肉切大块，白萝卜洗净；
steps.content_en: Cut the mutton into large pieces and wash the white radish;

steps.content_zh: 萝卜切小块；
steps.content_en: Cut radish into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 备好调料；
steps.content_en: Prepare seasonings;

steps.content_zh: 羊肉放入电饭煲，加入刚刚没过食材的清水，放入除了盐以外的所有调料；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标；
steps.content_en: Put the lamb in the rice cooker, add water just to cover the ingredients, and add all seasonings except the salt; tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余60分钟时加入白萝卜；
steps.content_en: With 60 minutes left, add the white radish;

steps.content_zh: 放入盐调味；
steps.content_en: Add salt to taste;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后加入香菜出锅。
steps.content_en: After cooking, add cilantro and serve.

description_zh: 樱花季来个应景的樱花蛋糕，集颜值和口感，赶紧做给你心中的Ta吧！
description_en: It's cherry blossom season—make a seasonal cherry blossom cake that's as beautiful as it is delicious, and whip one up for that special someone!
tips_zh:
1、步骤比较多，总体来说分三个大步骤，细心点就可以做好啦。
2、脱模之前拿吹风机对着模具四周吹一会就可以轻松脱模啦。
tips_en:
1. There are quite a few steps, but it boils down to three main ones—just be careful and you'll nail it.
2. Before unmolding, blow a hairdryer around the sides of the mold for easy release.

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕胚原料；
steps.content_en: Cake base ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 蛋清和蛋黄分离（装蛋清的容器要无油、无水、无蛋黄）；
steps.content_en: Separate egg whites and egg yolks (the container containing egg whites must be oil-free, water-free, and egg yolk-free);

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中加入玉米油、牛奶搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Add corn oil and milk to egg yolks and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 筛入面粉，搅拌到无颗粒的状态；
steps.content_en: Sift in the flour and stir until no lumps remain;

steps.content_zh: 蛋清中挤入柠檬汁，第一次加入20克细砂糖，用电动打蛋器搅拌到海绵泡的状态；再次加入20克细砂糖搅拌到有纹路的状态；最后加入20克细砂糖，搅拌到有直立不弯曲的小角的状态；
steps.content_en: Add lemon juice to the egg whites, then 20 g caster sugar; beat with an electric mixer until spongy. Add another 20 g and beat until lines appear; add the final 20 g and beat until stiff, upright peaks form;

steps.content_zh: 蛋白霜和面糊分三次混合后倒入锅中，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烘焙；
steps.content_en: Mix the meringue and batter in three batches and pour it into the pot. Click the start cooking icon on your phone to start baking;

steps.content_zh: 完成后取出放凉；
steps.content_en: When finished, take out and let cool;

steps.content_zh: 奶油芝士原料；
steps.content_en: Cream cheese ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 吉利丁粉加水浸泡；
steps.content_en: Soak gelatine powder in water;

steps.content_zh: 将牛奶烧开后关火，倒泡好入吉利丁搅拌至融化，冷却到室温；
steps.content_en: Bring the milk to a boil, then turn off the heat, pour in the gelatine and stir until melted, then cool to room temperature;

steps.content_zh: 奶油奶酪隔水融化，搅拌到顺滑；
steps.content_en: Melt the cream cheese over water and stir until smooth;

steps.content_zh: 奶油加入糖粉搅拌到有纹路的状态；
steps.content_en: Add the icing sugar to the cream and stir until it becomes textured;

steps.content_zh: 将融化的芝士、吉利丁液和奶油混合，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Combine melted cheese, gelatine and cream, stir well;

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕切开；
steps.content_en: Cut the cake;

steps.content_zh: 用慕斯圈刻出形状；
steps.content_en: Cut out shapes with a mousse ring;

steps.content_zh: 浇上之前做好的奶油芝士馅，放入冰箱冷藏2小时或者冷冻1小时；
steps.content_en: Pour the cream cheese filling made previously and refrigerate for 2 hours or freeze for 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 淋面的材料；
steps.content_en: Material for glazing;

steps.content_zh: 雪碧倒出后放出气体，吉利丁粉中加入清水放到微波炉中大火一分钟融化成液体后倒入雪碧中；
steps.content_en: After the Sprite is poured out, gas will be released. Add water to the gelatine powder and put it in the microwave over high heat for one minute to melt it into liquid and then pour it into the Sprite;

steps.content_zh: 腌渍樱花提前用开水泡开，凉水冲洗干净；小心缓慢的从模具边缘倒入事先冷藏定型完毕的慕斯蛋糕上，用牙签轻轻的将樱花拨开；摆成你想要的造型，之后放入冰箱冷藏至镜面凝固定型即可；
steps.content_en: Soak the pickled cherry blossoms in boiling water in advance and rinse with cold water; carefully and slowly pour from the edge of the mold over the pre-chilled, set mousse cake, gently separate the blossoms with a toothpick; arrange them as you like, then refrigerate until the mirror glaze sets.

steps.content_zh: 完成后脱模。
steps.content_en: Unmold when finished.

description_zh: 入口香甜，不油不腻，肉汤鲜美，玉米清甜，适合各种人群食用。
description_en: It is sweet in the mouth, not greasy or greasy, the broth is delicious, and the corn is sweet, making it suitable for all kinds of people.
tips_zh:
1、除了盐不用加入其他的调料，影响汤的清甜口感。
2、根据个人的喜好加入水量。
tips_en:
1. There is no need to add other seasonings except salt, which will affect the sweet taste of the soup.
2. Add the amount of water according to personal preference.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 排骨焯水后洗净；
steps.content_en: Blanch the ribs and wash;

steps.content_zh: 玉米切块；
steps.content_en: corn diced;

steps.content_zh: 莲藕切厚片；
steps.content_en: Cut lotus root into thick slices;

steps.content_zh: 生姜拍松；
steps.content_en: Lightly crush the ginger;

steps.content_zh:
将排骨、玉米、莲藕和生姜同时放入锅中，根据个人需求加入水；
点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Place the ribs, corn, lotus root and ginger in the pot, add water as desired;
tap the Start Cooking icon on your phone's screen.

steps.content_zh: 完成后放入少许盐调味，即可。
steps.content_en: When done, add a little salt to taste.

description_zh: 带着淡淡的椰香，入口软糯清甜。
description_en: With a hint of coconut aroma, it is soft and sweet in the mouth.
tips_zh: 1、包豆沙的时候手上可抹点油，会更好操作。
tips_en: 1. When making bean paste, you can put some oil on your hands for easier operation.

steps.content_zh: 将糯米粉、澄粉和细砂糖混合后，倒入椰汁揉成光滑的面团；
steps.content_en: Mix glutinous rice flour, orange powder and fine sugar, then pour in coconut milk and knead into a smooth dough;

steps.content_zh: 将面粉团分成六份；用手拍成面皮放入豆沙馅，包成团子；
steps.content_en: Divide the dough into six portions; pat it into dough with your hands, add bean paste filling, and wrap into balls;

steps.content_zh: 蒸笼中垫上油纸，放上包好的团子，锅中加水，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Line the steamer with parchment, place the wrapped dumplings, add water to the pot, then tap Start Cooking on the app;

steps.content_zh: 腌渍樱花用开水泡开，冲洗干净待用；
steps.content_en: Soak the pickled cherry blossoms in boiling water, rinse, and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好后取出，裹上椰蓉，在上面放上樱花装饰即可。
steps.content_en: After steaming, take it out, wrap it in coconut, and decorate it with cherry blossoms on top.

description_zh:
荔浦芋头，浓香软糯，粉嫩可口！皇室贡品！
红烧肉，肥而不腻，入口即化！肉中极品！
两者在一起，会是怎么样的火花？
做了就知道~哪哪都是满足……
description_en:
Lipu taro is fragrant, soft and glutinous, pink and delicious! Royal tribute!
Braised pork, fat but not greasy, melts in your mouth! The best meat!
What kind of spark will there be when the two come together?
Once you do it, you will know~Everything is satisfying...
tips_zh:
①煮红烧肉的水可以用净水器的水或瓶装水，别用自来水，会稍微影响口感！
②一定要用新鲜的五花肉，出水洗净去油！
③盐可以少放点，因为五花肉收汁够了，香芋咸了就不好吃！
④这一道可以根据自己喜好调整的菜，创意在你们，加油！
tips_en:
① Use filtered or bottled water for the braised pork—not tap water, which slightly affects the taste.
② Use fresh pork belly; blanch it, rinse, and remove excess fat.
③ Go easy on the salt—the pork reduces enough, and salty taro ruins the dish.
④ Adjust this dish to your liking—get creative and give it a go!

ingredients.quantity_en: A small handful cut into sections

steps.content_zh: 首先把新鲜的五花肉放电饭煲自选20分钟，出水洗净放里乘着！
steps.content_en: First, put the fresh pork belly in the rice cooker on manual mode for 20 minutes, then rinse off the released water and set aside!

steps.content_zh: 在煮五花肉的时候，把所有材料准备好~
steps.content_en: When cooking pork belly, prepare all the ingredients~

steps.content_zh: 五花肉好了，把所有材料放到里面，加水刚没过五花肉就可以了！按本菜谱110分钟开始！
steps.content_en: The pork belly is ready, put all the ingredients inside and add water just enough to cover the pork belly! Follow this recipe and get started in 110 minutes!

steps.content_zh: 把家里的荔浦芋头切块状，备着！等最后30分钟放进电饭煲里！
steps.content_en: Cut the Lipu taro into chunks and set aside—add it to the rice cooker in the last 30 minutes!

steps.content_zh: 时间到了尾声，用筷子夹戳一下香芋是否熟了！
steps.content_en: When time is almost up, poke the taro with chopsticks to check if it's done!

steps.content_zh: 最后收汁！完成！
steps.content_en: Finally, reduce the sauce! Done!

steps.content_zh: 夹出装盘，开吃！
steps.content_en: Take it out, put it on a plate, and eat!

ingredients.quantity_en: A small handful cut into sections

description_zh: 今天做的这道菜叫土豆粉蒸肉！大家都知道粉蒸肉即五花肉腌制入味，洒入蒸肉米粉和清水抓匀，然后放入锅中蒸熟即成。唯有用蒸肉米粉，才能做出美味的粉蒸肉！本菜将土豆垫底，可以有效吸收五花肉的油脂。土豆吸收肉脂而去涩达润，五花肉去脂后肥而不腻、软烂入味、咸辣鲜香、粑软滋润、味浓鲜香，别有一番风味。土豆与五花肉的香味交相辉映，是此菜的绝配靓点！快动起手来，做出不一样的粉蒸肉吧！
description_en: Today's dish is steamed pork with rice flour and potatoes! Steamed pork is pork belly marinated, coated with rice flour and water, then steamed until cooked—only rice flour gives it that authentic flavor. Potatoes underneath absorb the pork's fat, becoming rich and tender, while the pork turns rich but not greasy, soft, savory, spicy and fragrant. The aromas of potato and pork enhance each other—the perfect highlight of this dish. Give it a try for a different kind of steamed pork!
tips_zh:
①注意，五花肉和土豆的分量，不要过多。刚好均匀的平铺在两者之间。
②蒸肉米粉的量，在于自己的口味。
③这道土豆粉蒸肉，还可以变成香芋粉蒸肉等等， 创意在你们，做起来，加油！
tips_en:
① Don't use too much pork belly or potato—just enough to form even layers.
② Adjust the steamed pork flour mix to taste.
③ This potato steamed pork can also be made with taro, and so on—get creative and give it a try!

ingredients.quantity_en: Half a pack or appropriate amount

steps.content_zh: 首先当然准备充分的食材，配料！
steps.content_en: First of all, of course, prepare sufficient ingredients and ingredients!

steps.content_zh: 将姜葱蒜切碎末，装盘！五花肉泡水15分钟洗净沥干！土豆切滚刀状然后洗净泡水十分钟，去除淀粉！
steps.content_en: Chop the ginger, onion, and garlic into mince and serve! Soak the pork belly in water for 15 minutes, wash and drain! Cut the potatoes into hob shapes, wash them and soak them in water for ten minutes to remove the starch!

steps.content_zh: 把姜蒜末，倒入五花肉中抓均匀！
steps.content_en: Pour the minced ginger and garlic into the pork belly and spread it evenly!

steps.content_zh: 然后倒入生抽，老抽一起，加少许盐！注意抓均匀！腌制15分钟！
steps.content_en: Then add light and dark soy sauce and a little salt. Mix well and marinate for 15 minutes!

steps.content_zh: 蒸肉米粉倒入半包或者适量，加入少许清水搅浑！
steps.content_en: Add half a packet (or as needed) of steaming rice flour, then mix in a little water until cloudy!

steps.content_zh: 然后把蒸肉米粉涂抹腌制好的五花肉，充分搅拌！
steps.content_en: Then coat the marinated pork belly with steamed pork rice flour and mix well!

steps.content_zh: 然后将土豆切滚刀状平铺在碟底，一定注意要均匀，不要太多或重叠，这样可以充分入味粉蒸肉。
steps.content_en: Then cut the potatoes into wedges and spread them evenly over the bottom of the dish, not too many or overlapping, so the steamed pork absorbs the flavor.

steps.content_zh: 然后将五花肉均匀的平铺在土豆上面。
steps.content_en: Then spread the pork belly evenly over the potatoes.

steps.content_zh: 放入电饭煲60分钟，自选蒸煮！
steps.content_en: Put in the rice cooker for 60 minutes on the Steam setting.

steps.content_zh: 完成后加入备好的葱花碎末！
steps.content_en: When finished, add the prepared chopped green onion!

steps.content_zh: 好了，现在准备开吃吧！
steps.content_en: Okay, now get ready to eat!

ingredients.quantity_en: Half a pack or appropriate amount

description_zh: 这道菜味道酸甜，鸡翅吸收菠萝水果香味，吃起来特别香甜。水果入菜，更有风味。
description_en: Sweet and sour: the chicken wings soak up the pineapple's fragrance and taste wonderfully sweet. Cooking with fruit adds extra flavor.
tips_zh:
1、菠萝做菜一定要加适量糖，这样才会有很棒的酸甜味。
2、菠萝切成片或块放在盐水中浸泡30分钟，然后再洗去咸味，就可以达到消除过敏性物质的目的，还会使菠萝味道变得更加甜美。饭后半小时吃这些用盐水浸泡过的菠萝，既美味又营养。
3、喜欢酸甜味道的同学可以放些番茄酱增加风味。
tips_en:
1. Always add some sugar when cooking pineapple to get that great sweet-and-sour taste.
2. Soak pineapple slices or chunks in salt water for 30 minutes, then rinse off the salt—this removes the irritating compounds and makes the pineapple sweeter. Eating it half an hour after a meal is both delicious and nourishing.
3. If you like it sweet and sour, add a bit of ketchup.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸡翅在水中浸泡30分钟，除去血水，中途换水一次；
steps.content_en: Soak the chicken wings in water for 30 minutes to remove blood, changing the water once halfway;

steps.content_zh: 捞出后在表面划开，用葱、姜、老抽、生抽、料酒和胡椒粉腌渍20分钟；
steps.content_en: Remove, score the surface, and marinate with scallion, ginger, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, cooking wine and pepper for 20 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 菠萝切片在盐水中浸泡；
steps.content_en: Soak pineapple slices in salt water;

steps.content_zh: 腌渍好的鸡翅和腌渍鸡翅的料同时倒入锅中，加入少许水到鸡翅的½处，点击手机烹饪上开始烹饪图标继续烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the marinated chicken wings and marinated chicken wing ingredients into the pot at the same time, add a little water to ½ of the chicken wings, and click the start cooking icon on the mobile phone to continue cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余3分钟时，倒入菠萝和白糖，继续焖煮到烹饪结束即可（尝一下如果不够咸再放少许盐）；
steps.content_en: With 3 minutes left, add the pineapple and sugar, and simmer until done (taste and add a little salt if needed);

steps.content_zh: 完成后菜肴酸甜可口，菠萝软而不烂，还可以适当的加一点番茄酱增加风味。
steps.content_en: When finished, the dish is sweet and sour, the pineapple is soft but not rotten, and a little tomato sauce can be added to increase the flavor.

description_zh: 备点鸡蛋在家里是最好的懒人食品之一！可以做蒸鸡蛋，煮鸡蛋，鸡蛋面，鸡蛋羹……等等各种快手吃法！每天吃两颗鸡蛋，营养健康，方便快捷！动手吧，Come on, everybody Put your hands up!
description_en: Keeping eggs at home is one of the best lazy foods! You can make steamed eggs, boiled eggs, egg noodles, egg custard... and many other quick ways to eat it! Eat two eggs every day, nutritious, healthy, convenient and fast! Come on, everybody Put your hands up!
tips_zh:
①鸡蛋可以多煮些没事，时间增加3到5分钟左右！
②鸡蛋煮之前清洗下壳。
③鸡蛋每天不要吃太多，放保鲜盒，明天吃也可以的！
tips_en:
① You can boil a few extra eggs—just add 3 to 5 minutes.
② Wash the shells before boiling.
③ Don't eat too many eggs a day; store leftovers in a sealed container for tomorrow.

ingredients.quantity_en: 3 or as much as you like

steps.content_zh: 准备好纸巾
steps.content_en: Have tissues ready

steps.content_zh: 铺平电饭煲，放入鸡蛋，倒少量清水，打湿纸巾剩余浮水！
steps.content_en: Spread it flat in the rice cooker, add the eggs, pour in a little water, and use the damp paper towel to soak up any remaining surface water!

steps.content_zh: 自选蒸煮十分钟后，取出鸡蛋剥壳装盘！
steps.content_en: After steaming for ten minutes of your choice, remove the eggs and put them on a plate!

steps.content_zh: 可以切开，看下蛋黄熟的程度，根据自己口味调整时间！
steps.content_en: You can cut it open to see how cooked the egg yolk is, and adjust the time according to your taste!

ingredients.quantity_en: 3 or as much as you like

description_zh: 菠萝入菜，酸酸甜甜，菠萝和排骨简直就是天作之合。
description_en: Pineapple adds a sweet-tart flavor to dishes; pineapple and pork ribs are a perfect match.
tips_zh:
1、可以放一些番茄酱增加酸甜味。
2、排骨最好选择有肉多有脆骨的，口感佳。
tips_en:
1. Add a bit of ketchup for a sweet-and-sour note.
2. Choose ribs with plenty of meat and crunchy cartilage for the best texture.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 排骨焯水，大蒜去皮拍松，生姜去皮切片；
steps.content_en: Blanch the ribs; peel and crush the garlic, peel and slice the ginger.

steps.content_zh: 焯水后的排骨用料酒、生姜、蚝油、老抽、生抽腌渍20分钟；
steps.content_en: After blanching, marinate the blanched ribs with cooking wine, ginger, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, and light soy sauce for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 将上一步骤的原料倒如饭煲中，加入香叶、八角和桂皮，加水到排骨的¾处，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the ingredients from the previous step into a rice cooker, add bay leaves, star anise and cinnamon, add water to ¾ of the ribs, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 菠萝切片，放到盐水中浸泡；
steps.content_en: Slice the pineapple and soak in salt water;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余3分钟时放入菠萝，滴上几滴白醋、加入白糖，继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: With 3 minutes left, add the pineapple, a few drops of white vinegar, and sugar, and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 完成后，排骨中带有菠萝的酸甜味。
steps.content_en: When done, the ribs have a sweet and sour taste from the pineapple.

description_zh: 在酒酿小圆子的基础上添加了菠萝，让这款甜汤的口感更丰富，甜而不腻，各种水果可以自由搭配哦。
description_en: Pineapple is added to the fermented dumplings to make this sweet soup richer in taste, sweet but not greasy, and you can mix and match various fruits freely.
tips_zh:
1、菠萝在盐水中浸泡能让菠萝更加香甜，还可以达到消除过敏性物质的目的。
2、糖的量可以根据个人口味添加。
tips_en:
1. Soaking pineapples in salt water can make the pineapples more fragrant and sweet, and can also eliminate allergic substances.
2. The amount of sugar can be added according to personal taste.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度，点击手机图标开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 3 mark, then tap the phone icon to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 约十分钟后水烧开，放入小丸子继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: After about ten minutes, the water will boil, add the small meatballs and continue to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 菠萝切丁，泡在盐水中；
steps.content_en: Dice pineapple and soak in salt water;

steps.content_zh: 再次沸腾后倒入菠萝和酒酿；
steps.content_en: When it boils again, add the pineapple and fermented wine;

steps.content_zh: 再次煮沸后放入糖即可；
steps.content_en: After boiling again, add sugar;

steps.content_zh: 出锅啦，酸酸甜甜软软糯糯。
steps.content_en: It’s out of the pan, sour, sweet, soft and glutinous.

description_zh: 榆钱窝头，吃一囗都是浓浓的乡愁。榆钱，是榆树结的果儿，香甜可口，常为铜钱形状，故为榆钱。榆钱健脾安神。与玉米面混合后做成窝窝头，口感香甜，是减肥佳品。
description_en: Elm seed steamed buns—every bite is full of nostalgia for the countryside. Elm seeds are the fruit of the elm tree, sweet and delicious, often shaped like ancient coins, hence the name. They strengthen the spleen and calm the mind. Mixed with cornmeal and steamed into buns, they're sweet and great for weight loss.
tips_zh:
1、榆钱要先除去枝干后再浸泡后冲洗干净。
2、榆钱比较嫩，所以清洗的时候不要太用力。
tips_en:
1. Remove the stems from the elm seeds before soaking and rinsing.
2. Elm seeds are tender, so wash them gently.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 榆钱用水浸泡，去除杂物后冲洗干净，滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the elm seeds in water, remove debris, rinse well, and drain;

steps.content_zh: 将榆钱和玉米面混合；
steps.content_en: Mix yuqian and cornmeal;

steps.content_zh: 加入少许清水，揉成面团；
steps.content_en: Add a little water and knead into dough;

steps.content_zh: 做成窝窝头的形状；
steps.content_en: Make it into the shape of a steamed bun;

steps.content_zh: 500克面粉可以做10个；
steps.content_en: 500 grams of flour can make 10 pieces;

steps.content_zh:
蒸笼中放入纱布或者油纸，锅胆中加入水到水位线:东北米-2的刻度；
点击手机屏幕开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Place gauze or parchment in the steamer and add water to the inner pot up to the Northeast Rice-2 mark;
Then tap Start Cooking on the app;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好的样子；
steps.content_en: How it looks when steamed;

steps.content_zh: 清香可口的榆钱儿窝窝出锅。
steps.content_en: The fragrant and delicious Yuqianerwowo is served.

description_zh: 经典的川味做法，加上了郫县豆瓣酱的红烧牛肉，色泽红亮，口感更佳。米家饭煲特定的温度曲线，文火慢炖让牛肉更酥软入味。搭配面条便成为了带来无数经典回忆的红烧牛肉面。
description_en: A classic Sichuan-style braised beef with Pixian doubanjiang: glossy red in color and better in flavor. The Mi rice cooker's special temperature curve simmers the beef slowly over low heat until tender and full of flavor. Add noodles for the classic braised beef noodle soup that brings back so many memories.
tips_zh:
1、辛香料虽说是红烧牛肉的好搭档，不过也不要太多，以免抢了肉味。
2、喜欢吃肥一点的牛肉，可以选择牛腩瘦中带肥，肥而不腻。
3、配上米饭或者面条，吃法百搭。
tips_en:
1. Spices go well with braised beef, but don't overdo them or they'll mask the meat.
2. If you like fattier beef, choose brisket with a bit of fat—rich but not greasy.
3. Serve with rice or noodles; it goes with everything.

steps.content_zh: 原料；
steps.content_en: raw material;

steps.content_zh: 牛腩切方块，放入大碗中，用清水浸泡20分钟左右，泡出血水后，将血水倒掉，牛肉沥一下。如果血水较多，中途可换一次水 ；
steps.content_en: Cut the brisket into squares, soak in a large bowl of water for about 20 minutes, then discard the bloody water and drain. If there is a lot of blood, change the water once halfway;

steps.content_zh: 焯水后洗净；
steps.content_en: Blanch and rinse;

steps.content_zh: 取一个炒锅，洗净，加两勺油，下入姜片、葱白、蒜、花椒、八角、肉蔻、草果、丁香、陈皮炒出香味；
steps.content_en: Take a wok, clean it, add two tablespoons of oil, add ginger slices, scallions, garlic, pepper, star anise, nutmeg, strawberries, cloves, and tangerine peel and stir-fry until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 下入豆瓣酱，翻炒均匀；
steps.content_en: Add bean paste and stir-fry evenly;

steps.content_zh: 下入沥干的牛肉、中火翻炒、淋入2勺料酒，加入老抽、生抽，翻炒均匀；
steps.content_en: Add the drained beef, stir-fry over medium heat, pour in 2 tablespoons of cooking wine, add dark soy sauce and light soy sauce, stir-fry evenly;

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的牛肉倒入饭煲中，加入清水与牛肉齐平即可，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the fried beef into the rice cooker, add water to make it even with the beef, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，尝一下味道，如果不够，放入适量的调料调味即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, taste and add more seasoning if needed.

description_zh:
肝脏是动物体内储存养料和解毒的重要器官，含有丰富的营养物质，具有营养保健功能，是最理想的补血佳品之一。猪肝味甘、苦；性温；补肝明目，养血。
适宜气血虚弱，面色萎黄，缺铁性贫血者食用；肝血不足所致的视物模糊不清，夜盲．眼干燥症，小儿麻疹病后角膜软化症，内外翳障等眼病者。
description_en: The liver is the organ that stores nutrients and detoxifies the body. It is rich in nutrients, offers health benefits, and is one of the best foods for replenishing blood. Pork liver is sweet and bitter, warm in nature, and helps tonify the liver, improve vision, and nourish the blood. It suits those with qi and blood deficiency, a sallow complexion, or iron-deficiency anemia, as well as people with eye problems caused by liver blood deficiency, such as blurred vision, night blindness, dry eyes, corneal softening after measles in children, and cataracts.
tips_zh:
1、猪肝煮的时间长容易老，时间短又不容易熟，如何判断猪肝是否煮的刚刚好，可以用筷子戳一下猪肝，如果不冒血水且插进去不费力，那说明猪肝已经熟了。
2、 蘸料可以根据自己的口味调节。
tips_en:
1. Pork liver gets tough if overcooked and undercooked if rushed. To check doneness, poke it with a chopstick—if no blood runs and it slides in easily, it's done.
2. Adjust the dipping sauce to taste.

steps.content_zh: 猪肝，一块，清洗干净，用水浸泡，去除血水；
steps.content_en: Take a piece of pork liver, wash it, and soak in water to remove blood;

steps.content_zh: 把所有的调料都放入米家电饭煲的内胆中；
steps.content_en: Put all the seasonings into the inner pot of Mijia rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 猪肝焯水后放入米家电饭煲的内胆中，加入适量的水，最好要没过猪肝；点击开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pork liver, place it in the Mijia rice cooker's inner pot, add enough water to cover the liver, and tap Start Cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，切好的猪肝，然后再蘸点醋 ，很好吃哦！
steps.content_en: After the cooking is completed, cut the pork liver and dip it in some vinegar. It’s delicious!

description_zh: 俗话说，“吃榆钱，有余钱”。又到吃榆钱的季节，榆钱儿也叫榆荚，是榆树的种子，因为酷似古代麻钱儿，故名榆钱儿。吃榆钱的方法很多，可生食、做粥、蒸饭。
description_en: As the saying goes, 'Eat elm seeds, have spare money.' It's elm seed season again. Elm seeds (yu qian), also called elm pods, are elm tree seeds named for their resemblance to ancient coins. They can be eaten raw, in porridge or steamed with rice.
tips_zh: 榆钱清洗时比较碎，可以多放些水，清洗片刻，略静置一会儿，榆钱都飘浮到水面上，捞出即可。
tips_en: The elm coins are relatively broken when cleaning. You can add more water, wash them for a while, and let them sit for a while. The elm coins will float to the surface of the water, and then you can fish them out.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 小米和粥米洗净后放入锅中，水加到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机开始烹饪图标；
steps.content_en: Wash the millet and porridge rice and put them into the pot. Add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark. Click on the phone to start cooking icon;

steps.content_zh: 榆钱去蒂洗净，浸泡后去除杂物后滤干；
steps.content_en: Remove the stems from the elm seeds, wash, soak to remove debris, then drain;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切丝；
steps.content_en: Shred ginger;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余20分钟时放入姜丝和虾仁；
steps.content_en: With 20 minutes left, add the shredded ginger and shrimp;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后放入榆钱，用盐调味即可；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add the elm money and season with salt;

steps.content_zh: 一锅鲜香诱人的榆钱虾仁粥就出锅了。
steps.content_en: A pot of delicious and attractive Yuqian shrimp porridge is ready.

description_zh:
春天到处绿意盎然，喜欢春天不仅仅因为它是新的一年的伊始，更是因为在这个季节，可以品尝到各种又鲜又嫩的独属于春天的作物。
春风轻轻拂过，绿了枝头那一串串的榆钱，榆钱现在已是很少见了，今天刚好从市场看到了新鲜的榆钱，赶紧带回来些，做了简单又美味的榆钱饭，细细品味一下春天的味道。
description_en: Spring is bursting with greenery. I love it not just because it starts a new year, but because the season brings fresh, tender produce found only now. The spring breeze greens the clusters of elm seeds on the branches. They're rare these days; today I spotted fresh ones at the market, brought some home, and made a simple, delicious elm seed rice to truly taste spring.
tips_zh:
1、榆钱清洗时比较碎，可以多放些水，清洗片刻，略静置一会儿，榆钱都飘浮到水面上，捞出即可。
2、榆钱本来就可以生食，所以蒸制时间不宜过长，凉水入锅，蒸10分钟。
tips_en:
1. The elm coins are relatively broken when cleaning. You can add more water, wash them for a while, and let them sit for a while. The elm coins will float to the surface of the water, and then you can fish them out.
2. Yuqian can be eaten raw, so the steaming time should not be too long. Add cold water to the pot and steam for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 榆钱去蒂，在清水中浸泡除去泥土和杂物；
steps.content_en: Remove the stems from the elm seeds and soak in clean water to remove dirt and debris;

steps.content_zh: 滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Drain;

steps.content_zh: 将面粉均匀的洒在面粉上；
steps.content_en: Sprinkle flour evenly over flour;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀，让每个榆钱叶都能裹上面粉，蒸笼中垫上油纸或者纱布，将榆钱平铺上，锅中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Mix until every elm seed is coated in flour; line the steamer with parchment or gauze, spread the elm seeds, add water to the Northeast Rice-2 level and tap Start Cooking on the phone.

steps.content_zh: 蒸榆钱的时候准备好酱汁原料；
steps.content_en: While steaming the elm seeds, prepare the sauce ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 用葱花、蒜泥、芝麻油、辣椒油、香醋和生抽调成酱汁；
steps.content_en: Mix chopped scallions, minced garlic, sesame oil, chili oil, black vinegar, and light soy sauce into a sauce;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好后取出，榆钱还是很鲜嫩，淋上酱汁即可食用。
steps.content_en: After steaming, take it out. The Yuqian is still very tender. Pour the sauce on it and it is ready to eat.

description_zh: 东坡肉的特色在于八个字：肥而不腻，酥而不烂。慢着火，少着水，火候足时它自美。破解之法就在于先煮后蒸。也就是说，文火精炖之后，还要再蒸上半小时左右才算完工。
description_en: Dongpo pork is defined by eight words: rich but not greasy, tender but not mushy. Slow heat, little water—when the heat is enough, it becomes beautiful on its own. The secret is to boil first, then steam: after gentle simmering, steam for about another half hour to finish.
tips_zh:
1、五花肉不用着急处理，先汆水后切块有助于定型。
2、传统的东坡肉讲究的是以酒代水，所以按理说整个过程不应该加水。
tips_en:
1. No need to rush the pork belly—blanch it first, then cut into pieces so it holds its shape.
2. Traditional Dongpo pork uses wine instead of water, so technically no water should be added throughout.

steps.content_zh: 食材原料；
steps.content_en: Food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉汆水：冷水下锅，水开后沸腾的泡沫由赤色转为白色后关火，洗净后切成5 cm见方的正方形，用绳子扎起来；
steps.content_en: Boil pork belly: Pour cold water into the pot. When the water boils, the boiling foam will turn from red to white, then turn off the heat. Wash and cut into 5 cm squares and tie them up with rope;

steps.content_zh: 在锅底铺上一层葱，再铺上姜片，放入八角，香叶，陈皮，冰糖；
steps.content_en: Place a layer of green onions on the bottom of the pot, then put ginger slices on top, add star anise, bay leaves, tangerine peel, and rock sugar;

steps.content_zh: 将五花肉块皮朝下，一块一块码上；
steps.content_en: Place the pork belly pieces skin side down and place them one by one;

steps.content_zh: 倒入绍酒，以淹没五花肉3/4的量为准，每块肉上放一些老抽；
steps.content_en: Pour in Shaoxing wine to cover 3/4 of the pork belly, and put some dark soy sauce on each piece of meat;

steps.content_zh: 在表面再铺上一层葱；关上盖子，点击开始烹饪图标进行慢炖；
steps.content_en: Spread another layer of green onions on the surface; close the lid and click the start cooking icon to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 炖好的样子，不要着急吃哦，还有重要的一个步骤；
steps.content_en: Once the stew is done, don’t be in a hurry to eat it, there is still an important step;

steps.content_zh: 将肉取出放在碗中，入锅隔水蒸30分钟；
steps.content_en: Take the meat out and put it in a bowl, put it in a pot and steam it for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 完成的东坡肉，肥而不腻，入口即化，酥而不烂。
steps.content_en: The finished Dongpo pork is fat but not greasy, melts in your mouth, crispy but not rotten.

description_zh: 女性美容养颜的秘密全在这一碗羹里！桃胶、银耳、莲子、玫瑰都是清补、滋润身体的佳品，文火慢炖两个小时，让你吃出好皮肤。
description_en: The secret of women’s beauty and beauty is all in this bowl of soup! Peach gum, white fungus, lotus seeds, and roses are all good ingredients for nourishing and nourishing the body. Simmering them slowly for two hours will give you good skin.
tips_zh:
1、桃胶一定要提前充分浸泡一夜，取出中间的杂质，浸泡时间太多会泡发的不均匀。
2、冰糖的量根据个人口味调节。
tips_en:
1. Soak the peach gum thoroughly overnight and remove any impurities; too long a soak makes it expand unevenly.
2. Adjust the rock sugar to taste.

steps.content_zh: 桃胶提前一晚浸泡，中途换一次水去除杂质；
steps.content_en: Soak the peach gum overnight, changing the water once to remove impurities;

steps.content_zh: 银耳和莲子提前4小时浸泡，银耳泡发后撕成小朵；
steps.content_en: Soak the snow fungus and lotus seeds 4 hours ahead; tear the rehydrated snow fungus into small florets;

steps.content_zh: 取出玫瑰花待用；
steps.content_en: Take out the roses and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 将除了冰糖以外的所有食材放入锅胆中，水加到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机烹饪开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put all the ingredients except rock sugar into the pot, add water to the water level line: Thick porridge -1 mark, click on mobile phone cooking to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后桃胶和银耳已经呈现胶状，入口即化，莲子酥软，汤中带有玫瑰花特有的香气，最后放入冰糖调味就能食用啦。
steps.content_en: After the cooking is completed, the peach gum and white fungus have become gelatinous and melt in your mouth. The lotus seeds are soft and the soup has the unique aroma of roses. Finally, add rock sugar to taste and it is ready to eat.

description_zh: 浓郁的沙茶味包围着排骨和糯米，回味中带有淡淡的玫瑰的幽香，一碗饭多种滋味萦绕。
description_en: The rich flavor of sand tea surrounds the pork ribs and glutinous rice, with a faint fragrance of roses in the aftertaste, and a bowl of rice lingers with various flavors.
tips_zh:
1、排骨最好选择嫩一点字仔排。
2、还可以放一些如胡萝卜、土豆之类的食材一起蒸。
tips_en:
1. Choose tender young ribs.
2. You can also steam carrots or potatoes along with them.

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前浸泡一夜后滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice overnight and then drain the water;

steps.content_zh: 排骨在清水中浸泡半小时，中途换一次水后滤干，加入蒜末、姜末、沙茶酱、1勺生抽、少许盐、玫瑰花碎和1勺老抽；
steps.content_en: Soak the ribs in water for 30 minutes, changing the water once, then drain; add minced garlic and ginger, satay sauce, 1 tbsp light soy sauce, a little salt, crushed rose petals and 1 tbsp dark soy sauce.

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀后，腌渍半小时；
steps.content_en: After stirring evenly, marinate for half an hour;

steps.content_zh: 糯米中放入1勺沙茶酱、1勺老抽和1大勺生抽，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Add 1 spoon of satay sauce, 1 spoon of dark soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of light soy sauce to the glutinous rice and mix well;

steps.content_zh: 将糯米和排骨混合，蒸笼中垫上纱布或者油纸，将排骨和糯米均匀的铺在上面。锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机屏幕开始烹饪，完成后搅拌一下；
