steps.content_en: Mix the glutinous rice and spareribs, place gauze or oil paper in a steamer, and spread the spareribs and glutinous rice evenly on top. Add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice -2 mark, tap the phone screen to start cooking, and stir once completed;

steps.content_zh: 软糯不腻的一份沙茶排骨饭就做好啦~
steps.content_en: A portion of Shacha Pork Ribs Rice that is soft, glutinous and not greasy is ready~

description_zh: 再也没有比温润的奶茶遇上烧仙草和玫瑰更美好的事情了，浓郁的奶香、香醇的红茶香、淡淡的玫瑰香还有Q软的烧仙草，也许这就是你想要的生活吧~
description_en: There is nothing more beautiful than the warm milk tea meeting the grass jelly and roses. The rich milk fragrance, the mellow black tea fragrance, the light rose fragrance and the soft grass jelly. Maybe this is the life you want~
tips_zh:
1、除了龟苓膏还以加入红豆、芋圆之类的食材。
2、甜度自己掌控。
3、如果喜欢冰冻的口感可以放凉后冷藏饮用。
4、4L饭煲的用户可以适当增加食材原料。
tips_en:
1. Besides gui ling gao (herbal jelly), you can add red beans or taro balls.
2. Sweeten to taste.
3. For a chilled treat, cool it and refrigerate before serving.
4. If you have a 4 L rice cooker, you can increase the ingredients a bit.

steps.content_zh: 备齐原料备用；
steps.content_en: Gather all ingredients and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 锅胆洗净，可以挤入一些柠檬汁去除其他的味道；放入红茶包和玫瑰花，加入水到水位线：稠粥-½的刻度，点击手机图标开始煮茶；
steps.content_en: Clean the pot and squeeze in some lemon juice to remove other flavors; add black tea bags and roses, add water to the water level: thick porridge - ½ mark, click the phone icon to start brewing tea;

steps.content_zh: 将龟苓膏切成小块；
steps.content_en: Cut the turtle paste into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 约十分钟后沸腾；
steps.content_en: It comes to a boil after about 10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 加入牛奶和淡奶油；
steps.content_en: Add milk and whipping cream;

steps.content_zh: 加入砂糖后继续焖煮到再次沸腾即可；
steps.content_en: Add sugar and continue to simmer until it boils again;

steps.content_zh: 将龟苓膏放入杯子中；
steps.content_en: Put Guiling paste into the cup;

steps.content_zh: 完成后将奶茶装入杯子就完成啦~
steps.content_en: When finished, put the milk tea into the cup and it’s done~

name_en: Lotus seed, mung bean and lily porridge
description_zh: 最近觉得肝火有些旺盛，喝点莲子绿豆百合粥调理调理。用米家IH电饭煲做实在是太方便了，只需要把喜欢的食材洗净放入电饭煲中就等着美味吧。绝对的懒人福音
description_en: Lately I've felt a bit of internal heat, so I'm having some lotus seed, mung bean and lily porridge to rebalance. It's so easy with the Mijia IH Rice Cooker—just wash your favorite ingredients, put them in, and wait for the deliciousness. A true blessing for the lazy.
tips_zh: 米家电饭煲预约功能也可以让你一天幸福从营养美味早餐开始！
tips_en: The Mijia rice cooker's timer function lets you start every day with a nutritious, delicious breakfast!

steps.content_zh: 准备所有材料；
steps.content_en: Prepare all materials;

steps.content_zh: 洗净食材，放入电饭煲内；
steps.content_en: Wash the ingredients and place them in the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 水量齐平电饭煲的煲粥警示线；
steps.content_en: The amount of water is equal to the porridge warning line of the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 预约到第二天早上完成烹饪。起床后就能享；
steps.content_en: Set a timer to finish cooking the next morning so you can enjoy it right after getting up;

steps.content_zh: 煮粥完成，干稀度正好；
steps.content_en: Porridge is done, with the perfect consistency;

steps.content_zh: 口感也很棒！
steps.content_en: The taste is great too!

description_zh: 广式糯米鸡，是广东人早茶经典菜式之一，滋补佳品， 糯米富含B族维生素，能温暖脾胃，补益中气。 用荷叶制成的糯米鸡，对高血脂、高血压及肥胖症等有疗效。拆开荷叶时清香扑鼻，鲜味四溢，糯米润滑可口，鸡肉味道完全渗透到糯米之中，荷叶的清香回味悠长，开胃爽口，风味独特。
description_en: Cantonese glutinous rice chicken is a classic dim sum dish and a nourishing favorite. Glutinous rice is rich in B vitamins, warming the spleen and stomach and boosting qi; wrapped in lotus leaf, it is also said to help with high blood lipids, hypertension and obesity. Unwrap it and the fragrance bursts out, the rice silky and infused with chicken, with a lingering lotus aroma—appetizing and unique.
tips_zh:
1.如果觉得不够咸，可以在浸泡糯米的时候加少许的盐
2.重口味可以讲腌制的汤汁撒入糯米，更入味
3.荷叶网上可以买到，是整张荷叶，千万不要用热水浸泡
4.广式一般会加入咸鸭蛋的蛋黄，喜欢海鲜的可以放入瑶柱或者鲜虾.虾米都是可以的
tips_en:
1. If it isn't salty enough, add a little salt while soaking the glutinous rice.
2. For a stronger flavor, drizzle some marinade over the rice.
3. Lotus leaves are available online; use a whole leaf and never soak it in hot water.
4. Cantonese versions often add salted duck egg yolk; seafood lovers can use dried scallops, fresh shrimp, or dried shrimp.

steps.content_zh: 准备好材料；
steps.content_en: Prepare materials;

steps.content_zh: 糯米浸泡4小时以上；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice for at least 4 hours;

steps.content_zh: 香菇干泡开；
steps.content_en: Soak the dried shiitake mushrooms to rehydrate;

steps.content_zh: 荷叶用冷水浸泡，千万不要用热水，热水会把荷叶的香味给泡没，荷叶泡湿，软到可以进行包裹就行了；
steps.content_en: Soak the lotus leaves in cold water. Do not use hot water. Hot water will destroy the fragrance of the lotus leaves. Just soak the lotus leaves until they are soft enough to be wrapped;

steps.content_zh: 将鸡腿去骨切块，将香菇跟姜片切丝备好；
steps.content_en: Debone the chicken legs and cut them into pieces, shred the mushrooms and ginger slices and prepare;

steps.content_zh: 加入蚝油，生抽，老抽，糖，淀粉，油，进行搅拌，腌制半小时入味；
steps.content_en: Add oyster sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, starch, and oil, stir, and marinate for half an hour to add flavor;

steps.content_zh: 在荷叶扇面中心放入糯米，上面铺上腌制好的鸡肉香菇姜丝，然后再盖一层糯米，将荷叶上面的硬梗向食材折，然后两边的荷叶也向食材折，最后下面的荷叶也向里折，包裹的过程只要荷叶包住食材就可以了，不讲究；
steps.content_en: Place glutinous rice in the center of the lotus leaf fan, spread the marinated chicken, shiitake mushrooms and ginger shreds on top, then cover it with a layer of glutinous rice, fold the hard stems on the lotus leaves towards the ingredients, then fold the lotus leaves on both sides towards the ingredients, and finally fold the lower lotus leaves inward. The wrapping process only needs to wrap the ingredients with the lotus leaves, it doesn’t matter;

steps.content_zh: 将水加到米饭3刻度上，放入糯米鸡，盖上盖，点击烹饪，电饭煲会按照温度曲线跟时间烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the rice level 3, add the glutinous rice chicken, close the lid, and click Cook. The rice cooker will cook according to the temperature curve and time;

steps.content_zh: 出锅就可以享受美味了，不要忘记拍照分享哦。
steps.content_en: You can enjoy the delicious food right out of the pot, and don’t forget to take photos and share it.

description_zh: 清炖排骨，将猪肋排和白萝卜一起炖煮，味道鲜美、营养丰富，可补肾养血，滋养脾胃，润泽皮肤，汤汁清澈透明，不油不腻。
description_en: Braised pork ribs, stewed with pork ribs and white radish, is delicious and nutritious. It can nourish the kidneys and blood, nourish the spleen and stomach, and moisturize the skin. The soup is clear and transparent, not greasy or greasy.
tips_zh:
1、白萝卜待出锅前30分钟左右放入即可。
2、猪肋排事先用冷水浸泡、沸水焯烫，都是为了析出血水，让汤品味道更好。
3、精盐的用量，可根据自己的口味喜欢适量增减，喝汤以口味不要太咸为准。
tips_en:
1. Add the daikon about 30 minutes before the soup is done.
2. Soaking the ribs in cold water and blanching them in boiling water draws out blood and improves the soup's flavor.
3. Adjust the salt to taste—the soup shouldn't be too salty.

steps.content_zh: 准备所需食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 肋排洗净，切成小块，放入冷水中，把血水泡出；
steps.content_en: Wash the ribs, cut them into small pieces, put them in cold water and soak out the blood;

steps.content_zh: 白萝卜洗净、去皮、切片；
steps.content_en: Wash, peel and slice the white radish;

steps.content_zh: 葱切段、姜切片；
steps.content_en: Cut the scallion into sections and slice the ginger;

steps.content_zh: 锅内放清水，将肋排放入，水烧开煮出浮沫，将排骨捞出；
steps.content_en: Pour water into the pot, put the ribs in, boil the water until foam forms, and remove the ribs;

steps.content_zh: 米家电饭煲中放入清水，放入焯烫好的猪肋排、葱段、姜片、料酒、花椒，开启电饭煲；
steps.content_en: Add water to the Mijia rice cooker, then the blanched pork ribs, scallion pieces, ginger slices, cooking wine and Sichuan peppercorns; turn it on;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入萝卜；
steps.content_en: Add radish with 30 minutes remaining in cooking time;

steps.content_zh: 放入枸杞、精盐；
steps.content_en: Add goji berries and salt.

steps.content_zh: 成品汤汁清澈透明，不油不腻。
steps.content_en: The finished soup is clear and transparent, not oily or greasy.

name_en: Black date and lotus seed porridge
description_zh: 其实黑枣的营养价值不低于红枣，黑枣中含有丰富的蛋白质、脂肪、糖类、多种维生素等。以含维生素C和钙质、铁质最多，具有加强补血的效果。与莲子、枸杞一起搭配食用，还能起到养心安神，补肾健脾，益精明目等功效，适当食用有利于健康。
description_en: Black dates are no less nutritious than red dates, being rich in protein, fat, sugar and various vitamins—especially vitamin C, calcium and iron—which help boost blood nourishment. Eaten with lotus seeds and goji berries, they also nourish the heart, calm the mind, tonify the kidneys and spleen, benefit essence and improve vision. Moderate consumption is good for health.
tips_zh:
1、莲子也可以不用去皮，我是为了好看才去掉的
2、如果喜欢吃甜粥，可在煮粥时放入冰糖，或在食用前拌入蜂蜜
2、黑枣一次不能吃多，否则会引起胃酸过多和腹胀，并且忌与柿子同食
tips_en:
1. You don't need to peel the lotus seeds—I did it just for looks.
2. For a sweeter porridge, add rock sugar while cooking or stir in honey before eating.
3. Don't eat too many black dates at once—they can cause excess stomach acid and bloating; avoid eating them with persimmons.

steps.content_zh: 备好所需食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 枸杞清洗干净，无需浸泡
steps.content_en: Rinse the goji berries; no soaking needed

steps.content_zh: 莲子浸泡1小时以上，剥去外皮，取出莲心；
steps.content_en: Soak the lotus seeds for at least 1 hour, peel off the skins, and remove the cores;

steps.content_zh: 将大米和糯米放入锅中淘洗干净，随后倒入黑枣、莲子，并注入清水，水量在稠粥3/4的水位线，开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the rice and glutinous rice into the pot and wash them thoroughly, then pour in the black dates and lotus seeds, and add water until the water level reaches 3/4 of the thick porridge, and start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后放入枸杞，再焖5至10分钟即可；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add the wolfberries and simmer for another 5 to 10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 此粥可咸可甜，可就着小咸菜吃，也可拌入蜂蜜吃。
steps.content_en: This porridge can be savory or sweet—enjoy it with pickles or mixed with honey.

description_zh: 菠菜有“营养模范生”之称，富含类胡萝卜素、维生素C、维生素K、矿物质等多种营养素，这一道菠菜粥，很家常，对改善夜盲症有帮助。
description_en: Spinach is known as the "nutritional model student" and is rich in carotenoids, vitamin C, vitamin K, minerals and other nutrients. This spinach porridge is very homely and helps to improve night blindness.
tips_zh: 将菠菜事先沸水焯烫一下，是为了去除菠菜中的草酸。
tips_en: Blanch the spinach in boiling water beforehand to remove the oxalic acid in the spinach.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸭田米淘洗干净，用冷水浸泡半小时，捞出沥干水分；
steps.content_en: Wash the duck-field rice thoroughly, soak in cold water for half an hour, then drain;

steps.content_zh: 将菠菜洗净，在沸水中焯烫一下，切4厘米左右的段；
steps.content_en: Wash the spinach, blanch it in boiling water, and cut into sections of about 4 cm;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加入约1000毫升的冷水，放入鸭田米，煮粥；
steps.content_en: Add about 1000 ml of cold water to the pot, add the duck-field rice, and cook porridge;

steps.content_zh: 待粥将熟时，将菠菜段放入锅中继续熬煮；
steps.content_en: When the porridge is almost cooked, add the spinach segments into the pot and continue cooking;

steps.content_zh: 米烂菜熟时，放入精盐、味精，搅拌均匀，再焖煮片刻即可。
steps.content_en: When the rice is soft and the vegetables are cooked, add salt and MSG, stir well and simmer a little longer.

description_zh:
庭前芍药妖无格，池上芙蕖净少情。
唯有牡丹真国色，花开时节动京城。
这是唐代刘禹锡在诗中，对牡丹的赞美。牡丹，素有“花中之王”的美誉，牡丹不仅有观赏价值，还具有很多的药用价值。久服可养血和肝、散郁祛淤、常饮气血活肺、容颜红润，改善月经失调、痛经。
description_en:
The peony demon in front of the court has no integrity, but the hibiscus on the pond is pure and has little emotion.
Only peonies are the true national beauty, and they move the capital when they bloom.
This is Liu Yuxi’s poem praising peonies in the Tang Dynasty. Peony, known as the "King of Flowers", not only has ornamental value, but also has many medicinal values. Taking it for a long time can nourish the blood and liver, disperse depression and remove blood stasis, drink qi and blood frequently to activate the lungs, make the face rosy, and improve menstrual disorders and dysmenorrhea.
tips_zh:
1、不喜欢食用牡丹花瓣的，也可以先用冷水和花瓣煮沸10分钟后，滤去花瓣，用剩下的水煮粥也可以
2、此粥可养血调经，适合女性月经不调，行经腹痛，因此春季食用，有护肤的作用
tips_en:
1. If you don’t like to eat peony petals, you can boil the petals with cold water for 10 minutes, filter out the petals, and use the remaining water to make porridge.
2. This porridge can nourish blood and regulate menstruation. It is suitable for women with irregular menstruation and abdominal pain during menstruation. Therefore, eating it in spring has the effect of skin care.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将牡丹花花瓣漂洗干净；
steps.content_en: Rinse peony petals clean;

steps.content_zh: 鸭田米淘洗干净，用冷水浸泡半小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the duck field rice and soak it in cold water for half an hour;

steps.content_zh: 锅中放入浸泡好的米，开启煮粥按键或点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the soaked rice in the pot, press the Porridge button or tap Start Cooking on the phone to cook;

steps.content_zh: 剩余10分钟时放入牡丹花瓣和红糖；
steps.content_en: When 10 minutes remain, add peony petals and brown sugar;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，即可盛起食用。
steps.content_en: Once cooking is complete, it is ready to serve.

description_zh: 槐花味道清香甘甜，富含维生素和多种矿物质，具有清热解毒、凉血润肺、降血压、预防中风的功效。
description_en: Sophora japonica has a sweet fragrance and is rich in vitamins and minerals. It has the effects of clearing away heat and detoxifying, cooling blood and moisturizing the lungs, lowering blood pressure and preventing stroke.
tips_zh:
1、可以放入少许虾皮提鲜。
2、鸡蛋最后倒入，不用再次沸腾，这样蛋花会非常鲜嫩。
tips_en:
1. You can add a little dried shrimps to enhance the freshness.
2. Pour the eggs in last, without boiling again, so that the egg drop will be very fresh and tender.

steps.content_zh: 槐花在容器中浸泡，去除杂质；
steps.content_en: Soak the pagoda flowers in a container to remove impurities;

steps.content_zh: 滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Drain;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the thick porridge - 1 mark, then tap Start Cooking on the phone to cook;

steps.content_zh: 约10分钟后水沸腾，倒入准备好的槐花继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: After about 10 minutes, the water will boil, pour in the prepared sophora flowers and continue to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋打成蛋液，锅中再次沸腾后倒入蛋液，搅拌后用盐和芝麻油调味；
steps.content_en: Beat the eggs into a liquid, pour into the pot once it boils again, stir, and season with salt and sesame oil;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 南方人在立夏有吃乌米饭和咸豆儿糯米饭的习俗，乌饭叶子不好找，不妨做个豌豆儿糯米饭吧。
description_en: Southerners have the custom of eating black rice and glutinous rice with salted beans in the Beginning of Summer. Black rice leaves are hard to find, so you might as well make glutinous rice with peas.
tips_zh:
1、咸肉很咸，所以要浸泡一会去除咸味。
2、糯米浸泡后煮饭吸水能力很差，煮饭的时候按照教程的方法放水。
tips_en:
1. Salted pork is very salty—soak it for a while to remove some salt.
2. Soaked glutinous rice absorbs little water, so follow the recipe's water amounts.

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前浸泡1晚上，滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice overnight and drain;

steps.content_zh: 竹笋切丁，豌豆荚剥出豌豆；
steps.content_en: Dice the bamboo shoots and shell the peas from their pods;

steps.content_zh: 咸肉切成丁后，浸泡30分钟去除一些咸味；
steps.content_en: Cut the bacon into cubes and soak it for 30 minutes to remove some of the salty taste;

steps.content_zh: 在炒锅中将咸肉煸出油后倒入豌豆粒和笋丁一起炒香，盛出备用；
steps.content_en: In a wok, sauté the bacon to remove the oil, add the peas and diced bamboo shoots, stir-fry until fragrant, set aside;

steps.content_zh: 东北米洗净后与糯米同时倒入锅中，加水与米齐平即可；
steps.content_en: Wash the Northeastern rice and pour it into the pot at the same time as the glutinous rice. Add water to make it even with the rice;

steps.content_zh: 倒入炒好的食材，搅拌均匀后点击手机开始烹饪图标进行焖煮；
steps.content_en: Pour in the fried ingredients, stir evenly and click the start cooking icon on your phone to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 完成后米粒晶莹剔透，有油脂的香味和蔬菜的清香；
steps.content_en: When finished, the rice grains will be crystal clear, with the fragrance of oil and vegetables;

steps.content_zh: 享用吧~
steps.content_en: Enjoy~

description_zh: 最朴素的吃法，原汁原味。
description_en: The simplest way to eat, authentic taste.
tips_zh: 一般蒸到鱼的眼珠变白突出，即可判断已经蒸熟。
tips_en: Generally, when the fish's eyes turn white and protrude after steaming, it can be judged that it has been steamed.

steps.content_zh: 将小黄鱼去鳞，去内脏，用清水洗净；
steps.content_en: Remove the scales and internal organs of the small yellow croaker and wash them with clean water;

steps.content_zh: 将小黄鱼放入容器中加入盐、胡椒粉、葱丝姜片和料酒后腌制20分钟；
steps.content_en: Put the small yellow croaker into a container, add salt, pepper, shredded green onions, ginger slices and cooking wine and marinate for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 将腌制好的黄花鱼装盘，撒上腌制时的葱丝和姜片；
steps.content_en: Place the marinated yellow croaker on a plate and sprinkle with the marinated green onions and ginger slices;

steps.content_zh: 也可将腌好的黄花鱼切片后再装盘；锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击开始烹饪图标进行蒸制；
steps.content_en: You can also slice the marinated yellow croaker and put it on a plate; add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice -2 mark, click the start cooking icon to steam;

steps.content_zh: 结束后去掉多余汤汁和蒸熟的葱姜，撒上新鲜的葱丝、姜丝和辣椒圈；
steps.content_en: When done, remove the excess sauce and the steamed scallion and ginger, then sprinkle with fresh shredded scallion, shredded ginger and chili rings;

steps.content_zh: 淋上蒸鱼豉油，取一个炒锅将花生油加热后浇在鱼上，这道菜就完成了。
steps.content_en: Drizzle with steamed fish soy sauce, heat peanut oil in a pan, and pour it over the fish—the dish is done.

description_zh: 肉骨茶Bak-Kut-Teh （福建语） 是南洋美食之一，是一道以猪骨配合中药煲成的汤底。这份药膳汤因为有排湿毒的功效，所以很适合体内湿气重的人士。
description_en: Bak-Kut-Teh (Hokkien) is one of the delicacies of Southeast Asia, a soup base made by simmering pork bones with Chinese herbs. This medicinal soup helps expel dampness and toxins, so it is especially suitable for people with high internal dampness.
tips_zh: 老餮们都是拿着油条配肉骨茶一起吃。一大碗汤，两三条肉骨，一碟油条，一碟指天椒酱油，一碟小咸菜，一碗米饭，一杯好茶，一顿饭就圆满了
tips_en: The old guys all eat fried dough sticks with Bak Kut Teh. A big bowl of soup, two or three meat bones, a plate of fried dough sticks, a plate of chili padi soy sauce, a plate of pickles, a bowl of rice, a cup of good tea, and the meal is complete.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将仔排焯水，冷水下锅，水开后再煮5分钟后用温水冲洗干净，洗掉血沫；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pork chops, put them in a pot with cold water, boil them for 5 minutes, then rinse them with warm water to remove any blood foam;

steps.content_zh: 大蒜剥开分成一粒粒，可以留下最后一层蒜皮。将焯过水洗净的仔排放入锅胆内，放入大蒜、料酒和一包新加坡肉骨茶料包，加水至水位线：稠粥1的刻度，点击手机图标开始煲汤；
steps.content_en: Peel the garlic into small pieces, leaving the last layer of garlic skin. Put the blanched and washed pork chops into the pot, add garlic, cooking wine and a pack of Singaporean Bak Kut Teh ingredients. Add water to the water level: thick porridge 1. Click the phone icon to start making soup;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入生抽、盐、胡椒粉调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with light soy sauce, salt, and pepper;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用美味吧。
steps.content_en: Let’s start enjoying the delicious food.

description_zh:
“晴晚看槐花，悠然目不暇，
青枝披缟素，绿叶衬云霞。”
把槐花用清水淘干净，加进一些干面粉，拌匀后放进蒸笼，蒸到香气四溢时就熟了。槐花糕放时嘴里，又绵又酥，甜丝丝的余味无穷，好象那槐花已经进入了你的五脏六腑。
description_en:
'On a clear evening I gaze at the pagoda flowers, my eyes delighted; green branches draped in white, leaves set off the clouds.'
Wash the pagoda tree flowers well, mix in some dry flour, and steam in a steamer until fragrant. The flower cake is soft and crumbly, with a lingering sweetness, as if the blossoms have filled your whole body.
tips_zh:
1、洗过的槐花放在阴凉通风处，沥干水分，过程大概1个小时
2、可以根据个人喜好放入大蒜、辣椒等调料。
tips_en:
1. Place the washed Sophora japonica in a cool and ventilated place and drain the water. The process will take about 1 hour.
2. You can add garlic, pepper and other seasonings according to personal preference.

steps.content_zh: 槐花去除枝干，在清水中浸泡一会除去泥沙；
steps.content_en: Remove the stems from the pagoda flowers and soak in clean water for a while to remove sand;

steps.content_zh: 控干水分；
steps.content_en: Drain well;

steps.content_zh: 撒上面粉搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with flour and mix well;

steps.content_zh: 蒸笼中垫上油纸或者纱布，将拌好的槐花平铺在蒸笼上；点击手机开始烹饪图标进行蒸制；
steps.content_en: Line the steamer with parchment or gauze, spread the mixed pagoda flowers evenly, then tap Start Cooking on the app to steam;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后稍微搅拌，装盘撒上葱花、淋上生抽和芝麻油，香软可口。
steps.content_en: After taking it out of the pot, stir it slightly, put it on a plate and sprinkle with chopped green onion, drizzle with light soy sauce and sesame oil. It's soft and delicious.

description_zh: 两个字：鲜、香。槐花的清香味比很多蔬菜浓郁，回口甘甜，选用了肥三瘦七的五花肉，口感松软鲜香。
description_en: Two words: fresh and fragrant. The fragrance of Sophora japonica is stronger than that of many vegetables, and the aftertaste is sweet. It uses pork belly that is fat, thin, and has a soft and fragrant taste.
tips_zh:
1、非常适合老人和宝宝食用。
2、搅打肉丸的时候要朝着一个方向搅打，这样煮出来的丸子才会Q弹。
tips_en:
1. Great for seniors and young children.
2. Stir the meat mixture in one direction only so the meatballs turn out bouncy.

steps.content_zh: 槐花在清水中浸泡、洗净；
steps.content_en: Soak the pagoda flowers in clean water and rinse well;

steps.content_zh: 小葱切葱花、生姜切成姜末倒入肉末中，倒入料酒、盐和胡椒粉，搅打上劲；
steps.content_en: Chop the shallots into finely chopped green onions and the ginger into minced pieces. Pour into the minced meat, add cooking wine, salt and pepper, stir well;

steps.content_zh: 用虎口挤出丸子；
steps.content_en: Use the tiger's mouth to squeeze out the balls;

steps.content_zh: 准备好的肉丸；
steps.content_en: prepared meatballs;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，放入槐花后点击手机开始烹饪图标，煮出槐花的香味；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the thick porridge - 1 mark, add the pagoda tree blossoms and tap Start Cooking on the phone to bring out their fragrance;

steps.content_zh: 约十分钟后沸腾，倒入做好的肉丸继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: After boiling for about ten minutes, pour in the prepared meatballs and continue to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 丸子全部浮起后就表示丸子已经熟了，放入少许盐调味，淋上芝麻油就完成啦~
steps.content_en: When all the meatballs float, it means the meatballs are cooked. Add a little salt to taste, then drizzle with sesame oil and it's done~

description_zh: 铁棍山药是众多山药品种之一，山药富含丰富的蛋白质，维生素和多种氨基酸与矿物质，既能补脾肺肾之气，又能滋养脾肺肾之阴，为气阴双补之珍品。
description_en: Iron stick yam is one of many yam varieties. Rich in protein, vitamins, amino acids and minerals, it both tonifies the qi of the spleen, lungs and kidneys and nourishes their yin, making it a treasured ingredient that replenishes both qi and yin.
tips_zh:
1.糖，牛奶，玫瑰根据自己喜好即可
2.觉得奶香不足的，牛奶可以用奶油或者酸奶替代
tips_en:
1. Adjust sugar, milk, and rose to taste.
2. If it isn't milky enough, use cream or yogurt instead of milk.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 在电饭煲里放东北米2刻度的水，把铁棍山药去皮放入电饭煲里蒸，放入后就可以用电饭煲烹饪了
steps.content_en: Put 2 degrees of Northeast Rice water into the rice cooker. Peel the iron stick yam and steam it in the rice cooker. After adding it, you can use the rice cooker to cook.

steps.content_zh: 蒸好的山药，取出，用勺子压成泥状
steps.content_en: Take out the steamed yam and press it into a puree with a spoon

steps.content_zh: 加入备好的牛奶，糖，玫瑰搅拌均匀
steps.content_en: Add the prepared milk, sugar and rose and mix well

steps.content_zh: 装入盛具，用玫瑰点缀下即可，有模具的可以压成任何形状
steps.content_en: Put it into a container and decorate it with roses. If there is a mold, it can be pressed into any shape.

description_zh: 焖燥的夏日总是没胃口吃饭，吃一份凉皮最好不过了，自己做健康卫生。
description_en: On hot, muggy summer days when you have no appetite, nothing beats cold skin noodles - homemade is healthy and hygienic.
tips_zh:
1、凉皮一次不要做太多，吃多少就做多少，也不要放入冰箱冷藏，那样凉皮的口感会变差。
2、揭下来的凉皮表面要刷上油，这样逐张叠放上去就不会粘连了。 
3、面糊倒入盘子后，要用手晃一下，使面糊均匀的铺在盘底。蒸的时候，要盖上锅盖。
tips_en:
1. Make only as much cold-skin noodle sheet as you'll eat—don't refrigerate it, or the texture suffers.
2. Brush each peeled-off sheet with oil so the stacked layers don't stick together.
3. After pouring the batter into the plate, swirl it to spread evenly across the bottom, and cover with the lid while steaming.

steps.content_zh: 干面粉加适量的水和一点盐和成面团，软硬无所谓，然后盖湿布醒上十几分钟；
steps.content_en: Mix dry flour with an appropriate amount of water and a little salt to form a dough. It doesn't matter whether it's soft or hard. Then cover it with a damp cloth and let it rest for ten minutes;

steps.content_zh: 在一个稍大的盆里放上一些凉水，把面团放进去，用手抓着面团像揉衣服一样“洗”。水越来越白；淀粉被洗进水里，手里剩下的是面筋，这时候手里的面团会越来越散，没关系，最后打捞一下就可以了；
steps.content_en: Put some cold water in a large bowl, add the dough and 'wash' it with your hands as if laundering clothes. The water turns cloudy white as starch washes out, leaving gluten in your hands. The dough will crumble—don't worry, just scoop it out at the end.

steps.content_zh: 等感觉面团怎么洗也不“变小”了就用手捞一下，把面筋捞到一个碗里，盆中的水通过一个细筛过滤到另外一个容器里，得到的“渣”也和面筋放在一起。得到的液体放进冰箱过夜或至少放置四小时，目的是让淀粉在水里沉淀；
steps.content_en: When the dough no longer seems to shrink no matter how much you wash it, scoop out the gluten into a bowl. Strain the water in the basin through a fine sieve into another container and keep the residue with the gluten. Refrigerate the liquid overnight or at least 4 hours so the starch settles;

steps.content_zh: 再加一点清水，把还比较散的面筋像揉面一样揉成一团，再继续洗一洗，把里面的淀粉尽可能的洗干净。最后可以拿到水龙头下边冲边搓，得到的面筋；
steps.content_en: Add a little more water, knead the crumbled gluten into a ball as if kneading dough, then keep washing to remove as much starch as possible. Finally, rinse under the tap while rubbing to obtain the gluten.

steps.content_zh: 面粉水过夜或静置至少四小时后淀粉已经沉下去了，上层变成了清水，这时用一个勺把清水撇出来，只留下面的部分。这时下面的淀粉可能已经变得很粘很硬，要用力搅开，直到变成均匀的一盆面糊；
steps.content_en: After the flour water has been left to stand overnight or for at least four hours, the starch has settled and the upper layer has turned into water. At this time, use a spoon to skim out the water, leaving only the flour part. At this time, the starch below may have become very sticky and hard, so stir it vigorously until it becomes a uniform bowl of batter;

steps.content_zh: 准备一个平底的盘子（最好是金属的），抹一点油防粘；盛出一勺面糊在盘子上铺平；
steps.content_en: Prepare a flat-bottomed plate (preferably metal), grease it with a little oil to prevent sticking; scoop out a ladle of batter and spread it on the plate;

steps.content_zh: 锅内放水，蒸煮程序烧开，将盛了面糊的碟子放蒸笼上，蒸5分钟，即可成型；
steps.content_en: Put water in the pot and bring to a boil using the steam program, then place the plate of batter in the steamer and steam for 5 minutes until set;

steps.content_zh: 凉皮成型后，取出来放冷水中冷却30秒。可以取两个碟子轮流使用，取出一个碟子放水中冷却，锅中再放入下一个碟子；
steps.content_en: After the cold skin is formed, take it out and cool it in cold water for 30 seconds. You can take two plates and use them in turn, take out one plate and put it in water to cool, and then put the next plate in the pot;

steps.content_zh: 冷却后的凉皮很轻松的就可以揭下来，揭下来的凉皮表面刷一层香油，依次放入碟子内，每层之间都要刷，这样才不会粘在一起；
steps.content_en: After cooling, the cold skin can be peeled off easily. Brush a layer of sesame oil on the surface of the peeled cold skin, then put it into the dish one by one, brushing between each layer so that it will not stick together;

steps.content_zh: 依次将所有的凉皮做完，做完的凉皮切条；
steps.content_en: Finish all the cold skins in turn and cut the finished cold skins into strips;

steps.content_zh: 那团面筋的处理：不用时把它放在清水里浸着。等到开始做凉皮时在面筋里加一点酵母粉揉匀，等凉皮全蒸完了，在锅里放蒸格，面筋放进一个碗里开锅后蒸上十五分钟就好了；
steps.content_en: Handle the gluten dough by soaking it in clean water when not in use. When making liangpi, knead in a little yeast. Once all the liangpi are steamed, place a steamer rack in the pot, put the gluten in a bowl and steam for 15 minutes after the water boils;

steps.content_zh: 面筋切块，黄瓜切丝，蒜瓣剁碎，香菜切碎、与切好的凉皮放在一起，依个人口味放入适量食盐，辣椒油，花椒油，芝麻油，陈醋，撒上黑芝麻，拌匀后开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Cut the gluten into cubes, shred the cucumber, chop the garlic cloves, chop the coriander, and put it together with the cut cold skin. Add an appropriate amount of salt, chili oil, pepper oil, sesame oil, and mature vinegar according to your personal taste. Sprinkle with black sesame seeds, mix well, and enjoy.

description_zh: 五香卤鸭翅，忍不住吮指的美味，好吃到没朋友~
description_en: The five-spice braised duck wings are so delicious that you can’t help but suck your fingers. They’re so delicious that they have no friends~
tips_zh:
1、刚出锅会不够味。煮熟不捞出泡在锅里，放入冰箱或者常温一夜，就会很入味了。
2、卤过鸭翅的卤水，滤掉香料，自然冷却后放入干净的玻璃器皿中，密封保存，放入冷冻以便下次继续使用。
tips_en:
1. It won't be flavorful straight out of the pot—leave the wings in the liquid overnight (in the fridge or at room temperature) to absorb the flavor.
2. Strain the spices from the braising liquid, let it cool, then store it in a clean sealed glass container in the freezer for reuse.

steps.content_zh: 鸭翅凉水入锅，焯水后洗净；
steps.content_en: Put the duck wings into a pot with cold water, blanch them and wash them;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片，大葱拍松各种香料洗净；
steps.content_en: Slice the ginger, lightly crush the scallions, and rinse the assorted spices;

steps.content_zh: 将鸭翅倒入锅中，加入各种香料后注入清水，放入生抽、老抽、盐、冰糖，搅拌后点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the duck wings into the pot, add various spices, add water, add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, salt and rock sugar, stir and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后需要在汤汁中浸泡2小时，捞出鸭翅过滤多余汤汁，冷却后更好吃；
steps.content_en: After cooking, soak the duck wings in the broth for 2 hours, then drain off the excess liquid; they taste even better cooled.

steps.content_zh: 吃前拍个照片，留着深夜放毒 ： ）
steps.content_en: Take a photo before eating and save it for poisoning late at night :)

description_zh: 无法抗拒的法式浪漫“舌吻”，凉爽Q滑，根根肥美，为卤味中珍品。
description_en: The irresistible French romantic "tongue kiss", cool and smooth, with plump roots, is a treasure of braised food.
tips_zh:
1、鸭舌比较难处理，表面上有层膜需要撕去。
2、想要鸭舌更劲道，需要在卤好鸭舌后入烤箱，将鸭舌烤干。
tips_en:
1. Duck tongue is difficult to handle. There is a film on the surface that needs to be removed.
2. If you want the duck tongue to be more chewy, you need to marinate the duck tongue and put it in the oven to dry it.

steps.content_zh: 鸭舌在清水中浸泡，去除血水；
steps.content_en: Soak duck tongue in clean water to remove blood;

steps.content_zh: 冷水入锅焯水，水开后煮继续煮5分钟，捞出后清洗干净；
steps.content_en: Pour cold water into a pot and blanch it. After the water boils, continue to cook for 5 minutes. Take it out and clean it;

steps.content_zh: 将处理好的鸭舌和各种香料、调料一起放入锅中，加入清水搅拌后点击开手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the processed duck tongue and various spices and seasonings into the pot, add water and stir, then click on the phone to start cooking icon to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 完成烹饪后，将鸭舌浸泡在卤水中浸泡，最好放到冰箱中浸泡过夜，这样会更入味；
steps.content_en: After finishing cooking, soak the duck tongue in the brine, preferably in the refrigerator overnight, which will make it more delicious;

steps.content_zh: 捞出后将鸭舌滤干卤水，开始大快朵颐吧。
steps.content_en: Remove the duck tongues, drain the braising liquid and dig in.

steps.content_zh: 剩下的卤水滤掉香料，放入干净的玻璃器皿中冷却后包上保鲜膜，冷冻保存。
steps.content_en: Strain out the spices from the remaining brine, cool it in a clean glass vessel, wrap it in plastic wrap, and freeze it.

description_zh: 卤鸭掌的妙处在于它嚼劲十足，是肉食朋友的理想食物。适合各种场合食用，夜宵、聚餐、旅行、看电视的时候都能来一个，跟着我做不好吃你打我~~~
description_en: The beauty of braised duck feet is their satisfying chew—perfect for meat lovers. Great any time: late-night snacks, gatherings, trips or TV watching. Follow my recipe and if it's not delicious, you can spank me~~~
tips_zh:
1、卤水用完之后继续捞出香料，放入干净的容器中，密封冷冻保存，以便下次继续使用，好的卤水要养，每次卤的时候要适量增添香料和调料，一锅好卤水可以传承。
2、鸭掌冷藏后风味更佳。
3、不要煮太长时间，60分钟为宜，煮过了鸭掌就不劲道了。
4、卤水的做法见我的另一道卤鸭舌的做法。
tips_en:
1. After the brine is used up, continue to fish out the spices, put them in a clean container, seal and freeze them for further use next time. Good brine needs to be maintained. Add an appropriate amount of spices and seasonings every time you brine. A pot of good brine can be passed down.
2. The flavor of duck feet will be better after being refrigerated.
3. Don’t cook it for too long, 60 minutes is appropriate. The duck feet will lose their flavor after cooking.
4. For the method of brine, see my other method of braised duck tongue.

steps.content_zh: 取出上次卤好鸭舌剩余的卤水，解冻备用；
steps.content_en: Take out the remaining brine from the duck tongue that was braised last time, defrost it and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 鸭掌冷水入锅，加入冷水放入花椒和料酒，选择蒸煮模式20分钟，焯水；
steps.content_en: Put the duck feet in a pot with cold water, add Sichuan pepper and cooking wine, select steam-cook mode for 20 minutes, and blanch;

steps.content_zh: 焯水后的鸭掌洗净；
steps.content_en: Blanch the duck feet and rinse;

steps.content_zh: 将解冻好的卤水倒入锅中，放入八角、香叶、花椒和生抽、老抽、盐，这次做的鸭掌是麻辣味的，所以可以多放些辣椒和花椒，记得把辣椒掰开，加入适量的清水没过鸭掌，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行卤制；
steps.content_en: Pour the thawed brine into the pot, add star anise, bay leaves, Sichuan peppercorns, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and salt. The duck feet you are making this time are spicy, so you can add more chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns. Remember to break up the chili peppers, add an appropriate amount of water to cover the duck feet, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to marinate;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，将鸭掌浸泡在卤水中自然冷却后捞出，滤掉卤汁，开始享用吧~
steps.content_en: After cooking, soak the duck feet in the braising liquid until cooled, then remove, drain, and enjoy~

description_zh: 刚刚上市的豌豆清香鲜甜，只要加少许盐和香料稍稍煮熟，无需更多调味。将整个豆荚在唇边轻轻一捋，鲜嫩的豆粒全部跳进口中。
description_en: Freshly harvested peas are sweet and fragrant. Just a pinch of salt and seasoning, briefly cooked—nothing more needed. Slide the whole pod past your lips and the tender peas pop right into your mouth.
tips_zh: 豌豆不要煮过了，老了就不好吃。
tips_en: Don't overcook the peas, otherwise they won't taste good.

steps.content_zh: 豌豆洗净放入锅中；
steps.content_en: Wash the peas and put them in the pot;

steps.content_zh: 加入盐、八角、花椒、桂皮；
steps.content_en: Add salt, star anise, peppercorns, and cinnamon;

steps.content_zh: 加水加到稠粥1的刻度；点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the level of thick porridge 1; click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 完成后就可享用啦。
steps.content_en: Once completed, enjoy.

description_zh: 夏日即将来临，需要多吃点薏米。薏米是常用的中药又是普遍、常吃的食物，性味甘淡微寒，有利水消肿、健脾去湿、舒筋除痹、清热排脓等功效。
description_en: As summer approaches, eat more job's tears (coix seed). A common food and medicinal ingredient, it is sweet, bland and slightly cooling, helping drain dampness, reduce swelling, strengthen the spleen, relax the tendons, clear heat and promote drainage of pus.
tips_zh: 薏米不要放多，放多就成薏米粥，影响口感。
tips_en: Don't add too many job's tears, or it will turn into job's tears porridge and affect the texture.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材备用；
steps.content_en: Have ingredients ready;

steps.content_zh: 薏米用水浸泡四小时以上，捞出沥干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the job's tears in water for at least 4 hours, then drain;

steps.content_zh: 将沥干水分的薏米放入锅胆内,加水到水位线稠粥1的刻度，点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the drained barley into the pot, add water to the water level line of thick porridge 1, click to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 柠檬洗净切片备用；
steps.content_en: Wash and slice the lemon; set aside.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后放凉装入杯中,加入切好的柠檬片,可根据个人口味加入适当的蜂蜜或砂糖；
steps.content_en: After cooking, let cool, pour into a cup, add sliced lemon, and add honey or sugar to taste;

steps.content_zh: 完成后可以马上饮用，或者冷却后放入冰箱中冷藏，味道更佳。
steps.content_en: You can drink it immediately after finishing, or cool it and store it in the refrigerator for a better taste.

description_zh: 用各种菌菇和糯米制成的烧麦，味道鲜美口感软糯入味，制作起来也不困难，可以一次多做一些冷冻起来，每天早上热几个当早餐。
description_en: Shaomai made with assorted mushrooms and glutinous rice is savory, soft, and flavorful, and not hard to make. Prepare a big batch, freeze them, and heat a few each morning for breakfast.
tips_zh: 不同烧麦的做法都是大同小异的，里面的馅料可以根据自己的口味放入喜好的食材，比如咸肉、咸蛋黄等。
tips_en: The cooking methods of different siomai are similar. You can add your favorite ingredients into the filling according to your own taste, such as bacon, salted egg yolk, etc.

steps.content_zh: 备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare food ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 糯米用水浸泡一夜，捞出沥干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice in water overnight, then drain;

steps.content_zh: 将糯米放入碗中放在蒸笼中，或者在蒸笼上放纱布将糯米铺在上面，锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度，蒸煮模式30分钟；
steps.content_en: Put the glutinous rice into a bowl and place it in a steamer, or put gauze on the steamer and spread the glutinous rice on it. Add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice -3 mark, steaming mode for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 各种菌类洗净切碎，一小块生姜也切末；
steps.content_en: Wash and chop various fungi, and mince a small piece of ginger;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加油烧热并放入姜末和切好的菌类炒香。下入蒸好的糯米一起炒，可根据情况加适量的水不要太湿，糯米保持一粒一粒的最好；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in the pot and stir-fry minced ginger and the chopped mushrooms until fragrant. Add the steamed sticky rice and stir-fry together, adding a little water if needed but not too much - the rice is best when the grains stay separate;

steps.content_zh: 面粉澄粉拌匀（也可只用面粉，加入一点澄面面的延展性透明性会更好）缓缓加入热开水一边快速搅拌，稍晾凉然后将面揉成团；
steps.content_en: Mix the flour and Chengfen evenly (you can also use only flour, adding a little Chengfa will make the dough more malleable and transparent). Slowly add hot water while stirring quickly, let it cool slightly and then knead the dough into a ball;

steps.content_zh: 将面团搓成长条，掐成30等分，每份都揉圆，压扁，然后像擀饺子皮一样擀，注意最后着重擀下边缘，这样就有烧卖的荷叶边了；
steps.content_en: Roll the dough into a long strip, cut it into 30 equal parts, round each part, flatten it, and then roll it out like a dumpling wrapper. Pay attention to rolling out the edges at the end, so that you have the ruffled edges of the siomai;

steps.content_zh: 填入炒好的馅料；
steps.content_en: Fill in the fried stuffing;

steps.content_zh: 上面用虎口微收口即可；
steps.content_en: Use the tiger's mouth to slightly close the top;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中补一点水，将包好的烧麦放入蒸笼中，蒸煮20分钟；
steps.content_en: Add a little water to the pot, put the wrapped siomai into the steamer, and steam for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧！
steps.content_en: Start enjoying!

description_zh: 三文鱼肉色橙红，口感鲜嫩柔滑，做成握寿司，不需任何添加也能体现它本质的美味，好吃又美观！
description_en: Salmon meat is orange-red in color and tastes tender and smooth. When made into nigiri sushi, its essential taste can be reflected without any additions. It is delicious and beautiful!
tips_zh: 捏饭团时，手上沾上点水，这样米饭不会粘到手上
tips_en: Wet your hands a little when shaping rice balls so the rice will not stick.

steps.content_zh: 大米用凉水冲洗，快速换水，反复四到五遍，直到水比较清透
steps.content_en: Rinse the rice with cold water, change the water quickly, and repeat four to five times until the water is clear.

steps.content_zh: 入电饭煲，水加到水位线东北米刻度2，选择精煮模式
steps.content_en: Put the rice cooker into the rice cooker, add water to the water level line Northeast rice mark 2, select the cooking mode

steps.content_zh: 煮好后开盖，用饭勺翻动打散，稍微放凉后加入寿司醋拌匀
steps.content_en: After cooking, open the lid, use a rice spoon to stir and break up, let cool slightly, then add sushi vinegar and mix well.

steps.content_zh: 准备好三文鱼、芥末和寿司饭
steps.content_en: Prepare salmon, wasabi and sushi rice

steps.content_zh: 用刀倾斜75度，将三文鱼斜切成约一厘米厚的薄片
steps.content_en: Tilt the knife at 75 degrees and cut the salmon into thin slices about one centimeter thick.

steps.content_zh: 将寿司饭攥成约20-25克的小饭团，长度不超过三文鱼片即可
steps.content_en: Shape the sushi rice into small rice balls of about 20-25 grams, no longer than the salmon fillet.

steps.content_zh: 生鱼片沾上少许芥末，放在饭团上，用手指轻按鱼片，让鱼片和饭团充分黏合
steps.content_en: Dip the sashimi with a little wasabi, place it on the rice ball, and press the fish fillet lightly with your fingers to make the fish fillet and the rice ball fully adhere.

steps.content_zh: 美味的三文鱼寿司基本完成喽，沾上酱油就可以吃了！
steps.content_en: The delicious salmon sushi is nearly finished — dip in soy sauce and eat!

name_en: Lily Bulb and Red Date Congee
description_zh: 百合清新爽口，红枣细滑甘甜，再加上有机粥米熬成一锅温润好粥，微甜而不腻，稠密又不失清爽。有助于改善身体虚弱而有心烦失眠、低热易怒者尤为适宜。
description_en: Fresh lily bulbs and smooth, sweet red dates cooked with organic porridge rice make a gentle, soothing congee—slightly sweet but not cloying, thick yet light. It helps with weakness and is especially suitable for those with restlessness, insomnia, low fever, or irritability.
tips_zh:
1、可以将红枣切开煮，这样粥中的红枣味会更浓一些。
2、百合不宜放太多，过多会发苦。
tips_en:
1. You can cut the red dates and cook them, so that the red dates flavor in the porridge will be stronger.
2. Don’t put too much lily, as too much will cause bitterness.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材备用；
steps.content_en: Have ingredients ready;

steps.content_zh: 红枣、粥米洗净；
steps.content_en: Wash the red dates and porridge rice;

steps.content_zh: 干百合用温水浸泡1个小时；
steps.content_en: Soak dried lilies in warm water for 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 将粥米和红枣同时放入电饭煲中，加入清水到水位线：稠粥-¾的刻度；点击手机开始烹饪图标开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put porridge rice and red dates into the rice cooker at the same time, add water to the water level: thick porridge - ¾ mark; click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入浸泡好的百合，放入冰糖继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add the soaked lily bulbs and rock sugar, and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 此粥软绵香甜，淡淡的红枣味沁人心脾。
steps.content_en: This porridge is soft, sweet, and fragrant, with a subtle red date flavor that refreshes the senses.

description_zh: “最远去过省城，最靓食过土鲮”，这是古时顺德的一句俗谚。形容鲮鱼虽然多骨，但味道鲜美，顺德厨师能把鲮鱼做出超过一百款美食；鲮鱼干是出门打拼的顺德人必带的两种食材之一。
description_en: 'The farthest we've gone is the provincial capital; the finest we've eaten is the mud carp'—an old Shunde saying. Though bony, the mud carp is delicious, and Shunde chefs make over a hundred dishes from it. Dried mud carp is one of two essentials Shunde people take when working away from home.
tips_zh: 鲮鱼虽然美味但是刺比较多，所以食用时要仔细些为好。
tips_en: Though delicious, mud carp has many bones, so eat it carefully.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切成姜丝、小葱切成葱段、辣椒切圈；
steps.content_en: Cut the ginger into shreds, the green onions into slices, and the chilies into rings;

steps.content_zh: 鲮鱼干不需要浸泡，广东风味的鱼干偏甜并不会太咸，洗净即可，切段平铺在盘子上，在上面撒上葱段、姜丝和辣椒圈，淋上料酒；
steps.content_en: Dried dace does not need to be soaked. Cantonese-style dried fish is sweet and not too salty. Just wash it, cut it into sections and lay it flat on a plate. Sprinkle green onions, shredded ginger and pepper rings on top, and pour cooking wine;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level: northeast meter -2 mark, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 蒸制30分钟；
steps.content_en: Steam for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 完成后取出即可享用啦。
steps.content_en: When finished, take it out and enjoy.

name_en: Lazy version of double skin breasts
description_zh: 绝对的懒人版方法,虽然省略了制作第一层奶皮的步骤，但是口感也是非常的棒，适合在慵懒的下午来个一碗。（貌似这样就变成单皮奶了）
description_en: The absolute lazy version of this method, although it omits the step of making the first layer of milk skin, the taste is also very good, suitable for a bowl on a lazy afternoon. (It seems like this will turn into single-skin milk)
tips_zh:
1、如果觉得有蛋腥味的话可以在蛋清中滴上几滴柠檬汁或者加入香草精油。
2、保鲜膜包紧，不要堵住电饭煲上盖的出气孔。
tips_en:
1. If you feel there is an eggy smell, you can add a few drops of lemon juice or vanilla essential oil to the egg white.
2. Wrap it tightly with plastic wrap and do not block the air outlet on the top cover of the rice cooker.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋的蛋黄和蛋清分离，取蛋清备用（蛋黄可以留着炒菜吃）；
steps.content_en: Separate the yolk and white; reserve the white (the yolk can be saved for stir-frying);

steps.content_zh: 将牛奶、蛋清和白砂糖同时倒入容器中，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Pour the milk, egg whites and sugar into the container at the same time and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 取小碗，过滤牛奶蛋清液；
steps.content_en: Take a small bowl and filter the milk and egg white liquid;

steps.content_zh: 静置一会，包上保鲜膜，在保鲜膜上用牙签插许多小洞洞防止蒸汽凝结成水滴滴在碗中；锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Let it sit for a while, cover with plastic wrap, and poke many small holes in the wrap with a toothpick to prevent steam from condensing and dripping into the bowl; add water to the inner pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 2 mark, then tap the Start Cooking icon on the screen to begin cooking;

steps.content_zh: 压力IH电饭煲的用户可以用蒸架蒸哦；约5分钟后水沸腾，放入碗开始蒸；
steps.content_en: Users of pressure IH rice cookers can use the steaming rack to steam; after about 5 minutes, the water will boil, put it in the bowl and start steaming;

steps.content_zh: 完成后冷却，放入冰箱中冷藏，最后放上蜜红豆或者坚果享用~
steps.content_en: After completion, cool it, put it in the refrigerator, and finally top it with honey red beans or nuts and enjoy~

steps.content_zh: 浓浓的奶香味，顺滑的口感。
steps.content_en: Rich milky aroma and a smooth, silky texture.

description_zh: 一共卤了接近20个，然后出了趟门，回来后只剩下两个，美其名曰试菜 ：） 烹饪的过程中已经香气四溢，引人围观了。
description_en: I braised nearly 20 of them in total, and then I went out and only two were left when I came back. It was euphemistically called a test dish :) During the cooking process, the aroma was already overflowing, attracting people to watch.
tips_zh:
1、若卤的不够入味可以将鸭胗浸泡在卤水中过夜，鸭胗切片后淋上一些卤水。
2、因为这次做的是麻辣味道的，所以放了些很辣的指天椒和较多的花椒。
tips_en:
1. If the brine is not tasty enough, you can soak the duck gizzards in brine overnight. Slice the duck gizzards and pour some brine over them.
2. Because this time I made it spicy, I added some spicy padi padi and more peppercorns.

steps.content_zh: 取出上次卤鸭掌后冷冻的卤水，用微波炉解冻；
steps.content_en: Take out the brine that was frozen since the last time you braised duck feet, and defrost it in the microwave;

steps.content_zh: 准备好鸭胗和各种香料；
steps.content_en: Prepare duck gizzards and various spices;

steps.content_zh: 鸭胗焯水后用清水洗净，除去表面的膜；
steps.content_en: Blanch the duck gizzards, rinse with clean water, and remove the surface membrane;

steps.content_zh: 将卤水倒入锅中，加入鸭胗、香料和调料，再适量的清水，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the brine into the pot, add duck gizzards, spices and seasonings, and an appropriate amount of water. Click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后将鸭胗浸泡在卤水中到自然冷却；
steps.content_en: After cooking, soak the duck gizzards in the braising liquid until cooled naturally;

steps.content_zh: 切片，装盘；
steps.content_en: Slice and plate;

steps.content_zh: 老规矩，将卤水中的香料过滤，倒入干净的容器中，密封冷冻保存以便下次使用。
steps.content_en: As usual, strain the spices out of the braising liquid, pour into a clean container, seal and freeze for next time.

name_en: Pepper Pork Belly and Chicken Soup
description_zh: 一直觉得猪肚鸡汤是一道比较难做的菜肴，直到自己动手做以后才发现没有想象中的困难。鲜美的鸡汤和微辣的胡椒味刺激着味蕾，很适合在冷暖交替的天气里来上一大碗。
description_en: I have always thought that pork belly and chicken soup is a difficult dish to make. It was not until I made it myself that I realized that it was not as difficult as I imagined. The delicious chicken soup and slightly spicy pepper flavor stimulate the taste buds, which is perfect for a big bowl in the alternating cold and warm weather.
tips_zh:
1、加入牛奶是为了让汤变得更浓稠，鲜美。
2、汤中还可以加入腐竹、白果、枸杞等食材。
tips_en:
1. Milk makes the soup richer and creamier.
2. You can also add dried tofu skin, ginkgo nuts, or goji berries.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 土鸡冷水入锅焯水，洗净后滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Blanch the chicken in cold water in a pot, wash and drain;

steps.content_zh: 猪肚洗净后与土鸡放入锅中，生姜切片、大蒜去皮、白胡椒粒放在砧板上用刀面压破后共同放入锅中，淋上料理米酒，加入水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行煲汤；
steps.content_en: Wash the pork tripe and place it in the pot with the free-range chicken. Slice the ginger, peel the garlic, crack the white peppercorns with the flat of a knife, and add them all. Drizzle with cooking rice wine, add water to the thick porridge level 1 line, and tap Start Cooking on the app to make soup;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间10分钟时打开上盖，撇去油脂，倒入牛奶后继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: At 10 minutes, open the lid, skim off the fat, pour in the milk, and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后撒上一些胡椒粉，放入盐和鸡粉调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, sprinkle with pepper and season with salt and chicken powder;

steps.content_zh: 趁热享用。
steps.content_en: Serve hot.

name_en: Pork spine, corn and carrot soup
description_zh: 这是我家大女儿特别爱喝的一道汤，排骨玉米胡萝卜汤，几乎每个周末都会做一次，平时大多都是用高压锅做，这次换了电饭煲，除了时间要比高压锅久一点，但更方便操作，中途打开锅盖添加食材什么的丝毫没压力。上周末去买排骨的时候去晚了，没买到好的排骨，看着腔骨还不错，就买了些腔骨回来煮汤。
description_en: This is a soup that my eldest daughter especially likes to drink. Pork Ribs, Corn and Carrot Soup. She makes it almost every weekend. Usually she makes it with a pressure cooker. This time I switched to a rice cooker. In addition to taking a little longer than the pressure cooker, it is more convenient to operate. There is no pressure at all when opening the lid to add ingredients. I went late last weekend when I went to buy ribs. I didn't buy good ribs. I saw that the ribs were pretty good, so I bought some and made soup.
tips_zh: 做这个汤用的玉米一定要是甜玉米，这样汤里有清爽的香甜味儿，更好吃。
tips_en: The corn used to make this soup must be sweet corn, so that the soup has a refreshing sweetness and is more delicious.

steps.content_zh: 腔骨买的时候让卖肉的人帮忙剁成小块，回家后简单冲洗一下就可以了，冷水下锅，水开后去血沫；
steps.content_en: Have the butcher chop the spine bones into small pieces when you buy them; at home just rinse them briefly, put them in the pot with cold water, and skim off the blood foam once the water boils;

steps.content_zh: 腔骨去血沫，捞出沥水；
steps.content_en: Skim the foam from the spine bones, remove, and drain;

steps.content_zh: 把腔骨放进电饭煲里，注入清水，选择炖汤120分钟或者点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the cavities into the rice cooker, pour in water, choose to stew the soup for 120 minutes or click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 炖煮腔骨期间，把甜玉米、胡萝卜、苦瓜、胡萝卜都切个块状；
steps.content_en: While stewing the pork bones, cut the sweet corn, carrots, and bitter melon into chunks;

steps.content_zh: 大概在电饭煲炖汤程序进行了一小时后，把切好的玉米、胡萝卜、苦瓜都放进电饭煲里，继续炖煮1.5个小时；
steps.content_en: About an hour after the rice cooker has started the soup stewing process, put the chopped corn, carrots, and bitter melon into the rice cooker and continue to simmer for 1.5 hours;

steps.content_zh: 等电饭煲的提示音响起，就炖好了，放入少许盐调味；
steps.content_en: When the rice cooker beeps, it is done — add a little salt to season;

steps.content_zh: 装在大碗里，可以上桌开吃了；
steps.content_en: Put in a large bowl and ready to serve;

steps.content_zh: 这个汤是我家大女儿特别喜欢的一道汤，每周一炖，小朋友吃的美美的。
steps.content_en: This soup is a favorite of my eldest daughter. She stews it every Monday and the children eat it deliciously.

name_en: Red dates, longan and eight-treasure porridge
description_zh: 粥是一种日常主食，早上晚上喝点温热的粥，营养丰富又能够养胃护胃。以前煮粥都是用汤锅或砂锅，煮的时候怕溢出来，要专门一个人在旁边盯着，边煮边搅拌，比较麻烦些。现在好多了，有电饭煲帮忙，即便早餐的时候想喝份绵软浓稠的粥，也可以很简单。比如我今天分享的这款红枣桂圆八宝粥，里面放了莲子、红豆等食材，都是比较难煮的，我头一天晚上把所有的食材和水都放进电饭煲里，设置好预约时间，第二天早上起床后，等待我的就是一锅好粥。
description_en: Porridge is a daily staple food. Drink some warm porridge in the morning and evening. It is rich in nutrients and can nourish and protect the stomach. In the past, soup pots or casseroles were used to cook porridge. There was a risk of overflowing when cooking, so a dedicated person had to keep an eye on the porridge and stir it while cooking, which was more troublesome. It's much better now. With the help of a rice cooker, even if you want to drink soft and thick porridge for breakfast, it can be very simple. For example, the red dates, longan and eight-treasure porridge I shared today contains lotus seeds, red beans and other ingredients, which are relatively difficult to cook. I put all the ingredients and water into the rice cooker the night before, set the reservation time, and when I got up the next morning, a pot of good porridge was waiting for me.
tips_zh: 红枣桂圆八宝粥 营养丰富又能够养胃护胃
tips_en: Red date and longan eight-treasure porridge: nutritious and gentle on the stomach

steps.content_zh: 准备好各种食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare various ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 洗净后放进锅里；
steps.content_en: Wash and put into the pot;

steps.content_zh: 注入适量的清水；
steps.content_en: Inject appropriate amount of water;

steps.content_zh: 预约好时间，煮粥的预约时间可以在电饭煲的面板上操作，很方便，可以直观的选择几点钟煮好；我是晚上十一点多设置的，准备第二天早饭吃，所以设置了6：30分煮好；也可以在知吾煮预约也很方便；
steps.content_en: Set the timer: you can schedule porridge cooking on the rice cooker's control panel, which is convenient and lets you pick exactly when it will be ready. I set it just after 11 p.m. for breakfast the next morning, so I set it to finish at 6:30 a.m.; you can also schedule it in the Zhiwuzhu app, which is just as convenient;

steps.content_zh: 第二天早上，去厨房打开锅盖，香浓味道已经飘满房间，一觉醒来，发现有刚煮好的美味营养的八宝粥等着自己，感觉太好了；
steps.content_en: The next morning, I went to the kitchen and opened the lid of the pot. The aroma was already filling the room. When I woke up, I found that there was freshly cooked delicious and nutritious rice pudding waiting for me. It felt so good;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌一下，看看浓稠度如何，还不错吧；
steps.content_en: Stir it and see how thick it is, it's not bad;

steps.content_zh: 盛到碗里，快快上桌，早餐吃的美美的。
steps.content_en: Spoon into bowls and serve right away — enjoy a wonderful breakfast.

description_zh: 棒棒鸡丝，源于川菜，麻辣鲜香、肉质细嫩，微带酸味，很是爽口，制作起来也很简单，适合下酒和炎热季节食用。
description_en: Bang bang chicken comes from Sichuan cuisine—numbing, spicy, savory, and tender with a slight tang. It's refreshing, easy to make, and perfect with drinks or in hot weather.
tips_zh:
1、鸡胸肉煮好后敲打一下，会变得松散，很好撕
2、调味品中，精盐、辣油、麻酱等用量，可根据自己的口味增减
tips_en:
1. After the chicken breast is cooked, tap it and it will become loose and easy to tear.
2. In condiments, the amount of refined salt, spicy oil, sesame paste, etc. can be increased or decreased according to your own taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸡胸肉洗净后放入饭煲中，加入适量的水，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken breast and put it into the rice cooker, add an appropriate amount of water, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 把芝麻酱、花生碎、辣椒油、生抽、醋、白糖、精盐、姜末、蒜末调拌成味汁；
steps.content_en: Mix sesame paste, crushed peanuts, chili oil, light soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, refined salt, minced ginger, and minced garlic into a sauce;

steps.content_zh: 把煮好的鸡胸肉用擀面棍敲打至松散；
steps.content_en: Pound the cooked chicken breasts with a rolling pin until loose;

steps.content_zh: 全部撕成细丝；
steps.content_en: Tear them all into thin shreds;

steps.content_zh: 把鸡丝肉、葱丝码入盘中；
steps.content_en: Put the shredded chicken and green onions into a plate;

steps.content_zh: 淋上调好的味汁，淋香油，撒绿葱丝、黑芝麻点缀，吃的时候拌均匀即可；
steps.content_en: Pour over the prepared sauce, drizzle with sesame oil, and garnish with green onion strips and black sesame seeds; mix well before eating.

name_en: Rock sugar mung bean and amaranth soothing porridge
description_zh: 粳米可提高人体免疫力，促进血液循环，从而减少高血压的机会，还能预防糖尿病、老年斑和便秘。冰糖绿豆苋菜一起熬煮，清热解毒、生津止渴，适合夏季调理食用。
description_en: Japonica rice boosts immunity and blood circulation, lowering the risk of high blood pressure and helping prevent diabetes, age spots and constipation. Simmered with rock sugar, mung beans and amaranth, it clears heat, detoxifies and quenches thirst — ideal for summer.
tips_zh:
1、此为适合夏季的安神粥
2、绿豆要先浸泡一下，会很好熟
3、苋菜和冰糖易熟，最后放入即可
4、苋菜属于喜光的感光性蔬菜，食用后不易长时间在阳光下暴晒
tips_en:
1. A calming porridge perfect for summer.
2. Soak the mung beans first so they cook easily.
3. Amaranth and rock sugar cook quickly—add them at the end.
4. Amaranth is a photosensitive vegetable; avoid prolonged sun exposure after eating.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 把绿豆、粳米淘洗干净，绿豆清水浸泡3小时以上，粳米浸泡半小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and japonica rice, soak the mung beans in water for more than 3 hours, and soak the japonica rice for half an hour;

steps.content_zh: 锅中放入1500克的清水，放入绿豆、粳米，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put 1500 g of water in the pot, add the mung beans and japonica rice, then tap Start Cooking on the phone to cook;

steps.content_zh: 苋菜洗净，切5厘米长的段；
steps.content_en: Wash the amaranth and cut into 5 cm lengths;

steps.content_zh: 待米熟豆烂，放入苋菜和冰糖，再煮上10分钟即可；
steps.content_en: When the rice is cooked and the beans are tender, add amaranth and rock sugar, and cook for another 10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 享用吧。
steps.content_en: Enjoy.

name_en: Steamed Pork Patties with First Vegetables
description_zh: 顺德淡口头菜香脆爽口、入口清香，是粤菜食材中不可缺少的原材料，有几百年历史，随着顺德人移民至世界各地，淡口头菜也畅销省港澳及世界各地。头菜蒸肉饼是一道传统的顺德美食。
description_en: Shunde Dankou cuisine is crispy, refreshing and fragrant. It is an indispensable raw material in Cantonese cuisine. It has a history of hundreds of years. As Shunde people immigrated to all over the world, Shunde Dankou cuisine is also sold well in Hong Kong, Macao and other parts of the world. Steamed meatloaf with first vegetables is a traditional Shunde delicacy.
tips_zh:
1、头菜必须要提前浸，因为是腌制过的，不然煮出来的会好咸。
2、我在肉末中加入了一个蛋清，这样搅打后会让肉饼更Q弹爽口。
tips_en:
1. Soak the preserved mustard greens in advance—they're salted and would make the dish too salty.
2. I added one egg white to the minced pork; beating it in makes the patty bouncier.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 头菜切块后浸泡1小时；
steps.content_en: Cut the lettuce into pieces and soak for 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 将泡好水的头菜和生姜用料理机打成碎；
steps.content_en: Crush the soaked cabbage and ginger in a food processor;

steps.content_zh: 猪肉中加入头菜碎、油、生抽和一个蛋清后搅打出胶质；
steps.content_en: Add chopped cabbage, oil, light soy sauce and one egg white to the pork and beat until the gelatin is obtained;

steps.content_zh: 平铺在盘子上；
steps.content_en: Spread flat on plate;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加入水，将蒸笼放入，点击手机烹饪上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the inner pot, put in the steamer, and tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone to cook;

steps.content_zh: 完成后如果觉得味道淡还可以再加入一些生抽，撒上葱花就可享用啦~
steps.content_en: After finishing, if you feel the taste is bland, you can add some light soy sauce, sprinkle with chopped green onion and enjoy~

description_zh: 白米、糙米、菜脯和鸡蛋的組合，做好的米饭中味道丰富，打开锅盖的一瞬间香味四溢。
description_en: White rice, brown rice, preserved radish, and eggs make a richly flavored dish; the moment you open the lid, the aroma fills the air.
tips_zh: 如果觉得这样做有鸡蛋的腥味，也可以将鸡蛋炒好后再拌入饭中，一样的美味。
tips_en: If you feel that this method has a fishy smell from eggs, you can also stir-fry the eggs and then mix them into the rice. It will be just as delicious.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大蒜切成蒜末；
steps.content_en: Chop the garlic into minced pieces;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅中放入少许油，烧热后放入蒜末，炒香；
steps.content_en: Heat a little oil in a pan, add the minced garlic, and stir-fry until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 放入菜脯碎、白砂糖和胡麻油炒香；
steps.content_en: Add chopped preserved vegetables, white sugar and sesame oil and stir-fry until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 炒好的菜脯；
steps.content_en: Stir-fried preserved radish;

steps.content_zh: 白米和糙米洗净后放入饭煲中，加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度；加入炒好的菜脯，搅拌均匀后，可以在App中选择糙米饭，或者直接点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the white rice and brown rice and put them into the rice cooker. Add water to the water level line: Northeast rice -3 mark; add the fried preserved vegetables and stir evenly. You can select brown rice in the App or directly click on the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪快要结束時把鸡蛋打成蛋液；
steps.content_en: Near the end of cooking, beat the eggs;

steps.content_zh: 听到结束提示音后，将鸡蛋液倒入米饭中搅拌均匀后继续保温10分钟；
steps.content_en: After hearing the end tone, pour the egg liquid into the rice, stir evenly, and continue to keep warm for 10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用美食吧。
steps.content_en: Let’s start enjoying the food.

description_zh: 粽子，是端午节汉族的传统节日食品，由粽叶包裹糯米蒸制而成。传说是为纪念屈原而流传的，是中国历史上文化积淀最深厚的传统食品。每年五月初，中国百姓家家都要浸糯米、洗粽叶、包粽子。如今粽子的附加料多种多样，豆沙，猪肉，松子，红枣等，品种更是丰富多彩。
description_en: Zongzi is a traditional Dragon Boat Festival food of the Han Chinese: glutinous rice wrapped in zong leaves and steamed. Legend says it honors Qu Yuan, and it has the deepest cultural roots of any traditional Chinese food. Every early May, Chinese families soak glutinous rice, wash zong leaves and wrap zongzi. Today the fillings vary widely — red bean paste, pork, pine nuts, red dates — for an endless variety.
tips_zh:
1.糯米和五花肉多腌制几小时入味更好吃。
2.最好是肥瘦肉都要，只有瘦的太干口感不好。
3.不要包的太多，糯米煮好后会膨胀。
tips_en:
1. The glutinous rice and pork belly will taste better if they are marinated for a few hours.
2. It is best to have both fat and lean meat. Only the lean meat will taste bad if it is too dry.
3. Don’t wrap too much, as the glutinous rice will expand after cooking.

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前一夜浸泡，滤干水分，粽叶提前用水煮沸后浸泡；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice overnight and drain; boil the zong leaves in water in advance and soak them;

steps.content_zh: 糯米里加入盐，生抽，老抽，搅拌均匀，腌制4小时入味；
steps.content_en: Add salt, light soy sauce, and dark soy sauce to the glutinous rice, mix well, and marinate for 4 hours to add flavor;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉里加入蚝油，生抽，酱油，五香粉，盐，生姜，搅拌均匀，五花肉腌制4小时入味；
steps.content_en: Add oyster sauce, light soy sauce, soy sauce, five-spice powder, salt, and ginger to the pork belly, stir well, and marinate the pork belly for 4 hours to add flavor;

steps.content_zh: 粽叶卷成一个筒状(有毛边的一面面对面贴在一起)；
steps.content_en: Roll the zong leaves into a tube (put the sides with the rough edges facing each other);

steps.content_zh: 放一点糯米压实，放上板栗和腌渍好的五花肉；
steps.content_en: Put a little glutinous rice to compact, top with chestnuts and marinated pork belly;

steps.content_zh: 最上面铺一层糯米压实；
steps.content_en: Top with a layer of glutinous rice and press down firmly;

steps.content_zh: 盖上叶子；
steps.content_en: Cover with leaves;

steps.content_zh: 用绳子扎紧；
steps.content_en: Tie tightly with rope;

steps.content_zh: 冷水下锅，加水没过粽子即可，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour cold water into the pot and add water to cover the rice dumplings. Click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 将煮好的粽子放入冷水中静置，拔凉。此处是为了让粽子抱团成型。然后就可以享用啦~
steps.content_en: Put the cooked rice dumplings into cold water and let them cool. This is to make the rice dumplings form into a ball. Then you can enjoy it~

description_zh: 北方粽子的代表红枣粽子。枣粽子，不但形状美观，香甜可口，而且还有滋养强身之效。年老体弱者常吃枣粽子，能健脾胃，强筋骨。
description_en: The representative of northern rice dumplings is red date rice dumplings. Date rice dumplings are not only beautiful in shape, sweet and delicious, but also nourishing and strengthening the body. The elderly and infirm often eat jujube rice dumplings, which can strengthen the spleen and stomach and strengthen the muscles and bones.
tips_zh:
1、红枣切丁去核，方便老人和孩子食用；
2、缠棉线时，一定要缠紧；
3、开吃粽子时，喜欢加糖的，包开粽子时撒一层糖即可使用。
tips_en:
1. Dice and pit the red dates so they're easy for kids and seniors to eat.
2. Wrap the cotton thread tightly.
3. If you like sugar with your zongzi, sprinkle some on when you unwrap it.

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前浸泡一夜，滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice overnight and drain;

steps.content_zh: 红枣泡发；
steps.content_en: Soak the red dates until soft;

steps.content_zh: 粽叶用水煮沸后浸泡5分钟，过凉水；卷成一个筒状；
steps.content_en: Boil the zong leaves in water, soak for 5 minutes, rinse in cold water, then roll into a tube;

steps.content_zh: 在底部放一些糯米，放上两个浸泡好的红枣；
steps.content_en: Put some glutinous rice on the bottom and two soaked red dates;

steps.content_zh: 再放上糯米压紧；
steps.content_en: Then add glutinous rice and press tightly;

steps.content_zh: 盖上叶子；
steps.content_en: Cover with leaves;

steps.content_zh: 用绳子扎紧；
steps.content_en: Tie tightly with rope;

steps.content_zh: 冷水下锅，加水没过粽子即可，点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour cold water into the pot, add water to cover the rice dumplings, and click to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 将煮好的粽子放入冷水中静置，拔凉。此处是为了让粽子抱团成型。然后就可以享用啦~提前祝大家端午节快乐。
steps.content_en: Put the cooked rice dumplings into cold water and let them cool. This is to make the rice dumplings form into a ball. Then you can enjoy it~ I wish everyone a happy Dragon Boat Festival in advance.

description_zh: 漫画中奢华的乌冬面，总是让人垂涎欲滴。看似复杂，一碗热腾腾的豚骨海鲜乌冬面其实只要十几分钟就做好了！
description_en: The lavish udon in manga always makes your mouth water. Despite looking complex, a steaming bowl of tonkotsu seafood udon takes just over ten minutes to make!
tips_zh:
1、豚骨汁是可以在大的超市里买到的；和清水的比例为10：1；
2、食材可以根据个人喜好放入，如：金针菇、肥牛、鲜虾等；
3、乌冬面要在拆包装后用清水冲洗干净表面的面粉。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料和豚骨汁；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients and tonkotsu juice;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：稠粥-½的刻度，放入豚骨汁搅拌均匀后点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level: thick porridge - ½ mark, add the tonkotsu juice and mix well, then click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 约八分钟后水烧开沸腾；放入除了蟹柳和叉烧肉以外的食材，进行焖煮；
steps.content_en: After about eight minutes, the water will boil; add the ingredients except crab sticks and barbecued pork and simmer;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后捞出，再摆上日式叉烧肉和蟹柳，一碗乳白色汤汁的豚骨乌冬面就做好了。
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, take it out, add Japanese barbecued pork and crab sticks, and a bowl of tonkotsu udon noodles with milky white soup is ready.

description_zh: 爱吃肉又想清淡，还要兼顾营养，同时要易于上手，冬瓜排骨汤，再合适不过的简单家常靓汤！
description_en: If you love meat but want something light, nutritious, and easy to make, winter melon rib soup is the perfect simple home-style dish!
tips_zh:
1、不要一开始就放盐；
2、滴一点点醋可以除去猪肉的腥气，醋味慢慢的散去了之后很提香呢。
tips_en:
1. Don't add salt at the beginning.
2. A few drops of vinegar remove the pork's gamey smell; once the vinegar aroma fades, it enhances the flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 仔排洗净，剁成小块，大葱切断，姜切片；
steps.content_en: Wash the pork chops, chop into small pieces, cut the green onions, and slice the ginger;

steps.content_zh: 将躲好的仔排焯水，水开后再煮几分钟直到血沫变为白色；
steps.content_en: Blanch the hidden pork chops. After the water boils, cook for a few minutes until the blood foam turns white;

steps.content_zh: 将焯水后的仔排用温水洗净血沫，放入锅中，放入葱段、姜片、八角、料酒；
steps.content_en: Wash the blanched pork chops with warm water to remove any blood foam, put them into a pot, add green onion slices, ginger slices, star anise and cooking wine;

steps.content_zh: 加水到水位线稠粥1刻度；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the water level line to thicken the porridge 1 mark; click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜洗净去皮切片，香菜和香葱洗净切碎备用；
steps.content_en: Wash, peel and slice the winter melon, wash and chop the coriander and chives and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入冬瓜（此时可根据个人喜好加入粉丝，菌类等）和胡椒粉，继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: With 30 minutes left, add the winter melon (you can also add glass noodles or mushrooms to taste) and pepper, and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，根据个人口感加入适当的鸡精、盐和芝麻油调味，撒上香葱，香菜即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, add appropriate chicken essence, salt and sesame oil for seasoning according to personal taste, and sprinkle with chives and coriander.

name_en: Mung bean and lily bulb porridge
description_zh: 绿豆和百合放在一起具有很强的清热解暑的功效。绿豆是夏令饮食中的上品，能清热消暑，利尿解毒。若与百合搭配在一起煮，那就是夏季的绝配。
description_en: Mung beans and lily bulbs together are excellent for clearing heat and relieving summer heat. Mung beans are a top summer food, clearing heat, relieving summer heat, promoting urination and detoxifying. Cooked with lily bulbs, they are a perfect summer pairing.
tips_zh:
1、冰糖的量可以根据个人的口味调整。
2、可以冷藏后食用，更清爽。
tips_en:
1. Adjust the rock sugar to taste.
2. Chill before serving for a more refreshing result.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 绿豆和粥米洗净浸泡3-4小时；干百合浸泡1小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and porridge rice and soak for 3-4 hours; soak the dried lily bulbs for 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 将浸泡好的粥米和绿豆一起放入锅中，加水到水位线：稠-1的刻度，可点击煮粥90分钟或者点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the soaked porridge rice and mung beans into the pot together, add water to the water level line: thick-1 scale, you can click to cook the porridge for 90 minutes or click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入冰糖与浸泡好的百合，继续焖煮到结束；
steps.content_en: When 30 minutes remain in the cooking time, add rock sugar and soaked lilies and continue to simmer until the end;

steps.content_zh: 夏日炎炎的晚上来一碗，然后睡个好觉。
steps.content_en: Have a bowl on a hot summer night and have a good night's sleep.

description_zh:
银鱼营养价值极高，又被称作“鱼中人参”。具有补肾增阳、祛虚活血，益脾润肺等功效，是上等滋养补品。并且还具有高蛋白、低脂肪的特点，基本没有大鱼刺，适宜小孩子食用。
银鱼蒸蛋这道菜，入口滑嫩，味道鲜美，做法也特别简单。
description_en: Icefish is extremely nutritious and is known as the 'ginseng of fish.' It tonifies the kidneys and boosts yang, dispels deficiency and invigorates blood, benefits the spleen and moistens the lungs - a top-grade nourishing tonic. It is also high in protein and low in fat, with virtually no large bones, making it suitable for children. Steamed egg with icefish is smooth and tender, delicious, and very simple to make.
tips_zh:
1、蛋液过滤一下，可以使蒸出来的鸡蛋糕口感细腻滑嫩
2、银鱼放早了会沉底，所以最后放会好看点
tips_en:
1. Strain the beaten egg for a silky, smooth steamed egg custard.
2. Ice fish sink if added too early, so add them last for a nicer look.

steps.content_zh: 备好所需食材;
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银鱼中加入料酒、少许盐、白胡椒粉拌匀腌制片刻;
steps.content_en: Add cooking wine, a little salt and white pepper to the icefish, mix well and marinate briefly;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋打散后加入清水，鸡蛋液和水的比列是1：1.5;
steps.content_en: Beat the eggs and add water at a 1:1.5 egg-to-water ratio;

steps.content_zh: 把蛋液过滤一遍;
steps.content_en: Strain the egg liquid once;

steps.content_zh: 加点盐调味;
steps.content_en: Add some salt to taste;

steps.content_zh: 再加入一半的银鱼混合均匀;
steps.content_en: Add half of the whitebait and mix well;

steps.content_zh: 盖上保鲜膜放进电饭煲蒸笼里，保鲜膜上用牙签扎几个孔，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Cover with plastic wrap and place in the rice cooker steamer; poke a few holes in the wrap with a toothpick, then tap Start Cooking on your phone;

steps.content_zh: 蒸至鸡蛋凝固后，放入剩下的银鱼再继续蒸5分钟即可；
steps.content_en: Once the egg has set, add the remaining icefish and steam for another 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好取出后倒入味极鲜、芝麻油，最后撒点葱花就可以享用了；
steps.content_en: When done, remove and add soy sauce and sesame oil, then sprinkle with chopped scallion to serve;

description_zh: 酸菜鱼也称为酸汤鱼，是一道源自重庆的经典菜品，酸菜鱼以草鱼为主料，配以泡菜等食材煮制而成，口味酸辣可口。
description_en: Pickled fish, also called sour soup fish, is a classic from Chongqing. Made with grass carp and pickled vegetables, it's hot and sour and delicious.
tips_zh:
1.调料包超市有卖，里面已经有酸菜了，不喜欢太多酸菜可以用豆芽放在酸菜鱼下面煮
2.如果只用调料包，不放更多酸菜或者豆芽，放少点水
tips_en:
1. Seasoning packs are sold in supermarkets and already contain sauerkraut. If you don’t like too much sauerkraut, you can use bean sprouts and cook them under the sauerkraut fish.
2. If you only use the seasoning packet, do not add more sauerkraut or bean sprouts, but add less water.

steps.content_zh: 准备好材料
steps.content_en: Prepare materials

steps.content_zh: 将鱼切片放入料酒以及上汤酸菜鱼调味料里的腌鱼包，搅拌腌制15分钟
steps.content_en: Add the fish slices to the marinated fish buns mixed with cooking wine and pickled fish seasoning, stir and marinate for 15 minutes

steps.content_zh: 加入东北米3刻度的水，烧开
steps.content_en: Add 3 meters of water from Northeast China and bring to a boil

steps.content_zh: 切好酸菜用油炒一炒
steps.content_en: Chop the sauerkraut and fry in oil

steps.content_zh: 烧好开水后，加入上汤酸菜鱼调味料以及炒好的酸菜煮5分钟
steps.content_en: Once the water boils, add the premium pickled fish seasoning and the stir-fried pickled cabbage, and cook for 5 minutes

steps.content_zh: 加入腌制好的鱼，煮至发白，然后盛出
steps.content_en: Add the marinated fish, cook until white, then serve

steps.content_zh: 将干辣椒以及花椒用油爆香
steps.content_en: Sauté the dried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns in oil until fragrant

steps.content_zh: 将爆香的油倒入酸菜鱼
steps.content_en: Pour the fried oil into the pickled fish

steps.content_zh: 放入香菜，就可以下饭了
steps.content_en: Add coriander and it’s ready to serve

description_zh: 外表呆萌，口感香甜，太可爱了。
description_en: It looks cute, tastes sweet, and is so cute.
tips_zh: 如果没有自发粉，可以用500克中筋面粉加上5克酵母，发酵戳馒头一下不回弹的状态。
tips_en: If you don’t have self-rising flour, you can use 500 grams of all-purpose flour and 5 grams of yeast to ferment the buns until they don’t spring back when poked.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 自发粉加入300克温水搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en: Add 300 g of warm water to the self-rising flour and stir until smooth.

steps.content_zh: 把絮装的面块反复揉，揉至表面光滑；
steps.content_en: Knead the stuffed dough repeatedly until the surface is smooth;

steps.content_zh: 把光滑的面团放进容器，并盖上保鲜膜发酵；
steps.content_en: Put the smooth dough into a container and cover with plastic wrap to ferment;

steps.content_zh: 发酵的时候把豆沙分成大小均匀的陷团；
steps.content_en: During fermentation, divide the bean paste into evenly sized lumps;

steps.content_zh: 大约20分钟左右面会发酵成两倍的大小。将面团揉成长条状；
steps.content_en: In about 20 minutes the dough will double in size. Knead it into a long strip.

steps.content_zh: 然后分成大小均匀的面团；
steps.content_en: Then divide into evenly sized dough portions;

steps.content_zh: 将面团压扁，直至能包住馅料；
steps.content_en: Flatten the dough until it can cover the filling;

steps.content_zh: 将馅料包裹在面皮中；
steps.content_en: Wrap filling in dough;

steps.content_zh: 用玉米粒和芝麻塑造形象；
steps.content_en: Shape the details with corn kernels and sesame seeds;

steps.content_zh: 将包好的豆沙包放入垫有纱布或者油纸蒸屉；锅内加水到水位线：东北米-2，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标开始蒸制；
steps.content_en: Place the wrapped red bean paste buns into a steamer lined with gauze or oil paper; add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice - 2, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start steaming;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好了的样子；
steps.content_en: How it looks when done;

steps.content_zh: 萌萌哒~
steps.content_en: So cute~

description_zh: 萌萌的小南瓜，口感微甜不腻，造型可爱。
description_en: This cute little pumpkin is slightly sweet, not greasy, and adorably shaped.
tips_zh:
1、每种南瓜的含水量不同，所以在揉面团的时候可以根据当前的情况自行增加或者减少糯米粉的量；
2、做完后要记得刷油不然粘手，要用没有味道的油比如玉米油。
3、生的南瓜除了蒸熟还可以用微波炉打熟。
tips_en:
1. Pumpkins vary in water content, so adjust the glutinous rice flour as you knead.
2. Remember to brush with oil when done, or it will stick to your hands—use a neutral oil like corn oil.
3. Raw pumpkin can also be cooked in the microwave instead of steamed.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 南瓜入蒸笼中蒸熟后滤掉水分打成泥，再次过滤多余水分；
steps.content_en: Steam the pumpkin in a steamer, filter out the water and puree it, then filter out the excess water again;

steps.content_zh: 将糯米粉、玉米淀粉、白砂糖和南瓜泥混合油揉成光滑的面团；（因为每种南瓜的含水量不同，所以制作过程中适当的增添糯米粉和水）
steps.content_en: Knead glutinous rice flour, cornstarch, white sugar and pumpkin puree mixed with oil into a smooth dough; (because each type of pumpkin has different water content, add glutinous rice flour and water appropriately during the production process)

steps.content_zh: 分成6个小团子，揉搓光滑；
steps.content_en: Divide into 6 small balls and knead until smooth;

steps.content_zh: 用牙签在顶部按下痕迹；
steps.content_en: Use a toothpick to press marks on top;

steps.content_zh: 然后继续用牙签在侧面压出南瓜的形状；
steps.content_en: Then continue using the toothpick to press out the shape of the pumpkin on the side;

steps.content_zh: 用枸杞压在顶部当做南瓜藤；锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，蒸笼中放上油纸将做好的南瓜放入，入锅蒸20分钟；
steps.content_en: Press a goji berry on top as the pumpkin vine; add water to the inner pot to the 'Northeast rice - 2' level, line the steamer with parchment, place the pumpkins in, and steam for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 完成后在表面刷上少许玉米油防止粘黏，口感微甜不腻。
steps.content_en: After finishing, brush a little corn oil on the surface to prevent sticking, and the taste will be slightly sweet but not greasy.

name_en: Rose and Milky Chinese Yam Puree
description_zh:
玫瑰花味甘微苦、性温，最明显的功效就是理气解郁、活血散淤和调经止痛。此外，玫瑰花的药性非常温和，能够温养人的心肝血脉，舒发体内郁气，起到镇静、安抚、抗抑郁的功效。
玫瑰花即可入药又可入菜，这款玫瑰山药泥，将玫瑰花融入到山药中，不仅增加了营养和颜值，还提升了整个菜肴的味道。山药泥入口绵糯、香甜，非常不错。
description_en:
Roses are sweet, slightly bitter, and warm in nature. Their most obvious effects are regulating qi and relieving depression, activating blood circulation and dispersing blood stasis, regulating menstruation and relieving pain. In addition, roses have very mild medicinal properties, which can warm the heart, liver, and blood vessels, relieve depression in the body, and have calming, soothing, and anti-depressant effects.
Roses can be used both as medicine and in dishes. This rose yam puree incorporates roses into the yam, which not only increases nutrition and appearance, but also enhances the taste of the entire dish. The yam paste is glutinous and sweet in the mouth, which is very good.
tips_zh: 没有炼乳，可以换成白糖，甜度可根据自己口味来放
tips_en: If you don't have condensed milk, use sugar instead, adjusting sweetness to taste.

steps.content_zh: 备好所需食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将山药去皮切片，放入电饭煲中蒸制30分钟；
steps.content_en: Peel and slice the yam, put it into a rice cooker and steam for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 在蒸山药期间，可以把玫瑰花茶掰成碎片备用；
steps.content_en: While steaming the yam, you can break the rose tea into pieces and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 山药蒸到能用筷子轻松扎透就可以了；
steps.content_en: Steam the yam until it can be easily pierced with chopsticks;

steps.content_zh: 用勺子把山药碾压成泥状，再倒入玫瑰花碎；
steps.content_en: Mash the yam into a puree with a spoon, then add the crushed rose petals;

steps.content_zh: 放入炼乳搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Add condensed milk and mix well;

steps.content_zh: 将拌匀的山药泥装进裱花袋中；
steps.content_en: Put the mixed yam puree into a piping bag;

steps.content_zh: 挤出自己喜欢的形状即可。
steps.content_en: Pipe into whatever shape you like.

description_zh: 你还在犹豫是不是要排队等待购买网红肉松蛋糕吗?赶紧放弃这个念头，自己动手丰衣足食。
description_en: Are you still hesitating whether to wait in line to buy Internet celebrity meat floss cake? Quickly give up this idea and make enough food and clothing by yourself.
tips_zh:
1、装蛋清的容器要无油、无水、无蛋黄。
2、打发蛋清的时候可以滴上两滴柠檬汁或者白醋有利于打发。
tips_en:
1. The bowl for egg whites must be free of oil, water, and yolk.
2. Add two drops of lemon juice or white vinegar to help the whites whip.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄与蛋清分离；
steps.content_en: Separate the yolk from the white;

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中加入牛奶、玉米油、筛入低筋粉；
steps.content_en: Add milk and corn oil to the yolk, then sift in low-gluten flour;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 将蛋清打发，并在打发的过程中分三次加入白砂糖，蛋清要打到干性发泡状态，出现拉起后有直立不弯曲的小角；
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites, and add the sugar in three batches during the beating process. The egg whites should be beaten until they are in a dry foamy state, with small corners that stand upright and are not bent when pulled up;

steps.content_zh: 分三次取蛋白拌入蛋黄面糊中，翻拌时注意不能画圈，要无规则的翻版；
steps.content_en: Take the egg whites and mix them into the egg yolk batter in three batches. When mixing, be careful not to make circles, but to make irregular folds;

steps.content_zh: 将翻拌均匀的面糊加入锅胆，然后轻轻磕几下，去掉表面的气泡；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烘焙；
steps.content_en: Add the evenly mixed batter to the pot, then tap it gently a few times to remove air bubbles on the surface; click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start baking;

steps.content_zh: 蛋糕烘焙好的样子；
steps.content_en: How the cake looks when baked;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后等蛋糕温度降下来以后将蛋糕从中间片开，八等分；
steps.content_en: After the cake is out of the pan, wait until the temperature of the cake has cooled down. Slice the cake from the middle and divide it into eight equal parts;

steps.content_zh: 取一片蛋糕涂上沙拉酱，然后再扣上一片蛋糕，并将蛋糕四周全都涂上沙拉酱；
steps.content_en: Take a piece of cake and spread it with salad dressing, then put another piece of cake on top and spread the salad dressing all around the cake;

steps.content_zh: 将涂满沙拉酱的蛋糕放到肉松中来回翻滚，让其粘满肉松；
steps.content_en: Place the cake coated with salad dressing in the meat floss and roll it back and forth to coat it with meat floss;

steps.content_zh: 和外面买的一模一样的，而且更安全放心，享用吧。
steps.content_en: It’s exactly the same as what you buy outside, and it’s safer and more secure. Enjoy it.

name_en: Black rice and honeycomb charcoal rice
description_zh: 白米饭吃多了，想换换花样，看到家里还有不少黑米，就想着做个好玩的煤球饭。
description_en: I ate too much white rice and wanted to change my style. When I saw there was a lot of black rice at home, I thought of making a fun briquette rice.
tips_zh: 黑米和糯米比较难煮，所以煮之前要充分浸泡。
tips_en: Black rice and glutinous rice are more difficult to cook, so soak them thoroughly before cooking.

steps.content_zh: 准备黑米和白糯米，也可以全部都用黑米，提前浸泡半天或者可以前一天晚上洗净后浸泡；
steps.content_en: Prepare black rice and white glutinous rice. You can also use all black rice. Soak it for half a day in advance or wash it the night before and soak it;

steps.content_zh: 将白米和黑米放入锅中，由于浸泡后的糯米和黑米吸水能力不强，所以加水稍微没过大米即可；
