steps.content_en: Put the white rice and black rice into the pot. Since soaked glutinous rice and black rice do not absorb water very well, add water to slightly cover the rice;

steps.content_zh: 放入古法红糖，浸泡半小时，把锅里的米搅拌一下，让红糖汁渗入到每一粒米中；
steps.content_en: Add traditional brown sugar and soak 30 minutes, stirring the rice so the syrup soaks into every grain.

steps.content_zh: 点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标就进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 时间到后，一锅香喷喷的黑米饭就做好了；
steps.content_en: When the time is up, a pot of fragrant black rice is ready;

steps.content_zh: 取一个蛋糕模具，我用的是6寸蛋糕模，把黑米饭装到模具里，如果模具会粘，请在模具上抹层油以后再装米饭，并用饭勺把米饭压实；
steps.content_en: Take a cake mold, I use a 6-inch cake mold, and put the black rice into the mold. If the mold is sticky, please apply a layer of oil on the mold before filling it with rice, and use a rice spoon to compact the rice;

steps.content_zh: 压实以后，倒扣在盘子里，这样一个圆形的米饭胚子就出来了；
steps.content_en: After compacting, turn it upside down on a plate so that a round rice embryo comes out;

steps.content_zh: 筷子沾水，在米饭上扎出小孔，扎一个孔后再沾水，再去扎下一个孔，这样不沾筷子，一个甜甜的煤球饭就做好了。
steps.content_en: Dip the chopsticks in water and poke small holes in the rice, dipping again between each hole so they do not stick. Your sweet "coal ball" rice is ready.

description_zh: 醋椒豆腐作为天津夜市中十分常见的一种小吃，也是天津特有的砂锅，里面含有豆腐、鸡蛋、火腿、木耳、粉丝等，口味微酸微辣，十分美味。
description_en: Vinegar-pepper tofu is a common Tianjin night-market snack and local claypot dish, with tofu, egg, ham, wood ear mushrooms and glass noodles in a mildly sour, spicy broth.
tips_zh: 使用的醋最好为独流老醋，如果没有可以用陈醋代替。
tips_en: The best vinegar to use is old vinegar. If it is not available, you can use mature vinegar instead.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 木耳加水泡发；
steps.content_en: Soak the dried wood ear mushrooms in water until rehydrated;

steps.content_zh: 豆腐切片，泡发的木耳、火腿、蟹足棒、葱、姜切丝，香菜切碎备用；
steps.content_en: Slice the tofu, shred the soaked fungus, ham, crab sticks, green onion and ginger, chop the coriander and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的豆腐、木耳和粉丝一起放入锅胆；
steps.content_en: Put the cut tofu, fungus and vermicelli into the pot;

steps.content_zh: 加入排骨汤（可用水代替）至水位线稠粥1的刻度，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add pork rib soup (can be replaced with water) to the water level line of thick porridge 1, click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 淀粉加水做成水淀粉备用，鸡蛋打散备用；
steps.content_en: Mix starch with water into a slurry and set aside; beat the egg and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余8分钟时开盖加入水淀粉，淋入鸡蛋，边淋边搅拌；
steps.content_en: When 8 minutes remain, open the lid, add a cornstarch slurry and drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring;

steps.content_zh: 然后放入切好的葱丝、姜丝、火腿丝和蟹足棒；
steps.content_en: Then add the shredded scallion, ginger, ham, and crab sticks;

steps.content_zh: 根据个人口味加入盐、醋、胡椒、香油，然后撒上香菜，一锅香喷喷的醋椒豆腐煲就做好啦~
steps.content_en: Add salt, vinegar, pepper, and sesame oil to taste, then sprinkle with cilantro—a fragrant pot of vinegar-pepper tofu stew is ready~

description_zh: 夏天来临，各种的海鲜也开始上市，价格也不贵。海鲜的鲜甜素来深入人心，与粉丝或面条煮为汤时更能百分百品尝到海鲜的纯粹滋味。
description_en: Summer brings all kinds of seafood to market at reasonable prices. Its natural sweetness is always a hit, and when cooked in soup with cellophane noodles, you taste the pure essence of the sea.
tips_zh: 蛏子和蛤蜊煮之前要在盐水中浸泡，让其充分吐沙。
tips_en: Soak razor clams and clams in salted water before cooking to purge the sand.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 海鲜洗净，蛏子、花蛤洗净后用清水浸泡4小时以上，然后再冲洗干净，大虾先去除沙线再洗净；
steps.content_en: Wash the seafood; soak the razor clams and clams in clean water for at least 4 hours, then rinse again; devein the prawns before washing;

steps.content_zh: 圆白菜切块；
steps.content_en: Cut cabbage into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切丝；
steps.content_en: Shred ginger;

steps.content_zh: 将花蛤、蛏子、姜丝一起放入锅胆，加适量料酒和生姜；
steps.content_en: Put clams, razor clams and shredded ginger into the pot together, add appropriate amount of cooking wine and ginger;

steps.content_zh: 加入排骨汤（可用水代替）至水位线：稠粥1的刻度；
steps.content_en: Add pork rib soup (can be replaced with water) to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余15分钟时加入圆白菜、粉丝和大虾；
steps.content_en: When 15 minutes remain, add cabbage, glass noodles and large shrimp;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后根据个人口味加入盐、鸡精、胡椒粉调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, add salt, chicken bouillon, and pepper to taste.

description_zh: 又是一年高考，做个状元及第粥，愿广大学子都能高中状元。状元及第粥是广东省传统小吃之一，起源于明朝，据传与岭南才子伦文叙苦读后高中状元有关。或许一碗小小的粥并不具有让你具有高中状元的魔力，但这其中蕴含的意义却是我们无法忽略的。闲暇之时，不如配上这一碗小小的粥，携着这粥的美好寓意，学海无涯不妨苦中作乐。
description_en: It’s another year of college entrance examination. I want to be the number one scholar and pass the exam. I hope all students can be the number one scholar in high school. Zhuangyuanjidi porridge is one of the traditional snacks in Guangdong Province. It originated in the Ming Dynasty. It is said to be related to Lun Wenxu, a talented scholar from Lingnan who studied hard and became the number one scholar in high school. Maybe a small bowl of porridge does not have the magic power to make you the top student in high school, but the meaning contained in it is something we cannot ignore. In your spare time, why not pair it with this small bowl of porridge. With the beautiful meaning of this porridge, you can learn endlessly and enjoy the hardships.
tips_zh: 喜欢吃嫩一点的猪肝和腰花的话，可以在烹饪最后30分钟时放入，然后焖煮熟。
tips_en: If you like tenderer pork liver and kidneys, you can add them in the last 30 minutes of cooking and then simmer until cooked through.

steps.content_zh: 猪心、肝洗净切片，猪肚洗净切片，猪肠洗净切小段，猪腰洗净去除腰骚切花刀后切块；
steps.content_en: Wash and slice the pork heart and liver, wash and slice the pork tripe, wash and cut the pork intestines into short sections, and wash the pork kidneys, remove the odor, score them, and cut into pieces;

steps.content_zh: 小葱、香菜和油条切碎，生姜切丝；
steps.content_en: Chop shallots, coriander and fried dough sticks, and shred ginger;

steps.content_zh: 将洗净切好的猪杂加入适当姜丝、盐、耗油、料酒调匀后腌制30分钟以上；
steps.content_en: Add appropriate amount of shredded ginger, salt, oil and cooking wine to the washed and cut pork offal, mix thoroughly and marinate for more than 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 将腌制好的猪杂焯水，水开后再煮5分钟，煮出血沫；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pickled pork offal, boil the water for 5 minutes, and cook until the blood foams;

steps.content_zh: 将焯好的猪杂捞出，用温水洗净剩余血沫，焯猪杂的汤去除血沫，取净汤与猪杂一起放入锅胆；
steps.content_en: Take out the blanched pork offal, wash the remaining blood foam with warm water, remove the blood foam from the soup used to blanch the pork offal, put the clean soup into the pot together with the pig offal;

steps.content_zh: 放入洗净的大米，加水到水位线稠粥1的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add the washed rice, fill with water to the thick porridge 1 level and tap Start Cooking on the phone.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，可根据个人口味加入盐、胡椒粉、耗油调味。最后加入切好的油条，撒上香葱和香菜；
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt, pepper, and oyster sauce to taste. Finally, add the cut youtiao (fried dough sticks) and sprinkle with scallion and cilantro;

description_zh: 乌饭又称黑饭，江南一带地方民间风俗小吃，用乌叶捣成汁混入米饭中制成，米的颜色是蓝色。乌树嫩叶取汁制成的乌饭兼具有轻身明目，黑发驻颜，延年益寿的功效。
description_en: Wu fan (black rice cake) is a folk snack from the Jiangnan region, made by pounding leaves into juice and mixing it with rice, turning the grains blue. Made with juice from tender leaves, it's believed to lighten the body, sharpen vision, darken hair, preserve youth and prolong life.
tips_zh: 浸泡的糯米，刚开始浸泡进去的时候，要搓下。
tips_en: When you first put the glutinous rice in to soak, rub it a bit.

steps.content_zh: 把新鲜的乌叶清洗干净；
steps.content_en: Wash the fresh black leaves;

steps.content_zh: 用榨汁机取其汁水；
steps.content_en: Extract the juice with a juicer;

steps.content_zh: 把糯米浸泡在乌叶的汁水里，可以适当的加点大米；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice in the juice of the black leaves, and you can add some rice appropriately;

steps.content_zh: 经过一晚上的浸泡，米已经变得很黑了；
steps.content_en: After soaking overnight, the rice has turned very dark;

steps.content_zh: 用水冲洗干净；
steps.content_en: Rinse clean with water;

steps.content_zh: 清洗干净的乌米，稍微要比之前的白点了，变得灰黑了；
steps.content_en: The cleaned urmi is slightly whiter than before, and has turned gray and black;

steps.content_zh: 把乌米放入电饭煲的内胆中，加入适量的水，因为浸泡过米的吸水能力已经变差，所以加水稍稍没过大米即可，开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the black rice into the inner pot of the rice cooker, add an appropriate amount of water, because the water absorption capacity of soaked rice has become worse, so add water to slightly cover the rice, and start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 程序结束，是不是乌黑发亮的，乌米饭就做好了；
steps.content_en: At the end of the process, if it is black and shiny, the black rice is ready;

steps.content_zh: 粘点红糖，超级好吃。
steps.content_en: Dip in a little brown sugar — super delicious.

name_en: Steamed Scallops with Garlic & Glass Noodles
description_zh: 粉丝扇贝配蒜蓉真是太搭了，爱辣的再放点小米辣，海鲜的鲜中有丝丝辣味，就像性情温柔的姑娘有时候犯点小爆脾气也是蛮可爱的。
description_en: Glass noodles, scallops and garlic are a perfect match; add some bird's eye chili if you like it spicy. The seafood's freshness with a hint of heat is like a gentle girl who sometimes shows a little temper — quite endearing.
tips_zh:
1、如果没有蒸鱼豉油可以用生抽代替；
2、加入白糖是为了提鲜；
3、炒蒜蓉的时候一点要小火慢慢炒，大火容易将蒜蓉炒糊。
tips_en:
1. If you don't have steamed fish soy sauce, use light soy sauce instead.
2. The sugar enhances the umami.
3. Fry the minced garlic over low heat—high heat will scorch it.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 扇贝洗净去除裙边；
steps.content_en: Wash the scallops and remove the skirt;

steps.content_zh: 大蒜去皮切成末、生姜切末、小葱切成葱花、指天椒切成圈；
steps.content_en: Peel and mince the garlic, mince the ginger, cut the shallots into finely chopped green onions, and cut the chili padi into rings;

steps.content_zh: 龙口粉丝在冷水中浸泡30分钟，泡软；
steps.content_en: Soak Longkou vermicelli in cold water for 30 minutes until soft;

steps.content_zh: 调料用的是和海鲜更搭配的蒸鱼豉油；
steps.content_en: Use fish steaming soy sauce, which pairs well with seafood;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热后转小火放入食用油，可以多一点油，放入姜末、蒜末和条甜椒炒香；
steps.content_en: Heat the pan, reduce to low heat, and add cooking oil (a little more is fine). Stir-fry the minced ginger, garlic, and bell pepper strips until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸鱼豉油、料酒和白糖调味，煮沸后关火；
steps.content_en: Add steamed fish soy sauce, cooking wine and sugar to taste, bring to a boil and then turn off the heat;

steps.content_zh: 放入一大半葱花，蒜蓉酱就熬好了；
steps.content_en: Add most of the scallion and the garlic sauce is done.

steps.content_zh: 泡软的粉丝切碎后倒入蒜蓉酱，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Chop the soaked vermicelli into soft pieces and pour into the garlic sauce, stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 蒜蓉粉丝垫底，放上扇贝肉；
steps.content_en: Place the garlic vermicelli on the bottom and put the scallop meat;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中放水，将扇贝放入蒸笼中，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行蒸制；
steps.content_en: Put water in the inner pot, place the scallops in the steamer, and tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen to steam;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好后取出，在上面撒上葱花、香菜碎，在每个扇贝上淋上几滴蒸鱼豉油；
steps.content_en: After steaming, take it out, sprinkle chopped green onion and coriander on top, and drizzle a few drops of steamed fish soy sauce on each scallop;

steps.content_zh: 烧一些热油，泼在上面就完成啦；
steps.content_en: Burn some hot oil, pour it on top and it’s done;

steps.content_zh: 扇贝Q弹爽口，入口鲜美，粉丝蒜味浓郁。
steps.content_en: The scallops are chewy and chewy, and the vermicelli is rich in garlic flavor.

description_zh: 八宝又名佛粥，原意是指用八种不同的原料熬制成粥，一般以粳米或糯米为主料，再添加辅料。在今天，八宝粥”的用料已经超出八种。多种杂粮食材营养丰富，香浓的味道更是饱含着深情，适合全家人一同共享。
description_en: Babao, also known as Buddha porridge, originally means porridge made from eight different raw materials. Generally, japonica rice or glutinous rice is used as the main ingredient, and auxiliary ingredients are added. Today, "Eight Treasure Porridge" has more than eight kinds of ingredients. A variety of miscellaneous grains are rich in nutrients, and the fragrant taste is full of affection, suitable for the whole family to share.
tips_zh: 如果是第二天早上当早饭的话可以将食材放入锅中加入水后，预约到第二天早上完成。
tips_en: If it is for breakfast the next morning, you can put the ingredients into the pot, add water, and reserve it until the next morning.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将除去冰糖外的所有原料洗净后浸泡至少4小时；
steps.content_en: Wash all ingredients except rock sugar and soak for at least 4 hours;

steps.content_zh: 将浸泡好的原料放入锅中，加入水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行熬粥；
steps.content_en: Put the soaked raw materials into the pot, add water to the water level line: Thick porridge-1 scale, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to make porridge;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时，放入冰糖调味；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add rock sugar to taste;

steps.content_zh: 一碗香甜软糯的八宝粥就做好啦。
steps.content_en: A bowl of sweet, soft and glutinous eight-treasure porridge is ready.

name_en: Honey Locust Seed and Peach Resin Dessert Soup
description_zh: 只涨颜值不长膘的美容羹。桃胶又名桃花泪，胶如脂，凝如珠，再加上口感清爽的皂角米、温润的银耳和补血的红枣，组成了一碗晶莹剔透的美容羹。入口爽滑却不黏腻，皂角米更增加了Q弹的口感，是爱美女士不可多得的养颜佳品。
description_en: A beauty soup that only enhances appearance but not fat. Peach gum, also known as peach blossom tears, is as gelatinous as fat and condensed like beads. Together with refreshing saponin rice, warm white fungus and blood-enhancing red dates, it forms a bowl of crystal clear beauty soup. It is smooth but not sticky in the mouth, and the soap locust rice adds a chewy texture. It is a rare beauty product for ladies who love beauty.
tips_zh: 桃胶与皂角米在浸泡之前质地都非常坚硬，所以要充分浸泡。
tips_en: Peach gum and soapnut rice are very hard before soaking, so soak them thoroughly.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银耳、桃胶与皂角米洗净后提前浸泡一夜，浸泡过程中要将桃胶换一次水去除杂质；银耳撕成小朵；
steps.content_en: Wash the snow fungus, peach gum and honey locust seeds and soak overnight; change the water once while soaking the peach gum to remove impurities; tear the snow fungus into small florets;

steps.content_zh: 红枣洗净后泡发；
steps.content_en: Wash the red dates and soak them in hair;

steps.content_zh: 将除去冰糖以外的食材全部倒入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour all the ingredients except rock sugar into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时放入冰糖后继续焖煮至烹饪完成；
steps.content_en: When there are 10 minutes remaining in the cooking time, add rock sugar and continue to simmer until cooking is complete;

steps.content_zh: 趁热享用吧。
steps.content_en: Enjoy hot.

description_zh: 气血双养护的大补羹。双红指的是红枣和红豆，均为优质的温补食材，滋润心脾、养心开胃。桂圆有丰富的葡萄糖、蔗糖等成分，营养价值很高。另外桂圆的B族维生素、维生素C含量也极其丰富，对提高免疫力和抵抗皮肤病方面大有裨益。
description_en: A nourishing soup that supports both qi and blood. 'Double Red' means red dates and red beans, both excellent warming ingredients that nourish the heart and spleen and stimulate the appetite. Longan is rich in glucose, sucrose, and other nutrients, and packed with B vitamins and vitamin C, which help boost immunity and resist skin conditions.
tips_zh: 身体内热者不宜一次食用过多。
tips_en: Those with internal heat should not eat too much at once.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将所有原料洗净后浸泡4小时左右，倒入锅中；
steps.content_en: Wash all the ingredients, soak them for about 4 hours, and pour them into the pot;

steps.content_zh: 加入清水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the water level line: -1 mark for thick porridge, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时放入冰糖调味；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add rock sugar to taste;

steps.content_zh: 趁热享用，滋润心脾、养心开胃。
steps.content_en: Enjoy hot; it nourishes the heart and appetite.

description_zh: 莲子桂圆粥是一道传统名点。营养丰富，能增强记忆力，补脑益智。桂圆有丰富的葡萄糖、蔗糖等成分，带来了独特的香甜滋味。莲子绵软，桂圆鲜嫩爽口，是鲜香味美的滋补好粥。
description_en: Lotus seed and longan porridge is a traditional snack. Rich in nutrients, it can enhance memory and nourish the brain. Longan is rich in glucose, sucrose and other ingredients, which brings a unique sweet taste. The lotus seeds are soft and the longan is tender and refreshing. It is a delicious and nourishing porridge.
tips_zh: 喜欢喝质地浓稠的朋友们可以适量的减少水量，加到稠粥-¾的刻度。
tips_en: Friends who like to drink thicker texture can reduce the amount of water appropriately and add it to -¾ of the thick porridge.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将除去冰糖以外的食材浸泡2小时左右；
steps.content_en: Soak the ingredients except rock sugar for about 2 hours;

steps.content_zh: 将浸泡好的食材倒入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行煲粥；
steps.content_en: Pour the soaked ingredients into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to cook porridge;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时倒入冰糖，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add rock sugar and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 趁热享用。
steps.content_en: Serve hot.

name_en: Snow fungus and goji berry sweet soup
description_zh: 银耳带来浓浓的胶质，汤汁浓稠，香滑爽口，朵朵银耳入口即化。枸杞消除了味觉的单调，并且提高了滋补保健效果。枸杞性质比较温和，多食大有裨益。一碗好羹滋润而不腻滞，美味香滑又不上火，健康生活不可或缺的佳品。
description_en: Snow fungus releases rich gelatin, making the soup thick, smooth and refreshing, with every floret melting in the mouth. Goji berries relieve the monotony of flavor and enhance the nourishing and health benefits. Goji berries are mild in nature, and eating more of them is very beneficial. A good bowl of sweet soup is moisturizing but not greasy, delicious, smooth and not 'heaty' - an indispensable treasure for a healthy life.
tips_zh:
1、银耳一定要充分浸泡后撕成小朵，这样有利于煮出胶纸；
2、枸杞不宜久煮，所以在最后放入。
tips_en:
1. Soak the snow fungus thoroughly and tear it into small florets so it releases its gel.
2. Goji berries shouldn't be cooked long, so add them at the end.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银耳提前浸泡4小时；
steps.content_en: Soak the snow fungus 4 hours in advance;

steps.content_zh: 撕成小朵后倒入锅中，加水到水位线:稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Tear into small florets, put in the pot, add water to the thick porridge-1 level and tap Start Cooking on the phone.

steps.content_zh: 枸杞洗净后泡发；
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the goji berries;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时同时将枸杞和冰糖倒入，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add the goji berries and rock sugar, and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 入口即化的枸杞银耳羹就做好了。
steps.content_en: The wolfberry and white fungus soup that melts in your mouth is ready.

description_zh: 猪肉豆角饭，是我从小吃到大的美食，小时候记忆最深刻的就是放学刚一进门，就闻到香气扑鼻的豆角饭，大柴锅呼呼的冒着热气，等待的过程就是不住的咽口水，上桌一口气能吃两三碗。现在都是用电饭煲来做了，更省事，营养丰富，饭菜一锅出，真香啊！
description_en: Pork and green bean rice is a dish I have loved since childhood. My fondest memory is coming home from school to the smell of fragrant bean rice steaming in a big wood-fired pot, swallowing constantly while waiting. I could eat two or three bowls at once. Now I make it in a rice cooker - easier, nutritious, and a whole meal in one pot. So good!
tips_zh: 建议使用五花肉制作，纯瘦肉会差些香味
tips_en: It is recommended to use pork belly, pure lean meat will have less flavor.

steps.content_zh: 备好食材，豆角去筋；
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients and remove the strings from the green beans.

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净倒入电饭煲内胆备用；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and pour it into the rice cooker and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 猪肉切片（用五花肉香、梅花肉嫩）；
steps.content_en: Pork slices (pork belly is fragrant and plum blossom meat is tender);

steps.content_zh: 豆角洗净，切小段，葱切葱花；
steps.content_en: Wash and cut the green beans into short pieces; chop the scallion;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加入植物油，小火煸香八角；
steps.content_en: Add vegetable oil to the pot and stir-fry the star anise over low heat until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 放入肉片中火煸炒，用五花肉的煸黄煸出油，瘦肉的颜色变白就可以了，加入葱姜爆香，放入料酒去腥，加酱油提色；
steps.content_en: Stir-fry the meat over medium heat until the pork belly browns and renders fat and the lean turns white; add scallion and ginger until fragrant, cooking wine to remove the gamey taste and soy sauce for color.

steps.content_zh: 放入豆角中火炒到颜色变绿；
steps.content_en: Add the green beans and stir-fry over medium heat until they turn green.

steps.content_zh: 加入清水、放入盐，大火烧开1分钟，尝一下汤，味道有点咸才合适，关火；
steps.content_en: Add water and salt, boil over high heat for 1 minute, taste the soup, if it tastes a little salty, turn off the heat;

steps.content_zh: 连汤带豆角倒入装有米的电饭煲里，汤的量以不没过食材刚要齐平为宜，汤不够的加开水补；
steps.content_en: Pour the beans and broth into the rice cooker with the rice; the liquid should just cover the ingredients—add boiling water if needed;

steps.content_zh: 点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen to cook;

steps.content_zh: 饭焖好后，用筷子打散、拌匀即可上桌。
steps.content_en: After the rice is simmered, break it up with chopsticks and mix well before serving.

name_en: Steamed Winter Melon with Dried Scallops
description_zh: 冬瓜钾盐含量高，钠盐含量低，足量钾可促进细胞新陈代谢，顺利排出毒素。所以冬瓜有利尿消肿的作用，能够轻松搞定你的水肿脸。冬瓜含有的葫芦巴碱能抑制糖类转化为脂肪，让你越吃越瘦哦。
description_en: Winter melon is high in potassium and low in sodium; adequate potassium boosts cell metabolism and helps flush out toxins. That's why it acts as a diuretic and reduces swelling—even that puffy face. It also contains trigonelline, which inhibits the conversion of sugar into fat, so the more you eat, the slimmer you get.
tips_zh: 这是一道十分清淡的菜肴，所以盐不要放太多影响冬瓜的清淡的味道。
tips_en: This is a very light dish, so don't add too much salt or you'll mask the winter melon's delicate flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 瑶柱用水泡发一夜，泡好后用盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、姜片腌制20分钟；
steps.content_en: Soak the scallops in water overnight, then marinate them with salt, chicken essence, pepper and ginger slices for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜洗净去皮去切块，切好后在中间挖个圆洞；
steps.content_en: Wash, peel and cut the winter melon into pieces. After cutting, make a round hole in the middle;

steps.content_zh: 朝天椒切圈，小葱切碎备用；
steps.content_en: Slice the bird's eye chilies into rings and chop the scallions; set aside.

steps.content_zh: 浸泡好的瑶柱滤干水分，用生姜、鸡精和料酒腌渍；
steps.content_en: Drain the soaked scallops and marinate them with ginger, chicken essence and cooking wine;

steps.content_zh: 将腌制好的瑶柱放入冬瓜的圆洞内，上面放一个朝天椒圈将盘子放入蒸屉，锅内加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行蒸制；
steps.content_en: Put the pickled scallops into the round hole of the winter melon, put an upturned pepper ring on top, put the plate into the steamer, add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice -2 mark, click the start cooking icon on your phone to steam;

steps.content_zh: 结束后将蒸出的汤汁倒入炒锅内，可以再加一点水烧开后加入水淀粉做成芡汁，然后加入盐、鸡精、香油调味后淋到冬瓜上，撒上葱花，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: After the steaming is completed, pour the steamed soup into the wok. You can add a little water to boil, then add water starch to make gravy. Then add salt, chicken essence, and sesame oil to taste, then pour it on the winter melon, sprinkle with chopped green onion, and enjoy.

description_zh: 豆腐白嫩如玉，润滑爽口，一吃到嘴里就化了，豆香怡人。有极高的营养价值，也富含蛋白质，因此民间也流传着很多种美味的做法，豆腐蒸蛋就是其中一种，其制作方法简单，是常见的家常菜，口味可以根据个人喜好变换。
description_en: Tofu is as white and tender as jade, smooth and fragrant, melting in the mouth. Rich in protein and nutrients, it has many home-style recipes—steamed tofu with egg is a simple classic, easily adapted to taste.
tips_zh: 鸡蛋液要过滤，这样整出来的鸡蛋会顺滑没有气泡。
tips_en: Strain the beaten eggs so the cooked eggs turn out smooth and free of bubbles.

steps.content_zh: 虾仁洗净去除沙线；
steps.content_en: Wash the shrimps and remove any sand lines;

steps.content_zh: 大葱切成葱花备用；
steps.content_en: Slice green onions into chopped green onions and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋打散后倒入100毫升的温水，加入适量的盐、鸡精搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: After beating the eggs, pour 100 ml of warm water, add appropriate amount of salt and chicken essence and mix well;

steps.content_zh: 内酯豆腐切成大约1cm后的片然后放入容器；
steps.content_en: Cut lactone tofu into approximately 1cm pieces and place in a container;

steps.content_zh: 将调好的蛋液倒入容器，滤除泡沫，将虾仁放到豆腐上，撒上葱花；
steps.content_en: Pour the prepared egg liquid into the container, filter out the foam, place the shrimp on the tofu, and sprinkle with chopped green onion;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至水位线：东北米2的位置，将容器放入电饭煲蒸屉内，盖上锅盖，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice 2 mark, put the container in the steaming rack of the rice cooker, cover with the lid, and tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后根据个人口味淋上适量的香油和蒸鱼豉油，趁热享用吧。
steps.content_en: After it's out of the pot, pour an appropriate amount of sesame oil and steamed fish soy sauce according to your personal taste, and enjoy while it's hot.

description_zh: 天热的时候，不想开火，也没什么食欲。香香辣辣的凉面，可以早上起来做上一大盆，吃的时候挑一碗出来，拌上佐料就是美味的一顿。即使一天不再开火也足够解决全家的“温饱”问题。
description_en: When it's hot, I don't want to start the fire and I don't have much appetite. You can make a big bowl of spicy cold noodles in the morning, pick out a bowl when you eat it, and mix it with condiments to make a delicious meal. Even if the fire is stopped for one day, it is enough to solve the "food and clothing" problem of the whole family.
tips_zh:
1、面条不能煮的完全熟，这样就失去了嚼劲。
2、酱料可以根据自己的口味调整，比如放入花生米、老干妈等等。
tips_en:
1. Don't cook the noodles all the way through, or they'll lose their chew.
2. Adjust the sauce to taste—add peanuts or chili sauce, for example.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 黄瓜洗净切丝，大葱切断，姜切片，大蒜切碎，香葱切碎备用；
steps.content_en: Wash and shred the cucumber, cut the green onions, slice the ginger, chop the garlic, chop the chives and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 鸡胸洗净放入锅胆，加入料酒、葱段、姜片，加水到水位线稠粥1/2的位置；选择蒸煮模式20分钟；
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken breast and place in the inner pot; add cooking wine, scallion sections, and ginger slices, then add water to the 1/2 porridge mark on the water level line; select steam-cook mode for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 鸡胸用筷子可以轻松插进去，没有血丝流出就代表熟了，出锅后用凉水冲洗并冷却，用到拍几下这样容易撕成丝；
steps.content_en: When a chopstick inserts easily and no blood runs out, it's cooked. Rinse under cold water to cool, then tap lightly with a knife so it's easy to shred;

steps.content_zh: 锅中再加入一些水，继续蒸煮模式，烧开后放入拉面；
steps.content_en: Add more water to the pot, continue with the steam mode, and add the ramen noodles once it boils;

steps.content_zh: 用筷子夹起一根，掐断后中间还有一点点发白就可以捞出了，拉面出锅后将面条放入冷水，滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Pick up a strand with chopsticks; if it's still slightly white in the middle when snapped, it's done. Put the noodles in cold water after cooking, then drain well;

steps.content_zh: 芝麻酱内加入盐、醋、鸡精，然后用水稀释；
steps.content_en: Add salt, vinegar, and chicken bouillon to the sesame paste, then thin it with water;

steps.content_zh: 将黄瓜丝放到拉面上，然后加入鸡丝、调好的麻酱汁、辣酱、麻椒油、大蒜碎、香葱、芝麻。拌匀开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Place the shredded cucumber on the noodles, then add the shredded chicken, prepared sesame sauce, chili sauce, Sichuan pepper oil, minced garlic, scallion and sesame seeds. Mix well and enjoy.

description_zh: 盐水毛豆因其制作方便，营养丰富而备受大家的喜爱。毛豆富含植物蛋白、多种矿物质、维生素及膳食纤维。因为含有丰富的钾，能缓解炎热天气造成的疲乏无力和食欲下降，所以特别适合夏季食用。还等什么，赶快做一份吧！
description_en: Salted edamame is popular for being easy to make and nutritious. Edamame is rich in plant protein, minerals, vitamins, and fiber. Its high potassium content helps relieve fatigue and loss of appetite in hot weather, making it perfect for summer. What are you waiting for—make a batch now!
tips_zh:
1、不喜欢香料的味道可以只用盐。
2、若要保持毛豆的碧绿，盐需要早一点放。
3、毛豆不可多吃，多吃会胀气。
tips_en:
1. If you don't like spices, just use salt.
2. Add the salt early to keep the edamame bright green.
3. Don't overeat edamame—it can cause gas.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 毛豆剪掉两头的角；
steps.content_en: Cut off both ends of the edamame beans;

steps.content_zh: 毛豆洗净放入锅中，加入盐、八角、花椒、桂皮；
steps.content_en: Wash the edamame and put in the pot; add salt, star anise, Sichuan pepper, and cinnamon;

steps.content_zh: 加水加到稠粥1的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the level of thick porridge 1, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后将毛豆在汁水中浸泡至冷却，就可以享用啦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, soak the edamame in the sauce until cool, then enjoy.

description_zh: 泡椒凤爪起源于重庆的民间，是一道被大家津津乐道的小吃。以酸辣爽口、皮韧肉香而著称。既登得大雅之堂，也进入了寻常百姓家。正宗的泡椒凤爪丰满洁白，咀嚼时骨肉生香，具有很强的催味功效。
description_en: Pickled chili chicken feet originated in Chongqing as a much-loved snack. Known for their hot-and-sour crunch, chewy skin, and fragrant meat, they appear at both elegant banquets and everyday tables. Authentic ones are plump and white, with bone and meat releasing aroma as you chew—a real appetite booster.
tips_zh:
1、煮好的凤爪用冰水激一下这样肉质会更紧实，更脆。
2、泡制凤爪的时间最好是一个晚上，这样有足够的时间让凤入味。
3、想要凤爪更入味可以将泡椒切开，让泡椒味道充分散发。
tips_en:
1. Plunge the cooked chicken feet into ice water for firmer, crunchier meat.
2. Soak them overnight so the flavor fully develops.
3. For more flavor, slit the pickled chilies so their taste spreads.

steps.content_zh: 凤爪洗净，剪去指甲，切成3段；
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken feet, trim off the nails, and cut into 3 sections;

steps.content_zh: 葱切段，姜切片，芹菜胡萝卜切成大小合适的条；
steps.content_en: Cut the scallion into sections, slice the ginger, and cut the celery and carrot into strips;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的凤爪放入锅胆，加入八角、花椒、葱段、姜片；
steps.content_en: Put the cut chicken feet into the pot, add star anise, peppercorns, green onions and ginger slices;

steps.content_zh: 加水到水位线稠粥1刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the water level line to thicken the porridge 1 mark, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余2分钟的时候，开盖放入切好的芹菜和胡萝卜；
steps.content_en: When 2 minutes remain, open the lid and add the chopped celery and carrot;

steps.content_zh: 程序结束后将凤爪和蔬菜捞出，用冰水激一下，冲洗干净；
steps.content_en: After the program ends, remove the chicken feet and vegetables, plunge them into ice water and rinse clean;

steps.content_zh: 之后将凤爪和蔬菜沥干水分码放到保鲜盒里，每码放一层就加一些泡椒进去；
steps.content_en: Then drain the chicken feet and vegetables and put them in a crisper, adding some pickled peppers to each layer;

steps.content_zh: 加入盐、白砂糖、白酒、白醋和泡椒自带的泡椒水；
steps.content_en: Add salt, white sugar, white wine, white vinegar and the pickled pepper water that comes with the pickled pepper;

steps.content_zh: 加入纯净水或凉白开直到没过凤爪，盖上盖子蒙上一层保鲜膜，放入冰箱冷藏室冷藏一夜；
steps.content_en: Add purified water or cold boiled water until the chicken feet are covered, cover with a lid and a layer of plastic wrap, and refrigerate overnight in the refrigerator;

steps.content_zh: 第二天浸泡入味就可以享用啦。
steps.content_en: Soak it in and enjoy it the next day.

description_zh: 一到夏天我就很向往老大爷的生活方式，傍晚时分一个人吹着小风，喝着小酒，吃着盐水花生米。再眯着眼睛看看夕阳，真是想想就很惬意。
description_en: Every summer I envy the old guys' lifestyle: in the evening, a cool breeze, a little drink, and some salted peanuts, then squinting at the sunset—pure bliss just thinking about it.
tips_zh:
1、冷藏后可以直接吃花生米或者将胡萝卜、芹菜焯水后放入麻油与花生做成凉菜。
2、带壳煮花生也一样，只不过要先加水和盐泡泡，更入味。
tips_en:
1. Once chilled, eat the peanuts as-is, or blanch carrot and celery and toss with sesame oil and peanuts for a cold salad.
2. The same works for peanuts in their shells—just soak them in salted water first for more flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 花生米洗净放入锅中；
steps.content_en: Wash the peanuts and put them in the pot;

steps.content_zh: 加入盐、八角、花椒、桂皮，加水加到稠粥1的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add salt, star anise, peppercorns, cinnamon, and water to the thick porridge level 1. Click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后自然放凉后入冰箱冷藏，并在汤汁中浸泡4小时以上，这样会更入味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, cool naturally, then refrigerate and soak in the sauce for at least 4 hours for better flavor;

steps.content_zh: 喝着小酒，吃着盐水花生米。再眯着眼睛看看夕阳，真是想想就很惬意。
steps.content_en: Sipping a little wine, munching salted peanuts and squinting at the sunset—just thinking about it is pure bliss.

name_en: Water Chestnut and Glutinous Rice Balls
description_zh: 一款百吃不厌的糯米丸子。鲜肉中加上了马蹄，口感清脆、香甜，糯米软弹。
description_en: A glutinous rice meatball you never tire of. Fresh pork mixed with water chestnuts for a crisp, sweet bite, with soft and chewy glutinous rice.
tips_zh:
1、糯米一定要充分浸泡。
2、肉末选择三肥七瘦的猪肉。
tips_en:
1. Glutinous rice must be fully soaked.
2. For minced meat, choose pork that is three fat and seven lean.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前浸泡提前一晚浸泡，浸泡后滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak glutinous rice in advance. Soak it one night in advance, then drain the water after soaking;

steps.content_zh: 马蹄洗净后去皮切碎丁，生姜切末，香葱切成葱花，倒入肉末中在加入淀粉；
steps.content_en: Wash, peel, and finely dice the water chestnuts, mince the ginger, and chop the scallions; add them to the minced meat along with some starch;

steps.content_zh: 放入料酒、盐、鸡精和蛋，朝着一个方向搅拌上劲；
steps.content_en: Add cooking wine, salt, chicken essence and eggs, stir in one direction;

steps.content_zh: 做成大小均匀的肉丸；
steps.content_en: Form into evenly sized meatballs;

steps.content_zh: 在糯米上滚动，均匀的黏上糯米；同时锅中加入清水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Roll on the glutinous rice to evenly coat the glutinous rice; at the same time, add water to the pot to the water level line: northeast rice -2 mark, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 约5分钟后水烧开，放上蒸笼，继续蒸20分钟即可；
steps.content_en: After about 5 minutes the water boils; place over the steamer and steam for another 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好了的样子；
steps.content_en: How it looks when done;

steps.content_zh: 3L的饭煲一笼可以蒸8个左右，可以分几次蒸完哦。
steps.content_en: A 3L rice cooker can steam about 8 rice dishes, and you can steam them in several batches.

name_en: Bitter melon and pork rib soup
description_zh: 苦瓜排骨汤味苦甘、清润，具清暑除热、明目解毒的功效，是潮汕一带夏日解暑的汤饮，民间上亦常用以治疗感暑烦渴，暑疖，痱子过多。
description_en: Bitter melon and pork ribs soup is bitter-sweet, clear and moist. It has the effects of clearing heat, removing heat, improving eyesight and detoxifying. It is a soup that relieves summer heat in Chaoshan area. It is also commonly used among the people to treat summer heat, polydipsia, heat boils and excessive prickly heat.
tips_zh: 苦瓜加盐焯一下可以去除一定的苦味。
tips_en: Blanching bitter melon with a little salt removes some of its bitterness.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 仔排洗净，剁成小块，大葱切圈，姜切片，苦瓜去瓤切片；
steps.content_en: Wash the pork chops and chop them into small pieces, cut the green onions into rings, slice the ginger, remove the pulp from the bitter gourd and slice it into slices;

steps.content_zh: 仔排焯水，冷水入锅水开后再煮几分钟直到血沫变为白色；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pork chops, add cold water to the pot and boil for a few minutes until the foam turns white;

steps.content_zh: 将焯好的仔排用温水洗净血沫，放入锅中，加入大葱1段、生姜3片、八角2颗和适量的料酒加水到水位线稠粥1刻度；手机APP点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the blanched pork chops with warm water to remove the blood foam, put it into the pot, add 1 green onion, 3 slices of ginger, 2 star anise and an appropriate amount of cooking wine. Add water until the water level reaches 1 mark of thick porridge; click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 炖排骨汤的同时将切好的苦瓜也焯一下水，焯的时候加一些盐；
steps.content_en: While stewing the pork ribs soup, blanch the cut bitter melon in water and add some salt while blanching;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余20分钟时放入苦瓜盖上锅盖继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: With 20 minutes left, add the bitter melon, cover, and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，根据个人口感加入适当的盐、鸡精、白胡椒粉调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt, chicken bouillon, and white pepper to taste.

description_zh: 美味到不行的鸡肉吃法，麻辣、鲜香、嫩爽的经典川味。
description_en: The most delicious way to eat chicken, classic Sichuan flavor that is spicy, fragrant and tender.
tips_zh: 调料可以根据自己的口味调节。
tips_en: The seasoning can be adjusted according to your own taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料，鸡腿洗净备用;
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients, wash the chicken legs and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 葱切段，姜切片，香葱切末，大蒜切末;
steps.content_en: Cut the green onions into sections, slice the ginger, mince the chives, and mince the garlic;

steps.content_zh: 将鸡腿放入锅胆，加入八角、葱段、姜片、料酒;
steps.content_en: Put the chicken legs into the pot, add star anise, green onion segments, ginger slices and cooking wine;

steps.content_zh: 加水到水位线稠粥1刻度,手机APP点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the water level line to thicken the porridge 1 mark, click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 将大蒜、花生碎、香醋、生抽、辣椒油、藤椒油、盐调成适合自己口味的酱汁；
steps.content_en: Mix garlic, crushed peanuts, balsamic vinegar, light soy sauce, chili oil, cane pepper oil, and salt to make a sauce that suits your taste;

steps.content_zh: 准备一盆冰水，烹饪结束后将鸡腿，用凉水冲洗干净，然后放入冰水中冷却；
steps.content_en: Prepare a basin of ice water. After cooking, rinse the chicken legs with cold water and put them in the ice water to cool;

steps.content_zh: 将冷却的鸡腿斩成片，码入盘中，倒入酱汁，撒上芝麻和香葱，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Cut the cooled chicken legs into slices, place them on a plate, pour in the sauce, sprinkle with sesame seeds and chives, and enjoy.

description_zh: 夏天来了，别再煮绿豆汤了，做碗绿豆沙，清热解毒下火气，冰镇起来更爽。
description_en: Summer is here. Instead of cooking mung bean soup, make a bowl of mung bean paste. It can clear away heat and detoxify, and it will be more refreshing when chilled.
tips_zh: 如果买不到去皮绿豆，将浸泡好的绿豆煮开花后用料理机搅拌成沙。
tips_en: If you can't buy peeled mung beans, boil the soaked mung beans and blend them into a paste in a food processor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 去皮绿豆洗净，浸泡30分钟；
steps.content_en: Wash the peeled mung beans and soak them for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 放入锅胆，加水到水位线稠粥1的位置，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the pot into the pot, add water to the thick porridge 1 position on the water level, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后根据个人口味加入适量的冰糖调味，并用铲子搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add rock sugar to taste and stir well with a spatula;

steps.content_zh: 待绿豆沙自然放凉后放入冰箱冷藏，随吃随取，吃的时候可拌入桂花一起食用。
steps.content_en: Let the mung bean paste cool naturally, then refrigerate it; take as needed and mix in osmanthus flowers when serving.

description_zh: 马蹄银耳羹长期食用可清心降火、补肺凉肝，加了红枣和木瓜之后口感更佳。
description_en: Water chestnut and white fungus soup, when eaten regularly, can clear heart fire, nourish the lungs and cool the liver; adding red dates and papaya makes it taste even better.
tips_zh: 荸荠与红枣本身有甜味，所以只放了30克冰糖，可以根据个人口味调节。
tips_en: Water chestnuts and red dates are naturally sweet, so only 30 g of rock sugar is used; adjust to taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银耳提前浸泡一夜后撕成小朵；红枣从中间切开泡发；
steps.content_en: Soak the snow fungus overnight, then tear into small florets; split the red dates in half and soak to rehydrate;

steps.content_zh: 荸荠去皮，木瓜去皮去籽切块；
steps.content_en: Peel the water chestnuts, peel the papaya, remove the seeds and cut into pieces;

steps.content_zh: 将处理好的银耳、红枣和荸荠同时放入锅中，加入清水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度线，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the processed white fungus, red dates and water chestnuts into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 scale, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟的时候倒入木瓜和冰糖，继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: When there are 10 minutes left in the cooking time, add papaya and rock sugar and continue to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 完成后就可以享用啦。
steps.content_en: Once done, enjoy.

description_zh: 《舌尖上的美食2》让泉州萝卜饭印象深刻。萝卜饭是闽南沿海一带所特有的美食，以大米、萝卜、香菇和干的海鲜味原料，最后淋上熬好的葱油，一道菜也是一顿饭，是漂泊在海外游子的思念，也是生活在东南亚一带华侨心中的古早味。
description_en: 'A Bite of China 2' left a lasting impression with Quanzhou radish rice. A specialty of the southern Fujian coast, it's made with rice, radish, shiitake mushrooms, and dried seafood, finished with scallion oil. One dish makes a whole meal—a taste of home for overseas wanderers and a nostalgic classic for Chinese communities in Southeast Asia.
tips_zh:
1、虾米是含有大量盐分的，大米是用盐水浸泡过的所以就不用额外的加入盐；
2、成品可能会有些油，所以根据个人口味倒入葱油；
3、熬葱油的时候要小火慢慢熬制，颜色变得金黄色立即关火。
4、还可以加入瑶柱、蛤蜊肉、虾干等海鲜增加风味。
tips_en:
1. Dried shrimp are very salty and the rice was soaked in salt water, so no extra salt is needed.
2. The dish may be a bit oily—add scallion oil to taste.
3. Make the scallion oil slowly over low heat and turn off the heat as soon as it turns golden.
4. Dried scallops, clam meat, or dried shrimp also add great flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净后放少许水浸泡，滴入几滴老抽，撒上一点点盐搅拌均匀，给个底味；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice, soak it in a little water, add a few drops of dark soy sauce, sprinkle with a little salt and stir evenly to give it a base flavor;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉焯水后洗净，放入锅中加清水，放入八角、大葱、生姜用老抽上色、盐调味，卤30分钟左右；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pork belly and wash it, put it into a pot with water, add star anise, scallions, and ginger, color with dark soy sauce, season with salt, and marinate for about 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 卤五花肉的时候处理其他食材，红葱头切丝、香菇泡发后切片、白萝卜切小块；
steps.content_en: While marinating the pork belly, prepare other ingredients: shred the shallots, soak the mushrooms and slice them, and cut the white radish into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉卤好后取出，卤水留下备用；
steps.content_en: After the pork belly is marinated, take it out and keep the brine for later use;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅洗净后倒入多一些的油，放入葱丝熬葱油；
steps.content_en: After cleaning the wok, pour more oil, add shredded green onions and boil the green onion oil;

steps.content_zh: 洋葱变成金黄色的程度即可，关火倒出；
steps.content_en: Once the onion turns golden, turn off the heat and pour it out;

steps.content_zh: 卤好的五花肉切成稍微厚一点的片；
steps.content_en: Cut the braised pork belly into slightly thicker slices;

steps.content_zh: 熬好葱油的锅不用洗，继续加热后倒入肉片煸炒出油；
steps.content_en: Don’t wash the pan in which the scallion oil has been boiled. Continue to heat, add the meat slices and stir-fry until the oil is released;

steps.content_zh: 放入萝卜、香菇和虾米煸炒；
steps.content_en: Add radish, mushrooms and dried shrimps and stir-fry;

steps.content_zh: 倒入浸泡好的大米翻拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Pour in the soaked rice and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的所有食材倒入电饭煲锅胆中，加入留下的卤水，再加入少许水与食材齐平，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour all the fried ingredients into the rice cooker pot, add the remaining brine, then add a little water to level with the ingredients, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 1个小时后米饭焖煮好，倒入葱油搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: After 1 hour, the rice is simmered, add the scallion oil and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 一个字，香。
steps.content_en: One word, fragrant.

description_zh: 相比传统的红烧猪蹄而言，话梅猪蹄中酸甜的话梅味融入到猪蹄中，解除了油腻。经过一夜在冰箱中的腌制后再入锅煮，猪蹄更劲道入味。
description_en: Unlike traditional braised pork trotters, preserved-plum trotters absorb the sweet-and-sour plum flavor, cutting the richness. Marinating in the fridge overnight before cooking makes the meat firmer and more flavorful.
tips_zh:
1、猪皮因为经过焯水冷却的冷热收缩，再经冰箱的冷藏，烹制后肉质软焾皮却是爽口的，很棒！所以美味是需要花时间的，在冰箱中冷藏的步骤必不可少。
2、话梅的量以2个猪手6-8颗话梅为宜。
tips_en:
1. Blanching and chilling the pork skin, then refrigerating it, makes the meat tender but the skin pleasantly chewy—great! Good food takes time, so don't skip the chilling step.
2. Use 6-8 preserved plums for 2 pork knuckles.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 生姜去皮切片、香葱切段；
steps.content_en: Peel and slice the ginger, cut the scallions into sections;

steps.content_zh: 猪蹄冷水入锅焯水，沸腾后继续煮3分钟，捞起后用清水冲洗干净；放到干净的容器中，加入葱、姜、话梅、花雕酒和适量的生抽，用保鲜膜包起，入冰箱中冷藏一晚上；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pig's trotters in cold water in a pot. After boiling, continue to cook for 3 minutes. Remove and rinse with clean water. Put it in a clean container, add onions, ginger, plums, Huadiao wine and an appropriate amount of light soy sauce. Wrap it with plastic wrap and refrigerate it in the refrigerator overnight.

steps.content_zh: 第二天将猪蹄和腌料都倒入饭煲中，加入香料、冰糖和老抽，加清水到猪蹄的¾处，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: The next day, put the trotters and marinade into the cooker, add the spices, rock sugar and dark soy sauce, pour in water to three-quarters of the trotters' height, then tap Start Cooking on your phone;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后尝一尝是否够味，如果不够再放一些生抽或者盐调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, taste and add a bit more light soy sauce or salt if needed.

description_zh: 电饭煲卤鸡爪，省时省力的下酒菜。
description_en: Braised chicken feet in the rice cooker—an easy, time-saving dish to go with drinks.
tips_zh:
1、老卤水的做法参考下前卤鸭翅的食谱。
2、卤水中含盐又放了生抽和老抽所以就不用放盐了。
3、喜欢吃有嚼劲的可以减少卤的时间。
4、卤水用完后倒入干净的容器中入冰箱冷冻。
5、很多人会担心卤制后会不会在做饭有味道，这点完全不用担心，因为电饭煲的内胆都是有不沾涂层的，所以卤制完后洗干净完全不影响，在卤制的过程中电饭煲的排气口、防堵罩等等都可以拆下来，这些清洗干净后踏实的做米饭熬粥，绝对不影响。
tips_en:
1. For the recipe of old brine, please refer to the recipe of pre-braised duck wings.
2. The brine contains salt and contains light soy sauce and dark soy sauce, so there is no need to add salt.
3. If you like to eat chewy food, you can reduce the stewing time.
4. After the brine is used up, pour it into a clean container and freeze it in the refrigerator.
5. Many people worry about whether the cooking will smell after marinating. There is no need to worry about this, because the inner pot of the rice cooker has a non-stick coating, so washing it after marinating will not affect it at all. During the marinating process, the exhaust port, anti-clogging cover, etc. of the rice cooker can be removed. After cleaning, you can make rice and porridge without any impact.

steps.content_zh: 鸡爪清洗干净；
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken feet clean;

steps.content_zh: 用剪刀剪去指甲；
steps.content_en: Trim the nails with scissors;

steps.content_zh: 准备好各种香料和香料袋；
steps.content_en: Have a variety of spices and spice bags ready;

steps.content_zh: 将生姜拍松与其它香料一起放入香料袋中；
steps.content_en: Floss the ginger and add it to the spice bag along with the other spices;

steps.content_zh: 鸡爪冷水入锅，焯水后冲洗干净；
steps.content_en: Put the chicken feet in a pot of cold water, blanch, and rinse clean;

steps.content_zh: 将鸡爪倒入锅中，加入卤水、香料包、生抽和老抽，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the chicken feet into the pot, add brine, spice packets, light soy sauce and dark soy sauce, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后在卤水中继续浸泡30分钟让鸡爪更入味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, soak the chicken feet in the braising liquid for 30 minutes to absorb more flavor.

steps.content_zh: 撒上一些把芝麻装饰。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with sesame seeds to garnish.

description_zh: 丝瓜是夏季里最好的食材之一，消暑降火两相宜。汤里只放盐调味，却也不显得寡淡，有淡淡的鱼肉鲜味和丝瓜香味，是夏日里的一款好汤。
description_en: Loofah is one of the best summer ingredients, cooling and soothing. Seasoned only with salt, the soup is far from bland, with a delicate fish and loofah flavor—a wonderful summer soup.
tips_zh:
1、加入猪肉末是为了让鱼丸中含有少许脂肪，口感更佳。
2、如果买不到龙利鱼柳，也可以购买草鱼取鱼背上的鱼肉。
3、想要鱼丸更加Q弹，可以再加入一些淀粉。
tips_en:
1. The ground pork adds a little fat for a better texture in the fish balls.
2. If you can't find basa fillets, use the back meat of a grass carp instead.
3. For bouncier fish balls, add a bit more starch.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 龙利鱼切小块加上肉末和一片生姜放入搅拌机中，倒入约30毫升的清水打成鱼肉茸；
steps.content_en: Cut the basa fish into small pieces and place in a blender with the minced meat and a slice of ginger; pour in about 30 ml of water and blend into a fine fish paste;

steps.content_zh: 鱼肉茸中加入盐、淀粉和少许胡椒粉和一个蛋清，用筷子顺着一个方向搅打上劲，放入冰箱中冷藏备用；
steps.content_en: Add salt, starch, a little pepper, and one egg white to the minced fish, stir vigorously in one direction with chopsticks until firm, then refrigerate until ready to use;

steps.content_zh: 丝瓜去皮切成滚刀块；
steps.content_en: Peel the loofah and cut into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 电饭煲中加水到水位线：东北米-4的刻度，放入一片生姜，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the rice cooker to the 'Northeast rice - 4' level, add a slice of ginger, and tap Start Cooking on your phone;

steps.content_zh: 约8分钟后水烧开；
steps.content_en: The water will boil in about 8 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 用勺子挖出鱼肉茸，放到沸水中做成鱼丸；（备一碗清水，做好一个鱼丸勺子在清水中涮一下，这样不会粘）
steps.content_en: Scoop up the fish paste with a spoon and drop into boiling water to make fish balls; (keep a bowl of water nearby and dip the spoon in after each one so it won't stick)

steps.content_zh: 倒入丝瓜继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: Pour in the loofah and continue to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 再次煮沸后，加入少许盐调好口味即可。
steps.content_en: After boiling again, add a little salt to adjust the taste.

description_zh: 炎热的夏天就需要丝瓜这种清热凉血的食材，清蒸这种做法省时省力、味道清淡。
description_en: Hot summer requires ingredients like loofah, which can clear away heat and cool blood. Steaming saves time, effort and has a light taste.
tips_zh:
1、也可以将虾仁切成粒放入丝瓜盅里面。
2、虾仁和丝瓜熟的很快，不用蒸太长时间，水沸腾后蒸5-6分钟即可。
3、酱汁可以根据个人口味放入其他的调料。
tips_en:
1. You can also cut the shrimp into pieces and put them into the loofah cup.
2. Shrimp and loofah cook quickly, so you don’t need to steam them for too long. Steam them for 5-6 minutes after the water boils.
3. Other seasonings can be added to the sauce according to personal taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾洗净去壳，从中间切开取虾线，从虾背处平着切开至虾腹，把虾身切透一个洞，注意不要把前部切断了；
steps.content_en: Wash and shell the fresh shrimp, cut along the middle to remove the vein, slice horizontally from the back to the belly, cutting a hole through the body—be careful not to cut off the front;

steps.content_zh: 再将虾尾从洞中穿过去，做成虾球；
steps.content_en: Then pass the shrimp tail through the hole to make shrimp balls;

steps.content_zh: 丝瓜去皮切成3-4厘米的段，做成丝瓜盅；
steps.content_en: Peel the loofah and cut into 3-4 cm segments to make a loofah cup;

steps.content_zh: 将虾球放在丝瓜盅上；
steps.content_en: Place the shrimp balls on the loofah cup;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-2，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast Rice - 2, click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 小葱切成葱花，加入蒸鱼豉油和芝麻油调成酱汁；
steps.content_en: Chop the scallions into finely chopped green onions, add steamed fish soy sauce and sesame oil to make a sauce;

steps.content_zh: 约5分钟后水沸腾；放入蒸笼继续蒸5分钟即可；
steps.content_en: After about 5 minutes, the water will boil; put it in the steamer and continue to steam for 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后淋上刚刚做好的酱汁。
steps.content_en: After serving, pour the freshly prepared sauce over it.

description_zh: 粉蒸肉自带糯而清香，口感酥而不烂，是一道脍炙人口的传统名菜，尤其在南方地区流行。粉蒸肉最传统的做法以猪五花肉为原料，我们在传统基础上做些创新改变，辣味的粉蒸牛肉，味道独特又做法简单，最适合懒人在家鼓捣了。
description_en: Steamed pork with rice flour is glutinous and fragrant, and tastes crisp but not rotten. It is a popular traditional dish, especially in the south. The most traditional way to make steamed pork is pork belly. We have made some innovative changes based on tradition. The spicy steamed beef has a unique taste and is simple to make. It is perfect for lazy people to tinker with at home.
tips_zh:
1、切牛肉的时候要刀要与牛肉的文理成90°切，这样牛肉容易酥烂。
2、除了南瓜还可以用土豆、红薯、紫薯等高淀粉含量的食材代替。
tips_en:
1. Slice the beef against the grain at a 90° angle so it becomes tender.
2. Instead of pumpkin, use other starchy ingredients like potato, sweet potato, or purple sweet potato.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 牛肉洗净切1厘米作用厚的片，加入生抽，料酒，耗油搅拌均匀，腌制20分钟；
steps.content_en: Wash the beef and cut into slices about 1 cm thick; mix with light soy sauce, cooking wine, and oyster sauce, and marinate for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 腌好的牛肉裹上蒸肉粉；
steps.content_en: Coat the marinated beef with steaming rice powder;

steps.content_zh: 南瓜去皮切1厘米厚的片，垫在盘子上，腌好的牛肉裹上蒸肉粉放到南瓜上；
steps.content_en: Peel the pumpkin and cut it into 1 cm thick slices, place it on a plate, wrap the marinated beef in steamed pork powder and place it on the pumpkin;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸笼中，锅内加水到水位线：东北米3的刻度;手机APP点击程序开始；
steps.content_en: Put it into the steamer and add water to the water level line: northeast meter 3; click on the mobile APP to start the program;

steps.content_zh: 小葱切葱花；
steps.content_en: Chop green onions;

steps.content_zh: 香菜切碎；
steps.content_en: Chop the cilantro;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后撒上葱花和香菜，趁热享用吧。
steps.content_en: After cooking, sprinkle with chopped scallions and cilantro, and serve hot.

description_zh: 说起新疆的美食，绝不会漏掉手抓饭。相传一千多年前的新疆，有一位叫阿布艾里•依比西纳的医生靠自创的手抓饭治好了自己的顽疾，足以看出手抓饭的滋补，此后手抓饭的配方便慢慢风靡了新疆。伊犁产的旱稻，加上新疆优良的胡萝卜洋葱（皮牙子）和羊肉，这是一锅香喷喷的手抓饭所必备的。虽然无法找全这些食材，我们还是可以在家做一锅属于自己的手抓饭。
description_en: No list of Xinjiang food is complete without pilaf. Legend says a doctor named Abu Ali ibn Sina cured himself with his own pilaf over a thousand years ago—proof of its nourishing power—and the recipe spread across Xinjiang. Ili dry-land rice, local carrots, onions and lamb are the essentials. Even without all of them, you can still make your own pot at home.
tips_zh:
1、如果没有黄萝卜就用普通胡萝卜代替即可。
2、羊肉要选择有肥有瘦的，以羊腿肉和羊排最佳。
tips_en:
1. If you don’t have yellow radish, just use ordinary carrots instead.
2. Choose fat or lean mutton, with mutton legs and mutton chops being the best.

ingredients.name_zh: 羊腿或羊排（要有肥有瘦的）
ingredients.name_en: Lamb leg or lamb ribs (with both fat and lean meat)

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients and ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大米提前用凉水泡40分钟左右滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the rice in cold water for about 40 minutes in advance and drain the water;

steps.content_zh: 羊肉切块浸泡在清水30分钟中去除血水，过程中换水一次；
steps.content_en: Cut the lamb into pieces and soak in water for 30 minutes to remove the blood, changing the water once;

steps.content_zh: 捞出后滤干水分，最好用厨房纸吸干表面水分；
steps.content_en: Drain the water after taking it out. It is best to use kitchen paper to absorb the surface water;

steps.content_zh: 黄萝卜切成条，最好黄萝卜胡萝卜都有、这样口感颜色都比较好。买不到黄萝卜的话，可全用胡萝卜切成条；
steps.content_en: Cut the yellow radish into strips. It is best to have both yellow radish and carrot, so the taste and color will be better. If you cannot buy yellow radish, you can use carrots cut into strips;

steps.content_zh: 洋葱切丝；
steps.content_en: Slice the onion into strips;

steps.content_zh: 开炒，炒锅中放入少油，烧热后放入羊肉煎上色，标准为两面金黄；
steps.content_en: Start frying, put a little oil in the frying pan, heat it up, add the mutton and fry until it turns golden brown on both sides;

steps.content_zh: 捞出羊肉后将洋葱和胡萝卜放入煸炒，炒到洋葱颜色变深；
steps.content_en: Remove the mutton and stir-fry the onions and carrots until the onions turn darker in color;

steps.content_zh: 放入大米，煸炒，用盐、孜然粉调味；
steps.content_en: Add the rice and stir-fry, seasoning with salt and cumin.

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的食材倒入饭煲中，加入少许的水大米齐平；
steps.content_en: Pour the fried ingredients into the rice cooker, add a little water to level the rice;

steps.content_zh: 在上面铺上煎好的羊肉，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Place the fried mutton on top and click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 葡萄干洗净后用温水泡开，米饭煮好后开盖撒入葡萄干继续关上盖子焖10分钟即可。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the raisins in warm water. When the rice is done, open the lid, sprinkle in the raisins, cover again and let stand for 10 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

ingredients.name_zh: 羊腿或羊排（要有肥有瘦的）
ingredients.name_en: Lamb leg or lamb ribs (with both fat and lean meat)

name_en: Rib and Glass Noodle Clay Pot
description_zh: 夏天没胃口，不如来一份排骨粉丝煲，排骨粉丝煲也是天津吃烧烤吃海鲜时十分常见的砂锅，也是天津特有的砂锅，香浓可口，十分美味。
description_en: If you don’t have an appetite in summer, it’s better to have the Pork Ribs Vermicelli Pot. The Pork Ribs Vermicelli Pot is also a very common casserole when eating barbecue and seafood in Tianjin. It is also a unique casserole in Tianjin. It is fragrant, delicious and very delicious.
tips_zh: 蔬菜除了圆白菜还可以放入香菇、青菜、金针菇等自己喜欢的食材。
tips_en: Besides cabbage, you can add shiitake, bok choy, enoki or other favorite vegetables.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 肋排洗净剁成大小合适的块；
steps.content_en: Wash the ribs and chop them into pieces of suitable size;

steps.content_zh: 圆白菜切块；
steps.content_en: Cut cabbage into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 葱、姜切丝，香菜切碎备用；
steps.content_en: Shred onions and ginger, chop coriander and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 将剁好的排骨焯水，冷水下锅，水开后再煮5分钟后用温水冲洗干净，洗掉血沫；
steps.content_en: Blanch the chopped ribs, put them in a pot with cold water, boil them for 5 minutes, then rinse them with warm water to remove any blood foam;

steps.content_zh: 将焯过水洗净的排骨放入锅胆内，放入适量料酒、姜丝、八角，加水至水位线：稠粥1的刻度，手机APP点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the blanched and washed spareribs into the pot, add an appropriate amount of cooking wine, shredded ginger, and star anise, add water to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark, click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余20分钟时加入圆白菜和粉丝；
steps.content_en: With 20 minutes left, add the cabbage and glass noodles;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后根据个人口味加入盐、鸡精、胡椒粉调味，撒上葱丝、香菜即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt, chicken bouillon, and pepper to taste, then sprinkle with shredded scallion and cilantro.

description_zh: 提到武汉，肯定会想起周黑鸭和精武鸭脖。香辣入味嚼劲十足，越吃越上瘾。担心外面买的添加剂太多，那不如自己动手做吧。
description_en: Mention Wuhan and you think of Zhou Hei Ya and Jingwu duck necks—spicy, flavorful and chewy, moreish with every bite. Worried about additives in store-bought ones? Make your own.
tips_zh:
1、想要辣的可以用新鲜的朝天椒。
2、放入冰箱中冷藏后味道更佳。
3、如果没有老卤水就用清水。
tips_en:
1. If you want it spicy, you can use fresh chili peppers.
2. It tastes better after being refrigerated.
3. If there is no old brine, use clean water.

steps.content_zh: 上次卤好鸡爪的卤水，拿出用微波炉解冻；
steps.content_en: Take out the brine from which the chicken feet were marinated last time and defrost it in the microwave;

steps.content_zh: 鸭脖子冷水入锅焯水后清洗干净，去除表面的油脂，一切两段；
steps.content_en: Blanch the duck neck in cold water in a pot, clean it, remove the fat on the surface, and cut it into two pieces;

steps.content_zh: 生姜拍松后与香料一起包入香料袋中，将卤水、鸭脖和香料袋放入锅中，加入生抽、老抽和冰糖，在放入适量的清水，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Beat the ginger loosely and pack it into a spice bag together with the spices. Put the brine, duck neck and spice bag into the pot, add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and rock sugar. Add an appropriate amount of water and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后捞出，将鸭脖子浸泡在卤水中自然冷却；
steps.content_en: After cooking, remove the duck necks and soak them in the braising liquid until cooled;

steps.content_zh: 冷却后风干；
steps.content_en: Cool and then air-dry;

steps.content_zh: 最后切段，喊上三五好友，来个聚会~
steps.content_en: Finally, cut into sections and call a few friends over for a get-together~

description_zh: 蒜蓉蒸丝瓜是一道常见的菜，尤其在广东地区特别盛行。丝瓜是汁水丰富的食材，所以烹饪也特别简单，以期保留香嫩爽口的口感。这道菜好吃又营养，在炎热的夏天蒸个丝瓜吃，又清甜又简单。
description_en: Steamed loofah with garlic is a common dish, especially popular in Guangdong. Loofah is juicy, so it is very simple to cook in order to keep its tender, refreshing texture. Delicious and nutritious, steamed loofah is a sweet and easy dish for hot summer days.
tips_zh: 丝瓜切好后要放入水中浸泡，以免在空气中氧化变色。
tips_en: After cutting the loofah, soak it in water to avoid oxidation and discoloration in the air.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 丝瓜去皮，切成1cm左右厚的片，大蒜切碎，香葱切末，辣椒切碎；
steps.content_en: Peel the loofah, cut into about 1cm thick slices, mince the garlic, mince the chives, and mince the peppers;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的丝瓜放入蒸屉，锅内加水至水位线：东北米2的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the cut loofah into the steamer, add water to the pot to the water level: 2 Northeast meters, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅内加入花生油，油热后放入大蒜末，炒出香味后加入辣椒碎、蒸鱼豉油和生抽，煮开后关火并根据个人口味加入适量的盐、鸡精和香油；
steps.content_en: Heat peanut oil in a pan, add minced garlic, and once fragrant add crushed chili, steamed fish soy sauce, and light soy sauce. Bring to a boil, turn off the heat, and add salt, chicken essence, and sesame oil to taste;

steps.content_zh: 丝瓜出锅后，淋上炒好的酱汁然后撒上葱末，美味上桌，尽情地开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: After the loofah is taken out of the pan, pour the fried sauce on it and sprinkle with chopped green onion. Serve it delicious and enjoy.

description_zh:
相比馒头，我更爱吃有葱油味道的花卷。
原以为花卷是个很难做的食物，没想到一次就成功。
description_en:
Compared to steamed buns, I prefer Hanamaki with the flavor of scallion oil.
I thought that Hanamaki was a difficult food to make, but I didn't expect that I succeeded in just one try.
tips_zh:
1、这个配料的量可以做14个小花卷。
2、蒸花卷的过程中一定不要打开盖子。
3、完成后也不要着急打开，记得焖一会，这样面团不会回缩。
tips_en:
1. This amount makes 14 small flower rolls.
2. Don't open the lid while steaming the rolls.
3. After cooking, wait a bit before opening so the dough doesn't shrink.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将面粉与酵母混合后缓缓倒入清水，揉成光滑的面团；
steps.content_en: Mix flour and yeast, slowly pour in water, and knead into a smooth dough;

steps.content_zh: 放入容器中，盖上保鲜膜发酵成原来2倍大的面团；
steps.content_en: Put in a container, cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled.

steps.content_zh: 发酵完成后用擀面杖擀成一张面饼；
steps.content_en: After fermentation is completed, use a rolling pin to roll it into a piece of dough;

steps.content_zh: 用刷子刷上一层油，撒上葱花；
steps.content_en: Brush on a layer of oil and sprinkle with chopped scallions;

steps.content_zh: 均匀的撒上椒盐；
steps.content_en: Sprinkle salt and pepper evenly;

steps.content_zh: 卷起来；
steps.content_en: roll up;

steps.content_zh: 切成4厘米左右宽的面团；
steps.content_en: Cut the dough into about 4 cm wide;

steps.content_zh: 用筷子在面团中间按下去；
steps.content_en: Press down in the center of the dough with chopsticks;

steps.content_zh: 两端捏在一起就成了小花卷了啦；
steps.content_en: Pinch the two ends together to form a small flower roll;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标开始烹饪；蒸笼中垫上油纸或者纱布，放上醒发好的花卷；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice -2 mark, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking; line the steamer with oil paper or gauze, and put the proofed flower rolls;

steps.content_zh: 约5分钟后水烧开，放入蒸笼开始蒸花卷，完成后再焖上5分钟就完成了。
steps.content_en: After about 5 minutes the water boils; put in the steamer to steam the flower rolls, then let them rest for 5 minutes when done.

description_zh: 将花蛤与葱、姜、蒜、金针菇和粉丝混合后，淋上特制的酱料，然后将它们包在锡纸中，大火蒸制。一点汁水都没有溢出，鲜美无敌~
description_en: Mix the clams with scallion, ginger, garlic, enoki mushrooms and glass noodles, drizzle with the special sauce, wrap in foil and steam over high heat. Not a drop of juice escapes—incredibly delicious~
tips_zh:
1、根据自己的口味调制酱料，喜欢吃辣的加辣椒。
2、除了金针菇和粉丝之外还可以加入其它的食材，比如娃娃菜、绿豆芽等。
tips_en:
1. Mix the sauce to taste—add chili if you like it spicy.
2. Besides enoki mushrooms and glass noodles, you can add baby cabbage or bean sprouts.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 花蛤洗净后泡在水里吐沙；
steps.content_en: Wash the clams and soak them in water to spit out sand;

steps.content_zh: 粉丝加温水泡发；
steps.content_en: Soak the glass noodles in warm water;

steps.content_zh: 葱姜切丝，大蒜切末，金针菇去根洗净；
steps.content_en: Shred the scallion and ginger, mince the garlic, and trim and wash the enoki mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 将豆瓣酱、番茄酱、耗油、花生油、生抽、料酒、白糖、胡椒粉、鸡精调制成酱汁
steps.content_en: Mix bean paste, tomato sauce, oil, peanut oil, light soy sauce, cooking wine, sugar, pepper and chicken essence to make a sauce

steps.content_zh: 把锡纸平铺到砧板上，然后依次铺上粉丝、金针菇、吐好沙的花蛤；
steps.content_en: Spread the tinfoil on the cutting board, then place the vermicelli, enoki mushrooms, and clams that spit out sand in order;

steps.content_zh: 淋上调制好的酱汁，再铺上蒜末和葱丝姜丝；
steps.content_en: Pour on the prepared sauce, then top with minced garlic and shredded onions and ginger;

steps.content_zh: 将锡纸对折，剪去多余的锡纸，再将周围的三个边分别向上折，多折几次把口封好后放入蒸架；
steps.content_en: Fold the tinfoil in half, cut off the excess tinfoil, then fold the three surrounding sides upward respectively, fold it a few times to seal it, and then place it on the steaming rack;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至水位线：东北米-3的刻度，放上蒸笼，点击手机屏幕开始烹饪图标进行蒸煮；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 3 mark, place the steamer on top, and tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen to steam;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 中式传统的发糕，味道不输给西式的蛋糕。玉米面与白面混合经过发酵后蒸出的发糕，又香又甜，加上葡萄干或者红枣后别有风味。
description_en: Traditional Chinese fa gao (steamed sponge cake) rivals Western cake in taste. Made from fermented cornmeal and wheat flour, it's fragrant and sweet, with raisins or red dates adding a special touch.
tips_zh: 酵母粉提前用牛奶溶化，以酵母溶液使用时，可使酵母与面粉充分接触。
tips_en: Dissolve the yeast in milk in advance so it mixes thoroughly with the flour when used.

steps.content_zh: 用40℃左右的温水将白糖、泡打粉、酵母一起溶化；
steps.content_en: Dissolve the sugar, baking powder, and yeast in warm water at about 40°C;

steps.content_zh: 面粉和玉米面混合到一起，加入调好的糖水，搅拌成均匀的面糊；
steps.content_en: Mix the flour and cornmeal together, add the prepared sugar water, and stir into a uniform batter;

steps.content_zh: 把调好的面糊放进容器，并盖上盖子（最好是保鲜膜）发酵；
steps.content_en: Put the prepared batter into the container and cover it with a lid (preferably plastic wrap) to ferment;

steps.content_zh: 大约1小时左右面糊会发酵成两倍的大小，将面糊倒入纸杯中；
steps.content_en: The batter will ferment to double in size in about 1 hour. Pour the batter into a paper cup;

steps.content_zh: 撒上适量的葡萄干。将容器入蒸屉；锅内加水到水位线：蒸水线东北米-2的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进烹饪；
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with raisins and put the container in the steamer; add water to the Steam line Northeast Rice-2 level and tap Start Cooking on the phone.

steps.content_zh: 如果没有纸杯，可以用玻璃器皿，记得只要倒入四分之三的高度即可；
steps.content_en: If you don’t have paper cups, you can use glassware. Remember to pour only three-quarters of the way up;

steps.content_zh: 完成后，开始享用吧，可以与蛋糕媲美的口感。
steps.content_en: Once done, enjoy the texture, which is comparable to cake.

description_zh: 小时候妈妈用面粉和红糖做的红糖馒头，是那个时候最美味甜蜜的食物了。红糖馒头形状有趣，口感细腻甜润，红糖还是女性的滋补佳品，所以跟妈妈学了做法，时不时做些给自己吃。
description_en: The brown sugar buns my mom made with flour and brown sugar were the sweetest, most delicious treat of my childhood. With a fun shape and a fine, sweet texture—and brown sugar being a nourishing tonic for women—I learned the recipe from her and make them for myself now and then.
tips_zh:
1、如果没有自发粉，要在面粉中添加酵母。
2、牛奶也可以用开水代替，但是做好的馒头会缺乏奶香味。
tips_en:
1. If you don’t have self-rising flour, add yeast to the flour.
2. Milk can also be replaced with boiling water, but the finished steamed buns will lack the milky flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 牛奶加热后加入红糖，将红糖完全溶化，然后稍微晾凉一点，大约到40℃左右；
steps.content_en: Warm the milk, add brown sugar, stir until fully dissolved, then let cool to about 40 C;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋打入自发粉内，加入牛奶搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Beat the eggs into the self-raising flour, add the milk and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 把絮装的面块反复揉，揉至表面光滑；
steps.content_en: Knead the stuffed dough repeatedly until the surface is smooth;

steps.content_zh: 把光滑的面团放进容器，并盖盖子发酵；大约20分钟左右面会发酵成两倍的大小；
steps.content_en: Put the smooth dough into the container and cover it to ferment; the dough will ferment to double in size in about 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 将面团揉成长条状；
steps.content_en: Knead the dough into a long strip;

steps.content_zh: 然后分成大小均匀的面团；
steps.content_en: Then divide into evenly sized dough portions;

steps.content_zh: 将面团整形；
steps.content_en: Shape dough;

steps.content_zh: 将整好形的馒头入蒸屉；锅内加水到水位线：东北米-2的位置，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the shaped steamed buns into the steamer; add water to the pot to the water level: northeast meter -2, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 完成后不要着急打开盖子，继续焖5分钟；
steps.content_en: Don't rush to open the lid when it's done, and continue to simmer for 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 完美的红糖馒头就这样做成了，那就尽情享用自己的成果吧。
steps.content_en: This is how perfect brown sugar steamed buns are made, so enjoy your results.

description_zh: 凉拌茄子是一道脍炙人口的凉菜，以茄子为主料的拌菜。有意思的是南北做法会有些许不同，南方把茄子烹煮得酥软入口，而北方更喜茄子带一点脆脆的口感。这道菜清心解暑，有助消化，最适合作为夏令佳肴食用。
description_en: Cold tossed eggplant is a beloved dish made with eggplant. Interestingly, northern and southern versions differ: the south cooks eggplant until meltingly soft, while the north prefers a slight crunch. Light and cooling, it aids digestion and is an ideal summer dish.
tips_zh:
1、 如果是无公害茄子最好不要去皮，会更有营养。
2、捣蒜的时候加少许盐，不会四处飞溅，而且口感也会更好。
tips_en:
1. If it is a pollution-free eggplant, it is best not to peel it, as it will be more nutritious.
2. Add a little salt when pounding garlic to avoid splashing around and taste better.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 茄子洗净，切成4块；将切好的茄子放入蒸屉，锅内加水至水位线：东北米2的刻度。点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the eggplant and cut into 4 pieces; place it in the steamer basket, add water to the pot up to the northeastern rice 2 mark, then tap the start-cooking icon on the phone screen;

steps.content_zh: 大蒜捣碎，香葱切末，辣椒切圈；
steps.content_en: Mash garlic, mince chives, and cut chilies into rings;

steps.content_zh: 用生抽、醋、辣椒油、蒜末、盐、鸡精、香油根据个人口感调制成酱汁；
steps.content_en: Make a sauce with light soy sauce, vinegar, chili oil, minced garlic, salt, chicken bouillon, and sesame oil to taste;

steps.content_zh: 将出锅后自然冷却的茄子切成条状，淋上酱汁然后撒上葱末和辣椒圈。美味上桌，尽情地开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Cut the cooled eggplant into strips, drizzle with sauce and sprinkle with chopped scallions and chili rings. Serve and dig in!

description_zh: 小吊梨汤，润而不甜，稠而不腻，是和豆汁齐名的老北京特饮之一。
description_en: Xiaodiaoli soup is moist but not sweet, thick but not greasy. It is one of the special drinks of old Beijing that is as famous as bean juice.
tips_zh: 梨皮不要扔掉，洗净后放入锅中，可以治疗咳嗽。
tips_en: Don't throw away the pear peel. Wash it and put it in a pot to treat coughs.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银耳和枸杞加水泡发，银耳泡发后去掉黄根，撕成小片；
steps.content_en: Soak white fungus and wolfberry in water. After soaking white fungus, remove the yellow roots and tear them into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 雪花梨去皮，洗净，切成小块。将银耳、梨和话梅放入锅胆，加水到水位线：稠粥1的刻度；手机点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Peel, wash and cut the snowflake pear into small pieces. Put the snow fungus, pear and preserved plums in the inner pot, add water up to the water level line: the thick porridge 1 mark, then tap Start Cooking on the phone;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余10分钟时加入泡好的枸杞和适量的冰糖；
steps.content_en: When 10 minutes remain in the program, add soaked wolfberry and appropriate amount of rock sugar;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 车仔面是在50年代香港经济低潮时兴起的，它价格便宜花样繁多，可以根据自己的口味放入各种食材，很受普通民众的欢迎。
description_en: Cart noodles arose in Hong Kong's 1950s downturn. Cheap and versatile, they let you add any ingredients you like, making them popular with ordinary people.
tips_zh:
1、车仔面的搭配的食材可以根据个人的口味随便变化，鱼丸、牛肉都是不错的选择。
2、煮面的时候要开盖煮，不然可能会造成溢出。
tips_en:
1. Customize the che zai noodles with whatever you like—fish balls and beef are both good choices.
2. Cook the noodles with the lid off, or the water may boil over.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至水位线：稠粥3/4的位置，加入油、葱和少许盐，点击开始烹饪，或者选择蒸煮12分钟；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the thick porridge ¾ mark, add oil, scallions and a little salt, then tap Start Cooking or select Steam for 12 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 香肠切片；
steps.content_en: sliced ​​sausage;

steps.content_zh: 约8分钟后水烧开，下入面条，开盖煮；
steps.content_en: After about 8 minutes the water boils; add the noodles and cook with the lid open;

steps.content_zh: 面条煮熟后捞出；
steps.content_en: Boil the noodles until cooked, then drain;

steps.content_zh: 加入甜辣酱、XO酱拌匀加入香肠片；
steps.content_en: Add sweet chili sauce and XO sauce, mix well and add sausage slices;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀后开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Mix well and enjoy.

description_zh: 我们家人都爱吃蔓越莓干，所以一买就是一大袋，平时我也喜欢在做蛋糕或者其它食品的时候加点蔓越莓干，尤其是孩子们不爱吃的食物，比如粗粮窝窝头。不可否认，粗粮窝窝头的口感较为粗糙，很多人并不爱吃。如果想要让它细腻，就要加大量的精细面粉和糖，才会好吃，可是那样又违背了吃粗粮的初衷。有一次做玉米面窝窝头的时候加了一把葡萄干，大女儿就特别喜欢吃，后来我再做这种粗粮窝窝头的时候，就会放葡萄干或者蔓越莓干在里面，这样就可以减少白面的份量，也不再放白糖了。不过需要注意的是，这种窝窝头要趁热吃，凉了就不好吃了。
description_en: My family loves dried cranberries, so we buy them by the bag. I add them to cakes and other treats, especially foods the kids avoid, like coarse-grain wowotou. True, those buns are rough and not to many tastes; making them tender takes lots of refined flour and sugar, which defeats the purpose. Once I added a handful of raisins to cornmeal buns and my eldest loved them; since then I add raisins or cranberries, cutting the white flour and skipping sugar. Just remember: eat them hot—cold ones are not good.
tips_zh: 这种窝窝头要趁热吃，凉了就不好吃了。
tips_en: This kind of steamed buns should be eaten while it's hot. It won't taste good when it's cold.

steps.content_zh: 把玉米面粉、绿豆面粉、小麦面粉放在一个小盆里；
steps.content_en: Put corn flour, mung bean flour, and wheat flour in a small basin;

steps.content_zh: 再倒进奶粉和酵母粉；
steps.content_en: Pour in the milk powder and yeast powder;

steps.content_zh: 加入清水，因为各种面粉的吸收性不同，建议一点点的增加清水，适量增减，最后的面团柔软并不粘手；
steps.content_en: Add water. Because the absorption of various flours is different, it is recommended to add water little by little, increase or decrease appropriately. The final dough will be soft and not sticky;

steps.content_zh: 揉成一个柔软的面团，再把蔓越莓干放进去，拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Knead it into a soft dough, add the dried cranberries and mix evenly;

steps.content_zh: 最后得到一个柔软的面团，盖上保鲜膜，静置醒发1小时；
steps.content_en: You'll end up with a soft dough; cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 因为大部分都是粗粮，所以发酵效果并不是特别明显，但会有一点膨胀，取出一小块面团，在手心里搓成圆锥形；
steps.content_en: Because most of them are coarse grains, the fermentation effect is not particularly obvious, but it will expand a little. Take out a small piece of dough and roll it into a cone shape in the palm of your hand;

steps.content_zh: 用手指在中间捏个洞，就是窝窝头了；
steps.content_en: Pinch a hole in the middle with your fingers to make a wowotou bun;

steps.content_zh: 依次摆放在蒸屉里，我这个份量用小米3L电饭煲可以蒸两屉；可以点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标，或者选择蒸煮模式进行蒸制；
steps.content_en: Place them in the steamer drawer one after another. The Xiaomi 3L rice cooker can steam two drawers for my portion. You can click the start cooking icon on the phone screen, or select the steaming mode to steam;

steps.content_zh: 完成后，蔓越莓杂粮窝窝头就做好了。杂粮含量大，口感略粗糙，但因为加了蔓越莓干，酸酸甜甜的，倒是味道也不错。平时吃精细粮食吃习惯了，不如试试这种粗粮窝窝头吧。
steps.content_en: Once done, your cranberry multigrain wotou (steamed corn buns) are ready. Packed with whole grains and slightly coarse in texture, the dried cranberries add a sweet-tart twist that tastes quite good. If you're used to refined staple foods, try these whole-grain buns for a change.

name_zh: 胡萝卜蔓越莓戚风蛋糕
description_zh: 放假在家，多多说想吃蛋糕，天气热，娃们都上火，我也懒得动烤箱，想着那不如用电饭煲做蛋糕吧。正好最近喜欢用料理机做胡萝卜汁，做出来的面包和饼干颜色都很漂亮，用它来做蛋糕一定也是很好的。为了丰富口感，又切了一些蔓越莓干进去，酸酸甜甜的。用电饭煲做蛋糕也很省事，虽然没有烤箱烤出来的卖相好，口感相对湿润些，但孩子们喜欢就可以了。
description_en: At home on holiday, Duoduo kept asking for cake. It was hot, the kids were overheated, and I could not be bothered with the oven—so why not make cake in the rice cooker? I had recently been making carrot juice in the food processor, which gave lovely color to bread and cookies, so it would work in cake too. I chopped in some dried cranberries for a sweet-tart kick. Rice cooker cake is easy: not as pretty as oven-baked and a bit moister, but if the kids love it, that is enough.

steps.content_zh: 先把胡萝卜去皮切成小块，加上等量的纯净水，放进料理机里打成胡萝卜汁；
steps.content_en: First, peel the carrots and cut them into small pieces, add an equal amount of purified water, and put it into a food processor to make carrot juice;

steps.content_zh: 打好的胡萝卜汁细腻无颗粒；
steps.content_en: The beaten carrot juice is fine and grain-free;

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜汁倒进一个大碗里，再放入四个鸡蛋的蛋黄；蛋白放在另一个无油无水的容器里；
steps.content_en: Pour the carrot juice into a large bowl and add the yolks of four eggs; put the whites in another oil- and water-free container;

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜汁和鸡蛋搅拌均匀，再将低筋面粉过筛到胡萝卜蛋糊里；
steps.content_en: Whisk the carrot juice and eggs together, then sift the cake flour into the carrot-egg mixture;

steps.content_zh: 用打蛋器划“Z”字形，将面粉和胡萝卜蛋糊拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Use a whisk in a 'Z' motion to mix the flour and carrot-egg batter evenly;

steps.content_zh: 蛋清加上白砂糖用电动打蛋器打发，拉起蛋白可以看到有直立短小的三角形；
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with sugar using an electric mixer until short, upright peaks form when lifted;

steps.content_zh: 取一半的蛋白，放进蛋黄碗里，上下翻拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Take half of the egg whites, put them into the egg yolk bowl, and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 拌均匀后的蛋糊再倒回原来的蛋白盆里；
steps.content_en: After mixing evenly, pour the egg batter back into the original egg white basin;

steps.content_zh: 继续上下翻拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Continue folding and mixing evenly;

steps.content_zh: 把事先切碎的蔓越莓干倒进蛋糕糊里；
steps.content_en: Pour the previously chopped dried cranberries into the cake batter;

steps.content_zh: 快速的翻拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Stir quickly and evenly;

steps.content_zh: 拌好的蛋糕糊倒进电饭煲里；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标，或者电饭煲启动“蛋糕”模式，用时60分钟；
steps.content_en: Pour the mixed cake batter into the rice cooker; click the start cooking icon on the phone screen, or start the "cake" mode of the rice cooker, and wait for 60 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 因为没有放油，所以倒的时候可能不是一下子就能倒出来的，用硅胶刮刀在边上轻轻的划一圈，就可以很轻松的倒出来了；或者在倒蛋糕糊之前先在内胆里抹层油；倒扣在晾网上放凉；
steps.content_en: Because there is no oil, it may not be poured out at once. Use a silicone spatula to lightly draw a circle on the edge and it can be poured out easily; or before pouring the cake batter, apply a layer of oil in the inner pot; invert it on a drying net and let it cool;

steps.content_zh: 等蛋糕凉了以后，再用锯齿刀切开，就可以吃了；
steps.content_en: After the cake has cooled, cut it with a serrated knife and you can eat it;

steps.content_zh: 因为用的是胡萝卜汁，所以颜色发黄，有点淡淡的胡萝卜甜味儿，再加上蔓樾莓干的酸甜口感，这款蛋糕很是受孩子们的欢迎。
steps.content_en: Because it uses carrot juice, it has a yellow color and a slight carrot sweetness. Coupled with the sweet and sour taste of dried cranberries, this cake is very popular with children.

description_zh: 花卷是很常见的一种面食，把紫薯泥添加在里面，制作成双色花卷，不仅外观好看，也增加了营养。
description_en: Hanamaki is a very common kind of pasta. Purple sweet potato puree is added to it to make a two-color flower roll. It not only looks good, but also increases nutrition.
tips_zh:
1、紫薯的用量多少产生的颜色不一样，可根据自己喜欢增减，也可以换成其他颜色的如菠菜汁、南瓜泥等。
2、蒸熟后，稍等2分钟再取出。
tips_en:
1. The amount of purple sweet potato changes the color—adjust to taste, or use spinach juice or pumpkin puree instead.
2. Wait 2 minutes after steaming before taking it out.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 紫薯蒸熟碾成紫薯泥备用；
steps.content_en: Steam the purple sweet potato and grind it into purple sweet potato puree and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 酵母用温水化开；
steps.content_en: Dissolve the yeast in warm water;

steps.content_zh: 将白糖、酵母和面粉搅拌均匀后缓缓的加入清水揉成面团，取一小半加入紫薯泥做成紫面团，发酵；
steps.content_en: Stir the sugar, yeast and flour evenly, then slowly add water and knead it into a dough. Add a small portion of the purple sweet potato puree to make a purple dough, and ferment;

steps.content_zh: 把紫色面擀成面皮；
steps.content_en: Roll out the purple dough into dough;

steps.content_zh: 白色的面团也擀成面皮，刷油；
steps.content_en: Roll out the white dough into dough and brush with oil;

steps.content_zh: 紫薯的面皮摞在白色面皮上，刷油；
steps.content_en: Stack the purple sweet potato dough on the white dough and brush with oil;

steps.content_zh: 如图卷起；
steps.content_en: Rolled up as shown;

steps.content_zh: 切段；
steps.content_en: cut into sections;

steps.content_zh: 拧成花卷；
steps.content_en: Twist into flower rolls;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标；上汽后继续蒸15分钟，焖2分钟后起锅即可。
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 3 mark; tap the Start Cooking icon on the phone screen; once steam comes out, steam for another 15 minutes, then let it sit for 2 minutes before taking it out.

description_zh: 糯米蛋有着粽子的香糯，吃起来美味营养又不麻烦，因为很难买到生的咸鸭蛋，便改用鸡蛋，结果成品也是一样的好吃。
description_en: The glutinous rice eggs have the aroma of rice dumplings and are delicious, nutritious and hassle-free to eat. Because it was difficult to buy raw salted duck eggs, I used eggs instead, and the finished product was equally delicious.
tips_zh:
1、糯米最好要提前一晚清水浸泡。
2、因为这几种调料都有咸淡滋味，所以无需放精盐。
3、蒸制的时候，注意要防止蛋壳倒下去。
4、这个食材的用量，可以做出8个糯米蛋。
tips_en:
1. Ideally soak the glutinous rice in water overnight.
