2. These seasonings are already salty, so no extra salt is needed.
3. While steaming, be careful not to let the eggshell tip over.
4. This amount makes 8 sticky rice eggs.

steps.content_zh: 准备所需食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare the required ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前一晚清水浸泡；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice in water overnight;

steps.content_zh: 把火腿切碎丁；
steps.content_en: Chop ham into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 玉米粒和青豆，用沸水焯烫一下；
steps.content_en: Blanch corn kernels and green beans in boiling water;

steps.content_zh: 把所有食材倒进盆中；
steps.content_en: Pour all ingredients into the basin;

steps.content_zh: 加入生抽、酱油、蚝油，搅拌均匀入味；
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, stir well and combine;

steps.content_zh: 把糯米蛋刀放在鸡蛋的小头上，扣紧；
steps.content_en: Place the glutinous rice egg knife on the small end of the egg and fasten it;

steps.content_zh: 抬起上端，砸下去；
steps.content_en: Lift the upper end and smash it down;

steps.content_zh: 很轻松的就打开鸡蛋壳，倒出蛋清；
steps.content_en: Easily open the egg shell and pour out the egg white;

steps.content_zh: 把拌好的糯米装入蛋壳中；有糯米蛋刀，处理蛋壳很简单；
steps.content_en: Put the mixed glutinous rice into egg shells; with the glutinous rice egg cutter, it is very easy to handle the egg shells;

steps.content_zh: 用锡纸包裹好，放入锅中，蒸制25分钟；
steps.content_en: Wrap it in tin foil, put it in the pot, and steam for 25 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 不愧为红极一时的糯米蛋，真的很好吃啊。
steps.content_en: The glutinous rice eggs are worthy of being a hit, they are really delicious.

name_en: Stewed Napa Cabbage with Frozen Tofu
description_zh: 著名的东北名菜，白菜软烂清甜，冻豆腐已经吸收满满的汤汁，一口下去，满满的汤汁充盈着口中，那种无与伦比的满足感油然而生。
description_en: A famous Northeastern dish: the cabbage is tender and sweet, and the frozen tofu has soaked up the broth — every bite bursts with flavor and brings unmatched satisfaction.
tips_zh: 可以放入一些五花肉煸炒香后一起煮，味道会更香一些。
tips_en: You can add some pork belly and stir-fry until fragrant, then cook together to make the taste more fragrant.

steps.content_zh: 冻豆腐切块；
steps.content_en: Cut frozen tofu into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 白菜切段；
steps.content_en: Cut cabbage into sections;

steps.content_zh: 葱姜切末；
steps.content_en: Mince the scallion and ginger;

steps.content_zh: 辣椒切段；
steps.content_en: Cut the chili into segments;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅起油，油热后下入葱、姜、蒜、八角、干辣椒炒香；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a wok; once hot, add scallion, ginger, garlic, star anise, and dried chilies and stir-fry until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 下入白菜翻炒均匀；
steps.content_en: Add cabbage and stir-fry evenly;

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的白菜倒入锅胆，加入冻豆腐，并加入所有调料搅拌均匀，盖上锅盖；点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the fried cabbage into the pot, add the frozen tofu, add all the seasonings and stir evenly, cover the pot; click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 结束后可根据个人口味加入适量的盐和鸡精调味；
steps.content_en: When done, add salt and chicken essence to taste;

steps.content_zh: 美味完成，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Done and delicious — dig in!

description_zh: 简单几步就可以学会这道鸭锁骨，吹着空调哼着歌再来根鸭锁骨，完美。吃了一个就停不下来。
description_en: You can learn this duck clavicle in just a few simple steps, humming to the air conditioner and then adding the duck clavicle, perfect. Once you eat one you can't stop.
tips_zh:
1、辣椒和花椒的量根据个人口味喜好放入，喜欢吃麻辣的可以多放一些。
2、如果没有老卤水，就多放一些调味料和香料。
3、慢火煮一个小时就够了，时间太长肉会散开。
4、用完的卤水放入冰箱中冷冻起来可以反复利用很多次。
tips_en:
1. Add chilies and Sichuan pepper to taste—use more if you like it spicy and numbing.
2. Without a master braising liquid, add extra seasonings and spices.
3. An hour of gentle simmering is enough; too long and the meat falls apart.
4. Freeze the used braising liquid and reuse it many times.

steps.content_zh: 取出冷冻的卤水，放入微波炉中解冻；
steps.content_en: Take out the frozen brine and defrost it in the microwave;

steps.content_zh: 准备好各种香料；
steps.content_en: Prepare various spices;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片后与各种香料放入卤料袋中；
steps.content_en: Slice the ginger and put it into a marinade bag with various spices;

steps.content_zh: 冷冻的鸭锁骨解冻后在清水中浸泡30分钟，中途换一次水冲洗掉血水；
steps.content_en: After defrosting, soak the frozen duck clavicle in clean water for 30 minutes, changing the water halfway to rinse away the blood;

steps.content_zh: 将鸭锁骨与卤料包放入饭煲中，倒入解冻好的卤水，加入适量的生抽、老抽、料酒和盐，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the duck clavicle and brine package into the rice cooker, pour in the thawed brine, add an appropriate amount of light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, cooking wine and salt, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后将鸭锁骨在卤水中浸泡到冷却，这样可以更入味些。捞出鸭锁骨后将卤水倒入干净的容器中，放入冰箱中冷冻，以便下次使用。
steps.content_en: After cooking, soak the duck collarbones in the braising liquid until cool for deeper flavor. Remove them, pour the liquid into a clean container, and freeze it for next time.

description_zh: 用啤酒代替水来卤豆干，加上炒香的花椒和辣椒。麻辣鲜香的豆干中带有啤酒的麦芽香味，最合适拿来下酒。
description_en: Braise the dried tofu in beer instead of water, with stir-fried Sichuan pepper and chilies. The spicy, savory tofu with beer's malty aroma is perfect with drinks.
tips_zh: 花椒和辣椒的量根据个人口味调节。
tips_en: The amount of pepper and chili pepper is adjusted according to personal taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将干辣椒切成段后与花椒、香叶、八角一起用清水浸泡十分钟后捞出滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Cut the dried chilies into sections and soak them with water for ten minutes together with Sichuan peppercorns, bay leaves and star anise, then remove and drain the water;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅中放油，烧热后转小火放入浸泡好的辣椒，煸炒出香味；
steps.content_en: Put oil in a wok, heat it up, then turn to low heat and add soaked chili peppers, stir-fry until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 将豆干、煸炒好的香料倒入饭煲中，加入500毫升的啤酒，放入盐、生抽、老抽、糖调味，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the dried tofu and stir-fried spices into the rice cooker, add 500 ml of beer, salt, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and sugar to taste, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后将豆干浸泡在汤汁中30分钟就入味啦，开吃。
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, soak the dried tofu in the soup for 30 minutes and the flavor will be absorbed. Start eating.

description_zh: 杨枝甘露是一道标准的粤式甜品，起源于上世纪80年代香港的粤菜酒家，将西柚肉加进平常的芒果西米露中。“杨枝甘露”初听似乎和甜品没有联系，其实它真正的意义是“观音用杨柳枝撒下甘露般令人神清气爽”。在这个热情似火的夏天，杨枝甘露能带给我们畅快清爽。  ​
description_en: Mango pomelo sago is a classic Cantonese dessert, originating in Hong Kong Cantonese restaurants in the 1980s by adding pomelo pulp to the usual mango and sago sweet soup. 'Yang Zhi Gan Lu' may sound unrelated to dessert, but it actually means 'Guanyin sprinkles nectar with a willow branch to refresh the senses.' In this blazing summer, it brings us a cool, refreshing treat.
tips_zh:
1、虽然西米比较难煮，但是切记西米不能浸，浸泡后会融化。
2、煮西米的时候切记要开着盖子。
tips_en:
1. Sago is tricky to cook, but never soak it—it will dissolve.
2. Keep the lid off while cooking sago.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至水位线：稠粥1的刻度，点击手机APP开始程序，大约10分钟左右水开，加入西米并不停的搅拌，直到西米没有白心；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the thick porridge 1 mark, tap Start in the phone app; after about 10 minutes the water boils, then add the tapioca pearls and stir constantly until no white centers remain;

steps.content_zh: 将西米捞出用凉水冲洗掉粘液后放入冷水中备用；
steps.content_en: Take out the sago and rinse it with cold water to remove the mucus, then put it in cold water and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 将一半的芒果放入料理机打成果酱，剩余芒果切块；
steps.content_en: Put half of the mango into a food processor and make jam, and cut the remaining mango into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 将红柚剥皮去籽，剥出果粒；
steps.content_en: Peel and remove the seeds from the red grapefruit;

steps.content_zh: 将西米、椰浆、芒果酱、芒果块、蜂蜜按照喜欢的口味混合，最后撒上红柚果粒。
steps.content_en: Mix sago, coconut milk, mango jam, mango chunks, and honey according to your favorite taste, and finally sprinkle with red pomelo pieces.

description_zh: 啤酒鸭，这是一道风味独特的佐酒佳肴，制作简单，因此成为九江人餐桌上常见的一道菜。啤酒鸭是将鸭肉与啤酒一同炖煮而成，使滋补的鸭肉不仅入口鲜香，还带有一股啤酒清香，真是人间美味。
description_en: Beer duck is a uniquely flavored dish to accompany drinks. Simple to make, it's a common sight on Jiujiang tables. Duck braised with beer turns tender and savory with a hint of beer aroma—truly a delight.
tips_zh:
1、做啤酒鸭不用另外放水。
2、鸭子选用嫩一点的白条鸭肉质鲜嫩，不要用老水鸭。
tips_en:
1. No extra water needed for beer duck.
2. Use a young dressed duck for tender meat, not an old duck.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸭子去除内脏、洗净、切块；
steps.content_en: Remove the duck's innards, wash, and cut into chunks;

steps.content_zh: 葱、姜、蒜切末，辣椒切成段；
steps.content_en: Mince the scallion, ginger and garlic; cut the chili into sections;

steps.content_zh: 青红椒切块备用；
steps.content_en: Chop the green and red peppers and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅起油，油热后下入葱、姜、蒜、八角、香叶、干辣椒炒香；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a wok; once hot, add scallion, ginger, garlic, star anise, bay leaf, and dried chilies and stir-fry until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 下入切好的鸭块，翻炒至没有汤汁渗出后盛出；
steps.content_en: Add the cut duck pieces, stir-fry until no soup leaks out, and then set aside;

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的鸭块倒入锅胆，如果出油太多可以去掉一部分；
steps.content_en: Pour the fried duck pieces into the pan. If there is too much oil, remove part of it;

steps.content_zh: 加入生抽、老抽、蚝油、啤酒，点击手机上开始烹饪的图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, and beer, and click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余5分钟时放入青红椒，程序结束后可根据个人口味加入适量的盐和鸡精调味；
steps.content_en: When 5 minutes remain, add green and red peppers; after the program ends, season with salt and chicken bouillon to taste;

steps.content_zh: 撒上香葱，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with scallion and enjoy.

description_zh: 小圆子软软糯糯的还有嚼劲，红豆汤的甜度也是刚刚好，夏天冰镇后品尝更加好味，难怪是大家都爱的甜品！
description_en: The dumplings are soft, glutinous and chewy, and the red bean soup is just right in sweetness. It tastes even better when chilled in the summer. No wonder it is everyone’s favorite dessert!
tips_zh:
1、为了方便煮红豆可以提前将红豆放入冰箱中哦浸泡一晚，第二天拿来煮。
2、冰糖也可以换成红糖，更适合身体不适的MM。
tips_en:
1. To cook the red beans more easily, soak them in the fridge overnight and cook them the next day.
2. You can swap rock sugar for brown sugar, which is gentler when you're not feeling well.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 提前将红豆浸泡4小时左右，浸泡后将红豆与泡红豆的水同时放入饭煲中，放入陈皮加水到水位线：稠粥¾的刻度，点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Soak the red beans about 4 hours ahead, then put them and their soaking water into the cooker; add dried tangerine peel, fill with water to the thick porridge ¾ level and tap Start Cooking.

steps.content_zh: 煮红豆的时候在糯米粉中缓缓加入90克清水，做成软硬适中的糯米面团；
steps.content_en: While cooking the red beans, gradually add 90 g water to the glutinous rice flour to make a dough of medium firmness;

steps.content_zh: 将面团揉成长条状，揪成小块在手中搓成小圆子，盘子上要放糯米粉防止黏住；
steps.content_en: Knead the dough into a long strip, break it into small pieces and roll it into small rounds with your hands. Put glutinous rice flour on the plate to prevent it from sticking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余20分钟的时候，打开电饭煲放入小圆子和冰糖后继续焖煮到结束；
steps.content_en: When there are 20 minutes left in the cooking time, open the rice cooker, add the dumplings and rock sugar and continue to simmer until the end;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后可以立即享用，也可以冷却后放入冰箱中冷藏后食用。
steps.content_en: Enjoy right away, or cool and refrigerate before serving.

description_zh: 香软的玉米面馒头，做成绣球的形状。炎热夏季，点心变着花样做给宝宝吃。馒头是锻炼咀嚼能力较好的食物之一，玉米面的绣球馒头从色彩到造型都让宝宝爱不释手。
description_en: Soft cornmeal mantou shaped like embroidered balls. In the hot summer, vary the snacks you make for your baby. Mantou is one of the best foods for practicing chewing, and these cornmeal balls are adorable in both color and shape.
tips_zh:
1、用的面粉为市售的玉米面粉，也可以换成普通白面。
2、动手能力强的小伙伴，可以做成双色的，用紫薯、南瓜等有色的食材做一个面团。
tips_en:
1. The flour used is commercially available corn flour, which can also be replaced with ordinary white flour.
2. Friends with strong hands-on skills can make two-color dough by using purple sweet potato, pumpkin and other colored ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将面粉、酵母与牛奶混合后揉成光滑的面团；
steps.content_en: Mix flour, yeast and milk and knead into a smooth dough;

steps.content_zh: 包上保鲜膜，发酵1小时左右，按下去不会弹起的状态；
steps.content_en: Wrap in plastic wrap and ferment for about 1 hour until it does not pop up when pressed;

steps.content_zh: 取一个20克重左右一个揉成小面团，可以做成16个；
steps.content_en: Take a piece weighing about 20 grams and knead it into a small dough, which can be made into 16 pieces;

steps.content_zh: 搓成长约20厘米，粗细均匀的长条；
steps.content_en: Roll into an even log about 20 cm long;

steps.content_zh: 如图所示成“井”字摆放；
steps.content_en: Place it in the shape of "well" as shown in the picture;

steps.content_zh: 将编号1、3、5、7顺时针压在下一个上面；
steps.content_en: Press numbers 1, 3, 5, and 7 clockwise on top of the next one;

steps.content_zh: 将编号2、4、6、8逆时针压在下一个上面；
steps.content_en: Press numbers 2, 4, 6, and 8 counterclockwise on top of the next one;

steps.content_zh: 重复操作，知道无法压住，尾部捏死；
steps.content_en: Repeat until it can no longer be pressed, then pinch the tail end closed;

steps.content_zh: 将底部收紧；
steps.content_en: Tighten the bottom;

steps.content_zh: 翻转过来，用两只手搓圆；
steps.content_en: Turn it over and roll it round with both hands;

steps.content_zh: 一次将剩余的做好；
steps.content_en: Make the rest at a time;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度，4L的饭煲正好一次性能蒸6个，3L的要蒸两次；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 3 mark; a 4 L cooker can steam 6 at once, while a 3 L cooker needs two batches;

steps.content_zh: 点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Tap the Start Cooking icon on your phone to begin cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后不要急着开盖，焖3分钟左右；
steps.content_en: After cooking, don't open the lid right away; let it steam for about 3 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

name_en: Spicy and sour tripe appetizer soup
description_zh: 炎热的夏季没有吃饭没有胃口，来一碗酸酸辣辣的牛肚汤，瞬间让你胃口大开。
description_en: In the hot summer, if you don’t have any appetite, a bowl of spicy and sour tripe soup will whet your appetite in an instant.
tips_zh:
1、酸辣的程度可以根据个人的口味调节。
2、除了这些原料还可以放入番茄、豆腐等食材。
tips_en:
1. The degree of sourness and hotness can be adjusted according to personal taste.
2. In addition to these raw materials, you can also add tomatoes, tofu and other ingredients.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将香菇、黑木耳、粉丝用温水泡发；
steps.content_en: Soak the mushrooms, black fungus and vermicelli in warm water;

steps.content_zh: 淀粉加水制成水淀粉；
steps.content_en: Mix starch with water to make a slurry;

steps.content_zh: 香菇、黑木耳、笋、牛百叶洗净切丝，牛肉切片，朝天椒切圈，香菜切碎备用；
steps.content_en: Wash and julienne the shiitake mushrooms, black fungus, bamboo shoots, and beef tripe; slice the beef, cut the bird's eye chilies into rings, and chop the cilantro; set aside.

steps.content_zh: 将香菇和木耳放入锅胆加水至水位线：稠粥2/3的刻度，盖上锅盖；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the mushrooms and fungus into the pot and add water to the water level: 2/3 of the thick porridge, cover the pot lid; click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时放入其他食材，并搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add the remaining ingredients and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 剩余2分钟加入水淀粉勾一下芡，程序结束后可根据个人口味加入适量的盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、香油和醋调味。
steps.content_en: Add water starch for the remaining 2 minutes to thicken the gravy. After the program is completed, you can add an appropriate amount of salt, chicken essence, pepper, sesame oil and vinegar to season according to your personal taste.

description_zh: 耗时30分钟，简单的几个步骤，妥妥的搞定一碗卖相好看，口感香软入味的啤酒烧土豆！
description_en: In just 30 minutes and a few simple steps, you can make a great-looking, tender and flavorful beer-braised potato dish!
tips_zh:
1、五花肉冷冻过后会比较好切成片。
2、土豆要选用黄心土豆，煮熟后比较软。
tips_en:
1. Chill the pork belly in the freezer first—it's easier to slice.
2. Use yellow-fleshed potatoes; they turn softer when cooked.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 土豆去皮切块浸泡在水中防止氧化；
steps.content_en: Peel and cut potatoes into pieces and soak in water to prevent oxidation;

steps.content_zh: 将肉片垫在饭煲底部；
steps.content_en: Place the meat slices on the bottom of the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 放入土豆和各种香料；
steps.content_en: Add potatoes and various spices;

steps.content_zh: 倒入啤酒、生抽和盐，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour in beer, light soy sauce and salt, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 完成后尝一下味道，如果不够入味可以放少许的生抽调味。
steps.content_en: Taste it after it's done. If it's not tasty enough, add a little soy sauce to taste.

description_zh: 《中华小当家》中龙虾三争霸决胜的一道菜，面对李严用存放十六年的极品干货炖煮的海龙锅，小当家使用自己家乡四川所常见的山珍野菜烹煮了一道宝山（山珍）飞龙（虾丸子）锅战胜对方。这是山的味道和海的味道的结合体，一锅汤底还可以用来涮海鲜。
description_en: In Cooking Master Boy, this is the dish that decided the lobster showdown. Facing Li Yan's Sea Dragon Pot made with premium ingredients aged sixteen years, Mao Xing used wild mountain vegetables from his Sichuan home to make a Treasure Mountain (mountain delicacies) Flying Dragon (shrimp balls) Pot and won. It combines the flavors of mountain and sea, and the broth can also be used to cook seafood.
tips_zh:
1、如果有高汤可以用高汤代替清水。
2、除了这些“山珍”，还能放入如山药、竹荪、竹笋等食材。
tips_en:
1. Use stock instead of water if you have it.
2. Besides these 'mountain delicacies,' you can add Chinese yam, bamboo fungus, or bamboo shoots.

steps.content_zh: 准备好鲜虾；
steps.content_en: Prepare fresh shrimp;

steps.content_zh: 去虾头与虾线；
steps.content_en: Remove shrimp heads and devein;

steps.content_zh: 加入一片生姜，剁成虾泥，加入少许盐和淀粉，顺着一个方向搅动上劲后放入冰箱中冷藏；
steps.content_en: Add a piece of ginger, chop into shrimp paste, add a little salt and starch, stir vigorously in one direction and put it in the refrigerator;

steps.content_zh: 蔬菜类清洗干净；杏鲍菇和香菇切片；
steps.content_en: Wash the vegetables; slice the king oyster and shiitake mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 将生姜、香菇、杏鲍菇和大葱放入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击手机上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put ginger, shiitake mushrooms, king oyster mushrooms and green onions into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark, click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余15分钟时取出虾泥，将虾泥握在手中，用虎口挤出丸子状，用勺子取下放入锅中；
steps.content_en: With 15 minutes left, take the shrimp paste in your hand, squeeze out balls between your thumb and index finger, and scoop them into the pot with a spoon;

steps.content_zh: 等虾丸浮起就煮好了；
steps.content_en: The shrimp balls are cooked when they float;

steps.content_zh: 放入金针菇和白玉菇继续煮；
steps.content_en: Add enoki and white beech mushrooms and keep cooking.

steps.content_zh: 最后放入盐、白胡椒粉调味即告完成。
steps.content_en: Finally, add salt and white pepper to taste—done.

description_zh: 没有猪儿朵的夏天，那肯定是既不完美又不完整的！炎炎夏日，总会想傍晚若是能来一盘猪耳朵、配上小酒喝两盅，小日子会有多惬意！操作方法挺简单，卤料也不复杂，自己就可以在家动手卤制一锅香喷喷的卤猪耳朵。
description_en: Summer without Zhuerduo is definitely neither perfect nor complete! In the hot summer, I always think about how pleasant my life would be if I could have a plate of pig ears and two glasses of wine in the evening! The operation method is quite simple and the braised ingredients are not complicated. You can braise a pot of fragrant braised pig ears at home.
tips_zh:
1、如果没有老卤水，参考卤鸭翅的食谱，开一锅卤水。或者可以购买李锦记卤水，超市中就有售。
2、如果猪耳朵上有毛，可以在火上稍微烤一下。
3、卤完剩下的卤汁，放入干净的容器中，冷却后放入冰箱中冷冻，下一次卤东西的时候使用。
tips_en:
1. If you don't have a master braising liquid, make one using the braised duck wings recipe, or buy Lee Kum Kee braising sauce from the supermarket.
2. If the pig ears have hairs, singe them briefly over a flame.
3. Store leftover braising liquid in a clean container, cool, and freeze for next time.

steps.content_zh: 准备好香料和猪耳朵；
steps.content_en: Prepare spices and pig ears;

steps.content_zh: 香料洗净，生姜切片后一起放入煲汤袋中；
steps.content_en: Wash the spices, slice the ginger, and put them together in a soup bag;

steps.content_zh: 取出冷冻的卤水，放入微波炉中解冻；
steps.content_en: Take out the frozen brine and defrost it in the microwave;

steps.content_zh: 猪耳朵焯水后洗净与卤水和香料包一起放入饭煲中，加入生抽、盐和料酒，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Blanch and rinse the pork ears, then place them in the rice cooker with the braising liquid and spice bag. Add light soy sauce, salt, and cooking wine, then tap Start Cooking on the app;

steps.content_zh: 卤好后在卤水中浸泡1小时后捞出，放入冰箱中冷藏；
steps.content_en: After brine, soak in brine for 1 hour, take it out and put it in the refrigerator;

steps.content_zh: 猪耳朵切条以后可以与芹菜、胡萝卜、煮花生米一起放入辣椒油、生抽等调味料凉拌；
steps.content_en: After cutting the pig ears into strips, you can add chili oil, light soy sauce and other seasonings together with celery, carrots, and boiled peanuts for cold dressing;

steps.content_zh: 完美！
steps.content_en: Perfect!

description_zh: 烹饪的过程中不加入水，肉质鲜嫩的童子鸡经过“按摩”后，与大量的葱姜与花雕酒一起炖成一份鲜美的酒香童子鸡，保持了鸡肉鲜嫩本味。
description_en: No water is added. The tender young chicken is 'massaged' and then stewed with plenty of scallion, ginger, and Huadiao wine, preserving its fresh, tender flavor.
tips_zh:
1、鸡一定要选择嫩一点的童子鸡，而且不要太大。
2、烹饪时不用加入水，除了料酒外鸡肉中本身的水分也会溢出来。
tips_en:
1. Use a young, tender chicken—and not too large.
2. No need to add water; the chicken releases its own juices along with the cooking wine.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 童子鸡洗净后用盐和胡椒粉揉搓后静置30分钟让鸡肉入味；
steps.content_en: Wash the young chicken, rub with salt and pepper, and let sit for 30 minutes to absorb the flavors;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片垫底，放上所有的香葱，再把鸡肉放上淋上花雕酒，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Place sliced ginger at the bottom, top with all the scallions and then the chicken, drizzle with Huadiao wine, and tap Start Cooking on your phone;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后取出，倒入适量的生抽，撒上辣椒圈、香菜和花椒，烧一锅热油淋在辣椒和花椒上；
steps.content_en: After cooking is completed, take it out, pour an appropriate amount of light soy sauce, sprinkle with chili rings, coriander and Sichuan peppercorns, heat a pot of hot oil and pour it on the chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns;

steps.content_zh: 一道肉质鲜嫩，原汁原味的童子鸡就做好啦。
steps.content_en: A dish of chicken with tender meat and original flavor is ready.

description_zh: 消暑冰粥，拯救没胃口的你。酸酸甜甜的芒果，搭配入口顺滑的糯米粥，一碗下肚，身体里停留一天的“戾气”就这样消散了。
description_en: Cool off the heat with ice porridge and save you from losing your appetite. The sweet and sour mango is paired with the smooth glutinous rice porridge. After one bowl, the "violent energy" that has stayed in the body for a day will dissipate.
tips_zh:
1、冰粥虽好但是不要贪凉一次性吃太多哦，容易造成肠胃不适。
2、还可以加入红豆或者其他杂粮一起煮。
tips_en:
1. Although ice porridge is good, don’t be greedy for coldness and eat too much at one time, as it may easily cause gastrointestinal discomfort.
2. You can also add red beans or other grains to cook together.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前洗净用水泡发2小时以上；
steps.content_en: Wash the glutinous rice in advance and soak it in water for more than 2 hours;

steps.content_zh: 将大米洗净同泡好的糯米一起放入锅胆；加水至水位线：稠粥3/4的位置；点击手机屏幕是开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and put it into the pot together with the soaked glutinous rice; add water to the water level: 3/4 of the thick porridge; tap the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 煮粥的时候将芒果去皮去核，切成小块；
steps.content_en: While cooking the porridge, peel and pit the mango and cut into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 将一半的芒果肉用料理机打成果酱；
steps.content_en: Puree half of the mango pulp into jam in a food processor;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，加入芒果酱和冰糖搅拌融化；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add mango puree and rock sugar, and stir until dissolved;

steps.content_zh: 自然冷却后可放入冰箱冷藏；吃之前可加入新鲜的芒果肉。
steps.content_en: After natural cooling, it can be placed in the refrigerator; fresh mango pulp can be added before eating.

description_zh: 猪舌肉质富有弹性，不像卤肉口感会比较柴。卤汁没有过多的香料，味道不复杂却能最恰当的配合猪舌本身的质地。
description_en: The meat of pork tongue is elastic, unlike braised pork, which has a thicker texture. The marinade does not have too many spices, and the taste is not complex but can best match the texture of the pork tongue itself.
tips_zh: 如果没有老卤水参考卤鸭翅的配料，开一锅卤水，并每次卤好后放入冰箱中冷冻，以便下次继续使用，卤水是越用越香的。
tips_en: If you don’t have old brine, refer to the ingredients for braised duck wings, boil a pot of brine, and freeze it in the refrigerator after each brine, so that you can continue to use it next time. The more you use the brine, the more fragrant it becomes.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 取出上次卤猪耳朵后放入冰箱冷冻的卤水，放入微波炉中解冻；
steps.content_en: Take out the brine from the last braised pig ears, put it in the frozen brine from the refrigerator, and defrost it in the microwave;

steps.content_zh: 猪舌焯水后冲洗干净，与卤水、香料一起放入饭煲中，加入调料，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pig tongue, rinse it, put it into the rice cooker together with the brine and spices, add the seasonings, and click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后将猪舌捞出，可以趁热切片后淋上一些卤汁，也可以冷却后当凉菜食用。用好的卤水冷却后放入干净的容器中，放到冰箱中冷冻。
steps.content_en: After cooking, remove the pork tongue. Slice it hot and drizzle with braising liquid, or cool and serve as a cold dish. Cool the used braising liquid, pour into a clean container, and freeze it.

description_zh: 兔子造型的馒头，肯定会让小盆友们爱不释手，平常不愿意吃的白面馒头也会多吃一个。
description_en: The rabbit-shaped steamed buns will definitely make little friends put it down. They will also eat one more white-flour steamed buns that they usually don’t want to eat.
tips_zh:
1、红豆作为装饰，还没有蒸熟，不建议食用；
2、烹饪时间完成后不要着急取出，焖一会面团不会回缩。
tips_en:
1. The red beans are only for decoration and are not fully cooked—don't eat them.
2. Don't take it out as soon as cooking finishes; let it sit so the dough doesn't shrink.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 面粉和酵母混合均匀，缓缓加入清水搅拌，揉成表面光滑的面团；
steps.content_en: Mix the flour and yeast evenly, gradually add water while stirring, and knead into a smooth dough;

steps.content_zh: 盖上湿润的布发酵1小时左右，冬天要隔着温水发酵；
steps.content_en: Cover with a damp cloth and ferment for about 1 hour. In winter, ferment with warm water;

steps.content_zh: 发酵到原来的2倍大左右，按下去不会反弹的状态；
steps.content_en: Ferment until it is about 2 times its original size and will not rebound when pressed;

steps.content_zh: 取出，排气后平均分成5份，每份60克；
steps.content_en: Take it out, deflate it and divide it into 5 equal portions, each portion is 60 grams;

steps.content_zh: 揉成粗细均匀，长约35厘米的长条状；
steps.content_en: Roll into an even log about 35 cm long;

steps.content_zh: 对折，将香肠放到面条的上半部分；
steps.content_en: Fold in half and place sausage on top half of noodles;

steps.content_zh: 如图所示将下面的面团绕着香肠插入；
steps.content_en: Insert the dough below around the sausage as shown;

steps.content_zh: 用红豆当眼睛，整形后静置5分钟左右；
steps.content_en: Use red beans as eyes and let them sit for about 5 minutes after shaping;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度点击开始烹饪，约6分钟后水烧开；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 3 mark, tap Start Cooking, and the water will boil in about 6 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 水沸腾后将蒸笼放入锅中，3升饭煲的蒸笼可以放俩，4升饭煲的蒸笼可以放仨；
steps.content_en: Once the water boils, place the steamer in the pot; the 3 L cooker's steamer holds two, the 4 L holds three;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后继续焖3分钟。
steps.content_en: Continue steaming for 3 minutes after cooking.

description_zh: 40℃的夏日，闷热不堪。正值水蜜桃大量上市的的季节，煮一锅水蜜桃糖水，兑上红茶，放两块冰，一口闷下去甭提有多爽了。
description_en: In the sweltering 40°C summer, when juicy peaches are in season, make a pot of peach syrup, mix it with black tea, add a couple of ice cubes, and take a sip—pure bliss.
tips_zh: 不要一次性饮用过多的凉饮料，防止拉肚子。
tips_en: Do not drink too many cold drinks at one time to prevent diarrhea.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 水蜜桃洗净去核切片；
steps.content_en: Wash, pit, and slice the peach;

steps.content_zh: 柠檬切片；
steps.content_en: Slice the lemon;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的水蜜桃放入锅胆，加入适量的冰糖，加水至水位线：稠粥1/2的位置。点击手机屏幕开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Place the sliced peaches in the inner pot, add some rock sugar and water up to the water line: Thick Porridge ½. Tap Start Cooking on your phone's screen.

steps.content_zh: 将红茶用开水沏好，备用；
steps.content_en: Make black tea with boiling water and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后先不要开盖，盖着盖子焖20分钟，开盖时加几滴柠檬汁并搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: After cooking, keep the lid on and let stand for 20 minutes. Then open, add a few drops of lemon juice, and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 取煮出来的汤汁，和茶水按照自己的口味随意调配。自然冷却后可放入冰箱冷藏，喝之前可加入一片切好柠檬和水蜜桃片。
steps.content_en: Take the boiled soup and mix it with tea according to your own taste. After cooling naturally, you can put it in the refrigerator and add a slice of lemon and peach slices before drinking.

description_zh: 红豆那甜甜绵绵的味道简直爽歪歪再加上色彩丰富、口感Q弹的芋圆那感觉别提有多满足了。
description_en: The sweet, creamy taste of adzuki beans is simply delightful, and with colorful, chewy taro balls it is incredibly satisfying.
tips_zh:
1、最正宗的做法是用木薯粉做成芋圆，但是比较麻烦使用糯米粉会节约很多时间。
2、加水揉糯米粉团的时候不要一次性加太多，慢慢加入揉成软硬适中的状态。
tips_en:
1. The most authentic way is to use cassava flour to make taro balls, but it is more troublesome to use glutinous rice flour and it will save a lot of time.
2. When adding water to knead the glutinous rice dough, do not add too much at one time. Add it slowly and knead it into a moderately soft and hard state.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 红豆洗净后在清水中浸泡至少2小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the adzuki beans and soak in water for at least 2 hours;

steps.content_zh: 红薯和紫薯洗净后放入饭煲的蒸笼或者其他蒸锅中蒸熟大约30分钟，红薯太大可以切开蒸；
steps.content_en: Wash the sweet potatoes and purple sweet potatoes, then steam them in the rice cooker steamer or another steamer for about 30 minutes; cut large sweet potatoes into pieces first.

steps.content_zh: 红豆浸泡后倒入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥-¾的刻度，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Soak the red beans and pour them into the pot. Add water to the water level: thick porridge - ¾. Click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 紫薯蒸好后去皮，用勺子压成泥；
steps.content_en: After steaming the purple sweet potatoes, peel them and mash them into puree with a spoon;

steps.content_zh: 加入100克糯米粉一边搅拌一边缓缓倒入清水，不要一次性倒入太多水；
steps.content_en: Add 100 grams of glutinous rice flour and slowly pour in water while stirring. Do not pour too much water at once;

steps.content_zh: 揉成光滑的团子；
steps.content_en: Knead into smooth dough;

steps.content_zh: 红薯同样处理；
steps.content_en: Prepare the sweet potato the same way;

steps.content_zh: 揉成长条；
steps.content_en: Roll into a long log;

steps.content_zh: 切成小段后揉成小圆子状；
steps.content_en: Cut into small pieces and roll into small balls;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余20分钟的时候，打开电饭煲放入小圆子和冰糖后继续焖煮到结束；
steps.content_en: When there are 20 minutes left in the cooking time, open the rice cooker, add the dumplings and rock sugar and continue to simmer until the end;

steps.content_zh: 完成后尝一下甜度，如果不够甜再适当的增添糖；
steps.content_en: Taste the sweetness when it's done. If it's not sweet enough, add more sugar.

steps.content_zh: 冷藏后味道更佳哦。
steps.content_en: It tastes better after being refrigerated.

description_zh: 酸辣汤如其名，又酸又辣，喝完之后神清气爽。除了粉丝还有各种料，好点的牛肉多一些，一般都会漂几个油面筋。想要开胃，就要喝一碗酸辣汤，配上一个卤蛋或着一只卤鸡腿已经足够对付一顿饭了。
description_en: Hot and sour soup lives up to its name—sour, spicy and refreshing. It's full of ingredients besides glass noodles, with extra beef in better versions and fried gluten balls on top. For an appetite boost, a bowl with a braised egg or drumstick makes a full meal.
tips_zh:
1、酸辣度根据个人的口味调节。
2、加醋一定要到临近出锅才加入，不然随着不断加热醋味会挥发。
tips_en:
1. Adjust the sourness and spiciness to taste.
2. Add the vinegar only just before serving—otherwise the flavor cooks off.

ingredients.name_en: Sweet potato starch or mung bean starch

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 粉丝、香菇、木耳提前用温水泡发；
steps.content_en: Soak the glass noodles, shiitake mushrooms and wood ear mushrooms in warm water in advance;

steps.content_zh: 千张切丝，牛肉切片，泡好的香菇、木耳切丝，面筋切小块，朝天椒切圈，香菜切碎备用；
steps.content_en: Shred Qianzhang, slice beef, shred soaked mushrooms and fungus, cut gluten into small pieces, cut chili into rings, chop coriander and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的香菇和木耳放入锅内，加水至水位线：稠粥2/3的刻度，盖上锅盖；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the chopped mushrooms and fungus into the pot, add water to the water level: 2/3 of the thick porridge, cover the pot lid; click on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余10分钟时打开锅盖放入除牛肉和香菜外的所有食材；
steps.content_en: When 10 minutes remain in the program, open the lid and add all ingredients except the beef and cilantro;

steps.content_zh: 淀粉加入清水做成水淀粉；
steps.content_en: Mix the starch with water to make a slurry;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余3分钟时打开锅盖加入水淀粉勾芡，并加入生抽、老抽和醋，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: When 3 minutes remain, open the lid, add a cornstarch slurry to thicken, then add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce and vinegar; stir well;

steps.content_zh: 根据个人口味加入适量的盐、鸡精、香油、五香粉调味；放入牛肉，撒上香菜，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Season with salt, chicken bouillon, sesame oil, and five-spice powder to taste; add the beef, sprinkle with cilantro, and enjoy.

ingredients.name_en: Sweet potato starch or mung bean starch

description_zh: 银鱼是闻名遐迩的“太湖三白”之一，也是无锡人餐桌上的常客，它头尾甚小，无骨无鳞，肉嫩味鲜。银鱼和鸡蛋是绝配，既然夏天到了，不妨就做个汤好好品味一番吧。
description_en: Icefish is one of the famous 'Three Whites of Lake Tai' and a regular on Wuxi dining tables. With a tiny head and tail, no bones and no scales, it has tender flesh and a delicious taste. Icefish and eggs are a perfect match; now that summer is here, why not make a soup and savor it?
tips_zh:
1、蛋液一定要在水烧开时倒入。
2、可以根据个人口味加入榨菜、紫菜等食材。
tips_en:
1. Pour in the beaten egg only when the water is boiling.
2. Add pickled mustard greens or seaweed to taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 干银鱼泡发洗净后，加水至水位线：稠粥1的位置；点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: After soaking and washing the dried whitebait, add water to the water level: thick porridge 1; click the start cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 香菜洗净，切碎；
steps.content_en: Wash and chop coriander;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋放入容器，打散；
steps.content_en: Put the eggs in a container and beat;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余2分钟时将蛋液均匀，缓慢的倒入锅胆，并不停搅拌；
steps.content_en: When there are 2 minutes left in the program, pour the egg liquid evenly into the pot slowly and stir constantly;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后可根据个人口味加入适量的胡椒粉、盐、鸡精、香油调味，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with pepper, salt, chicken bouillon, and sesame oil to taste. Enjoy!

name_en: Chilled Oat and Mung Bean Congee
description_zh: 这么热的天，没有清凉的绿豆粥怎么行？若是再往里面加点燕麦片，那就更加健康了，搭配上炼奶、蜂蜜和冰块，这个夏天就靠它啦。
description_en: On a hot day, how can you skip cooling mung bean porridge? Add oats for extra health, then top with condensed milk, honey and ice—your summer savior.
tips_zh:
1、燕麦用的是生的燕麦片，如果用整粒的燕麦米那么就要提前浸泡。
2、肠胃不好的人群不宜一次性食用过多。
3、蜂蜜和炼乳根据个人口味放入。
tips_en:
1. Use raw rolled oats; if using whole oat kernels, soak them first.
2. Those with sensitive stomachs shouldn't eat too much at once.
3. Add honey and condensed milk to taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 燕麦和绿豆洗净，放入锅胆；加水至水位线：稠粥1的位置；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the oats and mung beans and put them in the inner pot; add water to the thick porridge level 1 line; tap Start Cooking on the app;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后待自然冷却后放入冰箱冷藏2小时；
steps.content_en: After cooking, let it cool naturally, then refrigerate for 2 hours;

steps.content_zh: 根据个人口味加入适量的蜂蜜和炼乳，如果想要更凉快还可以放上冰块。
steps.content_en: Add honey and condensed milk to taste; for extra coolness, add some ice cubes.

name_en: Shiitake and Minced Pork Braised Rice
description_zh: 颗颗饱满的米饭中充斥的浓郁的香菇味和淡淡的海鲜味，同时还有煸炒好的猪肉不会让米饭的味道太单调。有饭有菜只要刷一个锅，相当的方便。
description_en: Every plump grain of rice is infused with rich shiitake aroma and a subtle seafood flavor, while the stir-fried pork keeps it from being one-dimensional. With both rice and dishes in one pot, there's only one pot to wash - very convenient.
tips_zh:
1、因为大米是浸泡过的，已经吸收了水分，所以后面加水不要加太多，与米齐平即可。
2、猪肉最好要有肥有瘦的五花肉，这样吃起来会让米饭有猪油的香味，又不会太油腻。
tips_en:
1. Since the rice has been soaked and absorbed water, don't add too much more—just enough to cover it.
2. Use pork belly with both fat and lean meat; it gives the rice a lardy aroma without being greasy.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 香菇提前洗净用温水泡发；
steps.content_en: Wash the mushrooms in advance and soak them in warm water;

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净浸泡30分钟，滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and soak it for 30 minutes, then drain the water;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉切丁、香菇切丁、大葱切断、姜切片，泡香菇的水留用；
steps.content_en: Dice the pork belly, dice the mushrooms, cut the green onions, slice the ginger, and reserve the water for soaking the mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅起油，油热后加入葱段和姜片，煸炒至金黄色，有葱油的香味溢出；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a wok; once hot, add scallion segments and ginger slices and stir-fry until golden and the scallion oil is fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 下入五花肉抄至变色、出油，然后下入香菇和虾皮炒出香味；
steps.content_en: Add the pork belly and cook until it changes color and becomes oily, then add the mushrooms and dried shrimps and stir-fry until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 下入洗净的大米和所有调料以及适量的泡香菇的水；
steps.content_en: Add the washed rice, all seasonings and an appropriate amount of water for soaking the mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 翻炒均匀后盛出；
steps.content_en: Stir well and take out;

steps.content_zh: 炒好的大米倒入锅胆并加水与食材齐平，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the stir-fried rice into the inner pot, add water to level with the ingredients, and tap 'Start Cooking' on your phone;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后搅拌下打散，尝尝味道，如果不够再放入少许盐和鸡精调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, stir and break up, taste, if not enough, add a little salt and chicken essence to taste;

steps.content_zh: 美味出锅，尽情享用吧。
steps.content_en: Delicious and ready — enjoy!

description_zh: 夏日易燥，这时就可以吃点莲子来安神。莲子可以入药，不过它更多时候的角色是食物，如煮粥、做甜品，它最被人熟知的功效就是养心安神。
description_en: It’s easy to get dry in summer, so you can eat some lotus seeds to calm your nerves. Lotus seeds can be used as medicine, but they are more often used as food, such as cooking porridge and making desserts. Its most well-known effect is to nourish the heart and calm the mind.
tips_zh:
1、莲子心非常苦，务必要去掉。
2、如果是新鲜莲子则不用浸泡这个步骤。
tips_en:
1. Lotus seeds are very bitter and must be removed.
2. If it is fresh lotus seeds, there is no need to soak this step.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 莲子提前洗净用水泡发2小时以上，去掉莲子心；
steps.content_en: Wash the lotus seeds in advance, soak them in water for more than 2 hours, and remove the lotus seeds;

steps.content_zh: 将泡好的莲子和冰糖一起放入锅胆；加水至水位线：稠粥1/2的位置；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the soaked lotus seeds and rock sugar into the pot; add water to the water level: 1/2 of the thick porridge; click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后，自然冷却；
steps.content_en: Let it cool naturally after cooking;

steps.content_zh: 可放入冰箱冷藏后享用味道更佳。
steps.content_en: It will taste better after being chilled in the refrigerator.

name_en: Barley and mixed fruit ice porridge
description_zh: 生活中，不少朋友都很喜欢食用麦仁。麦仁的营养价值非常丰富，它富含纤维素、蛋白质及少量矿物质，不仅能够帮助肠道消化，里面含有的丰富营养和食物纤维还能有效提供身体内的能量，对于身体排毒也有一定的帮助。用大麦仁来煮粥，加上各种自己喜爱的水果，淋上蜂蜜或者果酱，美味美观又营养。
description_en: In life, many friends like to eat wheat kernels. Wheat kernels are very rich in nutritional value. They are rich in fiber, protein and a small amount of minerals. They not only help intestinal digestion, but also contain rich nutrients and dietary fiber that can effectively provide energy in the body and help detoxify the body. Use barley kernels to cook porridge, add a variety of your favorite fruits, and drizzle with honey or jam. It is delicious, beautiful and nutritious.
tips_zh: 水果可以根据个人喜好放入。
tips_en: Add fruit to taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大麦仁和大米洗净，放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥1的位置；点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the barley kernels and rice, put them into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge 1; click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 煮粥的时候将水果洗净，去皮，切成果粒备用；
steps.content_en: While cooking the porridge, wash, peel, and dice the fruit;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后根据个人口味加入适量的蜂蜜或冰糖调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add honey or rock sugar to taste;

steps.content_zh: 自然冷却后放入冰箱冷藏2小时，撒上果粒，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Let cool naturally, then refrigerate for 2 hours, sprinkle with fruit pieces, and enjoy.

description_zh: 馒头是中国人早餐餐桌上常见的一样点心，补充碳水化合物与蛋白质满足一上午的能量。围绕着馒头也可以花些巧心思，加点燕麦增添嚼劲，加点牛奶让馒头奶味浓郁。
description_en: Mantou (steamed buns) are a common breakfast staple in China, providing carbs and protein for morning energy. Get creative by adding oats for chewiness or milk for a richer flavor.
tips_zh:
1、馒头放入蒸笼的时候注意，每个馒头之间要保留足够的空隙，因为后面蒸的时候它们还会长大；
2、馒头放入蒸笼再发酵的时长取决于你那里的室温，大概会是半小时到1个小时。
tips_en:
1. When placing the steamed buns in the steamer, be careful to leave enough space between each bun, because they will grow when steamed later;
2. The length of time you put the steamed buns in the steamer to ferment depends on the room temperature where you live, and it will probably take half an hour to an hour.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 面粉倒入容器，加入酵母和白砂糖；
steps.content_en: Pour the flour into a container and add yeast and white sugar;

steps.content_zh: 一边加入牛奶一边搅拌，搅拌成絮状，然后揉成面团；
steps.content_en: Add milk while stirring, stir until fluffy, and then knead into dough;

steps.content_zh: 加入燕麦，再次将面团揉均匀；
steps.content_en: Add oats and knead the dough evenly again;

steps.content_zh: 再次将面团揉均匀，包上保鲜膜；
steps.content_en: Knead the dough evenly again and wrap it in plastic wrap;

steps.content_zh: 大约40分钟后，面团变成两倍大后，将面团擀成薄饼；
steps.content_en: After about 40 minutes, when the dough has doubled in size, roll the dough into a pancake;

steps.content_zh: 将薄饼叠起来，盖上保鲜膜醒20分钟；
steps.content_en: Fold the pancakes, cover with plastic wrap and rest for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 再次擀成薄饼，然后从边上上卷起来；
steps.content_en: Roll out into a thin pancake again, then roll up from the sides;

steps.content_zh: 将面卷切成小块，盖上保鲜膜再醒一会，同时锅中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度；点击手机点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Cut the roll into small pieces, cover it with plastic wrap and let it rest for a while. At the same time, add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice -2 mark; click on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 蒸笼中放上纱布，将生馒头放入蒸笼中，约6分钟后水烧开，将蒸笼放入饭煲中；
steps.content_en: Place gauze in the steamer and put in the raw mantou; after the water boils (about 6 minutes), place the steamer in the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后不要立即开盖，焖一会。
steps.content_en: After cooking, don't open the lid right away; let it rest a while.

name_en: Yellow peach and lotus seed soup
description_zh: 又到了吃莲子的季节，夏食莲子古已有之。小小的莲子却是安神的佳品，搭配上黄桃和大枣无论从口味还是色泽都十分诱人。
description_en: It’s the season of eating lotus seeds again. Eating lotus seeds in summer has been around since ancient times. The small lotus seeds are a good way to soothe the nerves. Paired with yellow peaches and jujubes, they are very attractive in terms of taste and color.
tips_zh: 莲子心很苦记得去掉。
tips_en: Remember to get rid of lotus seeds if they are very painful.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 莲子提前洗净用水泡发2小时去心；
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the lotus seeds for 2 hours in advance, then remove the cores;

steps.content_zh: 大枣洗净，去核，切丁，黄桃去皮，去核，切丁；
steps.content_en: Wash the jujubes, remove the pits and dice them; peel the yellow peaches, remove the pits and cut them into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 将泡好的莲子、切好的大枣和冰糖一起放入锅胆；加水至水位线：稠粥1/2的位置；手机点击开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the soaked lotus seeds, cut jujubes and rock sugar into the pot together; add water to the water level: 1/2 of the thick porridge; click on the start cooking icon on your mobile phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 剩余20分钟时，开盖加入切好的黄桃，并搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: When 20 minutes are left, open the lid, add the chopped yellow peaches, and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成自然冷却后可放入冰箱冷藏；
steps.content_en: After cooking and cooling naturally, refrigerate;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 即使是土豆泥，它也可以有着冰淇淋般的爽滑口感，有着丰富的奶香。小小一勺，就拥有夏日微风般的奇妙感觉。
description_en: Even mashed potatoes can be as silky as ice cream, rich with milky flavor. One little spoonful feels like a summer breeze.
tips_zh:
1、土豆一定要带皮煮，不然就煮散了。
2、还可以放入奶油和芝士增加香味哦。
tips_en:
1. Boil the potatoes with their skins on, or they'll fall apart.
2. Add cream and cheese for extra richness.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 土豆洗净，放入锅胆；加水至刚好没过土豆点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Wash the potatoes and put them into the pot; add water until just enough to cover the potatoes. Click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 40分钟后土豆煮熟；
steps.content_en: After 40 minutes the potatoes are cooked;

steps.content_zh: 过凉水后，很容易就能把皮去掉；
steps.content_en: After running in cold water, the skin can be easily removed;

steps.content_zh: 压成泥；
steps.content_en: pressed into mud;

steps.content_zh: 加入牛奶、盐和少许黑胡椒调味；
steps.content_en: Add milk, salt and a pinch of black pepper to taste;

steps.content_zh: 将土豆泥装入裱花袋中，裱出造型，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Put the mashed potatoes into a piping bag, decorate and enjoy.

name_en: Black rice and coconut milk iced porridge
description_zh: 学会这道冰粥以后都不用去鲜芋仙啦。煮好的黑米粥，冷藏后淋上香浓的椰浆，自己动手也能做出甜品店的味道！
description_en: Once you learn this iced porridge, you won't need to visit the dessert shop. Cook black rice porridge, chill it and drizzle with creamy coconut milk—dessert-shop flavor made at home!

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 黑米洗净，用水浸泡4小时以上；
steps.content_en: Wash the black rice and soak in water for at least 4 hours;

steps.content_zh: 将泡好的黑米和洗净的大米放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥1的位置，点击手机屏幕上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the soaked black rice and washed rice into the pot, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后可根据个人口味加入适量的蜂蜜或冰糖调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add honey or rock sugar to taste;

steps.content_zh: 自然冷却后放入冰箱冷藏2小时；滴入椰浆，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: After cooling naturally, refrigerate for 2 hours; add coconut milk and enjoy.

name_en: Fermented rice and egg drop soup
description_zh: 醪糟甘甜芳醇，能刺激消化腺，增进食欲，有助消化。醪糟含有十多种氨基酸，其中有8种是人体不能合成而又必需的。每升米酒中赖氨酸的含量比葡萄酒和啤酒要高出数倍，为世界上其它营养酒类中所罕见的，因此人们称其为“液体蛋糕”。这款甜品对女人更是大补，做月子的女性尤其适合服用。
description_en: The glutinous rice is sweet and aromatic, can stimulate the digestive glands, increase appetite, and aid digestion. Fermented glutinous rice contains more than ten kinds of amino acids, 8 of which cannot be synthesized by the human body but are necessary. The lysine content per liter of rice wine is several times higher than that of wine and beer, which is rare among other nutritional wines in the world, so people call it "liquid cake". This dessert is a great tonic for women, and it is especially suitable for women undergoing confinement.
tips_zh:
1、米酒不宜久煮，不然味道会变酸；
2、甜度根据个人口味调节；
3、除了葡萄干还可以加入枸杞、红枣等食材。
tips_en:
1. Don't cook the rice wine too long, or it will turn sour.
2. Adjust the sweetness to taste.
3. Besides raisins, you can add goji berries or red dates.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：稠粥-½的刻度，点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the thick porridge - ½ mark, then tap Start Cooking;

steps.content_zh: 煮水的时候将淀粉加水调成淀粉糊；
steps.content_en: When boiling water, add starch to water to make a starch paste;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋打散；
steps.content_en: Beat the eggs;

steps.content_zh: 约6分钟后水烧开，倒入淀粉糊搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: After about 6 minutes the water boils; pour in the starch slurry and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 倒入蛋液，搅拌成蛋花；
steps.content_en: Pour in the egg liquid and stir into egg droplets;

steps.content_zh: 倒入米酒后加入糖搅拌即可；
steps.content_en: Pour in rice wine, add sugar and stir;

steps.content_zh: 最后撒上葡萄干就能享用啦。
steps.content_en: Finally, sprinkle with raisins and enjoy.

description_zh: 在夏天，冬瓜是餐桌上的常客，煮出的肉丸紧实光滑，劲道Q弹，冬瓜清爽可口。肉丸煮熟后流出的动物油让汤汁的味道更鲜美可口。
description_en: In summer, winter melon is a frequent guest on the table: the meatballs turn firm and smooth, springy and chewy, while the melon stays refreshing. Fat released from the meatballs makes the broth even more delicious.
tips_zh:
1、除了盐和白胡椒粉不用加入其它的调料，会影响汤清淡的口感。
2、冬瓜要切薄一点，容易煮熟。
tips_en:
1. Don't add seasonings other than salt and white pepper—they'll spoil the light flavor of the soup.
2. Slice the winter melon thinly so it cooks easily.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切成末、小葱切成葱花；肉末中加入1枚鸡蛋、生姜末、一半的葱花和淀粉，放入少许盐调味，朝着一个方向搅打上劲；
steps.content_en: Cut the ginger into mince and the shallot into chopped green onion; add 1 egg, minced ginger, half of the chopped green onion and starch to the minced meat, add a little salt to taste, and beat vigorously in one direction;

steps.content_zh: 做成肉丸后放入冰箱中冷藏备用；
steps.content_en: Form into meatballs and refrigerate until ready to use;

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜切薄片；
steps.content_en: Cut winter melon into thin slices;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：稠粥-¾的刻度，点击手机屏幕开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level: thick porridge - ¾ mark, click the start cooking icon on the phone screen to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 约10分钟后水烧开，用勺子将肉丸放入锅中，撇去浮沫；
steps.content_en: After about 10 minutes, the water will boil. Use a spoon to put the meatballs into the pot and skim off the foam;

steps.content_zh: 放入冬瓜继续煮到冬瓜变得半透明即可；
steps.content_en: Add the winter melon and continue cooking until the winter melon becomes translucent;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入盐和白胡椒粉调味，撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt and white pepper, then sprinkle with chopped scallion.

description_zh: 卤兰花干，美味的想不到，一口下去卤香四溢，Q弹有筋道。
description_en: The braised dried orchids are incredibly delicious. One bite is filled with braised aroma and chewy texture.
tips_zh:
1、兰花干是超市购买炸好的，动手能力强想挑战一下的同学可以用豆干油炸。
2、辣味根据个人口味自行调节，也可粘着辣酱吃。
tips_en:
1. Fried tofu flowers were store-bought and pre-fried; if you're feeling adventurous, deep-fry tofu yourself.
2. Adjust the heat to taste, or serve with chili sauce for dipping.

steps.content_zh: 准备好兰花干备用；
steps.content_en: Prepare dried orchids for later use;

steps.content_zh: 各种香料也准备好；
steps.content_en: Various spices are also prepared;

steps.content_zh: 将兰花干和香料一起放入锅中，加入清水没过食材倒入调料搅拌后点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the dried orchids and spices into the pot, add water to cover the ingredients, pour in the seasonings, stir, and then click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后让兰花干在锅中浸泡30分钟会更入味哦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, let the dried tofu knots soak in the pot for 30 minutes for deeper flavor.

description_zh: 大热天回到家里来一碗放在冰箱里冰镇着的黄桃罐头，好舒爽！制作过程也特别简单！
description_en: Coming home on a scorching day to a bowl of chilled canned yellow peaches—so refreshing! And it's incredibly easy to make.
tips_zh:
1、糖的多少决定了罐头能放多久，越浓就越不容易变质。
2、加盐是为了调节罐头的口味，会有更甜的口感。
3、一定要冷藏后再吃！！！这样黄桃口感才会比较爽口。
tips_en:
1. The sugar level determines how long the canned peaches keep—the sweeter, the less likely they spoil.
2. A pinch of salt balances the flavor and enhances the sweetness.
3. Be sure to chill before eating!!! That's when the yellow peaches taste their best.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 黄桃去皮去核后切成块放入饭煲中，加入水稍稍没过黄桃，放入冰糖和盐，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Peel and core the yellow peaches, then cut them into pieces and put them into a rice cooker. Add water to slightly cover the yellow peaches. Add rock sugar and salt. Click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪过程中准备好干净的容器；
steps.content_en: During cooking, prepare a clean container;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后的样子，糖水粘稠；
steps.content_en: After cooking, the sugar water is thick;

steps.content_zh: 如果做得多，就要立即放入罐头中，盖上盖子拧紧，冷却后由于气压差，罐头就是很密封的了。做得少一次能吃完的话就自然冷却后放冰箱冷藏；
steps.content_en: If making a large batch, put it in jars immediately and screw the lids on tight; as it cools, the pressure difference seals the jars. If making a small amount to finish at once, just cool and refrigerate.

steps.content_zh: 冷藏后就可以享用啦，味道完全不输给外面卖的。
steps.content_en: You can enjoy it after refrigeration. The taste is not inferior to the ones sold outside.

description_zh: 薏米性凉，具有利水、清热除燥的功效，冬瓜可以清热解毒、祛湿解暑，而老鸭汤可以滋五脏之阳、清虚劳之热、补血养胃。喝薏米冬瓜老鸭汤，清热祛湿又滋阴养颜。
description_en: Job's tears are cooling and help drain dampness and clear heat; winter melon clears heat, detoxifies and relieves summer dampness; old duck soup nourishes the organs, clears deficiency heat and replenishes blood. This soup clears heat, removes dampness and nourishes the skin.
tips_zh:
1、不去皮的冬瓜祛暑效果更好。
2、鸭子要用老鸭，才能炖出鲜美的汤。
tips_en:
1. Unpeeled winter melon has a better effect in dispelling heat.
2. Only old ducks can make delicious soup.

steps.content_zh: 薏米浸泡2小时左右；
steps.content_en: Soak the job's tears for about 2 hours;

steps.content_zh: 老鸭洗净后冷水入锅焯水后冲洗干净；
steps.content_en: Wash the old duck, blanch it in cold water, then rinse clean;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切块；
steps.content_en: Cut ginger into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 将老鸭、生姜和薏米同时放入饭煲中，加入清水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度；点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the duck, ginger and barley into the rice cooker at the same time, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark; click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜切片；
steps.content_en: Slice winter melon;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时放入冬瓜继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: When 30 minutes remain in the cooking time, add the winter melon and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入适量的盐调味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt to taste.

description_zh: 荷叶蒸鸡，鲜嫩肥美的鸡肉，经过蒸制，最大限度地保留了它的营养成份，肉质细嫩可口，滋味鲜醇，并伴有荷叶的甘美清香。
description_en: Steamed chicken with lotus leaf: steaming preserves the nutrients of the tender, succulent chicken, leaving it juicy and flavorful with the delicate sweetness and fragrance of lotus leaf.
tips_zh:
1、不要在锅中蒸米饭，荷叶的蒸出的荷叶汁水会渗入米饭中。
2、鸡肉要选择三黄鸡或童子鸡，既容易熟肉质又鲜嫩。
tips_en:
1. Do not steam rice in the pot. The lotus leaf juice from the steamed lotus leaves will seep into the rice.
2. For chicken, choose three-yellow chicken or baby chicken, which is easy to cook and tender.

steps.content_zh: 鸡肉清洗干净中在清水中浸泡30分钟，泡去血水；
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken and soak in clean water for 30 minutes to remove the blood;

steps.content_zh: 香菇泡发；
steps.content_en: Rehydrate the shiitake mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 浸泡好的鸡肉滤干水分，加入姜片、香葱、香叶、八角、香菇片、淀粉、蚝油、生抽腌制30分钟左右；
steps.content_en: Drain the soaked chicken, add ginger slices, chives, bay leaves, star anise, shiitake mushroom slices, starch, oyster sauce, and light soy sauce and marinate for about 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 干荷叶要用水浸泡洗净后使用，将腌制好的食材放入荷叶上；
steps.content_en: Dried lotus leaves should be soaked in water and washed before use. Put the pickled ingredients on the lotus leaves;

steps.content_zh: 包紧；
steps.content_en: wrap tightly;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度，将包好的荷叶鸡放入蒸笼中，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 3 mark, put the wrapped lotus leaf chicken in the steamer, and tap Start Cooking in the app to cook;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后就可以享用啦。
steps.content_en: Enjoy once cooking is complete!

description_zh: 冬瓜饭做法颇简单，相貌颇普通，但味道很惊艳！冬瓜的清甜与大米的软糯融合之后，会产生独特的清香，爽口甘甜，适合夏秋季节。
description_en: Winter melon rice is simple to make and looks ordinary, but tastes amazing! The melon's sweetness blends with the soft rice into a unique delicate aroma—refreshing and sweet, perfect for summer and autumn.
tips_zh: 水一定不要加多，与大米齐平就行啦，可以稍微多一点点。
tips_en: Don't add too much water—just level with the rice, perhaps a tiny bit more.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净浸泡30分钟；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and soak it for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 冬瓜去皮切成小丁、小葱切成葱花；
steps.content_en: Peel the winter melon and cut into small cubes, and cut the green onions into finely chopped green onions;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热后放少许食用油，倒入葱花煸香；
steps.content_en: After the wok is hot, add a little cooking oil, add chopped green onions and stir-fry;

steps.content_zh: 放入冬瓜和虾皮翻炒；
steps.content_en: Add winter melon and dried shrimp and stir-fry.

steps.content_zh: 将浸泡好的大米滤干水分，冬瓜炒到微微变色时倒入大米，放入少许盐搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Drain the soaked rice, stir-fry the winter melon until it changes color slightly, add the rice, add a little salt and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 炒好的大米倒入饭煲中，加入水与大米齐平即可，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the stir-fried rice into the cooker, add water to level with the rice, and tap 'Start Cooking' in the app;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后米饭打散，再搭配一个水波蛋就可以当做简简单单的一餐啦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, fluff the rice and serve with a poached egg for a simple meal.

description_zh: 不会说话的牛舌最深情。酱牛舌、卤牛舌、爆炒牛舌……每一道牛舌做的菜说起来都会让人流口水......
description_en: The dumb tongue is the most affectionate. Sauced beef tongue, braised beef tongue, stir-fried beef tongue... Every dish made with beef tongue will make people drool...
tips_zh:
1、如果购买的是没有修过的牛舌，表面会有一层硬皮，需要使用开水烫，然后再用冷水淋下就可以去皮了。
2、如果没有老卤水参考卤鸭翅的食谱制作一锅卤水可以一直使用。
3、卤好后过滤卤水，冷却后放入冰箱冷冻，下次使用时取出解冻使用。
tips_en:
1. If the beef tongue is untrimmed, it has a tough outer skin—blanch it in boiling water, then rinse with cold water and peel it off.
2. If you have no master braising liquid, make one using the braised duck wings recipe and reuse it indefinitely.
3. After braising, strain the liquid, cool, and freeze; thaw it for next time.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 牛舌焯水后冲洗干净；
steps.content_en: Blanch the beef tongue and rinse;

steps.content_zh: 将牛舌放入饭煲中，倒入卤水、香料和调料；点击App开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the beef tongue into the rice cooker, pour in the brine, spices and seasonings; click the App to start cooking icon to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后可以取出切片趁热享用，也可以冷却后当凉菜或者切片烤着吃。
steps.content_en: After cooking, you can take it out and slice it and enjoy it hot, or you can cool it and use it as a cold dish or slice it and bake it.

description_zh: 卤牛肚咬下去爽口弹牙。
description_en: The braised beef tripe is refreshing and chewy when you bite into it.
tips_zh:
1、食材若肉厚还需增加码味的环节，可放冰箱码味一夜，普通食材码味2小时也是去除异味的好方法。
2、我购买的是处理好的牛肚，如果是购买未处理的，需要处理牛肚，先上碱面，洗净后换白醋，再洗净后加淀粉，去掉筋筋皮皮等你觉得奇怪的东西。
3、没有老卤水可以参考我之前发的卤鸭翅的食谱，做一锅老卤水，经常卤一些都不用去卤菜店了。
tips_en:
1. Thick cuts of meat need extra marinating—overnight in the fridge works; even 2 hours helps ordinary ingredients lose any off-flavor.
2. I bought pre-cleaned beef tripe. If yours isn't cleaned, rub it with baking soda, wash, then rub with white vinegar, wash again, and rub with starch; remove any sinewy or odd bits.
3. If you lack a master braising liquid, use my braised duck wings recipe to make one—then you won't need the deli again.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 撕掉背面的膜；
steps.content_en: Peel off the membrane on the back;

steps.content_zh: 老卤水解冻；
steps.content_en: Thaw old brine;

steps.content_zh: 将处理好的牛肚放入饭煲中，加入香料、调料盒老卤水，如果卤水不够加一些清水即可，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the processed tripe into the rice cooker, add spices, seasoning box and old brine. If the brine is not enough, just add some water. Click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后就可以捞出切条享用啦，也可以冷却后凉拌。
steps.content_en: After cooking, take it out, cut into strips, and enjoy, or cool and serve as a cold salad.

description_zh: 每一粒米饭上都包裹着浓浓的紫菜味，一口下去都是大海的味道。
description_en: Every grain of rice is coated with rich seaweed flavor—each bite tastes of the ocean.
tips_zh: 将紫菜烘焙一下是为了让紫菜更香，同时还能容易捏碎，如果没有烤箱可以忽略这一步骤。
tips_en: Roasting the seaweed is to make the seaweed more fragrant and easy to crush. If you don't have an oven, you can ignore this step.

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净后浸泡；
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the rice;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉切薄片，洋葱切丝；
steps.content_en: Thinly slice the pork belly and shred the onion;

steps.content_zh: 香菇泡发后切丝；
steps.content_en: Rehydrate the shiitake mushrooms and julienne;

steps.content_zh: 紫菜在150℃的烤箱中烘5分钟，然后用手捏碎；
steps.content_en: Bake the seaweed in an oven at 150°C for 5 minutes, then crush it with your hands;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热后倒油，下五花肉小火煸炒；
steps.content_en: Heat the pan, add oil, and stir-fry the pork belly over low heat;

steps.content_zh: 当五花肉稍微焦黄时，放入洋葱炒香；
steps.content_en: When the pork belly is lightly browned, add onions and saute until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 下香菇丝翻炒；
steps.content_en: Add shredded shiitake mushrooms and stir-fry;

steps.content_zh: 浸泡的大米滤干水分后倒入锅中，放紫菜一起翻炒，倒入盐调味；
steps.content_en: Drain the soaked rice, put it in the pot, stir-fry with the nori, and season with salt;

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的米倒入饭煲中，加水没过食材1厘米左右，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the fried rice into the rice cooker, add water to cover the ingredients by about 1 cm, and click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后打散，尝一下味道是否够咸，如果不够再放入少许盐调味即可；
steps.content_en: After cooking, beat it lightly, taste, and add a little more salt if needed;

steps.content_zh: 出锅享用吧。搭配一个煎蛋就可以当一餐午饭啦。
steps.content_en: Serve and enjoy. Pair it with a fried egg for a complete lunch.

description_zh: 水蜜桃有美肤、清胃、润肺、祛痰等功效，与银耳同煮成银耳羹，更佳可以美容润肤、滋补身体。
description_en: Peach has the effects of beautifying the skin, clearing the stomach, moistening the lungs, and eliminating phlegm. When cooked together with Tremella fuciformis, it can be made into Tremella fuciformis soup, which is better for beautifying, moisturizing, and nourishing the body.
tips_zh:
1、挑选银耳的时候要挑黄色的，没有漂白的 。
2、银耳不充分浸泡不容易煮出胶质，可以根据个人喜好增加或减少焖煮的时间。
tips_en:
1. Choose yellowish, unbleached snow fungus.
2. If not soaked well, snow fungus won't release its gel; adjust the simmering time to taste.

steps.content_zh: 干银耳最好提前一晚上在冰箱中浸泡，这样更容易煮出胶质；
steps.content_en: It is best to soak the dried white fungus in the refrigerator one night in advance, so that it is easier to cook out the gelatin;

steps.content_zh: 水蜜桃去核切成厚片；
steps.content_en: Pit the peach and cut into thick slices;

steps.content_zh: 干枸杞洗净后浸泡；
steps.content_en: Wash and soak dried wolfberry;

steps.content_zh: 将浸泡好的银耳撕成小朵放入锅胆中，加入水蜜桃和冰糖，加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Tear the soaked Tremella into small florets and put them into the pot, add peaches and rock sugar, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark, click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时倒入枸杞继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: When 10 minutes of cooking time remain, add wolfberry and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 完成后趁热享用。
steps.content_en: Serve hot when done.

description_zh: 素食也可以很美味，海带作为性价比超高的食材，不仅营养价值高、健康还适合各种做法，红烧、凉拌、烧汤、卤味都不在话下。
description_en: Vegetarian food can be delicious too. Kelp is a great value ingredient — nutritious, healthy and versatile: braised, cold-tossed, in soup or in a braising liquid.
tips_zh:
1、海带结要浸泡后冲洗干净，里面可能会有泥沙。
辣度根据个人口味调节
tips_en:
1. Kelp knots should be soaked and rinsed as there may be sediment inside.
The spiciness can be adjusted according to personal taste

steps.content_zh: 海带要充分浸泡后滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Soak the kelp thoroughly, then drain;

steps.content_zh: 准备好香料；
steps.content_en: Prepare spices;

steps.content_zh: 将海带和香料都放入锅中，加入清水没过海带，倒入调味料搅拌均匀；点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the kelp and spices into the pot, add water to cover the kelp, pour in the seasonings and stir evenly; click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后将海带在卤水中浸泡30分钟，可以趁热吃，也可以冷却后放入冰箱冷藏后当凉菜或者小吃。
steps.content_en: After cooking, soak the kelp in the braising liquid for 30 minutes. Eat it hot, or chill it in the fridge as a cold dish or snack.

description_zh: 清晨起来看见家里有新采的木槿花，就想着做这道菜，电饭锅里煮下粥（大米小米糙米大麦红枣花生粥）后，开始准备炖蛋。木槿花具有清热利湿，凉血解毒的功效，红枣为滋阴补阳补血佳品 ，加一点可增加香味，也可不加。
description_en: Waking to see freshly picked hibiscus at home inspired this dish. Cook the porridge in the rice cooker (rice, millet, brown rice, barley, red dates, and peanuts), then prepare the steamed egg. Hibiscus clears heat, drains dampness, and cools the blood; red dates nourish yin and yang and build blood—a little adds fragrance, but can be omitted.
tips_zh: 蒸蛋时间和大家平时的一样，只是有的电饭煲较慢，根据具体情况调整。红枣可不加。
tips_en: The time for steaming eggs is the same as everyone usually does, except that some rice cookers are slower and can be adjusted according to the specific situation. Red dates can be omitted.

steps.content_zh: 准备食材，清洗红枣，把蛋打在碗里
steps.content_en: Prepare the ingredients, wash the red dates, and beat the eggs in a bowl

steps.content_zh: 将木槿花逐个掰开
steps.content_en: Break the hibiscus flowers one by one

steps.content_zh: 去除花萼花芯花蕊
steps.content_en: Remove calyx, core and stamens

steps.content_zh: 清洗
steps.content_en: Washing

steps.content_zh: 切碎
steps.content_en: chopped

steps.content_zh:
鸡蛋液加水，比例为1:3，水能多不能少，少了会老。
将木槿花和掰开的红枣放入鸡蛋液，加适量酱油和盐，搅拌均匀。
steps.content_en:
Mix the beaten eggs with water at a 1:3 ratio—use more water rather than less, or the eggs will turn tough.
Add the hibiscus flowers and torn red dates to the egg mixture, season with soy sauce and salt, and stir well.

steps.content_zh: 贴上保鲜膜或盖上盖子，蒸蛋会更嫩，再放入电饭煲蒸40分钟。我在前面已经说过，我先煮了粥，因此在最后40分钟的时候再打开电饭煲放入蒸蛋即可。
steps.content_en: Cover with plastic wrap or cover to make the steamed eggs more tender, then put them in the rice cooker and steam for 40 minutes. As I said before, I cooked the porridge first, so I opened the rice cooker and put in the steamed eggs during the last 40 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 蒸好后，揭开保鲜膜，木槿花浮在上面。红枣香扑鼻而来，红枣放的少，因此其甜味不明显。
steps.content_en: When done, remove the plastic wrap; the hibiscus flowers float on top. The aroma of red dates rises, though their sweetness is mild since only a few were used.

description_zh: 与红烧猪蹄相比，我更喜欢嚼劲十足卤猪蹄。经过卤水卤制然后浸泡过的猪蹄不像红烧猪蹄软烂，却也是相当入味。自己动手制作不含添加剂吃以来也更放心。
description_en: I prefer the chewy braised pork trotters to the braised pork trotters. The pig's trotters that have been marinated in brine and then soaked are not as soft as the braised pig's trotters, but they are still quite tasty. Making it yourself without additives makes you feel more confident when you eat it.
tips_zh:
1、卤制90分钟的时候猪蹄已经软烂但是表皮还是Q弹的，这个时候效果最佳。
2、喜欢吃辣的同学自行添加辣椒。
3、没有老卤水可以参考下卤鸭翅的食谱，做一锅卤水长期使用。或者也可以超市购买瓶装的卤水。
tips_en:
1. After marinating for 90 minutes, the pig's trotters are already soft but the skin is still elastic. This is the best time.
2. Students who like spicy food can add chili pepper by themselves.
3. If you don’t have old brine, you can refer to the recipe for braised duck wings and make a pot of brine for long-term use. Or you can buy bottled brine in the supermarket.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 猪蹄入冷水焯水，沸腾后煮3分钟，冲洗干净后滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pork trotters in cold water, boil for 3 minutes after it comes to a boil, then rinse and drain;

steps.content_zh: 放在冰箱中的卤水解冻后与猪蹄一起放入锅中，加入调料与香料，点击App上开始烹饪图标开始卤制；
steps.content_en: Thaw the braising liquid from the fridge, put it in the pot with the pig's trotters, add seasonings and spices, and tap Start Cooking in the app to braise.

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后将猪蹄浸泡在卤水中到冷却。就可以享用啦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, soak the pork trotters in brine until cool. You can enjoy it.

description_zh: 各种蔬菜融合，低脂肪高纤维，减肥清肠的一锅好汤。虽然只有蔬菜，但是味道不差哦。
description_en: A fusion of various vegetables, low in fat and high in fiber, a great soup for weight loss and bowel cleansing. Although there are only vegetables, the taste is not bad.
tips_zh: 意式番茄酱也就是意面酱，不要用番茄沙司代替。
tips_en: Italian tomato sauce is also pasta sauce, do not use tomato sauce instead.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将除了包心菜以外的食材切成大小均匀的丁；
steps.content_en: Cut all ingredients except cabbage into evenly sized dices;

steps.content_zh: 将切好蔬菜丁倒入饭煲中，加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the diced vegetables into the rice cooker, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark, click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪过程中将包心菜切碎，在烹饪时间剩余5分钟时倒入饭煲中继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: During cooking, chop the cabbage, and with 5 minutes left, add it to the rice cooker to continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后倒入番茄酱搅拌均匀后，加入少许的盐和胡椒粉调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, stir in tomato sauce, then season with a little salt and pepper;

steps.content_zh: 美味营养健康的一锅汤就做好了。
steps.content_en: A delicious, nutritious and healthy pot of soup is ready.

name_en: Lao Gan Ma steamed dried tofu with fermented black beans
description_zh: 蒸菜好吃不上火，所有汁水都锁在一盘菜肴中。经过蒸制的五花肉片，油脂已经流出渗入到豆干中，同时伴有老干妈的香味，下面煮饭上面蒸菜美味一锅出。
description_en: Steamed dishes are delicious and don't cause heatiness, with all the juices locked in one plate. Steamed pork belly slices release their fat into the dried tofu, along with the aroma of chili sauce — rice below, steamed dish above, a complete meal in one pot.
tips_zh:
1、如果用的是白豆干，要先将豆干卤一下，这样豆干才有味道，可以参考卤豆干的食谱。
2、食谱的程序是蒸煮的程序，也可以在煮饭的时候一起蒸。
tips_en:
1. If you are using dried white beans, you need to braise the dried beans first so that the dried beans have a flavor. You can refer to the recipe for braised dried beans.
2. The program of the recipe is a steaming program, and you can also steam it while cooking.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 五花肉洗净后切薄片，刀与豆干成45°片成薄片，这样这样豆干的接触面积大更容易入味，大蒜切成蒜末；
steps.content_en: Wash the pork belly and cut it into thin slices. Hold the knife and dried tofu at a 45° angle and slice into thin slices. This will allow the dried tofu to have a large contact area and make it easier to taste. Cut the garlic into minced garlic;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热后放入少许油，将五花肉煸炒出香味后倒入老干妈、剁椒、大蒜，翻炒后加入蒸鱼豉油煮沸即可；
steps.content_en: Heat a little oil in the pan, stir-fry the pork belly until fragrant, then add chili sauce, chopped chili, and garlic. Stir-fry, add steamed fish soy sauce, and bring to a boil.

steps.content_zh: 将豆干垫底，上面铺上炒好的五花肉后放入加好水的饭煲中，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Place the dried tofu on the bottom, put the fried pork belly on top and put it into a rice cooker filled with water. Click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后即可享用啦。
steps.content_en: Enjoy once cooking is complete!

name_en: Steamed Chicken Breast with Garlic Sauce
description_zh: 鸡胸肉因为含有大量的优质蛋白、少量的脂肪，所以在减肥餐中占据着举足轻重的地位。但是，由于脂肪含量低鸡胸肉很容易被做的干柴难以入口。那赶紧来试试这道蒸出来鸡胸肉，经过长时间的腌制和恰到时间蒸制后，鸡肉已经变得爽滑鲜美，简直和鱼肉有的一拼！
description_en: Chicken breast is a staple in weight-loss meals because it's high in quality protein and low in fat. However, its low fat content makes it easy to overcook into dry, tough meat. Try this steamed chicken breast—after long marinating and perfectly timed steaming, the meat turns tender and delicious, almost as good as fish!
tips_zh:
1、鸡肉腌制至少需要一个小时，不然蒸出来的鸡肉不嫩。
2、如果不喜欢蒜蓉的味道可以不放。
3、用鸡腿代替鸡胸味道更佳。
tips_en:
1. Marinate the chicken for at least an hour, or it won't be tender when steamed.
2. Skip the garlic if you don't like it.
3. Chicken thighs taste better than breasts here.

steps.content_zh: 鸡胸肉洗净后切丁；
steps.content_en: Wash and dice chicken breast;

steps.content_zh: 加入盐、黑胡椒和淀粉，搅拌均匀后入放入冰箱腌制1小时，当然时间越久越好吃；
steps.content_en: Add salt, black pepper and starch, mix well and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Of course, the longer the time, the better;

steps.content_zh: 大蒜剁成蒜蓉；
steps.content_en: Chop the garlic into minced garlic;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅烧热后滴入少许橄榄油，倒入蒜蓉小火炒香，变色后即可关火；
steps.content_en: Heat the pan, add a little olive oil, and stir-fry the minced garlic over low heat until fragrant; turn off the heat once it changes color.

steps.content_zh: 取出腌制好的鸡胸肉，平铺在盘子底部，在上面撒上炒好的蒜蓉，锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，将盘子放在蒸笼中，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Take out the marinated chicken breast, lay it flat on the bottom of the plate, sprinkle the fried garlic on top, add water to the pot to the water level: northeast rice -2 mark, place the plate in the steamer, click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好的样子；
steps.content_en: How it looks when steamed;

steps.content_zh: 取出后就可以享用啦，嫩到没朋友。
steps.content_en: You can enjoy it after taking it out, it is so tender that it has no friends.

description_zh:
减脂增肌的不二法门，那就是鸡胸肉。如何做的好吃也是一门学问，清蒸不同于水煮，还保留着鸡肉中的水分，不会让鸡肉显得柴。
原料:
description_en:
The best food for fat loss and muscle gain is chicken breast—and making it tasty is an art. Steaming, unlike boiling, keeps the meat moist and prevents it from drying out.
Ingredients:
tips_zh:
1、腌制鸡肉这一步骤不能省略，不然蒸的不好吃。
2、干香菇也可以用鲜蘑菇代替，但是要在锅中炒一下，不然会出很多水。
tips_en:
1. Don't skip marinating the chicken, or the steamed dish won't taste good.
2. You can use fresh mushrooms instead of dried shiitake, but sauté them first or they'll release too much water.

steps.content_zh: 将鸡胸肉洗净后片成三大片；
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken breast and cut into three large pieces;

steps.content_zh: 撒上盐和黑胡椒码味，倒入淀粉揉搓均匀；
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with salt and black pepper, add starch and rub in evenly;

steps.content_zh: 干香菇泡发后切成小片；
steps.content_en: Soak dried shiitake mushrooms and cut into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 取一片鸡胸肉上面均匀码上香菇片，然后重复这一步骤，如图所示；
steps.content_en: Take a piece of chicken breast and arrange mushroom slices evenly on top, and then repeat this step, as shown in the picture;

steps.content_zh: 用保鲜膜包起来；
steps.content_en: Wrap in plastic wrap;

steps.content_zh: 用锡纸包裹住卷好鸡肉卷，放入冰箱中冷藏腌制至少一小时；
steps.content_en: Wrap the rolled chicken in foil and refrigerate to marinate for at least an hour;

steps.content_zh: 将腌制好的鸡肉卷放入加好水的饭煲中，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the marinated chicken rolls into a rice cooker filled with water, and click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后取出，配合一些果蔬沙拉，淋上少许橄榄油就是一顿完美的减肥餐啦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, take it out, mix it with some fruit and vegetable salad, and drizzle it with a little olive oil to make a perfect weight loss meal.

description_zh: 湖南腊肉名气很大，很大原因是民国美食家兼职大师们一次次用文字记录下来，梁实秋甚至说了最绝对的话：湖南腊肉，天下第一。湖南腊肉不同于四川，更多了一些淡淡的烟熏味。腊味之制作最重要的一个步骤就是烟熏。微温的烟熏火燎，日久便把肉类熏得焦黑，同时烟熏的特殊味道也都熏进去了。香软的芋头经过蒸制后被腊肉的油脂包裹，更多了一种淡淡烟熏味。
description_en: Hunan bacon is very famous. The main reason is that the part-time gourmet masters of the Republic of China recorded it in writing time and time again. Liang Shiqiu even said the most absolute words: Hunan bacon is the best in the world. Hunan bacon is different from Sichuan in that it has a more subtle smoky flavor. The most important step in making cured meat is smoking. The lukewarm smoke burns the meat, and over time the meat becomes blackened, and the special flavor of the smoke is also absorbed. The soft and fragrant taro is steamed and wrapped in bacon fat, adding a light smoky flavor.
tips_zh:
1、可以在煮饭的同时将这道菜蒸上。
2、超市里买的腊肉比较咸，要在水中浸泡一会除去一些咸味。
3、芋头在水中煮过几分钟后更容易去皮。
tips_en:
1. You can steam this dish while the rice cooks.
2. Store-bought cured pork is quite salty—soak it in water for a while to remove some salt.
3. Taro is easier to peel after boiling for a few minutes.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 腊肉洗净后切成薄片，香芋去皮切成0.5厘米厚的片；
steps.content_en: Wash and thinly slice the cured pork; peel the taro and cut into 0.5 cm thick slices;

steps.content_zh: 香芋片垫底，将腊肉平铺上面；
steps.content_en: Line the bottom with taro slices and spread the cured bacon on top;

steps.content_zh: 锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，将盘子放入蒸笼中，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice -2 mark, put the plate into the steamer, and click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后可以撒上香菜、葱花增加风味。
steps.content_en: After cooking, sprinkle with cilantro and chopped scallion for extra flavor.

description_zh: 冰糖梨水能清热止渴，养胃生津，适用于外感温热病毒引起的发热、伤津、口渴。
description_en: Rock sugar pear water can clear away heat and quench thirst, nourish the stomach and promote body fluids. It is suitable for fever, body fluid damage and thirst caused by exogenous warm viruses.
tips_zh: 梨皮具有清心润肺、降火生津，清热润燥、止咳化痰的作用。所以如果上火的人群饮用可以将梨皮一起煮成糖水。
tips_en: Pear skin has the functions of clearing the heart and moistening the lungs, reducing fire and promoting fluid production, clearing away heat and moisturizing, relieving cough and reducing phlegm. Therefore, if people who suffer from internal heat drink it, they can boil the pear peels together into sugar water.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 雪花梨洗净、去皮、去核、切块；
steps.content_en: Wash, peel, core and chop the snowflake pear;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的梨和冰糖放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥1的位置；点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the cut pears and rock sugar into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge 1; click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 也可把煮熟的梨和梨水一起放入料理机打成梨汁饮用。
steps.content_en: You can also put cooked pears and pear water into a food processor to make pear juice for drinking.

description_zh: 银耳、莲子和大枣组成三宝与有机粥米一起煮成一锅润燥粥，不仅香甜可口还能在干燥的秋天润肺生津、滋阴养胃、益气安神。
description_en: Snow fungus, lotus seeds and red dates form the 'three treasures'; cooked with organic porridge rice into a moisturizing porridge that is sweet and delicious, and in dry autumn nourishes the lungs, promotes fluids, nourishes yin and the stomach, and boosts qi and calms the spirit.
tips_zh: 此粥具有很好的滋阴润燥﹑补中益气和清热止血的作用。
tips_en: This porridge nourishes yin, moistens dryness, tonifies the middle and boosts qi, and clears heat to stop bleeding.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银耳和莲子提前用水泡发，大枣洗净去核切块，大米洗净备用；并将泡好的银耳去蒂并撕成小片；
steps.content_en: Soak the snow fungus and lotus seeds in water in advance; wash, pit and chop the red dates; wash the rice and set aside; remove the stems from the soaked snow fungus and tear into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 将银耳和洗净的大米一起放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥1的位置，点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the white fungus and washed rice into the pot together, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余60分钟打开锅盖放入莲子、大枣和冰糖搅拌均匀，继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: When 60 minutes remain, open the lid, add lotus seeds, red dates and rock sugar, stir well and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后趁热开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Once cooking is complete, serve hot.

description_zh: 山药和百合均是我们普通人经常见得食材， 山药又名薯蓣，具有益气养阴、补脾肺肾的功效，属补气药。而用百合煮粥，不仅可以滋润肺胃，而且还对呼吸道和消化道黏膜有保护作用。能滋阴又能利湿，能滑润又能收涩。
description_en: Yam and lily are everyday ingredients. Yam, also called Chinese yam, tonifies qi and nourishes yin, benefiting the spleen, lungs and kidneys. Lily porridge moistens the lungs and stomach and protects the respiratory and digestive mucosa—nourishing yin while draining dampness, lubricating yet astringent.
tips_zh: 剥完山药或者切完之后，会手痒难耐，可以把手洗干净，然后在火上烘一下，就能缓解刺痒了；当然，你也可以防患于未然：在动手处理山药前，不妨带个橡胶手套，或在手上套个保鲜袋，然后再削皮或者切，这样就可以防止接触到可能引发过敏的物质，也就不用担心手会痒了。
tips_en: After peeling or cutting yams, your hands will feel unbearable itching. You can wash your hands clean and then dry them on the fire to relieve the itching. Of course, you can also take precautions beforehand: before handling yams, you might as well wear rubber gloves or put a plastic bag on your hands before peeling or cutting. This will prevent you from coming into contact with substances that may cause allergies, and you don’t have to worry about itchy hands.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 山药去皮，洗净切块，百合洗净，掰成片，大米洗净；
steps.content_en: Peel the yam, wash and cut into pieces, wash the lily and break it into pieces, wash the rice;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的山药和洗净的大米一起放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥1的位置；点击手机App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
