steps.content_en: Put the chopped yam and washed rice into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge 1; click the start cooking icon on the mobile app to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 余30分钟打开锅盖放入百合并搅拌均匀，盖上锅盖继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: After the remaining 30 minutes, open the lid and add lily, stir evenly, cover the pot and continue to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 天气闷热，若是没什么胃口，又担心发胖，赶紧动手做一份低脂低卡，又让人胃口大开的鸡胸肉沙拉吧。
description_en: The weather is sultry and hot. If you have no appetite and are worried about gaining weight, quickly make a low-fat, low-calorie, appetizing chicken breast salad.
tips_zh:
1、各种蔬菜可以根据个人的喜好选择。
2、如果鸡胸肉太厚的话可以片成两片再煮。
3、如果在意沙拉酱热量高的话可以用盐、黑醋和橄榄油拌匀，这样脂肪会低一些。
tips_en:
1. Choose any vegetables you like.
2. If the chicken breast is too thick, slice it in two before cooking.
3. To cut calories, dress with salt, balsamic vinegar, and olive oil instead of mayo.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh:
鸡胸洗净，除去油脂后和姜片、葱段、八角一起放入锅胆，加入料酒、生抽、盐
加水至水位线：稠粥1/2的刻度，点击手机APP上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Wash the chicken breasts, remove the fat and put them into the pot together with ginger slices, green onion segments and star anise. Add cooking wine, light soy sauce and salt.
Add water to the water level: 1/2 of the thickness of the thick porridge. Click the start cooking icon on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 准备好自己喜欢吃的各种果蔬，比如黄瓜、圣女果和各种生菜；
steps.content_en: Prepare various fruits and vegetables you like to eat, such as cucumbers, cherry tomatoes and various lettuces;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后取出鸡胸肉可以泡在冰水中冷却，或者自然放凉后撕成鸡丝，摆在准备好的果蔬上，淋上沙拉酱撒上一些黑胡椒就可以啦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, cool the chicken breast in ice water or let it cool naturally, then shred. Place it over the prepared fruit and vegetables, drizzle with salad dressing, sprinkle with black pepper, and serve.

description_zh: 吃够了白水煮鸡胸的味道，可以尝试着用味增酱来做出来鸡胸，低脂低卡，增肌减脂。
description_en: After eating enough of the taste of boiled chicken breasts, you can try using miso sauce to make chicken breasts, which are low-fat and low-calorie, and can build muscle and reduce fat.
tips_zh: 可以搭配各种低脂、低糖的蔬菜类一起食用，就是一份优质的减肥餐啦。
tips_en: It can be eaten with a variety of low-fat and low-sugar vegetables to create a high-quality weight loss meal.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸡胸洗净，除去油脂，切片；
steps.content_en: Wash chicken breasts, remove fat, and slice into slices;

steps.content_zh: 加入料酒、盐、黑胡椒腌制10分钟；
steps.content_en: Add cooking wine, salt and black pepper and marinate for 10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 将腌好的鸡肉和所有酱汁一同放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥1/2的刻度；点击手机App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the marinated chicken and all the sauce into the pot, add water to the water level: 1/2 of the thick porridge; click the start cooking icon on the mobile app to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后可根据个人口味再撒上写黑胡椒和葱花调味。
steps.content_en: After serving, you can season with black pepper and chopped green onion according to your personal taste.

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 番茄、海鲜和豆腐的组合，不仅味道鲜美可口，脂肪含量也非常低。适合减肥人群经常食用。
description_en: Tomato, seafood, and tofu make a delicious combination that's also very low in fat—great for people watching their weight.
tips_zh:
1、如果买不到海鲜料理包，可以放一些自己喜欢的海鲜。
2、可根据个人口味放入葱和香菜。
tips_en:
1. If you can't find a seafood meal kit, just add whatever seafood you like.
2. Add scallions and cilantro to taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 内酯豆腐与番茄切丁；
steps.content_en: Lactone tofu and diced tomatoes;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的豆腐和番茄放入饭煲中，加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，盖上锅盖点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the chopped tofu and tomatoes into the rice cooker, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 mark, cover the pot and click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪的过程中，淀粉加水调成水淀粉，鸡蛋打成蛋液；
steps.content_en: While cooking, mix starch with water to make a slurry and beat the egg;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时加入海鲜包，关上锅盖继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: When 10 minutes of cooking time remain, add the seafood buns, close the lid and continue simmering;

steps.content_zh: 再次沸腾时开盖，倒入水淀粉搅拌均匀后淋上蛋液搅拌；
steps.content_en: When it boils again, open the lid, pour in the water starch and stir evenly, then pour in the egg liquid and stir;

steps.content_zh: 放入盐、白胡椒粉调味，最后淋上芝麻油就可以享用啦。
steps.content_en: Season with salt and white pepper, drizzle with sesame oil and enjoy.

description_zh:
柠檬爱上了雪梨，冰糖是它们的见证人。
入秋后气温还是高居不下，经常炖点梨水也是非常好的。滋养下干燥的身体。
description_en:
Lemon fell in love with snow pear, and rock sugar witnessed it.
After autumn begins, the heat lingers, so stewing some pear water regularly is a great way to nourish a dry body.
tips_zh: 梨皮是极好润燥养生的食材，洗净即可不用削皮。
tips_en: Pear peel is an excellent moisturizing and health-preserving ingredient. You can wash it without peeling it.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 雪花梨洗净、去皮、去核、切成小块，柠檬洗净、切片；
steps.content_en: Wash, peel, core and cut snowflake pears into small pieces. Wash and slice lemons;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的梨放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥1的位置；点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the cut pears into the pot, add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1; click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后根据个人口味加入适量的冰糖调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add rock sugar to taste;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后根据个人口味加入适量的冰糖调味；待梨水变温的时候放入切好的柠檬片；
steps.content_en: After cooking, add an appropriate amount of rock sugar to taste according to personal taste; when the pear water becomes warm, add sliced ​​lemon;

steps.content_zh: 再加上几枚枸杞点缀，开始享用吧，也可以放入冰箱中冷藏后享用。
steps.content_en: Garnish with a few wolfberry berries and enjoy. You can also put it in the refrigerator to chill before enjoying.

description_zh: 芋头具有健脾、利湿、解毒、消痒的功效。能够合理运送营养物质，使皮肤润泽，同时提高机体的免疫力。荔浦芋又名槟榔芋作为广西的首选贡品在岁末进贡皇家大典。尤其是在清朝乾隆年间达到了极盛。
description_en: Taro strengthens the spleen, drains dampness, detoxifies, and relieves itching. It helps transport nutrients, keeps the skin moisturized, and boosts immunity. Lipu taro, also called betel-nut taro, was Guangxi's finest tribute to the imperial court at year's end, especially during the Qianlong era of the Qing Dynasty.
tips_zh: 蒸制时间的长短根据切片的薄厚来调整。
tips_en: Adjust the steaming time according to the thickness of the slices.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 荔浦芋头去皮、洗净、切片，装入大小合适的盘子里，并放入蒸笼中，关上盖子后点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Peel, wash and slice Lipu taro, put it into a plate of suitable size and put it into the steamer. Close the lid and click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后根据个人口味撒上适量白砂糖调味；开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: After serving, sprinkle with appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to personal taste; enjoy.

description_zh: 浏阳蒸菜在蒸制过程中能最大限度地保持食物的原汁原味和营养，避免了煎、炸造成有效成分的破坏和有害物质的产生。浏阳蒸菜含油脂少、热量低，易于消化吸收。蒸制过程中以水渗热，吃了不易上火，所用调料量少，清淡养胃，有利于消费者的保健养生。
description_en: Steaming preserves food's natural flavor and nutrients to the fullest, avoiding the nutrient loss and harmful compounds caused by frying. Liuyang steamed dishes are low in fat and calories and easy to digest. Heat passes through water, so they're less likely to cause internal heat; with few seasonings, they're light and gentle on the stomach, promoting health.
tips_zh: 还可以放上剁椒增加风味。
tips_en: Add chopped chili for extra flavor.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 荔浦芋头去皮、洗净、切滚刀块，朝天椒切圈，大蒜和香葱切末；
steps.content_en: Peel, wash and cut the Lipu taro into hob cubes, cut the Chaotian pepper into rings, and mince the garlic and chives;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅起油，油热后放入豆豉、朝天椒、蒜末，炒出香味后加入所有调料炒匀；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a wok. When the oil is hot, add tempeh, chili pepper, and minced garlic. Stir-fry until fragrant. Add all the seasonings and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的荔浦芋头装入大小合适的盘子里，放入炒好的豆豉酱，拌匀，并放入蒸架；
steps.content_en: Put the cut Lipu taro into a plate of suitable size, add the fried black bean sauce, mix well, and put it on the steam rack;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至水位线：东北米-2的刻度；点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level line: northeast meter -2 mark; click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后撒上香葱开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: After serving, sprinkle with chives and enjoy.

description_zh: 原汁原味，好吃不腻。保留了食物最原始的味道。
description_en: Authentic, delicious and not greasy. Retains the original taste of food.
tips_zh: 蜂蜜的多少可以按各人口味添加，不喜欢甜的，本身南瓜就带有点甜，不放也很好吃。
tips_en: Adjust honey to taste; pumpkin is naturally sweet, so you can omit it if you prefer.

steps.content_zh: 南瓜去皮、去瓤、洗净、切成扇形，将切好的南瓜装入碗内，最好不要有缝隙；
steps.content_en: Peel and remove the flesh from the pumpkin, wash it, and cut it into fan shapes. Put the cut pumpkin into a bowl, preferably without any gaps;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸笼中；
steps.content_en: Place in steamer basket;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至水位线：东北米-2的刻度，盖上锅盖，点击；手机APP开始烹饪
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 2 mark, cover with the lid, and tap Start Cooking in the phone app

steps.content_zh: 出锅后取出蒸出的汤汁，然后把南瓜扣到盘中，淀粉加水制成水淀粉；
steps.content_en: After taking it out of the pot, take out the steamed soup, then put the pumpkin on a plate, and add water to the starch to make water starch;

steps.content_zh: 将汤汁倒入炒锅，加一点水开锅后加入水淀粉，制成芡汁，可根据个人口味加入适量的蜂蜜调味
steps.content_en: Pour the soup into the wok, add a little water to the pot and add water starch to make gravy. You can add an appropriate amount of honey to taste according to your personal taste.

steps.content_zh: 将芡汁淋到南瓜上，开始享用吧！
steps.content_en: Pour the gravy over the pumpkin and enjoy!

description_zh: 浏阳蒸菜健康、味美、价廉、快捷。豆豉蒸南瓜是浏阳蒸菜的一道传统的美食。咸甜交融口味独特。
description_en: Liuyang steamed dishes are healthy, delicious, affordable, and quick. Steamed pumpkin with fermented black beans is a traditional Liuyang favorite, with a unique blend of salty and sweet.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 南瓜去皮、去瓤、洗净、切滚刀块，朝天椒切圈，大蒜和香葱切末；
steps.content_en: Peel, remove flesh from pumpkin, wash and cut into cubes, cut pepper into rings, mince garlic and chives;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅起油，油热后放入豆豉、朝天椒、蒜末；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a wok; once hot, add fermented black beans, bird's eye chilies, and minced garlic;

steps.content_zh: 炒出香味后加入所有调料炒匀；
steps.content_en: Once fragrant, add all the seasonings and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的南瓜装入大小合适的盘子里，放入炒好的豆豉酱，拌匀，并放入蒸架；
steps.content_en: Put the cut pumpkin into a plate of suitable size, add the fried black bean sauce, mix well, and put it on the steam rack;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至水位线：水位线：东北米-2的刻度；关上锅盖，点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 2 mark; close the lid and tap Start Cooking in the phone app;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后撒上香葱，享用吧。
steps.content_en: After serving, sprinkle with chives and enjoy.

description_zh: 茄子和大蒜是绝配，熬好的蒜蓉酱淋在茄子上，入锅蒸熟。软软的茄子上被浓郁蒜香味包裹，茄子爱好者的福音。
description_en: Eggplant and garlic are a perfect pair; drizzle the prepared garlic sauce over the eggplant and steam until tender. The soft eggplant wrapped in rich garlic aroma is a treat for eggplant lovers.
tips_zh:
1、辣椒根据个人口味放入。
2、还可放入少许豆豉增加风味。
没有蒸鱼豉油可以用生抽代替
tips_en:
1. Add chili pepper according to personal taste.
2. You can also add a little tempeh to increase the flavor.
If you don’t have soy sauce for steamed fish, you can use light soy sauce instead.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 茄子洗净后切条，放入盘子中；
steps.content_en: Wash the eggplant, cut into strips, and place on a plate;

steps.content_zh: 大蒜去皮，剁成蒜蓉，小米椒切碎；
steps.content_en: Peel the garlic, chop into minced garlic, mince the millet and pepper;

steps.content_zh: 锅中放油烧热后放入蒜蓉和小米椒，转小火；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in the pot, add minced garlic and bird's eye chilies, then reduce to low heat;

steps.content_zh: 蒜蓉变得金黄时，倒入蒸鱼豉油关火；
steps.content_en: When the minced garlic turns golden, pour in the steamed fish soy sauce and turn off the heat;

steps.content_zh: 将熬好的蒜蓉酱铺在茄子上，锅中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度，将盘子放在蒸笼中，盖上盖子点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Spread the cooked garlic sauce on the eggplant, add water to the pot to the water level: Northeast rice -2 mark, place the plate in the steamer, cover the lid and click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好后取出盘子，然后搅拌一下让每块茄子都能入味，找个美美的盘子装盘即可。
steps.content_en: After steaming, take out the plate, stir it around so that each piece of eggplant can absorb the flavor, and then find a beautiful plate to serve it on.

description_zh: 青口贝，质嫩，肉肥，味鲜不管拿来白灼还是蒸着吃都非常美味。
description_en: Green-lipped mussels are tender, plump and flavorful - delicious whether blanched or steamed.
tips_zh: 青口贝蛋白质及氨基酸含量较高，必需氨基酸占总氨基酸量的33.2%。
tips_en: Green-lipped mussels are high in protein and amino acids; essential amino acids make up 33.2% of the total amino acids.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 青口贝洗净、沥干水分；
steps.content_en: Wash and drain the mussels;

steps.content_zh: 大蒜切末，朝天椒切末，香葱切碎；
steps.content_en: Mince the garlic, mince the chili pepper, and mince the chives;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅起油，油热后放入切好的大蒜和香葱，炒出香味；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a wok. When the oil is hot, add chopped garlic and chives and stir-fry until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 放入盐、耗油、生抽、白砂糖、胡椒粉、鸡精制成酱汁；
steps.content_en: Mix salt, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, sugar, pepper and chicken bouillon into a sauce.

steps.content_zh: 将炒好的酱汁均匀的涂抹到青口贝上；
steps.content_en: Spread the fried sauce evenly onto the mussels;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸架，锅内加水至水位线东北米-2的刻度；点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put on the steaming rack, add water to the Northeast Rice-2 level and tap the app to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 出锅后撒上香葱。
steps.content_en: After serving, sprinkle with scallions.

description_zh: 秋天干燥季，肺部易受损害，很多人会咳嗽，自制秋梨膏不用担心有添加物，可以放心喝，喝时取一勺秋梨膏，用温开水调开即可饮用！
description_en: In the dry season of autumn, the lungs are easily damaged and many people will cough. You don’t have to worry about additives when making homemade Qiuli paste. You can drink it with confidence. Take a spoonful of Qiuli paste and mix it with warm water before drinking!
tips_zh: 大火收汁的时候要经常搅拌。
tips_en: Stir often when the juice is reduced over high heat.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 雪梨洗净、去皮、去核、切块；
steps.content_en: Wash, peel, core and chop the snow pear;

steps.content_zh: 罗汉果去皮、掰成小块，红枣去核、切片，生姜切片；
steps.content_en: Peel the monk fruit and break into small pieces; pit and slice the red dates; slice the ginger;

steps.content_zh: 将切好的雪梨加入料理机，加适量水（每一整杯梨肉加60ml水，这样好打些）打成泥；
steps.content_en: Add the sliced ​​pears to the food processor, add an appropriate amount of water (add 60ml of water for each whole cup of pear flesh, so it is easier to beat) and puree;

steps.content_zh: 将打好的梨肉倒入锅胆；
steps.content_en: Pour the beaten pear flesh into the pot;

steps.content_zh: 加入除蜂蜜外的所有食材，将削下的梨皮也一起加入锅内；点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add all the ingredients except honey, and add the peeled pear skin to the pot; click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后用筛子筛去梨肉和其他材料，只保留汤汁；
steps.content_en: After cooking, strain out the pear flesh and other solids, keeping only the liquid;

steps.content_zh: 筛出的残渣可用一块抹布包住，挤出残余汤汁；
steps.content_en: The sieved residue can be wrapped in a rag and squeeze out the remaining soup;

steps.content_zh: 将汤汁倒回锅胆，选择蒸煮模式 30分钟把汁熬成膏，
steps.content_en: Pour the soup back into the pot, select the steaming mode and boil the soup into a paste for 30 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 期间多开盖搅拌，尤其最后10分，放凉后加入蜂蜜。
steps.content_en: Open the lid and stir often during cooking, especially in the last 10 minutes; add honey after it cools.

description_zh: 大酱汤在韩国是是日常餐桌必不可少的传统菜品。其其的确营养丰富、味美可口、操作方便，在中国也很受欢迎。
description_en: Doenjang soup is an essential traditional dish on Korean dining tables. Nutritious, delicious and easy to make, it's also popular in China.
tips_zh: 可根据个人喜好放入各种蔬菜。
tips_en: Various vegetables can be added according to personal preference.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 花蛤先洗净，泡入水中吐沙；
steps.content_en: Wash the clams and soak them in water to purge the sand;

steps.content_zh: 牛肉切片，豆腐切成小块，金针菇洗净、去根、切断，西葫芦洗净、切片，土豆去皮切片，黄豆芽洗净，青椒洗净、切圈，洋葱切丝，大蒜切末；
steps.content_en: Slice the beef, cut the tofu into small pieces, trim and cut the enoki mushrooms, slice the zucchini, peel and slice the potato, rinse the soybean sprouts, slice the green pepper into rings, shred the onion, and mince the garlic;

steps.content_zh: 将花蛤、豆腐、金针菇、西葫芦、土豆、黄豆芽一起放入锅胆，加入大酱和韩式辣酱；
steps.content_en: Put the clams, tofu, enoki mushrooms, zucchini, potatoes, and soybean sprouts into the pot, and add doenjang and Korean hot sauce;

steps.content_zh: 加水至水位线：稠粥1的刻度，点击手机App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the water level line: thick porridge 1, click the start cooking icon on the mobile app to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪过程中将牛肉里脊切成薄片；切好的牛肉加入一些淀粉抓匀；
steps.content_en: During cooking, slice the beef tenderloin thinly and mix with some cornstarch;

steps.content_zh: 炒锅起油，油热后放入牛肉抄至变色；
steps.content_en: Heat oil in a wok, add beef until it changes color;

steps.content_zh: 加入洋葱炒制变软，盛出备用；
steps.content_en: Add onions and sauté until soft, set aside;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时开盖放入洋葱牛肉、青椒，尝一下味道，根据个人口味调整到自己最喜欢的状态；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, open the lid and add the onion, beef, and green pepper; taste and adjust the seasoning to your liking;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 香软可口，富含丰富的蛋白质，做好了可以煲汤或者直接吃，适合各类人群食用。
description_en: Soft and delicious, rich in protein, it can be made into soup or eaten directly, and is suitable for all types of people.
tips_zh: 煎蛋时一定要小火慢煎。
tips_en: When frying the egg, be sure to use low heat and cook slowly.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大葱切碎，姜切末；
steps.content_en: Chop green onions and mince ginger;

steps.content_zh: 肉馅放进容器加入切好的葱、姜，以及各种调料，加入一个生鸡蛋搅拌成馅料；
steps.content_en: Put the filling in a bowl, add the chopped scallion and ginger and all the seasonings, then add a raw egg and mix into a stuffing;

steps.content_zh: 剩下的5个鸡蛋放入容器，打匀；
steps.content_en: Put the remaining 5 eggs into the container and beat well;

steps.content_zh: 不粘锅热后，改小火，用刷子刷上薄薄的一层油；
steps.content_en: After the non-stick pan is hot, reduce the heat to low and apply a thin layer of oil with a brush;

steps.content_zh: 倒入蛋液，慢慢晃动锅体，摊成蛋皮；
steps.content_en: Pour in the egg liquid, slowly shake the pot and spread it into egg skin;

steps.content_zh: 将调好的馅料均匀的摊在蛋皮上，不要太厚；从边上开始卷起来；
steps.content_en: Spread the prepared filling evenly on the egg skin, not too thick; roll it up starting from the edge;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸架，锅内加水至水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机APP开始烹饪；开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Put the steaming rack into the pot, add water to the water level line: northeast rice -2 mark, click on the mobile APP to start cooking; start enjoying.

steps.content_zh: 切开享用吧。
steps.content_en: Cut and enjoy.

description_zh: 造型可爱，味道鲜美营养丰富。适合老人和儿童食用。
description_en: Cute in appearance, delicious and nutritious. Suitable for the elderly and children.
tips_zh: 煎蛋时一定要小火慢煎。
tips_en: When frying the egg, be sure to use low heat and cook slowly.

steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 大葱切碎，姜切末；

steps.content_zh: 肉馅放进容器加入切好的葱、姜，以及各种调料，加入一个生鸡蛋，搅拌成馅料；
steps.content_en: Put the meat filling into a container, add chopped onions, ginger, and various seasonings, add a raw egg, and stir into the filling;

steps.content_en: Put the remaining 5 eggs into the container and beat well;

steps.content_zh: 不粘锅热后，改小火，用刷子刷上薄薄的一层油；
steps.content_en: After the non-stick pan is hot, reduce the heat to low and apply a thin layer of oil with a brush;

steps.content_zh: 倒入蛋液，慢慢晃动锅体，摊成蛋皮；
steps.content_en: Pour in the egg liquid, slowly shake the pot and spread it into egg skin;

steps.content_zh: 将紫菜放到蛋皮上，再将调好的馅料均匀的摊在紫菜上，不要太厚；
steps.content_en: Place the seaweed on the egg skin, and then spread the prepared filling evenly on the seaweed, not too thick;

steps.content_zh: 从两边卷起来；
steps.content_en: Roll up from both sides;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸架，锅内加水至水位线：东北米-2的刻度；点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the steaming rack into the pot and add water to the water level line: Northeast rice -2 mark; click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。

description_zh: 皮皮虾肥美鲜甜，既有海蟹的风味又带着海虾的口感。沿海城市人人都是扒皮皮虾的好手，打捞量大、靠海且新鲜。
description_en: Mantis shrimp are plump and sweet, with the flavor of sea crab and the texture of shrimp. In coastal cities everyone is an expert at peeling them—they're plentiful, fresh, and right by the sea.
tips_zh: 皮皮虾味道虽美，但是壳上面有很多刺吃的时候要小心。
tips_en: Although Pipi shrimps taste delicious, you need to be careful when eating them because there are many spines on the shells.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 皮皮虾洗净；
steps.content_en: Rinse the mantis shrimp;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸屉，撒上花椒，锅内加水至：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put in the steamer, sprinkle Sichuan peppercorns, add water to the Northeast Rice-2 level and tap the app to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 蒸虾的同时调制酱汁，大蒜切碎，姜切末，切好后加入醋，生抽香油；
steps.content_en: While the shrimp steams, prepare the sauce: chop the garlic and ginger, then add vinegar, soy sauce and sesame oil;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

name_en: Tea tree mushroom pork ribs soup
description_zh: 飘香浓郁，味道鲜美回味甘甜，茶树菇营养丰富，含有人体所需的18种氨基酸，特别是含有人体所不能合成的8种氨基酸。
description_en: Richly fragrant, delicious with a sweet aftertaste. Tea tree mushrooms are highly nutritious, containing 18 amino acids the body needs, especially the 8 essential amino acids the body cannot synthesize itself.
tips_zh: 不要放入鸡精或者鸡汁调味，影响汤原本的味道。
tips_en: Do not add chicken essence or chicken juice for seasoning, as this will affect the original taste of the soup.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 干茶树菇泡发后洗净；
steps.content_en: Soak dried tea tree mushrooms and wash them;

steps.content_zh: 胡萝卜去皮切滚刀块，生姜切片；
steps.content_en: Peel the carrot and cut into chunks, and slice the ginger;

steps.content_zh: 排骨焯水后洗净与茶树菇、生姜和胡萝卜同时放入饭煲中，加入水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Blanch the pork ribs, wash them and put them into the rice cooker together with the tea tree mushrooms, ginger and carrots. Add water to the water level: Thick porridge -1 mark. Click the start cooking icon on the App to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入适量的盐和白胡椒粉调味即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt and white pepper to taste.

description_zh: 红糖红糖是个宝，多吃气色好，简单易学好吃不上火。
description_en: Brown sugar Brown sugar is a treasure. Eat more and you will look good. It is simple and easy to learn. It tastes good and will not cause internal heat.
tips_zh: 面糊要倒入容器的一半即可，面糊发酵以后会膨胀！
tips_en: Fill the container only halfway with batter - it will rise as it ferments!

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将适量的40度左右的温水倒入酵母中，搅拌均匀，其余温水加入红糖和白砂糖，将其融化；
steps.content_en: Pour an appropriate amount of warm water around 40 degrees into the yeast and stir evenly. Add brown sugar and white sugar to the rest of the warm water and melt it;

steps.content_zh: 面粉中加入鸡蛋，酵母和融化的糖水；
steps.content_en: Add eggs, yeast and melted sugar water to flour;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀，直到看不见明显的疙瘩；
steps.content_en: Stir evenly until no obvious lumps are visible;

steps.content_zh: 将调好的面糊倒入事先准备好的模具中，不要倒满，大概1/2的样子就可以了，模具中可以刷一层油，以便脱模；
steps.content_en: Pour the prepared batter into the pre-prepared mold, do not fill it full, about 1/2 is enough. You can brush a layer of oil into the mold to facilitate demolding;

steps.content_zh: 用保鲜膜包上模具，使面糊发酵；大约40分钟后，面糊变大到沾满模具的约80%；
steps.content_en: Wrap the mold with plastic wrap and let the batter ferment; after about 40 minutes, the batter will expand to cover about 80% of the mold;

steps.content_zh:
撒上葡萄干，将其放入蒸架，锅内加水至：蒸煮线（东北米2）的刻度。
点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Sprinkle with raisins, set on the steaming rack and add water to the Steam line (Northeast Rice 2) level.
Tap the app to start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 鲜美浓郁，面疙瘩加上海鲜让人一次能吃下两大碗。
description_en: Rich and delicious—the dough dumplings with seafood are so good you'll eat two big bowls at once.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 白蛤提前洗净、放入水中吐沙；
steps.content_en: Rinse the clams in advance and soak in water to purge the sand;

steps.content_zh: 虾去头、虾壳和虾线；
steps.content_en: Remove heads, shells and threads from shrimp;

steps.content_zh:
将白蛤和虾头、虾皮和一片生姜放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥1的刻度；
点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Put the white clams, shrimp heads, dried shrimp and a slice of ginger into the inner pot, add water to the thick porridge 1 level;
Tap Start Cooking in the app;

steps.content_zh: 茼蒿切成小段；
steps.content_en: Cut the crown daisy into short segments;

steps.content_zh: 葱切成葱花，姜切末，香菜切碎；
steps.content_en: Chop the green onions into finely chopped pieces, mince the ginger, and chop the coriander;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后将煮白蛤的汤倒出，蛤蜊取肉，去除虾皮，沉淀一会儿；
steps.content_en: After cooking, pour out the clam broth, remove the clam meat, discard the dried shrimp, and let it settle for a while;

steps.content_zh: 将汤倒回锅中，注意碗底的残渣不要倒进去，放入茼蒿，如果汤少可以加水至水位线：稠粥3/4的刻度，再次点击App开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the soup back into the pot, being careful not to pour the residue at the bottom of the bowl. Add the chrysanthemum chrysanthemum. If the soup is too short, add water to the water level: 3/4 of the thick porridge. Click the App again to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 面粉中加入1个鸡蛋，搅拌成疙瘩；
steps.content_en: Add 1 egg to the flour and stir into lumps;

steps.content_zh: 另一个鸡蛋打散；
steps.content_en: Beat another egg;

steps.content_zh:
剩余10分钟时放入调好的面、葱花和姜末，并搅拌均匀。
开盖煮，锅开后倒入蛋液，并搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en:
With 10 minutes left, add the prepared noodles, chopped scallions and minced ginger, and stir well.
Cook uncovered; once it boils, pour in the beaten egg and stir well.

steps.content_zh:
完成后根据个人口味加入适量的盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、香油调味。
撒上香菜，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en:
When done, season with salt, chicken bouillon, pepper and sesame oil to taste.
Sprinkle with cilantro and enjoy.

description_zh: 甜沫，真真是老青岛人熟悉的味道。曾经，一碗甜沫，一根油条或者一个烧饼，就构成了青岛人一顿香喷喷的早餐。虽然叫甜沫，却是咸味儿的，有关于甜沫的起源，也有很多种说法。一种说法是甜沫最早来源于一家姓“田”的粥铺救济灾民的粥，还有一种有意思的说法，说是因为每次往粥里添的东西都不同，人们每天都要问“今天填末了”？回答：添了青菜，或者添了粉丝，久而久之，这加了料的粥就有了“添末”的名字，随着时间流逝，慢慢就演化成“甜沫”了。
description_en: Tianmo is a taste truly familiar to old Qingdao locals. Once, a bowl of tianmo with a fried dough stick or a sesame flatbread made a hearty Qingdao breakfast. Despite its name of 'sweet foam,' it is actually savory, and there are many stories about its origin. One says it came from a porridge shop owned by a family surnamed Tian that fed famine victims. Another fun story says that because something different was added each time, people asked daily, 'What's been added today?'—greens, perhaps, or vermicelli. Over time the enriched porridge was called 'tianmo' (added bits), which eventually evolved into 'tianmo' (sweet foam).
tips_zh: 甜沫配油条绝配！
tips_en: Tianmo porridge with fried dough sticks is a perfect match!

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 红豆和花生米提前用水泡发1夜，
steps.content_en: Soak the adzuki beans and peanuts in water overnight in advance,

steps.content_zh: 粉丝提前泡发；
steps.content_en: Soak the glass noodles in advance;

steps.content_zh: 菠菜切成小段，豆腐泡切成小块，葱切成葱花，将切末，香菜切碎；
steps.content_en: Cut the spinach into short sections, quarter the fried tofu puffs, chop the scallion, mince the ginger, and chop the cilantro;

steps.content_zh: 将泡好的红豆和花生米放入锅胆加水至水位线：稠粥1的刻度；点击手机APP开始烹饪
steps.content_en: Put the soaked red beans and peanuts into the pot and add water to the water level: thick porridge 1; click on the mobile APP to start cooking

steps.content_zh: 小米面加适量的水和成面糊；
steps.content_en: Add appropriate amount of water to millet noodles and mix into batter;

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余15分钟开盖放入菠菜、粉丝、豆腐泡，开盖煮；
steps.content_en: When 15 minutes remain, open the lid, add spinach, glass noodles and fried tofu puffs, and cook uncovered;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪剩余10分钟放入葱、姜并将小米面糊缓缓倒入锅中，边到边搅拌均匀；

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束后根据个人口味加入适量的盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、香油调味；
steps.content_en: After cooking, season with salt, chicken bouillon, pepper, and sesame oil to taste;

description_zh: 灌汤小笼包作为江南地区的美食受到很多人的喜爱，但是制作过程繁琐、要求的技艺比较高，难倒了许多人。但是，超市里面的速冻小笼包也是一样的好吃哦，而且价格不贵。
description_en: As a delicacy in the Jiangnan region, soup dumplings are loved by many people, but the production process is cumbersome and requires relatively high skills, which stumps many people. However, the quick-frozen dumplings in supermarkets are equally delicious and not expensive.
tips_zh: 如果要继续蒸，注意锅中的水不要烧干了。
tips_en: If you want to continue steaming, be careful not to let the water in the pot dry out.

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水到水位线：东北米-2的刻度；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the water level line: the Northeast rice - 2 mark;

steps.content_zh: 蒸笼中垫上油纸或者纱布将小笼包整齐的放入，注意每个之间要预留缝隙；
steps.content_en: Line the steamer with parchment or gauze and arrange the xiaolongbao neatly, leaving gaps between them;
