steps.content_en: Put the steamer basket into the pot, cover it, and click the App to start cooking icon to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好的样子；
steps.content_en: How it looks when steamed;

steps.content_zh: 配一碟醋，美美的享用吧。
steps.content_en: Pair it with a dish of vinegar and enjoy.

description_zh: 这是一只喝醉的鸡。清新不油腻，吃了不长胖的醉鸡。
description_en: This is a 'drunken' chicken—light, non-greasy, and won't make you gain weight.
tips_zh:
1、也可以用全鸡腿做。
2、浸泡凉水这一步骤不能省略。
tips_en:
1. You can also use whole chicken legs.
2. Don't skip the cold-water soaking step.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片、小葱打成葱结放入饭煲中，加水到水位线：东北米-3的刻度，盖上盖子点击App上开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Slice the ginger, tie the scallions into a knot, and place both in the rice cooker. Add water to the 'Northeast rice - 3' level, close the lid, and tap Start Cooking in the app;

steps.content_zh: 约10分钟后水烧开放入清洗干净的半只童子鸡，盖上盖子继续焖煮；
steps.content_en: After about 10 minutes, bring the water to a boil, add the cleaned half of the chicken, cover with the lid and continue to simmer;

steps.content_zh: 准备好花雕酒和香糟卤；
steps.content_en: Prepare Huadiao wine and Xiang Zao braised wine;

steps.content_zh: 将香糟卤和花雕酒混合后倒入花椒备用；
steps.content_en: Mix Xiang Zao Lu and Huadiao wine, add Sichuan peppercorns and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间快结束时准备好一盆冰水；
steps.content_en: Near the end of cooking, prepare a bowl of ice water;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后立即将煮熟的鸡肉放入冰水中；
steps.content_en: Right after cooking, place the cooked chicken in ice water;

steps.content_zh: 完全冷却后滤干水分，将鸡肉切块；
steps.content_en: After completely cooling, drain the water and cut the chicken into cubes;

steps.content_zh: 将鸡肉和准备好的卤汁一起放入密封的容器中，并且切一些姜丝放入；
steps.content_en: Put the chicken and prepared marinade into an airtight container, and add some shredded ginger;

steps.content_zh: 盖上盖子密封，入冰箱中冷藏一晚上；
steps.content_en: Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight;

steps.content_zh: 第二天就可以享用啦！
steps.content_en: Enjoy it the next day!

description_zh: 加了地中海海盐和意大利香草的蛋糕，吃起来味道独特，甜而不腻。
description_en: The cake with Mediterranean sea salt and Italian vanilla tastes unique, sweet but not greasy.
tips_zh: 打发蛋清的容器要无油无水无蛋黄。
tips_en: The container used to whip egg whites must be oil-free, water-free and egg-yolk-free.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 将蛋黄和蛋清分离；
steps.content_en: Separate egg yolks and egg whites;

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄中加入玉米油和1/3的白糖搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Add corn oil and 1/3 of the sugar to the egg yolks and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 后筛入低筋粉、海盐、香草和水；翻拌至无疙瘩，无颗粒；
steps.content_en: Then sift in low-gluten flour, sea salt, vanilla and water; stir until there are no lumps or particles;

steps.content_zh: 剩余的糖分三次加入蛋清中，可加几滴柠檬汁，将蛋清打发；
steps.content_en: Add the remaining sugar to the egg whites in three batches. You can add a few drops of lemon juice to beat the egg whites;

steps.content_zh: 取大约一半的蛋清加入到面糊中，继续翻拌均匀，然后将面糊再倒入剩余蛋清中；
steps.content_en: Add about half of the egg whites to the batter, continue to mix evenly, then pour the batter into the remaining egg whites;

steps.content_zh: 再次翻拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Mix again;

steps.content_zh: 到入锅胆；点击手机App开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Go to the pot; click on the mobile app to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 羊大为美，鱼羊为鲜，这就是羊肉的魅力！在氽丸子过程中只需将丸子中多余飘浮出的油沫从锅中清除，待丸子飘起，加点胡椒粉，汤也就入味十足，用一只喜欢的小碗盛入热腾腾的丸子汤，看着都会很流口水。
description_en: 'Big sheep' means beauty, and fish plus lamb means freshness — that is the charm of lamb! While blanching the meatballs, simply skim off the excess foam and oil; once the meatballs float, add a little pepper and the soup will be full of flavor. Ladle the steaming meatball soup into a favorite little bowl — just looking at it makes your mouth water.
tips_zh:
1、肉泥打水要朝一个方向不停的搅拌，一定的搅拌上劲
2、羊肉要肥瘦都有，这样香
3、少许淀粉可以把肉泥更嫩不易散开
tips_en:
1. When adding water to the minced meat, stir continuously in one direction until it becomes sticky and springy.
2. Use lamb with both fat and lean meat for better flavor.
3. A little starch keeps the meat tender and stops it falling apart.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 白萝卜去皮、切片，大葱、姜、香菜切末；
steps.content_en: Peel and slice the white radish, mince the green onions, ginger and coriander;

steps.content_zh: 羊肉馅中加入姜末、鸡蛋、生抽、料酒、鸡精、盐、淀粉、香油、胡椒粉和4/5的大葱；
steps.content_en: Add minced ginger, eggs, light soy sauce, cooking wine, chicken essence, salt, starch, sesame oil, pepper and 4/5 green onions to the mutton stuffing;

steps.content_zh: 朝一方向搅拌至上劲；
steps.content_en: Stir in one direction until thick and elastic;

steps.content_zh: 将萝卜放入锅胆，加水至水位线：东北米4的刻度；点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the radish into the pot and add water to the water level line: northeast meter 4; click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 大约10分钟水开后放入剩余葱花，并将肉馅用勺子整理成丸子下入锅中；
steps.content_en: After the water boils for about 10 minutes, add the remaining chopped green onions, use a spoon to shape the meat filling into balls and put them into the pot;

steps.content_zh: 煮至丸子漂于水面、萝卜透明后放可出锅；
steps.content_en: Cook until the meatballs float and the radish turns translucent, then remove from the pot;

steps.content_zh: 出锅前可加入适量的盐、鸡精、芝麻油调味；
steps.content_en: Before serving, add appropriate amount of salt, chicken essence, and sesame oil to taste;

steps.content_zh: 撒上香菜，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with cilantro and enjoy.

description_zh: 糯米红枣又名心太软，红枣补血益气配上香喷喷的糯米，入口美味极了。
description_en: Glutinous rice red dates, also called Xintairuan ("soft heart"), are delightful: blood-nourishing red dates with fragrant sticky rice.
tips_zh: 不适宜一次性食用过多的红枣，红枣皮不易于消化，可能造成肠胃不适。
tips_en: It is not suitable to eat too many red dates at one time. The skin of red dates is not easy to digest and may cause gastrointestinal discomfort.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 红枣洗净，提前用水浸泡1小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the red dates and soak in water for 1 hour in advance;

steps.content_zh: 糯米面加入白砂糖搅拌均匀，加入适量的水继续搅拌成絮状；将搅拌好的糯米面揉成表面光滑的面团；
steps.content_en: Add sugar to the glutinous rice flour and mix well, then add water and stir into crumbs; knead into a smooth dough.

steps.content_zh: 红枣用小刀划开，取出枣核；
steps.content_en: Slit the red dates with a knife and remove the pits;

steps.content_zh: 取一点糯米面，揉成细长条，夹在红枣中间；
steps.content_en: Take a little glutinous rice flour, roll it into thin strips, and sandwich it between the red dates;

steps.content_zh: 装盘，上蒸笼；
steps.content_en: Plate and place in the steamer;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至:东北米-2的刻度，点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot up to the Northeast rice - 2 mark, then tap Start Cooking in the phone app;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 蒸出来的美味，营养又健康。
description_en: Steamed deliciousness — nutritious and healthy.
tips_zh: 如果选用干香菇，要提前洗净后充分泡发，并且选用较大的香菇。
tips_en: If you choose dried mushrooms, wash them in advance and soak them thoroughly, and choose larger mushrooms.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 油菜洗净、备用；香菇洗净、去蒂，干香菇要提前泡发；
steps.content_en: Wash and set aside the bok choy; wash the shiitake and remove the stems; soak dried shiitake in advance;

steps.content_zh: 大葱和姜切末，香葱切圈；
steps.content_en: Mince green onions and ginger, and cut chives into rings;

steps.content_zh:
肉馅中加入大葱、姜末、鸡蛋、生抽、料酒、1勺蚝油、1勺香油，
朝一方向搅拌成肉馅；
steps.content_en:
Add scallion, minced ginger, egg, light soy sauce, cooking wine, 1 spoonful of oyster sauce and 1 spoonful of sesame oil to the filling,
then stir in one direction until well combined;

steps.content_zh:
油菜放在盘子底下，香菇放倒油菜上，将肉馅用勺子放到香菇上；
放入蒸架，锅内加水至：水位线：东北米-2的刻度，点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Place the rapeseed under the plate, place the mushrooms on the rapeseed, and place the meat filling on the mushrooms with a spoon;
Place the steaming rack, add water in the pot to: water level line: northeast meter -2 mark, click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 程序结束后倒出蒸出的汤汁煮沸后加入1勺蚝油、1勺生抽然后淋入水淀粉制成芡汁；
steps.content_en: After the program ends, pour out the cooking juices, bring to a boil, add 1 spoon each of oyster sauce and light soy sauce, then drizzle in a cornstarch slurry to make a thick sauce;

steps.content_zh: 芡汁中加几滴香油然后淋到香菇上；
steps.content_en: Add a few drops of sesame oil to the thickened sauce and drizzle it over the shiitake mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 撒上香葱开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with chives and enjoy.

description_zh: 西湖牛肉羹因为添加了水淀粉及蛋清，貌似湖水，所以以西湖为名，起名为——西湖牛肉羹。
description_en: West Lake beef soup gets its name because the starch and egg white make it look like lake water—hence 'West Lake beef soup.'
tips_zh:
1、香葱可以换成香菜。
2、羹的浓稠度可以根据个人喜好调整，不要一次性放入过多的水淀粉。
tips_en:
1. Swap the scallions for cilantro if you like.
2. Adjust the thickness to taste—don't add all the starch slurry at once.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 牛里脊洗净、剁成末；
steps.content_en: Wash the beef tenderloin and mince it;

steps.content_zh: 香菇和豆腐切成小丁，姜切片，香葱切末；
steps.content_en: Dice the shiitake mushrooms and tofu, slice the ginger, and chop the scallions;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋只取蛋清，淀粉加水制成水淀粉；
steps.content_en: Use only the egg whites, and mix starch with water to make a slurry;

steps.content_zh: 切好的牛肉加水，搅拌均匀后捞出，去除血水后滤干；
steps.content_en: Add water to the cut beef, stir evenly, take it out, remove the blood and drain;

steps.content_zh:
豆腐和香菇放入锅胆，加水至水位线：稠粥3/4的刻度；
点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Put tofu and mushrooms into the pot, add water to the water level: 3/4 of the thick porridge;
Click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟时放入牛肉和料酒并搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: With 10 minutes left, add the beef and cooking wine, and stir well;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时除去姜片，放入水淀粉，飞入蛋清，撒入香葱；
steps.content_en: With 5 minutes left, remove the ginger slices, add the cornstarch slurry, drizzle in the egg white, and sprinkle with scallion;

steps.content_zh:
烹饪结束后根据个人口味加入适量的盐、鸡精、胡椒粉和香油调味
开始享用吧。
steps.content_en:
After cooking, add appropriate amounts of salt, chicken essence, pepper and sesame oil to season according to personal taste
Start enjoying.

description_zh: 造型可爱颜色丰富，作为宝宝们的早餐最适合不过了！
description_en: With cute shapes and rich colors, it’s perfect as breakfast for babies!
tips_zh: 烹饪完成后不要着急开盖，焖三分钟，这样蒸好的面团不会回缩。
tips_en: After cooking, wait 3 minutes before opening the lid so the steamed dough won't shrink.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 酵母加入适量温水融化备用；
steps.content_en: Dissolve the yeast in warm water and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 将面团放入容器，盖上盖子或保鲜膜，发酵1小时左右；
steps.content_en: Place the dough into a container, cover with a lid or plastic wrap, and ferment for about 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 1小时候面团变成原来的一倍大，再将其揉成光滑面团；
steps.content_en: After 1 hour, the dough will double in size, then knead it into a smooth dough;

steps.content_zh: 可以用各种有颜色是水果或者蔬菜榨汁和面时放入，做成彩色的面团；
steps.content_en: You can use various colored fruits or vegetables and put them into the dough when making juice to make colorful dough;

steps.content_zh: 取一小块面团，搓成火腿2倍长的面条；
steps.content_en: Take a small piece of dough and roll it into noodles twice as long as the ham;

steps.content_zh: 将面条缠绕在火腿上；
steps.content_en: Wrap noodles around ham;

steps.content_zh: 缠好的；
steps.content_en: Once wrapped;

steps.content_zh: 彩色的火腿卷；
steps.content_en: colorful ham rolls;

steps.content_zh: 放入蒸架；
steps.content_en: Put on the steaming rack;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加水至水位线：东北米-2的刻度；点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot to the water level line: northeast meter -2 mark; click on the mobile APP to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 广东人常说“宁可食无菜，不可食无汤”，对汤的喜爱程度可见一斑。发财好事汤是跟公司一位南方同事学的，汤中除了盐没有放其他调料，入口鲜香回口甘甜。生蚝干寓意着好市，生意红火；发菜寓意发财，小火慢炖两小时，精华都在汤中了。
description_en: Cantonese people often say, 'Better a meal without vegetables than without soup'—their love of soup says it all. I learned this Fortune and Good Things Soup from a southern colleague; it has only salt as seasoning, yet tastes savory with a sweet finish. Dried oysters symbolize a booming business and fat choy symbolizes wealth; simmered gently for two hours, all the essence is in the soup.
tips_zh: 每种蜜枣的甜度不一样，所以在烹饪前确定蜜枣是否特别甜，可以适当的减少蜜枣的量，大颗蜜枣放一粒就行了。
tips_en: Candied jujubes vary in sweetness, so check before cooking and reduce the amount if they're very sweet. One large jujube is enough.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 花菇泡发，眉豆、生蚝干、蜜枣洗净；
steps.content_en: Soak the shiitake mushrooms; wash the black-eyed peas, dried oysters, and red dates;

steps.content_zh: 猪肉洗净后切片，生姜切片；
steps.content_en: Wash and slice the pork, and slice the ginger;

steps.content_zh: 花菇泡发后一开二，将花菇、眉豆、生蚝干、蜜枣、猪肉和生姜同时放入饭煲中，加水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，点击App开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Soak the shiitake mushrooms and halve them; put the mushrooms, black-eyed peas, dried oysters, red dates, pork, and ginger into the rice cooker, add water to the porridge -1 mark, then tap the start-cooking icon in the app;

steps.content_zh: 发菜洗净后浸泡，在烹饪完成前10分钟放入锅中；烹饪完成后放入适量的盐调味即可享用啦。
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the nostoc, and put it into the pot 10 minutes before the cooking is completed; after the cooking is completed, add an appropriate amount of salt to taste and enjoy.

description_zh: 秋天，去吃芡实吧。芡实，生来偏水性，具有补脾肾祛湿的功效。芡实口感极好，糯而且有嚼劲。
description_en: In autumn, try euryale seeds (fox nuts). Naturally water-loving, they tonify the spleen and kidneys and help dispel dampness. They taste wonderfully soft and chewy.
tips_zh:
1、本食谱用的芡实是新鲜采摘的芡实，不是干的芡实。
2、糖尿病者禁止饮用芡实糖水。
tips_en:
1. This recipe uses freshly harvested fox nuts, not dried ones.
2. People with diabetes should not drink this sweet fox nut soup.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh:
将冰糖锅胆，加水至：稠粥1/2的刻度；
点击手机APP开始烹饪；
steps.content_en:
Put rock sugar in the inner pot and add water to the Thick Porridge ½ line;
tap Start Cooking in the phone app.

steps.content_zh: 程序剩余5分钟时放入芡实；
steps.content_en: When there are 5 minutes remaining in the program, add Gorgon;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后即可享用。
steps.content_en: Enjoy once cooking is complete.

name_en: Fish maw and chicken feet stew
description_zh: 对于很多爱美的人来说，补充胶原蛋白非常重要哦，如果要说能够帮助补充胶原蛋白的菜肴，不得不提的就是花胶炖鸡脚。这其中的花胶含丰富的高级胶原蛋白质，具滋阴养颜，补肾，强壮机能。
description_en: For beauty lovers, boosting collagen is key—and the dish to mention is fish maw stewed with chicken feet. Fish maw is rich in high-quality collagen, nourishing yin, improving complexion, tonifying the kidneys and strengthening the body.
tips_zh: 鸡爪的脂肪含量较高，在白肉中属于热量较高的食物，同时含有较多的钠，减肥时不宜多食。
tips_en: Chicken feet have a high fat content and are a high-calorie white meat food. They also contain a lot of sodium and should not be eaten when losing weight.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 花胶洗净后用清水浸泡4小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the fish maw and soak it in fresh water for 4 hours;

steps.content_zh: 焯水后备用；
steps.content_en: Blanch and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 鸡爪去指甲、猪肉切块后焯水；
steps.content_en: Remove the nails from the chicken feet, cut the pork into chunks, and blanch;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片、花生米洗净、干桂圆去壳后与鸡爪、瘦肉和花胶同时放入锅中，加入10毫升的料酒，点击App开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Slice the ginger, rinse the peanuts, and shell the dried longans; add them to the pot with the chicken feet, lean pork, and fish maw. Add 10 ml cooking wine and tap Start Cooking in the app;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后捞出生姜，放入盐和鸡精调味即可。
steps.content_en: After cooking, remove the ginger, then season with salt and chicken bouillon.

description_zh: 黑米因外皮乌黑而得名,属于糯米类，又称补血糯米、贡米、黑珍珠，是一种具有诸多保健功效的珍贵稻米。除了煮饭以外，还可以将黑米打碎，做成黑米蛋糕，蛋糕中流露出黑米特有的香味，再搭配上一些水果和酸奶，丝毫不逊色奶油蛋糕的味道，而且非常健康。
description_en: Black rice is named for its dark outer skin and belongs to the glutinous rice family. Also known as blood-tonifying glutinous rice, tribute rice, and black pearl, it is a precious rice with many health benefits. Besides cooking it as rice, you can also grind black rice into powder to make black rice cake, which brings out its unique aroma; paired with some fruit and yogurt, it is every bit as good as cream cake and much healthier.
tips_zh: 黑米质地坚硬，所以要充分浸泡充分打碎到细腻无颗粒的状态。
tips_en: Black rice has a hard texture, so it needs to be fully soaked and crushed until it is fine and grain-free.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 黑米洗净后前一天晚上浸泡过夜，滤干水分；
steps.content_en: Wash the black rice and soak it overnight the night before, then drain the water;

steps.content_zh: 蛋黄和蛋清分离，盛放蛋清的容器要无油无水无蛋黄；
steps.content_en: Separate egg yolks and egg whites, and the container for holding egg whites must be oil-free, water-free, and yolk-free;

steps.content_zh: 将黑米、玉米油、蛋黄和牛奶倒入料理机中快速搅打成黑米糊；
steps.content_en: Pour black rice, corn oil, egg yolk and milk into a food processor and quickly pulse into black rice paste;

steps.content_zh: 打好的黑米糊均匀无明显颗粒；
steps.content_en: The beaten black rice paste is even and has no obvious particles;

steps.content_zh: 蛋清用电动打蛋器打发；过程中分三次放入糖，打成干性泡发（拉起形成不弯曲的直角）；
steps.content_en: Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer, adding sugar in three batches, until stiff peaks form (upright peaks that don't bend);

steps.content_zh: 缓慢的将两者混合，并且不规则搅拌；
steps.content_en: Mix the two slowly, stirring occasionally;

steps.content_zh: 倒入锅胆中，在台面上轻轻磕几下，去除表面气泡；放入电饭煲中，点击App开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour it into the pot and tap it gently on the countertop a few times to remove surface bubbles; put it into the rice cooker and click the App to start cooking icon;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后倒扣出，放凉后淋上酸奶放上喜欢的水果即可享用啦。
steps.content_en: After cooking, invert onto a plate; once cooled, drizzle with yogurt, add your favorite fruit, and enjoy.

description_zh: 三杯鸡因烹制时不加水，仅用一杯米酒，一杯黑麻油，一杯酱油，因此得名为三杯鸡。制作三杯鸡的调料会十分讲究，台湾料理米酒、胡麻油、九层塔缺一不可。
description_en: Three Cup Chicken is named Three Cup Chicken because no water is added when cooking, only one cup of rice wine, one cup of black sesame oil and one cup of soy sauce are used. The seasoning for making Three Cup Chicken is very particular. Taiwanese cooking rice wine, sesame oil, and nine-story pagoda are indispensable.
tips_zh: 菜谱中提到的胡麻油，指的是黑芝麻油，在台湾也被称为胡麻油。
tips_en: The sesame oil mentioned in the recipe refers to black sesame oil, which is also called flax oil in Taiwan.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 来自台湾正宗的调料；
steps.content_en: Authentic seasonings from Taiwan;

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿剁成块后浸泡在清水中30分钟，泡去血水；
steps.content_en: Chop the chicken legs into pieces and soak them in water for 30 minutes to remove the blood;

steps.content_zh: 捞出泡好的鸡块，滤干水分后用米酒、生抽、胡麻油、大蒜、姜片腌制30分钟；
steps.content_en: Remove the soaked chicken pieces, drain, and marinate with rice wine, light soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and ginger slices for 30 minutes.

steps.content_zh: 将腌制的鸡块和腌料同时倒入锅中，放上冰糖搅拌均匀后点击手机烹饪图标开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the marinated chicken pieces and marinade into the pot at the same time, add rock sugar and mix well, then click the cooking icon on your phone to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 中途可以加入一些老抽上色；
steps.content_en: You can add some dark soy sauce for coloring in the middle;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余5分钟时放入洗净的九层塔；
steps.content_en: When there are 5 minutes remaining in the cooking time, add the washed nine-layer pagoda;

steps.content_zh: 完成后就可以出锅啦~
steps.content_en: Once done, you can take it out of the pot~

description_zh: 口感与颜值并存的彩色玫瑰花馒头。
description_en: Colorful rose flower steamed buns that are both delicious and beautiful.
tips_zh: 食材的颜色可以根据个人的口味爱好改变，比如用紫薯、红薯、菠菜汁等。
tips_en: The color of the ingredients can be changed according to personal tastes, such as purple potatoes, sweet potatoes, spinach juice, etc.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 南瓜提前蒸熟，用勺子碾压成泥；
steps.content_en: Steam the pumpkin in advance and crush it into puree with a spoon;

steps.content_zh: 将100克面粉中加入1克酵母、1克泡打粉、30克糖，搅拌均匀；加入大约40克牛奶或温水（牛奶最好加热到40℃），将面粉搅拌成絮状，然后揉成表面光滑的面团；
steps.content_en: Add 1 gram of yeast, 1 gram of baking powder, and 30 grams of sugar to 100 grams of flour, and stir evenly; add about 40 grams of milk or warm water (it is best to heat the milk to 40°C), stir the flour into floc, and then knead it into a smooth dough;

steps.content_zh: 南瓜泥加入100克面粉1克酵母1克泡打粉、30克糖用同样方法揉成黄色面团；
steps.content_en: Add 100 grams of flour, 1 gram of yeast, 1 gram of baking powder, and 30 grams of sugar to the pumpkin puree and knead into a yellow dough using the same method;

steps.content_zh: 紫芯火龙果去皮，切块加入适量温水放入料理机打成果汁；
steps.content_en: Peel and chop the purple dragon fruit, add a little warm water and blend into juice;

steps.content_zh: 将火龙果汁加入100克面粉，1克酵母1克泡打粉、30克糖用同样方法揉成紫色面团；
steps.content_en: Add dragon juice to 100 grams of flour, 1 gram of yeast, 1 gram of baking powder, and 30 grams of sugar and knead it into a purple dough in the same way;

steps.content_zh: 将面团放入容器，盖上盖子或保鲜膜，发酵1小时左右；
steps.content_en: Place the dough into a container, cover with a lid or plastic wrap, and ferment for about 1 hour;

steps.content_zh: 1小时后面团变成原来的一倍大，再将其揉成光滑面团；将面分成若干个小面团，擀成饺子皮大小的面皮；
steps.content_en: After 1 hour, the dough will have doubled in size, then knead it into a smooth dough; divide the dough into several small doughs and roll them into dumpling wrapper-sized dough;

steps.content_zh: 取7个面皮排列好，然后从上到下的卷起来；
steps.content_en: Arrange 7 pieces of dough, then roll them up from top to bottom;

steps.content_zh: 从中间切开，稍微整下形状；
steps.content_en: Cut it in the middle and shape it slightly;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后不要急着打开盖子，继续焖3分钟。
steps.content_en: After cooking, don't open the lid immediately; keep steaming for 3 more minutes.

description_zh: 苁蓉羊肉粥主要原料肉苁蓉，精羊肉，粳米 ，食用功效有补肾助阳，健脾养胃。
description_en: The main raw materials of Cistanche deserticola mutton porridge are cistanche deserticola, refined mutton, and japonica rice. Its edible effects are to nourish the kidneys, yang, and strengthen the spleen and stomach.
tips_zh: 苁蓉羊肉粥属温热性粥疗方，适用于冬季服食，夏季不可用。
tips_en: Cistanche and lamb congee is a warming medicinal porridge; eat it in winter, not summer.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 羊肉切小块后焯水洗净；
steps.content_en: Cut the lamb into small pieces, blanch and wash clean;

steps.content_zh: 生姜切片、胡萝卜切滚刀块、肉苁蓉洗净备用；
steps.content_en: Slice ginger, cut carrots into hob pieces, and wash Cistanche deserticola and set aside;

steps.content_zh: 将羊肉、胡萝卜、肉苁蓉、生姜和小葱同时放入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥-¾的刻度，点击app开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put the mutton, carrots, Cistanche deserticola, ginger and green onions into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level: thick porridge - ¾ mark, click the app to start cooking icon to start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 粳米洗净后浸泡，烹饪时间剩余90分钟时倒入锅中；
steps.content_en: Wash and soak the japonica rice, then add it to the pot when 90 minutes remain;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后放入适量的盐调味即可。
steps.content_en: Season with salt to taste after cooking.

description_zh: 刚怀孕那会吃不下饭，做了一个苹果粥，胃口立马好了。粥香香甜甜的，有苹果的清香，燕麦Q弹爽口。后来给宝宝做辅食，又重新开始做苹果粥了，宝宝也很喜欢。PS熟苹果有润肠的作用。
description_en: Early in my pregnancy I had no appetite, so I made apple porridge and instantly felt like eating again. Sweet and fragrant with fresh apple flavor and chewy oats. When my baby started solids, I made it again—and the baby loved it too. P.S. Cooked apple helps relieve constipation.
tips_zh: 也可以将葡萄干换成红枣哦。
tips_en: You can also replace the raisins with red dates.

steps.content_zh: 准备原材料
steps.content_en: Prepare raw materials

steps.content_zh: 将苹果洗净切小块，燕麦葡萄干洗净
steps.content_en: Wash the apples and cut them into small pieces, wash the oats and raisins

steps.content_zh: 将米大燕麦放入锅中，根据个人喜好加入适量的水
steps.content_en: Put the rice and oats into the pot and add an appropriate amount of water according to personal preference

steps.content_zh: 还剩30分钟的时候将苹果块和葡萄干加入即可
steps.content_en: When there are 30 minutes left, add the apple chunks and raisins.

description_zh: 银鳕鱼的营养价值极高，鱼肉味鲜甘美，嫩滑清口，因此非常适合冬天常食，以达到润肤美肌、预防高血压、糖尿病等食疗作用。
description_en: Black cod is extremely nutritious; its flesh is fresh and sweet, tender and smooth, so it is ideal to eat often in winter for moisturizing and beautifying the skin and helping prevent high blood pressure and diabetes.
tips_zh: 本做法偏西式，喜欢中式吃法的可以在出锅后淋上蒸鱼豉油食用。
tips_en: This is a Western-style recipe; if you prefer Chinese flavors, drizzle with steamed fish soy sauce before serving.

steps.content_zh: 鳕鱼洗净后用厨房用纸擦干水分，用盐、柠檬汁、黑胡椒、白胡椒腌制半小时。
steps.content_en: Wash the cod, dry it with kitchen paper, and marinate it with salt, lemon juice, black pepper, and white pepper for half an hour.

steps.content_zh:
将腌制好的银鳕鱼放入蒸架中，锅中水加到水位线：东北米2.5的刻度。
开始烹饪。
steps.content_en:
Put the marinated cod into the steaming rack, and add water in the pot to the water level: 2.5 meters northeast.
Start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 芦笋洗净后白灼，同时用蛋黄酱、柠檬汁调一个酱汁，完成后装盘即可。
steps.content_en: Wash and blanch the asparagus, meanwhile mix a sauce of mayonnaise and lemon juice, then plate.

description_zh:
20分钟
原汁原味的杏鲍菇，杏鲍菇是用来代替肉食的素菜，吃起来很有肉的感觉。而且每100克仅有35大卡的热量，是理想的减肥食物。
description_en:
20 minutes
King oyster mushrooms have a natural, meaty flavor—a great meat substitute. At only 35 kcal per 100 g, they're ideal for weight loss.
tips_zh: 杏鲍菇含有高蛋白、低脂肪和人体必需的各种氨基酸，更重要的是含有丰富的多糖类物质和膳食纤维，可以提高人体免疫功能
tips_en: Pleurotus eryngii contains high protein, low fat and various amino acids necessary for the human body. More importantly, it is rich in polysaccharides and dietary fiber, which can improve human immune function.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 杏鲍菇洗净，切片，香葱切碎；
steps.content_en: Wash and slice the king oyster mushrooms; chop the scallions;

steps.content_zh: 加入适量盐、白糖、胡椒粉和几滴橄榄油，可以加少量水，抓匀；码盘后放入蒸笼，锅内加适量水，盖上盖子启动电饭煲；
steps.content_en: Add an appropriate amount of salt, sugar, pepper and a few drops of olive oil. You can also add a small amount of water and mix well. Put the steamer in the plate, add an appropriate amount of water to the pot, cover the lid and start the rice cooker;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪完成后撒上葱花，出锅。
steps.content_en: After cooking, sprinkle with chopped scallion and serve.

description_zh: 天气变得炎热，人们感觉不到一丝凉风，迎面扑过来的是一层又一层的热浪。红丝、绿丝、糯米、冬瓜糖、蜜枣、薄荷等等，吃起来起来甜丝丝的，还有浓浓的薄荷味，这一碗独异于全国的绿豆汤一口下去就能驱散暑气。
description_en: The weather turns hot, with no hint of a breeze—just wave after wave of heat. Red and green candied strips, glutinous rice, winter melon candy, honey dates and mint make this uniquely delicious mung bean soup sweet and minty; one sip drives the heat away.
tips_zh:
1、苏州绿豆汤讲究清澈的汤水，糯米和绿豆都要整粒的，所以煮绿豆的时候水不要加多。
2、绿豆汤中的食材可以根据个人口味添加。
tips_en:
1. Suzhou mung bean soup is prized for its clear broth and whole grains of rice and beans, so don't add too much water when cooking the beans.
2. Add other ingredients to the soup to taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 绿豆和糯米洗净后提前一晚在冰箱中浸泡；
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and glutinous rice and soak in the refrigerator overnight in advance;

steps.content_zh: 浸泡好的糯米滤干放到垫有纱布的蒸笼中，绿豆倒入锅中加水与绿豆齐平，选择快煮模式40分钟；
steps.content_en: Drain the soaked glutinous rice and place in a steamer lined with cheesecloth. Put the mung beans in the pot, add water to level with them, and select Quick Cook for 40 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 取一个奶锅，加入1升纯净水倒入冰糖小火煮融化后滴入两滴薄荷精油，冷却后放到冰箱中冷藏；
steps.content_en: Take a milk pot, add 1 liter of purified water, add rock sugar, simmer over low heat until it melts, add two drops of peppermint essential oil, cool and place in the refrigerator;

steps.content_zh: 挖一勺煮好并冷却的绿豆和糯米垫底，放上冬瓜糖、蜜枣、葡萄干、金桔、红绿丝，倒入薄荷水即可。
steps.content_en: Dig a spoonful of cooked and cooled mung beans and glutinous rice on the bottom, add winter melon sugar, candied dates, raisins, kumquats, red and green shreds, and pour in mint water.

description_zh: 天气逐渐闷热潮湿，宜多吃具有祛暑益气、生津止渴的饮食。丝瓜微凉味甘、清热祛暑，与鸡肉同煮成粥，清香软糯，简单爽口。
description_en: As the weather grows muggy and humid, eat more foods that relieve heat, replenish qi and promote fluids. Loofah is slightly cool and sweet, clearing heat and summer fire; cooked into porridge with chicken, it's fragrant, soft and simply refreshing.
tips_zh: 丝瓜可以在最后半个小时的时候放入，防止煮了太烂。
tips_en: The loofah can be put in during the last half hour to prevent it from being overcooked.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 丝瓜洗净去皮，香菇泡发；
steps.content_en: Wash and peel the loofah and soak the mushrooms;

steps.content_zh: 丝瓜切丁，鸡肉躲成茸，香菇、生姜、彩椒、香葱切碎；
steps.content_en: Dice the loofah, mince the chicken, chop the mushrooms, ginger, colored peppers, and chives;

steps.content_zh: 鸡茸中加入香菇丁、姜末、盐和胡椒粉腌制；
steps.content_en: Add diced mushrooms, minced ginger, salt and pepper to the minced chicken;

steps.content_zh: 大米洗净后倒入锅中，加入清水到水位线：稠粥-1的刻度，选择煮粥90分钟；
steps.content_en: Wash the rice and pour it into the pot, add water to the water level: thick porridge -1 scale, choose to cook porridge for 90 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余30分钟时倒入鸡茸；
steps.content_en: When 30 minutes of cooking time remain, add chicken mince;

steps.content_zh: 剩余10分钟时倒入丝瓜、彩椒，用盐、胡椒粉调味，出锅后撒上葱花即可。
steps.content_en: When 10 minutes are left, add loofah and colored peppers, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle with chopped green onion after serving.

description_zh: 清热解暑安神的家常汤。
description_en: A home-style soup that clears heat, relieves summer heat, and calms the mind.
tips_zh: 如果用新鲜的莲子，要去除莲子心。
tips_en: If using fresh lotus seeds, remove the heart.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 绿豆和莲子洗净，浸泡30分钟；
steps.content_en: Wash the mung beans and lotus seeds and soak for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 将泡好的绿豆和莲子同时放入锅中，加水到最大水位线，盖上盖子启动烹饪模式；
steps.content_en: Put the soaked mung beans and lotus seeds into the pot at the same time, add water to the maximum water level, cover the lid and start the cooking mode;

steps.content_zh: 鲜百合洗净浸泡在水中；
steps.content_en: Wash the fresh lily bulbs and soak in water;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪结束前10分钟放入鲜百合和冰糖即可。
steps.content_en: Add fresh lily bulbs and rock sugar 10 minutes before cooking ends.

description_zh:
海南鸡饭起源于海南的文昌鸡，但是它是新加坡的国菜。
海南鸡饭除了鲜嫩爽口的鸡肉，香茅鸡油饭也必不可少。粒粒分明的泰国香米，每一粒都有鸡油和香茅的味道。饭粒被鸡油包裹，散发浅浅光泽，香氲缭绕，入嘴是一抹余温，与舌尖湿度完美融合，若无鸡，也能生吞两碗。
description_en:
Hainanese chicken rice originated from Wenchang chicken in Hainan, but it is the national dish of Singapore.
In addition to the tender and delicious chicken in Hainanese chicken rice, lemongrass chicken oil rice is also a must-have. The grains of Thai fragrant rice are distinct, each grain has the flavor of chicken fat and lemongrass. The rice grains are wrapped in chicken fat, exuding a light luster and lingering fragrance. There is a lingering warmth in the mouth, which perfectly blends with the moisture on the tip of the tongue. If there is no chicken, you can still swallow two bowls raw.
tips_zh:
1、买不到现成的鸡油可以用煎鸡皮，煎出的油脂就是鸡油了。
2、所有的香料都不可替换。
tips_en:
1. If you can’t buy ready-made chicken oil, you can use fried chicken skin. The fat produced by frying is chicken oil.
2. All spices are irreplaceable.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸡油饭用的米是长粒泰国米；
steps.content_en: The rice used for chicken rice is long-grain Thai rice;

steps.content_zh: 浸泡30分钟；
steps.content_en: Soak for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 红葱头去皮一开二、南姜去皮切片、香茅取下半部去皮拍松；
steps.content_en: Peel and halve shallots, peel and slice galangal, remove half of lemongrass, peel and fluff;

steps.content_zh: 将鸡皮和香料同时放到锅中，小火慢慢煎出鸡油；
steps.content_en: Put the chicken skin and spices into the pot at the same time, and slowly fry the chicken fat over low heat;

steps.content_zh: 煎出鸡油后取出香料和鸡皮，鸡皮丢弃；
steps.content_en: Once the chicken fat is rendered, remove the spices and chicken skin, and discard the skin;

steps.content_zh: 倒入泡好、滤干的泰国米；
steps.content_en: Pour in the soaked and drained Thai rice;

steps.content_zh: 放入盐和鸡精炒均匀；
steps.content_en: Add salt and chicken essence and stir-fry evenly;

steps.content_zh: 把炒好的米倒入饭煲锅胆中，加入鸡汤（煮鸡的汤）到丝苗米-2的刻度，铺上炒好的香料，然后开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour the fried rice into the rice cooker pot, add chicken stock (the soup used to cook the chicken) to the level of -2 for the shredded rice, add the fried spices, and start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 香茅鸡油饭就做好啦。
steps.content_en: The lemongrass chicken fat rice is ready.

description_zh: 即使是空巢青年，即使要赶着上班，早晨出门前也能喝碗热腾腾的稀饭。
description_en: Even empty nesters, even if they have to rush to work, can still drink a bowl of hot porridge before going out in the morning.
tips_zh:
当然最后一步也可以不加牛奶直接加水，没有牛奶味的稀饭是谷物原香也很滋润的。
锅胆座入电饭煲合盖，利用预约功能设置好第二天一早的开饭时间，就可以放心地睡觉，然后起床上班前就能享用热气腾腾的非常滋润的小米稀饭了。
我自己喝前喜欢加一点糖，当然有人就喜欢原香。
tips_en:
Of course, you can skip the milk and just use water—without milk, the porridge has a pure grain aroma and is still nourishing.
Set the inner pot in the cooker, close the lid and use the timer for the next morning; then sleep easy and enjoy a steaming, nourishing millet porridge before work. I like a little sugar in mine, but others prefer it plain.

steps.content_zh: 用量杯盛1/2杯小米，根据个人口味和家里储备可以添加少许绿豆、大米，或者其他豆子、麦仁等等。
steps.content_en: Use a measuring cup to hold 1/2 cup of millet. You can add a little mung beans, rice, or other beans, wheat kernels, etc. according to your personal taste and household reserves.

steps.content_zh: 准备1包牛奶。其实加上牛奶有牛奶口味，感觉蛮不错；不加牛奶也就是一碗普通的稀饭，也很不错。
steps.content_en: Prepare 1 packet of milk. In fact, with the addition of milk, it tastes like milk, which feels pretty good; without the addition of milk, it is just a bowl of ordinary porridge, which is also very good.

steps.content_zh: 小米和添加的一些辅料在碗中淘洗干净，我一般淘两次，都沥掉水。
steps.content_en: Wash the millet and some added accessories in a bowl. I usually wash it twice and drain off the water.

steps.content_zh: 小米倒进锅胆里，有水是我用来冲掉碗边的米粒的。
steps.content_en: Pour the millet into the pot, and use the water to wash away the rice grains on the edge of the bowl.

steps.content_zh: 倒进1袋牛奶，然后加水至合适水位线。因为是煮稀饭，我个人偏好稀稠适中的，所以1/2杯的米加水至稠的这边½水位线处。后续可以根据需求量和个人口感微调。
steps.content_en: Pour in one bag of milk, then add water to the appropriate water line. Since this is thin porridge and I prefer a medium consistency, I use 1/2 cup of rice with water up to the thick-porridge ½ line. Adjust later to taste and quantity.

steps.content_zh: 完成后即可享用哦。
steps.content_en: Enjoy when finished.

description_zh: 听说要排两公里的路去买网红青团，有这个时间不如自己研究下怎么做，豆沙、三丁、肉松馅儿，喜欢吃啥就包啥。
description_en: I heard that I have to line up for two kilometers to buy the Internet-famous Youth League. If I have this time, I might as well study how to make it by myself. I can make it with bean paste, sandwich, and meat floss fillings. I can make whatever I like.
tips_zh:
1、粘米粉就是普通的大米粉。
2、如果没有艾草粉，可以用新年的艾草或者菠菜煮熟后打成汁。
3、完成后刷油是为了增加光泽，以防表皮发硬。
tips_en:
1. Rice flour is just ordinary rice flour.
2. If you don’t have mugwort powder, you can use New Year mugwort or spinach to cook and beat into juice.
3. Apply oil after completion to increase the gloss and prevent the skin from becoming hard.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 艾草粉中加入100克水调成艾草汁；
steps.content_en: Add 100 g of water to the mugwort powder to make mugwort juice;

steps.content_zh: 糯米粉和粘米粉混合均匀；
steps.content_en: Mix the glutinous rice flour and rice flour well;

steps.content_zh: 倒入艾草汁后，再适量倒入水将米粉揉成团；(水要缓缓倒入，不可一次性加入太多)
steps.content_en: After pouring in the mugwort juice, add an appropriate amount of water and knead the rice noodles into a ball; (water should be poured in slowly, do not add too much at one time)

steps.content_zh: 取红豆沙，揉成团；
steps.content_en: Take red bean paste and knead it into a ball;

steps.content_zh: 取一些面团用手掌拍成面皮，放上豆沙馅儿；
steps.content_en: Take some dough and pat it into a dough with your palms, then put the bean paste filling on it;

steps.content_zh: 揉成圆球形
steps.content_en: Roll into a round ball

steps.content_zh: 蒸笼中垫上油纸；锅胆中加水到水位线：东北米-2，点击手机开始烹饪图标进行烹饪；
steps.content_en: Line the steamer with parchment; add water to the inner pot to the Northeast Rice-2 level, then tap Start Cooking on the app;

steps.content_zh: 准备一些橄榄油完成后刷在青团表面；
steps.content_en: Prepare some olive oil and brush it on the surface of the green dough;

steps.content_zh: 趁热吃吧。
steps.content_en: Eat it while it's hot.

name_en: Taro puree, meat floss and green dumplings
description_zh: 包教包会，不好吃退款，独家秘制的芋泥肉松青团。
description_en: Guaranteed instruction, refund if not delicious, exclusive secret recipe of taro paste and meat floss green dumplings.
tips_zh:
1、一次吃不完，可以刷油后包上保鲜膜保存。
2、调制青团皮的时候要慢慢的加水，揉成软硬适中的糯米粉团。
tips_en:
1. If you can't finish them, brush with oil and wrap in plastic wrap to store.
2. Add water gradually when making the dough, kneading to a medium-firm consistency.

steps.content_zh: 先调制青团馅料；
steps.content_en: Prepare the green dumpling filling first;

steps.content_zh: 荔浦芋头去皮；
steps.content_en: Peel the Lipu taro;

steps.content_zh: 切块；
steps.content_en: cut into pieces;

steps.content_zh: 电饭煲中放入清水，将切好的芋头块放到蒸笼中，盖上电饭煲蒸30分钟；
steps.content_en: Pour water into the rice cooker, place the cut taro pieces into the steamer, cover the rice cooker and steam for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 蒸芋头的时候准备青团的皮；
steps.content_en: While steaming the taro, prepare the skin of the green dumpling;

steps.content_zh: 艾草粉加入100克温水，调匀后加入糯米粉、粘米粉，再缓缓加入清水揉成软硬适中的面团；
steps.content_en: Add 100 g of warm water to the mugwort powder, mix well, then add glutinous rice flour and rice flour, and gradually add water to knead into a dough of medium firmness;

steps.content_zh: 30分钟后芋头蒸好了；
steps.content_en: After 30 minutes, the taro will be steamed;

steps.content_zh: 芋头中加入蛋黄酱、牛奶压成芋头泥，再放入肉松拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Mash the taro with mayonnaise and milk, then mix in the pork floss until smooth;

steps.content_zh: 取一块青团皮，压扁后放入馅料，包好；
steps.content_en: Take a piece of green dough skin, flatten it, add the fillings, and wrap it up;

steps.content_zh: 揉圆；
steps.content_en: Roll into a ball;

steps.content_zh: 一次将剩余的皮和馅料都做成青团；
steps.content_en: Form the remaining skin and filling into green dough at one time;

steps.content_zh: 电饭煲中继续加水，将青团放到蒸笼中，继续蒸20分钟；
steps.content_en: Add more water to the rice cooker, put the qingtuan in the steamer, and steam for another 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 蒸好；
steps.content_en: Steamed;

steps.content_zh: 表面上刷一层橄榄油；
steps.content_en: Brush a layer of olive oil on the surface;

steps.content_zh: 剩下的继续蒸；
steps.content_en: Continue to steam the rest;

steps.content_zh: 完成！
steps.content_en: Finish!

description_zh: 春采笋、蕨之嫩者，以汤瀹过。取鱼虾之鲜者，同切作块子。用汤泡，暴蒸熟，入酱、油、盐，研胡椒，同绿豆粉皮拌匀，加滴醋。今后苑多进此，名“虾鱼笋蕨兜”。“趁得山家笋蕨春，借厨烹煮自吹薪。倩谁分我杯羹去，寄与中朝食肉人。”（《山家清供•山海兜》）
description_en: In spring, blanch tender bamboo shoots and ferns in broth. Cut fresh fish and shrimp into pieces, soak in broth, then steam until done. Add soy sauce, oil, salt, and ground pepper; mix with mung bean sheets and a few drops of vinegar. This is often served in the imperial gardens, called 'Shrimp, Fish, Bamboo Shoot and Fern Pot.' 'I caught the spring of mountain bamboo shoots and ferns, borrowed a kitchen to cook them while tending the fire. Who can I share a bowl with? Send it to the meat-eaters at court.' (Shan Jia Qing Gong · Shan Hai Dou)
tips_zh:
1、煮好鱼虾的水不要倒掉，用来蒸制山海兜味道更鲜美。
2、包山海兜的时候可以在粉皮上抹水淀粉增强黏性。
3、蒸的时候注意山海兜不要被水打湿了。
tips_en:
1. Don't discard the water used to cook the fish and shrimp—use it to steam the sea-and-mountain dumplings for extra umami.
2. When wrapping, brush the starch sheet with a little starch slurry to help it seal.
3. While steaming, make sure the dumplings don't get soaked by water.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 新鲜的鳜鱼去骨，取净肉；
steps.content_en: Debone the fresh mandarin fish and take the fillets.

steps.content_zh: 切丁；
steps.content_en: dice;

steps.content_zh: 蕨菜切丁；
steps.content_en: Dice the bracken fern;

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾取虾仁，切丁；
steps.content_en: Peel the fresh shrimp and dice the meat;

steps.content_zh: 竹笋去壳，切丁；
steps.content_en: Husk the bamboo shoots and dice;

steps.content_zh: 锅中加水，放入2克盐和20毫升花雕酒，煮沸后倒入笋丁和蕨菜丁，煮2分钟后捞出；
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot with 2 g salt and 20 ml Huadiao wine; once boiled, add the diced bamboo shoots and bracken fern, cook for 2 minutes and drain;

steps.content_zh: 关火，放入鳜鱼丁和虾仁丁泡到鱼肉变白后捞出；
steps.content_en: Turn off the heat, add diced mandarin fish and diced shrimp and soak until the fish meat turns white, then take it out;

steps.content_zh: 绿豆粉皮在清水中浸泡软后，切成直径10厘米左右的等边三角形；
steps.content_en: Soak the mung bean sheet jelly in water until soft, then cut into equilateral triangles about 10 cm across;

steps.content_zh: 将绿豆粉皮的边角料、笋丁、蕨菜丁、桂鱼丁、虾仁丁，混合加入盐、黑胡椒粉、芝麻油搅拌；
steps.content_en: Mix the mung bean flour scraps, diced bamboo shoots, diced bracken, diced mandarin fish, and diced shrimp, add salt, black pepper, and sesame oil; stir;

steps.content_zh: 包好后放到蒸笼中（蒸笼垫上蒸纸），入锅蒸3分钟；
steps.content_en: After wrapping, place it in a steamer (lined with steaming paper) and steam for 3 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 完成后蘸醋食用。
steps.content_en: When finished, serve with vinegar.

name_en: Coconut milk black rice sweet soup
description_zh: 椰汁系列的糖水，称得上是粤港糖水的经典了。原本普通的糖水汤底换成香浓的椰汁，吃起来味道更丰富，欲罢不能。
description_en: Coconut-milk sweet soups are a classic of Cantonese and Hong Kong desserts. Swapping an ordinary soup base for rich coconut milk makes them more flavorful and utterly irresistible.
tips_zh: 红豆和黑米要提前浸泡，最好可以放到锅中预约到第二天早上完成。
tips_en: Red beans and black rice need to be soaked in advance. It is best to put them in the pot and reserve them until the next morning.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 红豆和黑米洗净浸泡最少2小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the red beans and black rice and soak them for at least 2 hours;

steps.content_zh: 紫薯去皮切丁；
steps.content_en: Peel and dice the purple sweet potato;

steps.content_zh: 将黑米、红豆和紫薯同时放入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥1的刻度，盖上盖子开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Put black rice, red beans and purple sweet potatoes into the pot at the same time, add water to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark, cover the lid and start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 烹饪时间剩余10分钟开盖；
steps.content_en: Open the lid with 10 minutes left in the cooking time;

steps.content_zh: 倒入浓缩椰汁搅拌；
steps.content_en: Pour in the coconut milk concentrate and stir;

steps.content_zh: 可以根据个人口味放入适量糖调味
steps.content_en: You can add an appropriate amount of sugar to taste according to your personal taste

description_zh: 春夏之交，乍暖还寒。煮锅糖水滋补一下更为适宜。
description_en: At the turn of spring and summer, it turns warm and cold. It is more appropriate to boil sugar water in a pot to nourish it.
tips_zh:
1、处理山药的时候要带上手套，或者用火烤一下，防止手痒。
2、想要银耳变得更糯，第一需要提前浸泡、第二煮好以后保温2小时效果会更好。银耳的质量也很重要。
tips_en:
1. Wear gloves when handling yams, or roast them over fire to prevent itchy hands.
2. If you want the white fungus to become waxier, you first need to soak it in advance, and second, keep it warm for 2 hours after cooking, the effect will be better. The quality of Tremella fuciformis is also important.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 银耳撕小块用温水浸泡至少3小时；
steps.content_en: Tear the snow fungus into small pieces and soak in warm water for at least 3 hours;

steps.content_zh: 红枣洗净；
steps.content_en: Wash the red dates;

steps.content_zh: 山药去皮切块；
steps.content_en: Peel and cut yam into pieces;

steps.content_zh: 将所有的食材倒入锅中，加水到水位线：稠粥1的刻度。盖上盖子开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Pour all the ingredients into the pot and add water to the water level: thick porridge 1 mark. Cover and start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 剩余10分钟时倒入冰糖搅拌；
steps.content_en: When 10 minutes remain, add rock sugar and stir;

steps.content_zh: 完成！
steps.content_en: Finish!

description_zh: 清新脱俗又低脂，温馨暖胃腔调高。茶泡饭在日本语中写作“茶漬け”（ちゃづけ），在今天，一些用肉汤、白开水的泡饭也会被统称为“茶泡饭”。这样制作出来的饭具有清香味。
description_en: Light, refreshing, and low-fat—a cozy, stomach-warming dish with real style. Ochazuke is the Japanese term for tea-soaked rice; today, rice soaked in broth or plain hot water is also called ochazuke. The result is a fragrant, delicate dish.
tips_zh:
1、除了鲑鱼还能用鳕鱼、比目鱼、金枪鱼等等无刺的鱼。
2、绿茶根据个人喜好选择。
tips_en:
1. Besides salmon, you can use cod, flounder, tuna, or other boneless fish.
2. Choose any green tea you like.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 2杯米淘洗干净后加水到东北米2的刻度线，盖上盖子开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Rinse 2 cups of rice, add water to the Northeast rice level 2 line, cover, and start cooking.

steps.content_zh: 煮米的时候准备制作玄米茶，选择自己喜欢的绿茶；
steps.content_en: While cooking the rice, prepare the brown rice tea using your favorite green tea;

steps.content_zh: 玄米又称为糙米，选择优质的糙米来制作；
steps.content_en: Brown rice is also called xuanmi; choose high-quality brown rice for this;

steps.content_zh: 玄米倒入炒锅中，小火慢慢煎炒到深棕色即可；
steps.content_en: Pour the brown rice into a pan and stir-fry over low heat until deep brown;

steps.content_zh: 与绿茶混合后就是玄米茶；
steps.content_en: When mixed with green tea, it becomes genmaicha;

steps.content_zh: 味噌稀释后腌制三文鱼；
steps.content_en: Dilute miso and marinate salmon;

steps.content_zh: 用烤箱烤180℃ 20分钟，或者煎锅小火慢慢煎熟；
steps.content_en: Bake in the oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, or fry in a frying pan over low heat until done;

steps.content_zh: 煮一壶水，沸腾后加入玄米茶，浸泡3分钟；
steps.content_en: Boil a kettle of water, add the brown rice tea after it boils, and steep for 3 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 米饭煮好后盛出，摆上紫苏梅和烤好的三文鱼，再挤一点芥末；
steps.content_en: When the rice is done, plate it, top with perilla plums and the baked salmon, then squeeze on a little mustard;

steps.content_zh: 淋上沏好的茶，撒上海苔丝和芝麻；
steps.content_en: Pour over the brewed tea and sprinkle with shredded nori and sesame seeds;

steps.content_zh: 完成！
steps.content_en: Finish!

description_zh: 这道菜粽香糯米鸡解决了不会包粽子的苦恼，包教包会，味道绝美。
description_en: This zongzi-style sticky rice chicken saves you from wrapping leaves—easy to learn and delicious.
tips_zh:
1、新鲜的粽子叶洗净、煮沸杀菌后使用。干粽叶，在清水中浸泡8小时后，煮沸使用。
2、糯米中还以加入青豆、玉米粒等蔬菜。
tips_en:
1. Wash fresh zongzi leaves and boil to sterilize before using. For dried leaves, soak in water for 8 hours, then boil.
2. You can add green peas, corn kernels, or other vegetables to the glutinous rice.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 干香菇温水泡发后切片；
steps.content_en: Soak dried shiitake mushrooms in warm water and slice into slices;

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿去骨、切块；
steps.content_en: Debone the chicken thigh and cut into chunks;

steps.content_zh: 鸡腿肉和香菇中加入蚝油、生抽、老抽、白糖、白胡椒粉拌匀后放到冰箱中冷藏30分钟腌制；
steps.content_en: Add oyster sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, and white pepper to the chicken thighs and shiitake mushrooms, mix well, then refrigerate for 30 minutes to marinate;

steps.content_zh: 糯米提前4小时浸泡，滤干水分后加入老抽、五香粉、盐拌匀；
steps.content_en: Soak the glutinous rice 4 hours in advance, drain the water, add dark soy sauce, five-spice powder, and salt and mix well;

steps.content_zh: 取三片粽叶，如图成十字放置；
steps.content_en: Take three rice dumpling leaves and place them in a cross shape as shown;

steps.content_zh: 放上糯米腌制好的鸡肉；
steps.content_en: Add the chicken marinated with glutinous rice;

steps.content_zh: 抱起来，用线捆绑；
steps.content_en: Pick it up and tie it with a thread;

steps.content_zh: 锅中放入足量的水（水位线3杯米的刻度），将包好的糯米鸡放入电饭煲中，盖上电饭开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Add plenty of water to the pot (water level line for 3 cups of rice), put the wrapped sticky rice chicken in the rice cooker, cover and start cooking;

steps.content_zh: 完成后稍微放凉；
steps.content_en: Let cool slightly when done;

steps.content_zh: 趁热享用。
steps.content_en: Serve hot.

description_zh:
“椰树之上采琼浆，捧来一碗白玉香”，清补凉的含义就是清火消暑、补充营养、感受凉意。清补凉是海南最有特色的小吃之一也是夏季最常见的小饮品。
洁白的椰奶、粉糯的绿豆、红豆、薏米搭配各种当季水果，美味可口、清凉解暑。
description_en:
"Pick nectar from the coconut trees and hold a bowl of white jade incense." Qingbuliang means to clear the fire, relieve the heat, replenish nutrition, and feel the coolness. Qingbuliang is one of the most unique snacks in Hainan and the most common small drink in summer.
White coconut milk, pink and waxy mung beans, red beans, and barley are paired with various seasonal fruits, which are delicious, refreshing and refreshing.
tips_zh:
1、冷藏后更美味哦，但是不要贪凉吃太多。
2、水果根据个人喜好搭配。
tips_en:
1. It tastes even better chilled, but don't overdo it.
2. Use any fruit you like.

steps.content_zh: 红豆、绿豆、燕麦、薏米洗净，浸泡2小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the adzuki beans, mung beans, oats and Job's tears, then soak for 2 hours;

steps.content_zh: 放入锅中，加入水到水位线：粥1的刻度，加入冰糖，选择煮粥2小时。煮好后冷却，放到冰箱中冰镇；
steps.content_en: Put in the pot, add water to the porridge 1 level and some rock sugar, select Porridge for 2 hours; cool, then chill in the fridge.

steps.content_zh: 煮粥的时候烧一锅水，放入西米约煮20分，煮到透明，放入冷水中冲洗干净；
steps.content_en: While cooking the porridge, boil a pot of water, add the tapioca pearls and cook about 20 minutes until transparent, then rinse in cold water;

steps.content_zh: 换一锅水，煮沸后放入芋圆，煮到漂浮起来后捞出，冲洗干净；
steps.content_en: Change a pot of water, bring it to a boil, add the taro balls, cook until they float, take them out, and rinse;

steps.content_zh: 仙草切成块；
steps.content_en: Cut grass jelly into pieces;

steps.content_zh: 菠萝切丁；
steps.content_en: Dice the pineapple;

steps.content_zh: 椰子切开，倒出椰汁椰肉切条；
steps.content_en: Cut the coconut, pour out the coconut milk and cut the coconut meat into strips;

steps.content_zh: 用煮好的杂粮垫底，一次放上各种辅料，最后倒上椰汁或者椰奶；
steps.content_en: Use the cooked cereals as the base, put all the accessories at once, and finally pour coconut juice or coconut milk;

steps.content_zh: 完成。
steps.content_en: Finish.

description_zh: 肋排用众口皆宜的奥尔良腌粉充分腌制入味，再用电饭煲先煲后焖，直到肉香四溢，轻轻松松就可脱骨，大口吃肉最是过瘾！
description_en: Marinate the ribs thoroughly in crowd-pleasing Orleans seasoning, then simmer and steam them in the rice cooker until the meat is fragrant and falls off the bone easily. Big bites of meat are pure satisfaction!
tips_zh: 排骨要选用新鲜的肋排，肉质鲜嫩，不要买成脊骨了。
tips_en: Use fresh pork ribs with tender meat—not backbone.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 肋排浸入冷水中，浸泡半小时泡出血水；
steps.content_en: Soak the ribs in cold water for half an hour to soak them in the bleeding water;

steps.content_zh: 排骨加奥尔良腌制粉、老抽、10毫升清水，抓匀腌制1小时入味
steps.content_en: Add Orleans marinated pork ribs, dark soy sauce, and 10 ml of water, mix well and marinate for 1 hour to add flavor.

steps.content_zh: 电饭煲内胆刷油，垫姜片、葱段，排骨入锅再加10毫升清水，盖上饭煲选择蒸煮模式30分钟；
steps.content_en: Brush oil in the inner pot, line with ginger slices and scallion sections, add the ribs and 10 ml water, close the lid, and select Steam for 30 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 煮完自动保温，再焖20分钟。出锅前撒一把白芝麻，排骨酥烂香浓，用手就可以轻松脱骨。
steps.content_en: After cooking, it keeps warm automatically; let stand another 20 minutes. Sprinkle with white sesame seeds before serving. The ribs are tender and richly flavored, and the meat comes off the bone easily.

description_zh: 新加坡绿豆爽据说是新加坡最受欢迎的甜品之一，在新加坡当地经常搭配油条一起食用。
description_en: Singapore mung bean dessert is said to be one of Singapore's most popular sweets, often eaten there with fried dough sticks.
tips_zh: 去皮绿豆和香兰叶是此甜品的灵魂，煮好的绿豆爽口感顺滑，香气宜人。
tips_en: Peeled mung beans and pandan leaves are the soul of this dessert. The cooked mung beans have a smooth texture and pleasant aroma.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 去皮绿豆提前洗净，用清水浸泡2小时；
steps.content_en: Wash the peeled mung beans in advance and soak them in water for 2 hours;

steps.content_zh: 香兰叶切成小段；
steps.content_en: Cut the pandan leaves into short pieces;

steps.content_zh: 泡好的绿豆放入锅胆，加水至：稠粥1的刻度；
steps.content_en: Put the soaked mung beans into the pot and add water to the thickness of porridge 1;

steps.content_zh: 加入香兰叶、白砂糖、盐，搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Add pandan leaves, sugar, and salt and stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 盖上锅盖，点击开始烹饪；
steps.content_en: Cover with the lid and tap Start Cooking;

steps.content_zh: 生粉加入150ml水制成水淀粉。
steps.content_en: Mix the cornstarch with 150 ml water to make a slurry.

steps.content_zh: 剩余5分钟时打开锅盖倒入水淀粉，不停搅拌直到汤汁浓稠；
steps.content_en: When 5 minutes are left, open the lid and pour in the water starch, stirring constantly until the soup thickens;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧
steps.content_en: Start enjoying

description_zh: 鸡油饭在新加坡是相当受欢迎的一道餐点，制作原料主要有泰国香米、鸡油、香兰叶等。
description_en: Chicken fat rice is quite popular in Singapore; its main ingredients include Thai jasmine rice, chicken fat, and pandan leaves.
tips_zh: 煮米饭的时候加入文昌鸡的鸡油以及香兰叶等调料，煮出来的米饭油香四溢、粒粒饱满，真是怎么吃都不会腻。
tips_en: Add Wenchang chicken fat and pandan leaves when cooking the rice; the result is fragrant, plump rice that never gets old.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 姜切片，香兰叶切成小段，大蒜拍扁
steps.content_en: Slice ginger, cut pandan leaves into small pieces, and flatten garlic

steps.content_zh: 泰国香米洗净，放入锅胆，加水至：丝苗米2的刻度
steps.content_en: Wash the Thai jasmine rice, place in the inner pot, and add water to the 'Si Miao rice 2' line

steps.content_zh: 加入所有食材及调料，搅拌均匀
steps.content_en: Add all ingredients and seasonings and stir evenly

steps.content_zh: 盖上锅盖，点击开始烹饪
steps.content_en: Cover with the lid and tap Start Cooking

steps.content_zh: 完成后除去香兰叶、姜、蒜，拌匀即可
steps.content_en: When finished, remove the pandan leaves, ginger, and garlic and mix well.
